rows.original: Upon walking into the inn, you immediately notice a newcomer – a tall, armored woman seated at the bar who is clearly not from around here. She has a longsword at her hip, and she's in conversation with Garth. Her armor is quite ornate, not to mention somewhat risque in places. Interesting...

rows.original: Alice is a striking sight, to say the least. Her face is flawlessly pretty, marked in places by religious piercings. With her facing you like this, you can see under her hood perfectly well, though from some angles it casts shadows across her face. Clasped at her shoulder by a Tiran symbol, her well-worn cloak flows down her back, the mark of any traveller. Her voluptuous bosom is held tightly by her breastplate, though a sizeable gap in the middle allows you a view of the center and underside of her enormous breasts, as well as the incredible cleavage created in their union. She's wearing a mesh top under the armor that covers her chest and stomach, extending all the way up her neck. The entire arrangement is, to put it lightly, dangerously eye-catching. She wears the trousers you might expect from any traveller, though with an accoutrement of chains and leather pads that identify her as a would-be combatant if the full-sized shield and longsword weren't enough of a clue. Her shield is emblazoned with the flowers of Yvennes, silver and red, and accompanied by images evoking Tira. [var0 |You know from your fun with her that the body under the armor is scarred, tattooed, and beautiful. She maintains a warrior's build in service of the innocent, though both her upper and lower half are all curves in the right places. Her mons pubis has a light layer of black hair, and you find yourself recalling the pleasant sensation of running your fingers across it. Alice gives you a smile as if she knows what you're thinking about. Though that can't be possible – can it? ]
rows.translation: 至少可以说，爱丽丝的外表非常引人注目。 她的脸庞完美无瑕，某些部位还戴着宗教风格的穿孔饰品。 当她这样面对你时，你可以清楚地看到她兜帽下的模样，不过从某些角度看，兜帽会在她脸上投下阴影。她肩头用一枚蒂拉的徽记扣住那件破旧的外袍，外袍顺着后背垂下，正是所有旅人都会有的装扮。 她那丰满的胸部被胸甲紧紧包裹着，不过胸甲中间有一道较大的缝隙，因此你可以看到她那巨大胸部的中部和下方，以及它们挤在一起所形成的惊人乳沟。她在覆盖胸部和腹部的护甲里面穿了一件网眼上衣，这件上衣一直延伸到她的颈部。整个穿着搭配，说得轻描淡写一点，危险地引人注目。 她穿的裤子正是任何旅行者都会选择的那种，不过她身上还佩戴着链条和皮革护具，这些装饰清楚地表明她是一名准备参与战斗的人——即便那面全尺寸的盾牌和长剑已经足以说明这一点。她的盾牌上绘着银红色相间的伊文尼斯之花，同时还有一些象征蒂拉的图案。 [var0 |你从与她的欢好中得知，那身铠甲下的身体布满伤痕，也有纹身，但却依然美丽动人。她保持着战士般的体态，只为守护那些无辜的人；她的上半身与下半身都拥有恰到好处的曲线。她的阴部覆盖着一层淡淡的黑色毛发，你不禁回想起手指拂过那里时那种愉悦的触感。 爱丽丝对你笑了笑，仿佛她知道你在想什么。不过，那不可能——对吧？ ]

rows.original: [alice.evePath |"What was it like getting from Garonne to Yvennes?" you ask. "I was actually not in Garonne when I received the order," Alice says. "A messenger was dispatched to the border village I had been staying in. I had finished my business there anyway, which was fortuitous timing. I would not have left otherwise." "What were you doing there?" you say. "Taking care of a small group of bandits," she says. "The crown has been coming down upon criminals ever-harder as of recent times. They had taken up residence further from its influence and started threatening the villagers into compliance. By now, they are likely rotting in a cell." "You handled the group alone?" you say. Alice nods. "Each paladin of our order is a gifted combatant. We often work alone. After I was done with them, I rode back to the capital on the instruction of the royal family. Such was the urgency of the request I hardly slept the first few nights. As I entered the Marches, though, I realized the necessity." "It's a hard land," you agree. "Hard is a good word for it," she says. "It gives rise to a hardy people, though they have been friendly to me at every turn. I travelled alongside others, trading protection for company. But none would come close to the territories that surround Hawkethorne, so I had to make my way on foot. There are too many potential dangers to merchants and travellers. Centaur marauders in the Foothills, living plants in the Frostwood. Even the wolves to the north are uncharacteristically aggressive." "Most people aren't going to be able to defend themselves," you reflect. "Exactly," Alice says, gesturing with her mug. "Life is not so tumultuous that the average person knows how to effectively wield a sword. Coming here is gambling with your life for normal people. The roads are not safe. Trade is an impossible concept. I have heard that the kingdom of Khor'minos has withdrawn into the mountain." "I've been there," you say. "They've retreated into the capital to deal with internal issues." "A sign of weakness," she sighs. "The spectre of death hangs over an isolated kingdom. Centaur marauders in the Foothills, living plants in the Frostwood. Even the wolves to the north are uncharacteristically aggressive." "Life is not so tumultuous that the average person knows how to effectively wield a sword. Coming here is gambling with your life for normal people. The roads are not safe. Trade is an impossible concept. I have heard that the kingdom of Khor'minos has withdrawn into the mountain." "I've been there," you say. "They've retreated into the capital to deal with internal issues." "A sign of weakness," she sighs. "The spectre of death hangs over an isolated kingdom. The coming years will be an interesting period. But yes, I made my way to Hawkethorne in search of a Yvennese princess. It turned out she was staying here in this very inn. rows.translation: [alice.evePath|前往鹰棘镇的旅程|任务？公主？]

rows.original:
"Tell me about Yvennes," you say.
    
    Alice thinks for a moment. "The borderlands are not so different from Hawkethorne, really, although they certainly do not have a castle in every village. The temperature is more reasonable, and the land a lot more fertile, so there's a lot of farmland where the terrain and soil allows for it. Riders from the capital patrol to and fro, carrying news inward and outward." 
    
    "Garonne itself is a proud, beautiful city," she continues. "The people suffered greatly during the Godswar, and parts of it fell into ruin. The treasury was all but depleted, to speak nothing of the population itself. But the rebuilding efforts have come to fruition." The paladin smiles. "I am not overly artistic, but I have an appreciation for the city's aesthetics. I am proud of it, in a way. The marble monuments and statues are magnificent." 
    
    "It does sound nice," you say.
    
    "I travelled through Barania and Sartanni to reach Hawkethorne," Alice says. "To the northwest of Yvennes. Barania is our largest trade partner. The people there are kind and peaceful. And very fluffy[pc.ra sheepfolk
        |, much like yourself
    ]. I didn't stay for long. Sartanni is a very rural realm. A lot of farmland, and not much else. A lot of elves, too – much more than my homeland."
    
    "What races live in Yvennes?" you ask.
    
    "Mostly humans, like myself," Alice says. "But we have a number of others. Some Baranians have lived there for generations, lupines, elves from the south. It is a large country, after all."
    
    "The south?" you echo. "I hadn't thought there was much there."
    
    "You are correct," she says. "It is little more than untamed wilderness surrounding Zhenna mountain, inhabited by nomadic elves and orcs. Even further south is the Valgar tribe-lands. There are occasional raiders that sail up from the southern tip of the continent, but not in any great number. To the west of Yvennes lies Dawnsword, a stronghold of Lumia's devout. We trade with them, mostly food and weapons."
    
    "It sounds quite peaceful, really," you say.
    
    Alice chuckles. "It is. But in comparison to the Marches, anywhere would be, I think. Perhaps not the heartlands. The territory is surrounded by allies, trade partners, the sea, and the forests of the south. The largest issues the kingdom faces are internal corruption and bandits among the outlying locales, which is not so bad."
    
    [evelyn.dragon
        |You lean back in your chair as Alice takes a bite of her food. Yvennes sounds like a very good staging ground if one was to move to unite the continent to the west...
    ]

    艾丽丝思考了一会儿，然后回答：“边境地区的环境和鹰棘镇其实并没有太大区别，只不过那里的每个村庄里肯定都没有城堡。那里的气温更加适宜居住，土地也更加肥沃，因此在地形和土壤条件允许的地方，有很多农田。来自首都的骑兵们来回巡逻，将消息传送到各地。
    
    “加龙河畔的这座城市本身就是一座充满自豪感且风景优美的城市，”她继续说道，“在那场神战期间，这里的人民遭受了巨大的苦难，城市的许多地区也陷入了废墟之中。国库几乎已经枯竭，更不用说民众的生活状况了。不过，重建工作终于取得了成果。”这位圣骑士微笑着说，“我虽然不是什么艺术大师，但我很欣赏这座城市的美学风格。在某种程度上，我为此感到自豪。那些大理石纪念碑和雕像确实非常壮观。
    
    “听起来确实很不错，”你说道。
    
    “我穿越了巴拉尼亚和萨塔尼，最终才到达鹰棘镇，”爱丽丝说，“就在伊文尼斯的西北方向。巴拉尼亚是我们最大的贸易伙伴。那里的人民善良而平和，而且动物们都非常可爱、毛茸茸的。[pc.ra sheepfolk
        |就像你一样
    ]我没有待太久。萨塔尼是一个非常偏远的地区，到处都是农田，其他的东西几乎没有。那里的精灵也很多——比我的家乡还要多。”
    
    “那么伊文尼斯里生活着哪些种族呢？”你问道。
    
    “主要是人类，就像我一样。”爱丽丝回答道。但我们还有其他许多地方。有些巴兰人已经在那里生活了好几代人，还有狼族以及来自南方的精灵。毕竟，这是一个幅员辽阔的国家。”
    
    “南方？”你重复道，“我之前没想过那里会有什么值得关注的东西。
    
    你说得对，”她说道，“那片地区只不过是环绕着詹娜山的未开垦荒野，那里居住着游牧的精灵和兽人。再往南就是瓦尔加尔部落的领地。偶尔会有一些掠夺者从大陆的南端驶来，但数量并不多。在伊文尼斯的西边，坐落着道恩斯沃德——这是卢米亚信徒们的据点。我们与他们进行贸易，主要交易的是食物和武器。
    
    “听起来确实很宁静啊，”你说。
    
    艾丽丝轻笑了一声：“确实如此。不过比起边境地区来说，任何地方都应该算是宁静的吧。或许并非那些核心地区。这个王国被盟友、贸易伙伴、海洋以及南方的森林所环绕。该国目前面临的最大问题在于内部的腐败现象，以及边远地区的土匪活动，不过这些问题的严重程度还不算太高。"

    ]

rows.translation: 伊薇恩

rows.original:
"So who is Alice Deschamps?" you ask her as she smiles. "How did she come to be a mighty paladin of Tira?"
    
    Alice laughs. "Humble beginnings. My father is a blacksmith and my mother is a baker, still living in the same village I was brought up in. I grew up well-fed and with a penchant for swinging a sword around. When I was twelve, a member of the order took me as her squire, and I eventually became a paladin myself."
    
    "What do you do when you’re not adventuring in a foreign land?" you say.
    
    She thinks. "I pray. I practice my swordsmanship. I travel to aid people in need, as is the creed of my order. That is enough for me. I have the rest of my life to pontificate – the time I can spend helping people with my sword arm is limited."
    
    You nod. "I understand. Purpose doesn't need to be complex."
    
    Alice smiles. "Exactly. Tis true I live a simple life. But I do find it gratifying to know mine efforts bring about a modicum of improvement for the people we serve."
rows.translation:
“那么，爱丽丝·德尚普到底是谁？”你问她，她微微一笑，“她是怎么成为蒂拉麾下那位强大的圣骑士的？”
    
    爱丽丝笑了起来：“我的起点很平凡。我的父亲是一名铁匠，母亲则是一名面包师，他们至今仍然住在我成长的那个村庄里。我从小衣食无忧，还特别喜欢挥剑。十二岁那年，教团的一位成员收我做了她的侍从，最终我自己也成了一名圣骑士。”
    
    “那么，在没有去异国冒险的时候，你会做些什么呢？”你问道。
    
    她想：“我祈祷，练习剑术，也会去帮助那些需要帮助的人，因为这就是我们教团的信条。这对我来说就已经足够了。我的余生都可以用来高谈阔论——而我能用剑帮助别人的时间却是有限的。”
    
    你点了点头。“我明白。目标并不一定非得复杂繁琐。”
    
    爱丽丝微笑着说道：“正是这样。我确实过着简单的生活。但当我看到自己的努力能为我们所服务的人们带来一些改善时，我还是会感到很有成就感。”

I grew up well-fed and with a penchant for swinging a sword around. When I was twelve, a member of the order took me as her squire, and I eventually became a paladin myself."
    
    "What do you do when you’re not adventuring in a foreign land?" you say.
    
    She thinks. "I pray. I practice my swordsmanship. I travel to aid people in need, as is the creed of my order. That is enough for me. I have the rest of my life to pontificate – the time I can spend helping people with my sword arm is limited."
    
    You nod. "I understand. Purpose doesn't need to be complex."
    
    Alice smiles. "Exactly. Tis true I live a simple life. But I do find it gratifying to know mine efforts bring about a modicum of improvement for the people we serve."

rows.original:
"So you belong to an order of paladins," you say.
    
    Alice nods. "The Order of the Hourglass. We venerate Tira's aspects as the goddess of death and of time. A pillar of our order is spending what time we have wisely."
    
    "And death?" you prompt.
    
    "Death comes for us all, in the end," Alice says. "It is what gives our lives meaning, what gives them value. It is what drives us to accomplish things both great and small. That is why our lady Tira is the goddess of both death and time. They go hand in hand, together, towards the horizon."
    
    "What does the order do?" you ask.
    
    "We counsel. We aid. We protect. We venture," Alice says. "Though it might seem mundane, all things we do are informed by our worship of The Lady of Death. We strive to keep unrightful death at bay."
    
    "Have you stopped by the church here?" you ask.
    
    Alice nods. "Just briefly, to pray when I first arrived. Brother Sanders was pleasant."
    
    "He used to be a paladin himself, you know," you say.
    
    She smiles. "He did not seem surprised I was here. Perhaps I will ask him about his faith one day."

    爱丽丝点了点头。“沙漏圣骑士团。我们尊崇蒂拉作为死亡与时间的女神。我们骑士团的基石之一，就是明智地利用我们所拥有的时间。”
    
    “那死亡呢？”你追问道。
    
    “最终，死亡会降临到我们所有人身上，”爱丽丝说道，“正是死亡赋予了我们的生活意义，赋予了它们价值。正是死亡驱使我们去完成那些或伟大或平凡的事情。因此，我们的蒂拉女神既是死亡之神，也是时间之神。它们相辅相成，共同向着地平线前进。”
    
    “这个组织是做什么的？”你问道。
    
    “我们提供咨询，提供帮助，给予保护，也会勇于冒险，”爱丽丝回答道，“虽然这些工作看起来可能很平凡，但我们所做的一切，都源于我们对‘死亡女神’的崇敬。我们努力防止不公正的死亡发生。”
    
    “你有没有来过这里的教堂？”你问道。
    
    爱丽丝点了点头。“刚来的时候只是短暂地去祈祷了一下。桑德斯修士人很和善。”
    
    “你知道，他以前自己也是一名圣骑士。”你说道。
    
    她微笑着说道：“他似乎并没有因为我的到来而感到惊讶。也许有一天，我会问他关于他的信仰的问题。”

rows.original:
[pc.pregStage 1
        |You give Alice a lingering look. "Care to join me upstairs?"
        |You look slyly at Alice. "Care to take a bottle upstairs?"
    ]
    
    Alice smiles warmly. "I believe you have proven time with you is well-spent, [pc.name]. I think your actual words were 'the best time I'll spend in Hawkethorne', which was quite the bold claim." She rises from her chair. "But perhaps justified. Shall we retire to further test the theory, then?"
    
    Alice takes a bottle from Garth and you join her upstairs for a cozy hangout, her sitting on the edge of the bed and you in a chair opposite. Without her armor on, she seems a lot more personable – how much of it is her and how much of it is your own impression, it's hard to say. All you know is that in her casual clothing, Alice is an incredibly striking woman. Every time she smiles it's all the more dazzling, and any time she moves it's a distraction. It's impossible not to notice her pleasing shape.
    
    Alice smiles, her eyes twinkling with mirth. "I am enjoying this. Your gaze is nothing if not voracious, [pc.name]."
    
    "You can hardly blame me for that," you say. "You are a divine sight both in and out of your armor."
    
    The paladin teasingly toys with the edge of her top, lifting it slightly to expose the undersides of her massive breasts. "Is that so? I would enjoy seeing what your idea of worship of the divine looks like..."

        她边唱边弹，这位阿努比亚女子开始摇摆腰肢、晃动臀部。紧贴她身体的轻薄丝绸什么也遮不住，凸显出那对被银质穿环彼此相连的丰满乳房，以及即使坐着也显得柔软而富有弹性的臀部。 
        
        当她的歌声攀上顶峰时，她用一声拖长的最高音收住了歌喉，那一口气几乎掏空了她的肺。等歌声彻底静下来，阿米娜向后倒回台上，随手一翻手腕扯下丝质裹胸，用那件衣物抹过满是汗水的额头，全然不在意自己此刻露出了多少肌肤。 
        
        等她喘匀了气，阿米娜伸了个懒腰，滚到舞台边缘，就在你对面坐下。“喜欢这首歌吗，英雄？要是你想的话，两场表演之间我有空陪你聊聊。”
    ]

Amina disrobes piece by piece, giving the temple's other patrons a thrill that, one by one, sends them eagerly into the arms of Cait or her acolytes, until Amina's all but naked and you're just about the only person left in her little audience.

Amina's bushy blonde tail begins to wag gently as you draw near the stage, throwing you a fetching little smile before she begins to sing. You can't understand the language, a trilling tongue from the far east that's full of rolling 'r's and undulating tones, but nevertheless you find yourself drawn into the cushions surrounding the stage, enraptured by the songstress.

When she runs herself silent, Amina flops back into the stage and pulls off her silken chest-wrap with a casual flick of her wrist, running the garment over her sweat-slicked brow without a care for how much skin she's showing off now.

rows.original: [rand |"Cait's really done an amazing job with this place," Amina muses, gesturing about. "The acoustics are better than any temple I've performed in before, and there's a certain... I don't know, gravitas perhaps... to having all this Jassiran opulence surrounding some mysterious magical mire that steals kittens away to worlds unknown." Is the portal being so close concerning at all for her? "Nah," she shrugs. "I don't know a damn thing about magic, but I know Cait and Mister Zethra well enough to reason that if they feel comfortable bringing us all here and building up a home around it, then it must be safe enough. I'm not going to go trying to give it a hug or anything, but I admit that sometimes when I steal a few private moments with Cait, I find myself looking at that rippling rend in the air more so than the pretty kitty herself. It's oddly fascinating. Almost beautiful, sometimes." Beautiful, but dangerous. You found that out first hand. Amina just smiles. | "You know, given just how dangerous this part of the world is, I didn't expect the temple to do quite so well." How does she figure? "Well," Amina says, flicking her tail from side to side, "it's just that there's no real commerce and trade in this part of the world. The village down the road is totally self sufficient, maybe welcomes a merchant wagon every month or so aside from the farmers in the valley. The nearest big cities are under a mountain to the east and across the mountains to the west; nobody comes out here unless they're goin' somewhere else. I just hope all the business we've been getting from the townsfolk and that merc company in the hills isn't just a passing interest in something new and interesting. Hell, I had a chat with Sally a while ago and she wondered aloud if there was enough coin in the barony to actually support the temple long-term. I don't just mean riches, you know, but actual physical coinage. I'd hate to see Sally ten years on bartering a quickie for a cabbage." You're sure it won't come to that. Coin seems to turn up everywhere you've stuck your nose into, at least. "Hopefully. Then again, now that I think about it, the more I want to slip a poem under Sally's door about the cabbage thing. That'd sure get a rise out of her!" | "You know, my brother doesn't think much of the Temple of Mallach. Always unsatisfied with it on some level; I know if it wasn't for me he'd have left long ago. Don't tell him I said as much, but I've always thought a stoic, strong man like him would have fit in better with the Tirans. But me? Mallach's always spoken to me. Not literally — I'm nowhere near that important — but what he teaches about pursuing your passions and bringing joy to others. Even if I hadn't been born into the temple, I know I'd have ended up singing his hymns eventually." Amina smiles to herself, idly plucking at the strings of her harp. "Music and dance are in my soul, [pc.name], as much a part of who I am as my name. That's why I'm so glad to be here. Sure, there's bigger audiences, and more fame and recognition, back in Jassira... but Cait lets me be me without interference. I don't have to worry about being ordered to spread my legs for coin if my songs and dances don't bring in enough supplicants for the other girls. I can experiment, try new things! It's such an incredible breath of fresh air. Even if the air around here is a little too cold for my liking." The topless anubian gives you a wink as she runs a hand up her chest, flicking a thumb over a stiff nipple. | "There's still so few acolytes that everyone has to chip in doing a little bit of everything," Amina says, running a hand through her mussed hair. "Since I don't whore, when I'm not performing Sally has me cleaning, cooking, refilling hookahs... anything to help keep this place running. It's hard work for a delicate little thing like me, you know! [var0|My favorite work, though, has definitely been helping Sally take care of the kids while she works. They're so precious...]" Amina giggles, which just makes her unbound breasts quake against their chains. "Really, though, things are getting better day by day. Imad and I aren't the first to come here from the homeland hoping for a better life, and I know we won't be the last either. Founding a new temple is exciting, a new chance for a lot of Jassirans that are fed up with the old clergy back home. And hey, if nothing else, there'll be a whole new generation of acolytes sprouting out from between Sally's legs before you know it. One garden of children alone could probably staff a whole temple by her lonesome... just give her a couple decades." And what about the other temple girls? Do they chip in to that effort too? "Some may. Really it depends... unlike in Jassira, Cait's much more interested in the wants and desires of the girls under her wing. Plenty of them will take breeding contracts eventually, but none of them quite so much as Sally. She's our prize brood-kitty — anybody else having kittens, or pups, is just Mallach's blessing on our little temple." ]
rows.translation: [rand |“凯特真的把这个地方打理得非常出色，”阿米娜边说边比划着，“这里的音响效果比我在任何一座寺庙里表演过的都要好，而且……怎么说呢，也许是种庄严感吧……让所有这些贾西拉式的奢华装潢环绕着一个神秘的魔法泥潭——它还会把小猫们偷到未知的世界去。” 这个传送门离得这么近，她难道一点都不担心吗？ “不，”她耸了耸肩，“我对魔法一窍不通，但我对凯特和泽特拉先生足够了解，足以推断：既然他们放心把我们所有人都带到这里，还在这东西周围建起一个家，那它肯定够安全了。我不会跑去试着抱它一下什么的，但我承认，有时候我和凯特偷得几分独处的时光，我发现自己盯着空中那道泛着涟漪的裂口，比盯着那只漂亮小猫本人还要多。它有种奇特的吸引力。有时候几乎称得上美丽。” 美丽，但危险。这一点你可是亲身体会过的。 阿米娜只是微笑着。 | “你知道，考虑到这地方有多危险，我真没想到这座寺庙能经营得这么好。” 她凭什么这么想？ “嗯，”阿米娜左右甩着尾巴说，“就是因为这一带根本没什么真正的商业和贸易。路那头的村子完全自给自足，除了山谷里的农夫，大概每个月也就迎来一辆商人的货车。最近的大城市，一座在东边的山底下，另一座要翻过西边的群山；没人会专程跑到这儿来，除非他们本来就要去别的地方。我只希望镇上居民和山里那家佣兵公司给我们带来的生意，不只是一时图个新鲜。唉，前阵子我和莎莉聊过，她还自言自语地琢磨，男爵领里到底有没有足够的钱币来长期支撑这座寺庙。我说的不只是财富，你知道，而是实实在在的硬币。我可不想十年后看到莎莉得靠打一炮来换一颗卷心菜。” 你确信事情不会发展到那一步。至少，在你插手过的地方，钱币似乎总是会冒出来。 “但愿如此。不过话说回来，我越想越觉得，不如写首诗从莎莉的门缝底下塞进去，就写卷心菜那档子事。那肯定能把她惹得跳脚！” | “你知道，我哥哥对马拉克神殿评价不高，总觉得它在某些方面不尽如人意；我知道，要不是为了我，他早就离开了。别告诉他我说过这些，但我一直觉得，像他那样坚忍强健的男人，本来更适合跟蒂拉人待在一起。可我呢？马拉克一直在对我说话。当然不是字面上的——我远没有重要到那个地步——而是他所教导的那些东西：追寻自己的热情，为他人带来快乐。就算我没有生在寺庙里，我也知道，自己最终还是会唱起他的赞美诗。” 阿米娜自顾自地微笑着，随手拨弄着竖琴的琴弦。“音乐与舞蹈就在我的灵魂里，[pc.name]，它们和我的名字一样，都是我的一部分。正因如此，我才会这么高兴能来到这里。当然，在贾西拉有更大的观众群，更多的名声和认可……但凯特让我能不受干涉地做自己。我不用再担心，要是我的歌舞没能替别的女孩招来足够多的信徒，就会被命令为了钱张开双腿。我可以尝试，玩点新花样！这口气新鲜得简直不可思议。尽管这里的空气对我来说还是有点太冷了。” 那位赤裸上身的阿努比亚女子朝你眨了眨眼，一只手顺着胸口往上抚去，拇指轻轻弹过一颗挺立的乳头。 | “这里的侍僧还是太少了，所以每个人都得搭把手，什么活都干一点，”阿米娜一边说，一边用手理了理凌乱的头发，“既然我不卖身，那我不表演的时候，莎莉就让我打扫、做饭、重新装填水烟袋……凡是能帮这个地方运转下去的活儿都干。对我这么个娇弱的小东西来说，这活儿可辛苦啦，你知道的！[var0|不过，我最喜欢干的还是趁莎莉忙的时候帮她照看孩子们。他们真是太可爱了……]” 阿米娜咯咯一笑，这一笑让她那对没被束缚的乳房在乳链上颤动起来。“不过说真的，情况正在一天天变好。我和伊马德不是第一批从故乡来这里盼着过上好日子的人，我知道我们也不会是最后一批。建立一座新寺庙是件令人兴奋的事，对许多受够了家乡旧神职人员的贾西拉人来说，这是个新机会。而且，嘿，别的不说，用不了多久，就会有一整代新侍僧从莎莉的双腿之间冒出来。光是她那一园子孩子，大概就够她一个人撑起整座寺庙了……只要给她几十年时间。” 那寺庙里的其他女孩呢？她们也会在这件事上出力吗？ “有些人会吧。这其实得看情况……和贾西拉不同，凯特对她手下这些女孩的意愿和欲望要上心得多。她们当中不少人最终都会签下生育契约，但没人像莎莉那么投入。她可是我们的王牌种猫——其他人怀上小猫或小狗，都只是马拉克赐给我们这座小寺庙的祝福罢了。” ]

rows.translation: 神庙

rows.original: [flags.AMINA_HER |[rand | "I mentioned my father was a spice merchant, didn't I?" Amina says offhandedly, stretching. "Twice he paid the temple to try and conceive children — well, I shouldn't say try, he was quite successful both times. But both my brother and myself somehow failed to live up to his expectations. What he expected from swaddled infants I will never know, but he refused to take us into his household. It caused a bit of a scandal at the time, and mother was demoted for... whatever it was she apparently had done. Don't ask me to explain it, I can't stand the temple bureaucracy. Nor my father's callousness." Is that common, fathers refusing their children? "No. Hence the scandal. A man doesn't spend a small fortune to impregnate a temple harlot just for the sexual thrill of it. That's what his housemaids are for. Some men will ask the temple to raise the children if they can't for whatever reason, like Mister Zethra — having his bastards running around the estate he shares with this wife probably wouldn't have done his marriage any favors. I think it's about half and half between those of us that stay with the temple, or go to their fathers' households. Of course, when the reverse happens — when a Mallchite stud like my brother knocks up a woman outside the temple — she almost always keeps her children. Imad has a son back in Jassira that a lonely ship's captain paid quite handsomely for. What possessed our father to refuse both of us so emphatically, I really don't know. Nobody ever deigned to tell us, anyway." That's just sad. | "My brother, Imad, is just about my favorite person in the world," Amina says with a smile. "He's always been there for me. Even when I wanted to pick up and move halfway around the world, Imad just asked how soon he needed to be packed... and he's never been totally comfortable at the temple. Really wanted to go off and become a mercenary, make a name for himself — at least one that'd travel further than just the ladies that frequented our home temple. Well, and a few pretty cat-boys that liked their meat tough." Amina chuckles. "Imad's done everything in his power to make sure I've had the best life I could have asked for. He'd protect me from other kids when I was the smallest, weakest thing in the temple, and then from the matrons when they wanted to put me out to whoring... if it wasn't for him, I'd be a mess of a woman let me tell you!" He seems like a good brother. "The best brother," Amina corrects, giving you a little smirk. "And I'm not going to let him or anyone else forget it! I try and do as much for him as he does for me now that I'm old enough to appreciate him. The least I can do is cook his favorite foods and take care of his laundry. It's not like our mother's going to be coming all the way across the sea for him..." ] |"Who, me?" Amina purrs, dark lips curling up into a little smile. "I'm just a minstrel from across the sea. Really nothing so special as the noble Lady Zethra or our resident garden of children, Salwah!" No need to be so humble. You'd just like to know a little bit about her. "Alright, alright. There's really not much to tell, but let's see... I came here with my older brother, Imad. We're both children born into the temple — our mother was like Sally, a garden of children, and our father was a spice trader that had too much money and not enough heart. He didn't want either of us after we were born for reasons I still don't truly understand, so we stayed with the temple. I learned to dance and sing and recite poetry at a young age, taking to it all like a swan to water. All said, not a bad childhood, no matter how much Imad grouses about how much mom never liked him much. I think you'll hear most temple girls say something to that effect: sure they raised us with the expectation we'd be selling our bodies for the temple's treasury, but we never went hungry and there was always a roof over our head — we were better off than a lot of children." Sounds like something Cait would say, yes. Amina smiles. "Like I said. Rather than be put to whoring, though, I was given the chance to use my musical talents for the glory of Mallach and the benefit of the temple coffers — my job is to sing and dance and recite lewd poetry, all to get the temple's patrons in the mood for the other girls. I set 'em up, and Cait and Sally bed 'em down. Back home, I had to meet certain quotas or I'd lose my standing, and end up working on my back — that's why I dragged me and my brother halfway around the world to join Cait's little venture here. I know that genuinely has my best interests at heart, unlike some stuffy clergyman who can't tell me and my mother apart and can recite more passages of scripture than names of girls in his own temple." The dancer makes a bitter little huff under her breath, leaning back on her stage. "So that's where I come from and what I do, all wrapped up in a neat little bow for you. Suffice to say I'm very happy to be here, and look forward to watching the temple grow under Cait's leadership. And making a worthy partner like yourself a little money, too." ]
rows.translation: [flags.AMINA_HER |[rand | “我之前说过，我父亲是个香料商人，对吧？”阿米娜漫不经心地说道，同时伸了个懒腰。“他曾两次花钱请神殿试着给他生孩子——嗯，我不该说试着，他两次都相当成功。可我和我哥哥不知怎的都没能达到他的期望。他究竟对襁褓里的婴儿抱有什么期望，我永远也不会知道，但他就是拒绝让我们进入他的家门。这件事在当时引起了一场风波，母亲也因此被降职了，理由是……不管她表面上到底做了什么。别让我去解释，我实在受不了神殿的官僚作风，也受不了我父亲的冷漠无情。” 父亲拒绝自己的孩子，这种事常见吗？ “不常见，所以才成了丑闻。男人不会为了那点性刺激，就花一大笔钱去让神殿的妓女生孩子——那种事交给他的女仆就行了。有些男人会因为各种原因没法自己抚养孩子，就请神殿把孩子养大，比如泽特拉先生——让他的私生子们在他和妻子共有的庄园里到处乱跑，对他的婚姻恐怕没什么好处。我们这些人里，留在神殿的和回父亲家的，大概各占一半。当然，当反过来的情况发生时——比如像我哥哥这样的马尔拉赫信徒在外面让女人怀了孕——她几乎总会留下孩子。伊马德在贾西拉有个儿子，是一位寂寞的船长花大价钱换来的。我实在不明白，是什么让我父亲如此坚决地拒绝我们两个……反正也从没人愿意告诉我们。” 真是太令人难过了。 | “我哥哥伊马德，差不多是这世上我最喜欢的人了，”阿米娜微笑着说道，“他一直都在我身边支持我。甚至当我想搬到大半个世界之外去的时候，伊马德也只是问我多久之后需要收拾好行装……而他在神殿里从来都没真正自在过。他真的很想出去当个雇佣兵，闯出自己的名号——至少得比那些常来我们家神殿的女士们传得更远才行。嗯，还有几个喜欢咬劲道肉的漂亮猫人男孩。” 阿米娜轻笑起来。“伊马德竭尽全力，就为了让我过上梦寐以求的最好的生活。我当年是神殿里最小、最弱的一个，他会保护我不受别的孩子欺负；后来那些主母想把我推出去卖淫时，又是他护着我……要不是有他，我肯定是个一团糟的女人，我跟你说！” 他看起来是个好哥哥。 “是最好的哥哥，”阿米娜纠正道，冲你微微一笑，“而且我绝不会让他或任何人忘了这一点！既然我现在长大了，懂得珍惜他，我就尽量为他多做些事，就像他为我做的一样。至少我可以给他做他最爱吃的饭菜、帮他洗衣服。毕竟我们的母亲又不可能隔着大海跑来看他……” ] |“谁，我吗？”阿米娜轻声哼道，深色的嘴唇微微上扬，勾起一丝浅笑。“我只不过是个从海对岸来的吟游诗人罢了。真没什么特别的，比不上高贵的泽特拉女士，也比不上我们这儿那位孩子成群的萨尔瓦！” 不用这么谦虚。你只是想多了解她一些罢了。 “好吧，好吧。其实真没什么好说的，不过让我想想……我是和我哥哥伊马德一起来到这里的。我们俩都是生在神殿里的孩子——我们的母亲和莎莉一样，生了一大群孩子，而我们的父亲是个钱多得花不完、心却少得可怜的香料商人。我们出生后，他出于某些我至今也没弄明白的原因，不要我们中的任何一个，于是我们就留在了神殿。我小小年纪就学会了跳舞、唱歌、背诵诗歌，对这些就像天鹅天生识水性一样上手。总的来说，我的童年并不坏，不管伊马德怎么抱怨母亲从来都不太喜欢他。我想大多数神殿女孩都会说类似的话：没错，他们养大我们，是指望我们为神殿的财库出卖身体，但我们从没挨过饿，头上也总有片屋顶——比起很多孩子，我们已经算过得好了。” 听起来确实是凯特会说的台词，没错。 阿米娜笑了。“就像我说的。不过，我并没有被推出去卖淫，而是得到了机会，用自己的音乐才华为马拉克增光、为神殿的财库出力——我的工作就是唱歌、跳舞、朗诵淫诗，全是为了让神殿的顾客们对其他女孩提起兴致。我负责给他们铺垫，然后由凯特和莎莉陪他们上床。在家乡，我必须完成一定的指标，否则就会丢掉自己的地位，最后只能靠躺着接客赚钱——这就是我拉着自己和哥哥跑过大半个世界，来加入凯特这儿这份小事业的原因。我知道他是真心为我着想，不像某些迂腐的教士，连我和我母亲都分不清，却能背出比自家神殿女孩名字还多的经文段落。” 舞者低声愤愤地哼了一声，靠回她的舞台上。“所以，这就是我的出身和我做的事，全都打包系好蝴蝶结送到你面前了。总之，我非常高兴能来到这里，也期待着看到神殿在凯特的领导力下发展壮大。同时也为你这样一位可敬的伙伴赚点小钱。” ]
rows.raw: " [flags.AMINA_HER |[rand | "I mentioned my father was a spice merchant, didn't I?" Amina says offhandedly, stretching. "Twice he paid the temple to try and conceive children — well, I shouldn't say try, he was quite successful both times. But both my brother and myself somehow failed to live up to his expectations. What he expected from swaddled infants I will never know, but he refused to take us into his household. It caused a bit of a scandal at the time, and mother was demoted for... whatever it was she apparently had done. Don't ask me to explain it, I can't stand the temple bureaucracy. Nor my father's callousness." Is that common, fathers refusing their children? "No. Hence the scandal. A man doesn't spend a small fortune to impregnate a temple harlot just for the sexual thrill of it. That's what his housemaids are for. Some men will ask the temple to raise the children if they can't for whatever reason, like Mister Zethra — having his bastards running around the estate he shares with this wife probably wouldn't have done his marriage any favors. I think it's about half and half between those of us that stay with the temple, or go to their fathers' households. Of course, when the reverse happens — when a Mallchite stud like my brother knocks up a woman outside the temple — she almost always keeps her children. Imad has a son back in Jassira that a lonely ship's captain paid quite handsomely for. What possessed our father to refuse both of us so emphatically, I really don't know. Nobody ever deigned to tell us, anyway." That's just sad. | "My brother, Imad, is just about my favorite person in the world," Amina says with a smile. "He's always been there for me. Even when I wanted to pick up and move halfway around the world, Imad just asked how soon he needed to be packed... and he's never been totally comfortable at the temple. Really wanted to go off and become a mercenary, make a name for himself — at least one that'd travel further than just the ladies that frequented our home temple. Well, and a few pretty cat-boys that liked their meat tough." Amina chuckles. "Imad's done everything in his power to make sure I've had the best life I could have asked for. He'd protect me from other kids when I was the smallest, weakest thing in the temple, and then from the matrons when they wanted to put me out to whoring... if it wasn't for him, I'd be a mess of a woman let me tell you!" He seems like a good brother. "The best brother," Amina corrects, giving you a little smirk. "And I'm not going to let him or anyone else forget it! I try and do as much for him as he does for me now that I'm old enough to appreciate him. The least I can do is cook his favorite foods and take care of his laundry. It's not like our mother's going to be coming all the way across the sea for him..." ] |"Who, me?" Amina purrs, dark lips curling up into a little smile. "I'm just a minstrel from across the sea. Really nothing so special as the noble Lady Zethra or our resident garden of children, Salwah!" No need to be so humble. You'd just like to know a little bit about her. "Alright, alright. There's really not much to tell, but let's see... I came here with my older brother, Imad. We're both children born into the temple — our mother was like Sally, a garden of children, and our father was a spice trader that had too much money and not enough heart. He didn't want either of us after we were born for reasons I still don't truly understand, so we stayed with the temple. I learned to dance and sing and recite poetry at a young age, taking to it all like a swan to water. All said, not a bad childhood, no matter how much Imad grouses about how much mom never liked him much. I think you'll hear most temple girls say something to that effect: sure they raised us with the expectation we'd be selling our bodies for the temple's treasury, but we never went hungry and there was always a roof over our head — we were better off than a lot of children." Sounds like something Cait would say, yes. Amina smiles. "Like I said. Rather than be put to whoring, though, I was given the chance to use my musical talents for the glory of Mallach and the benefit of the temple coffers — my job is to sing and dance and recite lewd poetry, all to get the temple's patrons in the mood for the other girls. I set 'em up, and Cait and Sally bed 'em down. Back home, I had to meet certain quotas or I'd lose my standing, and end up working on my back — that's why I dragged me and my brother halfway around the world to join Cait's little venture here. I know that genuinely has my best interests at heart, unlike some stuffy clergyman who can't tell me and my mother apart and can recite more passages of scripture than names of girls in his own temple." The dancer makes a bitter little huff under her breath, leaning back on her stage. "So that's where I come from and what I do, all wrapped up in a neat little bow for you. Suffice to say I'm very happy to be here, and look forward to watching the temple grow under Cait's leadership. And making a worthy partner like yourself a little money, too." ] "

rows.original: [rand | "Caitriss is a sweetheart. One of the [silly |real OGs |truest believers in the faith ]," Amina says, tail swishing. "I knew she would go far in the church the day I met her, back when we were just little kids. She relentlessly hounded me until I agreed to be her friend, and even Imad couldn't pry her off! The girl knows what she wants, and she'll risk it all to get it. Or at least, she used to be like that..." Used to be? Amina's tail slows. "I... I don't know, maybe it's just me, but ever since I came out here, she's seemed... like a piece of her is missing. I guess it must be what happened with Calla. Cait's confidence seems so shaken now, compared to the girl I used to know. Deep down I think she's scared. Part of her that's always been there is just gone all of a sudden, and she doesn't know if she'll ever get it back. All I can do is try and comfort her when I can, keep her mind off of it when she'll let me." Forcing a smile, the dancer adds, "I'm glad she's had someone like you to help her through all this. I know facing this demon incursion alone couldn't have been easy for either of you. But now that we're all here, please, even if none of us are great wizards or fighters... let us comfort you and Cait in whatever ways you need." | "Oh, Calla... I have to admit that as much as I adore Cait, Calla and I were even closer. You might not guess it from looking at me now, but when I was younger I was pretty athletic — I loved to run as fast as my legs would take me. Calla was the same way: she loved to push her body to the limits, to see what she was capable of. So much so that one time she even climbed to the very top of one of the temple minerettes... only to be paralyzed so severely by fear that one of the temple matrons had to invoke a spell to go up and fetch her down. That was a sight, I'm sure. Whenever the Zethra twins would come to our little seaside temple, Calla and I would always spend every second of their visit we could get away playing. Really was the best friend I ever had. Hope to all the gods she's alright, wherever she is." A wistful little smile plays across Amina's dusky lips. "It's a shame she was so much like my brother, too, never able to find her peace with the temple. I always knew she'd end up leaving the first day she could. Ah. Don't tell Cait, but it's Mallach's honest truth — if that sister of hers had stayed and taken her vows, I might just have asked the matrons to sanction me marrying her. Not like her blue blood would have mattered between two women, both sworn to Mallach." How would that work — two harlots marrying? Amina gives you a teasing look. "Why? Getting ideas about couples' services? Ha! Well, it's true, there was a couple back at Cait's home temple that sold themselves as a pair, but mostly it worked like any secular marriage. Well, the ceremony's different, but after that it's just like any other profession of love and bonding between two people. Or more people. Mallach's not bound by mating pairs or anything." So what's different about the ceremony? "Well..." Amina teases, leaning back with a salacious smirk. "People back home call it a 'slut marriage' for a reason. If both partners are gonna be expected to sell their bodies even after they wed, the temple likes to test their dedication after a fashion. Where most married couples get whisked away to their wedding night together in intimate privacy, a pair of Mallachite harlots that wish to bond instead are undressed in front of as much of the adult congregation as can be gathered and, hand in hand, bent over the altar by the priest — who then exhorts the witnesses to come and bless their union. Which really everyone's expected to fuck both partners at least once each during the proceedings. It's a big, long, and very messy thing..." Guess Mallach isn't much for monogamy! She shrugs. "Slut marriages are only for between two harlots — acolytes that are expected to spend most of their adult lives sexually servicing strangers. If two laymen want to be wed by Mallach's priests, they wouldn't be expected to endure the entire congregation gangbanging them. Unless they wanted to, anyway. I've got no doubt the priests would be happy to arrange it if they did." | "Mister Zethra is certainly a character!" Amina laughs. "Wizard, tinker, scholar, mathematician... and most importantly, a great dad. I'm only a little jealous of the twins for having such a great guy around for them. Even if he'd been nothing more than a peasant, I think Barnaphous would probably be one of the most pleasant men in the world to be around." But he's hardly a peasant, is he? "No, no he is not. From what I gather, his wife's part of the Sultana's court, and he's a second or third son of some important noble house — sorry, politics aren't exactly my specialty. I can recite beautiful poems about every sultan and sultana up until Nadia herself that would make you cry with patriotic fervor, but I couldn't unpack what any of it actually meant to save my life. Regardless, I know that he's of some importance back home, and his wife even moreso. She couldn't have children, though, so Mister Zethra turned to the temples — as is only right and proper Jassiran tradition. I imagine Calla would have ended up becoming his and Lady Randa's official heir when their tour of the old empire was finished up. With Cait sworn to the temples and Calla gone, though... no, that doesn't matter. You'll all find some way to get Calla back, so there's no need to worry about what'd happen if you don't. And that's all there is to it." Of course. That's your hope, anyway. Amina nods. "Anyway, that's all to say that even by Mallachite standards, Cait and Calla grew up wanting for nothing. Certainly not parental affection. A rich dad and a well-connected mother meant they'd go far, and the fact that they both turned out to be great people besides only reinforces it. The fact that Cait ended up with a temple of her own doesn't surprise me in the least — and I think Barnaphous is certainly proud of her for embracing her path as wholeheartedly as she has, just as he was proud of Calla for recognizing that she didn't want to walk Cait's with her. Gods, I kinda wish he'd give me a headpat and tell me I'm his good little sunflower or whatever... okay maybe I am more than a little jealous, haha." ]
rows.translation: [rand | “凯特真是个可爱的女孩。她是其中之一[silly |真正的元老 |这一信仰最坚定的信徒们 ]，”阿米娜说道，尾巴摇得飞快。“还在我们只是小孩子的时候，我遇见她的那天就知道，她一定会在教会里大有作为。她不停地缠着我，直到我同意和她做朋友，就连伊马德也没能把她拉开！这女孩知道自己想要什么，而且会不惜一切代价去得到它。或者至少，她曾经是这样的……” 曾经是这样？ 阿米娜的尾巴动作变得迟缓起来。“我……我也不确定，也许只是我的感觉而已，但自从我来到这里之后，她看起来……就好像少了些什么一样。我想，这应该就是卡拉身上发生的事情吧。与我以前认识的那个女孩相比，凯特现在的自信似乎已经受到了极大的打击。在内心深处，我认为她其实是害怕的。她身上某些一直存在的特质，突然之间就消失了，而她也不知道自己是否还能重新获得它们。我所能做的，就是尽量在她需要的时候安慰她，让她暂时忘记这些事情。” 舞者强挤出一丝笑容，继续说道：“我很高兴她身边有你这样一个人，帮她度过这一切。我知道，独自面对这次恶魔入侵，对你们俩来说都绝非易事。但现在我们都在这里了，所以，即便我们谁都不是什么了不起的巫师或战士……也请让我们以你们需要的任何方式来安慰你和凯特吧。” | “哦，卡拉……我必须承认，虽然我非常喜欢凯特，但我和卡拉的关系其实更加亲密。你现在看我可能猜不到，但在我年轻的时候，我运动能力相当不错——我非常喜欢尽情奔跑，尽我所能地跑得越快越好。卡拉也是如此：她总是喜欢将自己的身体逼到极限，想要看看自己究竟能做到什么。有一次，她甚至爬到了神庙一座宣礼塔的最顶端……结果却被吓得浑身僵直，动弹不得，以至于神庙里的一位女祭司不得不施法上去把她抱下来。那场面一定很精彩。每当泽特拉双胞胎来到我们那座海边的小神庙时，卡拉和我总会利用她们来访的每一刻溜出去玩。她真的是我一生中最好的朋友。愿诸神保佑她平安无事，无论她现在身在何处。” 一丝怅然的浅笑掠过阿米娜暗褐色的嘴唇：“真可惜，她和我哥哥太像了，始终无法与神庙达成和解。我就知道，她一有机会就会离开的。啊，别告诉凯特，但这是马拉克的真心话——如果她那个姐妹留下来并完成了誓言，我或许会请求女祭司们准许我和她结婚。毕竟，对于两个都已经向马拉克宣誓的女性来说，她的贵族血统根本无关紧要。” 那要怎么实现呢——让两个妓女结婚？ 阿米娜调侃地看了你一眼：“怎么？对双人服务起念头了？哈！好吧，确实有过——在凯特家乡的神殿里，有一对夫妇把自己成对出售，不过大体上，他们的运作方式跟任何世俗婚姻没什么两样。嗯，仪式是不一样的，但仪式之后，就跟两个人之间任何其他表达爱意与结合的方式一样了。或者更多人。马拉克可不受什么配偶配对的约束。” 那么，这种仪式有什么不同之处呢？ “嗯……”阿米娜调侃地笑着，向后仰靠，露出一副淫荡的笑容，“在家乡，人们把这种婚姻叫作‘荡妇婚姻’，是有原因的。既然夫妻双方在婚后仍要被指望出卖自己的身体，神殿就喜欢用某种方式考验他们的虔诚。大多数新婚夫妇都会被送进私密的空间共度新婚之夜，而一对想要结合的马拉克信徒妓女则相反：她们会在能召集起来的尽可能多的成年信众面前被脱光衣服，然后手牵着手，被神父按倒在祭坛上——神父随后会劝请见证者们上前来为她们的结合赐福。而实际上，整个过程中，在场的每个人都得把这对新人分别肏上一次。那可是件场面盛大、耗时漫长、而且非常狼藉的事……” 看来马拉克并不太赞成一夫一妻制啊！ 她耸了耸肩：“‘荡妇婚姻’只存在于两个妓女之间——也就是那些注定要在成年后的大部分时间里用身体服侍陌生人的侍僧。如果两个平信徒想让马拉克的祭司为他们主婚，他们也不会被要求忍受全体信众轮番肏他们。当然，除非他们自己愿意。我毫不怀疑，如果他们真想这样，祭司们会很乐意替他们安排。” | “泽特拉先生确实是个有意思的人！”阿米娜笑着说，“既是巫师，又是修补匠，还是学者、数学家……最重要的是，他是个了不起的父亲。我真有点羡慕那对双胞胎，身边能有这么好的人。就算他只是个普通农民，我想巴纳福斯大概也会是这世上最讨人喜欢的男人之一。” 但他显然不是个农民，对吧？ “不，不，他不是。据我所知，他的妻子是苏丹娜宫廷的一员，而他本人则是某个显赫贵族家庭的次子或三子——抱歉，政治实在不是我的专长。我可以背诵从每一位苏丹、苏丹妃一直到纳迪娅本人的优美诗篇，那些诗会让你怀着炽热的爱国之情落泪，可要是让我解释它们究竟是什么意思，我拼了命也说不出来。不管怎样，我知道他在家乡颇有分量，他妻子更是如此。只是她无法生育，所以泽特拉先生才转向了神殿——这也正是贾西拉再正当不过的传统。我猜，等他们游历旧帝国的旅程结束后，卡拉本来会成为他和兰达夫人的正式继承人。可既然凯特已经发誓侍奉神殿，卡拉又走了……不，这都不重要。你们总会想办法把卡拉找回来的，所以不必担心万一找不回来会怎样。事情就是这么简单。” 当然。反正这也是你的期望吧。 阿米娜点了点头，说道：“总之，这一切都说明，就算以马拉克信徒的标准来看，凯特和卡拉从小到大也什么都不缺。父母的关爱当然更不缺。有个富有的父亲和一位人脉广泛的母亲，意味着她们本会走得很远，而她们俩后来也都成了很好的人，这更是坐实了这一点。凯特最终拥有了属于自己的一座神殿，这一点我丝毫不觉得意外——而且我认为，巴纳福斯肯定为她如此全心全意地拥抱自己的道路而骄傲，就像他为卡拉认清自己不想陪她走凯特那条路而骄傲一样。天啊，我真希望他也能摸摸我的头，跟我说我是什么乖巧的小向日葵之类的……好吧，也许我确实不止有一点点嫉妒，哈哈。” ]
rows.raw: " [rand | "Caitriss is a sweetheart. One of the [silly |real OGs |truest believers in the faith ]," Amina says, tail swishing. "I knew she would go far in the church the day I met her, back when we were just little kids. She relentlessly hounded me until I agreed to be her friend, and even Imad couldn't pry her off! The girl knows what she wants, and she'll risk it all to get it. Or at least, she used to be like that..." Used to be? Amina's tail slows. "I... I don't know, maybe it's just me, but ever since I came out here, she's seemed... like a piece of her is missing. I guess it must be what happened with Calla. Cait's confidence seems so shaken now, compared to the girl I used to know. Deep down I think she's scared. Part of her that's always been there is just gone all of a sudden, and she doesn't know if she'll ever get it back. All I can do is try and comfort her when I can, keep her mind off of it when she'll let me." Forcing a smile, the dancer adds, "I'm glad she's had someone like you to help her through all this. I know facing this demon incursion alone couldn't have been easy for either of you. But now that we're all here, please, even if none of us are great wizards or fighters... let us comfort you and Cait in whatever ways you need." | "Oh, Calla... I have to admit that as much as I adore Cait, Calla and I were even closer. You might not guess it from looking at me now, but when I was younger I was pretty athletic — I loved to run as fast as my legs would take me. Calla was the same way: she loved to push her body to the limits, to see what she was capable of. So much so that one time she even climbed to the very top of one of the temple minerettes... only to be paralyzed so severely by fear that one of the temple matrons had to invoke a spell to go up and fetch her down. That was a sight, I'm sure. Whenever the Zethra twins would come to our little seaside temple, Calla and I would always spend every second of their visit we could get away playing. Really was the best friend I ever had. Hope to all the gods she's alright, wherever she is." A wistful little smile plays across Amina's dusky lips. "It's a shame she was so much like my brother, too, never able to find her peace with the temple. I always knew she'd end up leaving the first day she could. Ah. Don't tell Cait, but it's Mallach's honest truth — if that sister of hers had stayed and taken her vows, I might just have asked the matrons to sanction me marrying her. Not like her blue blood would have mattered between two women, both sworn to Mallach." How would that work — two harlots marrying? Amina gives you a teasing look. "Why? Getting ideas about couples' services? Ha! Well, it's true, there was a couple back at Cait's home temple that sold themselves as a pair, but mostly it worked like any secular marriage. Well, the ceremony's different, but after that it's just like any other profession of love and bonding between two people. Or more people. Mallach's not bound by mating pairs or anything." So what's different about the ceremony? "Well..." Amina teases, leaning back with a salacious smirk. "People back home call it a 'slut marriage' for a reason. If both partners are gonna be expected to sell their bodies even after they wed, the temple likes to test their dedication after a fashion. Where most married couples get whisked away to their wedding night together in intimate privacy, a pair of Mallachite harlots that wish to bond instead are undressed in front of as much of the adult congregation as can be gathered and, hand in hand, bent over the altar by the priest — who then exhorts the witnesses to come and bless their union. Which really everyone's expected to fuck both partners at least once each during the proceedings. It's a big, long, and very messy thing..." Guess Mallach isn't much for monogamy! She shrugs. "Slut marriages are only for between two harlots — acolytes that are expected to spend most of their adult lives sexually servicing strangers. If two laymen want to be wed by Mallach's priests, they wouldn't be expected to endure the entire congregation gangbanging them. Unless they wanted to, anyway. I've got no doubt the priests would be happy to arrange it if they did." | "Mister Zethra is certainly a character!" Amina laughs. "Wizard, tinker, scholar, mathematician... and most importantly, a great dad. I'm only a little jealous of the twins for having such a great guy around for them. Even if he'd been nothing more than a peasant, I think Barnaphous would probably be one of the most pleasant men in the world to be around." But he's hardly a peasant, is he? "No, no he is not. From what I gather, his wife's part of the Sultana's court, and he's a second or third son of some important noble house — sorry, politics aren't exactly my specialty. I can recite beautiful poems about every sultan and sultana up until Nadia herself that would make you cry with patriotic fervor, but I couldn't unpack what any of it actually meant to save my life. Regardless, I know that he's of some importance back home, and his wife even moreso. She couldn't have children, though, so Mister Zethra turned to the temples — as is only right and proper Jassiran tradition. I imagine Calla would have ended up becoming his and Lady Randa's official heir when their tour of the old empire was finished up. With Cait sworn to the temples and Calla gone, though... no, that doesn't matter. You'll all find some way to get Calla back, so there's no need to worry about what'd happen if you don't. And that's all there is to it." Of course. That's your hope, anyway. Amina nods. "Anyway, that's all to say that even by Mallachite standards, Cait and Calla grew up wanting for nothing. Certainly not parental affection. A rich dad and a well-connected mother meant they'd go far, and the fact that they both turned out to be great people besides only reinforces it. The fact that Cait ended up with a temple of her own doesn't surprise me in the least — and I think Barnaphous is certainly proud of her for embracing her path as wholeheartedly as she has, just as he was proud of Calla for recognizing that she didn't want to walk Cait's with her. Gods, I kinda wish he'd give me a headpat and tell me I'm his good little sunflower or whatever... okay maybe I am more than a little jealous, haha." ] "

rows.original: You enter into the Frost Hound Tavern. For the most part, everything is as it ought to be. The tavern is filled with people, most of them strangers, some of them familiar to you[party.has Agnimitra |. Agnimitra has a small crowd gathered around her as she plays her gittern for their entertainment; something jaunty and upbeat |. Someone is playing an instrument in one of the rearward corners of the main room; a lute, from the sound of it ]. It’s a bit livelier than you were expecting[dayNight | for the time of day |, even for the dead of night, as it is ]. Something dominates the picture of the tavern, however: a particularly massive body, wearing a dark cloak that goes all the way down to the floor, even from their sitting posture. The hood of the cloak’s been pulled up and obscures the figure’s face, but underneath the bottom hem of the fabric, you see a long, powerful tail, covered in serpentine scales – the topside of the tail is onyx-black, looking recently washed, or even polished, as it glints in the firelight of the tavern. At the end of the tail is a flickering red flame, burning healthily on the tip, but, oddly, not setting anything it touches alight. You recognize this person. Or, at least, the bulk, and the tail, and the clothes. You take a seat at an empty stool to the right of the person. "Astraea?" you ask, tapping on the person’s right arm. The cloaked figure starts in surprise at both the sound of the name and the touch on their arm. The hooded figure turns to you, and underneath the clouded hood, you see pale, drained skin, marked with crisscrossing black webs; a pair of golden eyes sit a fair distance from purple lips, giving them the appearance that they’re frozen cold. A strand of snow-white hair droops down from underneath the hood, but you can see the telltale flash of pink nearer to the hair’s root. "Oh, [pc.name]!" Astraea says jovially. The second she recognizes you, her posture changes completely, going from a hunched, hulking silhouette of a woman that just wanted to be left to her drink, to relaxing her back, lifting her mug in celebration, and even wagging her tail against the floor slightly. "Just the [pc.manWoman] I was thinking about! I was hoping to see you here!" You must admit, this is a surprise! Last you saw her, she was on her way to Tychris to report the success of her mission involving Matiha. That’s a fair distance from Hawkethorne – what is she doing here? "Questions second; drinks first," she demands, then turns her head towards the bar and taps on the countertop with her left hand. "Barkeep! Two more rounds!" You didn’t come here to drink, but... well, if she’s offering. "Let’s not undersell the achievement you accomplished in dealing with that witch, [pc.name]," Astraea says, lifting her mug to you in toast, but not drinking from it yet. "The world at large may not know of your deed, but I do. Nareva does. All of Tychris does. I owe you as many rounds as my purse will afford me, as far as it matters!" [pc.ra orc |You laugh and tell her not to say things that she can’t take back. Orcs are good at holding their drink. "I’m an Astrida magehunter," she smirks. "You’ll have to drink your fill of the sea of Kacia before you can catch up with my salary." She just walks around with a coin purse full enough to buy out a tavern of its beer? And she travels alone? "What, you think this needs protecting?" she says, lifting her left arm and flexing her bicep. The sleeve of her tunic doesn’t reach down far enough to conceal it; the muscle on her arm rises and rises until it’s the size of a kickball. "I may not have all my magic back yet, but[silly | I can still cast Fist with the best of them, at least when it comes to brutality |, well, let’s just say that I’m stuck in the right body ]." |[pc.isDK |Well, fuck it: free beer. You’re not about to try and talk her out of it. And all you had to do was go into the Ways Between and smash a rock. "You’re doing it again!" she says with a laugh, her left hand coming down to slap at her bulging knee. "What you did was something that two of Nareva’s finest couldn’t accomplish, and you’re comparing it to grinding a rock to dust. Stop trying to play it cool and take the victory for what it is." Maybe she’s right. Maybe you’re not bragging about it as much as you ought to. |Sure, you’ll take a free beer now and again, but you wouldn’t want to impose. What you did was for the better of Savarra as a whole. "'Impose’?" Astraea asks, crooking her head to one side before laughing. "That much humility can’t be healthy for a person. Anyone else that did what you did would never have shut up about it!" Would she have, if she accomplished the mission? "Would I, a magehunter, have bragged to people that I hunted a mage?" she asks. Then smirks. "Depends on who would listen." ] ] Garth soon arrives with two more full pitchers of frothing, golden ale, one in each hand, and sets them down in front of you both. True to her word, Astraea reaches into a coin purse that’s been tied to her left hip and withdraws a handful of coins – you don’t know how much, exactly, but definitely more than the beer is worth. Garth seems all too happy to continue to serve her if she’s going to pay like that. "It’s good to see you again, [pc.name]," Astraea says, lifting her mug in toast once more now that you have yours. You press your mug to hers. "To our continued health." And then she throws her head back and starts downing the mug, consuming the entire thing in a single swig – when you came in, she was looking so melancholy, and the drink in her hand had barely been touched. You’ve been with her for only a few minutes, and her spirits have shifted entirely. [pc.ra orc |Not to be outdone, you lift your own mug to your [pc.lipsChaste] and start drinking the entire thing right beside her. Whether or not you were expecting to get into something resembling a competition with her, your pride as an orc can’t just let her outdrink you. |[pc.isDK |You didn’t come here to get drunk (at least, not completely), and you know you’re not about to drink Astraea under the table. She probably gave herself an invincible liver when she polymorphed herself, for all you know. You throw the mug back and have a drink, but you don’t try to outpace her. |You didn’t come into the Frost Hound looking to get drunk (at least, not completely), but... Astraea’s sudden good mood is rather infectious. And she spent the money for you to have a drink. It’d be rude, and against her spirits, if you didn’t at least have a bit. ] ]
rows.translation: 你走进了霜犬酒馆。 酒馆里的一切似乎都井井有条。酒馆里挤满了人，其中大多数都是陌生人，但也有一些人你认识。[party.has Agnimitra |阿格尼米特拉弹奏着吉特琴，为周围的人们带来欢乐；她的演奏充满了活力与欢快的气氛。 |在主房间的某个后排角落，有人正在演奏某种乐器——从声音来判断，应该是鲁特琴。 ]这里的气氛比你预想的要热闹一些。[dayNight | 在这个时间段 |即使是在深夜，也是如此。 ]然而，有某个东西占据了酒馆画面中的主导地位：一个体型格外庞大的生物，它穿着一件长长的黑色斗篷，即使是在坐着的时候，斗篷也一直垂到地面。斗篷的兜帽被拉了起来，遮住了这个生物的面容，但从斗篷的下摆处，你可以看到一条长长的、强而有力的尾巴，尾巴上覆盖着蜿蜒的鳞片——尾巴的背部呈现出乌黑的光泽，看起来像是刚刚被清洗过，甚至被打磨过一样，在酒馆的火光照射下闪闪发光。在尾巴的末端，有一道闪烁的红色火焰，火焰在尖端旺盛地燃烧着，但奇怪的是，它并没有点燃任何它所接触到的东西。 你认出了这个人。或者，至少你能认出他的身体、尾巴以及他的衣服。你在那个人右侧的一把空凳子上坐了下来。 “阿斯特莱娅？”你轻声问道，同时轻触那个人的右臂。 那个披着斗篷的身影听到这个名字，同时也感受到手臂被触碰，顿时愣住了。那个戴着兜帽的身影转向你，在那层遮住面容的兜帽下，你可以看到苍白的皮肤上布满了纵横交错的黑色纹路；一对金色的眼睛距离那紫色的嘴唇有一段距离，这使得嘴唇看起来仿佛被冻得僵硬了。一缕雪白的头发从兜帽下方垂下来，但在发根附近，你可以看到那道标志性的粉红色光芒。 “哦，[pc.name]太好了！”阿斯特莱娅高兴地说道。当她认出你时，她的姿态立刻发生了变化——从原本那个蜷缩着、只想独自喝酒的女性形象，变成了放松身体、举起杯子庆祝的样子，甚至还有些兴奋地轻轻摇晃着尾巴。“真是太好了[pc.manWoman]我正好在想这个！我本来还希望能在这里见到你呢！” 你得承认，这确实是个意外吧！你上次见到她的时候，她正在前往泰克里斯的途中，去汇报她与玛蒂哈一起完成的任务取得的成果。从鹰棘镇到泰克里斯可是一段不短的距离——她怎么会在这里呢？ 先问问题，再喝酒，”她说道，然后转头朝向酒吧，用左手轻敲柜台：“酒保！再来两轮酒！” 你本来不是来喝酒的，不过……既然她主动提出来了，那就……好吧。 我们绝对不能低估你在对付那个女巫时所取得的成就。[pc.name]，阿斯特莱娅说道，她举起杯子向你敬酒，但暂时还没有喝下去。‘整个世界可能还不知道你的所作所为，但我知道。娜瑞瓦知道，整个提克里斯地区的人都知道。就我而言，无论我的钱包能负担得起多少次，我都应该请你喝酒，因为这对我来说意义重大！ [pc.ra orc |你笑着告诉她，不要说那些说出来就无法收回的话。兽人可是很会喝酒的。 “我可是阿斯特里达法师猎手，”她得意地笑道，“要想赶上我的薪水，你得先喝个够才行。” 她就带着一个装满钱的钱包到处走，这笔钱甚至足以买下整个酒馆的啤酒吧？而且她还是独自旅行的？ “什么，你这是觉得这个需要保护吗？”她说道，同时抬起左臂，活动着手臂上的二头肌。她的长袍袖子长度不够，无法完全遮住那块肌肉；她的手臂肌肉不断收缩，最终变得像一个足球那么大。“虽然我的魔法力量还没有完全恢复，但是[silly | 至少在狠辣程度上来说，我使用“拳头”这个技能仍然能比得上最厉害的那些人 |嗯，这么说吧，我现在陷入了困境。正确身体 ]。" |[pc.isDK |算了，管它呢：免费啤酒嘛。你总不可能试图劝她放弃这个想法吧。其实你只需要进入‘道路之间’，然后砸一块石头就行了。” “你又来这一套！”她笑着说，左手一挥，拍在了自己凸出的膝盖上。你所做的事情，连娜瑞瓦最优秀的两人都做不到，而你却把它说得好像只是把一块石头磨成粉末那么简单。别再装作若无其事了，好好承认这个胜利吧。” 也许她是对的。也许你不是你应该适当地夸耀一下这件事。 |当然，你偶尔会接受别人免费提供的啤酒，但你并不想让别人觉得这是你在强求什么。你所做的一切，都是为了整个萨瓦拉的利益。 “‘强求’？”阿斯特莱娅歪着头问道，然后笑了起来，“你居然这么谦虚不能这对一个人来说是有益的。如果其他人也做了你做的事，他们肯定也会一直喋喋不休地谈论这件事吧！” 那么，如果她完成了那个任务，她也会这样做吗？ “作为一个猎魔人，我会向别人吹嘘自己抓到了一名法师吗？”她问道，然后露出一丝笑容，“这得看有没有人愿意听吧。 ] ] 加斯很快拿着两罐冒着泡沫的金色麦芽酒走了过来，每只手各拿一罐，然后把它们放在你们两人面前。正如她所说，阿斯特莱娅从系在左腰上的钱袋里取出一把硬币——你不知道具体有多少，但肯定比这些啤酒的价值要高得多。看来，如果她愿意付这样的钱，加斯也非常乐意继续为她们服务。 “再次见到你真是太好了[pc.name]，为了我们所有的健康，”阿斯特莱娅说着，再次举杯祝酒。你也将自己的杯子与她的碰在了一起。“为了我们永远的健康。”然后她仰头将杯子里的酒一饮而尽——当你进来的时候，她看起来如此忧郁，手中的酒几乎没怎么被动过。你才和她相处了短短几分钟，她的情绪就已经完全改变了。 [pc.ra orc |为了不落后，你也举起了自己的杯子，准备一饮而尽。[pc.lipsChaste]然后就开始在她旁边把整杯东西都喝光。无论你原本是否打算和她展开一场类似竞赛的事情，作为一个兽人的自尊心，总不能就这样让她会把你喝得酩酊大醉。 |[pc.isDK |你来这儿可不是为了喝酒的（至少不是为了喝得烂醉如泥），你也知道自己不可能在喝酒上胜过她。说不定她在变形的时候给自己赋予了“无敌的肝脏”呢。你把杯子放回去，又喝了一口酒，但并没有试图在喝酒上超过她。 |你来到寒霜猎犬酒吧，本来并不是为了喝酒（至少不是为了喝个酩酊大醉），但是……阿斯特莱娅突然变得这么开心，这种气氛确实很容易传染。而且她还花了钱让你喝一杯。如果你连这一点都不做，那就太没礼貌了，也会违背她的本意。 ] ]

"Let’s not undersell the achievement you accomplished in dealing with that witch, [pc.name]," Astraea says, lifting her mug to you in toast, but not drinking from it yet. "The world at large may not know of your deed, but I do. Nareva does. All of Tychris does. I owe you as many rounds as my purse will afford me, as far as it matters!" [pc.ra orc |You laugh and tell her not to say things that she can’t take back. Orcs are good at holding their drink. "I’m an Astrida magehunter," she smirks. "You’ll have to drink your fill of the sea of Kacia before you can catch up with my salary." She just walks around with a coin purse full enough to buy out a tavern of its beer? And she travels alone? "What, you think this needs protecting?" she says, lifting her left arm and flexing her bicep. The sleeve of her tunic doesn’t reach down far enough to conceal it; the muscle on her arm rises and rises until it’s the size of a kickball. "I may not have all my magic back yet, but[silly | I can still cast Fist with the best of them, at least when it comes to brutality |, well, let’s just say that I’m stuck in the right body ]." |[pc.isDK |Well, fuck it: free beer. You’re not about to try and talk her out of it. And all you had to do was go into the Ways Between and smash a rock. "You’re doing it again!" she says with a laugh, her left hand coming down to slap at her bulging knee. "What you did was something that two of Nareva’s finest couldn’t accomplish, and you’re comparing it to grinding a rock to dust. Stop trying to play it cool and take the victory for what it is." Maybe she’s right. Maybe you’re not bragging about it as much as you ought to. |Sure, you’ll take a free beer now and again, but you wouldn’t want to impose. What you did was for the better of Savarra as a whole. "'Impose’?" Astraea asks, crooking her head to one side before laughing. "That much humility can’t be healthy for a person. Anyone else that did what you did would never have shut up about it!" Would she have, if she accomplished the mission? "Would I, a magehunter, have bragged to people that I hunted a mage?" she asks. Then smirks. "Depends on who would listen." ] ] Garth soon arrives with two more full pitchers of frothing, golden ale, one in each hand, and sets them down in front of you both. True to her word, Astraea reaches into a coin purse that’s been tied to her left hip and withdraws a handful of coins – you don’t know how much, exactly, but definitely more than the beer is worth. Garth seems all too happy to continue to serve her if she’s going to pay like that. "It’s good to see you again, [pc.name]," Astraea says, lifting her mug in toast once more now that you have yours. You press your mug to hers. "To our continued health." And then she throws her head back and starts downing the mug, consuming the entire thing in a single swig – when you came in, she was looking so melancholy, and the drink in her hand had barely been touched. You’ve been with her for only a few minutes, and her spirits have shifted entirely. [pc.ra orc |Not to be outdone, you lift your own mug to your [pc.lipsChaste] and start drinking the entire thing right beside her. Whether or not you were expecting to get into something resembling a competition with her, your pride as an orc can’t just let her outdrink you. |[pc.isDK |You didn’t come here to get drunk (at least, not completely), and you know you’re not about to drink Astraea under the table. She probably gave herself an invincible liver when she polymorphed herself, for all you know. You throw the mug back and have a drink, but you don’t try to outpace her. |You didn’t come into the Frost Hound looking to get drunk (at least, not completely), but... Astraea’s sudden good mood is rather infectious. And she spent the money for you to have a drink. It’d be rude, and against her spirits, if you didn’t at least have a bit. ] ] '

rows.original: "Questions now," Astraea says happily, setting down her now-empty mug and picking up the second drink that she had Garth get her. "You asked what it is I’m doing here. I’m actually here on business, believe it or not." On business? Is there some other emergency involving witches wielding ancient magics that you should know about? "You’ll be the first to know if there is," Astraea says with a smirk and a wink. You think to yourself that... you think you’re done witch-hunting for at least a little while. "Nah, nothing dangerous," she says, taking a swig of her beer and wiping it with the back of her left bracer. "It’s related to that Matiha witch, actually. One of her most powerful artifacts was that tower that she lived in, the one that could transform and teleport on her whims. Having had a first-hand encounter with her, I’m uniquely qualified to verify where the tower’s been. Well, me and Elexis. I guess that doesn’t make me 'uniquely’ qualified. I had followed its signatures to the foothills just to the east of this little hamlet. Up until she stuck it in the Ways Between, we had been relying on witness accounts that had actually seen the tower, but they’re sending me out to try and retrace Matiha’s steps." [var0 |Isn’t Matiha under her watch? Couldn’t she just, you know, interrogate her? "We have been," Astraea answers plainly, her face smooth as stone. "And she’s been very cooperative with us. Every question we give, she’s quick to answer. Naturally, we thought that she was trying to lure us into some false sense of security or something, but after confirming the first dozen or so answers with verifiable facts, we realized that she’s just... telling the honest-to-Nareva truth." Astraea lifts her massive right leg, resting her ankle on her knee. "I won’t lie, it's sort of weird and off-putting." Why’s that? "Because... I don’t know," she says, furrowing her brow and shaking her head. "It feels wrong. Every answer she gives us, it’s with this dejected, downtrodden, puppy-dog look in her eyes, like she has nowhere to go and nothing more to live for, so there’s no sense in lying. I can barely believe it’s the same witch that mind-controlled Elexis and sucked the magic right out of my body. It’s almost like we got the wrong woman." Astraea takes another gulp of her beer. A much, much longer one. Thinking about Matiha – and thinking about how Matiha is acting so innocently with the Narevan mages – is clearly putting her 'off-center.’ "It’s definitely her," Astraea says as she lowers her mug onto the bar’s countertop. She uncrosses her legs. "I’d recognize her gigantic, uh, hat, anywhere. But she’s... not the same. Whatever you did to her in that tower really did a number on her personality." Changing topic a bit, you |You ] ask her about Elexis – which might be a sour topic. They were comrades, and Astraea was particularly upset about Elexis not making it out of the tower. Is she okay? Last you saw her, she was in... bad shape. "I’m happy to say that she’s stable," Astraea replies joylessly. "But she... she was in the Ways Between, inside that tower, for a lot longer than I was, [pc.name]. It’s been however many days now since I’ve escaped, and I can barely make a spark with my fingers. I still can’t enter the Ways Between, either; it’s like walking through a wall of fire for me. But I’m getting stronger." As if to prove herself, Astraea turns her free hand over, palm facing upward, and flexes her gloved fingers. She glowers down at the palm of her hand, focusing intently on the space just above it; her fingers twitch and fidget with effort, as if she was trying to pry apart something sturdy. [pc.isMage |You feel the faintest twitch of something in the air between you two. Something very familiar, intrinsic to your very being – it’s like the gentle caress of a lover on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], brushing you just faintly enough to [pc.sfs |raise the hairs on your arms |brush the fur on your arms against the grain |raise the heat on your arms |tickle at your arms ], but so weak that anybody not as attuned to it as you would notice. Astraea is trying to use magic. The arcane miasma permeating the very air around you wisps and turns around her fingers with all the force of a butterfly’s wing. The very lowest of apprentices would be able to churn something stronger with less concentration than she’s putting into it. Eventually, the tiniest of sparks lights at the very tip of her thumb, and only for the briefest of seconds, before all of that effort evaporates to nothing. |You stare at her hand, one eyebrow raised in curiosity, as she focuses on it intensely. You can’t begin to wonder what it is she’s doing; from your angle, she looks as though something’s been strapped to her hand down to the wrist, and she’s trying to pry it off with an angry look. When your eyes go back to her tensed fingers, there’s suddenly a spark of light – a faint one, something weaker and dimmer than you could probably get by scuffing a pair of coins together really fast. But it was there. ] Astraea smirks, proud of the extremely little progress she just displayed. "I’m a master polymorph, [pc.name]. I was a leading witch in one of the most difficult schools of magic to master. I was one of the best, most elite magehunters within the Astrida, in all of Nareva’s service. And now I can’t even make more than a sparkler on my fingertips." She leans back and takes another hearty swig of her beer. She seems awfully satisfied with her[pc.isDK | fall from grace |, uh, progress ]. "When I got out of that tower, I couldn’t even manage that," she replies. "I wasn’t capable of even the littlest bit of magic. Which means that I’m healing. Elexis is, too," she continues, raising her mug up and away, her eyes to the ceiling of the tavern as she toasts the air, "but... it’s going to take her longer. She’s going to be bedridden for some time." Well then, if you need anything more to toast to, then it’d be to her, and Elexis, and their continued good health. You raise your mug. "Sure, I’ll toast to that," she replies with a toothy grin, pressing hers against yours before throwing it back and swallowing another few mouthfuls. You note that she’s going through it rather fast. How much beer has she had since she got here? Again, she lowers the mug and wipes her mouth with the back of her bracer. "This would be my fourth," she answers. "I crafted this body to be the strongest, most powerful form possible to combat Matiha in her tower. I know it doesn’t look like it now," she says as she lifts her finger to her face, tracing the black webbing all around her cheeks and eyes perfectly, and without the use of a mirror. "But this [silly |is what peak performance looks like |body is in perfect condition – the strength, the stamina, the blood pressure... it was all meticulously crafted to be the peak physical form ]." She clicks her tongue as she stares into the mug with some derision. "Which means its tolerance for alcohol is frustratingly high. Just one more reason why I’m looking forward to getting back into my own body." She loudly pats her hand on the wooden countertop to get Garth’s attention. "Barkeep! Another!"
rows.translation: 现在该问问题了，”阿斯特莱娅开心地说，她放下了已经空了的杯子，然后拿起加斯给她拿来的第二杯饮料。“你们之前问我来这里是为了什么。其实，信不信由你，我是来办事的。 是公事吗？难道还有其他与女巫们使用古老魔法有关的紧急情况需要你知道吗？ “如果有的话，你一定会是第一个被告知的。”阿斯特莱娅笑着说，还眨了眨眼。 你心里想着：是啊，确实应该让我先知道才行。你以为自己可以暂时停止这种‘猎巫’行动了吧。” “不，没什么危险的，”她一边说，一边喝了一口啤酒，然后用左臂护手背擦了擦嘴。“其实，这和那个叫玛蒂哈的女巫有关。她最强大的神器之一，就是那座她居住其中的塔楼——那座能够根据她的意愿随意变形和传送的塔楼。由于我曾与她有过直接接触，因此我完全有资格确认这座塔楼目前位于何处。嗯，我和艾莱克西斯一起。不过，这大概并不能让我被认为具备“独特的”资格吧。我们一直沿着那些痕迹，一路追到了这个小村庄东边的山脚下。在她把那东西放入“通道”之前，我们一直依靠那些目击者的描述来推进调查看到过那座塔，但他们让我出去尝试沿着玛蒂哈的足迹重新走一遍。 [var0 |难道玛蒂哈不是在她们的监管之下吗？她们难道不能直接审问她吗？” “我们已经这么做了，”阿斯特莱娅平静地回答，她的面容如同石头一般毫无表情，“而且她也非常配合我们的调查。我们提出的每一个问题，她都很快就回答了。我们起初以为她是在试图让我们产生一种虚假的安全感之类的，但在用可验证的事实核对了前十几条回答之后，我们意识到她其实只是在……说完全真实的实话。阿斯特莱娅抬起她那粗壮的右腿，将脚踝搁在膝盖上。‘说实话，这种感觉有点奇怪，甚至让人感到不适。’” “为什么会有这种感觉呢？” “因为……我也说不清楚，”她皱着眉头，摇了摇头说道。这种感觉错误她给我们的每一个回答，都带着那种沮丧、卑微的神情，眼神中仿佛充满了无助与绝望，就好像她已经无处可去，也没有任何理由继续活下去，所以撒谎也没有任何意义。我简直无法相信，这就是那个曾经控制了埃莱克西斯、把我的魔力全部吸走的同一个女巫。感觉我们找错人了……” 阿斯特莱娅又喝了一大口啤酒。这一口比之前的任何一口都要长得多。一想到玛蒂哈——以及想到玛蒂哈是如何与纳雷万的法师们一起表现得如此天真无邪的，她就感到非常不安。肯定是她，”阿斯特莱娅说着，将杯子放在吧台的台面上，然后解开了交叉的双腿。“我在任何地方都能认出她那顶巨大的帽子。但是她……已经不一样了。你在那座塔里对她做的那些事，确实严重影响了她的性格。换个话题吧，你…… |你 ]我很高兴地告诉你，她的状况已经稳定了，”阿斯特莱娅愉快地回答道，“但是她……她在那座塔里，在‘幽途’之中待的时间，比我长多了。[pc.name]然而，自从我逃脱以来，已经过去了好多天，我的手指几乎已经无法产生任何火花了。我也还是无法进入那些通道之中，对来说，那就像是在穿越一堵火墙一样。不过，我正在逐渐变得更强。仿佛是在证明自己的能力，阿斯特莱娅将空着的那一只手掌心向上翻开，戴着手套的手指微微弯曲。她凝视着自己的手掌，专注地注视着手掌正上方的那个区域；她的手指不停地抽动、扭动，仿佛在努力撬开某个坚硬的东西。 [pc.isMage |你能感觉到，在你们两人之间的空气中，有某种微妙的东西在悄然流动。那种感觉非常熟悉，仿佛是你与生俱来的一部分——就像恋人轻柔的抚触一样[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]轻轻刷过你的身体，刚好达到那种效果[pc.sfs |让人不寒而栗 |用手臂逆着毛发的生长方向摩擦 |让手臂更加活跃起来 |惹人发笑 ]但这种力量太过微弱，除非像你这样对它极为敏感的人，否则根本不会注意到。 阿斯特莱娅正在尝试使用魔法。弥漫在你周围空气中的那股神秘能量，如同蝴蝶的翅膀般轻柔地围绕着她的手指流动。就算是最初级的学徒，也能用比她少得多的精力做出更强大的成果。然而，最终，她拇指尖上仅会迸发出一丝微弱的火花，而那短暂的瞬间过后，所有那些努力都会化为乌有。 |你注视着她的手，好奇地挑起了眉毛，而她则全神贯注地盯着自己的手看。你实在想不明白她到底在做什么；从你的角度看，她的手上似乎被什么东西绑在了手腕处，而她正用愤怒的表情试图把它弄掉。 当你的目光再次落在她紧绷的手指上时，突然有一道微弱的光芒出现了——那光芒很微弱，比快速摩擦两枚硬币所产生的轻型还要弱小、暗淡。但确实有那么一道轻型。 ] 阿斯特莱娅得意地笑了笑，为自己刚才所取得的那一点点进展感到自豪。“我可是个变形大师啊[pc.name]我曾经是其中一所最难掌握魔法的学校里最出色的女巫之一。在娜瑞瓦帝国的整个阿斯特里达地区，我也是最顶尖、最精英的猎魔人之一。然而现在，我的指尖甚至连一丝微弱的火花都无法产生。” 她向后仰靠，又大口喝了一口啤酒。看来，她对自己目前的处境感到相当满意。[pc.isDK | 失宠 |嗯，进展吧。 ]当我从那座塔里出来时，我甚至都无法那个是的，”她回答道，“我甚至不具备最基本的魔法能力。这意味着我正在恢复健康，艾莱克西斯也是。”她继续说道，将杯子举到空中，目光望向酒馆的天花板，对着空气举杯致敬，“但是…………这会花她更长的时间。她有一段时间将不得不卧床不起。” 那么，如果还有什么值得我们举杯庆祝的事情，那就是祝她、祝埃莱克西斯以及他们能够一直保持健康。大家举起你们的杯子吧。 当然，我为此干杯。”她咧着嘴笑着说道，将自己的杯子轻轻碰了一下你的杯子，然后继续喝了起来。 你注意到她喝得相当快。从她来到这里开始，她已经喝了多少啤酒呢？ 她再次低下杯子，用护臂的后部擦了擦嘴。“这已经是第四次了，”她回答道。“我精心打造了这个身体，让它成为最强大、最有力的形态，以便能在玛蒂哈的塔中与她对抗。虽然现在看起来并不像那样，”她说着，用手指轻轻触碰自己的脸颊和眼睛——那些黑色的网状纹路竟然如此清晰，而她根本没有使用镜子。但是这个[silly |这就是巅峰表现的真正模样。 |身体状况堪称完美——力量、耐力、血压……所有这些指标都经过精心调养，以达到最佳的体能状态。 ]她吐了吐舌头，带着一丝嘲讽的目光盯着那个杯子。“这意味着这种酒对酒精的耐受性高得让人恼火。这也正是我迫不及待想要回到自己身体里的另一个原因。”她大声地用手拍打木制台面，想引起加斯的注意：“酒保！再来一杯！

More than anything, you want to take the opportunity to thank Barney for the most enchanting beauty to ever grace the Frost Marches. It genuinely takes a second for the realized to set in for Cait, but when it does, her ears flatten against her scalp and her cheeks flush red while her father laughs from the belly. 

    "Oh, you're quite the charmer, aren't you?" he chuckles, wiping the corner of his eye. "Well, it was my absolute privilege to help raise such a sweet girl — and really, I should be the one thanking you for taking such good care of her out there. Really, after everything that's happened, I'd be utterly lost if something happened to my sweet little sunflower..."
    
    "D-Daaaad." Somehow Cait's blushing even more now, but her tail's swishing a mile a minute behind her. 
    
    Barney puts his hands on his daughter's shoulders. "Don't you be embarrassed, Caitriss. You know you and your sister have always been the world to me. If there's anything good I've contributed to this world, it's the two of you. [pc.name] just sees what's clear as day to anyone."
    
    Ain't that the truth.

    哦，你真是个会吸引别人注意的人，不是吗？”他轻笑着，擦了擦眼角。“能够帮助培养出这样一个可爱的女孩，对我来说真的是一种莫大的荣幸——事实上，应该是我来感谢你，因为你一直这么悉心照顾她。说真的，经历了这一切之后，如果我亲爱的小向日葵出了什么事，我真的会不知所措……”

    "Oho! You liked what you saw, eh? Well, well, it's true I have mastered a few cantrips in my day, though it's hardly as impressive as all that. What you saw back there was mostly smoke and mirrors and a bit of illusion-craft — just a bit, I say. Really, my talents lie in research and numismatics of a more mundane variety. rows.translation:
回想起在商队旅馆里看到的那些神奇表演，你便问巴尼是否愿意再给你表演几个把戏。 

    “哦哦！你喜欢刚才看到的表演，是吧？其实，我确实掌握了一些简单的戏法，不过跟那些精彩的表演相比，还差得远呢。你刚才看到的，多半只是烟幕和幻象，再加上一点点欺骗手段——只不过是那么一点点而已。事实上，我的真正才能在于研究那些更为平凡的领域，比如货币学。正如我们亲爱的苏丹娜自己所说，我就是一个精通算盘的“巫师”！不过说到战场的话，嗯，那就更不用说了。”
    
    那么他就没有什么可以教你的了吗？
    
    巴尼摆弄着自己的帽子，低声嘟囔着一些含糊不清的咒语，最后才说道：“呃，我可没那么说！啊，对了，我们俩坐下来，好好聊一聊关于神秘学的话题吧！亲爱的凯特，麻烦给我们泡壶茶，好吗？”
    
    “呵呵，当然可以，爸爸。你们俩好好聊吧！”
rows.raw:
"
    Recalling the magic you saw on display back at the Caravanserai, you ask Barney if he wouldn't mind showing you a few tricks. 

    "Oho! You liked what you saw, eh? Well, well, it's true I have mastered a few cantrips in my day, though it's hardly as impressive as all that. What you saw back there was mostly smoke and mirrors and a bit of illusion-craft — just a bit, I say. Really, my talents lie in research and numismatics of a more mundane variety. I am, as our beloved Sultana has herself declared, a wizard of the abacus! Of the battlefield, though, hrm, much less so."
    
    So he's got nothing to teach you?
    
    Barney fidgets with his cap, mumbling half-formed arcane utterances under his breath before finally asserting "Well, I didn't quite go that far! Ah, yes, let's have ourselves a sitdown you and I and engage in a bit of occultic osmosis! Cait, dear, put a pot of tea on for us, would you?"
    
    "Hehe. Sure, dad. Have fun, you two!""

rows.translation: 学习技能

rows.original:
You spend the rest of the day studying from Barney's notes and vast collection of largely pointless but certainly very esoteric texts on the occult. It would be dry reading if not for the jovial company of the ever-excitable scholarly gentleman who's always happy to share some story about where that particular tome is from, or who taught him some obscure piece of arcana that's ever-so-slightly tangentially related to what you're doing. If he weren't such a talented storyteller, it might be exasperating, but as it is, between Barney's belly-laughs and Cait dropping in from time to time to bring tea and food, it's a pleasant day indeed.
        
        When you finally retire back home, it's well past dark, and you're only allowed to leave after Cait's served up a lovely meal of fresh-caught fish from the market that's been absolutely encrusted with red-hot Jassiran spices Barney brought along for the trip. It's certainly spicier than anything you're likely to find in the Marches, and so savory that you can't forget the taste until well after you're nestled in bed[cait.fucked|, getting ridden into the mattress by Cait]. You fall asleep soon after, mind full of Jassiran magics...
rows.translation:
你花了一整天的时间研读巴尼的笔记，以及他收集的大量关于神秘学的书籍——这些书籍大多内容枯燥无味，但确实充满深奥的知识。要不是有这位总是兴致勃勃的学者陪伴着你，这些阅读过程就会变得十分乏味。他总是乐于分享关于那些书籍的来历，或者讲述哪些人曾向他传授过一些与你当前研究内容略有关联的晦涩知识。如果他不是一个如此擅长讲故事的人，这种情况可能会让人感到烦躁，但事实上，有巴尼的阵阵大笑，还有凯特不时过来端茶送饭，这一天确实过得相当愉快。
        
        当你终于回到家时，天已经完全黑了，而且只有在凯特准备好用市场上新鲜捕获的鱼烹制的一顿美味饭菜之后，你才被允许离开——这些鱼还被撒上了巴尼为这次旅行特意带来的热辣的贾西兰香料。它肯定比你在边境地区能找到的任何食物都要辣，而且鲜美得让你在床上躺下之后很久都忘不掉那股味道。[cait.fucked|，被凯特骑得陷进床垫里]不久之后，你便进入了梦乡，脑海中仍回荡着贾西兰的魔法……
