rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Train non-class ranged power that you are high enough level to use. Costs 100 Electrum Coins per level of the power, and will take up the rest of your day.
rows.translation: 当你达到足够高的等级时，就可以学习这种非职业范围的远程技能。学习每级这种技能需要消耗100枚琥珀金币，而且学习过程会占用你一整天的时间。
rows.raw: "Train non-class ranged power that you are high enough level to use. Costs 100 Electrum Coins per level of the power, and will take up the rest of your day."

rows.original:
You ask Barney if he and Cait have made any breakthroughs with Calla's situation since you talked last.

    "Ah, my poor girl," he sighs, adjusting his cap. "By all the gods, I wish there was some way to know she was safe. That there was something we could do for her, but all evidence indicates that the portal won't open for another year, no matter what sorcery we attempt. Perhaps only the gods have the power to [silly|reverse an isekai plotline|open portals out of season]. But still, I won't give up hope, nor sit idly by! Someone, somewhere, must know more about extra-planar travel than that witch Evergreen — we simply must look!"
    
    Cait worries one of her ears. "I just wish we had access to a proper archive, or one of the old Belharan schools of magic — somewhere like Estelore. Sketchy witches in the woods are one thing, but actually having primary sources or research notes to hand would be a big help. Until then, I just can't shake the feeling that we aren't doing enough. That there's something we're missing in all this!"
    
    "Perhaps the city of Tychris might have something for us?" Barney postulates, rapping his knuckles against one of his tomes. "It's only a couple of days from Hawkstone Barony, and was once a renowned center of the magical arts. Admittedly, the salamanders were most famous for their war mages — and for their glassblowing, truly remarkable craftsmanship, that was — but the city still was home to many reputable scholars of every school of magic, and I know there was a great archive in the city. Or there was, before the Godswar. [flags.TYCHRIS_ENTER
        |I hear you've been there yourself, [pc.name]! Please, if you would, bring Caitriss along next time you have cause to visit the city. I'm sure she'd be able to make some headway in their archives!"
    
        "I'm sure I can!" Cait nods, patting Barney's shoulder. "I'll find something there that can help us. Some clue, or... or some kind of wizardry the Tychrisian mages have forgotten about in there. There has to be something — so please, [pc.name]... let me come with you next time?"
        |Yet another reason to make our way there, when the roads clear up. According to Garth, they're still mostly snowed in from that great blizzard."
    
        Cait pats his shoulder. "Don't worry, dad. We'll find a way to Tychris eventually!"
    ]
rows.translation:
你问巴尼，自从上次谈话以来，他和凯特是否在卡拉的处境上取得了什么突破。

    “啊，我可怜的女儿，”他一边调整帽子，一边叹息。“诸神在上，我真希望有办法确认她平安无事，也希望我们能为她做些什么；可所有证据都表明，无论尝试何种魔法，那道传送门都要再过一年才会开启。或许只有诸神拥有[silly|逆转异世界剧情|让传送门在错误季节开放]的力量。不过，我绝不会放弃希望，也不会坐以待毙！在某个地方一定有人比常青女士那个女巫更了解异位面旅行——我们必须找到那个人！”
    
    凯特不安地拨弄一只耳朵。“我只希望我们能进入一座正规的档案馆，或者贝尔哈尔某所古老的魔法学院——像埃斯托洛尔那样的地方。林子里形迹可疑的女巫是一回事，可要是手边真有第一手资料或研究笔记，那会大有帮助。在找到它们之前，我始终无法摆脱这种感觉：我们做得还不够，在这一切之中遗漏了什么！”
    
    “或许提克里斯城里有我们需要的东西？”巴尼一边推测，一边用指节敲着一本典籍。“那里距离鹰石男爵领只有几天路程，而且曾是著名的魔法艺术中心。诚然，蝾螈族最负盛名的是战法师——还有玻璃吹制；那确实是非凡的工艺——不过城里依然汇聚了各魔法学派的许多知名学者；而且我知道，那里曾有一座宏伟的档案馆。至少诸神之战前是这样。[flags.TYCHRIS_ENTER
        |听说你亲自去过那里，[pc.name]！拜托，下次你因事进城时，请带凯特丽丝一起去。我相信她一定能在档案馆里取得一些进展！”
    
        “我一定可以！”凯特点点头，拍了拍巴尼的肩膀。“我会在那里找到能帮助我们的东西。某条线索，或者……或者提克里斯法师遗忘在那里的某种魔法。一定会有什么的——所以求你了，[pc.name]……下次让我和你一起去，好吗？”
        |等道路恢复通行后，我们又多了一个前往那里的理由。据加斯所说，那场大暴风雪后，道路现在大多仍被积雪封锁。”
    
        凯特拍了拍他的肩膀。“别担心，爸爸。我们迟早会找到前往提克里斯的路！”
    ]

rows.translation: 关于卡拉

rows.original: "Ah, Jassira, the sweet desert rose of my youth," Barney sighs wistfully, scratching at his moustache. "What's there to say that hasn't been written in poetry and sung by bards since time immemorial?" Cait giggles. "Dad... you can just say it's very pretty and very warm." "Haha! Well, I'm sure I have a bit more to say about it than that, sunflower. As I mentioned when we met, [pc.name], I am a magistrate of the Sultanate — a position that requires me to travel not just throughout the country of Jassira but through all the lands she has conquered, to be the eyes and the ears of the Sultana. I have traveled from the grassy mountains of northern Arkacia, so rich in history and ancient castles and cities, and sailed the endless deserts south of Jassira through the great river, where I met with nomadic anubian tribes and great prides of manticores lording over the scant few oases with harems so indolent and luxurious even the Sultana herself became jealous when I described them!" "And don't forget the Great Temple!" Cait chimes in, tail wiggling excitedly. "There's a pantheon in the capital dedicated to all the gods, but Mallach's temple shines higher than all of them at the very heart of the city. You can hear its bells anywhere... and the harlots' moans, too, on hol[silly|e-]y days. [var0|Ah, I wish my own temple could be even half as grand... that I could bring so much of Mallach's love all the way out here! It would melt the frost right out of the Marches!|I wish you could see it, [pc.name]! There's nothing even a tenth as grand anywhere on the continent outside of Belhar City.]" Barney chuckles to himself. "Ah, perhaps when we have Calladona back, I'll have the privilege of taking you there in the flesh! You haven't lived until you've seen the great spires of the capital glistening from the first rain of the year, so bright in the sunlight you can hardly bear to look at them. And all the fruits, from every land touched by the Sea of Sapphires, brought to market by the most beautiful merchant-princesses for the pleasure of the Sultana's court. Oh, look at me, I'm getting homesick already, aren't I? Yes, yes I am..."
rows.translation: “啊，贾西拉，我年轻时心中那朵甜美的沙漠玫瑰……”巴尼满怀感慨地叹息着，一边挠着自己的胡须。“关于她，自古以来不就有无数诗篇被创作出来，也有无数吟游诗人用歌声来赞美她吗？” 凯特咯咯笑了起来：“爸爸……你直接说她非常漂亮、非常温暖不就行了。” “哈哈！不过，关于她，我要说的可远不止那个，向日葵。就像我们见面时我提到的那样，[pc.name]，我是苏丹国的官员——这个职位要求我不仅要在贾西拉国内游历，还要走遍她所征服的所有土地，做苏丹娜的耳目。我曾游历阿尔卡西亚北部草木繁茂的山脉，那里历史底蕴深厚，遍布古老的城堡与城市；也曾沿着那条大河穿越贾西拉南部无边无际的沙漠，在那里遇到了游牧的阿努比亚部落，以及统治着寥寥几处绿洲的庞大蝎狮群——它们的后宫如此慵懒奢靡，以至于当我向苏丹娜描述时，连她本人都心生嫉妒！” “还有伟大的神庙呢，可别忘了！”凯特兴奋地插话道，尾巴兴奋地摇来摇去。“首都有一座供奉所有神明的万神殿，但马拉克的神庙位于城市正中心，比它们所有都要辉煌。无论在哪儿，你都能听到它的钟声……还有圣[silly|洞]日里那些妓女的呻吟声。[var0|啊，我真希望自己的神庙能有它一半的宏伟……这样我就能把马拉克这么多的爱一路带到这里来！这样的爱意一定能融化边境地区的严寒！|我真希望你能看到它，[pc.name]！除了贝尔哈城，整个大陆上再也没有哪里能有它十分之一的宏伟。]” 巴尼自顾自地笑了起来。“啊，也许等我们把卡拉多娜找回来之后，我就能有幸亲自带你去那里看看了！你要是在年初第一场雨后，见过首都那些高耸的尖塔在阳光下闪闪发亮、耀眼得几乎让人不敢直视的样子，才算没白活一场。还有那些水果，来自蓝宝石之海所及的每一片土地，由最美丽的商人公主们送进市场，只为供苏丹娜的宫廷享用。哦，看看我，我都开始想家了，不是吗？是的，是的，我确实想家了……”

rows.translation: 贾西拉

rows.original: Glancing from Cait to Barney, you ask the elder cat if he wouldn't mind telling you about Cait's other parent. Barney smiles at just the thought of her. "Mmm, Nadira, the most radiant of Mallach's beloved, whose beauty, wit, and charm knew no equal — until our daughters were grown, haha! Ah, Caitriss [cait.thicknessRange 70 90|is the gods' own simulacra of her, I'd say. Truly, the resemblance is more striking now than it's ever been|has filled out even more than her mother, but still, the resemblance is striking indeed!|[cait.cupRange G|is perhaps more, ehem, buxom than her mother but beyond that the resemblance is truly striking!|[cait.isLeothran|was, before she became quite so fluffy at least, was the god's own simulacra of her mother.|is nearly the gods' own simulacra of her mother — or will be, when she's a bit older and aha, more filled out.]]] Really, as the Belharans would say, the apple did not fall far from the tree!" "Calla's even more like her," Cait adds. "At least on the outside. Though she always tried to be as opposite to us as she could on the inside..." Her father places a hand gently on Cait's shoulder. "Calladona is a very independent soul. Where you and your mother found peace and stability in the Temple, she saw a gilded cage. If only she'd realized it was also safety..." Barney sighs, adjusting his cap. "But... let us not dwell on such things, hmm? We can at least take heart in knowing that your mother is safe and well back at the Great Temple, and will welcome both her beautiful girls back with open arms someday soon. Ah, the stories you will both have to tell her..." You clear your throat gently, before the cats can get too lost in homesickness. Barney still hasn't told you what Nadira's really like. "Ah, hmm, yes of course, my apologies [pc.name]. It is just difficult to put a whole person, especially one I have known most of my life, into a few sentences — and every turn of phrase that comes to mind sounds like worshipful verse for a goddess!" "Try something like, 'She's very kind and pretty, a good dancer and a better poet, and a great mom.' See, easy!" Laughing, Barney ruffles Cait's hair and says, "Yes, yes, quite right! Yes, that's my Nadira. Beautiful inside and out, with a brilliant mind for the arts, and a heart overflowing with care and love for everyone who has the pleasure of her acquaintance. And knowing her is, indubitably, one of life's greatest pleasures." So: he's a magister of Jassira and she's a temple harlot — how did that work out? "Ah, yes, well... a fair a question as any, I suppose. I suppose it all started, oh, nearly thirty years ago now. My family had long since betrothed me to Randa, my wife, and the day of our marriage was fast approaching. I was desperately nervous, as most young men are, but doubly so because I was a bookish fellow, prone to long nights of study and days spent reading, rather than, ah, consorting with the opposite sex. I had known my lady Randa for some time by then, of course, and really was quite enamored with her — I should say I'm luckier than most, privileged as I am to marry a woman I'd consider among my dearest friends even if we were not romantically involved. But, indeed, that very fondness is what drove me to the Mallachite temple — the idea of, shall we say, displeasing my dear Randa on our wedding night had me so knotted up I couldn't see straight!" Barney chuckles at himself, cheeks rosy. "Well, what's a man to do but seek out the help of professionals? Yes, indeed, he must do something to ease his mind about such things, and where better than in the arms of one of Mallach's beloved? Between the three of us, [pc.name], I have always thought it was fate — that I would find my way to the Prince of Passion's temple on the same day that a noble-blooded girl, far more charming and witty than any of her peers, was making her debut. There were many, many suitors eager to claim her first, but somehow amidst that throng of wealthy and prestigious men... Nadira picked me out of the crowd. We connected immediately — a few words and looks exchanged, and it was as if I'd known her my whole life, yes. I'll be forever grateful for what she taught me, not just that night but every day that I could find my way to her ever after." Cait smiles, tail swishing. "All while we were growing up, dad was always dropping in at the temple whenever he wasn't on assignment from the Sultana. Seeing him around, spending time with mom, always brightened my day. Mallach loves when we love!" "Ah, yes, well, I do try... and don't ever believe for a second that you girls and your mother don't do just the same for me."
rows.translation: 你将目光在凯特和巴尼之间来回移动，然后询问那只年长的猫，是否愿意告诉你关于凯特的另一位父母的一些事情。 一想到她，巴尼就露出了微笑。“嗯，纳迪拉——马拉克最钟爱的女子之一，她的美貌、智慧与魅力无与伦比……直到我们的女儿们长大成人，哈哈！啊，凯特[cait.thicknessRange 70 90|我想说，她简直就是神明创造的自己的复制品。说实话，如今这种相似之处比以往任何时候都要明显。|她的外貌甚至比她母亲还要出众，不过，这种相似之处确实非常明显！|[cait.cupRange G|或许她的胸部比她母亲更丰满一些，但除此之外，她们之间的相似之处确实非常明显！|[cait.isLeothran|至少在她还不是现在这个样子之前，她简直就是她母亲的完美复制品。|她几乎就是她母亲的完美复制品——等她再长大一些，身材更加丰满之后，就会变得更加像她母亲了。]]]真的，用贝尔哈兰人的话说，‘苹果不会掉得离树太远’吧！” “卡拉和她更是如此，”凯特补充道，“至少外表上是这样。不过在内心深处，她总是试图与我们形成最大的反差……” 她的父亲轻轻拍了拍凯特的肩膀：“卡拉多娜是一个非常独立的灵魂。你和你的母亲在神庙中找到了平静与安宁，她却看到了一座镀金的牢笼。要是她能早些意识到，那其实也是安全……” 巴尼叹了口气，调整了一下自己的帽子，说道：“不过……咱们还是别纠结这些事情了，嗯？至少我们可以欣慰的是，你的母亲安然无恙地待在大神殿里，不久的将来，她一定会张开双臂，欢迎你们两个漂亮的女儿回家。啊，你们俩以后肯定有很多故事要讲给她听呢……” 你轻轻清了清嗓子，以免那些猫咪们过于陷入思乡之情。毕竟，巴尼至今还没有告诉你纳迪拉到底是个怎样的人。 “啊，嗯，对了，当然，实在抱歉，[pc.name]。要把一个完整的人，尤其是这样一个我陪伴了大半人生的人，用短短几句话描述出来，确实是一件很难的事——而且我脑海中想到的每一句话，听起来都像是在赞美一位女神啊！” “你可以试试这样说：‘她非常善良又漂亮，舞跳得很好，诗写得更好，还是个非常出色的母亲。’看，多简单！” 巴尼笑着揉了揉凯特的头发，说道：“没错，没错，正是这样！对，这就是我的纳迪拉——内外兼美，对艺术有着非凡的鉴赏力，心中充满了对每一个有幸与她相识之人的关怀与爱。能与她相识，无疑是人生中最美好的事情之一。” 所以，他是贾西拉的法师，而她是神庙里的妓女——他们究竟是怎么走到一起的？ “啊，这个嘛……我想，这确实是个值得探讨的问题。一切大概都是从将近三十年前开始的。我的家人早就把我许配给了兰达，也就是我的妻子，我们的婚期也快到了。我和大多数年轻男子一样，内心充满了紧张与不安，但我的情况更为复杂——因为我是个书生气较重的人，常常整夜学习，整天埋头读书，而很少有机会与异性交往。当然，那时我已经认识兰达小姐有一段时间了，而且我真的非常喜欢她。我应该说，我比大多数人都幸运，有幸娶到了一个我视为挚友的女性，即使我们之间并没有恋爱关系。但事实上，正是这种强烈的喜爱之情驱使我前往马拉克信徒神庙——可以说，一想到在我们的婚礼之夜让亲爱的兰达不高兴，我就焦虑得无法正常思考了！” 巴尼暗自窃笑，脸颊顿时红了起来。“嗯，一个男人除了寻求专业人士的帮助还能做什么呢？没错，他确实必须采取一些措施来缓解自己心中的忧虑，而还有什么地方比投进马拉克心爱女子的怀抱更合适呢？咱们仨私下说，[pc.name]，我一直认为这是命运的安排——我竟会在那个出身高贵、比任何同龄人都更迷人、更聪慧的女孩首次登台的同一天，寻到了那位激情王子的神庙。有许多、许多追求者都急于成为她的第一位客人，但在那群富有且声名显赫的男子之中……纳迪拉却从人群里挑中了我。我们立刻产生了共鸣——仅仅几句交谈和几个眼神，就仿佛我与她相识了一辈子。我会永远感激她教给我的一切，不仅仅是那一夜，而是此后每一天只要我能设法去见她。” 凯特微笑着，尾巴欢快地摇动着。“在我们成长的过程中，每当父亲没有接到苏丹娜的任务时，他总会去神庙里。看到他在那里，和妈妈一起度过时光，总是能让我的一天充满欢乐。马拉克最喜欢看到我们彼此相爱了！” “啊，没错，我确实是这么做的……而且请千万不要以为，你们这些姑娘和你们的母亲没有为我做同样的事情。”
rows.raw: " Glancing from Cait to Barney, you ask the elder cat if he wouldn't mind telling you about Cait's other parent. Barney smiles at just the thought of her. "Mmm, Nadira, the most radiant of Mallach's beloved, whose beauty, wit, and charm knew no equal — until our daughters were grown, haha! Ah, Caitriss [cait.thicknessRange 70 90|is the gods' own simulacra of her, I'd say. Truly, the resemblance is more striking now than it's ever been|has filled out even more than her mother, but still, the resemblance is striking indeed!|[cait.cupRange G|is perhaps more, ehem, buxom than her mother but beyond that the resemblance is truly striking!|[cait.isLeothran|was, before she became quite so fluffy at least, was the god's own simulacra of her mother.|is nearly the gods' own simulacra of her mother — or will be, when she's a bit older and aha, more filled out.]]] Really, as the Belharans would say, the apple did not fall far from the tree!" "Calla's even more like her," Cait adds. "At least on the outside. Though she always tried to be as opposite to us as she could on the inside..." Her father places a hand gently on Cait's shoulder. "Calladona is a very independent soul. Where you and your mother found peace and stability in the Temple, she saw a gilded cage. If only she'd realized it was also safety..." Barney sighs, adjusting his cap. "But... let us not dwell on such things, hmm? We can at least take heart in knowing that your mother is safe and well back at the Great Temple, and will welcome both her beautiful girls back with open arms someday soon. Ah, the stories you will both have to tell her..." You clear your throat gently, before the cats can get too lost in homesickness. Barney still hasn't told you what Nadira's really like. "Ah, hmm, yes of course, my apologies [pc.name]. It is just difficult to put a whole person, especially one I have known most of my life, into a few sentences — and every turn of phrase that comes to mind sounds like worshipful verse for a goddess!" "Try something like, 'She's very kind and pretty, a good dancer and a better poet, and a great mom.' See, easy!" Laughing, Barney ruffles Cait's hair and says, "Yes, yes, quite right! Yes, that's my Nadira. Beautiful inside and out, with a brilliant mind for the arts, and a heart overflowing with care and love for everyone who has the pleasure of her acquaintance. And knowing her is, indubitably, one of life's greatest pleasures." So: he's a magister of Jassira and she's a temple harlot — how did that work out? "Ah, yes, well... a fair a question as any, I suppose. I suppose it all started, oh, nearly thirty years ago now. My family had long since betrothed me to Randa, my wife, and the day of our marriage was fast approaching. I was desperately nervous, as most young men are, but doubly so because I was a bookish fellow, prone to long nights of study and days spent reading, rather than, ah, consorting with the opposite sex. I had known my lady Randa for some time by then, of course, and really was quite enamored with her — I should say I'm luckier than most, privileged as I am to marry a woman I'd consider among my dearest friends even if we were not romantically involved. But, indeed, that very fondness is what drove me to the Mallachite temple — the idea of, shall we say, displeasing my dear Randa on our wedding night had me so knotted up I couldn't see straight!" Barney chuckles at himself, cheeks rosy. "Well, what's a man to do but seek out the help of professionals? Yes, indeed, he must do something to ease his mind about such things, and where better than in the arms of one of Mallach's beloved? Between the three of us, [pc.name], I have always thought it was fate — that I would find my way to the Prince of Passion's temple on the same day that a noble-blooded girl, far more charming and witty than any of her peers, was making her debut. There were many, many suitors eager to claim her first, but somehow amidst that throng of wealthy and prestigious men... Nadira picked me out of the crowd. We connected immediately — a few words and looks exchanged, and it was as if I'd known her my whole life, yes. I'll be forever grateful for what she taught me, not just that night but every day that I could find my way to her ever after." Cait smiles, tail swishing. "All while we were growing up, dad was always dropping in at the temple whenever he wasn't on assignment from the Sultana. Seeing him around, spending time with mom, always brightened my day. Mallach loves when we love!" "Ah, yes, well, I do try... and don't ever believe for a second that you girls and your mother don't do just the same for me.""

rows.translation: 凯特的妈妈？

rows.original: So, you have to ask, what does Randa think about him and Nadira? "Hmm, well, that's a bit more... complicated. Such affairs are nothing remarkable in Jassira, or much of the world I suspect, and for the first years of our marriage I never got the sense that Randa minded. That the two of us were close at all was more than I can say for many marriages arranged for the needs of noble houses before those of the heart, and it's a very lucky few indeed that could call their spouse more than just a partner, as I do with Randa. 'Tis quite a blessing to call my wife a dear and lasting friend. Indeed, as my romance with Nadira deepened, I gave them ample opportunity to get acquainted, too, oh yes... but, uh, well, you see a nobleman is expected to produce heirs for his house. Randa's family of course was very insistent on hurrying that along, as her brother had died heirless some years ago... but..." Barney's shoulders slump, and for once that graying tail of his falls utterly still. Already, Cait's taking his hand, squeezing it in both of hers as he speaks. "Our attempts at having children together ended in three heart-wrenching tragedies over as many years. After that, when I realized Randa's heart couldn't take being broken a fourth time — to say nothing of my own — I politely but firmly told her parents to fuck off and leave us alone. They got the message eventually, and I was able to give my beloved wife much-needed time to heal. And yet..." He shrugs helplessly. "A nobleman is expected to produce heirs for his house, you understand. It's the same all over the world, from inner Macah to here in the Frost Marches, and so it is in Jassira too. As I said, I have always felt it was fate that I would build such a strong bond with a blue-blooded Mallachite... as if this was the gods' will, that she and I should be in such a position to have our beautiful daughters. I thank all the gods for my girls each day, [pc.name]. They are the light and the joy in my life, but my poor Randa... ah, even though she and I had a long and earnest talk before I approached Nadira with my request, and she gave me her blessing, still... she has never been quite as warm towards Nadira, nor to the girls, as perhaps she might once have." "She's a good woman, though," Cait hurries to add, still holding her father's hand. "It's just... every time I meet her, she looks at me so sadly. I really do wish I had the opportunity to know her better." "Perhaps you will, sunflower. I hope you will."
rows.translation: 那么，你不得不问一句：兰达对他和纳迪拉之间的关系有什么看法？ “嗯，这件事就有些……复杂了。我想，在贾西拉乃至世界许多地方，这类关系都算不上稀奇；而且在婚后的最初几年里，我从未觉得兰达介意。我和她能够如此亲近，就已经胜过许多为了贵族家族利益而非真心缔结的婚姻；真正能像我和兰达这样，将配偶视为生活伴侣之外更重要存在的人，实在少之又少。能够称自己的妻子为亲密长久的挚友，着实是一份祝福。的确，随着我和纳迪拉的感情日益深厚，我也给了她们许多彼此熟悉的机会，确实如此……可是，呃，你明白，贵族男子必须为家族留下继承人。兰达的兄长在几年前去世，没有留下子嗣，她的家人自然极力催促我们赶快生育……可是……” 巴尼垂下双肩；那条日渐灰白的尾巴也破天荒地彻底静止下来。凯特已经握住他的手，用自己的双手紧紧包住它，而他继续说道：“我们曾三度尝试生育孩子，却在三年间经历了三场撕心裂肺的悲剧。后来，我意识到兰达的心再也经不起第四次破碎——更别提我自己的心了——于是礼貌而坚决地叫她父母滚开，别再烦我们。他们最终明白了我的意思，我也终于能给深爱的妻子亟需的时间去疗愈。然而……” 他无奈地耸耸肩。“你也明白，贵族男子必须为家族留下继承人。全世界都一样，从玛卡恩内地到这里的霜冻边疆，贾西拉自然也不例外。正如我说过的，我始终觉得，自己会与一位出身高贵的玛拉赫信徒结下如此深厚的羁绊，乃是命中注定……仿佛诸神有意让她和我处在这样的境地，从而拥有我们美丽的女儿们。[pc.name]，我每天都为女儿们感谢所有神明。她们是我生命中的光芒与喜悦，可我可怜的兰达……唉，尽管我向纳迪拉提出请求前，曾与兰达进行过漫长而坦诚的交谈，而且她也祝福了我，但她对纳迪拉和女儿们……终究从未像曾经可能做到的那样热情。” “不过，她是个好女人，”凯特仍握着父亲的手，急忙补充。“只是……每次见到她，她都会用那么悲伤的眼神看着我。我真的希望自己有机会更了解她。” “也许会有的，我的小向日葵。我希望你会有。”

rows.translation: 兰达
观察者
凯特与巴纳福斯

rows.original:
"Hey daaaaaaad," Cait says, pushing past you and flashing her father a winning smile. "I've got a favor to ask of my favoritest daddy in the whole wide world..."
    
    The next handful of minutes are spent with Cait explaining her plans for a temple to Mallach here in the Marches, as well as her obtaining permission to go ahead with the construction and the need to secure the site. Her father listens quietly, taking deep drags from his pipe as he digests his daughter's tale.
    
    "...And that's why we need you to come up with us, Dad. If anybody short of the Winter City is going to be able to figure out what's up with this old place, it's you. Besides, it'll give us a chance to rub our brains together on that portal thing. Maybe... do you think we'll be able to find where Calla got taken? Or if she's — " Cait swallows hard — "if she's coming back?"
    
    Barney gives you a look, and you shrug; the old cat-man turns back to his daughter and taps out his pipe. "I don't know, sunflower, but we owe it to your sister to try. Even if there's nothing we can do, we ought to make sure she has a warm welcome waiting for her on her return, hmm? Yes, we must! And besides... if we're going to be making ourselves at home in Hawkethorne for the rest of the year, we might as well bring a bit of Jassiran hospitality to the barbarians, oh yes. I'm sure your temple will draw quite the crowd."
    
    Cait blushes, tail curling around a leg. Something unspoken passes between the two, some second meaning in the words, before Barney secures his pipe and plants both hands on his daughter's shoulders. "Ah, after all, I was planning to go up there anyway before long and see the portal for myself, but it's good that the both of you will be at my side while I'm doing it. From what the locals say, things have been getting more dangerous in these parts lately, no thanks to the demoness that, if you will, traded places with my daughter."
    
    "Dad! You actually thought of going up there alone?"
    
    "I considered it."
    
    Cait scowls, fixing her father with a death-glare. "I... I can't... don't you dare start going out on your own adventures again! I know, I know, you wouldn't be my dad otherwise... but seriously! Consider my foot put down. I don't know what I'd do if you went missing as well, especially after everything that's already happened. I mean, If [pc.name] and I hadn't turned up at the caravanserai when we had..."
    
    Smiling, Barney reaches over and gives his daughter a small hug; Cait sniffles and sinks into her father's arms with a sigh.
    
    "Dad... this was supposed to be a great big adventure. Just the three of us, going to see the whole wide world. But with Calla gone, everything's just so... so much scarier. I can't treat it like a sightseeing tour — and neither can you! We can't... we can't lose each other, too. I won't..."
    
    Barney sighs, smiles, then gives you an apologetic look while patting his daughter on the back. "Now, now, dear, [pc.name] is watching. Besides, we have work to do. There's no sense in crying... I was just meaning to say that I'd be happy to help, is all. Yes, just that. I'll need a little bit to gather up the reagents I need from the local witch and put together my instruments, but we should be ready to go shortly. Dry your eyes, sunflower! It'll be one step closer to seeing your sister again."
    
    Cait sniffles, wiping away her tears, and nods.
    
    "Come talk to me again when you're ready, and I'll head up the mountainside with you."
rows.translation:
嘿，爸爸……”凯特一边说，一边从你身边挤过去，向她的父亲露出一个迷人的微笑，“我有件事想请我最亲爱的爸爸帮忙……”
    
    接下来的几分钟里，凯特详细地向父亲解释了她计划在边境地区为玛拉赫建造一座寺庙的打算，以及她为推进这项工程所需要做的各种准备，包括获得施工许可和确保建设场地的安全等等。她的父亲静静地听着，一边抽着烟斗，一边仔细思考着女儿讲述的事情。
    
    ……这就是为什么我们需要你帮忙，爸爸。如果说除了冬城的人之外，还有谁能够弄清楚这个古老地方到底发生了什么，那肯定就是你。另外，这也让我们有机会一起研究那个传送门的问题。也许……我们能够找到卡拉被带去的地方吧？或者，她会不会……”凯特艰难地咽了口唾沫，“她会回来吗？
    
    巴尼看了你一眼，你只是耸了耸肩；那个老猫人又转过头去，继续用烟斗敲击着烟嘴。“我不知道，向日葵，但为了你妹妹，我们至少应该试一试。即使我们什么也做不了，至少也应该确保她回来时能受到热情的欢迎，嗯？是的，我们必须这么做！而且……既然我们今年剩下的时间都要在鹰棘镇生活了，那么我们不妨把贾西兰的热情好客带给那些野蛮人，没错。我相信你们的神庙一定会吸引很多人前来。"
    
    凯特的脸颊泛起了红晕，尾巴紧紧地卷在她的腿上。两人之间似乎有某种未说出口的情绪在流淌，那些话语中蕴含着某种隐含的含义。随后，巴尼拿起了他的烟斗，将双手放在女儿的肩上：“啊，其实我本来也打算不久之后去那里亲自看看那个传送门，不过有你们俩在我身边，那就更好了。据当地人所说，最近这些地区的局势变得越来越危险了，而这都要归咎于那个可以这么说的女恶魔——她竟然和我的女儿交换了位置。
    
    爸爸！你真的打算一个人去那里吗？”
    
    “我确实考虑过这个办法。”
    
    凯特皱起了眉头，用一种充满威胁的眼神盯着她的父亲。“我……我绝对不允许你再独自去冒险了！我知道，如果你不是我的父亲，也许你会这么做……但说真的，我可不会允许的。如果你也失踪了，我真不知道该怎么办，尤其是在发生了这么多事情之后。我的意思是[pc.name]我们本来应该一起出现在那家旅舍里的……”
    
    巴尼微笑着伸出手，轻轻拥抱了自己的女儿；凯特抽泣着，叹了口气，靠在了父亲的怀里。
    
    “爸爸……这本该是一场充满刺激的冒险啊。就我们三个人，一起去看看这个广阔的世界。但是现在卡拉不在了，一切都变得……变得太可怕了。我不能再把这次旅行当作一次观光之旅来对待了——你们也一样！我们绝对不能……不能再失去彼此了。我不会的……”
    
    巴尼叹了口气，笑了笑，然后一边轻拍女儿的背，一边用歉意的眼神看着你：“好了，好了，亲爱的。[pc.name]他正在看着呢。而且，我们还有工作要做。哭也没什么用……我只是想说，我很乐意帮忙而已。是的，就是这个意思。我需要一些时间，去向当地的女巫那里取所需的炼金材料，然后准备好我的仪器，不过我们应该很快就能出发了。擦干你的眼泪，向日葵！这样你就能离再次见到你的姐姐更近一步了。”
    
    凯特抽泣着，擦去泪水，然后点了点头。
    
    “等你准备好了，再来找我谈谈，我会和你一起前往山丘那边。"
rows.raw:
"
    "Hey daaaaaaad," Cait says, pushing past you and flashing her father a winning smile. "I've got a favor to ask of my favoritest daddy in the whole wide world..."
    
    The next handful of minutes are spent with Cait explaining her plans for a temple to Mallach here in the Marches, as well as her obtaining permission to go ahead with the construction and the need to secure the site. Her father listens quietly, taking deep drags from his pipe as he digests his daughter's tale.
    
    "...And that's why we need you to come up with us, Dad. If anybody short of the Winter City is going to be able to figure out what's up with this old place, it's you. Besides, it'll give us a chance to rub our brains together on that portal thing. Maybe... do you think we'll be able to find where Calla got taken? Or if she's — " Cait swallows hard — "if she's coming back?"
    
    Barney gives you a look, and you shrug; the old cat-man turns back to his daughter and taps out his pipe. "I don't know, sunflower, but we owe it to your sister to try. Even if there's nothing we can do, we ought to make sure she has a warm welcome waiting for her on her return, hmm? Yes, we must! And besides... if we're going to be making ourselves at home in Hawkethorne for the rest of the year, we might as well bring a bit of Jassiran hospitality to the barbarians, oh yes. I'm sure your temple will draw quite the crowd."
    
    Cait blushes, tail curling around a leg. Something unspoken passes between the two, some second meaning in the words, before Barney secures his pipe and plants both hands on his daughter's shoulders. "Ah, after all, I was planning to go up there anyway before long and see the portal for myself, but it's good that the both of you will be at my side while I'm doing it. From what the locals say, things have been getting more dangerous in these parts lately, no thanks to the demoness that, if you will, traded places with my daughter."
    
    "Dad! You actually thought of going up there alone?"
    
    "I considered it."
    
    Cait scowls, fixing her father with a death-glare. "I... I can't... don't you dare start going out on your own adventures again! I know, I know, you wouldn't be my dad otherwise... but seriously! Consider my foot put down. I don't know what I'd do if you went missing as well, especially after everything that's already happened. I mean, If [pc.name] and I hadn't turned up at the caravanserai when we had..."
    
    Smiling, Barney reaches over and gives his daughter a small hug; Cait sniffles and sinks into her father's arms with a sigh.
    
    "Dad... this was supposed to be a great big adventure. Just the three of us, going to see the whole wide world. But with Calla gone, everything's just so... so much scarier. I can't treat it like a sightseeing tour — and neither can you! We can't... we can't lose each other, too. I won't..."
    
    Barney sighs, smiles, then gives you an apologetic look while patting his daughter on the back. "Now, now, dear, [pc.name] is watching. Besides, we have work to do. There's no sense in crying... I was just meaning to say that I'd be happy to help, is all. Yes, just that. I'll need a little bit to gather up the reagents I need from the local witch and put together my instruments, but we should be ready to go shortly. Dry your eyes, sunflower! It'll be one step closer to seeing your sister again."
    
    Cait sniffles, wiping away her tears, and nods.
    
    "Come talk to me again when you're ready, and I'll head up the mountainside with you."
    
    "

rows.original: "Ah, you're ready, hmm?" Barney hefts a large leather-wrapped bundle by his side with a huff of effort. "I've got all I need here." Cait hurries to help him with the load, hooking her staff under the knot so they can use it like a pole. Barney chuckles, taking the back end behind her. "Do you not want to fetch little Salwah first, sunflower? She is the one out of all of us actually invested in the temple, hmm?" Cait considers her dad's words a moment, then shakes her head. "I... I want to keep her out of this for now. It's too dangerous. I'm a little surprised she managed to make it here from Jassira all alone..." "Ah, a girl after my own heart. If I were thirty years younger..." "Dad!" Barney chuckles and takes his daughter by the shoulder. "Come on, let's get going. If you would please lead the way, [pc.name]?" The trek up the mountainside is quick — Barney is surprisingly spry for an old man with a heavy burden, but then again, he's spent most of his life traveling the world. He gently declines all offers to shoulder the bundle for him, stating the need to keep a close eye on his delicate devices, and easily keeps pace with [party.compNames] as you all head up to the old temple, Castle Hawkstone looming in the distance. "Well, we're here!" Cait declares as the [party.manyCompanions |four |three ] of you arrive at the heart of the ruined temple. "Not the prettiest of sights, isn't it, Dad?" You look around and shake your head. [dayNight |Even though the sunlight helps drive away the worst of the darkness |Even though the passage of time has calmed things somewhat and dried out the worst of the stains ], the memories of your brush with the cultists on the night of the blizzard cause the shadows to seem a little darker, the abandoned altar more menacing. You step away from Cait and Barney, wandering over to the crumbled pillars and foundations to examine them in closer detail. Every now and then, you throw a suspicious glance at the spot in the air where the portal to... wherever it was Calla was taken to once stood, but no magical rends in time and space appear to be imminent. On his part, Barney unwraps the large leather bundle to reveal a plethora of metallic and wooden devices of arcane nature — [pc.isMage |with your magical training, you're able to guess at some of their purposes, but the details of their function still elude you. They look vaguely Jassiran, aesthetically speaking, which means he probably brought them all the way from his homeland; for a moment, you're tempted to offer to help the old cat-man in setting up his apparatus, but think better of it |you have no idea what any of them are for, but they look vaguely Jassiran when it comes to their aesthetics, which means he probably brought them all the way from his homeland ]. He whistles a jolly little tune to himself as he sets up his apparatus, completely oblivious to the old temple's forbidding nature, and you can only shake your head at it all. [party.has ryn |While the both of you have been looking around, Ryn's been sitting on a block of fallen marble, one of many that lie on the foot of a crumbled wall; being reminded of the mortality of one's people can't be easy on her. Well, you'll give her the space she needs for now. If there's some way in which Ryn can be useful, you're sure she'll snap to it[pc.isDK | — or you'll make her ]. "Hmm," Cait muses, running her fingers along the pillar she's examining, defaced with markings that may or may not be lewd depending on how one looks at them. "Hm, hm." Hmm? "I'm not sure. It looks innocuous enough... but do you feel that, [pc.name]? That... that thing?" That sense of... incipient lustfulness, faint but present, a subtle but insistent pressure on your consciousness. That wasn't there the last time you were here. "You feel it too, huh? It can't really have been what those cultists were doing, otherwise we'd have sensed it back then. This is something completely different." She looks around, then back at her father. "Dad doesn't look like he's feeling it, either. Wonder why." "I feel it too," Ryn pipes up from where she's been sitting morosely. "It's been hammering at the back of my head ever since we arrived. I... I'd have been looking with you, but I thought if I sat down for a bit, it'd pass. It hasn't." Cait and you share a glance, and then the two of you come rushing up to Ryn's side. "You too, Ryn?" Ryn winces. "It's not too far... not too far from how things can get when I really, really need help... but in a different way. I'm feeling it, all right, but my body isn't responding, either..." Has she any idea of what might be going on? "I have my suspicions." She looks up at the two of you. "Could you please help me up?" Taking Ryn by under her shoulders, Cait and you heft the elven royal off her seat and to her feet. She directs you to take her to the altar where Calla once lay, and gestures at its base, wincing. "This altar isn't of our make, the cultists must have placed it there themselves. Try moving it aside, please?" The slab of marble is deceptively light for its size, and while Cait and you have to work together to get it to budge, it's not the impossible task one might expect from a solid slab of stone. Ryn helps as much as she's able to, and together the three of you shove it to one side. "That thing's got to go when I refurbish the place," Cait says with a scowl, wiping her brow. The thin granite tiles beneath are cracked by the altar's weight, and Ryn gets on her knees and prises them out from the floor with a knife. Her expression darkens as part of a solidly cut hardwood beam is exposed — one as thick as the central supports of the Frost Hound. You nod for her to go on. "Fallen branches from wyld trees would be gathered, shaped, and worked into the construction of temples. The power gathered would be used to fuel both the temple and the needs of the people who lived around it." "I'm starting to see where this is going," Cait begins. "All this power sloshing about, it drew those creeps to this place and they used it for their sick rituals. Now that there's no one around, it's just been building up since. What happens when there's too much?" Ryn shrugs helplessly. "I don't know. The schism happened two and a half centuries ago — I'm the last person who would know the details of druidic powers and magic. We... we could tear out all the beams, burn them or something. That would stop the flow of energy, I think." She would destroy such an important part of her people's heritage? "It's already in ruins, [pc.name]." "But that wouldn't solve the problem of safely releasing what's already there, Ryn. "And that's why you're [etheryn.crowned |a good queen! So considerate of other peoples' faiths. |going to be a good queen someday, Ryn. Cait hurries to help him with the load, hooking her staff under the knot so they can use it like a pole. Barney chuckles, taking the back end behind her. "Do you not want to fetch little Salwah first, sunflower? She is the one out of all of us actually invested in the temple, hmm?" Cait considers her dad's words a moment, then shakes her head. "I... I want to keep her out of this for now. It's too dangerous. I'm a little surprised she managed to make it here from Jassira all alone..." "Ah, a girl after my own heart. If I were thirty years younger..." "Dad!" Barney chuckles and takes his daughter by the shoulder. "Come on, let's get going. If you would please lead the way, [pc.name]?" The trek up the mountainside is quick — Barney is surprisingly spry for an old man with a heavy burden, but then again, he's spent most of his life traveling the world. He gently declines all offers to shoulder the bundle for him, stating the need to keep a close eye on his delicate devices, and easily keeps pace with [party.compNames] as you all head up to the old temple, Castle Hawkstone looming in the distance. "Well, we're here!" Cait declares as the [party.manyCompanions |four |three ] of you arrive at the heart of the ruined temple. "Not the prettiest of sights, isn't it, Dad?" You look around and shake your head. [dayNight |Even though the sunlight helps drive away the worst of the darkness |Even though the passage of time has calmed things somewhat and dried out the worst of the stains ], the memories of your brush with the cultists on the night of the blizzard cause the shadows to seem a little darker, the abandoned altar more menacing. You step away from Cait and Barney, wandering over to the crumbled pillars and foundations to examine them in closer detail. Every now and then, you throw a suspicious glance at the spot in the air where the portal to... wherever it was Calla was taken to once stood, but no magical rends in time and space appear to be imminent. Further removal of the loose tiles uncovers much of the same — solid hardwood beams as part of the foundations. He reaches out for the smooth, finished wood, then thinks better of it and draws his hand back. "Oh boy. This stuff is strong. That wasn't around when we were present... like it's been building up for a while." |"I don't get it," Cait says as she raps the altar with the base of her staff and cocks a ear at the sound. "As far as I can tell, the altar's nothing more than a chunk of stone — oh! Of course! How could I have been so silly — [pc.name], could you please help me out here?" Without waiting for a reply, Cait sets her shoulder against the altar and leans her weight against the stone, to little avail. Sighing, you take up position beside her, [party.manyCompanions |and even [comp2.name] comes over to add [comp2.hisHer] strength to the task |pitching in with all your might ]. Together, you're able to push aside the altar under your combined efforts, stone grinding against stone with a horrible gravelly noise until you've moved the altar aside. Where it stood are a couple of loose, cracked marble tiles, faintly depressed from the weight that had until recently stood upon it. "Thought so!" Cait explains triumphantly, getting on her knees and prising up the thin tiles with her fingers. "The style of the altar didn't quite match up with the rest of the temple, and it definitely wasn't as weathered. That creep probably had it carted in from elsewhere and placed here for a reason. Let's see what he was hiding here." By and large, though, Cait's expression turns from jubilant from puzzled when she reveals a part of a smooth wooden beam, thick, heavy and part of the temple's foundation. Your pink kitten frowns and taps her chin, thinking. "That's not right. It was strongest here... but all there's to be had in this cubbyhole is nothing. Any ideas, [pc.name]?" You're as lost as she is. "Hmm." Cait reaches out to touch the simple wooden beam, and you get a twinge of danger in the back of your mind — you reach out to stop her, slap her hand away, but it's too late. The moment her hand comes into contact with the wood, Cait's cheeks flush and she pulls back as if burned by a hot stove. Still, she's not unscathed — your pink kitten pants and gasps, squirming on the ground with her ears flattened against her head and rubbing her thighs together until she's able to get a grip on herself. You grab her by under the shoulder and pull her away from the exposed foundation, and she heaves a few deep breaths, blinking blearily as the sudden rush of sensation fades. Is she feeling all right? "It'll pass," she gasps, chest heaving as she reaches up and vigorously rubs her burning cheeks. "It could have been worse; I got careless there." ] The wood, the foundation. This feeling wasn't there on the night of the blizzard. [party.has quintillus |"It makes sense now. After we set up here, Tollus began using more and more power in his rituals; and that was when the yearly sacrifices began." Quin looks pensive a moment. "Without anywhere to go or burn it off, this stuff has just been building up here ever since you chased off the cult. I always figured he was getting the power from the sacrifices, but I guess I was wrong." |"I guess it makes sense," Cait says. "After we chased off those creeps, there's been no one to use all this power, so it's built up to the point where we can feel it like this." ] And what happens when there's too much of it in one place? Cait shrugs, smiling ruefully. "I don't know, but I'd rather not find out. It's a good thing we came back here to check on things and clean up the mess those creeps left behind, right? Come on, [pc.name], let's go see what Dad makes of this." ] Your conversation's interrupted by Barney calling you and Cait over — the old tomcat's finished assembling his implements, and now the arcane devices are emitting clicking noises as he works away at a crank on the side. The old wizard is huffing and puffing, working up a sweat as sparks of arcane energy crackle on the side of the metal, but there's a smile of satisfaction on his mustached lips as the devices whir to life. "There you are, kids. Find anything?" Cait briefly gives him a run-down of the power conduit you found, and he nods. "Oh yes, dangerous stuff welling up here. Yes, yes indeed. Give it another month or so, and what capacitance this temple might have had would spill over. Might well take half the mountainside with it, destabilise the castle's foundations." Really? That sounds... well, a bit of a stretch. "Oh indeed, [pc.name]. I'm not saying it was a good thing, but each and every group of squatting crazies who would come here and leech off some of the magic for their own ends likely helped prevent this place from going up in a cloud of magically-charged smoke. Enough power to open a portal to another world just sitting around... once you build your temple, sunflower, I'm going to have more than enough reason to stick around, oh yes." "Dad!" Now to the more important question, though. Can he do something about this magical buildup or whatever it is? Barney looks contemplative, scratching his beardy chin. "Oh, I believe I can, but I'll need to take some more readings, assess the aetheric situation further. It's quite possible that the energies will lash back in some fashion if we try to stabilise them, so both you and I will need to account for that. Caitriss, I do think I'll need the assistance of that junior of yours after all. If you feel you're ready for a fight, I can try to stabilise the area now." Cait quirks up an eyebrow. "A fight?" "Like I said, sunflower, given the readings I'm getting — " he taps the plethora of arcane devices at hand — "it's likely to happen. You'll need to protect me while I work. It shouldn't take too long, but I don't know exactly how much time I'll need to complete the stabilisation ritual, even with Sally's help." Cait stares at her father, then heaves a sigh and turns to you with a rueful smile. "Well, you heard my dad. Are you ready for this now, or would you head back down to Hawkethorne and prepare first?" rows.original:
You shake your head. No, you're not ready for this just yet.
        
        Barney nods. "Well, since we came all the way up here, let me take some more readings, investigate the place further. I won't be long — maybe another hour or two. The better we understand the problem we're dealing with, the better chance we have at tackling it."
        
        The old cat-man is good to his word; all traces of joviality vanish from his countenance as he focuses his attention on his artifice, casting small spells, adjusting knobs and applying himself to the hand-cranked device. He has Cait and you bring him some small samples of debris from the old temple, mostly from the exact spot where the portal was summoned, and hems and haws, turning them about in his hands before feeding them into his arcane devices.
        
        "Well, Dad?" Cait asks after an hour of this. "Learn anything?"
        
        Barney strokes his chin, eyes trained on his whirring apparatus. "Nothing I didn't already know. I wouldn't say what we're up against is insurmountable... but it won't be easy, either. Then again, your mother is so fond of saying that nothing worth doing was ever easy, isn't she?"
        
        Cait forces a small laugh. "Yeah, she'd say that about now."
        
        "I wouldn't say that this has been a waste. We'll head back down to the village, I'll rest my legs, and we can pick up your junior before we head on up again." Barney gives you a nod as he begins to dismantle his arcane devices and lights his spice pipe up with a snap of his fingers. "Thanks for your help today, [pc.name]. It wouldn't have gone as easily as it had without you around."
        
        No problem, you've been helping out Cait since the night of the blizzard, and the same goes for her family. So, you should see him again when you're ready to take this on?
        
        A nod. "Come find me anytime you're ready. For now, shall we head back? I've got some thinking to do."
rows.translation:
你摇了摇头。不，你现在还没有准备好面对这个挑战。
        
        巴尼点了点头：“好吧，既然我们都已经来到这里了，那就让我再做些测量，进一步调查这个地方吧。我应该不会花太长时间——大概再需要一两个小时吧。我们对所面临的问题了解得越透彻，解决它的机会就会越大。
        
        那位老猫人非常守信用；当他全神贯注地摆弄着他的装置，施展小法术、调节旋钮时，他脸上所有的欢快神情都消失了。你带着凯特从那座古老寺庙里捡来一些碎片样本——这些碎片大多来自传送门被召唤出来的确切位置——他把这些碎片在手中仔细翻来覆去，然后将其放入他的神秘装置中。
        
        嗯，爸爸？”经过一个小时的尝试，凯特问道，“有学到什么吗？”
        
        巴尼摸了摸下巴，目光紧紧盯着那台正在运转的设备。“并没有学到什么我之前不知道的东西。我不能说我们面临的困难是无法克服的……但这也绝不会是一帆风顺的。不过，你妈妈总是说，任何值得去做的事情从来都不会轻松，对吧？
        
        凯特勉强挤出了一个笑。“是啊，她现在肯定也会这么说。”
        
        “我可不认为今天的努力是白费的。我们回到村子，让我好好休息一下，然后再去接你的弟弟，再继续上路吧。”巴尼点了点头，开始拆卸他的那些神秘装置，同时打了个响指，点燃了他的香料烟斗。“今天真的多亏了你的帮助。[pc.name]如果没有你在场，事情就不会这么顺利了。”
        
        “没问题，从暴风雪那晚开始，你就一直在帮助凯特，她的家人也一样。所以，当你准备好继续帮忙的时候，应该再去见他吧？”
        
        他点了点头：“只要你准备好了，随时都可以来找我。现在，我们还是回去吧？我还有些事情需要思考。

rows.original: [flags.BARNEY_PORTAL |"You're ready to give it another go?" Cait nods. "We are, Dad. Someone's got to do something about it, and even though we failed the last time, we're still the best qualified in all of Hawkethorne to make the place safe." She's right. You're more prepared this time. Barney takes a deep drag on his pipe and nods. "I see. At least now that we know those elemental spirits are leashed to their source, we can always retreat if things go badly." "That's quitter talk, Dad! We'll get them this time!" Cait smiles and smacks her father on the back with her tail. "[pc.name], would you please help dad get his things together while I pick up Sally? I'll meet you in front of the Frost Hound." Within the hour, you're back up at the old temple ruins once more, Castle Hawkstone staring down on the [party.manyCompanions |five |four ] of you like a grim, dark sentinel. Barney goes through the motions of setting up his arcane devices again while the girls create the ritual circle, and you feel the hair on the back of your neck rise once more as they start dancing and the air becomes redolent with power. "They're coming again!" This time, you're expecting it. As power gathers and congeals into more of those amorphous, spectral masses of crackling magical energy, [comp2.name] and you step forward to hold the line even as Cait and Salwah retreat, the former to your side, the latter behind Barney. The old wizard huffs and puffs as he spins the crank in a blur, sweat beading on his forehead as the chaotic elementals press the attack. It's a fight! You will have to survive 10 rounds in order to buy enough time for Cait's dad to finish dissipating the portal energies. |[var0 |"You're ready to go up again and get this mess settled? Let me get my things, and I'll be with you." "I'll go call Sally, Dad. She shouldn't be far away." The catfolk are quick about it — fifteen minutes later, the four of you are heading back up the mountainside to the ruined temple, where you quickly lay out the components of the ritual. While you help Barney set up his arcane instruments about where the altar recently stood, |No, there's no time like the present. You're as prepared as you'll ever be, and dragging this out any longer might only make things worse, if this magical buildup from the portal's remnants is as dangerous as Barney makes it out to be. If not now, then when? If not you, then who? Barney sees the resolve in your gaze and grins. "Let's get started, then. Cait, would you please go down and fetch Salwah? [pc.Name], could you please help me move some of this over there?" You've just finished getting Barney's devices into position when Cait returns up the mountainside with Salwah in tow, her junior [dayNight |barely breaking a sweat despite the trek up to the ruined temple |still yawning and a little drowsy at being woken up in the middle of the night ]. She follows obediently behind Cait, and perks up when she sees Barney and you working away by where the altar used to stand. "Hi, Mr. Zethra! Hi, [pc.name]!" The dark-skinned catgirl looks between the three of you. "So, we're doing this, then?" "Of course. [pc.names] been so kind as to help me with getting my setup in order; now it's time for you girls to do your part. Cait knows what I'm up to, just follow her lead, all right?" "Okay!" With that, ] Cait and Salwah busy themselves with drawing in a simple chalk circle atop the wooden conduit you discovered. Your pink kitten's stood up her staff in the middle like some kind of outsized divining rod, and Salwah's scratched in several symbols around the edges at Barney's direction. [pc.isMage |The setup is quite basic, but from your knowledge of such things you're fairly sure it should be functional and sufficient for the kittens' needs. If whatever they're looking for is strong enough to render such precautions useless, then nothing they could do would be effective, anyway |The entire affair looks suspiciously basic and flimsy, but then again you're not educated in such matters, are you? As things are, you'll just have to trust that your temple kittens know what they're doing and be ready to leap into action should something go horribly wrong ]. On his part, Barney's unrolled a local map of the area he's borrowed from Garth, made when the Hawkethorne's settlers were surveying the land about their newly founded village. It's actually quite extensive, covering much of the southern valley and the woods all the way to the River Ridell, but you can't help but wonder how accurate they've got to be after the last decade or two since they were last updated to match the terrain. As the two kittens finish constructing the circle, Barney sits on the steps by the edge of the temple, poring over the maps and thinking to himself. "I would've preferred to be able to triangulate the exact position of every source this conduit is drawing power from," he murmurs. "If my hunch is correct, this conduit could be drawing power from ley lines stretching half way across the March. It would be easier to cut the sources themselves, but then again, that might damage the portal irreparably — then how would my girl get home, hmm? No, we'll just have to drain the well so to speak. Yes, yes we will..." Barney looks to be absorbed in his thoughts after that, so you step over to the circle and give Cait and Salwah a nod. How's it going? Cait perks up. "Pretty decently, [pc.name]! Shouldn't be too long now before the circle's ready — sure, it's not exactly temple magic, but Dad did teach me a few things while I was traveling with Calla, so I could help him out!" [pc.isMage |You have some knowledge of magic. Could you possibly help? Salwah looks over her shoulder at you, dusting off her hands. "Well, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and I are going to be tracing the energy to its source. If you could reinforce the circle while we're about it, that would be appreciated." Yeah, you can see. It's crude, if functional; you can definitely shore it up a bit. Anything else you can do, though? "Not unless you were raised as a Jassiran Mallachite." You smile. All right, you can take a hint. |Should you be prepared for anything? You have memories of things that can happen when conducting rituals at this site, after all. Cait gives you a thin smile. "I don't think I'll be opening any portals today... but I'd feel safer if you were around to leap into action should anything happen, [pc.name]. Even with Dad around, a lot of the setup Sally and I are using is improvised, and while it should be enough the unexpected can always happen." You see. That, and Barney did warn you of potential dangers that might emerge while stabilising the area. "Like I said, I'd feel safer if you were around. You've already come through in quite the number of situations we've managed to get ourselves in." Behind Cait, Salwah giggles. Well, that is true. All right, then. You'll be ready to save your two kittens should anything go awry. Cait [pc.heightRange 69 |stands on tiptoe to kiss you on the cheek |leans in and kisses you on the cheek ]. "Thanks, [pc.name]." ] "Are you done there, kittens?" "Just about, Dad!" Cait calls back. "We're ready to begin!" "All right, then everyone. Take up your positions!" While [party.manyCompanions |[comp2.name] and you ready your weapons |you ready your [pc.weapon] ] and stand guard by Barney, the old cat-man starts cranking his arcane devices, his pudgy arms a blur as the apparatus begins to click and whirr. Colored sparks fly from the bearings, alarming you, but Barney doesn't seem to mind them so they must be part and parcel of this ritual... right? On their part, Cait and Salwah take up positions on opposite ends of the chalk circle and begin dancing along its inner edge, keeping in time with each other as they move in a clockwise motion. Arms flowing, hips and tails swaying, the two temple kittens continue to cavort away — while you're not sure if the sexualisation of it all is absolutely necessary, it's fitting given who they are, and you can't deny the results. [pc.isMage |As the thrum of repressed energy becomes palpable from where you are beyond the circle, you pour some of your own power into the carefully laid chalk sigils, preventing as much of that alien power as you can from escaping and giving more of it for Cait and Salwah to work on |Even though you're not as magically attuned as they are, the thrum of power in the air as it's being worked is palpable even from where you are beyond the circle ]. You look to Barney for any kind of guidance as to what you ought to do next, but he's fully absorbed in his own task, working the crank with one hand while adjusting the position of several glass beads with the other. Lost in themselves and their actions, the temple kittens continue to dance, light on their feet and using their tails to keep balance as they sway and gyrate to some beat only they can hear. Before long, Cait's staff starts to glow — first a faint white in the middle of its focusing gem, then the light fades by degrees to a pulsating orange-brown, sickly and disgusting like syrupy, viscous vomit. The faint pressure on the inside of your mind rapidly grows as the ritual progresses, but you shake it off and concentrate on [pc.isMage |pouring more power into the circle |your surroundings, ready to rush in should something untoward happen ]. Time seems to slow; beads of sweat appear on Cait's pale skin and Salwah's dusky complexion alike, seeping into their clothes as they continue to strut their stuff. There's a moment of tension in the air, and then — "Kittens! Watch out!" Barney's voice roars over the ruined temple even as he doesn't dare stop working his devices. "We're almost there!" The portal on that day... you remember it being bright pink. This is something else altogether, leftover residue in addition to what's accumulated since that fateful night, and it doesn't look good. More light coalesces about Cait's staff in the middle of the circle, dripping out from rents in the air and forming amorphous shapes to pull themselves together and slurp towards the girls. You're quick to act, swooping in and grabbing Salwah by the scruff of her neck while Cait snatches up her staff out of the circle and beats a hasty retreat. "What do we do, Dad?" Cait yells. "Hold them off me! The power — it doesn't want to be dispersed, it's protecting itself! Just a minute or two, and I should have it done!" Just a minute or two, huh? As Salwah runs around and takes cover behind Barney, [party.compNames] step up in front of the old wizard and his magical instruments, facing the tide of sickly, slimy creatures pouring out from the air above the old altar and the conduit. Hope he's right about it just being a minute or two... there's no end to them! It's a fight! You will have to survive ten rounds in order to buy enough time for Cait's dad to finish dissipating the portal energies. ]

你刚刚把巴尼的设备安置好，这时凯特带着萨尔瓦从山坡上走了回来，萨尔瓦是她的下属。 [dayNight |尽管爬上了那座废弃的寺庙，却几乎没流出一滴汗。 |在半夜被叫醒后，我仍然打着哈欠，还有点昏昏欲睡。 ]她乖乖地跟在凯特后面，当看到巴尼和你在曾经摆放祭坛的地方忙碌时，她的注意力立刻被吸引了过来。 “嗨，泽斯拉先生！嗨[pc.name]！”那个皮肤黝黑的猫女看着你们三个人。“那么，我们就这么决定了吗？” “当然。[pc.names]你们已经这么热心地帮助我完成了各项准备工作，现在轮到你们这些女孩发挥作用了。凯特知道我在做什么，只要跟着她的指示去做就行了，好吗？ “好的！” 就这样。 ]凯特和萨尔瓦在你发现的那个木制通道上，用粉笔画了一个简单的圆圈，然后开始忙碌起来。你的粉色小猫把它的“法杖”竖在圆圈的中间，就像是一根巨大的占卜棒；而在巴尼的指示下，萨尔瓦还在圆圈的边缘画了几处符号。 [pc.isMage |这个设置其实相当简单，但根据你对这类事物的了解，你应该相当有信心它能够正常使用，并且足以满足小猫们的需求。如果它们真正在寻找的东西强度足以让这些预防措施变得毫无作用，那么无论他们采取什么措施，都注定不会有效果的。 |整个事情看起来显得过于简单、不够周密，但话说回来，你毕竟并不擅长这类事情，对吧？目前来说，你只能相信你的神庙小猫们知道自己在做什么，同时也要做好随时采取行动的准备，以防万一出现什么严重的意外。 ]巴尼则拿出了他从加斯那里借来的一张该地区的地图——这张地图是鹰棘镇家族的定居者们在他们新建立的村庄周围进行勘测时绘制的。实际上，这张地图的范围相当广泛，覆盖了南部山谷的大部分地区以及一直延伸到里德尔河的那些森林地带。不过，你不禁会想：在过去的十几年里，由于地形发生了变化，这些地图是否还具备足够的准确性呢？当两只小猫完成构建圆圈的任务后，巴尼坐在寺庙边缘的台阶上，仔细研究着那些地图，自言自语道： “我其实更希望能够精确地计算出这条通道从每一个能量源获取能量的具体位置。”他低声说道。如果我的直觉没错的话，这条能量通道应该是在吸取那些横贯整个马奇地区的能量线所释放的能量。直接切断这些能量源会更容易一些，但那样的话，可能会对那个传送门造成不可修复的破坏——到时候我的女孩要怎么回家呢，嗯？不，我们只能把井里的水抽干，可以说是这样吧。是的，我们一定会这么做的……” 之后，巴尼似乎陷入了沉思，于是你走到那个圆圈旁边，向凯特和萨尔瓦点了点头。进展怎么样了？ 凯特精神一振：“相当不错嘛。[pc.name]应该用不了太长时间，那个圆圈就会准备好了——虽然这算不上什么高深的魔法，但在我和卡拉一起旅行的时候，爸爸确实教了我一些技巧，所以现在我可以帮他了！ [pc.isMage |你对魔法有些了解，能帮忙吗？ 萨尔瓦回头看了你一眼，一边拍掉手上的灰尘，一边说道：“嗯，凯特[silly |前辈 ]我打算追踪这种能量的来源。如果你们能在我们进行这项工作的同时把这个圈加固一下，那就太感谢了。” “嗯，你们应该能看出来，这个装置虽然粗糙，但确实能发挥作用；当然，还可以再做一些改进。不过，还有其他办法吗？” “除非你是从小在贾西兰·马拉克信徒的环境中长大的……” 你笑了。好吧，那你就接受这个暗示吧。 |你需要做好应对任何情况的准备吗？毕竟，你还记得在这个地方举行仪式时可能发生的一些事情。 凯特对你露出一个淡淡的微笑：“我想今天我应该不会打开任何传送门……但如果真的发生了什么，有你在身边能够立刻采取行动，我会觉得更安心。[pc.name]即使有爸爸在身边，萨莉和我采用的很多方法其实都是临时想出来的。虽然这些方法应该足够用了，但意外情况还是有可能发生的。” 你看，而且巴尼也确实提醒过你，在稳定这个区域的过程中可能会遇到一些潜在的危险。 就像我说的，有你在身边我会觉得更安心。在我们遇到过的很多困境中，都是你帮了我们大忙。” 在凯特身后，萨尔瓦轻声笑了起来。 “嗯，确实是这样。好吧，这样你就可以在遇到任何意外情况时及时拯救你的两只小猫了。 凯特[pc.heightRange 69 |踮起脚来想亲你的脸颊 |凑近过来，在你的脸颊上吻了一下。 ]谢谢，[pc.name]。" ] 小猫们，你们那边准备好了吗？” “差不多了，爸爸！”凯特回答道，“我们可以开始啦！” “好的，那么大家都准备好，各就各位吧！” 与此同时[party.manyCompanions |[comp2.name]准备好你的武器吧 |你准备好了吗？[pc.weapon] ]当老猫族巴尼站好守卫姿势时，他开始操作那些神秘的装置，他那圆胖的手臂在快速移动中显得有些模糊不清，那些机器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声响。彩色火花从轴承中迸发出来，让人感到有些惊慌，但巴尼似乎并不在意这些，看来这些现象其实是这个仪式中不可或缺的一部分。对吧？ 凯特和萨尔瓦分别站在粉笔圈的两端，开始沿着圈的内侧边缘跳舞，她们的动作完全同步，呈顺时针方向移动。手臂摆动，臀部与尾巴一起摇动，这两只“神庙小猫”继续欢快地玩耍着——虽然你不确定这种带有性意味的表现是否真的有必要，但考虑到她们的身份，这样的设计确实很合适，而且效果也确实不错。 [pc.isMage |当你站在圆圈之外，感受到那些被压抑的能量正在剧烈波动时，你将自己的一部分力量注入那些精心绘制好的粉笔符文之中，尽你所能阻止那些外来能量逃逸，从而为凯特和萨尔瓦提供更多的能量来继续他们的行动。 |尽管你没有他们那样与魔力有着紧密的联系，但当那些力量在空气中被释放时，那种能量波动的气息，即使是你站在圆圈之外，也能清晰地感受到。 ]每当你想知道接下来该做什么时，都会向巴尼寻求建议，但他却完全沉浸在自己的工作中：一只手转动曲柄，另一只手则调整着几颗玻璃珠的位置。那些寺庙里的小猫们也完全沉浸在自己的动作中，它们轻盈地跳跃着，用尾巴保持平衡，随着只有它们自己才能听到的节奏摇摆舞动。不久之后，凯特的手杖开始发光——起初是那颗聚焦宝石中央散发出的微弱白轻型，随后这种光芒逐渐转变为一种脉动状的橙棕色，那种光芒看起来黏稠而恶心，就像糖浆般的粘性呕吐物一样。随着仪式的进行，你内心会感受到越来越强烈的压迫感，但你努力将其甩掉，继续集中注意力。 [pc.isMage |为这个团队注入更多的力量 |观察你的周围环境，一旦发生任何不测，随时准备迅速采取行动。 ]时间似乎变得缓慢起来；凯特苍白的皮肤上，以及萨尔瓦那略带黝黑的肌肤上，都开始冒出细小的汗珠，这些汗珠渗入他们的衣物中，而他们依然继续着自己的表演。空气中弥漫着一丝紧张的气氛，然后—— 小猫们！小心！”巴尼的声音在废墟中的寺庙里回荡，但他却不敢停下操作设备。“我们快成功了！” 那天的传送门……你们还记得它是亮粉色的吧。而现在的情况却完全不同了，那些残留物，再加上自那个决定性的夜晚以来不断积累的东西，看起来情况很不妙。更多的光亮聚集在圆圈中央的凯特手中，从空气中的裂隙中渗出，形成一些无定形的形态，然后这些形态逐渐聚集起来，朝着那些女孩的方向移动。 你们行动得真快，立刻冲了上去，其中一个抓住了萨尔瓦的脖子，而凯特则迅速从圆圈中夺回自己的法杖，匆忙撤退了。 我们该怎么办，爸爸？”凯特大声问道。 “挡住他们，别让他们靠近我！那力量……我控制不住它。想要为了分散注意力，它正在保护自己！再等一两分钟，就应该搞定了。” “就再等一两分钟，是吧？当萨尔瓦四处奔跑、躲在巴尼身后时[party.compNames]站在那位老巫师和他的魔法仪器面前，面对着从古老祭坛上方以及那些通道中涌出来的那些病态而黏滑的生物们，只能希望他说的“只需要一两分钟”是真的……这些生物根本没有尽头！ 这是一场激烈的战斗！你必须存活十轮，才能为凯特的父亲争取足够的时间来消散那些传送门能量。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.BARNEY_PORTAL |"You're ready to give it another go?" Cait nods. "We are, Dad. Someone's got to do something about it, and even though we failed the last time, we're still the best qualified in all of Hawkethorne to make the place safe." She's right. You're more prepared this time. Barney takes a deep drag on his pipe and nods. "I see. At least now that we know those elemental spirits are leashed to their source, we can always retreat if things go badly." "That's quitter talk, Dad! We'll get them this time!" Cait smiles and smacks her father on the back with her tail. "[pc.name], would you please help dad get his things together while I pick up Sally? I'll meet you in front of the Frost Hound." Within the hour, you're back up at the old temple ruins once more, Castle Hawkstone staring down on the [party.manyCompanions |five |four ] of you like a grim, dark sentinel. Barney goes through the motions of setting up his arcane devices again while the girls create the ritual circle, and you feel the hair on the back of your neck rise once more as they start dancing and the air becomes redolent with power. "They're coming again!" This time, you're expecting it. As power gathers and congeals into more of those amorphous, spectral masses of crackling magical energy, [comp2.name] and you step forward to hold the line even as Cait and Salwah retreat, the former to your side, the latter behind Barney. The old wizard huffs and puffs as he spins the crank in a blur, sweat beading on his forehead as the chaotic elementals press the attack. It's a fight! You will have to survive 10 rounds in order to buy enough time for Cait's dad to finish dissipating the portal energies. |[var0 |"You're ready to go up again and get this mess settled? Let me get my things, and I'll be with you." "I'll go call Sally, Dad. She shouldn't be far away." The catfolk are quick about it — fifteen minutes later, the four of you are heading back up the mountainside to the ruined temple, where you quickly lay out the components of the ritual. While you help Barney set up his arcane instruments about where the altar recently stood, |No, there's no time like the present. You're as prepared as you'll ever be, and dragging this out any longer might only make things worse, if this magical buildup from the portal's remnants is as dangerous as Barney makes it out to be. If not now, then when? If not you, then who? Barney sees the resolve in your gaze and grins. "Let's get started, then. Cait, would you please go down and fetch Salwah? [pc.Name], could you please help me move some of this over there?" You've just finished getting Barney's devices into position when Cait returns up the mountainside with Salwah in tow, her junior [dayNight |barely breaking a sweat despite the trek up to the ruined temple |still yawning and a little drowsy at being woken up in the middle of the night ]. She follows obediently behind Cait, and perks up when she sees Barney and you working away by where the altar used to stand. "Hi, Mr. Zethra! Hi, [pc.name]!" The dark-skinned catgirl looks between the three of you. "So, we're doing this, then?" "Of course. [pc.names] been so kind as to help me with getting my setup in order; now it's time for you girls to do your part. Cait knows what I'm up to, just follow her lead, all right?" "Okay!" With that, ] Cait and Salwah busy themselves with drawing in a simple chalk circle atop the wooden conduit you discovered. Your pink kitten's stood up her staff in the middle like some kind of outsized divining rod, and Salwah's scratched in several symbols around the edges at Barney's direction. [pc.isMage |The setup is quite basic, but from your knowledge of such things you're fairly sure it should be functional and sufficient for the kittens' needs. If whatever they're looking for is strong enough to render such precautions useless, then nothing they could do would be effective, anyway |The entire affair looks suspiciously basic and flimsy, but then again you're not educated in such matters, are you? As things are, you'll just have to trust that your temple kittens know what they're doing and be ready to leap into action should something go horribly wrong ]. On his part, Barney's unrolled a local map of the area he's borrowed from Garth, made when the Hawkethorne's settlers were surveying the land about their newly founded village. It's actually quite extensive, covering much of the southern valley and the woods all the way to the River Ridell, but you can't help but wonder how accurate they've got to be after the last decade or two since they were last updated to match the terrain. As the two kittens finish constructing the circle, Barney sits on the steps by the edge of the temple, poring over the maps and thinking to himself. "I would've preferred to be able to triangulate the exact position of every source this conduit is drawing power from," he murmurs. "If my hunch is correct, this conduit could be drawing power from ley lines stretching half way across the March. It would be easier to cut the sources themselves, but then again, that might damage the portal irreparably — then how would my girl get home, hmm? No, we'll just have to drain the well so to speak. Yes, yes we will..." Barney looks to be absorbed in his thoughts after that, so you step over to the circle and give Cait and Salwah a nod. How's it going? Cait perks up. "Pretty decently, [pc.name]! Shouldn't be too long now before the circle's ready — sure, it's not exactly temple magic, but Dad did teach me a few things while I was traveling with Calla, so I could help him out!" [pc.isMage |You have some knowledge of magic. Could you possibly help? Salwah looks over her shoulder at you, dusting off her hands. "Well, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and I are going to be tracing the energy to its source. If you could reinforce the circle while we're about it, that would be appreciated." Yeah, you can see. It's crude, if functional; you can definitely shore it up a bit. Anything else you can do, though? "Not unless you were raised as a Jassiran Mallachite." You smile. All right, you can take a hint. |Should you be prepared for anything? You have memories of things that can happen when conducting rituals at this site, after all. Cait gives you a thin smile. "I don't think I'll be opening any portals today... but I'd feel safer if you were around to leap into action should anything happen, [pc.name]. Even with Dad around, a lot of the setup Sally and I are using is improvised, and while it should be enough the unexpected can always happen." You see. That, and Barney did warn you of potential dangers that might emerge while stabilising the area. "Like I said, I'd feel safer if you were around. You've already come through in quite the number of situations we've managed to get ourselves in." Behind Cait, Salwah giggles. Well, that is true. All right, then. You'll be ready to save your two kittens should anything go awry. Cait [pc.heightRange 69 |stands on tiptoe to kiss you on the cheek |leans in and kisses you on the cheek ]. "Thanks, [pc.name]." ] "Are you done there, kittens?" "Just about, Dad!" Cait calls back. "We're ready to begin!" "All right, then everyone. Take up your positions!" While [party.manyCompanions |[comp2.name] and you ready your weapons |you ready your [pc.weapon] ] and stand guard by Barney, the old cat-man starts cranking his arcane devices, his pudgy arms a blur as the apparatus begins to click and whirr. Colored sparks fly from the bearings, alarming you, but Barney doesn't seem to mind them so they must be part and parcel of this ritual... right? On their part, Cait and Salwah take up positions on opposite ends of the chalk circle and begin dancing along its inner edge, keeping in time with each other as they move in a clockwise motion. Arms flowing, hips and tails swaying, the two temple kittens continue to cavort away — while you're not sure if the sexualisation of it all is absolutely necessary, it's fitting given who they are, and you can't deny the results. [pc.isMage |As the thrum of repressed energy becomes palpable from where you are beyond the circle, you pour some of your own power into the carefully laid chalk sigils, preventing as much of that alien power as you can from escaping and giving more of it for Cait and Salwah to work on |Even though you're not as magically attuned as they are, the thrum of power in the air as it's being worked is palpable even from where you are beyond the circle ]. You look to Barney for any kind of guidance as to what you ought to do next, but he's fully absorbed in his own task, working the crank with one hand while adjusting the position of several glass beads with the other. Lost in themselves and their actions, the temple kittens continue to dance, light on their feet and using their tails to keep balance as they sway and gyrate to some beat only they can hear. Before long, Cait's staff starts to glow — first a faint white in the middle of its focusing gem, then the light fades by degrees to a pulsating orange-brown, sickly and disgusting like syrupy, viscous vomit. The faint pressure on the inside of your mind rapidly grows as the ritual progresses, but you shake it off and concentrate on [pc.isMage |pouring more power into the circle |your surroundings, ready to rush in should something untoward happen ]. Time seems to slow; beads of sweat appear on Cait's pale skin and Salwah's dusky complexion alike, seeping into their clothes as they continue to strut their stuff. There's a moment of tension in the air, and then — "Kittens! Watch out!" Barney's voice roars over the ruined temple even as he doesn't dare stop working his devices. "We're almost there!" The portal on that day... you remember it being bright pink. This is something else altogether, leftover residue in addition to what's accumulated since that fateful night, and it doesn't look good. More light coalesces about Cait's staff in the middle of the circle, dripping out from rents in the air and forming amorphous shapes to pull themselves together and slurp towards the girls. You're quick to act, swooping in and grabbing Salwah by the scruff of her neck while Cait snatches up her staff out of the circle and beats a hasty retreat. "What do we do, Dad?" Cait yells. "Hold them off me! The power — it doesn't want to be dispersed, it's protecting itself! Just a minute or two, and I should have it done!" Just a minute or two, huh? As Salwah runs around and takes cover behind Barney, [party.compNames] step up in front of the old wizard and his magical instruments, facing the tide of sickly, slimy creatures pouring out from the air above the old altar and the conduit. Hope he's right about it just being a minute or two... there's no end to them! It's a fight! You will have to survive ten rounds in order to buy enough time for Cait's dad to finish dissipating the portal energies. ] "
