She manages to calm her laughing after a while, occasionally slipping out a chuckle or two.|You shoot a fierce glare at Arona, quickly halting her laughing before she mumbles out an apology, awkwardly clearing her throat afterwards.] Clementine folds her arms angrily, her face scrunched into a cute pout. She waits until Arona’s laughing has completely stopped before continuing.|] "I was the oldest of six siblings; my Father was uh, w-well he was a busy person. Our large family made it hard to make ends meet. We were farmers you see, but our small farm couldn’t compete with the large estates that produced more crops in a month than we could in a year. Selling our wool wasn’t an option either, in a nation of sheepfolk there’s simply an abundance of it. Most people sold theirs to textile mills but that was never enough to make a living. I moved out when I was about eighteen summers. It was...hard leaving home but it was better for everyone. Made it easier for my family to live." "I thought I would get a farm of my own and follow in my parents' footsteps but I soon realized that it simply wasn’t the life for me. Waiting weeks for crops to grow only to have them ruined by a drought or stolen by a pack of roaming gnolls convinced me to pursue other passions. Like sewing!" "Most sheepfolk know some basic level of sewing but I decided to stake my career on it. Unfortunately that led me into the familiar problem of competition." She sighs. "Once more the abundance of my people pitted me against impossible odds. Everyone and their mother fancied themselves a tailor or a seamstress; there was just no place for a little fish like me in such a big pond." "So I decided to travel around, poke around the Heartland to ply my trade. It didn’t go very well. Most of my clothes were average at best and the close proximity to Barania meant more often than not that I would be competing with other sheepfolk who were far beyond my league. I tried to get an apprenticeship a handful of times but we sheepfolk can be amazingly prideful when it comes to our wool." "You see most sheepfolk who are tailors and seamstresses only apprentice their kin, proudly flaunting their wool as a mark of their heritage. I found a number of non-sheepfolk who would teach me but most of them just saw me as a wool factory rather than a real apprentice. Anytime I complained for higher wages or a real hand at sewing they would give some backhanded excuse or just fire me and hire another sheepfolk." "That led to me coming here. I learned that the Frost Marches had an extremely small population of sheepfolk, meaning I could practice my trade without too much competition. You rescued me from that marefolk, I managed to get an apprenticeship under Nelia in exchange for supplying my wool and that’s pretty much it." Nelia doesn’t abuse her for her wool like her previous employers? "No, she’s a very kind woman. That and I’m one of the few sheepfolk in the Frost Marches. If I decided to stop supplying her it’s not like she could just grab another sheepfolk off the streets." "Ummm, what else, what else. Oh! I love to bake, as you probably know. Seeing people enjoy my baking just makes my heart melt inside. If I wasn’t a seamstress I would definitely be a baker. Only thing is I can’t stand the mess, there’s just so much to clean up afterwards." Clementine kicks her legs back and forth, thinking of what else to say. "Mmmm, that’s about it really. Sorry it’s not the most exciting story."'

rows.translation: 她自己

rows.original: "You wanna know about my wool!?" she gasps excitedly before breaking into a vibrant grin. Well, yeah it’s why you asked. Is she...okay? She’s kind of vibrating in her chair right now. "Yes! I just really like talking about my wool!" she chirps at you as her tail wags furiously. "Okay feel it, feel it, feel it!" she tells you, sticking her poofy arm at you. Uh, what? Weren’t you learning about her wool not touching it? "You’ve gotta touch it in order to learn about it! Now touch my wool!" she commands with a surprising level of authority in her voice. [party.hasCompanions| "You too!" she orders, pointing at [party.compNames].|] You fulfill Clementine’s wishes as [pc.hasHandwear|you move to touch her wool when she suddenly lands a stinging slap on your [pc.hand]. "Take off your glove, dummy! How are you supposed to properly feel when you’re wearing a glove?" she exclaims. Okay okay! Gods, how did she get so assertive all of a sudden? Removing your [pc.handwear], |]you grab a handful of her white wool. And holy shit. You knew her wool was soft from just looking at it but feeling takes it to the next level. It feels like your [pc.hand] is being drawn into her warm fluff, the hairs on her wool latching onto your fingers and pulling you further into her fleece. Well who are you to deny them? You dig deeper until your fingers are practically buried in her coat. It feels like you're grabbing a pillow—no—no pillow you’ve ever laid upon comes close to the softness of her wool. Reaching as far as you can, you meet the flesh of her slender arm before gliding your [pc.hand] through her magnificent fleece, never meeting a single tangle throughout all of her length. Clementine is having the time of her life. Just the mere act [party.som|of you|of you two|of you three] petting her wool has her grinning giddily while she uses all of her willpower to stop herself from jumping out of her seat. This is great and all, but is she going to tell you about her wool? "Huh? O-oh right! Sorry, I got a little carried away." she apologizes, brushing her neck wool nervously. "Okay, so every sheepfolk is born with wool, but not everyone has wool as soft as mine." she proudly boasts. "There’re plenty of folk who will tell you that their wool is softest in all of Savarra and that they come from a great lineage of fluffiness cultured and nurtured through hundreds of generations to produce the most pristine wool that is currently on their backs." she says in a highly mocking tone. "That’s a load of crap." "I’m sure some part of your heritage can influence your wool but a truly marvelous fleece is achieved through hard maintenance and constant attention. Cleaning is by far the most important step. You can’t have fine wool if there's dirt and muck all stuck to it; I take a bath at least once a day if — hey! What are you doing!? Keep touching, keep touching! You’ve gotta keep touching if you want a proper lesson!" she barks at you once she notices your [pc.hand] drifting away from her wool. She’s just making up an excuse to have you touch her wool! "N-no! And even if I am, so what? Is it that bad to touch?" she retorts, trying to ignore the blush creeping in on her face. Well, no but why — "Well then, what’s the problem?" Nevermind. "Good. Then of course there’s trimming. Most sheepfolk have personal preferences when it comes to how thick their wool is. Some keep it very short, only having a little fuzz to show. Others keep it relatively thick, enough to really poof out but not enough to overwhelm them. Like me! But some people get it really thick. I mean thick to the point where they’re more wool than sheepfolk. Never really got the appeal, it always makes them move awkwardly with so much weight. Of course no one ever lets it grow too thick because then it starts to cover their hands and their face. Then they really can’t do anything." "The final part is brushing. Brushing gets out all the tangles and keeps my wool smooth and soft. There’s a special technique to it as well, you can’t just grab a brush and start rubbing yourself down all willy nilly. You’ve gotta make sure you really get into the hairs, dig in to the roots of it."[party.has kiyoko| "Do you use any oils on your wool Clementine? I apply some to my tails constantly to maintain their silky touch." Kiyoko asks. "Oh no no no no. Oil would ruin it’s entire constitution, it would sink into the roots and never get out unless you completely sheared it off." Clementine says, shuddering at thought. "Wool is much too dense to use oil." "I see. Thank you Clementine." Kiyoko says politely.|] She seems to be quite proud of her wool, given her...energetic attitude. "Well of course! Every sheepfolk takes pride in their wool. It’s defined us throughout all of history. If you have anything and I mean anything made of wool, I guarantee it came from a sheepfolk. We’re not the strongest people or the smartest, but we’ve clothed the backs of Savarra and that’s something no other race can lay claim to." she remarks proudly.
rows.translation: 你想知道关于我的羊毛的事情吗？！”她兴奋地喘着气，随即露出灿烂的笑容。 嗯，没错，这就是你问这个问题的原因吧。她……没事吧？现在她坐在椅子上，身体都在微微颤抖呢。 “没错！我就是非常喜欢谈论我的羊毛啊！它一边疯狂地摇着尾巴，一边对你吱吱叫。‘来，摸摸看，摸摸看！’它这样说着，还把它那毛茸茸的胳膊伸向你。” 呃，什么？你不是在学习关于它的毛的特性，而不是去触摸它吗？ “你必须先触摸它，才能真正了解它啊！现在来摸摸我的羊毛吧！”她用一种出人意料的权威肌肉度命令道。 [party.hasCompanions| 你也是！”她命令道，同时指向[party.compNames]。|] 你实现了克莱门汀的愿望。 [pc.hasHandwear|就在你刚伸手去触碰她的羊毛时，她突然给了你一记狠狠的耳光。[pc.hand]把手套脱掉，笨蛋！戴着手套的话，你怎么能正确地感受呢？”她大声说道。 好吧好吧！天啊，她怎么突然变得这么强势了呢？ 把手套脱掉[pc.handwear]， |]你抓了一把她的白色羊毛。 天啊…… 光是看着，你就知道她的羊毛一定很柔软，但感受将这种体验提升到了一个新的层次。真的让人感觉仿佛[pc.hand]当你被她柔软的绒毛吸引时，她羊毛上的细毛会缠住你的手指，将你进一步拉进她的“温暖怀抱”之中。那么，你又有何资格拒绝这样的邀请呢？你越挖越深，直到手指几乎完全埋进她的毛皮里。这种触感就像是在抱一个枕头——不，没有任何枕头能比得上她羊毛的柔软度。当你尽可能地伸长手臂时，最终会触碰到她纤细手臂的肌肤[pc.hand]她的毛皮柔软而华丽，整个长度上都没有一根毛打结。 克莱门汀现在正享受着人生中最美好的时光。仅仅是这个事实本身，就已经让她感到无比开心了。 [party.som|你们中的某些人|你们两个当中|你们三个当中]抚摸着她的毛，她开心地笑着，同时用尽全力克制自己，才没有从座位上跳起来。 这一切确实很有趣，但她会不会真的开始跟你讲关于她的毛的事情呢？ “啊？哦，对了对了！对不起，我有点太激动了。”她一边紧张地挠着脖子上的羊毛，一边道歉。 “嗯，每个羊人出生时身上都会长羊毛，但并不是每个人的羊毛都像我的这么柔软。”她自豪地说道，“有很多人会告诉你，他们的羊毛是整个萨瓦拉地区最柔软的，因为他们拥有一个悠久的传统——数百年来，他们的祖先一直致力于培育这种柔软的羊毛，因此他们身上现在的羊毛才是最纯净、最柔软的。她用极其嘲讽的语气说道，” “那完全是一派胡言。” “我敢肯定，你的某些遗传因素确实会影响你的性格，但真正的奇妙无比的要获得柔软的羊毛，就必须进行精心照料和持续的保养。清洁无疑是其中最重要的步骤。如果羊毛上沾满了污垢和灰尘，就根本不可能得到优质的羊毛；我每天至少会清洗一次羊毛……嘿！你在干什么！？继续摸啊，继续摸！如果你想真正学会这个技巧，就必须坚持不断地触摸！”她注意到你的[pc.hand]正从羊毛上移开，便冲你嚷道。 她只是在编造借口，想让你去触碰她的“毛线”罢了！ “不——就算我真的这么做了，那又怎样？触碰它有那么糟糕吗？”她反驳道，试图忽略自己脸上逐渐浮现的红晕。 嗯，不是这样的，但为什么呢——” “那到底有什么问题呢？” 算了，没关系。 “很好。那么当然就需要修剪了。大多数羊人对于自己的羊毛应该有多厚都有自己的偏好。有些人会把羊毛剪得很短，只留下一点点绒毛而已。有些人会把它调得浓一些，这样它就能真正膨胀起来，但同时又不会让使用者感到不适。就像我这样！不过也有些人会用不同的调配方法。真的太厚了。我的意思是，厚到几乎让他们看起来更像羊毛而不是人类。我一直不太理解这种设计有什么吸引力，因为这么厚的毛发会让他们行动起来很不方便。当然，没人会任由毛发长得太厚，因为那样它们的手和脸都会被毛发覆盖住。那么他们就真的无能为力了。” “最后一步就是梳理。梳理可以清除所有的缠结，让我的羊毛保持光滑柔软。其实这也有一套特别的技巧，不能随便拿把刷子就开始乱刷一通。你必须确保自己真正深入研究这个问题，彻底探究其根源。[party.has kiyoko| 你在自己的羊毛上使用任何油类吗？我经常会在羊毛的尾部涂抹一些油，以保持它们丝滑的手感。”清子问道。 “哦，绝对不行。油会破坏羊毛的天然结构，它会渗透到羊毛的根部，除非你把羊毛完全剪掉，否则这些油永远都洗不掉。”克莱门汀听到这里，不禁打了个寒颤，“羊毛的质地太过紧密，根本不适合使用油类。” “明白了，谢谢你，克莱门汀。”清子礼貌地说道。|] 从她那充满活力的态度来看，她似乎为自己的羊毛感到非常自豪。 “嗯，当然啦！每个羊人都会为自己的羊毛感到骄傲。在整个历史上，羊毛一直是我们身份的象征。如果你有什么……我是说任何东西这是用羊毛制成的，我敢保证这些羊毛一定来自羊人族。我们或许不是最强壮的，也不是最聪明的种族，但正是我们为萨瓦拉的人们提供了衣物，而这一点，没有任何其他种族能够做到。”她自豪地说道。

rows.translation: 羊毛

rows.original: [clementine.pregStage 1 2 3 4 |"So how does it feel? Any different from normal so far?" you ask. "You know, I expected the beginning to be a lot worse." she says lazily tapping the bump on her belly. "What do you mean? The end is the thing people usually complain about, and you're not even close to that," you say. She sticks her tongue out, puffing up her cheeks at you, "I know, I know," she pouts. "I mean, they are no bigger than a pebble right now but I was expecting things to be worse. I've heard people talk about awful morning sickness and weird cravings, but I'm not getting that at all. Well, I am getting cravings and nausea a little, but they are not as bad as I thought they would be. Earlier I wanted cabbage with chicken. That's not that weird a craving, though." She shrugs, "It just feels weird to have my body changing like this." "Well strap in, cause there are only going to be more changes. I wonder how big they'll get," you ponder. "I hope not too big! I still have to work and keep track of my wool. It’ll be a pain to do anything when I’m all round. Not to mention I’m gonna outgrow most of my clothes." the little puffball grumbles. "Just make sure you’re around when I’m all fat and have to waddle around everywhere." "I'll be there to pamper any time I can. Are you gonna knit yourself new clothes or just buy them? If that'd be too much I could just go buy you some from Khor'minos when things get to be too much." She waves off your comment, gently shaking her head. "No, I’ll just stick with my sleeveless dress. I was considering just buying new clothes, but that just feels like a waste of electrum. These simple dresses will work, though I might have to add more to their hems. I’d rather just knit new clothes myself, if I need any. It’s gonna be....hard when I’m bigger with our children but I’ll just suck it up and save the coins. The money should go towards them anyway." You can’t argue with that logic. |"Well,the morning sickness has ended but I think I’d rather have that than deal with the leg cramps," she sighs, rubbing her temple with frustration. "It simply makes everything more difficult. I don’t even want to get up in the morning, let alone go to sleep knowing I have to deal with that when I wake up. Last week, one morning I nearly cried from the pain. Somewhat embarrassing but my legs just feel that sore and sensitive." "No need to be embarrassed, come sit so I can massage them," you say, bidding her sit with you and gently massaging her calves. "That feels good," she says, patting her tummy and resting her head. "Now I just need something to automatically do this to both legs all night while I'm sleeping... The babies are getting bigger, too. I think I feel them kick sometimes "That's wonderful. Why didn’t you say something sooner?" Using your other hand, you unveil her midriff. Her growing belly is hot to the touch and a rosy hue to match her blushing cheeks. You simply can’t get enough of it, leaving no inch of her unloved. It takes a good while, but you even feel one or two bumps that might be kicks as you gently caress her tummy "See? I knew you’d be over the moon about my belly. You’re like a [pc.raMulti lupine catfolk ursine porcine |dog with a bone |cat with a string |bear with a fish |pig in mud |child with a blanket ]," she teases, rubbing her belly with you. "Oh come on now, you know this is one of the best parts of this stage. Me admiring my handiwork and you getting the pampering you deserve." Clementine sighs as she shakes her head. Yet she can’t help but blush from ear to ear with a joyous smile as you pat her tummy one last time. "You’re starting to rub off on me, sweetheart. I’ml happy to have a family with you." "As am I." |"So how are things coming along?" you ask. Clementine is massive now, her tummy fully swollen with your progeny. Her midriff now supports a hefty belly, firmer than before and smooth to the touch. The poor sheep girl is weighed down by the extra heft in an obvious way. She looks ready to pop any day now. You can also plainly see how tired she is from needing to lug your spawn around, and you wouldnt be surprised if shes also mentally ready for the babies to come already. She looks at you with a sour expression. Uh oh, you're gonna hear it now. You can see how things are coming plenty well, so this might be a touchy subject now. She might as well vent her problems out. Keeping all those emotions in is surely bad for a pregnant woman. "Well, I’ve got a lot to say!" she exclaims, pointing to her swollen belly. The sheep girl's eyes lock onto you and squint. "Why are your lambs so rowdy? I can’t even get a good night's sleep because if one of them is relaxing it means one of the others is kicking me just as I'm about to nod off! And that on top of all the other problems I’m having, like barely being able to move around." Clementine slowly gets up, holding on to her back with one hand and the arm of the chair with the other, "I need to support my back every time I need to move more than one room! Thank goodness the folk here are so nice to help me around." Sitting back down, Clementine looks over to the kitchen with a bitter glance, "You're lucky the people of this town are kind enough to help me, cause if I had to go to the market by myself, it'd take me hours with how often I need to rest while I'm moving around. Not that it isn't nice to have people doing things for me, but it feels bad when I don't have the option to do it myself." Continuing her spout, Clementine’s eyes drill into yours. She really has a bone to pick. "Not only that but my breasts have been leaking milk non stop! It keeps staining my dresses! Gods, it's so embarrassing to go out anywhere." She looks down to her swollen teats, you scarcely see the outlines of the blemish. Letting out a small groan as her shoulders droop, she looks drained. Her eyes flicker with annoyance. Pregnancy has really taken a toll on her. "Ugh... Sorry for that little rant. I’ve just been so tired, all the kicking they do and the massive belly makes it hard to sleep, and I guess I just feel you should know how I feel since it's your fault I'm like this!" "It's ok, apology accepted but I don't know if it's warranted. I did make you like this, and I wasn't expecting a fire and forget instant batch of children. I know you're struggling and if venting how you feel makes it more manageable then I want to hear every bit of it," you say, gently rubbing her tummy as you speak. Lifting her dress to unveil her rosy belly, you plant a kiss on her belly button to punctuate your statements. "S-sweetheart," she whispers, and as you plant another kiss on her chest you can feel how hard her heart is thundering. The final kiss lands on her lips, and she gives you the most happy and comfortable gaze since you started talking with her. "Thank you." |"How's it going? Still holding out okay?" you ask "Y-yeah, at least I think so," she says, tapping her fingers on her gigantic belly. "It helps that my body feels like it's changing to accommodate them. I'm plump in so many places I didn't used to be, and I don't even know where to begin..." She looks down to her body, and you can see she's telling the truth. rows.original: You walk up to Clementine's cozy home and happily knock on the door. Usually you would get an answer right away, and the lovely sheep girl would be cheerfully greeting you, but this time is different. A sinking feeling grows in your stomach as you begin to worry for Clem's safety. A few awkward minutes pass as you [pc.isDK |im ]patiently wait at the door. Once you've been there for longer than that, your [pc.isDK |annoyance |concern ] grows. You knock again, hoping that she just missed your first, [pc.isDK |rapping on the door with frustration |and praying silently that she's ok. ] It could be that she's just not home, however, and you can't just sit around forever. You assure yourself that that's the case, and that she must just be out buying baking ingredients. Before you can turn around to leave, however, you hear slow footsteps getting louder from behind the door. Feeling puzzled by the delay and still a bit [pc.isDK |irritated |worried ], you turn back just in time to see the door crack open a hair. Clementine doesn’t step out, only beginning to speak with a shaky voice, "U-Um, I'm not taking any visitors right now. S-sorry, but I feel..." She stops mid-sentence, trying to find the right words. Her voice is full of melancholy, "U-under the weather right now." "It's [pc.name]," you say, "[pc.dcb |I don't wanna catch anything though, so I'll see you when you're better |sorry to interrupt, and I hope you feel better soon! |I'd give you a big get-well smooch, but I don't want to get sick! ] I'll come visit some other time." You turn to leave, but you barely make it five steps before Clementine's muffled call comes out from behind her door. "Wait! Please, [pc.name]. I-I didn’t know it was you. You’re... just the person I needed." You stop and turn back. If she needs you despite her illness it must be for something serious. When you return to the door, you can see Clem inside. Her face is downcast, and she doesn't meet your gaze, but she doesn't exactly look sickly. Honey-brown eyes dart over the floor, occasionally inching in your direction but never able to take that final leap. "It's good to see you," Clementine says, finally opening the door enough to poke her fluffy head out. "I've been in my head and didn't actually look to see who it was. Speaking of, I actually have something really important to talk to you about. It can't wait any longer!" Even through the slit of the doorway, you can see how much the sheep-girl is trembling. You've seen how shy she can be, but this is [silly |some next level neet shit |more than normal. ] You step forward with a concerned frown, taking her hand when she offers it. "What is it? Is something wrong?" Without warning, Clem fully opens the door with enough force to whizz by your face. While you're still surprised and processing the gust of warm air and nice smells from her home, she yanks you inside with a lot more force than you're used to her exerting. You're pulled along through several rooms, and the little sheep is flushed red as a cherry by the time you make it to her intended destination, the kitchen. By the time she stops to take a breather, the poor thing looks like she's about to explode from embarrassment. "Clementine, please. Would you tell me what's going on?" you ask, hoping she's done fretting herself into a stupor. You don't want her to [silly |actually burst into flames |hurt herself from exertion ]. "There's something important I need to ask you!" she proclaims, finishing her effortful trip by pulling out a chair for you to sit in. Once you're in the chair, however, she struggles to find exact words for whatever it is she needs to ask you. A few minutes pass with nothing more than Clementine continuously walking in circles, all the while trying to work up the courage to speak. [pc.dcb |It looks like if you want to get back to your own plans anytime soon, you'll have to deal with this yourself. |It looks like she’s getting right back into her head about this, and you may need to intervene. |The fluffy sheepfolk looks so worried as she frets, and your bimbofied brain works frantically on a solution before you conclude that a good cuddle[silly |, or lots of sex, ] will take your minds off both your problems. ] Sighing to yourself, you rise from your seat and step in front of the timid sheep girl. In her frantic pacing she doesn’t see you and bumps into your chest, her horns slightly poking you. "Shootshoot.... Sorry! I'm doing it again!" she says with a mix of shame and trepidation. Her whole body shakes from whatever nervousness has come over her. Without saying a word, you pull Clementine into a hug. She tries to protest and pull away at first, but she eventually gives in and simply melts into you, letting all that worry leave her body. Finally she pulls back, gathering herself, you flash her a big smile when it becomes apparent she's finally mustered the courage to speak. "I'm so sorry! I'm so sorry, [pc.name], just ..." she looks down to her hooves. "I-I’m just scared of what your answer will be." "My answer to what, silly?" you ask, shaking your head. "You still haven't told me what's got you worried. If it's something about us you know I could never hate you for speaking your mind." "That's exactly it!" she says with a faint smile. "I s-should've known you'd guess. I wanted to talk about... us." "Ah," you say, raising an eyebrow. "Anything in particular, or just in general?" She blushes even harder as you gaze at her. "Ever since you saved me in the Valley, and sheared my wool, I’ve been thinking – thinking – about you all this time and the future, our future." "I know we had s-sex before but recently something has felt...different," she continues with a sigh, combing her fingers through her wool. "My stomach suddenly feels uneasy when I think of you. My heart starts pounding and I get red as a beet!" She pauses to shake her head at the thought as her cheeks flush brighter. "Heck, even Nelia has been teasing and poking at me about you!" she says, slapping her cheeks to push herself into the next sentence. "Get it together, Clementine! You can do this!" "I love you! I really love you [pc.name], from the bottom of my heart!" she blurts, "I want something more from this. As silly as it sounds I want to truly be your woman and for you to be mine. I know in my heart I’ve met my mate for life." At some point she's clasped both your hands in hers, and grows redder by the moment as she notices that fact. Her legs shake, and the poor girl looks ready to faint if she has to wait on a response to this fact for another moment.

"I s-should've known you'd guess. I wanted to talk about... us." "Ah," you say, raising an eyebrow. "Anything in particular, or just in general?" She blushes even harder as you gaze at her. "Ever since you saved me in the Valley, and sheared my wool, I’ve been thinking – thinking – about you all this time and the future, our future." "I know we had s-sex before but recently something has felt...different," she continues with a sigh, combing her fingers through her wool. "My stomach suddenly feels uneasy when I think of you. My heart starts pounding and I get red as a beet!" She pauses to shake her head at the thought as her cheeks flush brighter. "Heck, even Nelia has been teasing and poking at me about you!" she says, slapping her cheeks to push herself into the next sentence. "Get it together, Clementine! You can do this!" "I love you! I really love you [pc.name], from the bottom of my heart!" she blurts, "I want something more from this. As silly as it sounds I want to truly be your woman and for you to be mine. I know in my heart I’ve met my mate for life." At some point she's clasped both your hands in hers, and grows redder by the moment as she notices that fact. Her legs shake, and the poor girl looks ready to faint if she has to wait on a response to this fact for another moment. '

rows.translation: 卢玛与加德福德

rows.original: You smile at the delicate sheep girl and pull her [pc.hasBreasts |into your cleavage |to your chest ], feeling her heartbeat thud over and over like a watermill breaching a river. You look into her honeydew-colored eyes while she squirms in your arms, waiting for your response. Placing a hand on her head, you gently pat till the stress bleeds out again. "Clementine, you didn’t have to worry yourself half to death like this." Moving your hand down, you cup her cheek, "I want you to know, I have always loved you. Ever since those first few times we met. It's not silly. You are special to me in a way you can't imagine, and I can't wait to see what our future brings." "R-really?" Clem blurts in disbelief. You simply nod and keep stroking the wool on her head. At that moment the wooly dam breaks and unleashes its wholesome waters. She immediately pulls you into a deep kiss. In response, you grab her wooly ass and kiss her back. Your tongues intertwine as you both grow more passionate. It's hard to hold back the animal inside that begs you to tear each other's clothes off, but you exercise restraint. Stopping the make-out session, you become aware of her precious little tail wagging from side to side against your wrists. She clearly wasn't quite as invested in that show of restraint, and quickly begins to smooch your entire face in excitement. When she pulls away a few seconds later, pure joy has taken her. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I was just so scared that you wouldn't feel the same way. Can I... call you ‘Sweetheart’ from now on?" she whispers, looking at you expectantly. "I haven't the faintest idea why, after what we've done together," you chuckle alongside another stroking pat on her head. "And you can call me anything you wish, Clementine," The fluffy sheep melts into your touch and giggles slightly. "Are you gonna dote on me every time you’re here?" she playfully teases. "I'll try and best my current efforts, even" you reply, massaging her wooly scalp to give her a taste of your commitment. Strangely, her expression grows a little worried as she grabs one of your hands and lifts it to her chest, her eyes having a glint of concern once more. "I’m sorry for poking you with my horns and making a scene," she looks down, still red-faced from her confession. "I made a big fuss over nothing it seems." [pc.isDK |You promise yourself you'll punish her with a thorough breeding session later if that's what she wants, even though |You don't tell her that it was your fault for stepping in front of her in the first place, and ] it didn’t even hurt. You don't want to bring down the mood with platitudes. instead... "How about we celebrate?" She smiles, nodding and giving you a peck on the cheek before looking at her pantry. "I can make a batch of cookies real quic-," She pauses. "No... I always make cookies for you. A cake would be more fitting. I’ve saved some ingredients for special occasions like this!" For the next few hours you help Clementine make a cake for your "mini celebration". [pc.bg noblescion |Despite letting the family chef handle such matters like this in your youth, you're not helpless to aid your lovable sheep girlfriend. Even though it gets extremely messy, | Despite not having the opportunity to make a cake very often, and it getting extremely messy, ] the end result is pretty good, and you spend just as much time eating it as you did baking it. When you've finally finished, Clem gives you a peck on the lips before letting you return to the streets of Hawkethorne. She's positively glowing, still, even as you leave, and that only makes you more excited to discuss your future together on your next visit. You and Clementine are officially lovers now!

rows.original: You gently guide the sheep girl's hands back to her side, still smiling but less enthusiastic. She senses the answer before you've even had the chance to voice it. Tears well up in her eyes, and she looks like she could break down if you don't handle this very carefully. [pc.dcb |Still, you need her to know how you feel before she gets the wrong idea. |You don't think it will be too much trouble, but it still hurts to see her like this. |It would be so easy to cuddle and kiss these problems away, but even you know that wouldn't help this problem in the long run. ] "Listen, Clem. I don't think I can give you that kind of relationship right now. It's one thing to have fun, but I could easily die in my fight against the demons, or worse, and I don't want to tell you yes only to break your heart in a way you couldn't recover from. Things might change in the future, but are you ok if we just stay like we are for now? I could be gone for[pc.isBimbo |, like, a month.. or even like, totally two months! | months or even die out there. ] I don't want you fretting over whether I'm alive or dead even more than you already do." You finish your statement to deafening silence from the little sheep. Just looking at her, you can tell she's processing what you've said. There are still tears in her eyes, but they aren't falling. Whatever's going through her head at the moment, you feel at least somewhat hopeful that you haven't ruined her life, even if you may have ruined her night. Eventually, she musters up a response that doesn't bring the tears flooding down. "It's ok. I know this all came on a little fast. I'd just been bottling it up. Honestly now that I've got it off my chest it's a lot less scary to hear that. It still s-sucks, don't get me wrong, but I get it. Thinking of you going off and dying does make me feel like I'd fall apart, and I bet that'd be even worse if we were more serious. Sorry for making a scene, b-but don't think I'll just give up after you've saved the world. I'll be right there to try again! O-only maybe I won't work myself up so much..." You smirk at that. "Oh, who am I kidding, I'll probably turn bright as an apple again," she says with a giggle that breaks her dour mood a little. She wipes the tears from her eyes and smiles again. "Could I have some time alone, though? I'll be fine, I just gotta clean up a bit. I promise I'm not going to get sad again. A-as long as you keep coming by, anyway." You nod, walking to the entrance of her home. Before you leave, you take a look back, seeing Clementine give you a gesture for a hug. She is just too precious for this world. Quickly reapproaching her, you accept the invitation. Enveloping the fluffy sheepfolk in your arms, you squeeze and she squeezes till neither of you can take in a full breath. Not to drag out the moment for too long, you pull back from Clementine. Giving her one last pat on the head, you leave with a wave and head back out into hawkethorne proper.
rows.translation: 你轻轻地将那个牧羊女孩的手部放回她的身侧，脸上依然带着微笑，但热情已经减退了许多。她甚至在你开口之前就感受到了那个答案。泪水在她的眼中打转，如果你不格外小心地处理这件事，她似乎随时都会崩溃。 [pc.dcb |不过，你还是需要让她知道你的真实感受，以免她产生误解。 |你可能觉得这不会带来太多麻烦，但看到她这样的样子，还是让人感到很难过。 |想要通过拥抱和亲吻来解决这些问题其实非常简单，但你也明白，从长远来看，这样做并不能真正解决根本问题。 ] 听着，克莱姆。目前我觉得我无法给你那种关系。一起享受欢乐固然很好，但我在与恶魔的战斗中随时可能丧命，甚至遭遇更糟的事情。我实在不想只是为了不让你心碎，却最终让你无法恢复过来而答应你。未来情况可能会改变，但我们现在就保持现状，你愿意吗？因为我随时都可能离开[pc.isBimbo |大概一个月吧……甚至可能整整两个月！ | 可能会持续数月，甚至最终消失殆尽。 ]我可不想让你更加担心我到底是活着还是死了。” 你说完后，小羊羔却陷入了令人窒息的沉默。只要看着它，你就知道它正在消化你所说的话。她的眼里依然噙着泪水，但它们并没有掉下来。无论此刻她正在想些什么，你至少还能感到一丝希望——你并没有毁掉她的生活，尽管你可能确实破坏了她这个夜晚。最终，她还是找出了一个办法，让泪水没有再次夺眶而出。 没关系。我知道这一切发生得太突然了，我之前一直把情绪压抑在心里。说实话，现在我把心里的话说出来了，听起来反而没那么可怕了。虽然这仍然很糟糕，别误会，但我理解你的感受。一想到你可能会离开这个世界确实这让我感觉自己快要崩溃了，而且我敢打赌，如果我们之间的关系再认真一些，情况会变得更糟。很抱歉刚才发了脾气，但是别以为在我帮你解决了那些麻烦之后，我就会放弃。我一定会继续努力，再试一次的！只不过，也许下次我不会让自己那么激动了。……” 你对此报以一丝微笑。 “哦，我到底在骗谁呢，我大概又会变得像苹果一样红润起来吧，”她笑着说，笑声让她原本阴郁的情绪稍微缓解了一些。她擦去眼角的泪水，又露出了笑容。“不过，能给我一点独处的时间吗？我会没事的，只需要稍微整理一下而已。我保证不会再难过了。只要你能继续来看我就好。 你点了点头，然后走向她家的门口。在离开之前，你回头看了一眼，看到克莱门汀正向你招手，似乎想要拥抱你。她对这个世界来说实在太珍贵了。你迅速再次靠近她，接受了她的邀请。将那些毛茸茸的羊人拥入怀中，你们紧紧相拥，直到彼此都无法正常呼吸。 为了避免让这个时刻持续得太久，你从克莱门汀身边退开，最后轻轻拍了拍她的头，然后挥手告别，重新回到了鹰棘镇的主区域。

rows.original: "Hey Clem, I've been thinking really hard on it, and if you're still ok with it, I think I would be ok with taking our relationship to the next level," you say. Clem stares with an uncomprehending grin for a moment, but you watch as her skin turns red as an apple with a blush as she realizes just what you've said. Her grin turns to wide-eyed shock, and then her little tail starts swooshing fast enough that you can hear it parting the air. "Huh? Y-you're not kidding, right? You can't joke like that, [pc.name]!" "I'm not joking, I'm serious. I'm not going to die out there. I'm going to save the world, and I want you waiting at home when I'm done." You wait another few moments, and are delighted to see the sheep only grow more excited, till you can hear her fluffy tail whooshing in the air. You have to stop her from tipping over when it gets so waggy she wobbles in place. "Seven gods! You aren't kidding! I'm not dreaming! I can feel you here!" she says, squeezing you harder than you thought possible. "Actually, I think I have dreamt this, but now it's true!" "It is. Wanna do something to celebrate that fact?" She smiles, nodding and giving you a peck on the cheek before looking at her pantry. "I can make a batch of cookies real quic-," She pauses. "No... I always make cookies for you. She's positively glowing, still, even as you leave, and that only makes you more excited to discuss your future together on your next visit. You and Clementine are officially lovers now!
rows.translation: “嘿，克莱姆，我一直在认真考虑这件事；假如你依然愿意，我想自己可以接受让我们的关系更进一步，”你说道。 克莱姆先是茫然地咧嘴笑着，盯了你一阵；等她意识到你究竟说了什么，你亲眼看着红晕将她的皮肤染得像苹果一样鲜红。她的笑容化作睁大双眼的震惊，随后小尾巴飞快地左右扫动，速度快到你能听见它划开空气的声响。 “啊？你、你不是在开玩笑，对吧？这种事不能拿来开玩笑，[pc.name]！” “我没有开玩笑，我是认真的。我不会死在外面。我会拯救世界；等一切结束，我希望你能在家里等我回来。” 你又等待了片刻，欣喜地看着羊女越发激动，直至毛茸茸的尾巴在空气中呼呼作响。她摇尾巴摇得站在原地都开始晃悠，你不得不扶住她，免得她失去平衡。 “七神在上！你真的没有开玩笑！我不是在做梦！我能感觉到你就在这里！”她说道，将你抱得比想象中还要用力。“其实，我好像确实梦到过这一幕，不过现在它成真了！” “确实如此。想做点什么庆祝一下吗？” 她微笑着点点头，在你脸颊上轻吻一下，随后望向食品柜。“我可以很快烤一批饼——”她停了下来。“不……我总是给你做饼干。蛋糕才更适合。我特意为这样的特殊时刻留了些材料！” 接下来几小时里，你帮助克莱门汀制作蛋糕，举行你们的“小小庆祝会”。[pc.bg noblescion |尽管年少时，这类事情都交由家中厨师处理，但帮助可爱的羊女友还难不倒你。虽然过程变得极其混乱， |尽管你很少有机会制作蛋糕，而且过程变得极其混乱， ]最终成果却相当不错；你们花在吃蛋糕上的时间，几乎和烤制它同样漫长。终于吃完后，克莱姆在你的唇上轻吻一下，才让你回到鹰棘镇的街头。即使你动身离开，她依然喜悦得容光焕发；这只令你更加期待下次造访时与她讨论共同的未来。 你和克莱门汀现在正式成为恋人！
rows.raw: ' "Hey Clem, I've been thinking really hard on it, and if you're still ok with it, I think I would be ok with taking our relationship to the next level," you say. Clem stares with an uncomprehending grin for a moment, but you watch as her skin turns red as an apple with a blush as she realizes just what you've said. Her grin turns to wide-eyed shock, and then her little tail starts swooshing fast enough that you can hear it parting the air. "Huh? Y-you're not kidding, right? You can't joke like that, [pc.name]!" "I'm not joking, I'm serious. I'm not going to die out there. I'm going to save the world, and I want you waiting at home when I'm done." You wait another few moments, and are delighted to see the sheep only grow more excited, till you can hear her fluffy tail whooshing in the air. You have to stop her from tipping over when it gets so waggy she wobbles in place. "Seven gods! You aren't kidding! I'm not dreaming! I can feel you here!" she says, squeezing you harder than you thought possible. "Actually, I think I have dreamt this, but now it's true!" "It is. Wanna do something to celebrate that fact?" She smiles, nodding and giving you a peck on the cheek before looking at her pantry. "I can make a batch of cookies real quic-," She pauses. "No... I always make cookies for you. A cake would be more fitting. I’ve saved some ingredients for special occasions like this!" For the next few hours you help Clementine make a cake for your "mini celebration". [pc.bg noblescion |Despite letting the family chef handle such matters like this in your youth, you're not helpless to aid your lovable sheep girlfriend. Even though it gets extremely messy, | Despite not having the opportunity to make a cake very often, and it getting extremely messy, ] the end result is pretty good, and you spend just as much time eating it as you did baking it. When you've finally finished, Clem gives you a peck on the lips before letting you return to the streets of Hawkethorne. She's positively glowing, still, even as you leave, and that only makes you more excited to discuss your future together on your next visit. You and Clementine are officially lovers now! '

rows.original: [flags.CLEM_PLANS |You settle down and broach the subject of her desire to marry and have children. You've talked about it before and know that it's important to her. "It's still something I hope for," she says,"But I still have my apprenticeship and you still have an invasion to stop. I understand that some things have to happen in their own time. I am just happy you're still willing to talk with me about it. Even just to share your thoughts and feelings." The two of you talk a little more about her work and what you both see happening in the future, or where you might be if not for recent events. Eventually the conversation dies down, and you know it's time to give Clementine an answer about whether you want to elevate your relationship to a new level. |Before broaching the more serious subject, you simply sit awhile and chat about the small things. Clementine is perfectly content to sit there and eat cookies with you while you explain the latest intricacies of your journeys. You tell her all the fun bits and some of the exciting bits, at least the ones that weren't so dangerous as to make her fret. That eases her mind and leads into both of you cuddling and relaxing. Now that you and Clementine are official, this would be a good time to bring up your actual intent for this visit. "I was just[pc.isBimbo |, like, totally ] wondering about our plans. What plans do you have? Did you have any plans beyond just the relationship?" She looks at you, eyes wide, a little shocked by the questions. "Oh, I didn’t really think about that. I was all caught up in my confession. I forgot to sit down and talk to you about our plans. You go first, sweetheart. I want to hear your thoughts. What do you have planned for us?" "Well," you say, "I’m sure you'll continue your apprenticeship with Nelia, right?" Clementine perks up at the mention of Nelia. "I’ve been making a lot of progress with her, ever since you’ve been visiting me I’ve been a lot more confident in my sewing. One day when we have time I really want to take your measurements and knit something for you to wear on your travels! Not only will you have something to remember me by, you’ll stay warm as well. And yes, by that I mean I plan to continue." "Speaking of travel though, I am still in the midst of mine," you remind her. "It’s okay, [pc.name]. I knew that right away and I still wanted this..." she says, burying her head in your chest and hugging you just a little tighter. Her voice is tinged with a little melancholy, but she sounds resolute in her decision. "I know I can’t ask you to avoid danger while you’re off saving the world... but... I believe you when you say you'll make it back, and I'll be right here waiting just like you wanted!" Scratching the back of her head and planting a kiss on her nose, you [pc.isDK |tell her what she wants to hear: |reaffirm her belief. ] You'll make it back here to see her. "Thank you! It means a lot, honey." your wooly lover states, embracing you with fluffy glee. "I guess that's all on my end. I really just wanted to make sure you were content and knew what you were getting into. What about you. What are your hopes for this?" "Darn! I nearly forgot!" she says, jolting to attention. "Um-, Let me get my diary. I wrote everything I wanted to discuss in that." Quickly prying herself from the hug, she shoots off into her room in search of her journal. Remaining seated, you wait for Clementine’s return. Not long after, you hear a triumphant shout. When she walks back in, she holds a thick book in both hands. It has a leather cover dyed red as her face usually gets when she's embarrassed. Diary in hand, she takes her place snuggled beside you once more before opening the book. She briskly flips through a sea of pages before finally stopping on one. "Sorry, [pc.name], I write a lot down so I don't forget." "No need to apologize for a respectable goal," you say, prompting a sheepish grin. "Thank you, but I generally just use this to write about however I’m feeling. Writing down my thoughts and problems helps them not seem so overwhelming." She blushes lightly, hugging the book to her chest. "Oh? Now I’m a little curious. How much of the book is about me at this point?" you tease, trying to peek over her shoulder to see what she wrote about. In her fervor to find the specific pages she's looking for, she responds quickly and without actually thinking about your question, "Oh easily this much. This is where I met you, and I don't think there's more than a page after that goes by without something about you being mentioned." She indicates a sizeably thick set of pages that start at this volume's half way point and continue to where she must have stopped writing. Like the rising sun, you see the flush creep into her cheeks when she truly realizes what she's just done. Embarrassed, the sheep-girl buries her head in the thick book. When you giggle at how earnest the reaction is, she pouts adorably. She playfully pulls on your cheek as revenge before continuing to search. "A-Anyways, I wrote down some of my long-term plans here as well." She flips through the pages then places her diary on the table, "Firstly, I want to make some renovations to the house. Some of the walls and ceiling are old and damaged, they need to be replaced. Plus, I want to extend the house and make it bigger." "I think I could find some people to help with that." "Thank you, it would mean a lot if you would talk to them for me. This is something I’ve been saving up for a long time for, but I don't have the first idea about how to ask," she states, flipping through some pages. Saving up huh? The few glances you've got at her journal have let you see some of her finances scribbled about. [pc.isBimbo |You don't bother trying to do the math yourself. Thinking too much heats up the air in your head, but you do see a lot of entries for sugar and other baking ingredients. |She seems to be very frugal, and what she does spend goes primarily towards ingredients for the bakery, most specifically...sugar. ] Leaning over to her diary she quickly takes a glance at it again, her cheeks becoming a faint rosy-hue once again. "Secondly, I want us to get married." "So soon? I was wondering if you'd ask, but didn't know when," you say. "No! There's no need to rush into it now that we’re official, but it is something I want to do down the road. You can surprise me if that feels better." "Of course I want you as a wife! I'm definitely not going to tell you when I'll propose, though." Flustered by your statement, Clem breaks the tension with a bevy of smooches, pecking your face with marks. "I don't know why I ever thought you'd have reservations. Thank you, sweetheart." You don’t say anything but instead kiss her on the forehead. She smiles brightly, her tail wagging from side to side. "One more thing," she says, closing her diary and pushing it aside. Turning to you, she takes a deep breath before grabbing one of your hands and holding it tightly. "[pc.name], the final thing I want is... children. I’ve always thought about having a family for the longest time, but I’ve never found the right person nor the right place. Not to mention dealing with all my siblings growing up. Now I have you in my life, and I want to start a family with you. If you want to have children, that is. I don’t want to force you into something you don’t want. I talked with the matron of the nursery, and she told me about your deal with them, so I know I'd have plenty of help while I'm working and unable to watch over them." She still looks a little nervous, but her tail wags excitedly "That’s everything I wanted to talk about. I want to know what you think." ]
rows.translation: [flags.CLEM_PLANS |你坐下来，认真地跟她谈起了她想要结婚并生孩子的愿望。你们之前已经讨论过这个话题，你也知道这对她来说非常重要。 “这仍然是我渴望的事情，”她说，“但我现在还在实习期，而你也需要阻止那场入侵。我明白有些事情需要按照它们自己的节奏来发展。我只是很高兴你仍然愿意和我讨论这些事情，哪怕只是分享你的想法和感受也好。 你们俩接着聊了一些关于她的工作，以及你们对未来发展的展望，也探讨了如果没有最近发生的那些事情，你们的处境可能会是怎样的。最终，谈话渐渐平息下来，你也知道，是时候告诉克莱门汀，你是否愿意将你们的关系提升到一个新的阶段了。 |在谈论更严肃的话题之前，你们可以先坐下来，聊一些轻松的小事情。克莱门汀很乐意陪着你坐在一起，一边吃着饼干，一边听你讲述你最近经历的各种趣事。你把所有有趣的事情，还有一些令人兴奋的经历告诉她，至少是那些不会让她担心、不会让她感到危险的经历。这样就能让她放松下来，然后你们就可以一起依偎着放松休息了。现在你和克莱门汀正式确定了关系，这个时候正是向你她说明你此次来访的真正目的的好时机。 我刚才[pc.isBimbo |完全就是这样。 ]我在想我们的未来计划。你有什么打算吗？除了维持这段关系之外，你还考虑过其他事情吗？” 她睁大眼睛看着你，似乎对这些问题感到有些惊讶。“哦，我其实没有认真考虑过这些。我完全沉浸在自己的表白中，忘记坐下来和你讨论我们的未来计划。你先说吧，亲爱的。我想听听你的想法，你为我们准备了什么计划呢？ “嗯，”你说道，“你应该会继续跟内莉娅学习吧？一提到涅莉亚，克莱门汀立刻精神振奋起来。“我和她一起取得了很大的进步。自从你开始来看我之后，我在缝纫方面也变得自信多了。等我们有时间的时候，我真的我想测量一下你的尺寸，然后为你织一些东西，让你在旅途中可以穿着！这样你不仅有东西可以纪念我，还能保持温暖。没错，我的意思就是我打算继续这样做。” “说起来，我自己的旅行也还在进行中呢，”你提醒她。 “没关系[pc.name]我当时就知道了，但我还是想要这个……”她说道，把头埋在你的胸前，将你的手臂搂得更紧了一些。她的声音里带着一丝忧郁，但她的决定听起来非常坚决。“我知道，在你去拯救世界的时候，我不可能要求你避开危险……但是……我相信你说的会回来，我会像你希望的那样，在这里等待你！” 你挠了挠她的后脑勺，然后在她的鼻子上轻吻了一下，说道： [pc.isDK |告诉她她想听的话： |重申她的信念。 ]你会回到这里见到她的。 “谢谢你！这对我来说意义重大，亲爱的。”你的毛茸茸的爱人高兴地拥抱着你，说道。 “我想这一切都应该由我来负责。我只是想确保你感到满意，也明白自己将会面临什么。你觉得呢？你对这件事有什么期望呢？” “哎呀！我差点忘了！”她突然警觉起来，说道，“嗯，让我去拿我的日记本。我想讨论的所有内容都写在上面了。” 她迅速从拥抱中挣脱出来，冲进自己的房间去寻找日记本。你依然坐在原地，等待克莱门汀的归来。不久之后，你听到了她兴奋的欢呼声。当她走回来时，双手捧着一本厚厚的书。书的封面是红色的皮革，这种颜色就像她感到尴尬时脸上的红晕一样。她手里拿着一本日记，再次依偎在你身边坐下，然后打开了这本书。 她快速地翻动着密密麻麻的页面，最终在一页上停了下来。“对不起[pc.name]，我会把很多事情都写下来，这样就不会忘记。” “为一个值得称赞的进球而道歉实在没有必要，”你说，这让他露出了尴尬的笑容。 “谢谢，但我通常只是用这些文字来记录自己的感受罢了。把我的想法和问题写下来，能让它们看起来不那么令人难以招架。”她轻轻红了脸，把书紧紧抱在胸前。 “哦？现在我有点好奇了……这本书里现在有多少内容是关于我的呢？你一直在逗弄她，试图从她肩膀后面偷看她写了什么。 由于她急于找到自己要找的那些页面，她没有仔细思考你的问题，就迅速回答道：‘哦，这个嘛，很简单。就是在这里我遇到了你，而且我觉得，在那之后的内容，一页都写不完吧某个东西关于你被提及这件事……” 她指了指那一叠相当厚的纸张——这些内容从这一卷的中间部分开始，一直延续到她停止写作的地方。当她真正意识到自己刚刚做了什么时，她的脸颊就像初升的太阳一样，渐渐泛起了红晕。害羞地，羊姑娘把头埋进了那本厚厚的书里。当你看到她如此认真地看书时，不禁会发笑，而她则会露出可爱的嘟嘴表情。作为报复，她会顽皮地拉拉你的脸颊，然后继续她的搜索。 “总之，我也把一些自己的长期计划写在了这里。她翻了几页日记，然后把它放在桌上，说道：“首先，我想对房子进行一些翻修。有些墙壁和天花板已经老旧且损坏了，需要更换。另外，我还想扩建房子，让它变得更大一些。我想我能够找到一些人来帮忙解决这个问题。” “谢谢你，如果你能代我与他们谈谈，那将意义重大。这是我长期以来一直想要做的事情，但我完全不知道该如何开口请求。”她一边说着，一边翻动着一些页面。 在存钱啊？你偶尔翻看她的日记时，应该看到里面写了一些关于她财务状况的内容吧。 [pc.isBimbo |你根本不会费心去自己计算这些数据。想得太多了只会让脑子更加混乱，不过你确实看到了很多关于糖以及其他烘焙材料的条目。 |她似乎非常节俭，她所花费的钱主要都用来购买制作面包所需的食材，尤其是……糖。 ]她凑近自己的日记本，迅速又看了一遍，脸颊再次泛起了淡淡的红晕。“其次，我想我们结婚。” “这么快就决定了？我一直在想你会不会提出这个要求，但不知道具体会什么时候。”你说道。 不！既然我们已经正式确定了关系，现在也没有必要急于行动。不过，这是我未来想要做的事情。如果你觉得这样会让我更开心，那就给我一个惊喜吧。” “我当然希望你成为我的妻子！不过，我肯定不会提前告诉你我什么时候会向你求婚。被你的话弄得有些慌乱，克莱姆用一连串的亲吻打破了这种紧张气氛，他的亲吻在你的脸上留下了一个个印记。“我真不明白自己当初为什么会觉得你会有所顾虑。谢谢你，亲爱的。” 你什么也没说，只是亲了亲她的额头。她灿烂地笑着，尾巴兴奋地左右摇动。 “还有一件事，”她说着，合上日记本把它放到一边。然后她转向你，深吸一口气，接着握住你的手，紧紧地握住它。 "[pc.name]，最后，我真正想要的是……孩子。很长一段时间以来，我一直渴望组建一个家庭，但却始终没有找到合适的人，也没有找到合适的地方。更不用说还要照顾我那些正在成长的兄弟姐妹了。现在你出现在我的生活中，我真的很想和你一起组建一个家庭。如果你想要孩子的话，我是这个意思。我并不想强迫你去做你不愿意做的事情。我已经和托儿所的负责人谈过了，她告诉了我你和他们之间的安排，所以我知道，在我工作无法照顾孩子们的时候，会得到很多帮助的。她看起来还是有点紧张，但她的尾巴兴奋地摇来摇去。 “这就是我想谈的全部内容。我想知道你的想法。 ]

        |Clementine is no where to be seen when you first enter her home, so you call out her name as you set your things aside. After a moment you hear her faint voice from another room, "Sweetheart... please come in. I’m in the den."

She gives you a bright smile, setting her book aside before looking back to her fireplace. Walking up, you take a seat beside her. Snuggling in beside your wonderful sheepish lover, you notice her face growing red as she hands you a cookie. "You’re just in time, I just took them out of the oven." 
        
        "What did you need? I can see how you're squirming, and I'm here for you if it's something bad," you say, nibbling a cookie.
        
        She nods, blushing even harder, and turning to you as she begins to speak. "Right, l-let me explain."
        
        She closes her eyes and takes a deep breath.
        
        "At first I was having slight problems. Waking up, feeling sick and sore. I just wanted to sleep all day. It was very different from my usual self. I was a little worried I had caught a bug or something worse. So I decided to talk to Nelia, I thought maybe I could take a few days off work or she could help. Well ......she gave me a response that I wasn’t expecting."
        
        Well what did she say?
        
        "She said it sounded exactly like when she was pregnant! So I asked Gwyn, and asked if I'd had my period recently and I hadn't, and all the signs are there. Then recently, well, feel for yourself." She takes one of your hands and places it on her stomach, you feel a slight bump from her normally flat tummy. New life growing inside her, your seed, your lineage continuing through her. "I really am pregnant!" 
        
        You can’t help but smile, "That’s wonderful, Clementine! It was only a matter of time with what we've been getting up to."
        
        [pc.heightRange 48 56

rows.original: As you enter Clementine's home, you see the [clementine.pregStage 3 4 |heavily |massively ] pregnant sheep waddle toward you. About halfway to the entryway, she pauses. You wonder why for just a moment, and then you see her eyes widen as a dark patch forms between her legs. [clementine.pregStage 3 4 |it's just a trickle at first, and then a bigger gush that soaks her garments. |it all comes in a huge gush that soaks her garments. ] Crossing the rest of the way yourself, you make sure she's ok, but it's quite obvious what's happened. Her water's broken. This is it, [pc.dcb |the first of your dark sheepspawn. You've just got to ensure they're birthed safely before you can breed more into her. |and it's wonderful! You've got to make sure they're birthed safely. |like, the most amazing moment ever! You've gotta make sure the babies are safe! ] "Help me to the nursery" she says, still a little shaky from the shock. Then she gasps and places a hand on her [clementine.pregStage 3 4 |gravid |monstrously swollen ] tummy. "A kick! T-They seem eager to meet the world." The two of you have plenty of time to make it to the nursery, where Gwyn sets up a mess of comfortable towels and special blankets on one of the beds. As her contractions start to really hit, her whole body clenches and a wave of pain batters her body. "Don’t leave me! Please stay, I-we need you!"

rows.original: You reassure Clementine, you’re not leaving her side. She nods, her face now flushed and beading with sweat. At first things are rather slow, when the contractions are still a time apart. Occasionally, she'll squeeze your arm and screw her eyes shut as her tummy squeezes and she attempts a push. It's still much too early at this point, unfortunately, and things settle before she gets any true reprieve. You give her arm a squeeze and lean in till your forehead touches hers. When she opens her eyes and gives you a tired and puzzled smile, you feed her warm encouragement. "You've got this, Clem. I know you'll be fine. You can get through this." Your firm yet comforting words seem to spur the small sheep on. Slowly, and whenever the contractions begin anew, she pushes. As the contractions grow shorter, her strain grows higher. She may be inexperienced, but her body knows what to do. Eventually it reaches the point where she's doing more pushing than not, and you and Gwyn have to remind her to keep breathing. "You did this to me, you [pc.mf |bastard |bitch ]!" she blurts, the pain escaping her in a series of curses and expletives that are very out of character for the friendly sheep. An uncharacteristic berserk rage descends on her. "I swear I'll smash your dick with a frying pan next time I see it! See how you like this feeling!!" "It’s okay, you’re almost there. Keep pushing!" you say, ignoring the pain prompted words and squeezing her shoulder tightly as Gwyn shifts around to catch the babies as they come. Your comforting words don't seem to stop the pain, but they do stop the curses spewing out of her mouth. Instead she looks at you with a pained and apologetic smile before clenching and pushing and screwing her eyes shut as strained noises escape her throat. After another series of convulsions and a substantial push from Clementine, you hear a mewling cry as Gwyn catches and swaddles the first of your children. For the first time since you got there, you let go of Clem's arm for long enough to take the child from the wetnurse. By the time you've got her comfortably tucked under one arm and resumed holding Clem's hand, it's obvious she's not done. [clementine.pregStage 3 4 |Another convulsion hits her and she pushes once again. There are clearly more lambs in her tummy. |Another convulsion hits her as she tries to push out the abundance of life in her womb. Her tummy hasn’t deflated at all, and she clearly has a lot more lambs to go before this is over. ] The rest of the children come much more easily than the first. It's not without struggle, but her screams are much less frequent, and the hard pushes last for a much shorter time. By the time she's done and pushed with all she's got, you and Gwyn have swaddled and held [var0] little lambs. They look almost like human babies, if not for much woollier hair and the nub of a tail you can feel beneath the cloth. Clem is a mess of sweat and snot and tears, but she still looks beautiful as she smiles up at you with a smile and a soft whimper. Gwyn approaches from the other side and hands her one of the babies to feed herself. "This beautiful little girl was the first to greet the world," she says, before undoing the tie on her own top and beginning to feed the other babies. Holding the pink-skinned cherub, emotions overload the sheep once again, and she can’t help but cry once more. She sobs quietly as you both cuddle with your children. Happily smiling at her lambs and then planting a lazy kiss on your cheek. "T-That was one of the hardest things I’ve ever done. It hurt so much," she sighs with a shudder of memory. "Sweetie, I'm... I'm sorry about some of the things I may have said. I didn't mean... m-most of them." Then she looks down to the baby nursing at her breast. "She’s so beautiful," she says in-between sobs. "All of them are perfect." Clementine stops for a moment, thinking before prying her eyes off the little treasures. "Remember the names we went over? Let’s name her Charlotte." The joy emanating from the sheep mother is infectious, a massive smile reaching from ear to ear painted across your face. You can’t help it, being a parent with your sheep girl inspires so much pride and happiness. "Charlotte is perfect, I’m sure she’ll take after you." Planting a kiss on your forehead, she gives you a simple nod. "I’m sure they all will pick up things from both of us." After cuddling for a little while, Clementine falls asleep with the lambs in her arms. Gwyn enters the room after giving you both some privacy and feeding the other lambs till they fall asleep. "Congratulations to both of you," she whispers, laying the other babes to rest with their mother. "You can rest here as long as you need." Nodding to the nursery matron, you keep a watchful eye on your family. Eventually Clementine finds the strength to move. After getting cleaned up and dressed, you happily return home with your rowdy lambs.

rows.original:
Your lover swiftly comes to greet you when you enter her home. At least, swiftly as she can given her heavily pregnant state. Still, she shines with maternal glory when she gives you a warm smile. Then, she purses her lips for a moment and her eyes go wide. It's easy to assume what's going on, but your assumptions are proven correct when a growing splotch of liquid wetness spreads from her crotch. Her water's broken, and [pc.dcb
        |your brood is coming.
        |these babies are coming.
        |the sheepy is gonna have more of your babies!
    ]
    
    Nodding to your lover, you shout out that you’re leaving, and help get your other children ready for the trip. It's easy enough to take a few trips, getting Clem to the nursery first and then transporting your children with the help of some locals. By the time you get everyone moved, Clementine is in the heat of things. You rush to join her, taking one of her hands and squeezing for support.
    
    Her labor is as mentally and physically draining as it usually is. You offer words of encouragement and praise as she pushes out each lamb. She has done this [clementine.kidCount 1 7 18
        |before. Yet she still struggles, her muscles pushing out the children while she grits her teeth and cries out in pain.
        |a few times. While she doesn’t struggle, it’s still a process, pushing out the children, while the whole ordeal drains her physically and emotionally.
        |many times before. The experienced mother has no issues pushing out the children. It’s still a draining ordeal but she doesn’t cry out in pain or struggle much.
    ] As contractions flow throughout her body. She exhales sharply, as she gives a powerful push. 
    
    Just like before, you hold her tight as gwyn catches and swaddles each babe. One after the other, she ensures each one is comfortable and ready to be fed after the final one is free. The rest of the birth goes without issue. Once all is told, Clementine has given birth to [var0] lambs to join your growing herd! Cleaning up your bundles of joy, Gwyn hands them to their mother and takes the excess to feed herself. Clem cries happy tears and smooches each one before helping the two she kept for herself to nurse.
    
    After cuddling for a little while, settling on names for your new additions, and making sure they've been fed. You both return home with your mewling babes.

    没过多久就找到了她，她正在厨房里烤饼干。看到你时，她露出了笑容，递给你一块刚烤好的饼干，然后先亲了你一下。你搂住她的腰，一边吃着饼干，一边不停地亲她。 
    
    “谢谢，亲爱的，”她说，“我知道我永远都可以依靠你。”
    
    “永远都会。我知道我不在的时候，你独自照看我们的羊羔很辛苦，但我相信你能把它们照顾好。谢谢你一直这么坚强。”
    
    “我爱你，”她回答道，然后给了你一个大大的、长长的吻。“你在这儿的时候，还想做点别的吗？”
rows.raw:
'
    You glance around the house. From where you're standing, you can spot at least [clementine.numKids 1 7 18
        |two
        |five
        |twelve
    ] of your children nodding off in places they shouldn't. One of them is on the couch, and Charlotte is passed out on a pile of toys that can't be comfortable. Clem looks exasperated when she sees where your eyes are moving, and she blushes deep when you raise an eyebrow.
    
    "T-they get so comfy though!" she says. "Honestly I'm just so happy when they go to sleep on their own. It gives me time to think and time to help the others."
    
    "I know. Still, It won't do to have them lying around the house like this. They could get hurt if they shift in their sleep," you reply.
    
    "Yeah, I know. I move them when I see they're deep enough in sleep to move."
    
    "I'll help this time," you say, patting her shoulder.
    
    "Thank you, sweetheart."
    
    The two of you work to get your children moved to their beds. They don't so much as stir with wakefulness as you grab them and begin your journey to get them to the bedroom. Along the way, they cuddle and snuggle your shoulder as you carry them, and you gently pat their backs and rub their wool. Each one remains asleep as you lay them down in their cribs. When you've finished collecting your progeny and putting them to bed, you leave to find where Clem disappeared to.
    
    It doesn't take long to find her, in the kitchen and baking cookies. She smiles when she sees you, handing you a fresh-baked cookie and then pre-empting it with a kiss. You hug her around the middle and pepper her with more kisses as you finish eating. 
    
    "Thanks, sweetheart," she says. "I know I can always count on you."
    
    "Always. I know dealing with our lambs is tough when I'm out alone, but I trust you to do it well. Thank you for staying strong."
    
    I love you," she replies, giving you a big, long smooch. "Wanna do anything else while you're here?"
    '

rows.original:
"I'm going to take Charlotte and go on a quick stroll around town," you say, seeking out the oldest of your babies and hoisting her into your arms.
    
    "Okay sweetheart. Both of you stay safe. Would you pick up these from the market while you're out?" Clem asks, retrieving a list of foods from a nearby table.
    
    "Certainly," you reply.
    
    After a parting kiss, you take your oldest child and are on your way. To start, you simply take a stroll through the less inhabited parts of town. Hawkethorne is plenty beautiful in its own right, and it's nice to just enjoy the architecture and the trees. When you walk around the outer walls, it gives you a good view of the forests edge, and you even catch some glimpses of wildlife in the fields and treeline. A couple rabbits and squirrels going about their day, and even a deer strolling out to reach a particularly tasty patch of grass.
    
    Charlotte watches all this with wide eyes. Your little daughter is incredibly attentive, holding tight to your shoulder and squeezing with her hands as her head swivels to follow the many things she's seeing. She spends extra time fixating on the animals you see, at least until they dart out of her range of sight. Any random townspeople who walk by also get the brunt of her focus, and she stares with her big blue eyes as they walk by you.
    
    When you stop by the Frost Hound, some stop to compliment her. A few even elicit a smile when they stop to compliment and give her tickles or headpats. She's more receptive to people she's seen before, and enjoys spending that time standing still just as much as the walking around. Gwyn gets an extra big smile, and you let her hold the babe for a few minutes so you can rest your arms. When you feel rested enough, you take her back so you can resume your walk.
    
    After that, and as the stroll stretches on, little Charlotte drifts off to sleep. You're thankful you took that chance to rest, as the sleeping child seems to weigh twice as much as when she was holding onto you of her own volition. Still, the exercise is nice, and you welcome the added challenge as you make your way to the market. One nice old lady with a stall to herself even gives you a small discount when she sees you working to hold a bag and a babe. 
    
    Once you've got everything on the list that was available, you start heading back home to Clem's house. The trip back is much more direct, as you'd like Charlotte to get at least some of this nap spent in her actual crib. Clementine beams when she sees you, and rushes to both give you a kiss and take the bag of fruits and vegetables you were carrying. That lets you place Charlotte in her crib, and then return to give Clem a big smooch.
    
    "Any other plans today, sweetheart?"
rows.translation:
我要带着夏洛特在城里散散步，”你说道，一边找到最小的孩子，把她抱到怀里。
    
    “好吧，亲爱的。你们俩一定要注意安全。你们出去的时候能不能顺便去市场把这些东西买回来？”克莱姆问道，他从旁边的桌子上拿出一份购物清单。
    
    当然，”你回答道。
    
    在吻别后，你带着最大的孩子出发了。起初，你们只是沿着小镇上人迹稀少的地方散步。鹰棘镇本身就非常美丽，欣赏那里的建筑和树木，实在是一件愉快的事情。当你沿着外围的墙壁走动时，可以清楚地看到森林的边缘，甚至还能偶尔看到田野和树丛中的野生动物。有几只兔子和松鼠在忙碌地活动，甚至还有一只鹿漫步出来，去吃那片特别美味的草地。
    
    夏洛特睁大眼睛看着这一切。你的小女儿真是非常专注，她紧紧抓住你的肩膀，双手还不停地用力，同时她的头也会不停地转动，试图跟上她所看到的一切。她会特别仔细地观察那些动物，至少直到它们从她的视线范围内消失为止。任何路过的小镇居民也会成为她关注的焦点，她会用她那双大大的蓝眼睛盯着他们，直到他们从你们身边走过。
    
    当你路过寒霜猎犬时，总会有人停下来夸赞她。有些人还会逗她笑，轻轻挠她痒痒或者轻拍她的头。对于那些她之前见过的人，她显得更加亲近，无论是静止站立还是四处走动，她都同样享受这样的时光。看到格温露出灿烂的笑容，你便让她抱一会儿婴儿，这样自己也能休息一下手臂。等休息得差不多了，你再把她带走，继续继续你的旅程。
    
    之后，随着散步的继续，小夏洛特渐渐睡着了。你很庆幸自己抓住了这个休息的机会——因为这个熟睡的孩子，现在看起来可比她主动紧抓着你的时候重多了。不过，这样的散步还是挺不错的，而且在前往市场的路上，这种额外的挑战反而让你感到有些兴奋。甚至有一位热心的老妇人，看到你一边提着袋子，一边照顾婴儿，还特意给了你一点折扣。 
    
    当你把清单上所有能买到的东西都买齐后，你就开始往克莱姆的家方向返回。回家的路要短得多，因为你希望夏洛特至少能在她自己的婴儿床里小睡一会儿。克莱门汀看到你时高兴极了，立刻跑过来亲了你一下，然后接过了你手里提的那袋水果和蔬菜。这样你就可以把夏洛特放到她的婴儿床里了，然后回去好好亲克莱姆一下。
    
    今天还有其他的安排吗，亲爱的？

rows.original:
"I couldn't help but notice the babies clothes piling up. Would you like some help getting them cleaned up?"
    
    "Yes please," Clem says with a sigh of relief. "Thank you, sweetheart."
    
    "Don't thank me yet, I could still be crushed in the tide of little outfits."
    
    With the jokes out of the way, you get to work. Clem helps get you a tub with warm, soapy water before going to care for the kids, while you're left to clean. First things first, you sort out which of the little outfits even truly need washing. Some of them don't have stains or marks at all, and those ones you set aside. When you're done, you can take those to hang and air out. No need to wash the wool any more than it needs to be.
    
    Most of the others, however, are various degrees of covered in food or spit-up or gods know what else. You offer a quick prayer to Lumia before diving into the thick of it. Once they get in the water, it's much less of an issue, and luckily none of the foods they've been eating or milk they've been drinking is all that gross or sticky. These all get washed thoroughly till any remaining marks have disappeared, and then they get wrung till they're more damp than wet. After that, they get taken outside to dry in the open air before they get anything else inside wet.
    
    There's a truly immense pile of clothes your little ones have gone through, and it takes you a good hour before you can see the bottom of those that still need cleaning. By this time, the initial batches you put out to dry have done so, so you bring them in to be put away while you work to replace them. When all is done, however, you leave the last bunch out to dry and make sure your hands are equally dry. The tub of water gets drug out and dumped in the same trip, and then you head back in to find Clem.
    
    She's in the kitchen, feeding Charlotte, and gives you a big smile when you come through the door. When you've walked close enough to touch, she puckers her lips and waits for you to lean down and kiss her.
    
    "Thanks, sweetheart," she says afterwards.
    
    "My pleasure," you reply. "Are those cookies I smell?"
    
    "They sure are. You're welcome to as many as you can eat."
    
    "Don't mind if I do," you say, plucking a cookie from the countertop and giving it a nibble. "That hits the spot after working."
    
    "Was there anything else you'd like to do now that you're done working?"
rows.translation:
我忍不住注意到那些婴儿的衣服堆积得越来越多。需要帮忙清理一下吗？”
    
    “好的，谢谢。”克莱姆松了一口气说道，“谢谢你，亲爱的。”
    
    “先别谢我，说不定我还会被这些小衣服淹没呢……
    
    玩笑开完了，该开始干活了。克莱姆会帮你准备一盆温热的肥皂水，然后你去照顾孩子们，剩下的工作就交给你了。首先，你要分辨哪些小衣服真的需要清洗。有些衣服上根本没有污渍或痕迹，就把它们放在一边。清洗完后，可以把这些衣服挂起来晾干。羊毛衣物没必要过度清洗，只要保持干净就可以了。
    
    然而，其他大多数食物都或多或少被食物残渣、吐出的奶液，或者天知道还有什么东西弄得沾满了污渍。在跳进水中之前，你会快速向卢米娅祈祷一番。一旦他们进入水中，这个问题就不再那么严重了，幸运的是，他们吃过的食物和喝过的牛奶并没有那么恶心或粘稠。这些物品都会被彻底清洗，直到所有残留的痕迹都消失殆尽，然后还会被拧干，直到它们变得比刚刚洗过的时候还要湿。之后，它们会被拿到户外，在空气中晾干，这样就不会有其他潮湿的东西再弄脏它们了。
    
    你的孩子们确实弄出了一大堆需要清洗的衣服，你花了整整一个小时才弄清哪些衣服还需要继续清洗。而那些你之前拿出去晾干的衣服已经干透了，于是你把它们收起来，同时开始准备替换新的衣物。不过，当所有工作都完成后，你还是会把最后那批衣服再拿出去晾干，同时确保自己的双手也彻底干透。洗衣服用的水也会被一起倒掉，然后你再回到屋里去找克莱姆。
    
    她正在厨房里喂夏洛特吃东西，当你走进门时，她朝你露出了灿烂的笑容。当你走到足够近的距离，可以触到她的时候，她会撅起嘴唇，等着你弯下腰来亲她。
    
    “谢谢，亲爱的，”之后她说道。
    
    不客气，”你回答道，“我闻到的是饼干的味道吧？”
    
    “没错，你可以随便吃，想吃多少都行。”
    
    “那我就不客气了。”你说着，从柜台上拿了一块饼干咬了一口，“工作结束后吃这些饼干，真是太舒服了。
    
    既然你已经完成了工作，现在还有其他想做的事情吗？

rows.original: "I couldn't help but notice the mess of knitting equipment all over the living room. Are you making something specific?" "Oh yeah! I've been making enough clothes for our babies and any more we have in the future," Clementine replies. "All by yourself? You know they don't all need to be homemade, right?" you ask. "I know, sweetheart. I just want them all to get the same personal touch. Plus I've got to get used to working this hard for them." If you say so, but don't overwork yourself," you reply with a hug and a kiss. "I'm sorry I can't really help with this." "Aw, it's ok", she says, rubbing your face with her delicate hands and giving you a playful pat on the head. Her touch soothes your concerns. "I can handle it here. I know the situation out there is rough, so having any time with you here is enough." After another moment, her eyes light up. "Oh! I did also make something for you!" she says, rushing into the living area with her tail wagging behind her. When she returns, it's carting a plush wool sweater the color of new-fallen snow. You take it when she hands it to you, giving it a feel. Good gods, It’s so fucking soft. It feels like your whole family just hugged you. All their fluffy, puffy wool hugging and soothing your entire being. Not only that, but it's warm, warm enough to block out the chill in the march air. "Thank you. I love it. I love you," you tell Clementine, hugging her tight and kissing her deep. "You're welcome, and thank you Sweetheart, this meant a lot to me. I did promise to make you something eventually. I just didn’t think it would be with a family." she kisses you one last time on the cheek, as you both return to your lambs.
rows.translation: “我忍不住注意到，客厅里到处都摆着针织工具。你在制作什么特定的东西吗？” “哦，是啊！我一直在制作足够多的衣服，给我们的宝宝们穿，也给未来可能再有的孩子准备，”克莱门汀回答。 “全都由你一个人完成？你知道，不是所有衣服都非得亲手制作，对吧？”你问道。 “我知道，亲爱的。我只是希望每个孩子都能感受到同样的心意。而且，我必须习惯为他们这样辛苦劳作。” “既然你这么说，但可别让自己过度劳累，”你一边回答，一边拥抱亲吻她。“抱歉，我实在帮不上什么忙。” “噢，没关系，”她说道，用纤柔的双手抚摸你的脸，又调皮地拍了拍你的脑袋。她的触摸抚平了你的忧虑。“这里的事情我应付得来。我知道外面的处境很艰难，所以只要你能在这里陪我一阵，就已经足够了。” 又过片刻，她的双眼突然亮了起来。 “哦！我还为你做了一件东西！”她说道，尾巴在身后兴奋摇摆，自己则匆匆跑进起居室。回来时，她拖着一件毛绒绒的羊毛衫，颜色洁白如新雪。 她把毛衣递给你，你接过来摸了摸。诸神在上，真他妈柔软。感觉就像整个家庭都在拥抱你；他们蓬松柔软的羊毛环绕着你，抚慰你的整个身心。不仅如此，它还非常温暖，足以隔绝边疆空气里的寒意。 “谢谢你。我很喜欢。我爱你，”你告诉克莱门汀，紧紧拥抱她，给了她一个深吻。 “不客气，也谢谢你，亲爱的，这对我意义重大。我确实答应过，迟早要为你做件东西。只是没想到，制作它时我们已经有了一个家庭。”她最后在你的脸颊上亲了一下，随后你们一起回到小羊们身边。

You can't help but notice your adorable sheep is looking a bit exhausted, and very much like she could use a nap. You ambush her before she can find another bit of work to do, and hug her around the middle. She gives you a half-hearted protest that turns into a laugh, and then turns to kiss you.
    
    "You seem kinda tired. Wanna go lie down and nap for a while?" you ask.
    
    "I'd like nothing more, sweetheart," she replies
    
    With a woozy smile, she radiates love from her entire being. Taking your hand, the little sheep girl [clementine.pregStage 0 3
        |
        |slowly 
    ]guides you to the bedroom.[clementine.pregStage 0 3
        |

Smiling, Cait uses the lull in the argument to finally pull her father and junior apart to get in a word edgewise. "As matron of this temple, I formally extend an invitation to you, uh, — " "Darius." "Right, Darius. So long as you're assisting my father in his investigations and helping him find a way to get my sister back, you're more than welcome to stay with us here in the temple. Some things are naturally expected of a Mallachite place of worship, but as you've noticed yourself, the walls are thick." Salwah scowls. "Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], you can't — " "Let's face it, Sally, our own matron back home was more than willing to bend the rules when it suited her; at least we're doing it for a good cause. We know why temples aren't supposed to be taking any permanent lodgers, and I think we can waive that rule in this remote corner of the world. Even if you work that womb of yours to exhaustion, it'll be a couple of generations before the living quarters Garth's people so kindly provided us with will start to fill. So yes, as matron, I can. "People have taken the trouble to be kind to us, Sally. I think we can pass along the favor." The dusky kitten doesn't look completely convinced at her senior's words, but there's the obvious undertone there that Cait's about to pull rank on her if she doesn't fall in line. Eventually, Salwah settles for a pout and flops back onto her cushioned recliner, sullenly taking a long draw from her hookah. "Well, that settles that," Barney says, mopping his brow. "Thanks for stepping in there, [party.has cait |Caitriss, [pc.name] |[pc.name] ]. Wouldn't have been able to get a word in edgewise if you hadn't." Honestly, you didn't do much. "Sometimes, all it takes is the right [pc.race] in the wrong place to make all the difference," the old cat-man replies. "Mmm, yes indeed. Speaking of which — come along now, Darius. I'll need to show you the setup that you're going to be working with, and the anomaly in question. Even though it's stabilised for now, I don't trust it in the slightest. Neither should you!" rows.translation: 当你走进寺庙的入口大厅时，你会看到一幅奇怪的场景：巴尼和萨尔瓦正在争吵。 [party.has cait |站在他们两人中间，显得十分尴尬的，是一个你从未见过的生物——一只年轻的霜鳞蝾螈，它显然对这种紧张的局面感到非常不适。 当凯特看到争吵正在发生时，她立刻从你身边跑过来，快步走到他们两人跟前，强行站在他们中间。爸爸！莎莉！这到底是什么意思？快停下来吧！” 巴尼擦了擦额头，目光在你们母女两人之间来回移动，说道：“啊，凯特…… |站在莎莉身边，试图安抚她的妹妹的是凯特，她轻轻拉了拉那个小女孩的肩膀；而在巴尼的另一边，则站着一位你从未见过的角色——一只年轻的霜鳞蝾螈，它显然对这种紧张的局面感到非常不安。 哎呀，这简直就是一团糟。你坚定地走上前去，把一只手放在那两只吵闹个不停的猫的肩膀上，慢慢地把它们分开——凯特看到这一幕，眼中充满了感激之情。 他们已经这样做了半个小时了，我实在没能把他们分开……谢谢。[pc.name]半个小时，是吗？那到底是怎么回事呢？” 巴尼擦了擦额头，叹了口气：“啊…… ]， [pc.name]你来得正是时候……或者也可以说来得不是时候，这取决于你从哪个角度来看。” “别再拐弯抹角了，到底发生了什么？” “是泽斯拉先生请来了他在提克里斯的一位朋友，来帮他研究那个传送门。”莎莉双臂交叉在胸前回答道。这倒也没什么，但他要求我们无限期地招待这个年轻人，这实在不太合适，尤其是考虑到城里还有很多其他的住处可供选择！” “我已经解释过了，萨尔瓦。在我不在场的时候，达里乌斯需要负责监督我打算对那个传送门残骸进行的实验，因此他必须留在神庙里，至少在…… 那只是个借口，您心里明白的，泽斯拉先生。我不知道您究竟在想什么真的虽然你们可能想要，但玛拉赫的神庙可不是那种任何人都能随便租个房间住下的地方！对于你的朋友来说，冰寒霜猎犬就已经足够了。我在寺庙建成之前，它就一直待在那里，而且环境相当舒适！ 当巴尼和萨尔瓦争论不休时，你将目光转向那个年轻的蝾螈人——他微微低着头，看起来对这一切显得十分尴尬。那么，你猜猜，他到底在想什么呢？他想想这一切吧？ 巴尼和萨尔瓦突然停止了争吵，将目光转向了那个倒霉的“传令官”。 “我、我？” 没错，就是他。 “嗯，我确实知道在贾西拉，马拉克信徒神庙是如何运作的。的确，这些神庙不会收留住客；神庙的居住区本来就是为那些虔诚的信徒准备的。但与此同时，那里也没有任何可能带来危险的通道——虽然目前这些通道已经稳定下来，但仍然有可能受到外界干扰而再次变得不稳定。虽然镇上的酒馆确实相当舒适，但整个村庄的环境对我来说来说，实在太嘈杂、太拥挤了，不符合我的喜好。如果有什么办法可以解决这个问题，我宁愿留在这里。这个地方有厚厚的墙壁，我觉得它们……嗯，能让人心静下来。” “好吧，我想我已经听够了。”凯特微笑着，趁着争论暂时停歇的时机，终于把父亲和弟弟拉开，找了个机会单独和父亲谈谈。作为这座寺庙的守护者，我正式邀请你——” “达里乌斯。” “没错，达里乌斯。只要你能够帮助我父亲进行调查，并协助他找到让我的妹妹回到我们身边的办法，你完全可以留在我们这座寺庙里。对于一个属于马拉克信徒族的礼拜场所来说，有些特征自然是意料之中的，但正如你自己注意到的那样，这里的墙壁确实非常厚。 萨尔瓦皱起了眉头：“凯特[silly |前辈 ]你不能这样——” “说实话，莎莉，我们家乡的管家在需要时也很乐意打破规则；至少我们这样做是出于好意。我们明白为什么寺庙不应该收留永久居住的客人，而且我觉得在这个偏远的地方，我们可以破例。即使你把你的身体用到极限，加斯的人们为我们提供的居住场所也要过上几代人才能住满。所以，作为管家，我可以人们都费心对我们好，莎莉。我想我们也可以将这份善意传递下去。” 说实话，你也没帮上什么忙。 “有时候，只需要有合适的人或合适的时机就行了。[pc.race]出现在错误的地方，反而会带来意想不到的结果，”那位老猫人回答道，“嗯，确实如此。说到这里——来吧，达里乌斯，我需要带你去看看你将要使用的设备，以及那个需要研究的异常现象。虽然目前情况已经稳定下来，但我丝毫不信任它。你们也不应该信任它！” 说完，巴尼便沿着寺庙的走廊走了下去，那个“传令官”则默默地跟在后面，低着头，显得十分尴尬——显然，这个年轻人对自己引发了这样的骚动感到非常羞愧。叹息着，凯特走到你身边，快速地在你的脸颊上亲了一下，然后[party.has cait |靠在你身边，放松下来。 你的粉色小猫虚弱地对你笑了笑：“我知道你在开玩笑[pc.name]，但是有时候我会想，是否真的是这样呢？我当然不这么认为。是等这一切结束后，我肯定会很怀念以前能够自由外出的日子。拜托，让我们把这件事抛在脑后吧。你把我们带到这里肯定是有原因的，对吧？ |她摇了摇头。 “我发誓，只要一不注意，他们就会立刻互相攻击起来。莎莉确实是个出色的管理者，但在执行寺院的规章制度时，她实在太固执了。当然，我也理解她为什么必须这样做，但有些特殊情况还是应该被允许的是这是理所当然的。” 经营一座寺庙确实很辛苦，对吧？ “你根本无法想象。过去，我对女祭司和大祭司做出的一些决定感到非常不满……但现在我身处他们的位置，开始理解他们为什么会那样做，尽管我仍然不喜欢他们的做法。说实话，现在就只有莎莉、我和爸爸……二十年后情况肯定会变得一团糟。 所以她才决定从小事做起！ 凯特轻声笑了起来，不过其实她并没有觉得这有什么好笑的。啊，够了，别再说了。[pc.name]你来到这里，无疑是想尽情享受乐趣、释放自己的激情的——很抱歉你不得不目睹这一切。来吧，你来到这里肯定是有原因的，对吧？ ]
