rows.original: You approach the young salamander man, who doesn't look up from the devices that Barney's set up about the portal. He's taking down several notes and cross-referencing them with a stack of heavy, leather-bound books that certainly weren't here the last time you looked — a corner of Cait's vast private chambers has been converted to a small workstation with a bookcase, desk, and seating for two. More of Barney's work, one presumes. Still, he appears completely oblivious to your presence until you clear your throat, at which he half-turns towards you, tail lashing out in surprise. "Oh!" Hope you're not interrupting anything, but it didn't seem like he'd be done anytime soon. "Of course you're not." Darius sets down his notes and books with a thump. "I was actually hoping to get properly acquainted with you — our meeting back there wasn't the best foot forward, as it were. Barnaphous can be quite the insistent man when he's excited about something — but I digress. I'm Darius." Any last name? He shakes his head. "Never had one. And you..." You're [pc.name]. "Right." The 'mander man extends a clawed hand to you, which you take quite firmly. "While Barnaphous has been talking a great deal about you, [pc.name], he didn't drop your name even once. It's caused me no small amount of vexation, as you can imagine. I thought I caught your name during that argument, but I couldn't be sure." You laugh. That does sound like Barney, yes... but couldn't he have asked the old man himself? "Ah, well... you know how he gets. Anyway, I've been looking forward to meeting you in person, [pc.name]. This whole business has me quite excited, and you in particular." Really? "Yes! Barnaphous told me all about the mutability of your body which resulted from the backwash of energy from the portal. Now, changing yourself isn't unknown, since we have alchemy and all, but it requires specially concocted potions that must be tailored to an individual's needs. But you... it must be seriously frustrating to put something in your mouth and end up looking different from it, right? Mealtimes must be a chore!" [var0 |Well, about that. You made a pact with one of the Seven so that your form would at least stabilize somewhat. Darius' face falls at that. "O-oh. All of you?" Well, not all of you — there're still some bits and pieces that've kept their mutability from the portal blast and all. Perhaps that would be sufficient? "It'll have to do." Darius purses his lips and taps his chin. "I understand why you did it; changing all the time would have been a great inconvenience. And yet... it would be a shame if such a scientific curiosity was to be erased from the world. "I'm sorry. I have no right to ask you to bear that kind of burden for my sake." |Well... some things change you, and others don't — you have absolutely no idea why this is the case. You've figured out that most foodstuffs that're suited to be used in alchemy are to be avoided unless you want to change yourself, but you don't know the underlying reasons. So long as you stay away from them, though, you're mostly fine. Darius strokes his chin and looks thoughtful at that. "Hm. Sorry about that — I got a little carried away." ] Oh, it's all right. You see why he and Barney get along pretty well. So, he's going to be staying here to look over the portal, or at least, what remains of it?
rows.translation: 你走近那个年轻的火蜥蜴人，他正低头研究巴尼在传送门周围架设的装置，压根没有抬头看你。他正记录着若干笔记，并拿它们与一摞厚厚的皮面装订书互相参照——上次你往这边看的时候，这些书肯定还不在这里。凯特那间宽敞的私人居室的一角已被改造成一处小工作区，里面有一排书架、一张书桌，还有可供两人落座的座位。想必又是巴尼的手笔。 不过，他似乎完全没有察觉到你的存在，直到你清了清嗓子；他这才半转过身来看向你，尾巴因惊讶而猛地甩了出去。 “哦！” 希望你并没有打扰到什么，不过看样子他一时半会儿也忙不完。 “你当然没有打扰到。”达里乌斯把笔记和书本重重地放下。“其实我一直想好好认识你——我们之前那次见面，可以说算不上好的开端。巴纳福斯在为什么事兴奋起来的时候，会是个相当固执的人——不过，我扯远了。我叫达里乌斯。” 有姓氏吗？ 他摇了摇头。“从来没有过。那你……” 你是[pc.name]。 “好的。”那个火蜥蜴男人向你伸出一只带爪的手，你相当用力地握住了。“虽然巴纳福斯一直在谈论你，[pc.name]，可他一次都没提过你的名字。你可以想象，这让我颇为恼火。我以为在那场争吵中听到过你的名字，但我不敢确定。” 你笑了起来。这确实很像巴尼的作风……不过他为什么不直接去问那位老人本人呢？ “啊，嗯……你也知道他就那样。总之，我一直很期待能与你当面相识，[pc.name]。这整件事让我非常兴奋，尤其是你。” 真的吗？ “没错！巴纳福斯把你身体的可变性全都告诉了我，那是传送门能量反冲造成的。话说回来，改变自身并不算闻所未闻，毕竟我们有炼金术之类的手段，但那需要专门调配的药剂，还必须按照个人的需求量身定制。可你呢……把一样东西放进嘴里，自己就会因此变得不一样，这肯定让人相当抓狂吧？吃饭的时候一定很折磨人！” [var0 |嗯，关于这个。你与七大存在之一订下了契约，好让你的形体至少能稳定一些。 达里乌斯一听这话，脸色顿时沉了下来。“哦……全部都这样吗？” 嗯，并不是全部——因为传送门爆炸等等缘故，你身上仍有一些零碎之处保留着可变性。也许这样就足够了？ “那就只能将就了。”达里乌斯抿起嘴唇，轻敲着下巴。“我理解你为什么要那么做；一直不停地变化肯定会带来极大的不便。不过……如果这样一桩科学奇观就这样从世上被抹除，未免太可惜了。” “我很抱歉。我根本没有权利要求你为了我而背负那样的负担。” |嗯……有些东西会改变你，有些则不会——你完全不明白为什么会这样。你已经发现，大多数适合用于炼金术的食物都得避开，除非你确实想改变自己，但你不知道其中的缘由。不过，只要远离这些食物，你基本上就没事。 达里乌斯抚着下巴，若有所思。“嗯，抱歉——我有点太忘形了。” ] 哦，没关系。你也看得出他和巴尼为什么相处得这么好。那么，他是要留在这里照看传送门，或者至少是它剩下的部分，对吧？
rows.raw: " You approach the young salamander man, who doesn't look up from the devices that Barney's set up about the portal. He's taking down several notes and cross-referencing them with a stack of heavy, leather-bound books that certainly weren't here the last time you looked — a corner of Cait's vast private chambers has been converted to a small workstation with a bookcase, desk, and seating for two. More of Barney's work, one presumes. Still, he appears completely oblivious to your presence until you clear your throat, at which he half-turns towards you, tail lashing out in surprise. "Oh!" Hope you're not interrupting anything, but it didn't seem like he'd be done anytime soon. "Of course you're not." Darius sets down his notes and books with a thump. "I was actually hoping to get properly acquainted with you — our meeting back there wasn't the best foot forward, as it were. Barnaphous can be quite the insistent man when he's excited about something — but I digress. I'm Darius." Any last name? He shakes his head. "Never had one. And you..." You're [pc.name]. "Right." The 'mander man extends a clawed hand to you, which you take quite firmly. "While Barnaphous has been talking a great deal about you, [pc.name], he didn't drop your name even once. It's caused me no small amount of vexation, as you can imagine. I thought I caught your name during that argument, but I couldn't be sure." You laugh. That does sound like Barney, yes... but couldn't he have asked the old man himself? "Ah, well... you know how he gets. Anyway, I've been looking forward to meeting you in person, [pc.name]. This whole business has me quite excited, and you in particular." Really? "Yes! Barnaphous told me all about the mutability of your body which resulted from the backwash of energy from the portal. Now, changing yourself isn't unknown, since we have alchemy and all, but it requires specially concocted potions that must be tailored to an individual's needs. But you... it must be seriously frustrating to put something in your mouth and end up looking different from it, right? Mealtimes must be a chore!" [var0 |Well, about that. You made a pact with one of the Seven so that your form would at least stabilize somewhat. Darius' face falls at that. "O-oh. All of you?" Well, not all of you — there're still some bits and pieces that've kept their mutability from the portal blast and all. Perhaps that would be sufficient? "It'll have to do." Darius purses his lips and taps his chin. "I understand why you did it; changing all the time would have been a great inconvenience. And yet... it would be a shame if such a scientific curiosity was to be erased from the world. "I'm sorry. I have no right to ask you to bear that kind of burden for my sake." |Well... some things change you, and others don't — you have absolutely no idea why this is the case. You've figured out that most foodstuffs that're suited to be used in alchemy are to be avoided unless you want to change yourself, but you don't know the underlying reasons. So long as you stay away from them, though, you're mostly fine. Darius strokes his chin and looks thoughtful at that. "Hm. Sorry about that — I got a little carried away." ] Oh, it's all right. You see why he and Barney get along pretty well. So, he's going to be staying here to look over the portal, or at least, what remains of it? "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "That's right," Darius says. "While I did have a comfortable post in the palace library back in Tychris, the Order Astrida gave me an indefinite leave of absence the moment Barnaphous sent for me, detailing what he'd found here. Two minds are better than one; in this line of work it's always better to have someone else to sound off your thoughts and theories on. That, and I owe a lot to the man for everything he's done for me." Hmm... "The man has a knack for finding interesting things, and this is no exception. I'm just glad that I was able to respond to his summons." [party.has cait |"No wonder Tychris was our intended next stop before all this happened," Cait pipes up. "He must've wanted to catch up with you — and to be frank, I wanted to meet you, too. Dad mentioned you once or twice in passing when he came to visit Calla and me back at the temple." "Oh, did he? Frankly, I'm nothing much to write home about..." "Don't undersell yourself like that. You're here helping Dad, and that's all that matters." ] Right. From what you've gathered, he's here studying the portal, or what remains of it. Darius nods. "It's stabilised for now, which means we can safely investigate it, but it would probably start to unravel again within a year to a decade if left unattended. That's another reason why Tychris is so interested in it as well — an unattended, open portal is a dangerous thing, to say the least, not just to its immediate vicinity but the region as well. Our first priority is to find a way to open or close it at will, or failing that, permanently seal it; my understanding is that the cult that used to operate here relied on a yearly astrological event to activate the portal, which is frankly quite stupid. "Another thing is — and forgive me for being direct — I would like to study you." What? "Your mutability is likely to be only one aspect of the changes the portal inflicted upon your person; as the local elf arcanist put it, she can 'totally smell the magic on you, like you got dunked in a well of it.' Nor, does it seem, has this effect worn off over time[var1|, and it took divine intervention to finally stop it in part|]. If you're willing, [pc.name], I would like to further examine its effects on your physiology, [pc.name] — it promises to be quite fascinating." [party.has cait |"What would these... uh, investigations involve?" Cait pipes up. "I don't want any weird stuff going on in my temple." "Nothing your father doesn't approve first, Miss Zethra. Certainly non-invasive, unless [pc.name] here desires otherwise." "Well, so long as Dad okays it first, then. And [pc.name] too, of course!" |What would these experiments involve? "Certainly not anything that Barnaphous doesn't approve of first, and very definitely non-invasive, unless that's something you desire." For some reason, that doesn't put much confidence in you about the whole matter... ] "I'm sorry. I've never been very good at adequately conveying myself in a comforting fashion — an artifact of my upbringing. That, and Barnaphous has always been a friend I can be quite direct with." The way he puts it, it makes him sound as if he doesn't have any other friends than Barney. Darius pointedly ignores that observation and clears his throat. "Well, now that I've said my piece, I'll be here if you need me.[var0| Barnaphous spends the day about his business, and watches the instruments in the evenings after I've taken my leave.] I do hope that you give my propositions some thought, [pc.name] — while I shan't pester you to do anything, simply having the chance to observe you in a controlled setting would go lengths to satisfying my curiosity."
rows.translation: “没错，”达里乌斯说。“虽然我在提克里斯的时候确实在皇宫图书馆里有一份舒适的差事，但巴纳福斯一召我来、说明他在此地发现了什么，阿斯特里达教团就立刻给了我无限期的休假。两个人总比一个人强；干这一行，总需要有个人来听你倾诉自己的想法和理论。再说，这个人帮了我那么多，我欠他太多了。” 嗯…… “这个人很擅长发现有趣的东西，这次也不例外。我只是很高兴自己能回应他的召唤。” [party.has cait |“难怪在这一切发生之前，提克里斯本来是我们下一站要去的地方，”凯特插话道。“他一定是想跟你叙叙旧——而且说实话，我也想见见你。爸爸以前来神庙看望卡拉和我的时候，偶尔会顺口提起你。” “哦，是吗？说实话，我没什么了不起的……” “别这样贬低自己。你能来帮爸爸，这才是最重要的。” ] 没错。根据你了解到的情况，他留在这里是为了研究那个传送门，或者说它残存的部分。 达里乌斯点了点头。“它目前已经稳定下来了，这意味着我们可以安全地对它进行研究；但如果无人照管，估计在一年到十年之内它又会开始崩解。这也是提克里斯对它如此感兴趣的另一个原因——往轻里说，一扇无人看管的敞开传送门也是件危险的东西，不仅会威胁到它附近，还会波及整个地区。我们的首要任务是找到随意开启或关闭它的方法；如果做不到，就把它永久封印。据我所知，以前在这里活动的那个邪教依靠每年一次的天文事件来激活传送门，说实话，这种做法相当愚蠢。” “还有一件事——请原谅我说话直白——我想研究一下你。” 什么？ “你的可变性很可能只是传送门对你造成的改变中的一个方面；用当地那位精灵奥术师的话说，她能‘完完全全闻到你身上的魔法味，就像你整个人在魔法井里泡过一样’。而且，这种影响似乎也没有随着时间消退[var1|，最后还得靠神力介入才部分止住了它|]。如果你愿意，[pc.name]，我想进一步研究它对你生理造成的影响，[pc.name]——这肯定会非常有意思。” [party.has cait |“这些……呃，调查会涉及些什么？”凯特插话道。“我可不想我的神庙里发生什么奇怪的事。” “凡是你父亲没有先批准的事，一概不会做，泽特拉小姐。调查绝对是非侵入性的，除非[pc.name]本人希望如此。” “好吧，只要爸爸先点头就行。当然，还有[pc.name]也是！” |这些实验会涉及些什么？ “绝对不会有任何巴纳福斯事先不同意的事，而且非常明确是非侵入性的，除非那是你本人的意愿。” 不知为何，这话让你对整件事并不怎么放心…… ] “我很抱歉。我一直都不太擅长用让人安心的方式表达自己——这是我成长环境的产物。再说，巴纳福斯一直是我可以说话很直接的朋友。” 照他这么说，听起来他好像除了巴尼之外再没有别的朋友了。 达里乌斯刻意无视了这句评论，清了清嗓子。“好了，既然我已经把话说完，你需要我的时候我就在这里。[var0| 巴纳福斯白天忙自己的事，等我离开后，他晚上会去查看那些仪器。]我真心希望你能认真考虑我的提议，[pc.name]——虽然我不会缠着你做任何事，但只要能有机会在受控环境下观察你，就足以让我的好奇心得到极大满足了。”

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: [rand |You find Darius at the table on the other end of Cait's chambers, sharing a drink with Rune — the two are chatting quite animatedly in what you presume must be Jassiran, the conversation coming to a quick halt when you draw close. "Oh look, boy. You've got a guest." Rune says with a chuckle, switching over to Belharan for your benefit. "Don't let a silly girl like me hold you up — it's too early for me to be drinking this much, anyway." Darius says something in Jassiran, but Rune just gives her friend a nod and wink, picking up the half-empty bottle and stowing it under an arm. Whatever's in there, it's strong. "You people play nice, okay? I'll be heading back on out to the front now." Laughing, Rune departs, leaving an awkwardly frazzled Darius in her wake, the 'mander scratching the back of his head sheepishly. "So, [pc.name]... what can I do for you?" |When you draw close, you see Darius working away at a hand crank at one of the many odd arcane devices Barney's set up by where the portal was. [pc.bg arcanist |Watching him evokes a twinge of sympathy in your heart for the poor bastard — you know full well from your days as an apprentice arcanist that you got to do all the grunt work back then, just like this 'mander is doing now |For all the magical ingenuity that Cait's dad has shown in cobbling this stuff together out of everyday objects, there's something to be said for the sophistication involved — or at least, you'd have expected scientific pursuits like this to involve less menial work ]. The crank hits a ratchet within the monitoring device several times, and it's only when it finally starts up with a whirr that Darius is able to turn his attention to you, mopping his brow sheepishly with the back of a hand. "Sorry about that. Hope I didn't keep you waiting, but the spectrometer doesn't wait for anyone; someone has to keep it wound." Oh no, it's all right. "I guess I've a little time while Barnaphous' things sort themselves out — is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?" |You check around the little corner of Cait's quarters and find Darius sitting at a table by Barney's makeshift lab, cross-referencing several notes from one of the musty old stacks the old cat's dragged out of Castle Hawkstone. He looks up as you approach, quickly hiding his notes, and gives you a thin smile. "Hey, [pc.name]. Nice to see you around the temple." Did you come at a bad time? He looked busy. The 'mander shakes his head. "I... I was getting distracted despite myself. Nothing to do with the temple — just my own thoughts, that's all. I'm sure a quick break would do me good, help me collect myself. What's up?" |As you approach Darius, you find the 'mander sitting at the table, nursing a large mug of something that smells richly fragrant even at this distance. He takes one last draught, smacks his lips, and sets the mug back down with a thud before noticing you and promptly looking embarrassed. "Uh... hey. Didn't expect you to be around, [pc.name]." Something smelled good, and you couldn't help but check it out. "Ah, it's Jassiran spice tea — I had to learn how to make a good cup growing up. Doesn't do anything for me, personally, but the taste is okay, and it brings back —" his voice chokes up for a moment — "memories." ... "Sorry about that, I shouldn't weigh you down with my baggage unasked. The instruments are all wound up, so I'm taking a break. Is there something you'd like to discuss? After all, you wouldn't have come all this way into the temple on a lark, right?" |Drawing close, you find Darius over by the instruments Barney's set up, fiddling with them and jotting down notes on a crude notepad made from several strips of paper fastened together with a metal ring. He looks adequately thoughtful throughout the process, so much so that he doesn't notice you stepping up to him. "Ah! Would you please make some noise when you move, [pc.name]? I nearly knocked over the flux analyser with my tail!" Sorry, you just couldn't resist. Still, you don't think you were that quiet... "...Ah, damn. Now I've lost my train of thought." The 'mander purses his lips. "It can't have been that important, or else I'd have taken care to remember it, I guess. But since you're here, is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?" ]
rows.translation: [rand |你在凯特房间另一头的桌旁看到达里乌斯，他正和露恩一起喝酒——两人聊得十分热烈，你猜他们说的肯定是贾西拉语，但当你走近时，谈话便戛然而止。 “哦，瞧啊，小伙子，你有客人来了。”露恩轻笑一声，为了照顾你而改用贝尔哈兰语，“别让我这种傻姑娘耽误你——反正现在还太早，我可喝不了这么多。” 达里乌斯用贾西拉语说了句什么，但露恩只是朝她的朋友点了点头、眨了眨眼，随即拿起那半空的酒瓶夹到腋下。不管里面装的是什么，都烈得很。 “你们可要好好相处，行吗？我这就回前线去了。” 露恩笑着离开了，留下一个尴尬又狼狈的达里乌斯，这位曼德尔不好意思地挠着后脑勺。 “那么，[pc.name]……有什么我能为你效劳的吗？” |当你走近时，你看到达里乌斯正在一台古怪的奥术装置旁转动手摇曲柄；巴尼在传送门原来的位置旁架起了许多这样的装置。[pc.bg arcanist |看着他，你心里不由得对这家伙生出几分同情——你很清楚，自己在当奥术师学徒时也干过所有那些粗活，就像这个曼德尔现在做的一样 |凯特的父亲用日常物件拼凑出这些东西时展现出的魔法巧思固然了不起，但其中所需的精密程度也值得一提——至少，你本以为这类科学工作该少些粗笨的体力活 ]。 曲柄在监测装置内部咔哒咔哒地拨动了好几次棘轮，直到它终于嗡嗡地运转起来，达里乌斯才总算能把注意力转向你，不好意思地用手背擦了擦额头。 “抱歉。希望没让你久等，可光谱仪不等人；总得有人给它上弦。” 哦，不，没关系。 “我想，在巴纳福斯的事情理出头绪之前，我还有点时间——有什么我能帮你的吗，[pc.name]？” |你在凯特住处的小角落里四处看了看，发现达里乌斯正坐在巴尼临时搭起的实验室旁的桌边，对照着老猫从鹰棘石堡里拖出来的旧书堆中的一本做笔记。你走近时他抬起头，飞快地藏起笔记，朝你淡淡地笑了笑。 “嘿，[pc.name]。很高兴在寺庙里见到你。” 你是不是来得不是时候？他看上去很忙。 这位曼德尔摇了摇头。“我……我不由自主地就走神了。跟寺庙无关——只是我自己的心事，仅此而已。我相信稍微歇一会儿对我是有好处的，能让我定定神。有什么事吗？” |你走近达里乌斯时，发现这位曼德尔正坐在桌边，慢慢喝着一大杯东西，哪怕隔着这么远也能闻到浓郁的香气。他喝了最后一大口，咂了咂嘴，砰地把杯子放回桌上，这才注意到你，顿时露出窘迫的神色。 “呃……嘿。没想到你会在附近，[pc.name]。” 有什么东西闻起来很香，你忍不住想过来看看。 “啊，这是贾西拉香料茶——我从小就得学着泡出一杯好茶。对我个人来说没什么用，但味道还不错，而且它能让我想起——”他的声音哽住了一瞬——“回忆。” …… “抱歉，我不该不请自来就向你倾倒我的包袱。仪器都上好弦了，所以我正歇一会儿。你有什么想聊的吗？毕竟，你不会无缘无故大老远跑到寺庙里来，对吧？” |走近之后，你发现达里乌斯在巴尼架设的仪器旁摆弄着它们，还在一块用几张纸条加一个金属环钉成的简陋记事本上写写画画。他整个过程都显得颇为沉思，以至于没注意到你走到他身边。 “啊！你走路的时候能不能出点声，[pc.name]？我差点用尾巴把那台通量分析仪打翻！” 抱歉，你就是忍不住。不过，你觉得自己刚才也没那么安静…… “……啊，该死。这下我把思路全忘了。”这位曼德尔抿了抿嘴唇。“想必也没那么重要，不然我肯定会留心记住的。不过既然你来了，有什么我能帮你的吗，[pc.name]？” ]
rows.raw: " [rand |You find Darius at the table on the other end of Cait's chambers, sharing a drink with Rune — the two are chatting quite animatedly in what you presume must be Jassiran, the conversation coming to a quick halt when you draw close. "Oh look, boy. You've got a guest." Rune says with a chuckle, switching over to Belharan for your benefit. "Don't let a silly girl like me hold you up — it's too early for me to be drinking this much, anyway." Darius says something in Jassiran, but Rune just gives her friend a nod and wink, picking up the half-empty bottle and stowing it under an arm. Whatever's in there, it's strong. "You people play nice, okay? I'll be heading back on out to the front now." Laughing, Rune departs, leaving an awkwardly frazzled Darius in her wake, the 'mander scratching the back of his head sheepishly. "So, [pc.name]... what can I do for you?" |When you draw close, you see Darius working away at a hand crank at one of the many odd arcane devices Barney's set up by where the portal was. [pc.bg arcanist |Watching him evokes a twinge of sympathy in your heart for the poor bastard — you know full well from your days as an apprentice arcanist that you got to do all the grunt work back then, just like this 'mander is doing now |For all the magical ingenuity that Cait's dad has shown in cobbling this stuff together out of everyday objects, there's something to be said for the sophistication involved — or at least, you'd have expected scientific pursuits like this to involve less menial work ]. The crank hits a ratchet within the monitoring device several times, and it's only when it finally starts up with a whirr that Darius is able to turn his attention to you, mopping his brow sheepishly with the back of a hand. "Sorry about that. Hope I didn't keep you waiting, but the spectrometer doesn't wait for anyone; someone has to keep it wound." Oh no, it's all right. "I guess I've a little time while Barnaphous' things sort themselves out — is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?" |You check around the little corner of Cait's quarters and find Darius sitting at a table by Barney's makeshift lab, cross-referencing several notes from one of the musty old stacks the old cat's dragged out of Castle Hawkstone. He looks up as you approach, quickly hiding his notes, and gives you a thin smile. "Hey, [pc.name]. Nice to see you around the temple." Did you come at a bad time? He looked busy. The 'mander shakes his head. "I... I was getting distracted despite myself. Nothing to do with the temple — just my own thoughts, that's all. I'm sure a quick break would do me good, help me collect myself. What's up?" |As you approach Darius, you find the 'mander sitting at the table, nursing a large mug of something that smells richly fragrant even at this distance. He takes one last draught, smacks his lips, and sets the mug back down with a thud before noticing you and promptly looking embarrassed. "Uh... hey. Didn't expect you to be around, [pc.name]." Something smelled good, and you couldn't help but check it out. "Ah, it's Jassiran spice tea — I had to learn how to make a good cup growing up. Doesn't do anything for me, personally, but the taste is okay, and it brings back —" his voice chokes up for a moment — "memories." ... "Sorry about that, I shouldn't weigh you down with my baggage unasked. The instruments are all wound up, so I'm taking a break. Is there something you'd like to discuss? After all, you wouldn't have come all this way into the temple on a lark, right?" |Drawing close, you find Darius over by the instruments Barney's set up, fiddling with them and jotting down notes on a crude notepad made from several strips of paper fastened together with a metal ring. He looks adequately thoughtful throughout the process, so much so that he doesn't notice you stepping up to him. "Ah! Would you please make some noise when you move, [pc.name]? I nearly knocked over the flux analyser with my tail!" Sorry, you just couldn't resist. Still, you don't think you were that quiet... "...Ah, damn. Now I've lost my train of thought." The 'mander purses his lips. "It can't have been that important, or else I'd have taken care to remember it, I guess. But since you're here, is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?" ] "

rows.original: Darius is a seven-foot frostscale salamander — tall for one of his people, but not exactly athletic or broad as stereotypical for those of his kind. Instead, the young 'mander is built a little lanky, perhaps from spending too much time indoors, or perhaps from not eating enough of the right things in his youth — either way, the effect's quite like a beansprout that's been grown in darkness, tall but thin. He's wearing a loose-fitting white shift over his body, bound at the waist with a rope belt; the man is clearly used to cheap, practical clothing in which he can move. The 'mander's styled his purple-blue hair loosely, trimming it just under his shoulders; the flowing style goes very well with the pair of ash-black 'mander horns that flow away and back from his head. Flecks of frostmander scale adorn his face about yellow slitted eyes, and like others of his race, he's sporting a pair of frilled ears, one of them pierced with bronze rings. And speaking of bronze, Darius is wearing more of it about his wrists and ankles in the form of bracers and anklets. Plain and unadorned, they don't appear to be jewelry — or at least, jewelry should be flashier, so you can only wonder at what functional purpose they have. The 'mander's forearms and feet are reptilian and scaly, although the claws that adorn his fingertips are carefully filed and don't get in the way of his handling of the books and arcane instruments that fill his life here in Barney's makeshift lab. Of course, there's also the standard-issue frostmander tail with its aurora flame, although like the rest of him, it's a little thinner and lankier than one would expect for one of its length. Perhaps the most interesting part of Darius' appearance would be the scar on his chest — while it's mostly hidden by his shift, you can catch it peeking out from about the hem from time to time, a gash of pale white on his skin. While you wouldn't have expected someone like him to have come into violence, the scar's a reminder that appearances can indeed by wholly deceiving...
rows.translation: 达里乌斯是一条身高七英尺的霜鳞蝾螈——对于他的同类来说已经算相当高了，但他的体格并不算特别健壮，也不像人们通常认为的那样魁梧。实际上，这只年轻的蝾螈体型有些瘦长，这可能是由于它长时间待在室内，或者是在幼年时期没有摄入足够的营养所致。无论如何，这种体型确实就像是在黑暗中生长的豆芽一样——虽然很高，但却很细。他身上穿着一件宽松的白色工作服，腰部用一根绳子束紧；显然，这个人已经习惯了这种既便宜又实用、便于活动的服装。 这位“领主”将自己那紫蓝色的头发随意地披散下来，剪短到刚好在肩膀下方；这种飘逸的发型与他那一对从头顶两侧垂下来的灰黑色“领主角”十分相配。在他黄色的裂隙状眼睛周围，点缀着霜冻巨龙鳞片的痕迹；与同族人一样，他也长着一对褶边耳朵，其中一只耳朵上还戴着青铜环。 说到青铜，达里乌斯的手腕和脚踝上也佩戴着青铜制成的护手和脚链。它们朴素无华，看起来根本不像是珠宝——至少不能算是珠宝。应该这些结构看起来更加华丽炫目，因此人们不禁会好奇它们究竟具有什么功能。这位“指挥官”的前臂和足部具有爬行动物的特征，覆盖着鳞片，不过他指尖上的爪子已经被仔细修剪过，因此并不会妨碍他操作那些摆满在巴尼临时搭建的实验室里的书籍和神秘仪器。当然，达里乌斯的身上还长着那条带有极光火焰的典型霜冻巨龙尾巴，不过与他的身体其他部分一样，这条尾巴相对于它的长度来说，显得有些细长。 或许达里乌斯外貌上最引人注目的地方就是他胸前的那道伤疤——虽然大部分时间都被他的皮毛遮住了，但偶尔还是能隐约看到那道淡白色的伤痕从皮毛边缘露出来。虽然你根本不会想到像他这样的人会诉诸暴力，但那道伤疤却提醒我们：外表确实有可能完全欺骗人……
