[rand
        |其实，还挺不错的。就像我之前说过，这种生活确实让我重新体验到了在贾西拉度过的那些美好时光，同时也把那些不愉快的回忆都掩盖住了。我现在的生活环境很整洁，萨尔瓦的厨艺也相当不错，我的每一天都过得平静而有序。对于一个小时候曾经是奴隶的人来说，这样的简单乐趣已经足以满足我的需求了。”

“他不参加寺庙里的其他活动吗？”

“你是说诗歌朗诵会吗？我之所以参加，是因为巴纳福斯也会去，而他的公司总能把任何活动办得非常愉快。

不……

“或者，你是指当瑞弗来到寺庙表演的时候？”

不……

“嗯，我尽量避开那个香料市场。我并不是猫族，所以这些对我来说根本没有任何意义。虽然香料茶还算不错，但浓重的烟雾以及香料盘碰撞发出的声响，确实不符合我的口味。”

现在你可能会觉得他是故意装傻的。
        
        那些神圣的妓女和狂欢活动其实并不是这座寺庙存在的真正意义，尽管它们确实构成了这座寺庙声名狼藉的主要原因。不过，就寺庙里进行的各种活动而言，我还是比较喜欢能够独自享受一场清凉的沐浴……当然，是独自享受啦。他轻笑了一声：“不，[pc.name]，我并不参与那种性行为，即使参与了也不会是正式的场合。尽管凯特对我破例允许我继续留在寺庙里，但萨尔瓦对我一直留在那里已经感到非常不满了。”
        |寺庙里发生的这些事情是否让他分心，无法专心工作呢？

“有时候，如果有人把香料厅的门敞开着，烟味就会飘进来，这确实很烦人。至于寺庙里的其他活动……这些墙很厚，所以声音的传播效果应该不太好。我想，这是设计上的考虑吧。”

“你明白我的意思吧。”

达里乌斯微笑着敲了敲自己的额头：“没错，你确实明白。不过说真的，这更多是取决于一个人的心态，而不是其他什么因素。是的，按照霜之鳞的判断标准，我确实还很年轻，但这座寺庙这个角落里的氛围与其他地方截然不同。我确实有一些需求……但还有其他一些需求，对我来说，它们远比周围发生的一切都要吸引人得多。凡事都有例外，但“眼不见心不烦”，这句话确实很有道理。
        |说实话，我对这座寺庙的建筑风格非常感兴趣。巴纳福斯告诉我，在加斯的人来到这里并为凯特修复这个地方之前，这里原本是一处苍白精灵的遗迹。”

没错。在那之前，恶魔崇拜者一直占据着这些废墟，不过尽管已经被废弃了这么久，这些建筑依然出奇地坚固。如果经过这么多年的使用，这些支撑结构仍然不够坚固，那就必须更换它们了，否则加斯的手下也就无法在这些支撑结构的基础上继续进行建造了。

“嗯，嗯。尽管这些建筑采用了贾西兰的风格，但淡色精灵们最初的辉煌风格在它们的建筑风格中依然得以体现。将这样的废墟重新修复成这样，真是太了不起了，简直给它注入了新的生命。”

如果你没有记错的话，巴尼亲自监督了这项建筑工程。

“啊！”达里乌斯打了个响指，“原来如此，这样就说得通了。巴纳福斯一直对古老建筑很感兴趣，尤其是那个时期的建筑——事实上，他在霍克斯通城堡里待的时间远远超出了他所能找到的各种借口所能解释的范围。但如果真的是他在指挥建筑工人们的话，那么最终呈现出这种融合了淡雅的精灵风格与贾西兰风格的独特建筑风格，也就不足为奇了。"
        |这座寺庙的空间非常大，”达里乌斯说道，“感觉它是为了容纳更多人而建造的……”

而且，这还是一座经过翻新的苍白精灵寺庙，在它最鼎盛的时期，肯定曾经容纳过许多德鲁伊。

“没错，没错。让这座寺庙得到充分利用，或许是她一生的事业目标，但我相信，凭借她的决心和奉献精神，她最终一定能够实现这个目标。
        
        [party.has cait
            |我真的不太清楚，”凯特摇着头说，“这听起来似乎还很遥远……”

“不过，千万不要低估自己的能力。
            
        ]
        嗯，你对凯特有着十足的信任，相信她一定能完成这件事——即使不是为了卡拉和她父亲，也一定是出于对她的信任。

“不过，在这段时间里，那些宽敞而空荡的大厅确实挺有吸引力的，尤其是当我独自待在里面的时候。听到自己的脚步声在空气中回荡……生活在这些被修复的废墟中，也确实有一种特别的滋味，不是吗？
        |我从来没想过在这样的地方竟然会有自来水，但事实就是如此。至少这对洗澡来说非常方便——在贾西兰的神庙里，很多浴池都是需要人工排水和注水的。可以想象，在那里水确实是一种非常珍贵的资源。坦白说，你自己也觉得这相当令人惊讶吧。”

“对于那些了解马奇地区地质情况的人来说，温泉其实是非常常见的现象——贝尔哈兰人在东北部地区建造了一座规模相当大的度假胜地，当地人把那个地方叫做‘风啸峰’。这些天没人会去那里，因为那里到处都是鹰身女妖。不过，无论是否经过加热处理，承压含水层其实遍布整个地区。如果水不是自动流动的，我相信巴纳福斯肯定会为他亲爱的女儿的神庙安装一台螺旋泵之类的设备。不过就目前的情况来看，这种自动供水系统确实为萨尔瓦在清理那个地方时节省了很多时间。"
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    [rand
        |"Quite well, actually. Like I think I've mentioned before, it really does bring back all the best parts of my life back in Jassira while hiding the worst. I have a clean living space, Salwah is a decent cook, and my days are calm and routine. From the perspective of someone who was a slave as a boy, such simple pleasures are sufficient for my needs."
        
        He doesn't partake of the temple's, uh, other activities?
        
        "You mean the poetry recital? I attend because Barnaphous does, and his company turns any event pleasant."
        
        No... 
        
        "Or perhaps you mean when River comes up to the temple to perform?"
        
        No... 
        
        "Well, I avoid the spice hall as much as I can. I'm not a catfolk, so it really doesn't do anything for me, and while spice tea is one thing all the heavy smoke and clink of spice plates isn't my style."
        
        Now you're thinking he's being obtuse on purpose.
        
        "The sacred whores and orgies aren't the point of the temple, although they do make up the lion's share of its notoriety. As far as temple activities go, though, I'm partial to being able to have a nice cold bath. By myself, of course." He chuckles. "No, [pc.name], I don't partake of the sex, and if I were to it wouldn't be on a formal basis. Salwah is already miffed enough at my continued presence in the temple, despite Caitriss making an exception for me."
        |Do the goings-on in the temple distract him from his work?
        
        "Sometimes, a whiff of smoke does creep in from the spice hall if someone leaves the door open. That's quite annoying. As for the temple's other activities... the walls are thick, and they don't carry sound that well. By design, I'd imagine."
        
        You see.
        
        Darius smiles and taps his forehead. "Yes, you see. Seriously, though — it's more a matter of one's frame of mind, than anything. Yes, I'm still young as frostscales reckon things, but the atmosphere here in this little corner of the temple is considerably different than the rest of it. I have needs, to be sure... but there are other needs, too, which I find far more fascinating than the other things going on around me. There are exceptions, as with anything, but out of sight, out of mind."
        |"Frankly, I'm quite interested in the temple's architecture. Barnaphous tells me that this used to be a pale elf ruin before Garth's people came in and fixed up the place for Cait."
        
        That's right. Before that, the demon cult had been squatting in the rubble, and even so it was surprisingly sturdy for having been abandoned so long. If the supports weren't sturdy after all those decades, they'd have to be replaced, and Garth's people wouldn't have been able to build around them.
        
        "Hm, hm. Despite the Jassiran trappings, the original splendour of the pale elves still manages to shine through in its architectural style. It's a marvelous rehabilitation of such a ruin, a fresh breath of air."
        
        Barney personally oversaw the construction work, if you remember correctly.
        
        "Ah!" Darius snaps his fingers. "That would explain it, yes. Barnaphous always had an interest in old architecture, especially of that period — he spends far too long up at Castle Hawkstone than what his pretexts cover for, really. But if he was the one directing the builders, it doesn't surprise me that the rather quaint blend of pale elf and Jassiran aesthetics was the result."
        |"There's a lot of space in this temple," Darius remarks. "It feels like it was built with the intention of accommodating many more people..."
        
        That, and it's a refurbished pale elf temple, which no doubt housed many druids in its heyday.
        
        "Yes, yes. It may be the matron's entire life's work to see it utilised to its maximum capacity, but I'm sure that given her drive and dedication, it'll eventually get done."
        
        [party.has cait
            |"I don't know about that, really," Cait says with a shake of her head. "It seems so far off..."
            
            "Now, don't undersell yourself."
            
        ]
        Hmm, you have perfect faith in Cait to get it done — for Calla and her dad, if not for her faith.
        
        "In the meantime, though, the vast, empty halls are quite fetching, especially when I have the pleasure of being alone in them. Hearing my footsteps echo... there's something to living in a restored ruin, isn't there?"
        |"I'd never have imagined that there'd be running water in such a place, but here we are. It's good for the baths, if nothing else — many of the baths in Jassiran temples have to be manually drained and filled by hand. Water is a precious commodity over there, as you'd imagine."
        
        Frankly, you found it quite surprising yourself.
        
        "For those who know the geology of the Marches, hot springs are quite commonplace — the Belharans built quite the grand resort up to the northeast, in what the locals call the Windy Peaks. No one goes there these days, what with it being overrun with harpies, but pressurised aquifers, whether heated or not, are all over the lay of the land. If the water weren't flowing on its own, I'm sure Barnaphous would have built a screw pump or something for his dear daughter's temple, but as things stand it really does save Salwah a lot of time when scrubbing the place out."
    ]
    "

rows.translation: 寺庙

rows.original: [rand |"Several of the volumes Barnaphous has here [flags.CARMEN_KILLED|were taken from the former baroness's collection|are on loan from the baroness's private collection]. They've been preserved very well, but judging by their age they may very well predate the Godswar. The palace library at Tychris has several similar volumes — I think they'd be extremely interested in what might lie in Castle Hawkstone if they knew of this. Happily, I see no reason to inform them of this fact — I do like this little village too much to have the Order Astrida tromping through the streets and making a mess of it." Well, he has your thanks for that. "After everything I've been through in my youth prior to meeting Barnaphous, I'm well aware of the value of a little peace and quiet. I wouldn't want to take it away from them because... well, for no good reason, really." |"For such a rural village, Hawkethorne's actually quite populous. Looking at the town square or marketplace, you'd imagine that you were in a town twice, or perhaps thrice its size!" Well, the recent troubles have encouraged a lot of people to flee upwards from Harvest Valley and seek refuge behind the village's palisades. While it doesn't seem like Hawkethorne's infrastructure has been painfully stretched thin yet, this can't go on forever.[flags.CQ_CLEAR| Even though the centaurs have settled down somewhat and are starting to reestablish some kind of order in the valley, people understandably are still quite reluctant to be the first to return to their old homesteads.|] "Most of the people I saw at the market weren't living in the village proper, too..." Yeah, they were most likely from out of town, too. Even if this is the frontier and taking the recent troubles into account, a lot of people are scattered all over the region and just make use of Hawkethorne's amenities when they need to. Is this all something new to him? "Not really. I just didn't expect the effect to be so... pronounced. I suppose it's because Jassira and Tronarii have been settled for such a long while that there's really no real frontier there. Sure, there're skirmish lines between centaur and orc raiders hiding in the sands, but it's not a frontier in the sense it is here. That, and I mostly stayed in Tychris after returning to this part of the world." Hmm... "Hmm, indeed. I personally find the history of this place quite fascinating, what with the village being built on the shell of the former town of the same name, razed two centuries or so prior. Barnaphous has certainly been absolutely fascinated by the architecture of various buildings such as the local chapel; if you don't watch him closely, he'll end up trying to organise a dig beneath the village itself!" |"The history of this village is quite fascinating, when you dig down into it. Belhar had quite the reach here even on the frontier, and the remnants of their handiwork still persist in the form of roads, watchtowers, and other infrastructure. The village, as well as the castle above, were once a far-flung barony; the main reason why anyone who was anyone in Belhar came up here was to enjoy the pleasures of the bath house they built up north over a rather large set of hot springs." Hot springs, he says. Darius nods. "The entire region is dotted with aquifers from accumulated snowmelt, which can be under considerable pressure. Combined with the high thermal activity of the region, it's unsurprising that there are many such springs, geysers and pools in the Marches; local peoples such as the native lupine tribes and frostscale salamanders have exploited them in various manners. However, when it came to the Belharan dignitaries, their primary purpose in the region was to seek rest and relaxation away from the imperial heartlands. I can't say I understand it myself, but there's supposedly something relaxing about being warm and comfortable while it's bitterly cold outside. The cold-hot treatment was supposed to be beneficial for one's health back in the day... "The ruins of those baths are supposedly still up there in the windy peaks beyond Khor'minos, although with the city under quarantine and the roads closed I'm not getting up there to look myself. Not that I would have the time with this particular scientific endeavor going on, of course." |"No, I don't head down into the town very often, save while on errands for Barnaphous. I've got everything I need up here — food, a comfortable place to rest, and I find a quiet evening talking with Barnaphous or some of the temple's more mundane entertainments more relaxing and stimulating than spending a miserable time amongst people I don't know. Sometimes, River comes up here and has a small performance for the temple's petitioners, and that's more than enough for variety." Yeah, you understand where he's coming from and won't force him to move out of his comfort zone if he doesn't want to. You just thought it might be better for him get to know the local people, since he's going to be staying here for some time. "The thought is appreciated, really, but I just don't see the need for it. Now, there're one or two exceptions, to be sure, but they're just that, exceptions. It's crowded, noisy, and more than a little too dirty for my tastes. All of the above, I promised myself I would do my utmost not to suffer the indignity of when I left my second owner." Ah... "The temple is quiet, spacious and clean. Just my style. The walls muffle the untoward noises that're part of being a Mallachite establishment, and Salwah keeps the place spotless out of necessity, if nothing else. I am truly blessed to be able to work and live in such an environment with the temple matron's permission, and see no reason to give that up for a so-called romp on the town." |"You know, [pc.name], when I look at the town below, I can't help but think it's got potential." Potential for what? Darius scratches his chin at that. "Potential to be something more, I'd say. I'm not sure exactly what — that remains to be seen — but I don't imagine that it'll stay as a simple little frontier village, not with the people who're converging upon it. Not all of them are necessarily good for any definition of the word you care to use, but they're most certainly driven. And when you have a lot of that kind of energy in one place, it tries to put itself to use, one way or another. Such is the nature of energy, yes?" You remember thinking that Hawkethorne was quite the sleepy hollow when you were caught up here during the blizzard. Yeah, that's changed a bit since then. "Local word has it that you were quite instrumental in bringing a number of faces to the village, so you get credit for that. A talent scout for the town, to put it simply if awkwardly." That's true... "Like Barnaphous is fond of saying, knowing the right people opens many doors that would otherwise have remained shut. This doesn't necessarily have to be in a sinister sense... if the town can muster up enough drive, resources and expertise to refurbish this place in a scant ten days, imagine what could be done with greater organisation and a wider variety of skillsets. Despite their inhospitable appearance, the Marches have always been rich in their natural bounty — all it's always lacked are the people with the drive, know-how and temperament to utilise them to the fullest degree. The minotaurs and my own people have come further than most, but still so much of the land is untapped. "Now that Caitriss has set down roots here, I do believe that Barnaphous wants that to change, and if he is for it, so am I. Certainly a more stable Marches would mean a better deal for Tychris and the frostscales as a whole, allowing us to put more resources to rebuilding rather than fighting to keep the proverbial wolves at bay." ]
rows.translation: [rand |巴纳福斯这里收藏的这几卷书籍[flags.CARMEN_KILLED|这些藏品是从那位前女男爵的收藏中提取出来的。|这些物品是从男爵夫人的私人收藏中借来的。]这些文献保存得非常好，但根据它们的年代来看，很可能是《神战》发生之前的产物。在提克里斯的皇宫图书馆里，也有几本类似的书籍——我想，如果他们知道这些文献的存在，一定会对霍克斯通城堡里可能藏有的东西感到非常感兴趣。幸运的是，我觉得没有必要把这件事告诉他们——我实在太喜欢这个小村庄了，实在不想让阿斯特里达骑士团在街上横冲直撞，把这里弄得一片混乱。 嗯，他应该为此感谢你才对。 在遇到巴纳福斯之前，我年轻时经历了许多事情，因此我非常明白宁静与安宁的珍贵。我实在不想剥夺他们这些东西……嗯，其实也没有任何理由要这么做。 |对于这样一个偏远的乡村来说，鹰棘镇的实际人口数量已经相当可观了。只要看看镇上的广场或市场，你就会觉得自己仿佛置身于一个规模是其两倍甚至三倍的城镇里！” 嗯，最近发生的一些麻烦事确实促使很多人从丰收谷逃往这里，来到这个村庄的防御围栏后面寻求庇护。虽然目前看来鹰棘镇的基础设施还没有出现严重的紧张状况，但这种局面总不能永远持续下去吧。[flags.CQ_CLEAR| 尽管半人马们已经逐渐安定下来，开始在山谷中重建某种秩序，但人们仍然很不愿意率先回到他们昔日的家园，这也是可以理解的。|] 我在市场上看到的大多数人其实并不住在那个村庄里……” 是啊，他们很可能也是来自外地的人。尽管这里地处边疆，而且最近也发生了一些麻烦事，但很多人其实分散在这个地区的各个地方，只有在需要的时候才会利用鹰棘镇所提供的便利设施。这对他来说都是新鲜事吗？ “其实并不是。我只是没有预料到效果会如此明显……我想，这是因为贾西拉和特洛纳里已经安定生活了这么久，那里已经真正没有了边界和界限了。确实，半人马与隐藏在沙丘中的兽人掠夺者之间存在着零星的冲突，但那里并不像这里这样是一片边境地带。另外，我回到这个世界这个区域之后，大部分时间都待在提克里斯。 嗯……确实如此。我个人觉得这个地方的历史非常有趣，因为这个村庄是建立在大约两百年前被毁的同一个名字的旧城镇的遗址之上。巴纳福斯对这里的各种建筑风格简直着迷不已，比如当地的教堂；如果你不密切关注他的动向，他甚至会试图在村庄下面进行挖掘呢！" |这个村庄的历史其实相当有趣，当你深入探究其中的时候就会发现。在边境地区，贝尔哈尔的影响力曾经相当广泛，他们留下的痕迹至今依然存在，比如那些道路、瞭望塔以及其他基础设施。这个村庄以及上面的城堡，曾经是一个偏远的领地；对于贝尔哈尔那些有地位的人来说，来到这里的主要目的，就是去享受他们在北方那片温泉地带建造的浴场所带来的便利与乐趣。 温泉，”他说。 达里乌斯点了点头：“整个地区都分布着由融雪积聚而成的含水层，这些含水层往往承受着巨大的压力。再加上这一地区地热活动十分活跃，因此在这里出现许多这样的温泉、间歇泉和温泉池也就不足为奇了。当地的原住民，比如那些狼族部落和霜鳞蝾螈，早就以各种方式利用这些自然资源了。然而，对于那些来自贝尔哈兰的贵族们来说，他们来到这个地区的主要目的，就是为了在远离帝国中心地带的地方享受宁静与放松。我自己也不太能理解这种做法，但据说，在外面天气严寒的时候，能够处于温暖舒适的环境中，确实会让人感到放松。在过去，这种冷热交替的疗法被认为对健康有益…… 据说，那些浴场的遗迹仍然存在于科尔米诺斯之外的那些多风的山峰之中。不过由于这座城市正处于隔离状态，道路也被封闭了，所以我并没有去那里亲自查看。当然，考虑到目前正在进行这项重要的科学研究，我也没有时间去那里。 |不，我并不经常去镇上，除非是去为巴纳福斯办事。我在这里什么都不缺——有食物，也有舒适的地方休息。我觉得，和一个叫巴纳福斯的朋友安静地聊聊天，或者享受寺庙里一些简单的娱乐活动，比和那些我不认识的人待在一起要轻松得多，也更有意义。有时候，瑞弗会来到这里，为寺庙里的祈求者们表演一些小节目，这样就已经足够让气氛变得丰富多彩了。 是啊，你明白他的想法，所以如果他不愿意，你也不会强迫他走出自己的舒适区。你只是觉得，既然他要在这里待一段时间，让他了解一下当地人可能会对他有好处。 “这个想法确实很周到，但我就是不觉得有必要这样做。需要确实，也有一两个例外情况，但那些只不过是例外而已。那里太拥挤、太吵闹了，而且卫生状况也远远不符合我的口味。对于以上这些情况，我曾向自己承诺，一定要竭尽全力，避免在离开第二任主人时遭受这种屈辱。啊……” “这座寺庙非常安静、宽敞且整洁，正是我喜欢的风格。墙壁能够有效隔绝那些在马拉克信徒场所中不可避免会出现的嘈杂声，而萨尔瓦也总是把这里保持得一尘不染——至少是出于必要吧。能够得到寺院女主人的允许，在这样的环境中工作和生活，我真是感到无比幸运。我认为，没有理由为了所谓的“城里玩乐”而放弃这一切。 |你知道，[pc.name]，当我俯瞰下面的小镇时，我不由得觉得它具备某种潜力。” “具备什么潜力呢？” 达里厄斯挠了挠下巴，说道：“我觉得它有潜力变成别的什么。不过我也不太确定具体会变成什么。什么 — 这还有待观察 — 但我认为，随着越来越多的人聚集到这里，这个地方不可能继续保持一个简单的小边疆村庄的状态。虽然他们中并不是所有人都符合你所使用的任何定义中的“好人”标准，但他们确实都充满了动力。当这么多这样的能量聚集在同一个地方时，它们总会以某种方式被释放出来。能量的本质就是这样的，对吧？ 你还记得在暴风雪中被困在这里时，觉得鹰棘镇这个地方真是太偏僻、太安静了。是啊，从那以后，这里确实发生了一些变化。 “当地人都说，你在为这个村庄吸引更多人驻留方面发挥了重要作用，因此你应该得到肯定。简单来说，你可以被看作是这个小镇的‘人才发掘者’吧。 确实如此……正如巴纳福斯常说的那样，结识合适的人脉能够打开许多原本会紧闭的大门。这并不一定意味着有什么阴险的意图……如果这个小镇能够集结足够的动力、资源和专业知识，在短短十天内修复这个地方，那么想象一下，如果能够有更完善的组织安排和更多样化的技能支持，还能取得什么样的成就吧。尽管这些地区看起来并不宜居住，但它们的自然资源其实非常丰富——一直以来，所缺乏的只是那些具备决心、专业知识以及合适性格的人，来将这些资源充分开发利用。弥诺陶洛斯族和我的族人已经取得了不小的进展，但仍有大片土地尚未被开发。 既然凯特丽丝已经在这里安了家，我确实认为巴纳福斯并不希望这种情况继续下去。如果他支持改变现状，那我也会支持。一个更加稳定的环境对于蒂克里斯以及整个霜之族来说无疑是有益的，这样我们就可以把更多的资源用于重建，而不是耗费精力去抵御那些所谓的‘狼群’了。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Several of the volumes Barnaphous has here [flags.CARMEN_KILLED|were taken from the former baroness's collection|are on loan from the baroness's private collection]. They've been preserved very well, but judging by their age they may very well predate the Godswar. The palace library at Tychris has several similar volumes — I think they'd be extremely interested in what might lie in Castle Hawkstone if they knew of this. Happily, I see no reason to inform them of this fact — I do like this little village too much to have the Order Astrida tromping through the streets and making a mess of it." Well, he has your thanks for that. "After everything I've been through in my youth prior to meeting Barnaphous, I'm well aware of the value of a little peace and quiet. I wouldn't want to take it away from them because... well, for no good reason, really." |"For such a rural village, Hawkethorne's actually quite populous. Looking at the town square or marketplace, you'd imagine that you were in a town twice, or perhaps thrice its size!" Well, the recent troubles have encouraged a lot of people to flee upwards from Harvest Valley and seek refuge behind the village's palisades. While it doesn't seem like Hawkethorne's infrastructure has been painfully stretched thin yet, this can't go on forever.[flags.CQ_CLEAR| Even though the centaurs have settled down somewhat and are starting to reestablish some kind of order in the valley, people understandably are still quite reluctant to be the first to return to their old homesteads.|] "Most of the people I saw at the market weren't living in the village proper, too..." Yeah, they were most likely from out of town, too. Even if this is the frontier and taking the recent troubles into account, a lot of people are scattered all over the region and just make use of Hawkethorne's amenities when they need to. Is this all something new to him? "Not really. I just didn't expect the effect to be so... pronounced. I suppose it's because Jassira and Tronarii have been settled for such a long while that there's really no real frontier there. Sure, there're skirmish lines between centaur and orc raiders hiding in the sands, but it's not a frontier in the sense it is here. That, and I mostly stayed in Tychris after returning to this part of the world." Hmm... "Hmm, indeed. I personally find the history of this place quite fascinating, what with the village being built on the shell of the former town of the same name, razed two centuries or so prior. Barnaphous has certainly been absolutely fascinated by the architecture of various buildings such as the local chapel; if you don't watch him closely, he'll end up trying to organise a dig beneath the village itself!" |"The history of this village is quite fascinating, when you dig down into it. Belhar had quite the reach here even on the frontier, and the remnants of their handiwork still persist in the form of roads, watchtowers, and other infrastructure. The village, as well as the castle above, were once a far-flung barony; the main reason why anyone who was anyone in Belhar came up here was to enjoy the pleasures of the bath house they built up north over a rather large set of hot springs." Hot springs, he says. Darius nods. "The entire region is dotted with aquifers from accumulated snowmelt, which can be under considerable pressure. Combined with the high thermal activity of the region, it's unsurprising that there are many such springs, geysers and pools in the Marches; local peoples such as the native lupine tribes and frostscale salamanders have exploited them in various manners. However, when it came to the Belharan dignitaries, their primary purpose in the region was to seek rest and relaxation away from the imperial heartlands. I can't say I understand it myself, but there's supposedly something relaxing about being warm and comfortable while it's bitterly cold outside. The cold-hot treatment was supposed to be beneficial for one's health back in the day... "The ruins of those baths are supposedly still up there in the windy peaks beyond Khor'minos, although with the city under quarantine and the roads closed I'm not getting up there to look myself. Not that I would have the time with this particular scientific endeavor going on, of course." |"No, I don't head down into the town very often, save while on errands for Barnaphous. I've got everything I need up here — food, a comfortable place to rest, and I find a quiet evening talking with Barnaphous or some of the temple's more mundane entertainments more relaxing and stimulating than spending a miserable time amongst people I don't know. Sometimes, River comes up here and has a small performance for the temple's petitioners, and that's more than enough for variety." Yeah, you understand where he's coming from and won't force him to move out of his comfort zone if he doesn't want to. You just thought it might be better for him get to know the local people, since he's going to be staying here for some time. "The thought is appreciated, really, but I just don't see the need for it. Now, there're one or two exceptions, to be sure, but they're just that, exceptions. It's crowded, noisy, and more than a little too dirty for my tastes. All of the above, I promised myself I would do my utmost not to suffer the indignity of when I left my second owner." Ah... "The temple is quiet, spacious and clean. Just my style. The walls muffle the untoward noises that're part of being a Mallachite establishment, and Salwah keeps the place spotless out of necessity, if nothing else. I am truly blessed to be able to work and live in such an environment with the temple matron's permission, and see no reason to give that up for a so-called romp on the town." |"You know, [pc.name], when I look at the town below, I can't help but think it's got potential." Potential for what? Darius scratches his chin at that. "Potential to be something more, I'd say. I'm not sure exactly what — that remains to be seen — but I don't imagine that it'll stay as a simple little frontier village, not with the people who're converging upon it. Not all of them are necessarily good for any definition of the word you care to use, but they're most certainly driven. And when you have a lot of that kind of energy in one place, it tries to put itself to use, one way or another. Such is the nature of energy, yes?" You remember thinking that Hawkethorne was quite the sleepy hollow when you were caught up here during the blizzard. Yeah, that's changed a bit since then. "Local word has it that you were quite instrumental in bringing a number of faces to the village, so you get credit for that. A talent scout for the town, to put it simply if awkwardly." That's true... "Like Barnaphous is fond of saying, knowing the right people opens many doors that would otherwise have remained shut. This doesn't necessarily have to be in a sinister sense... if the town can muster up enough drive, resources and expertise to refurbish this place in a scant ten days, imagine what could be done with greater organisation and a wider variety of skillsets. Despite their inhospitable appearance, the Marches have always been rich in their natural bounty — all it's always lacked are the people with the drive, know-how and temperament to utilise them to the fullest degree. The minotaurs and my own people have come further than most, but still so much of the land is untapped. "Now that Caitriss has set down roots here, I do believe that Barnaphous wants that to change, and if he is for it, so am I. Certainly a more stable Marches would mean a better deal for Tychris and the frostscales as a whole, allowing us to put more resources to rebuilding rather than fighting to keep the proverbial wolves at bay." ] "

rows.translation: 鹰棘镇

rows.original: [rand |At the mention of the bubbly catgirl, Darius breaks into a small smile. "Ah! Yes, Rune. Truth be told, I hadn't expected to see her here of all places. It's truly as if someone's guiding everyone who is anyone to this remote corner of the world, but whether it be by divine providence or sheer dumb luck, I'm glad to have one of my old friends around." They go back some ways, do they? The 'mander nods. "When I was first traveling with Barnaphous. We ran into her a few times and had some adventures — nothing too grand, really, but they were still fun. Rune's carefree nature is certainly one for keeping morale together; just seeing her face after a long, fruitless day lifts the spirits. I'm sure that just having her around the temple is going to attract more petitioners than there would be otherwise, and I'm glad that she's going to be staying here for the foreseeable future." |"You may imagine that Rune's head may be empty, but she's actually quite smart." Oh, really? Because every indicator has pointed to the distinct possibility that the lovely catgirl in question is just a silly bimbo, for all of her cheery nature. "Well, you see, all those brains of hers are whirring away just fine, they're just tuned towards seeking out the next act of copulation, or engaging in it. When she's given suitable encouragement, Rune can actually be quite brilliant." So... she's not stupid, she just constantly has sex on her mind. "Yes." And that makes her act in ways that are completely indistinguishable from if she were stupid. "Yes." What's the meaningful difference there, then? "None whatsoever." There's a moment's silence, and then at last, Darius bursts out laughing. "Ah, I was just teasing you, [pc.name]. Rune really is just a silly bimbo. Nothing wrong with that; it takes all kinds to make a world. Still, I was wondering if I could make you buy that excuse, as outlandish as it was." |"I've grown to consider Rune as a step-sister of mine. We've been through a lot together back in the day, and she used to drop in on me from time to time when she was in the general vicinity of Tychris. That she'll be staying in the area for the foreseeable future is pretty good news for me, although I do hope that familiarity won't breed contempt in this case." It must be good for them to be that close. "Tell me about it. I suppose one of the things I missed due to my childhood as a slave was actually having a family to call my own. I know, I know, I'm not expecting it to be all clear water and roses, but at the same time I thought I had a chance at it with my second owner, whom I thought was genuinely fond of me. Then, hearing about Barnaphous speaking of his daughters like that... I don't know. Nearly having it myself, and hearing about how good it could be really made me want what I didn't have, never had, and Rune just happened to come along at the right time to fill that need in the most perfect way possible." So, does he dote on Rune in the way that a big brother should? "Absolutely, doting and teasing alike. You know, maybe it's better this way despite everything I had to go through as a kid — being able to pick Barnaphous for a father and Rune as a sister is something I can treasure when most people don't get to choose their family." |"One of the things I'm constantly worried about is Rune wandering in here when both Barnaphous and I are out of the laboratory, as rare as that might be. One of the first things she wanted out of me was to see the place, so I obliged and showed her — " Why? "Well, not showing her would only have made her even more determined to get inside. The allure of forbidden fruit and all that, you understand. Typically, the temple matron's private quarters are off-limits, but Rune has a habit of getting into places where she doesn't belong. While it's been useful in the past, now it just makes me worry." Darius scratches the back of his head. "That she might accidentally get sucked up into the portal and wind up wherever Calla was taken is the least of what could happen should things go awry, which should tell you something about the danger of what we're working with." Well, if you do see Rune trying to sneak into Cait's rooms when he's not around, you'll be sure to tell her off. "That would be appreciated, thank you very much." |"Rune seems happy here. She was never quite at home when she was with me and Barnaphous — that was part of why she was traveling in the first place — be it in Jassira or Tronarii, but the fact that she's given serious thought to the idea of settling down here is quite heartening. The temple combines all the best parts of my past while being distant enough from the less savoury bits, and I think the same goes for her, too." The frontier is traditionally a place where people have gone to escape from their pasts, yes. "Well, I wouldn't call it escaping." Darius coughs nervously. "More a matter of finding a place where you're comfortable and at home, and this is it. Like me, she's really enjoying her work here, and the novelty hasn't faded yet, if it ever will. It certainly doesn't hurt to have another kitten to help look after the place when Caitriss is out adventuring with you." ]
rows.translation: [rand |一提到那个活泼的猫娘，达里乌斯便微微一笑。“啊！对，露恩。说实话，我完全没料到会在这种地方遇见她。真像是有人把所有有头有脸的人都引到了世界这个偏远的角落，不过不管是神意还是纯粹的运气，能有位老朋友在身边，我很高兴。” 看来他们认识挺久了？ 那个火蜥蜴人点了点头。“我最初和巴纳福斯一起旅行那会儿。我们碰上过她几次，一起经历了些冒险——其实没什么了不起的，但确实挺有趣。露恩那无忧无虑的性子最能维系士气；忙碌无果的一天之后，只要看到她的脸就让人精神一振。我敢说，光是有她在寺庙里，就能招来比平时更多的求助者。我很高兴她在可预见的将来都会留在这里。” |“你也许觉得露恩的脑袋空空如也，可其实她相当聪明。” 哦，是吗？因为所有迹象都表明，那位可爱的猫娘尽管性子开朗，却很可能只是个傻乎乎的蠢妞。 “嗯，你看，她那些脑子转得好好的，只是全都用来琢磨下一次交配，或者直接去做那档子事了。只要给她适当的鼓励，露恩其实可以非常聪明。” 所以……她不是傻，只是满脑子都想着做爱。 “没错。” 而这让她表现得和一个真正的傻子完全没什么两样。 “是的。” 那么，这两者之间到底有什么实质性的区别？ “完全没有。”沉默了片刻，达里乌斯终于放声大笑。“啊，我只是在逗你，[pc.name]。露恩确实就是个傻乎乎的蠢妞。这没什么不好；世界正是由形形色色的人才成其为世界。不过，我倒是想知道，这么离谱的借口能不能让你信以为真。” |“我已经渐渐把露恩当成我的义妹了。当年我们一起经历过很多事，那时候她只要到提克里斯附近，就会时不时来看我。她会在可预见的将来留在这一带，对我来说是个好消息，不过我也希望，这份熟稔不会带来轻慢。” 他们能这么亲近，一定是件好事。 “可不是嘛。我想，因为童年身为奴隶，我错过的东西之一就是拥有一个真正属于自己的家。我知道，我知道，我并不指望一切都风平浪静、美满如意，但那时我以为，我的第二任主人是真心喜欢我的，所以我以为自己有机会拥有一个家。可后来，听到巴纳福斯那样谈起他的女儿们……我说不清。差一点就能拥有，又听说了那能有多好，让我格外渴望那些我没有、也从未有过的东西；而露恩恰好在恰当的时候出现，以最完美的方式填补了这份空缺。” 那么，他是否像兄长该做的那样宠爱露恩呢？ “当然，既宠爱又逗弄。你知道，尽管我小时候吃了那么多苦，也许这样反而更好——能自己挑选巴纳福斯做父亲、露恩做妹妹，而大多数人根本没机会选择自己的家人，这份幸运我会好好珍惜。” |“我一直很担心的一件事是，露恩会在巴纳福斯和我都不在实验室的时候溜进来，尽管这种情况很少见。她最早向我提出的要求之一就是想看看这个地方，所以我答应了，带她参观了一番——” 为什么？ “嗯，不给她看，只会让她更下定决心要进去。禁果的诱惑什么的，你懂的。通常来说，寺庙女主管的私人住处是禁止外人进入的，可露恩总有办法钻进她不该去的地方。过去这还挺有用，现在却只让我担心。”达里乌斯挠了挠后脑勺。“万一事情出了岔子，她不小心被吸进传送门、落到卡拉被带去的地方，这还算是后果最轻的一种——由此可见我们摆弄的东西有多危险。” 好吧，如果你在凯特不在的时候看到露恩想溜进他的房间，你可一定要说说她。 “那就太好了，非常感谢。” |“露恩在这里看起来很开心。她跟我和巴纳福斯在一起时，从来都没真正有过家的感觉——这也是她当初外出旅行的原因之一——无论是在贾西拉还是特洛纳里，但她认真考虑过在这里安顿下来，这让我很欣慰。这座寺庙汇集了我过去所有最美好的部分，又离那些不那么美好的部分足够远；我想对她来说也是如此。” 边境历来就是人们逃离过去的地方，没错。 “嗯，我不会说那是逃离。”达里乌斯紧张地咳了一声。“更像是找一个让自己自在、有归属感的地方，而这里就是。她和我一样，真的很喜欢在这里的工作，新鲜感还没消退，也许永远都不会消退。再说，凯特丽丝跟你外出冒险时，多一只小猫帮忙照看这里，当然也没什么坏处。” ]

rows.original:
"Oh?" Darius coughs, his voice suddenly a little more nervous. "Well, they're a group of Narevan paladins. Kind of secretive, and they all have black scales, which is why we call them 'gothmanders' when they're not in earshot."
    
    He sounds apprehensive all of a sudden... 
    
    "Well, their job is to seek out evil magicians like the kind who caused the Godswar and all. Put a stop to them and their schemes before too much damage is done. I can understand why they'd be interested in the portal — under the right conditions, it is a font of incredible magical power, and I wouldn't want that falling into the wrong hands."
    
    Does he report to them?
    
    "I'm not so blessed to be in the order and they don't run the palace library, if that's what you're asking. I don't draw my salary or funding from them; that comes by the grace of the en Tychris line."
    
    But if they make a request, he hops to it... 
    
    "Justifiably so, and with the blessing of the head archivist, so there's no conflict of interest there. To be honest, they're kind of cool. Every so often they have a parade in the palace square, especially when they've caught some troublemaker and want to make an example of the poor fool. Everyone in Tychris respects the Order Astrida."
    
    Anything else he can tell you?
    
    Darius shrugs. "That's about as much as I know. If you want more, you'll have to ask one of them, or even better, the goddess herself. Now wouldn't that be a treat, ha!"
    
    [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED|Maybe|You see]. Well, thanks for his explanation. Perhaps you could discuss another topic?

哦？”达里乌斯轻咳了一声，声音突然变得有些紧张。“嗯，他们是一群纳雷万的圣骑士。他们行事比较隐秘，而且每个人的皮肤上都有黑色的鳞片，因此当他们不在我们能听到的范围内时，我们就称他们为‘哥特曼德’。”  
    
    他的语气突然变得有些忧心忡忡…… 
    
    嗯，他们的职责就是寻找那些像引发‘神战’那样的邪恶法师，阻止他们继续实施阴谋，以免造成更大的破坏。我能够理解他们为什么会对那个传送门感兴趣——在适当的条件下，它确实能释放出强大的魔法力量，而我绝对不希望它落入坏人之手部。
    
    他需要向他们汇报工作吗？

    不过，如果他们提出了要求，他肯定会照做…… 
    
    这是完全合理的，而且得到了首席档案管理员的批准，所以不存在任何利益冲突。说实话，他们还挺不错的。每隔一段时间，他们就会在宫殿广场上举行游行，尤其是当他们抓到某个捣乱者时，就会利用这个机会来惩戒那个愚蠢的家伙。在提克里斯，每个人都非常尊重阿斯特里达骑士团。

    达里乌斯耸了耸肩：“我就知道这些了。如果你想了解更多，就得去问他们中的某个人，或者更好的办法是，直接去问女神本人。那该多有趣啊，哈哈！

rows.original: Darius raises an eyebrow when you pop the question. "You're seriously offering to help me out?" Well, it's not just for him — it's for Barney and Cait, too. You don't feel like adventuring for the rest of the day, yet don't want to laze around for that time, so you might as well be productive in other ways. The 'mander mage contemplates you for a moment, then sighs and nods. "Well, I can't say you're unqualified for the task, so you won't get in the way. But research isn't as glamorous as the legends of Estelore make it out to be — it's mostly long, boring and involves a lot of drudgery. If you're willing to lend a hand, then I'm fine with it, sure." Yeah, you understand.[party.som | Patiently | Turning to [party.compNames], you tell [comp1.himHer] to take the rest of the day off in town on your dime, and meet you back here at the temple in the evening. With that done | Turning to [party.compNames], you tell them to take the rest of the day off in town on your dime, and meet you back here at the temple in the evening. With that done ], you turn back to Darius and see what he's got in mind for you today... [rand |Before you know it, the 'mander mage has brewed up a pot of spice tea, its heavy aroma filling the room even as he asks you to bring up several volumes borrowed from the castle from a bookcase up against the wall. He nods for you to take a seat across him from the table, and pours you a mug of the heavy, reddish-brown tea. "I came across several interesting fluctuations in the portal's energy signature over the past week, and have been discussing what exactly they might mean with Barnaphous and the temple at large. Since you have some background and personal experience with the portal itself, I'd like to pick your mind for your thoughts..." The both of you spend the next few hours going over Darius' observations and readings, cross-referencing your observations with the texts he's asked you to bring over to the table. You're not sure what kind of help you might be, but he's extremely interested in everything you have to say. "So, that's your theory, is it? It certainly supports my observations, but I hadn't considered interpreting them from that particular angle." You're happy to help. "Don't get me wrong, Barnaphous and I discuss our findings all the time, but after having been friends for so long it's easy to fall into established patterns of thought. Your perspective, especially from someone with the kind of practical experience you do, is valuable." Now he's just being flattering... "I mean everything I say. One of our goals is to see if we can't harness the portal as a source of free energy, even if we keep it closed forever. Imagine the things we could do for the village! Now, if you would be so kind as to give me your thoughts on this..." The rest of the day up till evening is spent slowly draining the pot of spice tea and having Darius bounce various ideas and observations off you regarding the portal and how it might be harnessed in various ways. The conversation stays surprisingly on-topic, and as the final hour of your discussion draws to a close you help the 'mander design several more experiments to investigate the portal more deeply and thoroughly without risking it exploding all over the place, or worse." "Much appreciated," Darius says, draining the tea's dregs from the pot with a note of finality. "I'll see if I can't put some of your ideas into action tomorrow, [pc.name] — I'd rather get to it now, but I also want to run them by Barnaphous in the evening, too. Not that I'm impugning you or anything, of course; it's just to keep him informed and in the know." Oh, of course not. |As it turns out, it's maintenance day here at the makeshift laboratory. Darius leaves and quickly returns with a small case of tools, mostly metal rods and several shaped pieces of wire with slivers of gemstones embedded in their sides; while you don't recognise them all, your training in the arcane quickly leads you to identify some of them as basic calibration equipment. "I'll start winding down the equipment from this side, and you can do the other. It should be fairly simple — don't do them all at once, though. Once we get the sides done, we can take care of the middle; something needs to be focused on the portal at all times." All right, got it. Barely moments have passed before you realize Darius didn't tell you how to go about winding down any of the arcane apparatus whirring quietly away by the portal's edge, but the answer soon becomes obvious: every single one of them has a big red button set into the side fashioned from some kind of copper alloy. Trust Barney to have a sense of humor even in his artifice... you push them, and the whirring slows and gradually grinds to a halt. "Perfect. If you'd come over to assist me, please..." The next couple of hours that pass certainly prove that your education in the arcane and magical was worth it as you help Darius carefully take apart and clean out each and every piece in the laboratory. Springs, gears, axels, and the occasional fine glass tube which the 'mander mage handles with considerable reverence. Aside from the last, there's nothing here that couldn't conceivably be shaped by Ogrish down in town, albeit with a little effort; Barney's ingenuity and resourcefulness shines through here. "I'll have to clean out the tubing later with diluted oil of vitriol," Darius remarks as he wraps the glass up in fine cloth. "Look at how filthy it's gotten." Really? You don't see it yourself... Darius just shakes his head and starts probing at several of the devices' internals with gem-encrusted wire. He wasn't kidding — the work isn't hard, but it is tedious drudgery, and you certainly get to flex your knowledge of the arcane and the finer points of your education — not. Most of your help ends up being in the form of another pair of hands, mostly to hold whatever Darius is working on steady while he cleans, replaces, and calibrates with the gem-encrusted wires. "Tally up every component we replace," he tells you, voice coming through strained teeth and cold sweat beading on his brow. "I'll have to send down to Ogrish for more eventually." Of course, it's not all grunt work. Darius does allow you to perform some of the finer tinkering under his watchful eye, always ready to step in should you precipitate an imminent mishap. You're naturally nervous and unsteady about such fine artifice, but the 'mander mage takes hold of your hands and guides you about the work — there's no doubt that it'd take longer if you just held the devices steady and he did all the maintenance himself, but by all appearances he's certainly having fun being able to guide you in these matters. Once the devices on the sides are dealt with, the two of you start them up again and repeat the process with those in the middle. "Getting tired?" Your fingers are cramping... Darius laughs and claps you on the shoulder. "Yeah, it was like that when I first started taking care of Barnaphous' creations, too. Still, it's good for learning control that's going to be used in fine work. Heads up now, we're almost done." The 'mander mage is good to his word; within half an hour, he's backing the rods and wires back into the case, carefully wrapping them up in soft cloth so they don't jangle around. "We're done for today. Thanks again for your help, [pc.name]." You don't think you were that useful, really... "Have you ever tried to hold a tripod steady with your tail while working on your back? Don't undersell the grunt work, [pc.name] — it may not be as glamorous as great wizardry work, but it's what keeps the spells stable and gears running. Sure, I may have had to show you a thing or two... but overall, I'm sure you shaved off precious time from this maintenance cycle." Aw, shucks, when he puts it like that... |"Good. We're taking readings today — this should go much faster with you around. Some of these things have been running for the last three days and Barnaphous wants to know if there have been any trends in the minor anomalies over that period." And if there were major anomalies? "If there were major anomalies, we wouldn't be standing here right now." Darius winks and gives you a dry and slightly bitter chuckle, devoid of humor, and hands you a tablet with a bit of paper on it. "Go on, then. Let's get to work." It can't have been that long you're standing there alternating squinting at readouts and scribbling on the paper, but it feels like forever. Eventually, you're done, though, and the 'mander mage meets you in the middle of it all, giving you a firm nod when he bumps up against you. Is that all? "Now comes the fun part. We've got the results, now we've got to make sense of them. This isn't just for Barney — I do make a fortnightly report in person back in Tychris, and their standards are pretty high. I'm actually glad to have someone who can do serious mathematics around, because getting this done on my lonesome takes hours." It still turns out that it takes hours. Darius puts on some spice tea, and the two of you have a go of making sense of all the numbers and observations that you've just collected from Barney's tinkertoys. Time drags on in silence, punctuated by occasional quiet discussion between the two of you and the sipping of spice tea, until you've finally gotten everything in order. It's not physically demanding work in the least, but gods, if you don't feel bushed at the end of wrangling all these numbers into something that makes sense. Does it have to be so thorough? "It's part of the conditions the palace library put on me when I left for Hawkethorne — a comprehensive report every fortnight, to be delivered in person. It's troublesome, to be sure, but the four-hour ride there and back does give me an excuse to stretch my legs and relax." You're not surprised, portals can be very dangerous things. "Either way, I'm glad for your help today, [pc.name]. You made this a lot easier on me, even if it was just number crunching and looking for anomalies in the variance. Barney never really liked this kind of stuff, which is completely understandable — I myself find it only somewhat tolerable. Thank you again." The pleasure's yours. ] "I'll see you out, then. I do have to prepare to wind down the lab." As you leave Cait's quarters and the makeshift laboratory therein, the door shuts behind you with a final thud. You're not sure exactly how useful you've been, but [party.hasCompanions |as you see [party.compNames] coming down the hallway to rejoin you, ]Darius certainly appreciated your company, if nothing else. Despite what he says, he does need to get out more...

|不知不觉间，这位法师已经泡好了一壶香料茶，浓郁的香气弥漫在整个房间里。他让你去墙边的书架那里取几本从城堡里借来的书。他示意你坐在他对面的桌子旁，然后给你倒了一杯颜色呈红棕色的浓茶。 在过去的一周里，我注意到这个传送门的能量信号出现了几次有趣的波动，因此我一直在与巴纳福斯以及整个神庙的成员讨论这些波动可能意味着什么。既然你对这个传送门本身有一些了解和个人经验，我想听听你的看法…… “别误会，我和巴纳福斯经常会讨论我们的发现，但毕竟我们是多年的朋友了，很容易就会陷入固定的思维模式。你的观点，尤其是像你这样拥有丰富实践经验的人所提供的看法，确实非常宝贵。 现在他只是在讨好我罢了…… “我说的每一句话都是认真的。我们的目标之一就是看看是否能够将这个传送门作为免费能源的来源来利用，即使我们永远把它关上也好。想象一下，如果我们能利用这个传送门，能为村子做多少事情啊！现在，如果你能告诉我你对此的看法的话…… 之后我得用稀释过的硫酸把这些管子清洗干净，”达里乌斯一边用细布把玻璃包起来，一边说道，“看看它们变得有多脏了。” “真的吗？你自己难道没看到吗……
