|很好。今天我们就要进行数据测量了——有你在场的话，这项工作应该会进行得快很多。有些设备已经运行了三天了，巴纳福斯想知道在这段时间里，这些轻微异常数据是否出现了什么变化趋势。” 那么，如果出现了严重的异常情况呢？ “如果出现了严重的异常是要是没有那些严重的异常情况，我们现在也不会站在这里。”达里乌斯眨了眨眼，发出一声干涩而略带苦涩的笑声，那笑声里没有任何幽默感，然后他把一块上面写着一些文字的平板交给了你。“那好吧，我们开始工作吧。” 你站在那里，一会儿眯着眼睛查看那些显示数据，一会儿又在纸上匆匆记录些什么，时间似乎过得并不快，但却感觉像过了很久很久。终于，你完成了任务。这时，那位“指挥法师”出现在你面前，当他与你擦肩而过时，他坚定地点了点头。 就这些吗？ “现在到了有趣的部分。我们得到了结果，接下来就要分析这些数据了。这不仅仅是为了巴尼——我确实需要每两周向蒂克里斯汇报一次，而他们的要求相当高。其实，能有一个人能帮我做这些复杂的数学分析，我真的很高兴，因为独自完成这些工作的话，会花费我好几个小时的时间。 结果还是花了几个小时才弄清楚。达里乌斯泡了一些香料茶，你们俩一起仔细分析从巴尼的机械装置中收集到的所有数据和观察结果。时间在沉默中慢慢流逝，只有你们偶尔的轻声讨论以及喝香料茶的声音打破这份宁静，直到最终把所有事情都整理得井井有条。这项工作其实根本不需要耗费太多的体力，但是天啊，当你把所有这些数字整理成有条理的信息后，真的会感到精疲力竭啊。 非得这么细致吗？ “这是我在离开皇宫图书馆前往鹰棘镇时所必须遵守的条件之一——每两周必须提交一份详细的报告，并且必须亲自送交。虽然确实挺麻烦的，但来回四小时的旅途倒也让我有了一个借口，可以借此活动活动腿脚、放松一下。 你应该不会感到惊讶，传送门其实可能是非常危险的东西。 “不管怎样，我很感谢你今天的帮助。[pc.name]你真的让我省去了很多麻烦，虽然这些工作只不过是进行数据计算以及查找数据中的异常值而已。巴尼从来都不喜欢这类事情，这也完全可以理解——我自己也觉得这类工作只能勉强接受而已。再次感谢你。” “不客气，能帮到你是我的荣幸。 ] 那我就送你出去吧。我确实得开始准备关闭实验室了。” 当你离开凯特的住处以及那里的临时实验室时，门在身后重重地关上了。你不确定正是如此你确实帮了大忙，但是[party.hasCompanions |如你所见[party.compNames]我正沿着走廊走过来，准备与你会合。 ]至少可以这么说，大流士确实很享受有你在他身边。尽管他嘴上这么说，但实际上他确实需要多出去走走……
rows.raw: " Darius raises an eyebrow when you pop the question. "You're seriously offering to help me out?" Well, it's not just for him — it's for Barney and Cait, too. You don't feel like adventuring for the rest of the day, yet don't want to laze around for that time, so you might as well be productive in other ways. The 'mander mage contemplates you for a moment, then sighs and nods. "Well, I can't say you're unqualified for the task, so you won't get in the way. But research isn't as glamorous as the legends of Estelore make it out to be — it's mostly long, boring and involves a lot of drudgery. If you're willing to lend a hand, then I'm fine with it, sure." Yeah, you understand.[party.som | Patiently | Turning to [party.compNames], you tell [comp1.himHer] to take the rest of the day off in town on your dime, and meet you back here at the temple in the evening. With that done | Turning to [party.compNames], you tell them to take the rest of the day off in town on your dime, and meet you back here at the temple in the evening. With that done ], you turn back to Darius and see what he's got in mind for you today... [rand |Before you know it, the 'mander mage has brewed up a pot of spice tea, its heavy aroma filling the room even as he asks you to bring up several volumes borrowed from the castle from a bookcase up against the wall. He nods for you to take a seat across him from the table, and pours you a mug of the heavy, reddish-brown tea. "I came across several interesting fluctuations in the portal's energy signature over the past week, and have been discussing what exactly they might mean with Barnaphous and the temple at large. Since you have some background and personal experience with the portal itself, I'd like to pick your mind for your thoughts..." The both of you spend the next few hours going over Darius' observations and readings, cross-referencing your observations with the texts he's asked you to bring over to the table. You're not sure what kind of help you might be, but he's extremely interested in everything you have to say. "So, that's your theory, is it? It certainly supports my observations, but I hadn't considered interpreting them from that particular angle." You're happy to help. "Don't get me wrong, Barnaphous and I discuss our findings all the time, but after having been friends for so long it's easy to fall into established patterns of thought. Your perspective, especially from someone with the kind of practical experience you do, is valuable." Now he's just being flattering... "I mean everything I say. One of our goals is to see if we can't harness the portal as a source of free energy, even if we keep it closed forever. Imagine the things we could do for the village! Now, if you would be so kind as to give me your thoughts on this..." The rest of the day up till evening is spent slowly draining the pot of spice tea and having Darius bounce various ideas and observations off you regarding the portal and how it might be harnessed in various ways. The conversation stays surprisingly on-topic, and as the final hour of your discussion draws to a close you help the 'mander design several more experiments to investigate the portal more deeply and thoroughly without risking it exploding all over the place, or worse." "Much appreciated," Darius says, draining the tea's dregs from the pot with a note of finality. "I'll see if I can't put some of your ideas into action tomorrow, [pc.name] — I'd rather get to it now, but I also want to run them by Barnaphous in the evening, too. Not that I'm impugning you or anything, of course; it's just to keep him informed and in the know." Oh, of course not. |As it turns out, it's maintenance day here at the makeshift laboratory. Darius leaves and quickly returns with a small case of tools, mostly metal rods and several shaped pieces of wire with slivers of gemstones embedded in their sides; while you don't recognise them all, your training in the arcane quickly leads you to identify some of them as basic calibration equipment. "I'll start winding down the equipment from this side, and you can do the other. It should be fairly simple — don't do them all at once, though. Once we get the sides done, we can take care of the middle; something needs to be focused on the portal at all times." All right, got it. Barely moments have passed before you realize Darius didn't tell you how to go about winding down any of the arcane apparatus whirring quietly away by the portal's edge, but the answer soon becomes obvious: every single one of them has a big red button set into the side fashioned from some kind of copper alloy. Trust Barney to have a sense of humor even in his artifice... you push them, and the whirring slows and gradually grinds to a halt. "Perfect. If you'd come over to assist me, please..." The next couple of hours that pass certainly prove that your education in the arcane and magical was worth it as you help Darius carefully take apart and clean out each and every piece in the laboratory. Springs, gears, axels, and the occasional fine glass tube which the 'mander mage handles with considerable reverence. Aside from the last, there's nothing here that couldn't conceivably be shaped by Ogrish down in town, albeit with a little effort; Barney's ingenuity and resourcefulness shines through here. "I'll have to clean out the tubing later with diluted oil of vitriol," Darius remarks as he wraps the glass up in fine cloth. "Look at how filthy it's gotten." Really? You don't see it yourself... Darius just shakes his head and starts probing at several of the devices' internals with gem-encrusted wire. He wasn't kidding — the work isn't hard, but it is tedious drudgery, and you certainly get to flex your knowledge of the arcane and the finer points of your education — not. Most of your help ends up being in the form of another pair of hands, mostly to hold whatever Darius is working on steady while he cleans, replaces, and calibrates with the gem-encrusted wires. "Tally up every component we replace," he tells you, voice coming through strained teeth and cold sweat beading on his brow. "I'll have to send down to Ogrish for more eventually." Of course, it's not all grunt work. Darius does allow you to perform some of the finer tinkering under his watchful eye, always ready to step in should you precipitate an imminent mishap. You're naturally nervous and unsteady about such fine artifice, but the 'mander mage takes hold of your hands and guides you about the work — there's no doubt that it'd take longer if you just held the devices steady and he did all the maintenance himself, but by all appearances he's certainly having fun being able to guide you in these matters. Once the devices on the sides are dealt with, the two of you start them up again and repeat the process with those in the middle. "Getting tired?" Your fingers are cramping... Darius laughs and claps you on the shoulder. "Yeah, it was like that when I first started taking care of Barnaphous' creations, too. Still, it's good for learning control that's going to be used in fine work. Heads up now, we're almost done." The 'mander mage is good to his word; within half an hour, he's backing the rods and wires back into the case, carefully wrapping them up in soft cloth so they don't jangle around. "We're done for today. Thanks again for your help, [pc.name]." You don't think you were that useful, really... "Have you ever tried to hold a tripod steady with your tail while working on your back? Don't undersell the grunt work, [pc.name] — it may not be as glamorous as great wizardry work, but it's what keeps the spells stable and gears running. Sure, I may have had to show you a thing or two... but overall, I'm sure you shaved off precious time from this maintenance cycle." Aw, shucks, when he puts it like that... |"Good. We're taking readings today — this should go much faster with you around. Some of these things have been running for the last three days and Barnaphous wants to know if there have been any trends in the minor anomalies over that period." And if there were major anomalies? "If there were major anomalies, we wouldn't be standing here right now." Darius winks and gives you a dry and slightly bitter chuckle, devoid of humor, and hands you a tablet with a bit of paper on it. "Go on, then. Let's get to work." It can't have been that long you're standing there alternating squinting at readouts and scribbling on the paper, but it feels like forever. Eventually, you're done, though, and the 'mander mage meets you in the middle of it all, giving you a firm nod when he bumps up against you. Is that all? "Now comes the fun part. We've got the results, now we've got to make sense of them. This isn't just for Barney — I do make a fortnightly report in person back in Tychris, and their standards are pretty high. I'm actually glad to have someone who can do serious mathematics around, because getting this done on my lonesome takes hours." It still turns out that it takes hours. Darius puts on some spice tea, and the two of you have a go of making sense of all the numbers and observations that you've just collected from Barney's tinkertoys. Time drags on in silence, punctuated by occasional quiet discussion between the two of you and the sipping of spice tea, until you've finally gotten everything in order. It's not physically demanding work in the least, but gods, if you don't feel bushed at the end of wrangling all these numbers into something that makes sense. Does it have to be so thorough? "It's part of the conditions the palace library put on me when I left for Hawkethorne — a comprehensive report every fortnight, to be delivered in person. It's troublesome, to be sure, but the four-hour ride there and back does give me an excuse to stretch my legs and relax." You're not surprised, portals can be very dangerous things. "Either way, I'm glad for your help today, [pc.name]. You made this a lot easier on me, even if it was just number crunching and looking for anomalies in the variance. Barney never really liked this kind of stuff, which is completely understandable — I myself find it only somewhat tolerable. Thank you again." The pleasure's yours. ] "I'll see you out, then. I do have to prepare to wind down the lab." As you leave Cait's quarters and the makeshift laboratory therein, the door shuts behind you with a final thud. You're not sure exactly how useful you've been, but [party.hasCompanions |as you see [party.compNames] coming down the hallway to rejoin you, ]Darius certainly appreciated your company, if nothing else. Despite what he says, he does need to get out more... "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The 'mander mage looks at you askance when you bring up the point. "Well, if it's all right with you. This doesn't actually have anything to do with getting Calla back, to be sure; I just want to sate my curiosity on the effects the portal's had on you." [var0 |It doesn't matter that the portal's effects have been negated somewhat by the deal you've made? "Then I get to take a closer look at that, too. As I understand it, you're not wholly immutable, either, so I get to examine how the two interact to produce the final result." |He's right in that it can get tiring having to watch what you eat, amongst other things. "It's such a strange phenomenon — physical transformation isn't unknown, of course, but usually one requires alchemy to effect such a change. For all this to happen to you and have no one at least document, let alone study it would be a terrible waste." ] It's a little strange being thought of as an experimental subject or specimen under study, but it'll advance the understanding of portals and their ilk... "That's the spirit!" Darius breaks into a grin, and he gives you a slap on the shoulder. "Why don't we step away from the lab for a bit and head back to the matron's quarters? You'll be more comfortable there." [rand |The both of you retreat into the plush silks of Cait's abode, and Darius instructs you to make yourself comfortable on one of the couches while he gets things ready. It takes a little bit, but he returns in fifteen minutes or so with a large basin of still-bubbling water and a couple of implements steeped in it. "Forgive me for the wait, but I needed to cleanse all the tools involved, especially the ritual blooding device. Salwah was not as forthcoming with hot water from the kitchens as she should have been." What does he intend to do? "I wish to draw a small amount of blood from your person, two thimblefuls, to be precise. You will not begrudge me this, will you?" Well, you did agree — in fact, you asked for this, and Darius clearly knows what he's doing. The 'mander mage's practiced movements suggests his experience at this, which raises some questions in and of itself, but your thoughts are wiped away as he daubs some hot alcohol on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] on your upper arm with a cloth and brings the blooding device to prick your flesh. There's a moment of tension as the trio of curved blades rests on your skin, and the 'mander mage gives you a nod. "I'm going to do it now. Relax — it'll hurt more if you tense up." Yes. Even knowing it's coming, the bronze blades are still hot from the boiling water and you bite your lip as they dig into your flesh and draw blood. Darius moves quickly and clinically, his face a neutral mask of concentration as he fills two small glass vials with the rich red fluid and caps them with bronze. When he's done, the 'mander mage cleans off your arm with more hot alcohol and returns the blooding device to the boiling basin. "You're still feeling good?" You're none the worse for the wear. That might have been a little harrowing, but it wasn't quite the way you expected it would've been. "Well, sit around and catch your breath for a bit — I have to go clean all of this up and preserve the samples I just drew. Your cooperation and assistance in this matter is quite appreciated." Can you watch him actually mess around with your blood when the time comes? "If it'll sate your curiosity and set your mind at ease, sure. I'd certainly be wanting to draw more samples, given the exhaustive nature of such investigation in consumption of workable samples... but imagine if we could make people more mutable temporarily, then stop it at will! Or... I don't know, even if there were no practical outcome to be gained from it all, I really, honestly, do want to understand what exactly is going on with you, [pc.name]." That's flattering in a way, you guess. Darius nods. "I've blathered and dithered too long — I need to get all of this out quickly and start working on it. If you don't mind staying here for a bit while I get back to the lab..." No, you understand. Lying back on the perfumed cushions, you watch Darius head back across to the lab on the other side of the chambers, his excitement so obvious he's practically tripping over his own tail. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... |The both of you retreat into the plush silks and perfumed cushions of Cait's abode, and Darius instructs you to make yourself comfortable and lie down on one of the plush couches while he gets things ready. True to his word, the 'mander mage returns shortly with one of Barney's tinkertoys, which he sets up on a tripod over you and starts cranking furiously. The bronze-and-leather contraption whirrs to life after a couple of false starts, a small chip of sapphire on its body starting to glimmer. "What I'd like you to do is for you to hold still while the flux analyser does its work," Darius explains. "It might take half an hour to a full hour, but I want to get a snapshot of your natural magical field — or at least, what passes for it after the portal's had its way with you. The more, the merrier." Does he really need so many? "[var0 |Even though your physical form's been stabilised somewhat, and by direct divine intervention no less |Of course. Like you ], your natural emanations are constantly shifting, as is your flux pattern. I'd like to be able to track their changes, for curiosity's sake if nothing else." Well, when he puts it that way... "It's for science." What do you need to do? "Like I said, lie here and hold still. You don't need to be perfectly unmoving for the hour or so, but as little as possible would be nice." You look up at the device Darius called the flux analyser, complete with the lens of polished crystal set into its underside, and try not to heave a sigh as you realize you'll be staring up at its slightly unnerving and alien form all the while. Darius shrugs, gives you an apologetic smile, and tries to engage you in idle conversation while Barney's tinkertoy does its work. While the 'mander made clearly isn't the best at conversation, [pc.isMage |he does bring out a variety of arcane writings he's brought back from his latest trip back to Tychris, and at least the two of you have some common ground to discuss as you while away the time. "It's kind of annoying that I've been asked to report back every fortnight, but it does give me the opportunity to return old material to the palace library and get new writings for the avenue of research on the portal we're pursuing at the moment." Is Tychris interested in what's going on here in Hawkethorne with the portal? Darius hums. "Those lizards never seem quite interested in anything I do, but then again they never seem quite interested in anything, anyway. I'd say no, but I'm not the best judge of people and they do want me to show back in person for my report, even if I think it's just a formality. Who knows?" |he does try to engage you in conversation about the goings-on in the temple and down in Hawkethorne. It doesn't go swimmingly well, given how he actively tries to go into town as little as possible, but it's a good effort to keep you distracted, if nothing else. [var1 |"You're intimately acquainted with Selima, right?" Given that you were the one who asked the trio of kittens to hang around town, yes, you are. "Like, um, can you tell me something about some of the things she likes?" Now that's an interesting question, and accompanied by a slip in his speech patterns no less. What's up? "You know. I'd, uh, just like to get to know her better, that's all. Might lead somewhere. Might not. But you won't know if you don't try, right? I mean, what's the worst that could happen, really? I get turned down?" |"Ogrish does surprisingly fine work for what he has on hand. This town is full of good people, despite being on the frontier backwaters." Well, like attracts like, as the saying goes. "No matter how fine the components Barnaphous needs from him, he's always been able to turn them out according to specifications. That kind of reliability is hard to find these days, especially in places where you don't have a long-standing craftsmens' tradition..." Like in Tychris? "...Well, yes." ] ] Eventually, though, the device's whirring comes to a halt, and it lets out a click with a distinct note of finality. Crossing over to the flux analyser, Darius removes the chip of sapphire from its side and carefully pulls away the device, returning it to its proper position in the makeshift laboratory before returning to you. "Ah. I'm sorry to be so abrupt, but I would like to get this down on paper properly before too long." He fingers the gem chip. "Do you mind if I take my leave?" No, not at all. You're glad to have helped. "I'm not leaving you to dry once I've gotten what I wanted or anything, but I do need to concentrate for this. I do apologise." With that, Darius heads back over to the laboratory table, gathering a stick of charcoal and some paper; with a flick of a finger, the 'mander mage projects forth a pattern of roiling color up from the glimmering sapphire chip and starts copying it down, his tail lashing about in excitement. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... |The both of you head away from the laboratory and over to the cushions and perfumes of Cait's quarters, where the 'mander mage asks you to sit down on one of the luxuriant couches and wait. "I'll get a couple of things I need for the examination. Do pardon me." But of course. Darius soon returns with several metal and wooden implements, and draws up a chair for himself. "All right, now — I'm going to give you a brief physical. Admittedly, I'm not the best at either anatomy or the like, but I'd wager I'm the best we have for miles around and you make do with what you have. If you don't mind, I'm going to have to come into contact with you at several points, so — " [pc.dcb |Yeah, he can just get on with it already instead of boring you. |You understand. He can begin anytime he likes. |Ooh, is the 'mander going to touch you with his scaly hands? You, like, totally enjoy being touched, so he can touch you all he wants! ] Darius sighs and nods. "All right, then. Just relax..." The next half-hour or so passes in silence save for the occasional hum of consideration from Darius. You can't help but feel like a show horse as he inspects your eyes, your ears, your limbs; the 'mander mage requests several times that you flex some muscles, and pinches and squeezes away. It's clear that he's trying to be professional and distant in all this, but isn't letting that hamper the effectiveness or efficiency of his physical. "Now, say ah." Ah...? "Hm. Interesting, interesting. I didn't know people could have such stretchy throats — I wonder if that's another effect of the portal on you? Maybe... " Darius scratches his chin, and then his eyes light up. "I'll have to see if that matches any anomalies on your aura, but that's something I hadn't noticed before." What didn't he notice before? He waves you off. "Not yet, not yet. I don't want to get either of us excited over what might very well be a dud, but it's given me something to think about. Actually, we're done for today." That quickly? You'd have expected a bodily examination to have lasted longer. "Well, it's — ah — non-invasive, and I do want to get this all down while it's fresh in my mind. Now, sorry to run out on you like this, but I really must record my observations..." Giving you a clap on the shoulder, Darius packs up his various bits and bobs and makes a brisk pace for the laboratory, pulling up seat at the table before scribbling away while his tail lashes about in excitement. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... ]
rows.translation: 当你提到这个话题时，那位法师用一种疑惑的眼神看着你。“嗯，如果你不介意的话……其实这和让卡拉回来并没有关系；我只是想了解一下这个传送门对你产生了什么影响而已。 [var0 |那么，你所做的那笔交易在某种程度上抵消了那个传送门带来的效果，这也没关系吧？ “那么，我也有必要仔细研究一下这个问题。据我了解，你并不是完全地这些元素本身也是不可改变的，因此我就可以研究它们是如何相互作用从而产生最终结果的。 |他说得对，时刻注意自己吃了什么，确实会让人感到疲惫。 “这真是一种奇怪的现象——身体形态的变化当然并非闻所未闻，但通常情况下，要实现这样的变化是需要借助炼金术的。而你身上发生了这种变化，却没有人对此进行记录，更没有人对此进行研究，实在是太可惜了。 ] 被当作实验对象或研究样本来对待，确实有点奇怪，但这样反而有助于加深人们对传送门这类事物的理解…… “正是这个意思！”达里厄斯咧开嘴笑了，然后拍了拍你的肩膀：“我们为什么不离开实验室，去女管家的住处休息一会儿呢？那里会让你感觉更舒服些。 [rand |你们俩走进了凯特舒适的居所，达里厄斯让你在沙发上休息，而他则去准备一些东西。过了大约十五分钟，他回来了，手里拿着一个装着还在冒泡的水的大盆子，还有几件浸泡在水中的工具。 请原谅让我等待了这么久，但我需要清洗所有相关的工具，尤其是那个用于仪式的吸血装置。萨尔瓦并没有像应该的那样及时从厨房提供热水。” 他到底打算做什么呢？ 我需要从你身上抽取少量的血液，确切地说，是两满指的量。你应该不会介意吧？” 嗯，你其实是同意的——事实上，是你自己要求的，而且达里乌斯显然很清楚自己在做什么。那位法师娴熟的动作显然表明他在这方面经验丰富，这一点本身就引发了一些疑问，但当他将热酒精涂抹在你的身上时，你的所有思绪都被抛到了一边。[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]他们用布包住你的上臂，然后使用那个采血工具刺破你的皮肤。当那三片弯曲的刀片接触到你的皮肤时，有一瞬间你会感到紧张；而那位法师则微微点了点头。 “现在就开始吧。放松一点——如果你紧张的话，疼痛会更剧烈。 是的。即使早知道这一刻会到来，那些青铜刀片从沸水中取出后依然炽热无比，当它们刺入你的皮肤、划出血来时，你还是会不由自主地咬住嘴唇。大流士动作迅速而精准，他的脸上带着专注而冷漠的表情，将那鲜红色的液体倒入两个小玻璃瓶中，然后用青铜盖子将瓶口密封起来。完成后，那位“曼德尔法师”会用更多的热酒精清洗你的手臂，再将那个用于取血的工具放回沸水中。 你还是感觉不错吧？” 你一点都没有受到太大的影响。虽然刚才的经历有点令人紧张，但其实并没有你想象中那么糟糕。 “好吧，先坐下来休息一会儿吧——我得去把这里清理干净，并把刚刚采集的样本妥善保存起来。对于你在这件事上给予我的配合与帮助，我真的很感激。 等那个时候到了，你能亲眼看到他是怎么处理你的血液的吗？ “如果这能满足你的好奇心，让你放心的话，当然可以。考虑到这种调查对可用样本的需求量非常大，我肯定也会想要再采集一些样本的。…但想象一下，如果我们能够暂时让人们的特性发生改变，然后又可以随意停止这种变化该多好！或者……虽然我不知道这样做是否真的能带来什么实际效果，但我真心地想要弄清楚，你身上究竟发生了什么。[pc.name]从某种意义上来说，这确实是一种恭维吧。” 达里厄斯点了点头：“我之前说得太多、太啰嗦了——我需要尽快把所有这些想法都说清楚，然后开始行动。如果你不介意的话，等我回到实验室后，你可以在这里稍等一会儿。不，你明白的。你躺在散发着香气的垫子上，看着达里乌斯穿过大厅，走向另一边的实验室，他的兴奋之情如此明显，简直都要被自己的情绪绊倒了。看来今天剩下的时间就只能这样过了…… |你们俩一起走进凯特那舒适豪华的居所，躺在铺着柔软丝绸、散发着香气的靠垫上。达里厄斯让你们放松下来，躺在沙发上休息，而他则去准备一些东西。果然，这位“指挥法师”很快就回来了，他拿来了巴尼的一个小机械装置，把它放在你们的上方，然后用尽全力启动它。这个由青铜和皮革制成的装置在经历了几次启动失败后，终于开始运转起来，它身上那颗小蓝宝石也开始闪烁起来。 “我需要你做的就是保持静止，让磁通分析仪能够正常工作，”达里乌斯解释道。这可能需要半个小时到一个小时的时间，但我真的很想获取你自然产生的魔法场的数据——或者至少，是在那个传送门对你产生影响之后，你所剩下的那种‘魔法场’的数据。数据越多越好。” 他真的需要这么多数据吗？ "[var0 |尽管你的肉体形态已经得到了一定程度的稳定，而且这种稳定还是通过神的直接干预才实现的。 |当然。就像你一样。 ]你的自然辐射一直在变化，你的能量流动模式也在不断改变。出于好奇，我希望能追踪这些变化。” “嗯，既然他这么说了……” “这是为了科学你需要做什么呢？” “就像我说的，就躺在这里，保持不动。虽然不需要一动不动地待上一个小时左右，但尽量不动会更好。” 你抬头看了看达里厄斯称之为“通量分析仪”的那个设备——它的底部装着一块经过抛光处理的水晶透镜。当你意识到自己将不得不一直盯着这个看起来有些令人不安、充满异域气息的装置时，你差点叹出一口气来。达里厄斯耸了耸肩，露出歉意的微笑，试图在你耳边闲聊几句，而巴尼的那些小玩意儿则继续在忙碌着。虽然很明显，达里厄斯并不擅长聊天[pc.isMage |他确实带来了他在最近一次前往提克里斯的旅行中收集到的各种神秘文献，至少你们俩有共同的话题可以讨论，以此来打发时间。 “虽然每隔两周就被要求提交报告，这有点烦人，但这也让我有机会把那些旧文献归还给宫殿图书馆，同时也能获取一些新的资料，用于我们目前正在研究的那个关于传送门的项目。提克里斯对鹰棘镇这里发生的关于那个传送门的事情感兴趣吗？ 达里厄斯哼了一声：“那些蜥蜴似乎从来不对我做的任何事感兴趣，不过话说回来，它们似乎对任何事情都提不起兴趣罢了。我本想说不，但毕竟我并不是判断他人品性的最佳人选，而且他们确实要求我亲自回去汇报，尽管我觉得这只是走个形式而已。谁知道呢？ |他确实会试图与你谈论寺庙里发生的事情，以及鹰棘镇地区的种种状况。不过，由于他总是尽量减少去镇上的次数，所以这样的对话进行得并不顺利。不过，至少这样的努力还能让你暂时分心，避免陷入其他思绪之中。 [var1 |你和塞利玛关系很熟，对吧？” 既然是你让那三只小猫留在镇上的，那么，没错，你确实和她关系熟。 “嗯，你能告诉我一些关于她喜欢的事情吗？这可真是个有趣的问题，而且他的说话方式也出现了一些变化。到底发生了什么呢？ “你知道的，我只是想更深入地了解她而已，没什么别的。也许会有结果，也许不会。但如果不尝试，你就永远不知道结果如何，对吧？我的意思是，最坏的结果又能怎样呢？难道就是被拒绝吗？ |以奥格瑞什现有的资源来看，他的工作做得相当不错。尽管这个小镇位于边远地区，但这里还是住着许多善良的人。” 嗯，正如俗话所说，物以类聚嘛。 无论巴纳福斯需要他提供什么样的高质量零部件，他总能按照要求将其完成。这种可靠性在如今已经十分难得，尤其是在那些没有悠久工匠传统的地区。就像在提克里斯那里一样吗？” “……嗯，是的。 ] ] 最终，设备的嗡嗡声渐渐消失了，它发出了一声带有终结意味的“咔嗒”声。达里厄斯走到磁通分析仪前，从设备侧面取下了那块蓝宝石芯片，然后小心翼翼地将整个设备取下来，放回临时搭建的实验室里原来的位置，之后才回到你身边。 啊，很抱歉我这么突然地提出这个请求，但我希望尽快把这件事以书面形式确定下来。”他指着那颗宝石芯片说道，“您不介意我现在离开吧？” “不，一点也不。能帮上您的忙，我非常高兴。 我并不是得到了自己想要的东西就打算抛弃你，但我确实需要集中精力去做这件事。真的很抱歉。” 说完，达里厄斯便回到了实验桌前，拿了一根木炭和一些纸。他轻轻一弹手指，那个“曼德法师”便从那颗闪烁着蓝宝石光芒的芯片上释放出一系列绚丽的色彩图案，他开始将这些图案抄录下来，而他的尾巴则兴奋地不停地摆动着。看来今天剩下的时间就只能干这个了…… |你们俩离开实验室，前往凯特所在的区域，那里有柔软的靠垫和芬芳的香气。那位“曼德法师”让你们坐在那些豪华的沙发上等待。 “我去拿一些进行检查所需的东西。请原谅我。” 不过，当然没有关系。达里乌斯很快拿来了几件金属和木制的工具，然后为自己搬来一把椅子坐下。 “好吧，现在开始——我会给你们做一个简单的身体检查。诚然，我在解剖学方面并不是最专业的，但可以肯定的是，在方圆几英里范围内，我是最擅长的这个人选了，所以你们就凑合着用我的服务吧。如果你不介意的话，以后我可能会有几次需要与你联系，所以—— [pc.dcb |是啊，他干脆直接开始做吧，别再让你无聊了。 |你明白的。他可以在任何他想开始的时间开始行动。 |哦，那个长满鳞片的家伙会用他的手触碰你吗？你似乎非常喜欢被触碰，所以他可以随意触碰你哦！ ] 达里厄斯叹了口气，然后点了点头。“好吧，那就这样吧。放松一点……” 接下来的半个小时里，房间里一片寂静，只有达里厄斯偶尔发出一些思考的声音。当他仔细检查你的眼睛、耳朵和四肢时，你不禁觉得自己就像一匹被展示给别人看的马；那位“指挥法师”还多次要求你活动一下肌肉，然后捏了捏、按了按你的身体各部位。显然，他试图在这一切过程中保持专业和疏离的态度，但这样的行为似乎并没有影响到他的检查效率和准确性。 现在，说‘啊’吧。” “啊……？” “嗯，有意思，真有意思。我以前不知道人们的喉咙竟然可以有这么大的弹性——不知道这是不是传送门对你产生的另一种影响？也许……”达里厄斯挠了挠下巴，然后眼睛突然亮了起来，“我得看看这是否与你身上的异常现象有关，不过这是我之前没有注意到的。 他之前怎么就没注意到呢？ 他摆了摆手，说道：“还不行，再等等。我可不想让我们中的任何一个人因为某个可能根本没什么用的东西而过于兴奋，不过这个发现确实让我有些思考。其实，今天我们就到这里吧。” 这么快就结束了？你本来以为体检会花更长的时间才结束的啊。 嗯，这个方法——啊——并不具有侵入性，而且我确实想趁这些记忆还新鲜的时候把它们记录下来。现在，很抱歉要这样突然中断谈话，但我真的必须把我的观察结果记录下来……” 达里厄斯拍了拍你的肩膀，然后收拾好自己的各种工具，快步走向实验室，在桌子前坐下，开始奋笔记录起来，他的尾巴兴奋地不停地摆动着。看来今天剩下的时间都要用来做这个了…… ]
rows.raw: " The 'mander mage looks at you askance when you bring up the point. "Well, if it's all right with you. This doesn't actually have anything to do with getting Calla back, to be sure; I just want to sate my curiosity on the effects the portal's had on you." [var0 |It doesn't matter that the portal's effects have been negated somewhat by the deal you've made? "Then I get to take a closer look at that, too. As I understand it, you're not wholly immutable, either, so I get to examine how the two interact to produce the final result." |He's right in that it can get tiring having to watch what you eat, amongst other things. "It's such a strange phenomenon — physical transformation isn't unknown, of course, but usually one requires alchemy to effect such a change. For all this to happen to you and have no one at least document, let alone study it would be a terrible waste." ] It's a little strange being thought of as an experimental subject or specimen under study, but it'll advance the understanding of portals and their ilk... "That's the spirit!" Darius breaks into a grin, and he gives you a slap on the shoulder. "Why don't we step away from the lab for a bit and head back to the matron's quarters? You'll be more comfortable there." [rand |The both of you retreat into the plush silks of Cait's abode, and Darius instructs you to make yourself comfortable on one of the couches while he gets things ready. It takes a little bit, but he returns in fifteen minutes or so with a large basin of still-bubbling water and a couple of implements steeped in it. "Forgive me for the wait, but I needed to cleanse all the tools involved, especially the ritual blooding device. Salwah was not as forthcoming with hot water from the kitchens as she should have been." What does he intend to do? "I wish to draw a small amount of blood from your person, two thimblefuls, to be precise. You will not begrudge me this, will you?" Well, you did agree — in fact, you asked for this, and Darius clearly knows what he's doing. The 'mander mage's practiced movements suggests his experience at this, which raises some questions in and of itself, but your thoughts are wiped away as he daubs some hot alcohol on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] on your upper arm with a cloth and brings the blooding device to prick your flesh. There's a moment of tension as the trio of curved blades rests on your skin, and the 'mander mage gives you a nod. "I'm going to do it now. Relax — it'll hurt more if you tense up." Yes. Even knowing it's coming, the bronze blades are still hot from the boiling water and you bite your lip as they dig into your flesh and draw blood. Darius moves quickly and clinically, his face a neutral mask of concentration as he fills two small glass vials with the rich red fluid and caps them with bronze. When he's done, the 'mander mage cleans off your arm with more hot alcohol and returns the blooding device to the boiling basin. "You're still feeling good?" You're none the worse for the wear. That might have been a little harrowing, but it wasn't quite the way you expected it would've been. "Well, sit around and catch your breath for a bit — I have to go clean all of this up and preserve the samples I just drew. Your cooperation and assistance in this matter is quite appreciated." Can you watch him actually mess around with your blood when the time comes? "If it'll sate your curiosity and set your mind at ease, sure. I'd certainly be wanting to draw more samples, given the exhaustive nature of such investigation in consumption of workable samples... but imagine if we could make people more mutable temporarily, then stop it at will! Or... I don't know, even if there were no practical outcome to be gained from it all, I really, honestly, do want to understand what exactly is going on with you, [pc.name]." That's flattering in a way, you guess. Darius nods. "I've blathered and dithered too long — I need to get all of this out quickly and start working on it. If you don't mind staying here for a bit while I get back to the lab..." No, you understand. Lying back on the perfumed cushions, you watch Darius head back across to the lab on the other side of the chambers, his excitement so obvious he's practically tripping over his own tail. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... |The both of you retreat into the plush silks and perfumed cushions of Cait's abode, and Darius instructs you to make yourself comfortable and lie down on one of the plush couches while he gets things ready. True to his word, the 'mander mage returns shortly with one of Barney's tinkertoys, which he sets up on a tripod over you and starts cranking furiously. The bronze-and-leather contraption whirrs to life after a couple of false starts, a small chip of sapphire on its body starting to glimmer. "What I'd like you to do is for you to hold still while the flux analyser does its work," Darius explains. "It might take half an hour to a full hour, but I want to get a snapshot of your natural magical field — or at least, what passes for it after the portal's had its way with you. The more, the merrier." Does he really need so many? "[var0 |Even though your physical form's been stabilised somewhat, and by direct divine intervention no less |Of course. Like you ], your natural emanations are constantly shifting, as is your flux pattern. I'd like to be able to track their changes, for curiosity's sake if nothing else." Well, when he puts it that way... "It's for science." What do you need to do? "Like I said, lie here and hold still. You don't need to be perfectly unmoving for the hour or so, but as little as possible would be nice." You look up at the device Darius called the flux analyser, complete with the lens of polished crystal set into its underside, and try not to heave a sigh as you realize you'll be staring up at its slightly unnerving and alien form all the while. Darius shrugs, gives you an apologetic smile, and tries to engage you in idle conversation while Barney's tinkertoy does its work. While the 'mander made clearly isn't the best at conversation, [pc.isMage |he does bring out a variety of arcane writings he's brought back from his latest trip back to Tychris, and at least the two of you have some common ground to discuss as you while away the time. "It's kind of annoying that I've been asked to report back every fortnight, but it does give me the opportunity to return old material to the palace library and get new writings for the avenue of research on the portal we're pursuing at the moment." Is Tychris interested in what's going on here in Hawkethorne with the portal? Darius hums. "Those lizards never seem quite interested in anything I do, but then again they never seem quite interested in anything, anyway. I'd say no, but I'm not the best judge of people and they do want me to show back in person for my report, even if I think it's just a formality. Who knows?" |he does try to engage you in conversation about the goings-on in the temple and down in Hawkethorne. It doesn't go swimmingly well, given how he actively tries to go into town as little as possible, but it's a good effort to keep you distracted, if nothing else. [var1 |"You're intimately acquainted with Selima, right?" Given that you were the one who asked the trio of kittens to hang around town, yes, you are. "Like, um, can you tell me something about some of the things she likes?" Now that's an interesting question, and accompanied by a slip in his speech patterns no less. What's up? "You know. I'd, uh, just like to get to know her better, that's all. Might lead somewhere. Might not. But you won't know if you don't try, right? I mean, what's the worst that could happen, really? I get turned down?" |"Ogrish does surprisingly fine work for what he has on hand. This town is full of good people, despite being on the frontier backwaters." Well, like attracts like, as the saying goes. "No matter how fine the components Barnaphous needs from him, he's always been able to turn them out according to specifications. That kind of reliability is hard to find these days, especially in places where you don't have a long-standing craftsmens' tradition..." Like in Tychris? "...Well, yes." ] ] Eventually, though, the device's whirring comes to a halt, and it lets out a click with a distinct note of finality. Crossing over to the flux analyser, Darius removes the chip of sapphire from its side and carefully pulls away the device, returning it to its proper position in the makeshift laboratory before returning to you. "Ah. I'm sorry to be so abrupt, but I would like to get this down on paper properly before too long." He fingers the gem chip. "Do you mind if I take my leave?" No, not at all. You're glad to have helped. "I'm not leaving you to dry once I've gotten what I wanted or anything, but I do need to concentrate for this. I do apologise." With that, Darius heads back over to the laboratory table, gathering a stick of charcoal and some paper; with a flick of a finger, the 'mander mage projects forth a pattern of roiling color up from the glimmering sapphire chip and starts copying it down, his tail lashing about in excitement. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... |The both of you head away from the laboratory and over to the cushions and perfumes of Cait's quarters, where the 'mander mage asks you to sit down on one of the luxuriant couches and wait. "I'll get a couple of things I need for the examination. Do pardon me." But of course. Darius soon returns with several metal and wooden implements, and draws up a chair for himself. "All right, now — I'm going to give you a brief physical. Admittedly, I'm not the best at either anatomy or the like, but I'd wager I'm the best we have for miles around and you make do with what you have. If you don't mind, I'm going to have to come into contact with you at several points, so — " [pc.dcb |Yeah, he can just get on with it already instead of boring you. |You understand. He can begin anytime he likes. |Ooh, is the 'mander going to touch you with his scaly hands? You, like, totally enjoy being touched, so he can touch you all he wants! ] Darius sighs and nods. "All right, then. Just relax..." The next half-hour or so passes in silence save for the occasional hum of consideration from Darius. You can't help but feel like a show horse as he inspects your eyes, your ears, your limbs; the 'mander mage requests several times that you flex some muscles, and pinches and squeezes away. It's clear that he's trying to be professional and distant in all this, but isn't letting that hamper the effectiveness or efficiency of his physical. "Now, say ah." Ah...? "Hm. Interesting, interesting. I didn't know people could have such stretchy throats — I wonder if that's another effect of the portal on you? Maybe... " Darius scratches his chin, and then his eyes light up. "I'll have to see if that matches any anomalies on your aura, but that's something I hadn't noticed before." What didn't he notice before? He waves you off. "Not yet, not yet. I don't want to get either of us excited over what might very well be a dud, but it's given me something to think about. Actually, we're done for today." That quickly? You'd have expected a bodily examination to have lasted longer. "Well, it's — ah — non-invasive, and I do want to get this all down while it's fresh in my mind. Now, sorry to run out on you like this, but I really must record my observations..." Giving you a clap on the shoulder, Darius packs up his various bits and bobs and makes a brisk pace for the laboratory, pulling up seat at the table before scribbling away while his tail lashes about in excitement. Guess this is it for the rest of the day... ] "

rows.original: "Ah. Well..." Is something the matter? "That's rather flattering, especially for someone who's a bit of a shut-in like me and having suffered a bit of heartbreak in my time. I thought I had it once... but even today, I'm still learning to understand about connecting with others. I just would rather... "...Well, I'll be blunt: you're a little too hard for my type. It brings back memories of my second owner and what she and her lover did to me, and that really just kills any attraction in that sense stone dead. I'm sorry." Ah... "It's nothing inherently wrong with you or anything, I know you're a nice person to be associating with Barnaphous and his daughter. I just can't feel for someone who looks like that. Sorry." [flags.EVELYN_PAST|"So if Hawkethorne is your escape from your family, do you think there's much of a chance they come here for you?" you ask her.

    "Honestly? No," Evelyn replies with a casual shrug. "It's incredibly unlikely. They're looking for me, of that I have no doubt, but they would never imagine I'd be here. I'm sure just considering it would have my parents turning their nose up at the idea."
    
    "It's not much of a place for royalty," you say, smiling at her.
    
    "But the creature comforts certainly make it appealing," she murmurs, reaching out and caressing your cheek. "Don't they, [pc.name]?"
    
    [pc.isBimbo|"I hope so! I don't want you to leave," you say, looking at her wide-eyed. "I like you too much!"
    
    Evelyn grins, then laughs, patting your cheek. "Oh, [pc.name]. You are a wonderful [pc.mf|person|woman]."|"I hope so," you mumble, leaning into her touch. "I don't want you to leave, Evelyn."
    
    "Oh, darling," she whispers, patting your cheek and smiling. "No need to worry about that."]|"You said Hawkethorne was an escape. Are you on the run from something? [pc.dcb|Or someone? I'll get rid of them if you want.|I can protect you, if you like.|I'll save you!]"
    
    "Thank you for the offer, and I mean that," Evelyn says with a smile. "Unfortunately, there's no single opponent for you or anyone to strike at. I came here because — well, because I was tired, I suppose. I don't think running away from your problems is a commendable solution but sometimes it's the only way, especially when the power structure isn't in your favor."
    
    "Sorry I'm being so vague, [pc.name]," she adds, looking downcast for a moment. "I don't want to reveal too much when it could hurt both of us."
    
    "It's okay," you say, patting her hand. "We've all got a few secrets."
    
    "I can only imagine yours," she says, half-laughing as she turns to you. "I don't know if you realize quite how much of an enigma you are, [pc.name]. Do you appear in front of all of the damsels in distress, or is it just me?"
    
    "Just some good luck," you say, grinning.
    
    "And a bit of desire," Evelyn murmurs, leaning in until her pretty face is only a couple of inches from yours. "Or was I wrong when I thought I saw you imagining yourself in that girl's place when we met?" Lifting her hand, she gently brushes the backs of her fingers against your cheek and smiles. "Only teasing, of course."
    
    Of course.]

    “这里确实算不上适合王族的地方，”你朝她微笑。
    
    “不过，生活上的舒适享受确实让这里变得颇具吸引力，”她低声说道，伸手抚摸你的脸颊。“不是吗，[pc.name]？”
    
    [pc.isBimbo|“希望如此！我不想让你离开，”你睁大眼睛看着她。“我实在太喜欢你了！”
    
    伊芙琳咧嘴一笑，随后笑出声来，轻轻拍着你的脸颊。“哦，[pc.name]。你真是个了不起的[pc.mf|人|女人]。”|“希望如此，”你含糊呢喃，主动贴近她的抚摸。“我不想让你离开，伊芙琳。”
    
    “噢，亲爱的，”她轻拍你的脸颊，微笑着低语。“不必为此担心。”]|“你说鹰棘镇是个避风港。你在躲避什么吗？[pc.dcb|或者某个人？只要你愿意，我可以除掉他们。|如果你愿意，我可以保护你。|我会拯救你！]”
    
    “谢谢你的好意，我是真心的，”伊芙琳微笑着说道。“可惜，并不存在一个能让你或其他任何人出手打倒的单独对手。我来到这里，是因为——好吧，我想是因为自己累了。我不认为逃避问题是什么值得赞扬的解决办法，可有时那是唯一的出路，尤其当权力结构对你不利时。”
    
    “抱歉说得这么含糊，[pc.name]，”她又说道，神情一时有些消沉。“我不愿透露太多，因为那可能同时伤害你我。”
    
    “没关系，”你拍拍她的手。“每个人都有一些秘密。”
    
    “我只能想象你藏着怎样的秘密，”她转向你，半是轻笑着说道。“[pc.name]，不知道你是否意识到，自己究竟是个多么神秘的人。你会出现在所有身陷困境的少女面前，还是只出现在我面前？”
    
    “只是运气不错，”你咧嘴笑道。
    
    “或许还有一点欲望，”伊芙琳低声说道，向你靠近，直到那张俏脸距离你只有几英寸。“还是说，我们相遇时，我以为你正在想象自己处于那个女孩的位置，其实是我看错了？”她抬起手，以指背轻柔擦过你的脸颊，露出微笑。“当然，只是在逗你。”
    
    当然。]

"Are the people you're running from that powerful?" you ask. "Yes. Well, not here. I imagine I'm beyond their reach by now, though you never know with royalty," she sighs. "You have royalty chasing you?" you say, jaw dropping in surprise. "Oh, yes," Evelyn murmurs. "They're looking for their pawn." She gives another sigh before continuing. "I was born in the city of Elou — the capital of Yvennes, far south of here." Yvennes? That's more than a month away by carriage. You stay silent, listening to what Evelyn has to say. rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Granting Evelyn draconic power will have far-reaching consequences. To grant a mortal the power of a dragon is a momentous decision.
rows.translation: 赋予伊芙琳龙之力将会带来深远的后果。把龙的力量赐予一个凡人，是一项极其重大的决定。
rows.raw: "\n Granting Evelyn draconic power will have far-reaching consequences. To grant a mortal the power of a dragon is a momentous decision.\n "

rows.translation: 继续
伊芙琳值得拥有这一切。
返回
你正在重新考虑这件事。
加斯
加斯

rows.original: The tavern's owner is working the bar, as always. He doesn't seem particularly busy — you could probably strike up a conversation.
rows.translation: 酒馆的主人像往常一样在吧台忙碌着。他看起来并不特别忙，你应该可以和他聊上几句。
rows.raw: "The tavern's owner is working the bar, as always. He doesn't seem particularly busy — you could probably strike up a conversation."

rows.translation: 睡觉
与[bedmateFH.name][bedmateFH.is azzy|[flags.AZZY_BRI_SLEEP 1| 还有布蕾妮]]上床。
伊芙琳

rows.original: Evelyn is sleeping — don't wake her up just yet.
rows.translation: 伊芙琳正在睡觉——暂时不要吵醒她。
rows.raw: "Evelyn is sleeping — don't wake her up just yet."

rows.translation: 杰琳
[flags.ALICE_MET|爱丽丝|圣骑士]

rows.original: [flags.ALICE_MET|Say hello to Alice.|Approach the paladin and introduce yourself.]
rows.translation: [flags.ALICE_MET|向爱丽丝问好吧。|走向那位圣骑士，自我介绍一下。]
rows.raw: "[flags.ALICE_MET|Say hello to Alice.|Approach the paladin and introduce yourself.]"

rows.translation: 同伴们
返回
与你的同伴互动吧。
顾客们
返回

rows.original: Interact with some of the patrons of the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: 与霜犬酒馆的一些顾客互动吧。
rows.raw: "Interact with some of the patrons of the Frost Hound."

rows.translation: 自慰

rows.original: Let loose some of that pent-up energy.
rows.translation: 把那些积压的能量释放出来吧。
rows.raw: "Let loose some of that pent-up energy."

rows.translation: 加雷特
去和加雷特谈谈吧。

rows.original: Garret doesn't seem to be here right now. Come back between 7-9 or 19-21.
rows.translation: 加雷特现在似乎不在这里。请在早上7点到9点或者晚上7点到9点之间再来吧。
rows.raw: "Garret doesn't seem to be here right now. Come back between 7-9 or 19-21."

rows.original: Brienne mentioned you'd get another present tonight. Wonder what that could be?
rows.translation: 布蕾妮说过，你今晚还会收到另一份礼物。不知道会是什么呢？
rows.raw: "Brienne mentioned you'd get another present tonight. Wonder what that could be?"

rows.original: Brint mentioned you'd get the rest of your present tonight. What ever could he possibly have meant?
rows.translation: 布林特说过你今晚会收到剩下的礼物。他到底是什么意思呢？
rows.raw: "Brint mentioned you'd get the rest of your present tonight. What ever could he possibly have meant?"

rows.translation: 瑞弗

rows.original: Garth mentioned talking with River about the task ahead. He might have some more information to offer you.
rows.translation: 加斯提到他已经和瑞弗讨论过接下来的任务，他可能还有一些信息可以提供给你。
rows.raw: "Garth mentioned talking with River about the task ahead. He might have some more information to offer you."

rows.original: Go on a date with the half-leothran twins.
rows.translation: 和那对半莱奥特兰双胞胎去约会吧。
rows.raw: "Go on a date with the half-leothran twins."

rows.translation: 阿斯特莱娅
枕边人
决定谁会与你同床共枕吧。

rows.original: You give Garth[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] a wave goodnight and head up to your room to sleep. You slip out of your [pc.armor] and crawl into bed, pulling the blankets tight around yourself and settling in for a much-deserved rest...
rows.translation: 你向加斯[party.solo|| 以及你的同伴[party.som|||]]挥手道晚安，然后上楼回自己的房间睡觉。你脱下[pc.armor]，钻进被窝，把毯子紧紧裹在身上，安顿下来享受这应得的休息……
rows.raw: "You give Garth[party.solo|| and your companion[party.som|||s]] a wave goodnight and head up to your room to sleep. You slip out of your [pc.armor] and crawl into bed, pulling the blankets tight around yourself and settling in for a much-deserved rest..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You wake up with a huge yawn and a stretch, rolling out of bed and gathering your gear. It's still dark out; the first hints of the sunrise are just peeking through the horizon outside your window. You've slept all you can manage this night. Time to see what the new day has in store!
rows.translation: 你打着一个大大的哈欠，伸了个懒腰，然后从床上爬起来，收拾好装备。外面还是一片暗影，天边的地平线上才刚刚出现一丝黎明的曙光。今晚你已经睡得够多了，是时候看看新的一天会带来什么了！
rows.raw: "You wake up with a huge yawn and a stretch, rolling out of bed and gathering your gear. It's still dark out; the first hints of the sunrise are just peeking through the horizon outside your window. You've slept all you can manage this night. Time to see what the new day has in store!"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You take a seat at the bar across from the old wolf, giving him a slight nod. He returns it, setting aside the mug he was polishing off and flicking his towel over his shoulder. "[pc.name]," he says, voice deep and gruff as ever. "What can I do for you?"
rows.translation: 你在老狼对面的吧台找了个位置坐下，向他微微点了点头。他也回以点头，然后放下他正在擦拭的杯子，把毛巾搭在肩上。 “[pc.name]，”他说道，声音依旧低沉而沙哑。“我能为您做些什么吗？”
rows.raw: ' You take a seat at the bar across from the old wolf, giving him a slight nod. He returns it, setting aside the mug he was polishing off and flicking his towel over his shoulder. "[pc.name]," he says, voice deep and gruff as ever. "What can I do for you?"'

rows.translation: 喝吧
点杯饮料吧！
喝吧

rows.original: You don't have the 10 EC required to get a drink.
rows.translation: 你没有购买饮料所需的10枚琥珀金币。
rows.raw: "You don't have the 10 EC required to get a drink."

rows.translation: 对话

rows.original: See if Garth's got a few minutes to chat.
rows.translation: 看看加斯是否有几分钟时间可以聊一聊。
rows.raw: "See if Garth's got a few minutes to chat."

rows.translation: 训练

rows.original: The old wolf's clearly had some experience. Maybe he could show you a thing or two?
rows.translation: 那只老狼显然经验丰富，或许他能教你一些东西吧？
rows.raw: "The old wolf's clearly had some experience. Maybe he could show you a thing or two?"

rows.translation: 奖章
上好的葡萄酒

rows.original: Inquire after getting some real wine for Evelyn and yourself to drink together. Hopefully her palate hasn't changed too much since her transformation...
rows.translation: 问问看能不能弄到一些真正的葡萄酒，好让你和伊芙琳一起喝。希望她在转变之后口味没有太大变化……
rows.raw: "Inquire after getting some real wine for Evelyn and yourself to drink together. Hopefully her palate hasn't changed too much since her transformation..."

rows.translation: 上好的葡萄酒

rows.original: Ask about getting a fancy vintage.
rows.translation: 询问能否弄到一瓶上好的陈年佳酿。
索尔维格的父亲
加斯，你是孩子的父亲吗？
园艺

rows.original: You've got a gardening problem north of town that Garth and the people of Hawkethorne might be able to help you with...
rows.translation: 在城镇的北部，你们遇到了园艺方面的问题，或许加斯以及鹰棘镇的居民能够帮助你们解决……
rows.raw: "You've got a gardening problem north of town that Garth and the people of Hawkethorne might be able to help you with..."

rows.translation: 驿堡

rows.original: Ask Garth about renovating the Wayfort. This will cost you 2500 EC!
rows.translation: 去问问加斯关于翻修荒废驿堡的事吧。这会花费你2500艾克朗哦！
rows.raw: "Ask Garth about renovating the Wayfort. This will cost you 2500 EC!"

rows.translation: 你需要2500枚琥珀金币。
艾莱赫

rows.original: Ask Garth for a Carpenter. This will cost you 1000 EC!
rows.translation: 向加斯请求派一名木匠来。这会花费你1000枚琥珀金币！
rows.raw: "Ask Garth for a Carpenter. This will cost you 1000 EC!"

rows.translation: 你需要1000枚琥珀金币。
寺庙

rows.original: With the baroness deposed, Garth is the de facto alderman of Hawkethorne — if there's anyone to be asked about putting up new buildings, it's him.
rows.translation: 在女男爵被罢免后，加斯实际上成为了鹰棘镇的市政官员——如果要有人被询问关于新建建筑的事宜，那肯定就是他了。
rows.raw: "With the baroness deposed, Garth is the de facto alderman of Hawkethorne — if there's anyone to be asked about putting up new buildings, it's him."

rows.original: It'd be better if Cait were here to explain things herself; she has a better idea of what she wants to do. Best for him to hear it straight from the cat's mouth than to have things lost when running messages.
rows.translation: 要是凯特能在场亲自解释这些事情，那就更好了。她更清楚自己想要做什么。对他来说，直接从她口中听到这些话，总比通过别人转达后信息变得模糊不清要好得多。
rows.raw: "It'd be better if Cait were here to explain things herself; she has a better idea of what she wants to do. Best for him to hear it straight from the cat's mouth than to have things lost when running messages."

rows.translation: 寺庙
武器

rows.original: You have a crate of weapons. Garth's defacto alderman of the town. Does Hawkethorne's little militia need some fine new arms?
rows.translation: 你有一箱武器。加斯其实是这个小镇的实质上的行政长官。鹰棘镇那支小小的民兵组织，是不是需要一些精良的新武器呢？
rows.raw: "You have a crate of weapons. Garth's defacto alderman of the town. Does Hawkethorne's little militia need some fine new arms?"

rows.translation: 寺庙

rows.original: You have the five thousand hawks needed to get started on Cait's temple.
rows.translation: 你已经拥有了开始建造凯特神庙所需的五千枚鹰币。
rows.raw: "You have the five thousand hawks needed to get started on Cait's temple."

rows.original: You don't have the money needed for this — Garth mentioned a sum of five thousand hawks the last time you spoke with him on the matter.
rows.translation: 你没有所需的资金——上次你就这件事与他交谈时，加斯提到过一笔五千枚鹰币的数额。
rows.raw: "You don't have the money needed for this — Garth mentioned a sum of five thousand hawks the last time you spoke with him on the matter."

rows.translation: 佐的家

rows.original: Garth is the kind of guy that's in-the-know about everything that goes on in Hawkethorne. Maybe he knows someone that can help with Zo's house?
rows.translation: 加斯是那种对鹰棘镇发生的所有事情都了如指掌的人。也许他认识某个能帮助佐解决房子问题的人吧？
rows.raw: "Garth is the kind of guy that's in-the-know about everything that goes on in Hawkethorne. Maybe he knows someone that can help with Zo's house?"

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: [pc.dcb|"Hit me."|"I'll take a drink, Garth."|"Could I, like, get a drink? Pretty please?" you ask, batting your lashes at the grizzled lupine.] "Sure, [pc.name]," he says, turning towards the huge rack of bottles behind the bar. "What're you having?"
rows.translation: [pc.dcb|打我。|我喝点东西吧，加斯。|能给我拿杯喝的吗？真的拜托了？你这样说着，一边眨着眼睛，望着那只灰白的狼。] 当然，[pc.name]，”他说道，同时转向吧台后面那巨大的酒瓶架。你在吃什么？
rows.raw: ' [pc.dcb|"Hit me."|"I'll take a drink, Garth."|"Could I, like, get a drink? Pretty please?" you ask, batting your lashes at the grizzled lupine.] "Sure, [pc.name]," he says, turning towards the huge rack of bottles behind the bar. "What're you having?" '

rows.translation: 蜂蜜酒

rows.original: A sweet mead cultivated from honey, this drink is particularly popular here in the north where it's more difficult to grow grapes. Folk wisdom says a draught a day's good for the mind. Maximizes Cunning.
rows.translation: 这种用蜂蜜酿制的甜酒在北方特别受欢迎，因为在那里种植葡萄相当困难。民间有句俗语说，每天喝一杯这种酒对大脑有益。 最大限度地发挥机敏与机智。
rows.raw: "A sweet mead cultivated from honey, this drink is particularly popular here in the north where it's more difficult to grow grapes. Folk wisdom says a draught a day's good for the mind.\n\nMaximizes Cunning."

rows.translation: 香料热葡萄酒

rows.original: Imported wine heated and spiced to perfection. A favored drink of the nobility, thought to be excellent for your health in the cold north. Maximizes Toughness.
rows.translation: 进口葡萄酒经过精心加热和调味，成为了贵族们喜爱的饮品。人们认为，在寒冷的北方，这种酒对健康非常有益。 最大化体魄度。
rows.raw: "Imported wine heated and spiced to perfection. A favored drink of the nobility, thought to be excellent for your health in the cold north.\n\nMaximizes Toughness."

rows.translation: 黑麦啤酒

rows.original: The common drink of peasants and laborers, beer is cheap and easy to make, and frequently consumed to fortify yourself for hard work or battle ahead. Maximizes Strength.
rows.translation: 啤酒是农民和劳动者们常饮的饮品，它价格低廉且制作简单，人们经常饮用它来为繁重的劳动或即将到来的战斗积蓄体力。 最大化力量。
rows.raw: "The common drink of peasants and laborers, beer is cheap and easy to make, and frequently consumed to fortify yourself for hard work or battle ahead.\n\nMaximizes Strength."

rows.translation: 苹果酒

rows.original: A sugary sweet cider that's plentiful in the fertile mountain valleys. Keeps you quick and alert, even when battered down by the ever-present snow and the long winter nights. Maximizes Agility.
rows.translation: 这种甜如糖果的苹果酒在肥沃的山间谷地中十分常见。即使面对持续不断的积雪和漫长的冬夜，它也能让你保持清醒与活力。 最大化敏捷。
rows.raw: "A sugary sweet cider that's plentiful in the fertile mountain valleys. Keeps you quick and alert, even when battered down by the ever-present snow and the long winter nights.\n\nMaximizes Agility."

rows.translation: 修道院麦酒
修道院麦酒

rows.original: A dark ale brewed by monks at the Monastery of the Tree Father far to the south. The initiates drink it to steel their nerves and focus their will before rituals. Maximizes Willpower.
rows.translation: 这是一种由远在南方的“树之父修道院”僧侣们酿造的深色艾尔啤酒。初入门的修士会在举行仪式之前饮用它，以镇定心神、集中意志。 最大化意志。
rows.raw: "A dark ale brewed by monks at the Monastery of the Tree Father far to the south. The initiates drink it to steel their nerves and focus their will before rituals.\n\nMaximizes Willpower."

rows.translation: 恋人干啤

rows.original: A dry, light beer made by the minotaurs of the eastern mountains to get drunk slowly, letting lovers take their time getting to know one another... and pay for a few more beers. Maximizes Presence.
rows.translation: 这是一种由东部山区的弥诺陶洛斯酿造的清淡的干啤，能让人慢慢进入醉意，好让恋人们有足够的时间去了解彼此……并为此多付几杯酒钱。 最大化气场。
rows.raw: "A dry, light beer made by the minotaurs of the eastern mountains to get drunk slowly, letting lovers take their time getting to know one another... and pay for a few more beers.\n\nMaximizes Presence."

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: "Gimme another," you slur at Garth, indicating the bottle you want. The old wolf glances between you, the booze, and the handful of coins you're trying to shove at him. "You sure,
rows.translation: “再给我来一个，”你对着加斯嘟囔着，以此来示意你想要哪瓶酒。 那只老狼将目光在你、酒，以及你试图塞给他的那几枚硬币之间来回转动。你确定？
rows.raw: ' "Gimme another," you slur at Garth, indicating the bottle you want. The old wolf glances between you, the booze, and the handful of coins you're trying to shove at him. "You sure, '

rows.original: ? You look like you're halfway to falling over already."
rows.translation: 你看起来都快站不稳了。
rows.raw: "? You look like you're halfway to falling over already." "

rows.original: you insist, making grabby hands at the liquor rack. The old wolf rolls his eyes and makes the exchange, planting the bottle in your hands and giving you a wide berth to enjoy your drinking spree in peace. Which you do, thoroughly and completely, pounding back the entire bottle until you're a
rows.translation: 你坚持己见，伸手去拿酒架上的酒。老狼翻了个白眼，然后把酒瓶递到你手里，同时退到一边，让你能安心地痛饮一番。 你确实这么做了，把整瓶酒都喝了个精光，直到
rows.raw: " you insist, making grabby hands at the liquor rack. The old wolf rolls his eyes and makes the exchange, planting the bottle in your hands and giving you a wide berth to enjoy your drinking spree in peace.\n \n Which you do, thoroughly and completely, pounding back the entire bottle until you're a "

rows.original: , blurry-eyed mess and so close to retching that you force yourself to your feet and start staggering for the door. Of course, in your state, you don't make it more than three steps before you face plant into the sawdust-covered floor. The world goes black...
rows.translation: 你的眼睛模糊不清，几乎要吐出来，于是你强撑着站起来，摇摇晃晃地朝门口走去。然而，以你现在的状态，还没走三步，就重重地摔在了满是锯末的地板上。世界陷入一片黑暗……
rows.raw: ", blurry-eyed mess and so close to retching that you force yourself to your feet and start staggering for the door. Of course, in your state, you don't make it more than three steps before you face plant into the sawdust-covered floor. The world goes black..."

rows.translation: “别告诉我该做什么！”
“我没事，我没事，”
但是加尔啊
下一步

rows.original: You slide a few small coins across the bar, and in their place appears a
rows.translation: 你将几枚小硬币滑到吧台上，然后它们的位置上出现了一个东西。
rows.raw: "\n    You slide a few small coins across the bar, and in their place appears a "

rows.original: . You raise it to the venerable bartender and slam down your
rows.translation: 你将酒杯举到那位德高望重的调酒师面前，然后一饮而尽。
rows.raw: ". You raise it to the venerable bartender and slam down your "

rows.original:
brew of the day. Nobody ever accused Garth of watering down the mead here, that's for sure: by the time you've finished a chaser shot your whole world is blurry and swimming around, making just the act of standing up an effort in and of itself. You catch yourself on the bar side before you can plummet face-first into the sawdust, groaning as a headache sets in.

    This probably wasn't your best idea...
rows.translation:
当天的特色饮品。可以肯定的是，从来没有人指责过加斯在这里稀释这种蜂蜜酒：当你喝完第二杯酒之后，整个世界都会变得模糊不清，东西都在眼前晃动，就连站起来都成了一件困难的事。你不得不抓住吧台才能避免脸先着地摔进锯末里，同时也会因为头痛而发出呻吟声。

    ……这大概真不是个好主意……
rows.raw: " brew of the day. Nobody ever accused Garth of watering down the mead here, that's for sure: by the time you've finished a chaser shot your whole world is blurry and swimming around, making just the act of standing up an effort in and of itself. You catch yourself on the bar side before you can plummet face-first into the sawdust, groaning as a headache sets in.\n\n    This probably wasn't your best idea..."

rows.original: You slide a few small coins across the bar, and in their place appears a
rows.translation: 你将几枚小硬币滑到吧台上，然后它们的位置上出现了一个东西。
rows.raw: "\n    You slide a few small coins across the bar, and in their place appears a "

rows.original: . You raise it to the venerable bartender and down your drink over the course of a few minutes, enjoying the peace and quiet.
rows.translation: 你将酒杯举向那位德高望重的调酒师，然后在几分钟内慢慢品尝着这杯酒，尽情享受这份宁静与安宁。
rows.raw: ". You raise it to the venerable bartender and down your drink over the course of a few minutes, enjoying the peace and quiet."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original:
When you open your eyes, they burn with a sudden rush of sunlight through your window. You recoil and grab your head, feeling it throb between your fingers. Gods damn, your head hurts!

    After a few moments of writhing around, you manage to throw your legs out of bed and stagger out. You feel sick to your stomach, you're naked, and you're not sure where half your belongings are
rows.translation:
当你睁开眼睛时，突如其来的阳光透过窗户照进你的眼睛，刺得你睁不开眼。你赶紧缩回身体，用手抱住头部，感觉头部在手指间跳动着，疼得要命——该死的，头好疼！

    在痛苦中挣扎了几分钟后，你终于勉强把腿从床上拖下来，摇摇晃晃地走了出去。你感到一阵恶心，而且自己是光着身的，更不知道自己的一半东西去哪儿了……
rows.raw:
"
    When you open your eyes, they burn with a sudden rush of sunlight through your window. You recoil and grab your head, feeling it throb between your fingers. Gods damn, your head hurts!

    After a few moments of writhing around, you manage to throw your legs out of bed and stagger out. You feel sick to your stomach, you're naked, and you're not sure where half your belongings are"

rows.original:
. You sigh and curse to yourself, starting to gather up your belongings. Who knows what you got up to last night... 
    
    Better take it easy on the booze, or you're not sure you're gonna be able to look Garth in the eye next time.
rows.translation:
你叹了口气，暗自咒骂着，开始收拾自己的东西。谁知道你昨晚到底干了些什么呢…… 
    
    最好少喝点酒，否则下次见到加斯时，你可能都没法直视他的眼睛了。
rows.raw: ". You sigh and curse to yourself, starting to gather up your belongings. Who knows what you got up to last night... \n    \n    Better take it easy on the booze, or you're not sure you're gonna be able to look Garth in the eye next time."

rows.original: — including a hefty portion of your coinpurse
rows.translation: ——其中包括你钱包里的一大笔钱
rows.raw: " — including a hefty portion of your coinpurse"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Mind answering a few questions for me, Garth?" The wolf-man shrugs and tosses his ever-present dishrag over his shoulder, planting his still-strong arms on the edge of the bar. "Sure, [pc.name]. That's pretty much what we bartenders are for — that, and listening to sob stories." He chuckles at himself before motioning for you to proceed. What do you ask him?
rows.translation: “加斯，能回答我几个问题吗？” 那个狼人耸了耸肩，把那块随时挂在身旁的抹布甩到肩上，然后将自己依然强壮的双臂搭在吧台的边缘。“当然，[pc.name]。这差不多就是我们调酒师存在的意义——除了调酒，就是听人诉苦。” 他自顾自地笑了笑，然后示意你可以继续了。你打算问他什么问题呢？

rows.original: [livrea.inHawk |"I met a bard, Livrea," you tell Garth. "Do you know anything about her?" The old wolf puts down the mug he's cleaning with a fond smile. "Ah, yes, River's only competition around here. She's passed through here plenty of times, does a circuit between the Marches and Sartanni a couple times a year. Always pays her tab on time, and even tips Gwyn when she's working here. Good kid. Y'know, she asked about you while you were knocked out after the storm, said she wanted a chance to interview a real hero." [party.has cait |Cait giggles. "I get the feeling that if I hadn't been able to take care of you, she'd have volunteered." ] "Do you think she'd be able to get back home on her own?" you ask. "She thinks the foothills are pretty dangerous." Garth shakes his head. "I wouldn't go out alone these days unless I had no other choice. Liv's mentioned her folks both work for the Royal Navy in Khor'minos, so I'd guess she knows how to use that sword she carries, but I urged her to think twice about trying to sneak back there by her lonesome. [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED |Even with the Kervus taken care of, it's still plenty dangerous out there for a girl all by herself. |Especially with orcs prowling the foothills. Most brigands'll just have their way with you if you can't fight 'em off, but orcs might clap a collar on you and drag you back to the islands. ] I'd feel a lot better if you walked her home, but a big group walking the road to Khor'minos is just as likely to attract a lot of unwanted attention. Your call." |"Hey, Garth, what ever happened to Livrea?" you ask. "I don't see her around town anymore." Garth shrugs. "She left a bit after you went off north. Asked me to let you know she's headed back to Khor'minos — that huge city under the mountain off east of here — and to wish you luck on your adventures." "Oh." A pause. "Did things get any safer in the foothills since then?" "No, but I hear she traded a bottle of Sartanni red wine to Ivris for a whole sack full of leananstones. Probably good enough to scare off just about anything out there, at least until she gets to the King's Gate." Ah. Looks like you'll next see Livrea in Khor'minos, then. ]
rows.translation: [livrea.inHawk |“我遇见了一位名叫莉维娅的吟游诗人，”你对加斯说道。“你了解她吗？” 老狼满脸亲切的笑容，放下了手中正在擦拭的酒杯。“啊，当然。她是这一带唯一能和瑞弗竞争的人。她来过这里许多次，每年都要在边疆和萨塔尼之间往返几趟。她每次都按时结清酒钱，格温在这里工作时，她甚至还会给小费。是个好孩子。你知道吗，暴风雨后你昏迷的那段时间，她还向我打听过你，说想找机会采访一位真正的英雄。” [party.has cait |凯特咯咯笑道。“我有种感觉，要不是我能照顾好你，她一定会主动请缨。” ] “你觉得她能独自回家吗？”你问道。“她觉得山麓相当危险。” 加斯摇了摇头。“这年头，除非别无选择，否则我可不会独自外出。莉芙提过，她的父母都在科尔米诺斯的皇家海军服役，所以我猜她知道该怎么用随身的那把剑；但我还是劝她三思，别一个人偷偷摸回去。[flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED |即使克尔维斯已经被解决了，外面对孤身一人的姑娘来说还是危险得很。 |尤其是还有兽人在山麓游荡。多数匪徒见你无力抵抗，顶多只是占你的便宜，可兽人说不定会给你套上项圈，把你拖回群岛。 ] 要是你能送她回家，我会安心许多；不过一大群人沿着通往科尔米诺斯的道路前进，同样很容易引来许多不必要的关注。由你决定吧。” |“嘿，加斯，莉维娅后来怎么样了？”你问道。“我最近在镇上都没见到她。” 加斯耸了耸肩。“你动身北上后没多久，她就离开了。她让我转告你，她已经启程返回科尔米诺斯——就是东边那座建在山下的巨城——还让我祝你冒险顺利。” “哦。”你停顿了一下。“此后山麓变得安全些了吗？” “没有，不过我听说她用一瓶萨塔尼红葡萄酒，从艾薇莉丝那里换了满满一袋利南石。那东西大概足以吓退外面的任何威胁，至少能保她平安抵达国王之门。” 原来如此。看来你下次会在科尔米诺斯见到莉维娅了。 ]

rows.original: Giving the old wolf a friendly smile, you ask if he wouldn't mind sharing some of his old war stories with you. Doesn't take a genius to realize he must have been a soldier, or even an adventurer like you, at some point. "That obvious?" he half laughs, half grunts. "What gave it away — my charming demeanor?" With a wry chuckle at his own joke, Garth rolls his broad shoulders and looks
rows.translation: 你对那只老狼露出友好的微笑，询问它是否愿意与你分享一些它过去的战争故事。其实不用费什么脑筋就能猜到，它肯定曾经当过士兵，或者像你一样，也是一名冒险家。 这么明显吗？他半笑半哼地回应道。是什么暴露了我的身份——是我那迷人的举止吗？ 加斯对自己开的玩笑报以苦笑，然后耸了耸宽大的肩膀，接着说道

Doesn't take a genius to realize he must have been a soldier, or even an adventurer like you, at some point. "That obvious?" he half laughs, half grunts. "What gave it away — my charming demeanor?" With a wry chuckle at his own joke, Garth rolls his broad shoulders and looks '

rows.original: at you. "Yeah, I was a mercenary first. Sellsword, hired onto a crew going treasure hunting in old Belharan ruins. Figured it would take me far from home, where people had gotten a little ruffled over a few too many pick-pocketings and burglaries."
rows.translation: 看向你。“没错，我最初是个雇佣兵。就是个佣兵，受雇加入了一支前往古老贝尔哈兰遗迹寻宝的队伍。我想这样就能远离家乡——那里的人因为扒窃和入室盗窃实在太多，已经有些坐不住了。”
rows.raw: ' at you. "Yeah, I was a mercenary first. Sellsword, hired onto a crew going treasure hunting in old Belharan ruins. Figured it would take me far from home, where people had gotten a little ruffled over a few too many pick-pocketings and burglaries."\n \n '

rows.original: Resting his arms on the bartop, he continues: "True to their word, I never saw home again. Went all over the southern heartlands, picking the smaller cities clean. Overgrown, falling apart, infested by kobolds on good days, and shadowy horrors on the bad... and with not a sign of the people that might have lived there once. Like everyone just gave up and left. Eerie. And dangerous, too. Lost half our number in the first year, dragged off by beasts or victim to their own greed. But it's also where I learned to fight, found more coin and loot than any so-called wealthy man back home... and where I met my wife." "So she was an adventurer too?" Garth nods. "The best of us. Captain of the Crossed Swords. Took a liking to a scrawny stray like me, of all people. Let it show when we were wintered in town, all crammed into that one little lodge. Every other man in the company burned with jealousy, let me tell you... but that's a winter I'll never forget." You can see the wistful smile plain on Garth's lupine face. He sighs, looking far away, and says, "We kept on like that for a few years. Kids came and went from the company, good ones and bad... and we just got older. More experienced. Harder. Somehow our luck held out for almost a decade of that, until one summer day my Captain comes to me and says she's pregnant. Gwyneth and her brother," he adds, nodding towards the out building where his daughter lives. "That changed things, of course," he laughs. "Can't go robbing tomb-cities and fighting bandits when you're waddling around with twins. Not that my wife didn't intend to! Nothing could stop her, not even when she was full of pups. Took everything I had to convince her we needed to leave her the company she'd inherited from her pa behind. Settle down. Make use of all the wealth we'd built up between us and make something for ourselves... and our children. So we came north, well past the reach of anyone that might want to do us harm, and we put down our roots here with a fresh-faced batch of outcasts and freeholders trying to resettle the old Marches." Garth yawns and stands up straight, stretching hard. "And that's the end of my adventuring career." You blink. "There's got to be more to it than that!" you complain. What about his leg? What happened to his wife? How'd they end up all the way out here? "Nosy brat, aren't you?" Garth chuckles, not unkindly. "It's been long enough that I don't mind the telling so much. Not as long as I've got a few drinks in me."
rows.translation: 他把双臂搁在吧台上，继续说道：“他们果真信守承诺，我再也没能见到家乡。我们踏遍了南方腹地，把那些小城市搜刮得一干二净。那里杂草丛生、摇摇欲坠；运气好时，只有狗头人盘踞其中，运气不好时，则会撞上潜伏在暗处的恐怖怪物……却连曾在那里生活过的人都不见踪影，仿佛所有人都放弃了一切，离开了那里。既诡异，又危险。头一年，我们就折损了一半人手：有的被野兽拖走，有的则成了自身贪欲的牺牲品。但也是在那里，我学会了战斗，找到的金币和战利品比家乡任何所谓的富人都多……还遇见了我的妻子。” “这么说，她也是位冒险者？” 加斯点点头。“她是我们当中最出色的人，也是交叉双剑团的团长。天底下那么多人，她偏偏看上了我这样一个瘦骨嶙峋的流浪汉。我们在镇上过冬，所有人都挤在那间小小的旅舍里时，她可没少表露心意。告诉你吧，团里的其他男人个个都嫉妒得发狂……但那个冬天，我永远不会忘记。” 加斯那张狼族面孔上的怅然微笑一览无余。他叹了口气，目光投向远方，说道：“后来几年，我们一直过着那样的生活。队伍里的年轻人来来去去，有好人，也有坏人……而我们只是渐渐老去，经验更加丰富，也更加坚韧。不知为何，我们的好运就这样维持了将近十年，直到某个夏日，我的团长来找我，说她怀孕了。怀的是格温妮丝和她的弟弟，”他补充道，同时朝女儿居住的外屋点了点头。 “这当然改变了一切，”他笑道。“肚子里揣着一对双胞胎，走路都摇摇摆摆时，可没法再去劫掠墓城、迎战强盗。倒不是说我妻子不想继续！没有什么能阻止她，就算肚子里怀满了小崽子也一样。我费尽口舌，才说服她把从父亲手中继承的队伍留在身后。安定下来。用我们共同积攒的财富，为自己……也为我们的孩子开创一番生活。于是我们一路北上，远远离开任何可能想伤害我们的人，和一群初来乍到、试图重新定居旧边疆的流亡者与自由民一起，在这里扎下了根。” 加斯打了个哈欠，站直身体，用力伸展四肢。“我的冒险生涯就此结束了。” 你眨了眨眼。“事情肯定不只这些！”你抱怨道。他的腿是怎么回事？他的妻子后来怎样了？他们又怎么会一路来到这里？ “你这小鬼，还挺爱打听的，是吧？”加斯笑道，语气中倒没有恶意。“事情已经过去这么久了，我也不怎么介意讲出来。尤其是肚子里已经灌了几杯酒的时候。”

rows.original: "You were a thief?" you ask, cocking an eyebrow. Not what you expected from a big, brawny fellow like him. Aren't thieves supposed to be lithe little guys
rows.translation: “你原来是个小偷？”你这么问，还挑了挑眉毛。真没想到他这样一个魁梧强壮的汉子会做出这种事。按常理来说，小偷应该都是些身手敏捷的小个子才对吧？
rows.raw: '\n "You were a thief?" you ask, cocking an eyebrow. Not what you expected from a big, brawny fellow like him. Aren\'t thieves supposed to be lithe little guys'

rows.original: Garth shifts his black nose at you. "Yeah, once upon a time. Lived in one of the bigger lupine villages to the southwest, a good few thousand of us. Enough to have both the poor and rich. And thieves, true, when us dirt farmers couldn't make ends meet between raiding season."
rows.translation: 加斯用它那黑色的鼻子朝你凑了过来。是的，很久很久以前。我们生活在西南部的一个较大的狼族村落里，有好几千人。那里既有穷人，也有富人。当然，也会有一些小偷——尤其是在我们这些农民在劫掠季节之外连基本生活都难以维持的时候。

rows.original: — then again, you're one to talk!
rows.translation: ——可话说回来，你自己也没资格说别人！
rows.raw: " — then again, you're one to talk!"

rows.translation: 他的冒险之旅

rows.original: "What can you tell me about the forest? You said people were getting attacked... disappearing?" "Ever since that night you and Cait went out, aye," Garth sighs. "The hunters went out in force once the blizzard passed, hoping to make up for lost time. Came back running in the days after, babbling about strange plant-creatures attacking them. Wolves running wild. The bee-folk we once traded with going mad and lashing out at anyone who drew near. Who knows what else." You have to ask: "Anything like this ever happen before?" Garth shakes his head. "Nothing this bad before. We've had lone monsters wander in before, big ones like manticores and drakes, but the hunters can usually drive them back before they cause too much damage. This, though, is every creature in the forest acting up at once it seems. Like they're being driven mad by something." "Any idea what?" The wolf-man sighs and sets down the glass he's been cleaning, bracing his hands on the bar and looking you square in the eye. "We both know what. There's no such thing as coincidence, kid. That demon you met on the hilltop... she's behind this. No doubt. Whether it's the demon herself, or some after-effect of whatever magic blew that temple up... I couldn't tell you." You were afraid of that. Damn. Garth gives you a reassuring pat
rows.translation: 你能告诉我关于那片森林的什么情况吗？你说有人在那里遭到袭击……还有人失踪了…… 从那个你们和凯特一起出去的夜晚之后，就是了。加斯叹了口气。暴风雪过后，猎人们全员出动，希望能弥补失去的时间。然而几天后他们慌忙返回，口中念叨着一些奇怪的事情：一些植物生物袭击了他们，野狼也开始肆意伤人，而我们曾经交易过的蜜蜂族也变得疯狂起来，见到任何人都会发起攻击。天知道还有哪些未知的危险在等待着他们…… 你得问问：以前有没有发生过类似的事情？ 加斯摇了摇头。从来没有这么糟糕的情况。以前确实也有单独出现的怪物，比如巨型螳螂或巨龙，但猎人们通常能在它们造成太大伤害之前将它们赶走。然而这次，似乎森林里的所有生物都同时发起了攻击，就好像有什么东西把它们逼疯了一样。 知道是什么吗？ 狼人叹了口气，放下了他一直在擦拭的玻璃杯，双手撑在吧台上，直视着你的眼睛。我们心里都明白。世上根本没有巧合这种东西，孩子。你在山顶遇到的那个恶魔……这一切肯定都与她有关。不管是她亲自出手，还是那些炸毁寺庙的魔法留下了后遗症……我也说不准。 你当时肯定是害怕的。真该死。 加斯拍了拍你的肩膀，让你感到安心。
rows.raw: ' "What can you tell me about the forest? You said people were getting attacked... disappearing?" "Ever since that night you and Cait went out, aye," Garth sighs. "The hunters went out in force once the blizzard passed, hoping to make up for lost time. Came back running in the days after, babbling about strange plant-creatures attacking them. Wolves running wild. The bee-folk we once traded with going mad and lashing out at anyone who drew near. Who knows what else." You have to ask: "Anything like this ever happen before?" Garth shakes his head. "Nothing this bad before. We've had lone monsters wander in before, big ones like manticores and drakes, but the hunters can usually drive them back before they cause too much damage. This, though, is every creature in the forest acting up at once it seems. Like they're being driven mad by something." "Any idea what?" The wolf-man sighs and sets down the glass he's been cleaning, bracing his hands on the bar and looking you square in the eye. "We both know what. There's no such thing as coincidence, kid. That demon you met on the hilltop... she's behind this. No doubt. Whether it's the demon herself, or some after-effect of whatever magic blew that temple up... I couldn't tell you." You were afraid of that. Damn. Garth gives you a reassuring pat '

rows.original: . "Nobody blames you, [pc.name]. If anybody, it's those freaks who attacked Cait and her sister we ought to be putting to task for this mess... if we could find 'em. Since we can't, it wouldn't hurt to talk to an expert." Leaning in and dropping his voice to little more than a whisper, Garth adds, "There's a witch in the woods. Past the old stone bridge, better part of a day's walk from here. She sometimes helps the villagers with their more arcane problems: potions, rituals. Things little Ivris in her shop can't or won't do. Her help comes at a cost, but... it might be worth it to get a few answers, if you catch my meaning." You nod. Maybe you ought to pay that witch a visit... if you can get past the monsters in the woods. Something tells you, though, that it won't be easy.
rows.translation: 。 没有人会责怪你，[pc.name]如果真要追究责任的话，那些袭击凯特和她妹妹的疯子们才是应该为此事负责的人……只要我们能找到他们的话。既然找不到，找位专家谈谈也没坏处。 加斯凑近身体，将声音压低到几乎只有耳语的程度，接着说道：森林里有一位女巫。她住在那座古老的石桥后面，从这里出发，需要步行大半天的时间才能到达。有时候，她会帮助村民解决一些较为棘手的问题：制作药剂、举行仪式之类的，这些都是小伊弗里斯在她的店里无法完成或不愿意去做的事情。她的帮助是需要付出代价的，但是……如果你明白我的意思的话，为了得到一些答案，这样的代价或许也是值得的。 你点了点头。也许你应该去拜访那位女巫……前提是你能成功穿过森林里的怪物。不过，你的直觉告诉你，这绝非易事。
