rows.original: "So, you did it, huh?" You cock your head at Garth. He's already heard about what you managed up there at the temple ruins? "Oh sure, the old man wouldn't stop talking my ear off about it not two moments after he got back triumphant. Not that I minded, given he drank at least twice as much as my idiot son does on a good night — and paid up front, too." Garth chuckles. "You sure did the town a good deed, kid. I don't know much about magic and that kind of stuff, but from the sound of it the entire village would've gotten it good if no one had gone up to do something about it. While the old man looks like the yarn-spinning type, I think he was on the level about this at any rate." Right, right. Now that the site is clear, is there something he can do about the ruined temple? The grizzled wolf gives you a nod. "Oh, sure I can. Once I get the money to pay them, I can have a gang of townie muscle come just like that and start work no problem. Like I've said before, I know some of the best people in the Marches — we'll have it done within days once we start work." And of course, he's looking to get the money from you. "You and Cait are the ones who want this built, so the two of you pay for it. Makes sense, no?" Ah, of course, the final hurdle to making your pink kitten's dreams reality. Given that you've helped out Hawkethorne yet again, surely you can get some kind of discount on the deal? "Oh sure, you can. I've already discussed it with the lads since I knew you'd come to me asking this very question, and they've agreed to refurbish the temple at cost. Labour, materials, everything — and with the old man helping out with the design and architecture they can drive the price even lower. Now, they can't do it for nothing — folks need to eat, too — but it's as cheap as it can be." So, how cheap is he talking about? "With the [var0|baroness|town] helping you out? Five thousand hawks should do it." Five thousand hawks? "It's a temple, and a pretty old and grand one at that. Marble's gotta be lugged in from elsewhere, and all that stuff. Surely Cait's worth as much to you, isn't she? Plus, there's a bunch of magic bullshit that the old man wants installed into the temple in order to ensure that hocus pocus doesn't start building up again, and we've got to get that shipped all the way in from Tychris. The price that kind of stuff carries aside, you know how dangerous the roads are coming from the valley." Hrmph... You turn to where Cait's [party.has cait |sitting at the bar beside you |sitting a short ways off ]. She grimaces. "Uhh. You know I don't take any more than food and drink costs from the whole adventuring thing. I've been happy to let you manage the money, oh glorious team leader! In faaaaact, I'm perfectly willing to share a portion of what the temple manages to take in with you. I'm not sure that it'll be very much, but it'll be some kind of return on the investment we're making." [pc.isDK |We? Hrmph. So, an i |I ]nvestment, huh... it's a little crude to put it that way when it's a temple you're wanting to build, but at the same time if Cait's willing to give you a cut, there's no downside to that, either. Still, five thousand hawks is going to take a long, long time to recoup, if ever. Still, that's the price tag Garth's put on it, and you're not likely to get a better deal from... well, there's not really anybody else around either, is there? You'll just have to come back to him again when you're ready to cough up such a sum.
rows.translation: 所以，你真的做到了，是吧？” 你歪着头看着加斯。他应该已经听说你在神庙废墟里所做的一切了吧？ “当然了，那个老头一回来就滔滔不绝地跟我讲这件事，简直停不下来。其实我并不介意，毕竟他喝的酒量至少是我那个蠢儿子的两倍——而且还是先付了钱的。”加思笑着说，“你确实为这个小镇做了件好事，孩子。我对魔法之类的东西了解不多，但听你这么说，如果没人去处理这件事，整个村子都会遇到麻烦的。虽然那个老人看起来像是那种喜欢闲聊的人，但我觉得在这件事上，他的判断力还是不错的。 对了，对了。既然场地已经准备好了，那么对于那座被毁的寺庙，他有什么办法可以处理吗？” 那只灰白的狼点了点头：“哦，当然可以。只要我拿到支付所需的钱，就可以召集镇上的一些壮汉来动手施工，根本不会有问题。就像我之前说的，我在边境地区认识一些最可靠的人手——一旦开始工作，几天内就能把事情搞定。 当然了，他其实是想从你这里拿到这笔钱。 “毕竟是你和凯特想要建造这个项目的，所以应该由你们两个人来承担费用。这样才合理，对吧？” 啊，当然了……实现你那可爱小猫的梦想，最后这个障碍当然也要克服。既然你又一次帮助了鹰棘镇，那么在这个交易中，你总该能得到一些优惠吧？ 哦，当然可以。自从我知道你会来问我这个问题，我就已经和那些人讨论过了，他们同意免费重新修建这座寺庙。包括人工、材料所有费用——而且有那位老先生帮忙设计建筑，成本还能进一步降低。现在，他们已经可以开始动工了没什么毕竟大家也得吃饭啊——不过价格已经便宜到不能再便宜了。” 那么，他所说的“便宜”到底是指多便宜呢？ “通过[var0|女男爵|城镇]五千那是一座寺庙，而且是一座非常古老、非常宏伟的寺庙。大理石肯定是从其他地方运过来的，还有其他各种材料。对你们来说，凯特肯定也很重要吧？另外，那个老头还想在寺庙里安装一些魔法装置，以防止那些诡计再次发生，所以我们必须得那个这些货物是从提克里斯运过来的。考虑到这类物品的价格，以及从山谷出来的道路有多危险，你应该能理解吧。 哼……你把目光转向凯特所在的方向。 [party.has cait |坐在你旁边的吧台旁 |距离不远的地方 ]她做了个鬼脸，说道：“呃，你知道的，对于这次冒险活动所产生的一切开支，我只会收取相当于食物和饮料费用的那部分钱。我一直都很乐意让你来管理这些钱，哦，伟大的团队领导！事实上，我非常愿意和你分享寺庙所获得的收入中的一份。虽然这笔钱可能不会很多，但总归是有些的一些也算是对我们所投入的努力的一种回报吧。 [pc.isDK |我们？哼。那么，一个i…… |我 ]投资，嗯……用这种方式来形容其实有点粗俗，毕竟你想要建造的是一座寺庙。但另一方面，如果凯特愿意分你一部分利润，这样做也没有什么坏处。不过，五千霍克斯这笔投资要花上很长很长的时间才能收回成本，甚至可能永远都收不回来。 不过，加斯已经定了这个价格，你也不太可能从别人那里得到更优惠的条件……嗯，其实周围也确实没有其他人可以选择，对吧？所以，当你准备好支付这笔钱时，还是得再去找他吧。

rows.original: "You got the money together?" Wordlessly, you upend the five thousand hawks onto the bar counter, letting the electrum coins spill out in a heap. Several heads turn at the clink of such a copious amount of money, and you hear one or two whistles from the tavern's patronage. You grin. Will this do? Maybe he should count it to be sure that you're not underpaying him. "No, no. This will do." Sweeping one arm around the hefty pile of coin, Garth scoops the lot into an empty trough he carries in from one side of the bar. "I guess you'll be wanting your money's worth, eh?" If he doesn't mind. A nod. "I'll get the muscle together, [pc.name] — you'll get a fine work of art the likes of which have never been seen in the Marches before. Sure, we don't know what a Mallachite temple should look like, but the old coot of a cat does and he's been chomping at the bit to get his little kitten's pet project sorted out for a while now. I bet he'll be overjoyed to hear that it's finally getting somewhere." Hey, he didn't have to put it as if you were being tardy in gathering together five thousand hawks. Garth chuckles. "Sorry, sorry. But yeah, starting tomorrow the lads should be in and getting to work. You're welcome to head up the mountain path and see the work while it's going on, of course, and the same goes for your pink kitten." "Much obliged!" Cait pipes up from [party.has cait |beside you |her usual spot in the bar room ]. How long does he think the refurbishment and renovations will take? "Ten days or thereabouts. Like I said, best men in the Marches. Give us ten days, and we'll change the entirety of the place inside out; you won't even recognise it when we're done." Garth gives you a wink. "Now then, if you don't mind, I have to get all this money where it needs to be." As the old wolf hefts up the trough in both burly hands and stumbles towards the back door, Cait [party.has cait |turns |comes running up ] to you and gives you a big hug, pressing her squishy body against yours. "Thanks so much, [pc.name]!" You've already given so much for her and risked even more, what's another addition to the list? Leaning into your pink kitten's hug, you give her a good scratch on the head and listen to her purr for a bit before pulling away. Seriously, though, it's for everyone's good as much as hers — she's just the most qualified to watch over the place. "Mmm. Even so, you've earned my thanks, and Dad's, and Sally's, too. And of course, Calla's, when we manage to get her back. I know Garth said it'd take ten days... but I wouldn't mind going up with you to see the site sometime, if you don't mind. It's... cathartic in a way to finally get some closure, even if it's not going to be really over until Calla returns." You'll consider it. For now, though, you're five thousand hawks lighter, and their loss is keenly felt... but for a good cause, of course! "Tsk, don't forget that I promised to give you a cut of everything the temple takes, in perpetuity. It's not going to be much at first, for sure, but maybe that'll just encourage you to pour more money and attention into it!" Cait laughs. "Seriously, though, [pc.name] — you've already done so much for us that I couldn't in good faith ask you for more. Still, you'll be getting a bit more every ten days in that chest of yours, I'll tell Sally to make sure of it!"
rows.translation: 你把钱凑齐了吗？” 你一言不发，将那五千枚鹰币全部倒在吧台上，那些银币顿时散落一地。听到这么一大笔钱落地的声音，周围有不少人的目光都被吸引了过来，你也听到酒馆里的一些顾客发出了惊叹声。 你咧嘴笑了。这样够吗？也许他应该数一数，以确保你没有少付他钱。 “不，不，这样就可以了。”加斯用一只手臂把那一堆硬币拢起来，然后把它们全部装进他从酒吧另一边拿来的一个空容器里。我想你肯定希望自己的钱花得值吧？” 如果他不介意的话…… 他点了点头：“我会召集相关人员来处理的。[pc.name] — 你们将会得到一件前所未有的杰作，这样的艺术品在马奇地区还是头一遭见到的。当然，我们并不知道马拉克信徒神庙到底应该是什么样子，但那只老猫心里很清楚，而且它也已经迫不及待地想要完成它为小猫准备的这个特别项目了。我敢打赌，听到这个项目终于有进展了，它一定会欣喜若狂的。 嘿，他其实没必要说得好像你们在筹备这件事上拖延了很长时间似的。五千只鹰加思轻笑着说道：“抱歉，抱歉。不过从明天开始，那些小伙子们应该就会开始工作了。当然，你随时都可以沿着山路上去看看他们的工作进展，你的粉色小猫也可以一起去哦。” “太感谢了！”凯特高兴地回答道。 [party.has cait |在你身边 |她在酒吧里常去的那个角落 ]他觉得这次翻修和改造需要多长时间呢？ “大概十天吧。就像我说的，这里可是边疆地区最优秀的工匠们。给我们十天时间，我们会把这个地方彻底翻个底朝天；等我们完工后，你甚至都不会认出它来了。”加思向你眨了眨眼。“那么，如果你们不介意的话，我得把这些钱用到该用的地方去了。” 那只老狼用它那双结实的爪子抱起那个食槽，摇摇晃晃地朝着后门走去，而凯特[party.has cait |转动 |跑过来 ]她走到你面前，紧紧地拥抱了你，将她柔软的身体贴在你的身上。“真的太感谢你了[pc.name]你已经为她付出了这么多，甚至还冒了更大的风险，再添些什么到这份清单上呢？你依偎在粉红色的小猫怀里，轻轻挠了挠它的头，听它满足地咕噜咕噜叫着，过了一会儿才拉开距离。说真的，这对每个人来说都是好事——她只是最合适的人选来负责管理这个地方。 “嗯，尽管如此，你还是值得我的感谢，还有爸爸和莎莉的感谢。当然，等我们把卡拉找回来之后，她也会感谢你的。我知道加斯说过这需要十天的时间……但如果你不介意的话，我很愿意陪你去看看那个地方。能够最终得到一些了结，从某种意义上来说，确实是一种解脱，尽管直到卡拉回来，这件事才算真正结束。你会考虑这个提议的。不过目前来说，你的财富减少了五千霍克斯，而他们的损失也确实令人感到痛心……不过，这一切都是为了一个好的目的，当然了！ “啧，别忘了，我曾经承诺会永远把寺庙所得的所有收益中的一部分分给你。刚开始的时候，投入的资金和精力肯定不会很多，但也许这反而会激励你投入更多的资源和精力吧！”凯特笑着说，“不过说真的[pc.name]你已经为我们做了太多，我实在无法再厚着脸皮要求你做更多了。不过，每隔十天，你的那个箱子里还是会多一些东西的，我会让莎莉确保这一点的！

rows.original:
You heft the crate of weapons up onto the bar in front of Garth. "Look what I've brought you[pc.isDK|, old man]."

    "A box... full of weapons?" Garth mutters, peering inside. "Hmm. Elven craftsmanship, aren't they?"
    
    You nod. "Seem to be."
    
    The old wolf draws one of the curved bronze swords, inspecting it with both hands. "Fine work. Well balanced. Ah! Sharp as hell, too. Where'd you get these?"
    
    "Demon smugglers, trying to arm the enemy army outside Khor'minos."
    
    "Shit. Better use than them, huh? Unless you've got a better idea, I'll pass these out to the folk around town. Next time a bunch of orcs or imps come calling, they'll be in for a nasty surprise!"
    
    Hell of a step up from pitchforks and hunting bows.
    
    "And the best of the bunch for my little valkyrie," Garth chuckles, placing one of the blades under the bar. "Mother ought to be able to protect her children."
    
    Indeed.
rows.translation:
你把武器箱抬上加斯面前的吧台。“看看我给你带了什么[pc.isDK|，老头]。”

    “一箱……武器？”加斯喃喃说道，朝里面张望。“嗯。是精灵的工艺，对吧？”
    
    你点点头。“看起来是。”
    
    老狼抽出一把弯曲的青铜剑，双手捧着仔细检查。“做工精良，配重均衡。啊！还锋利得要命。你从哪里弄来的？”
    
    “恶魔走私犯。他们想武装科尔米诺斯城外的敌军。”
    
    “操。交给我们用更合适，对吧？除非你有更好的主意，否则我会把它们分给镇上的居民。下次再有一群兽人或小恶魔找上门，他们一定会大吃一惊！”
    
    比干草叉和猎弓强了太多。
    
    “其中最好的一把留给我的小女武神，”加斯轻笑着，将一把剑放到吧台下面。“母亲总该有能力保护自己的孩子。”
    
    的确。

rows.original:
[flags.GARTH_GARDENING_REPEAT
        |"I see that look on your face," Garth says. "Ready to head into the woods and ruin somebody's garden?"
        |[flags.GARTH_GARDENING
            |"So now that Garret and the loggers are back..."
            
            "... Now they can help you with your plant problem, yep," Garth says with a nod and what might be a smile on his snout. "Already talked to the boys. They're getting some of their kit together and clearing their heads; let me know when you're ready to head up and I'll gather the crew for you. Keep in mind, once you breach the garden, whatever's in there will try and figure out what's going on before long. Only gonna get one chance at this before the boys have to run home. They're strong, but not fighters."
            |You start explaining your encounter with the ever-growing roots to Garth: that no matter how hard you tried, new roots grew faster than you could hew them down. That you need a lot of strong bodies to clear the way if you want to get into the corrupted garden, which certainly seems to be the source of a lot of the forest's problems.
            
            "That's... well, that's just damn weird," Garth finally says, setting the mug he was cleaning aside. "I've seen druid-magic before, but never like that, never that powerful. I think you're right, though, about getting more hands. No magic in the world that can't be overwhelmed eventually, least that's what Gweyr'd tell the men before we went into battle against mages. So you're going to need a lot of big, strong lads to do some dirty work for you. Lucky us, you already brought the lads back from Westbank. Just let me know when you're ready to head up and I'll gather the crew for you. Keep in mind, once you breach the garden, whatever's in there will try and figure out what's going on before long. Only gonna get one chance at this before the boys have to run home. They're strong, but not fighters."
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.GARTH_GARDENING_REPEAT
        |我看你脸上的表情，”加思说道，“是时候去树林里捣乱别人家的花园了吧？
        |[flags.GARTH_GARDENING
            |所以现在加雷特和那些伐木工们回来了……”
            
            “……他们现在可以帮你解决那个植物问题了，没错，”加思点点头说道，他的鼻子上似乎还挂着一丝微笑。“我已经跟那些人谈过了。他们正在整理一些装备，整理思绪；等你们准备好出发的时候告诉我，我会召集团队成员陪你们一起去。请记住，一旦你们进入了那个地方，里面的东西很快就会察觉到发生了什么。在那些男孩们不得不跑回家之前，我只有这一次机会了。他们虽然力气很大，但并不是打架的好手。
            |你开始向加斯解释你与那些不断蔓延的树根之间的遭遇：无论你多么努力，新的树根生长的速度总是比你砍伐它们的速度要快。如果你想进入那个被破坏的花园——而那个花园显然正是这片森林诸多问题的根源——的话，你就需要很多强壮的人手来清理道路。
            
            那……好吧，实在太奇怪了，”加思终于说道，把正在清洗的杯子放在了一边。“我以前确实见过德鲁伊使用的魔法，但从来没见过这样的，威力也这么大。不过，你说的没错，我们需要更多人手来帮忙。世界上没有任何魔法是永远无法被战胜的，至少在我们与法师们交战之前，格维尔是这么对士兵们说的。所以，你们需要很多强壮有力的家伙来为你们完成那些艰巨的任务。我们真幸运，你已经把那些人从西岸带回来了。等你准备好出发的时候告诉我，我会召集所有人陪你一起去。记住，一旦你们进入了那个地方，里面的那些东西很快就会察觉到发生了什么。在那些男孩们不得不跑回家之前，我只有这一次机会了。他们虽然力气很大，但并不是打架的好手。
        ]
    ]

rows.translation: 准备就绪

rows.original: "I'm ready," you tell the old wolf. "Let's go." He chuckles. "I don't know about the 'us' part there, but I've got the boys together. Garret too, so he can put those idiot muscles to good use for once. Pup!" Garret growls something into the mug he was nursing and lopes over. "What now, old man?" "Time to earn your keep, boy. Take [pc.name] here and the logging crew up north, like we talked about." "Pfft, come on, give me a real challenge! This is just babysitting all over again." "Go." Garth shoos his son off, earning a growl and a then a sigh from the younger lupine. "Alright, fine. Lead the way, [pc.name], the guys should be waiting outside." And so they are, and so you do. With two dozen armed men at your back, nothing in the woods has the temerity to trouble you on your way back to the corrupted garden. The loggers stay tightly bunched around you, axes and driving-mallets held in white-knuckled hands, save for Garret himself. The gray-furred wolf walks fearlessly, chest pushed out and tail swishing excitedly every time somebody starts at a noise from the depths of forest. When your merry band finally arrives at the garden, you lead them between the phallic stalks and vaginal flowers that loom all around. Soon enough, though, you find your way blocked by the same wall of thorn-vines and thick roots as the previous time you attempted entrance. They pulse and writhe as if not just alive, but animate. Several of the loggers step back, disgust evident on faces and drawn-down muzzles. Garret marches to the forefront and grabs an axe from one of the men. "Well, what're we all waiting for? Let's get to work!" He hefts it and swings, bringing the blade down into the thickest of the roots. There's a decidedly wet sound as the axe sinks in, nearly to the haft. Garret grunts, releases the handle, and steps back. The other loggers look on in rank confusion as the towering wolf lunges in again, delivering a punch to the back of the axehead with so much force that it's sent scything through the root and out the other side entirely. "Don't let him steal all the glory!" another Hawkethorner lupine howls, rushing in and hacking away with his own tool. The others follow suit, chopping through the wall with a flurry of blows that send wet, aromatic ichor splashing all across the garden grounds. You ready your [pc.weapon] and follow them in, warily stepping past bits of splattered plant-viscera as the men hew their way through the wall. It's hard, sweaty going — just as before, the roots and vines regenerate from every cut, regrowing like the corrupted weeds they are, but there's too many strikes coming too quickly to survive even for an enchantment of such potency. Step by step, the breach grows until its wide enough for you to push through. "Go get 'em, [pc.name]!" Garret says, slapping your back — and then yelping as a vine grabs his arm. "Fuck!" [var0 |As the plants behind you begin to surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers, something else happens. Twisting upon themselves, the various tendrils lash out — not at the loggers, but in pain as what look like tumors, pustules and other growths start sprouting on the cuts from the loggers' axes, healing powers turned destructive. Magical power thrums through the air, and you look back to see Hethia astride her warg, standing out from amidst the loggers as they make an organized retreat. "What are you looking at?" the druidess snaps in her usual chilly manner. "I'm just doing my duty and dealing with a couple of aberrant growths as they ought to be.[silly | D-don't think this means I like you or anything, b-baka! ]" The pustules burst, dripping sickly sweet sap all over the ground; with the corrupted vines and roots writhing in anguish as their corrupt regeneration is turned in upon itself, the loggers' retreat is more or less covered. A surfeit of life is just as terrible as a deficit... and equally vile in Hethia's eyes, it would appear. |The plants behind you surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers. You hear shouts, the sound of hacking blades, and soon enough, running feet. ] [party.has brint |"Well," Brint sighs, "at least they got us in. Let's go." ] [party.has cait |"At least it smells nice in here," Cait giggles. ] Something moves ahead. You stalk forward, low as you can, until you reach a clearing in the garden's heart. Several somethings are moving, turns out. You squint, trying to make out the figures cavorting in the glade. Girlish laughter carries on the wind, and what sounds like... music? A flute of some kind, and drums as well, beating out an up-tempo tune to which the women in the clearing throw themselves in a whirling dance. There's something alluring, inherently sexual, in their movements. Breasts and asses bounce hypnotically, almost enough to make you overlook the vine-like tentacles growing from their backs. Effigies. And they're dancing around something, what you think at first might be some sort of structure. As you draw near to the clearing's edge, though, you realize that it's actually a bulb — a huge, ten-foot-tall flower rooted down to the earth. It's closed up, dark green leaves and rosy petals folded in on themselves, but it's right in the middle of the clearing. The effigies seem to be cavorting around it, like it's some sort of great planty idol. Could that be the "mother" you've heard about? If so, it's nothing like the effigies it's produced. One green-skinned girl stands out among them, sitting atop the bulb and blowing on a twinned flute. Her tentacles slap rhythmically on a pair of drums couched on her thick thighs, setting the beat for her sisters' dance. Brilliant red face paint adorns her cheeks and surrounds her golden-hued eyes. Some kind of leader among them, you'd guess. [var1 |You [party.hasCompanions |wave off [party.compNames] and ]slip into the shadows, stalking forwards towards the edge of the clearing. Gods, there's a lot of these flowery sluts cavorting around the bud, and... and something's moving inside that titanic flower. Over the music, you can start to make out moaning and cries — cries for help as much as of pleasure. Somebody's trapped in there! |Suddenly, the music's tempo changes. The minstrel plant's golden eyes snap towards you, and a wicked smile spreads across her lush azure lips. "Oh-ho, look sisters! [party.hasCompanions |More village-folk |Another village-folk ] come to play!" She plays a sour note on her pipes, and the dancing comes to a staggering halt. The plant-girls surrounding the bulb all freeze mid-step, turning towards you with wide, lustful eyes. Their tentacles start thrashing, leaking more and more of that intoxicating nectar from the bulbous crowns. "Get 'em, girls! Mother needs more playthings to breed!" Oh, hell. “是时候让你证明自己的价值了，孩子。去吧[pc.name]就是这里，还有北边那些伐木工人，就像我们之前讨论过的那样。” “哼，得了吧，给我来点真正的挑战吧！这样简直就是在哄小孩玩而已。” “去吧。”加斯催促儿子离开，结果换来了一声低吼，紧接着是那年轻狼族的一声叹息。 “好吧，随你便。你先带路吧。[pc.name]，那些人应该正在外面等着呢。” 果然，他们就在那里等着，你也是这样。有二十几个武装人员跟在你们后面，树林里没有任何东西有胆量在你们返回那片被破坏的花园的路上打扰你们。那些伐木工人们紧紧地围在你身边，他们双手紧握着斧头和敲击工具，个个都紧张得指关节都发白了，只有加雷特例外。那只灰毛狼则毫无畏惧地走在前面，每当森林深处传来声响时，它都会挺起胸膛，兴奋地摇动着尾巴。 当你们这群欢乐的人终于来到花园时，你带领他们穿过周围那些形似阳具的茎秆和仿佛阴道般的花朵。然而不久之后，你们又一次发现，通往花园的道路被同样那些荆棘藤蔓和粗壮的根系给阻住了。它们脉动着、扭动着，仿佛不仅仅是活着的，而是真正有生命的。有几个伐木工人退后了几步，他们脸上的厌恶之情一览无余。 加雷特走到最前面，从其中一个人手中拿了一把斧头。好吧，我们还等什么呢？开始行动吧！” 他举起工具挥动起来，将刀刃狠狠地砍向那些最粗的根部。顿时，一阵剧烈的潮湿的听起来，那把斧头几乎已经砍到了斧柄的位置。加雷特发出一声闷哼，松开了斧柄，然后后退了几步。其他伐木工们一脸困惑地看着，那只高大的狼又一次冲了上来，用巨大的力量一拳击在了斧头的尾部，使得斧头整个穿过树根，从另一侧飞了出去。 别让他把所有的荣耀都据为己有！”另一只霍克索恩狼嚎着冲了进来，用它自己的工具开始砍伐。其他狼也纷纷效仿，一阵猛烈的攻击之下，湿漉漉的、散发着香气的体液溅得到了处都是。你准备好了吗？[pc.weapon]跟着他们进去，小心翼翼地避开那些溅得到处都是的植物内脏，那些人正在奋力砍伐着那堵墙。这工作非常艰难，让人满身是汗——就像之前一样，那些根茎和藤蔓每次被砍断后都会重新生长，它们就像那些被腐蚀了的杂草一样不断再生，但是现在的攻击来得太快了，即便是拥有如此强大的法术，也难以抵挡。一步一步地，那个缺口逐渐扩大，直到变得足够宽，你们可以挤过去。 “去把他们抓过来吧！[pc.name]啊！”加雷特一边说，一边拍着你的背，但紧接着，当一根藤蔓抓住他的手臂时，他立刻发出了惨叫。“该死！ [var0 |当你身后的植物开始焕发新生，重新生长并向那些伐木工人发起攻击时，另一件事情发生了。那些藤蔓开始扭曲缠绕，但它们并不是朝着伐木工人袭去，而是因为疼痛而如此反应——因为在伐木工人斧头留下的伤口上，开始长出类似肿瘤、脓包之类的东西，这些本应具有治愈作用的生物组织，此刻却变成了具有破坏性的东西。魔力在空气中激荡，你回头望去，看到赫希娅骑在她的战兽背上，从那些有条不紊地撤退的伐木工人群中脱颖而出。 “你在看什么？”女德鲁伊用她那惯常的冷淡语气问道。我只是在履行自己的职责，把那些异常生长的东西处理掉，这是理所应当的。[silly | 别以为这意味着我喜欢你什么的，笨蛋！ ]那些脓包破裂了，渗出的汁液带着病态的甜味，洒了一地；那些被腐蚀的藤蔓和根系在痛苦中扭曲着，因为它们的再生过程出现了异常，导致伐木工人们的退路几乎被完全阻断了。生命的过剩与匮乏同样可怕……在赫希娅的眼中，这两种情况似乎都同样令人厌恶。 |你身后的植物们突然焕发生机，重新生长起来，并向那些砍伐树木的人发起攻击。你听到了人们的呼喊声、砍伐工具发出的声响，不久之后，还听到了奔跑的脚步声。 ] [party.has brint |嗯，”布林特叹了口气，“至少他们让我们进去了。我们走吧。 ] [party.has cait |至少这里的气味很香啊，”凯特笑着说。 ] 有什么东西在前面移动。你尽量压低身形，悄悄地跟了上去，直到来到花园中央的一片空地上。几个原来，有些东西正在移动。你眯起眼睛，试图看清那些在林间空地上嬉戏的身影。少女们的笑声随风传来，还有……音乐声？似乎是某种笛子的旋律，再加上鼓声，共同构成了一首节奏明快的曲子。空地上的那些女子随着这音乐跳起了旋转舞步。她们的动作中蕴含着某种诱惑力，某种与性相关的魅力。她们的胸部和臀部随着节奏有节奏地晃动，几乎让人忘记了从她们背后伸出来的那些像藤蔓一样的触手。 那些雕像……他们围着某个东西跳舞，起初你可能会以为那是什么结构物。然而，当你靠近空地的边缘时，你才会发现那其实是一朵巨大的花——一朵高达十英尺的花，它的根部深深扎根于大地之中。它已经闭合了，深绿色的叶子和粉红色的花瓣都紧紧地包裹在自身之上，但它却正好位于这片空地的中央。那些雕像似乎在它周围嬉戏玩耍，就好像它是一尊巨大的植物神像。难道这就是你听说的“母亲”吗？如果是这样的话，那它就完全不同于它所制作的那些模拟形象了。 在她们中间，有一个皮肤呈绿色的女孩格外引人注目。她坐在一个球体上，同时吹奏着两支笛子。她的触手有节奏地敲打着放在她粗壮大腿上的鼓，为姐妹们的舞蹈打着节拍。她脸颊上涂着鲜艳的红色颜料，这些颜料环绕着她那金色的双眼——看来，她应该是她们中的领导者吧。 [var1 |你[party.hasCompanions |挥手示意让某人离开[party.compNames]以及 ]悄悄潜入阴影中，朝着空地的边缘悄悄靠近。天啊，有太多这些花枝招展的贱货在周围晃来晃去，而且……还有别的什么东西也在那里移动在那朵巨大的花朵内部。在音乐的伴奏下，你可以逐渐分辨出那些呻吟声与哭喊声——既有求救的呼喊，也有表达愉悦的声响。肯定有人被困在里面！ |突然，音乐的节奏发生了变化。那位吟游诗人的植物用它那金色的“眼睛”紧紧地盯着你，而它那茂盛的蔚蓝色嘴唇上浮现出一丝邪恶的微笑：“哦嗬，姐妹们，快看啊！ [party.hasCompanions |更多的村民们 |另一个村民 ]来玩吧！” 她用笛子吹奏出一阵刺耳的声音，舞蹈立刻戛然而止。那些围绕着球茎的植物少女们全都停下了动作，睁大充满欲望的眼睛望向你。她们的触手开始剧烈摆动，从那些球茎状的顶部不断渗出那种令人陶醉的蜜液。 “抓住它们，姑娘们！妈妈需要更多的玩物来繁殖呢！” 哦，糟了…… 你赶紧做好准备吧[pc.weapon]来迎接这些充满活力的植物们的攻势吧！ ]
rows.raw: " "I'm ready," you tell the old wolf. "Let's go." He chuckles. "I don't know about the 'us' part there, but I've got the boys together. Garret too, so he can put those idiot muscles to good use for once. Pup!" Garret growls something into the mug he was nursing and lopes over. "What now, old man?" "Time to earn your keep, boy. Take [pc.name] here and the logging crew up north, like we talked about." "Pfft, come on, give me a real challenge! This is just babysitting all over again." "Go." Garth shoos his son off, earning a growl and a then a sigh from the younger lupine. "Alright, fine. Lead the way, [pc.name], the guys should be waiting outside." And so they are, and so you do. With two dozen armed men at your back, nothing in the woods has the temerity to trouble you on your way back to the corrupted garden. The loggers stay tightly bunched around you, axes and driving-mallets held in white-knuckled hands, save for Garret himself. The gray-furred wolf walks fearlessly, chest pushed out and tail swishing excitedly every time somebody starts at a noise from the depths of forest. When your merry band finally arrives at the garden, you lead them between the phallic stalks and vaginal flowers that loom all around. Soon enough, though, you find your way blocked by the same wall of thorn-vines and thick roots as the previous time you attempted entrance. They pulse and writhe as if not just alive, but animate. Several of the loggers step back, disgust evident on faces and drawn-down muzzles. Garret marches to the forefront and grabs an axe from one of the men. "Well, what're we all waiting for? Let's get to work!" He hefts it and swings, bringing the blade down into the thickest of the roots. There's a decidedly wet sound as the axe sinks in, nearly to the haft. Garret grunts, releases the handle, and steps back. The other loggers look on in rank confusion as the towering wolf lunges in again, delivering a punch to the back of the axehead with so much force that it's sent scything through the root and out the other side entirely. "Don't let him steal all the glory!" another Hawkethorner lupine howls, rushing in and hacking away with his own tool. The others follow suit, chopping through the wall with a flurry of blows that send wet, aromatic ichor splashing all across the garden grounds. You ready your [pc.weapon] and follow them in, warily stepping past bits of splattered plant-viscera as the men hew their way through the wall. It's hard, sweaty going — just as before, the roots and vines regenerate from every cut, regrowing like the corrupted weeds they are, but there's too many strikes coming too quickly to survive even for an enchantment of such potency. Step by step, the breach grows until its wide enough for you to push through. "Go get 'em, [pc.name]!" Garret says, slapping your back — and then yelping as a vine grabs his arm. "Fuck!" [var0 |As the plants behind you begin to surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers, something else happens. Twisting upon themselves, the various tendrils lash out — not at the loggers, but in pain as what look like tumors, pustules and other growths start sprouting on the cuts from the loggers' axes, healing powers turned destructive. Magical power thrums through the air, and you look back to see Hethia astride her warg, standing out from amidst the loggers as they make an organized retreat. "What are you looking at?" the druidess snaps in her usual chilly manner. "I'm just doing my duty and dealing with a couple of aberrant growths as they ought to be.[silly | D-don't think this means I like you or anything, b-baka! ]" The pustules burst, dripping sickly sweet sap all over the ground; with the corrupted vines and roots writhing in anguish as their corrupt regeneration is turned in upon itself, the loggers' retreat is more or less covered. A surfeit of life is just as terrible as a deficit... and equally vile in Hethia's eyes, it would appear. |The plants behind you surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers. You hear shouts, the sound of hacking blades, and soon enough, running feet. ] [party.has brint |"Well," Brint sighs, "at least they got us in. Let's go." ] [party.has cait |"At least it smells nice in here," Cait giggles. ] Something moves ahead. You stalk forward, low as you can, until you reach a clearing in the garden's heart. Several somethings are moving, turns out. You squint, trying to make out the figures cavorting in the glade. Girlish laughter carries on the wind, and what sounds like... music? A flute of some kind, and drums as well, beating out an up-tempo tune to which the women in the clearing throw themselves in a whirling dance. There's something alluring, inherently sexual, in their movements. Breasts and asses bounce hypnotically, almost enough to make you overlook the vine-like tentacles growing from their backs. Effigies. And they're dancing around something, what you think at first might be some sort of structure. As you draw near to the clearing's edge, though, you realize that it's actually a bulb — a huge, ten-foot-tall flower rooted down to the earth. It's closed up, dark green leaves and rosy petals folded in on themselves, but it's right in the middle of the clearing. The effigies seem to be cavorting around it, like it's some sort of great planty idol. Could that be the "mother" you've heard about? If so, it's nothing like the effigies it's produced. One green-skinned girl stands out among them, sitting atop the bulb and blowing on a twinned flute. Her tentacles slap rhythmically on a pair of drums couched on her thick thighs, setting the beat for her sisters' dance. Brilliant red face paint adorns her cheeks and surrounds her golden-hued eyes. Some kind of leader among them, you'd guess. [var1 |You [party.hasCompanions |wave off [party.compNames] and ]slip into the shadows, stalking forwards towards the edge of the clearing. Gods, there's a lot of these flowery sluts cavorting around the bud, and... and something's moving inside that titanic flower. Over the music, you can start to make out moaning and cries — cries for help as much as of pleasure. Somebody's trapped in there! |Suddenly, the music's tempo changes. The minstrel plant's golden eyes snap towards you, and a wicked smile spreads across her lush azure lips. "Oh-ho, look sisters! [party.hasCompanions |More village-folk |Another village-folk ] come to play!" She plays a sour note on her pipes, and the dancing comes to a staggering halt. The plant-girls surrounding the bulb all freeze mid-step, turning towards you with wide, lustful eyes. Their tentacles start thrashing, leaking more and more of that intoxicating nectar from the bulbous crowns. "Get 'em, girls! Mother needs more playthings to breed!" Oh, hell. You ready your [pc.weapon] to meet the voluptuous plantlings' charge! ] "

rows.translation: 偷袭

rows.original:
You lunge forward, [pc.weapon] drawn, and immediately charge the nearest of the plant sluts. The sudden attack is met with an abrupt end to the music and a great deal of screaming as the effigies scramble to meet your charge.
                
                "Calm yourselves, sisters!" the minstrel plant shouts over the commotion. "We fight to defend mother!"
                
                Mother!? Oh, hell.
rows.translation:
你猛地向前冲去，[pc.weapon]它猛地冲了出去，立刻扑向了距离它最近的那些植物“贱人”。突如其来的攻击使得音乐戛然而止，周围充满了尖叫声，那些植物拟像慌忙地试图躲避它的攻击。
                
                “大家冷静点，姐妹们！”那位吟游植物在喧闹中大声喊道，“我们战斗是为了保护我们的‘母亲’！”
                
                母亲？！哦，天哪。

rows.raw: ' "I'm ready," you tell the old wolf. "Let's go." He chuckles. "I don't know about the 'us' part there, but I've got the boys together. Garret too, so he can put those idiot muscles to good use for once. Pup!" Garret growls something into the mug he was nursing and lopes over. "What now, old man?" "Time to earn your keep, boy. Take [pc.name] here and the logging crew up north, like we talked about." "Pfft, come on, give me a real challenge! This is just babysitting all over again." "Go." Garth shoos his son off, earning a growl and a then a sigh from the younger lupine. "Alright, fine. Lead the way, [pc.name], the guys should be waiting outside." And so they are, and so you do. With two dozen armed men at your back, nothing in the woods has the temerity to trouble you on your way back to the corrupted garden. The loggers stay tightly bunched around you, axes and driving-mallets held in white-knuckled hands, save for Garret himself. The gray-furred wolf walks fearlessly, chest pushed out and tail swishing excitedly every time somebody starts at a noise from the depths of forest. When your merry band finally arrives at the garden, you lead them between the phallic stalks and vaginal flowers that loom all around. Soon enough, though, you find your way blocked by the same wall of thorn-vines and thick roots as the previous time you attempted entrance. They pulse and writhe as if not just alive, but animate. Several of the loggers step back, disgust evident on faces and drawn-down muzzles. But their attentions are quickly drawn skyward as a number of curvy hornet-girls make their descent. [party.comp azzy |Azyrran gently taps you on the shoulder, a smile on her face as she turns with you to face the ivy wall. "My sisters can hold this place while we go inside, if your woodcutter friends are ready to help?" Azyrran sighs with relief when the men all nod. "Shall we do this thing?" |The caramel cuddlebug, Azyrran, is leading the group. "Hey, [pc.name]! Glad you could make it." She waves her lance, a grin on her face. "Are you and your woodcutter friends ready to help? Once the wall is down, my sisters and I can hold this place while you go inside." "Not joining me for the big boss fight?" you tease, and she harrumphs at you. "Don't say that... I haven't had a chance to fight alongside them for ages, and we'll be able to fight together as much as we want. I promise I'll be there for your victory moment, okay?" There's a surprisingly high-pitched, huffy note compared to her usually dulcet, sultry tones. She really is excited to fight with the other knights and maidens. ]'

rows.original: There's plenty of coy hornet giggling and finger-waving at the lumberjacks, blowing kisses [silly |and whispering 'call me' |and winking at them ]. You're fairly sure you aren't seeing things when they all flex and try to look their burliest while they sharpen their axes. Garret marches to the forefront and grabs an axe from one of the men. "Well, what're we all waiting for? Let's get to work!" He hefts it and swings, bringing the blade down into the thickest of the roots. There's a decidedly wet sound as the axe sinks in, nearly to the haft. Garret grunts, releases the handle, and steps back. The other loggers look on in rank confusion as the towering wolf lunges in again, delivering a punch to the back of the axehead with so much force that it's sent scything through the root and out the other side entirely. "Don't let him steal all the glory!" another Hawkethorner lupine howls, rushing in and hacking away with his own tool. The others follow suit, chopping through the wall with a flurry of blows that sent wet, aromatic ichor splashing all across the garden grounds. You ready your [pc.weapon] and follow them in, warily stepping past bits of splattered plant-viscera as the men hew their way through the wall. It's hard, sweaty going — just as before, the roots and vines regenerate from every cut, regrowing like the corrupted weeds they are, but there's too many strikes coming too quickly to survive even for an enchantment of such potency. Step by step, the breach grows until its wide enough for you to push through. "Go get 'em, [pc.name]!" Garret says, slapping your back — and then yelping as a vine grabs his arm. "Fuck!" [var0 |As the plants behind you begin to surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers, something else happens. Twisting upon themselves, the various tendrils lash out — not at the loggers, but in pain as what look like tumors, pustules and other growths start sprouting on the cuts from the loggers' axes, healing powers turned destructive. Magical power thrums through the air, and you look back to see Hethia astride her warg, standing out from amidst the loggers as they make an organized retreat. "What are you looking at?" the druidess snaps in her usual chilly manner. "I'm just doing my duty and dealing with a couple of aberrant growths as they ought to be.[silly | D-don't think this means I like you or anything, b-baka! ]" The pustules burst, dripping sickly sweet sap all over the ground; with the corrupted vines and roots writhing in anguish as their corrupt regeneration is turned in upon itself, the loggers' retreat is more or less covered. A surfeit of life is just as terrible as a deficit... and equally vile in Hethia's eyes, it would appear. With the druid and the hive knights working together to protect the men, they have little to worry about. |The plants behind you surge with new life, knitting back together and lashing out at the loggers. You hear shouts, the sound of hacking blades, and then the war-cries of hornet knights charging into battle to protect the men. ] [party.has brint |"Well," Brint sighs, "at least they got us in. Let's go." ] [party.has cait |"At least it smells nice in here," Cait giggles. ]
rows.translation: 有很多科伊黄蜂在对着伐木工们咯咯笑，还挥动手指，甚至吹着口哨。 [silly |同时低声说着“叫我”。 |还冲他们眨眼睛呢 ]你相当确定自己并没有看错——当他们所有人都在努力展示自己最强壮的一面，同时磨利斧头的时候，他们的动作确实显得格外有力。 加雷特走到最前面，从其中一个男人手中拿过一把斧头。“好了，我们还等什么？开始干活吧！” 他举起斧头挥了下去，斧刃狠狠地砍在了最粗的树根上。那一瞬间，确实发生了一些不同寻常的事情潮湿的听起来，斧头几乎已经砍到了柄部。加雷特发出一声闷哼，松开了斧柄，然后退后了几步。其他伐木工们一脸困惑地看着，那只高大的狼又一次冲了上来，用巨大的力量一拳击在斧头的尾部，使得斧头整个穿过树根，从另一侧飞了出去。 别让他把所有的荣耀都据为己有！”另一只霍克索恩狼嚎着冲了进来，用它自己的工具开始砍伐。其他狼也纷纷效仿，一阵猛烈的攻击使得湿漉漉的、散发着香气的体液溅得到处都是，整个花园里到处都是这些液体。你准备好了吗？[pc.weapon]跟着他们进去，小心翼翼地避开那些溅得到处都是的植物内脏，那些人正在奋力凿开那堵墙。这工作非常艰难，让人满身是汗——就像之前一样，那些根茎和藤蔓每次被砍断后都会重新生长，它们就像那些被腐蚀的杂草一样不断再生，但是现在的攻击来得太快了，即便是拥有如此强大的法术，也难以抵挡。一步一步地，那个缺口逐渐扩大，直到足够大，你们可以挤过去。 “去把他们抓过来！[pc.name]啊！”加雷特一边说，一边拍着你的背，但紧接着，当一根藤蔓抓住他的手臂时，他立刻发出了惨叫。“该死！ [var0 |当你身后的植物开始焕发新生，重新生长并向那些伐木工人发起攻击时，另一件事情发生了。那些藤蔓开始扭曲缠绕，但它们并不是攻击伐木工人，而是出于痛苦——因为在伐木工人斧头留下的伤口上，开始长出类似肿瘤、脓包之类的东西，这些本应具有治愈作用的生物组织，此刻却变成了具有破坏性的东西。魔力在空气中激荡，你回头望去，看到赫希娅骑在她的战兽背上，从那些有条不紊地撤退的伐木工人群中显得格外醒目。 “你在看什么？”女德鲁伊用她那惯常的冷淡语气问道。我只是在履行自己的职责，把那些异常生长的东西处理掉，这是理所应当的。[silly | 别以为这意味着我喜欢你什么的，笨蛋！ ]那些脓包破裂了，渗出的汁液带着病态的甜味，洒了一地；那些被腐蚀的藤蔓和根系在痛苦中扭曲着，因为它们的再生过程出现了异常，结果整个伐木工人的营地几乎都被这些汁液覆盖了。生命的过剩与匮乏同样可怕……在赫希娅的眼中，这两种情况似乎都同样令人作呕。 在德鲁伊和蜂群骑士的共同努力下，工人们几乎没有什么需要担心的了。 |你身后的植物们突然焕发生机，重新生长起来，并向那些伐木工人发起攻击。你听到了人们的呼喊声、砍伐工具发出的声响，紧接着，那些“黄蜂骑士”也发出了战斗的呐喊，冲上前去保护那些工人。 ] [party.has brint |嗯，”布林特叹了口气，“至少他们让我们进去了。我们走吧。 ] [party.has cait |至少这里的气味挺不错的，”凯特轻声笑着说。 ]

rows.original:
You charge forward into a clearing beyond the vine wall, soon followed by a squad of hornets that have pushed through the breach at your back. Effigies climb out of the woodwork, bearing aromatic vines and crude bows in equal numbers; plant-bound wolves and boars rush from the brush, snarling with wild-eyed rage at the Alraune's garden being assailed. The hornets rush to work, slamming shields into beasts and hurling whitefire at corrupted growths, clearing a path for [party.yall] to advance. 

                The effigies are viciously defending the heart of the garden — what you think at first might be some sort of structure. As you draw near to the clearing's edge, though, you realize that it's actually a bulb: a huge, ten-foot-tall flower rooted down to the earth. It's closed up, dark green leaves and rosy petals folded in on themselves, but it's right in the heart of the garden, in the last line of the effigies' defense. This must be the Alraune. 
                
                One green-skinned girl stands out among them, sitting atop the bulb and blowing on a twinned flute. Her tentacles slap rhythmically on a pair of drums couched on her thick thighs, thundering a war-dance to inspire her sisters. Brilliant red face paint adorns her cheeks and surrounds her golden-hued eyes. Some kind of leader among them, you'd guess. You'll have to start with her!
rows.translation:
你冲进了藤蔓墙后的空地，紧接着，一群黄蜂也从你背后的缺口处追了上来。那些拟像从树林中突然出现，它们手中既拿着芳香的藤蔓，也握着简陋的弓箭；那些与植物紧密相连的狼和野猪也从灌木丛中冲了出来，它们眼中充满狂怒，因为阿尔劳奈的花园正在遭受攻击。黄蜂们立刻开始行动，它们用盾牌击打那些野兽，同时向那些被腐蚀的植物喷射白火，为你们开辟出一条前进的道路。[party.yall]为了继续前进。 

                那些拟像正在拼命守护着花园的中心地带——乍看之下，你可能会以为那是什么建筑物。然而，当你靠近那片空地的边缘时，你会发现实际上那是一株巨大的球茎植物：一株高达十英尺的巨花，它的根部深深扎根于大地之中。它已经闭合了，深绿色的叶子和粉红色的花瓣都紧紧地包裹着自己，但它却位于花园的正中央，处于那些守护植物的最后防线之中。这一定就是阿尔劳奈。 
                
                在它们中间，有一个皮肤呈绿色的女孩格外引人注目——她坐在那个球茎上，吹奏着一支双管笛。她的触手有节奏地敲打着紧贴在她粗壮大腿上的那对“鼓”，发出震耳欲聋的声音，伴随着这种战舞的节奏激励着她的同伴们。她脸颊上涂着鲜艳的红色颜料，这些颜料环绕着她那金色的双眼——毫无疑问，她应该是他们中的领导者。你得先从她开始！

rows.original:
[var0
        |"Mmm," Garth says, listening while you talk. "Well, the loggers are still missing, [pc.name]. They're the people I'd normally send ya to. Find them, find the solution to your plant problem. Everything works out nice and neat, doesn't it?"
        
        You suppose it does at that. "Thanks, Garth. I'll get on it."
        |You start explaining your encounter with the ever-growing roots to Garth: that no matter how hard you tried, new roots grew faster than you could hew them down. That you need a lot of strong bodies to clear the way if you want to get into the corrupted garden, which certainly seems to be the source of a lot of the forest's problems.
        
        "That's... well, that's just damn weird," Garth finally says, setting the mug he was cleaning aside. "I've seen druid-magic before, but never like that, never that powerful. I think you're right, though, about getting more hands. No magic in the world that can't be overwhelmed eventually, least that's what Gweyr'd tell the men before we went into battle against mages. So you're going to need a lot of big, strong lads to do some dirty work for you, and I know where they are."
        
        "Great!" you say. "Let's go."
        
        He chuckles, holding up a weathered old hand. "There's one little problem. Keep your seat, and I'll explain..."
        
        You've got a feeling this is just going to make your life more complicated...
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |“嗯。”加斯边听你说边应道。“这个嘛，那些伐木工依然下落不明，[pc.name]。正常情况下，我会让你去找他们。找到他们，你的树根问题也就有了解决办法。一切都能干净利落地解决，对吧？”
        
        看来确实如此。“谢谢，加斯。我这就去办。”
        |你开始向加斯讲述自己遭遇那些不断生长的树根时发生的事：无论你多么努力，新根长出的速度总比你砍断它们更快。若想进入腐化花园，就需要许多强壮的人手清出道路；而那里显然正是森林中诸多问题的源头。
        
        “这……好吧，这也太他妈怪了。”加斯终于说道，将正在擦洗的杯子放到一旁。“我以前见过德鲁伊魔法，却从没见过这样的，更没见过威力如此强大的。不过，我觉得你说得对，确实需要更多人手。世上没有任何魔法是最终无法靠蛮力压倒的——至少格维尔以前带我们迎战法师时，总会这样对弟兄们说。所以，你需要一大群高大强壮的汉子替你干些脏活，而我知道他们在哪。”
        
        “太好了！”你说道。“我们走吧。”
        
        他轻笑一声，举起饱经风霜的老手。“还有一个小问题。你先坐着，我来解释……”
        
        你有种感觉，这件事只会让自己的生活变得更加复杂……
    ]

        |You start explaining your encounter with the ever-growing roots to Garth: that no matter how hard you tried, new roots grew faster than you could hew them down. That you need a lot of strong bodies to clear the way if you want to get into the corrupted garden, which certainly seems to be the source of a lot of the forest's problems.
        
        "That's... well, that's just damn weird," Garth finally says, setting the mug he was cleaning aside. "I've seen druid-magic before, but never like that, never that powerful. I think you're right, though, about getting more hands. No magic in the world that can't be overwhelmed eventually, least that's what Gweyr'd tell the men before we went into battle against mages. So you're going to need a lot of big, strong lads to do some dirty work for you, and I know where they are."
        
        "Great!" you say. "Let's go."
        
        He chuckles, holding up a weathered old hand. "There's one little problem. Keep your seat, and I'll explain..."
        
        You've got a feeling this is just going to make your life more complicated...
    ]
    "

rows.original: "Out west in the Old Forest, there's a logging camp — Westbank, named such on account of it sitting on the western bank of the river. Not much to look at, really, but pretty important to the town as a whole. The lads there fell the trees of the Old Forest, plant new ones, and work the fallen logs a little before floating them to the sawmill downstream to be turned into planks and beams. To give you a rough estimate, I'd say about half the timbers that now make up Hawkethorne once passed through there, so you can imagine how important it is to keep it up and running." Garth sighs, hanging his dishrag over a shoulder. "Now, there's been a problem of late — it actually started before you came, [pc.name], but recent troubles haven't been making it any better, either. About two to three weeks before you arrived in Hawkethorne, we got word that strange things had been going on near the camp. Animals acting oddly, getting too close to the palisades when they should've been rightfully scared of people. A series of close shaves with things in the darkness, too close together to be mere coincidence. "You may laugh, but there's something unsettling about a snowshoe rabbit hopping up to the gates and just sitting and staring for hours on end. It's not just the feeling of being watched, it's the feeling that the bunny is just a puppet — that someone else is looking at you through its eyes. I should know; I've seen such things done before in my younger days on the road. You thirsty there, [pc.name]?" You nod, but Garth's already set the mug under the tap and is filling it to the brim with mead. He lets the foam subside a little before sliding it across the counter to you. [dayNight |A tiny little voice in the back of your mind says something about this being too early in the day to start drinking, but you quickly snuff it out. This is good stuff. ]You raise the mug to your lips, tip your head back, and take a long, deep swig to keep the cold out. If this is a bribe, it's working pretty well. "Right, moving on with the story. Hawkethorne's full of hunters, but we don't have many people who can actually fight aside from me and old man Sanders. It took us a week or so to try and get something of a militia together and head into the Old Forest to investigate. During that time, word comes down from Westbank that a warg's been spotted prowling near the treeline. "My idiot son catches wind of this, and declares that he's going to go up there himself to take care of the problem by himself — I believe his exact words were that he was going to 'punch out all its blood.'" Garth sighs, shakes his head and looks down at the mug he's polishing. "Stupid, stupid, glory-seeking pup. By the time someone's wandered into the Frost Hound and told me what Garret was up to, he's already packed up and left. That was three days before you arrived, [pc.name]. Neither him nor anyone else from the logging camp have shown their faces in Hawkethorne since, and with all the nonsense happening of late no one's been able to go out and check on them." You can see where this is going. "So, I find your son and make sure the loggers are all okay, and then they'll pay me back with some labor?" He nods. "'Bout sums it up, yeah. I've been hemming and hawing about asking you since you first said you were heading into the woods, but I figured I'd wait a couple more days now that the blizzard's cleared. But if you need their help anyway, might as well get on with it. Hopefully they just need some help clearing the road back to town, or they're all so shitfaced from trying to pass the time they've forgotten to check if it's stopped snowing. But I've got a feeling it's something a bit more sinister than that. So. Any questions?"
rows.translation: 在西部那片古老的森林里，有一个伐木营地——名叫韦斯特班克，这个名字的由来是因为它位于河流的西岸。这个营地看起来并不怎么样，但实际上对整个小镇来说却非常重要。那里的工人们负责砍伐古古林里的树木，种植新的树木，然后对砍下来的原木进行初步加工，之后再将它们运送到下游的锯木厂，将其加工成木板和其他建筑材料。大概来说，现在组成鹰棘镇的木材中，有一半都是曾经从那里运过来的。所以你可以想象，维持这个运输通道的正常运转是多么重要。” 加斯叹了口气，把抹布搭在肩上。最近出现了一个问题，其实这个问题是从……开始的。在[pc.name]，之前你来了。但是最近的麻烦也让情况没有得到任何改善。在你来到鹰棘镇之前的两三周，我们收到了消息，说营地附近发生了一些奇怪的事情——动物们的行为变得异常，本应该对人类感到恐惧的它们，却反而凑得离栅栏太近了。一连串与黑暗中的那些东西的惊险遭遇，这些事件发生的频率实在太接近了，绝非巧合。 “你们可能会笑，但有一件事确实让人感到不安——那就是当一只雪鞋兔跳到大门前，然后就坐在那里，一动不动地盯着你看上几个小时。这种感觉不仅仅是因为有人在注视着你，而更是因为你觉得那只兔子其实只是一个木偶——有人正通过它的双眼看着你。我应该很清楚这一点；在我年轻时，在路上旅行时，我就见过这种事情发生。你在那儿口渴了吧？[pc.name]你点了点头，但加斯已经把杯子放在水龙头下，正把蜂蜜酒倒得满满的。他等泡沫稍微消退一些，才把杯子推到你的面前。 [dayNight |你脑海中有一个微小的声音在提醒你，现在才早上，现在还不是喝酒的时候，但你很快就压制住了这个声音。这酒确实不错啊。 ]你将杯子举到嘴边，仰头大口喝下，这样就能让寒冷远离身体。 如果这算是一种贿赂的话，那它的效果确实相当不错。 “好了，继续讲故事吧。鹰棘镇到处都是猎人，但我们手头上其实并没有多少能够战斗除了我和桑德斯老人之外，我们花了一周左右的时间才勉强组建起一支民兵小队，然后前往古林进行调查。就在那段时间里，从西岸传来了消息，有人看到有战争怪物在树林附近出没。 我那个愚蠢的儿子听说了这件事，竟然宣称要亲自去解决那个问题——我记得他的原话是，他要‘把里面所有的血都打出来’。”加斯叹了口气，摇了摇头，然后低头继续擦拭他正在擦拭的杯子。愚蠢的、贪图荣耀的家伙。等到有人走进霜犬酒馆酒馆告诉我加雷特在搞什么名堂时，他已经收拾东西离开了。那是在你到来的三天之前。[pc.name]从那以后，他以及伐木营里的其他人都再也没有出现在鹰棘镇。再加上最近发生的那些荒唐事，根本没人能够去看看他们的情况。 你应该能猜到接下来会发生什么了。所以，我会找到你的儿子，确保那些伐木工人都没事，然后他们就会用一些劳力来偿还我吧？” 他点了点头。“差不多就是这个意思。自从你第一次说要去森林里之后，我就一直犹豫要不要请你帮忙，但既然暴风雪已经过去了，我想再等几天再问你吧。但如果你无论如何都需要他们的帮助，那就干脆直接去寻求吧。希望他们只是需要一些帮助来清理回镇子的道路，或者是因为忙着打发时间而完全忘记了是否还在下雪。但我有一种感觉，这件事其实比那看起来要阴险得多。那么，还有其他问题吗？

rows.original: "[pc.name]! You've been busy, haven't you?" Garth gives you a friendly nod as you step back into the familiar warmth of the Frost Hound, motioning you over towards the bar. "Strangest thing. A blue lad just came through a few hours ago, dressed in Lumian robes, asking for a beer — said he was on his way to the farmland to set up trade between Pupperidge and the Winter City. Ha! Never thought I'd see the day." Etheryn appears behind you with [etheryn.lnhConfidence |a nervous smile |a smile |an easy smile ]. "[pc.HeShe] does good work. Because of [pc.name], th— my kingdom is finally reaching out again for the first time in more than a century." "Ah, and there's the Lady Regent herself. Crowned heads drink free here, little lady," the old wolf says, reaching under the bar. "Here. A bottle of wine the wife and I picked up years back from the Heartland, all the way down in Taelinya. Fitting to celebrate a whole kingdom returning to us, eh?" "Here, here!" Cait says, taking the seat on your other arm from Ryn. "To our frosty new friends!" Garth pours, and the group of you drink[pc.isPregnant |, though you beg off for a glass of water this time ].
rows.translation: "[pc.name]你最近一直很忙吧？” 当你重新走进寒霜猎犬号那熟悉的温暖空间时，加斯友好地向你点了点头，然后示意你往酒吧那边走。“真是奇怪，几小时前有个穿着卢米安长袍的蓝皮肤男孩来到这里，要了一杯啤酒——他说自己正要去农田，准备在帕珀里奇和冬城之间开展贸易。哈！真没想到有那么一天会见到这种事。” 伊瑟琳这时出现在你身后[etheryn.lnhConfidence |一个紧张的微笑 |一个微笑 |一个轻松的微笑 ]。 "[pc.HeShe]做得很好。正是因为如此。[pc.name]， th— 我的一个多世纪以来，这个王国终于再次与我们取得了联系。” “啊，还有那位女摄政王本人。在这里，王室成员可以免费喝酒，小姑娘。”老狼说着，伸手从吧台下面拿出了酒杯。“来，喝吧。这是我和妻子几年前从Heartland地区，一路跑到Taelinya买的那一瓶酒。正好可以用来庆祝我们的整个王国重新回到我们手中，对吧？” “来，给！”凯特说着，从小琳手中接过你另一只手臂上的座位。致我们这些新结识的朋友们！” 加思倒酒，在场的众人便一起饮下了酒。[pc.isPregnant |不过这一次，你还是乖乖地去喝了一杯水 ]。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Things haven't been quiet while you were up north, though," Garth continues, wiping the back of a hand across his muzzle. "Mmm. The least of it's been more sightings of that red-headed witch, Viviane or somesuch, all over the Old Forest. I don't know if she's got anything to do with those miners going missing, but..." "Miners?" you ask. "Oh! You haven't heard, of course. There's a mine not far from town; used to be Hawkstone Barony's pride of trade. Now, a few crews go up every moon or two to get Ogrish some ore. Nothing major these days. But this last group, they went out a few days back, haven't seen 'em since. And now some of the nomadic lupine tribes that we trade with sometimes — for meat and furs, you know — have come through saying they're missing people, too. Weird shit." "More demons, you think?" He shrugs. "Could be. Leorah says some of her hunters have been seeing horned wolf-men gone feral out in the wilds now. Whatever's spooking those bowmen has stayed well away from the village, at least. While you were busy with that demon business up north, another local girl — Drifa, her name was — went out saying she was going to try and find our missing people. Of course now her folks are yapping at me about her not coming home — though she's barely been gone long enough to walk up to the Alraune's garden and back, by my reckoning." "[pc.isDK |Let me guess," you sigh. "You want me to go save her?" |So," you say, "you want me to go looking for her?" ] "If you would," Garth nods, "there's a lotta folks in town who'd appreciate knowing what happened to their kin. Drifa and the miners. I don't want to pull you off Kasyrra's tail, mind, but just because you finished in the Winter City doesn't meant that the Old Forest is out of problems in need of solving. And you're damn good at solving problems." [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED |After a moment, Garth adds, "Even with the orcs gone, something's disrupted the trade to Khor'minos. Haven't seen a trader come from the east since the blizzard, not a one." |He's quick to add, "And don't forget those orcs. They've stopped trade between us and Khor'minos entirely now, it seems like. Haven't seen a trader come from the east since the blizzard rolled through, not a one." ] [flags.KM_ENTER |"Oh, that," you say. "Yeah, don't hold your breath. There's a quarantine over the city because of the demons. It's bad down there, Garth." "Well. Shit. One more reason to put that demon bitch over your knee, eh?" |Losing contact with the largest city in the hemisphere does seem... bad. ]
rows.translation: “不过，你北上的这段时间里，这里也没太平过，”加斯继续说道，用手背擦了擦口鼻。“嗯。最不值一提的，就是有人在古林各处多次见到那个红发女巫，薇薇安还是什么的。我不知道她和那些失踪的矿工有没有关系，不过……” “矿工？”你问道。 “哦！你当然还没听说。离镇子不远的地方有座矿场，过去曾是鹰石男爵领的贸易骄傲。如今每隔一两个月，还是会有几支队伍上山，给奥格里什采些矿石。不过现在规模不大了。但最近那一队几天前出发后，就再也没人见过他们。如今有些偶尔和我们做生意的游牧狼族部落——拿肉和毛皮来交易，你知道的——也经过这里，说他们那边同样有人失踪。真他妈古怪。” “你觉得又是恶魔？” 他耸了耸肩。“有可能。莱奥拉说，她手下有些猎人最近在荒野里见到了发狂的长角狼人。不管是什么东西吓坏了那些弓手，至少一直离村子远远的。你在北方忙着处理恶魔事件时，还有一个本地姑娘——名字叫德莉法——出门说要设法寻找我们失踪的人。当然，如今她的家人也在冲我嚷嚷，说她还没回来——不过按我的估算，她离开的时间勉强只够走到阿尔劳妮的花园再回来。” “[pc.isDK |让我猜猜，”你叹息道。“你想让我去救她？” |所以，”你说道，“你想让我去找她？” ] “如果你愿意的话，”加斯点点头，“镇上有许多人都想知道自己的亲人究竟出了什么事。德莉法和那些矿工都是。我无意让你放弃追踪卡希拉，但你在冬城处理完了事情，并不代表古林从此就再没有问题需要解决。而你确实非常擅长解决问题。” [flags.ORC_QUEST_CLEARED |过了片刻，加斯又说道：“即使兽人已经被解决，似乎还是有什么东西中断了通往科尔米诺斯的贸易。暴风雪以来，我就没见过一个商人从东方过来，一个都没有。” |他马上补充道：“还有，别忘了那些兽人。看来他们现在已经彻底截断了我们与科尔米诺斯之间的贸易。暴风雪席卷过后，我就没见过一个商人从东方过来，一个都没有。” ] [flags.KM_ENTER |“哦，那件事啊，”你说道。“嗯，别指望他们很快就来。恶魔肆虐，整座城市都被封锁了。下面的情况非常糟糕，加斯。” “好吧。妈的。看来又多了一个把那个恶魔婊子按在膝盖上狠揍屁股的理由，是吧？” |与这个半球最大的城市失去联系，听起来确实……很糟糕。 ]

rows.translation: 加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
Soon after stepping into town, you catch sight of Garth's familiar bulk, limping down the dirt road followed by [flags.SANDERS_MET
        |Brother Sanders
        |an older human man in white and red robes
    ]. The two men appear to be deep in discussion as they walk, oblivious to your presence.
    
    "I'm telling you there's more and more of those winged shits coming out of the foothills, Sanders," Garth grumbles. "I've got every man that can hold a bow taking shifts on the wall and I'm still not sure we can cover the entire town if they mass for an attack." 
    
    "Troubling indeed," the priest says. "[flags.ERYKA_HELPED
        |Eryka
        |One of Leorah's hunters
    ] mentioned having seen a Velunite paladin heading that way a bit ago, a quite large woman as I understand. Perhaps that problem will be dealt with by Greenbeard's axe."
    
    Garth frowns. "And if not? We can't just sit around hoping somebody solves our problems for us. You of all people should know hope isn't a strategy. We owe it to the village to— oh, [pc.name]. Perfect timing."
    
    The old wolf slaps a paw onto your shoulder. "Where have you been off to all this time, hm? Ha, you look like you've been through the wars, too."
rows.translation:
刚走进小镇，你就看到了加斯那熟悉的身影——他一瘸一拐地走在土路上，后面还跟着[flags.SANDERS_MET
        |桑德斯修士
        |一位身穿红白相间长袍的年长男子
    ]那两个男人边走边似乎在认真讨论着什么，完全没注意到你的存在。
    
    “我跟你说，那些长着翅膀的怪物从山脚下不断涌出来，桑德斯，”加思抱怨道，“我已经让所有会拉弓的人轮流在城墙上站岗了，但我还是不确定如果它们集体发动攻击，我们是否能够保护整个城镇。”
    
    “确实是个麻烦事，”牧师说道。[flags.ERYKA_HELPED
        |艾瑞卡
        |利奥拉的手下之一
    ]有人提到刚才看到一位名叫维伦信徒的圣骑士朝那个方向去了，据我所知，那是一位身材相当高大的女性。或许绿胡子用他的斧头就能解决那个问题。
    
    加思皱起了眉头：“如果不行呢？我们不能只是坐以待毙，指望别人来为我们解决问题。你们这些人应该最清楚，希望并不是解决问题的办法。我们欠这个村庄一个交代——哦[pc.name]时机把握得恰到好处。”
    
    老狼用爪子轻拍你的肩膀：“这段时间你去哪里了啊？哈，看你的样子，似乎也经历了很多磨难吧。

rows.translation: 拯救精灵族
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
"Saving a whole city, huh?" Garth laughs. "Damn, [pc.boyGirl], I knew you were something else the moment you stepped up to help Cait, but that's something else."
        
        "Bravo," Sanders says. "Amazing that we can go from being unsure if any of the pale elves were still alive up there to knowing an entire city still stands. You've outdone yourself, my friend."
        
        The old wolf nods along. "Though that might not be the only city in need of saving. Hordes of these... little winged demon-creatures have been poking around in the foothills. They haven't attacked the town yet, but we also haven't seen hide or hair from Khor'minos since that girl Livrea left. And she was talking about some kind of great big battle down there. If this Kasyrra woman slipped your grasp, might be she's down there with the other monsters."
        
        [party.has brint
            |"Khaak," Brint groans. "Hopefully home hasn't burned down while I'm away."
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |Brienne squeezes your hand. "I just hope my home's still standing..."
        ]
rows.translation:
拯救一整座城市，哈？”加斯笑道，“真了不起[pc.boyGirl]从你站出来帮助凯特那一刻起，我就知道你不同寻常，但你的表现真的太出色了。”
        
        “太棒了，”桑德斯说道，“从最初不确定那些苍白精灵中是否还有人活着，到如今知道有一整座城市依然存在，这个过程真是令人惊叹。你这次真是超越了自己，我的朋友。”
        
        老狼点了点头表示同意。“不过，可能还有其他城市也需要救援。成群这样的……带翅膀的小恶魔一直在山脚下活动。他们还没有攻击这个小镇，但自从那个叫莉维娅的女孩离开后，我们就再也没见过科尔米诺斯的任何踪迹。而她当时还提到过那里即将发生一场大规模的战斗。如果这个叫卡希拉的女人从你手中逃脱了，说不定她现在正和那些怪物们在一起呢。"
        
        [party.has brint
            |该死，”布林特呻吟道，“希望我不在家的时候家里没有发生火灾。
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |布蕾妮握住了你的手。“我只希望我的家还能完好无损……
        ]

rows.translation: 与魔后战斗
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
"Ha, you sent her packing, and that's enough," Garth says, squeezing your shoulder. "Don't be discouraged your prey's slipped the noose. You'll catch up sooner rather than later."

        "Perhaps very soon, if you have a mind to chase her," Sanders adds. "Garth and I were just discussing how many more monsters have been sighting in the foothills east of here lately. Worse yet, we haven't heard from the Kingdom of Khor'minos — our nearest neighbors in that direction — in some time..."
        
        "Not since that girl Livrea left," Garth says. "And she was talking about some big battle down there. If you're on that demon's scent, could be she's gone that way."
        
        [party.has brint
            |"Khaak," Brint groans. "Hopefully home hasn't burned down while I'm away."
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |Brienne squeezes your hand. "I just hope my home's still standing..."
        ]
rows.translation:
“哈，你把她赶跑了，这就够了，”加斯捏着你的肩膀说道。“别因为猎物挣脱绳套就灰心。你迟早会追上她的。”

        “如果你有心追赶，也许很快就能追上，”桑德斯补充道。“加斯和我刚才还在讨论，最近东边山麓出现的怪物越来越多。更糟的是，我们已经有段时间没收到科尔米诺斯王国的消息了——那是我们在那个方向最近的邻国……”
        
        “自从莉维娅那姑娘离开以后就没有了，”加斯说道。“她还说那边爆发过一场大战。如果你正在追踪那个恶魔的气味，她说不定去了那里。”
        
        [party.has brint
            |“该死，”布林特呻吟道。“希望我不在时家园还没有被烧毁。”
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |布蕾妮握紧你的手。“只希望我的家还立在那里……”
        ]

        "Though speaking of your friend," Sanders says, "that cult you encountered near the castle? It may be that they've relocated to the east of here. We've seen a number of strange monsters coming from that way, and no traders or pilgrims on the road from Khor'minos."
        
        "If you're the kind that can't leave loose ends, anyway," Garth says, "that might be of interest. That bard girl, Livrea, said that there was some kind of big battle down that way." 
        
        [party.has brint

rows.translation: 他们根本无权知道你最近在忙些什么，对吧？
rows.raw: "It's none of their business what you've been up to, is it?"

rows.translation: 维伦信徒圣骑士
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
"Oh, just a rumor, really," Sanders says. "But I have reason enough to believe a rather famous paladin of my faith is in the region, and heading east as well. She'll likely have beaten you to Khor'minos by a good while."

        "Who is she?"
        
        Sanders shakes his head. "I don't know, in truth. If the report I received is to be taken at face value, it may be Velun's own champion — or more likely one of her companions. Either way, she'll be a strong warrior, and devoted to protecting the realm from this corruption. If you have a chance to do so, I'd encourage you to seek her out. Though I am not sure exactly where she would have gone..."
        
        "Khor'minos is about the only thing that way," Garth says. 
        
        "It's also underground," Sanders says, "and that is... very far from the warmth of the forest. Still, I suppose all the earth is part of nature..."
rows.translation:
哦，其实只是个谣言而已，”桑德斯说，“但我有充分的理由相信，我信仰中那位相当著名的圣骑士就在这个地区，而且她也在向东前进。她很可能已经比你先到达了科尔米诺斯。

        她是谁？”
        
        桑德斯摇了摇头：“说实话，我不知道。如果我收到的那份报告是真实的，那么她可能是维伦自己的勇士——或者更有可能，是她的同伴之一。无论如何，她肯定是一位强大的战士，而且会竭尽全力保护这个王国免受这种腐败的侵害。如果你有机会的话，我建议你去找她。不过我不太确定她现在会在哪里……”
        
        “科尔米诺斯应该是那个方向上唯一的可能地点了，”加斯说。
        
        “而且那里还是在地下，”桑德斯补充道。…与森林的温暖截然不同。不过，我想，整个地球都属于大自然的一部分吧……

rows.original: What's this about a Velunite paladin?
rows.translation: 这个维伦信徒圣骑士是怎么回事？
科尔米诺斯
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
"Our nearest neighbor to the east," Sanders says. "And the largest realm in this part of the world. The bulk of the kingdom is underneath the Hornpeak mountains, and what remains sits along the coast of the continent. We get most of our metals and stones from them, and they buy excess food from Hawkethorne in turn."

        "Good people, by and large," Garth says. "[var0
            |Certain recent exceptions notwithstanding...
            |Though there's a minotaur that's been lurking around town a while now that gives me a bad feeling. The dangerous sort.
        ]"
        
        Sanders laughs. "No place is perfect, elsewise we'd have begged their king to annex us by now." 
        
        "Over my dead body," Garth grumbles.
        
        "Anything I should be worried about there?" you ask.
        
        "No," Garth says, "At least not from the kingdom. But to get there, you'll need to go through the foothills, the King's Gate, and then the under-mountain roads. It's a long trek, and even in good times it can be dangerous. Now? Mm, I'd pack for a long, hard journey if you want to reach the capitol's gates. You'll probably be attacked at all turns."
        
        "Gods go with you, [pc.name]."
rows.translation:
“我们东边最近的邻国，”桑德斯说道，“也是这个世界上此区域最大的王国。王国主体位于角峰山脉之下，其余领土则沿着大陆海岸分布。我们的金属和石料大多来自那里，而他们也会反过来购买鹰棘镇的余粮。”

        “总的来说，那里的人都不错。”加斯说道。“[var0
            |当然，近期的某些例外暂且不论……
            |不过，最近有头弥诺陶洛斯一直在镇子附近徘徊，让我有种不祥的预感。是危险的那一类。
        ]”
        
        桑德斯笑了。“没有哪个地方十全十美，否则我们早就求他们的国王吞并这里了。”
        
        “除非我死了。”加斯嘟囔道。
        
        “那里有什么需要我担心的吗？”你问道。
        
        “没有，”加斯说道，“至少王国本身没有。不过要到那里，你必须穿过山麓，经过国王之门，再走地下山道。这趟旅程很漫长，就算太平时节也可能遇到危险。至于现在？嗯，如果想抵达首都大门，我会为一场漫长艰苦的旅程做好准备。你大概一路上都会遇袭。”
        
        “愿诸神与你同在，[pc.name]。”

rows.original: What can they tell you about the Kingdom of Khor'minos?
rows.translation: 关于科尔米诺斯王国，他们能告诉你些什么呢？
rows.raw: "What can they tell you about the Kingdom of Khor'minos?"

rows.translation: 怪物
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
"Imps, I think they're called," Sanders says. "Small winged creatures born of corruption. We've seen them scouting the village of late, watching us. It's hard to let our young hunters and woodsmen go into the forest now, and they aren't the only problem of course. Strange women with inky tattoos, cultists, the list goes on..."

        "The point is, we're surrounded by things that want to hurt us," Garth says. "Things are going to get worse before they get better."
        
        "It's not just that," you tell them. "These demons are shapeshifters too. They can make themselves look human, or elven, or whatever again."
        
        Sanders' lips draw taut. "That complicates things."
        
        "A bit," Garth says. "Most of the folk in this village I've known for years. Even the refugees from the valley are hardly strangers. But still... we'll have to keep a closer eye on things. Shit."
        
        Sanders just nods, as if to concur with the curse.
rows.translation:
我想它们应该叫伊mps，”桑德斯说道，“那些由腐败而生、长着小翅膀的生物。最近我们经常看到它们在村庄周围活动，监视着我们。现在让我们的年轻猎人和伐木工人们进入森林实在很危险，当然，它们也不是我们面临的唯一问题。那些身上有着黑色纹身的奇怪女人，那些狂热信徒，类似的例子还有很多……”

        “关键在于，我们周围到处都是那些想要伤害我们的事物，”加斯说道，“情况在好转之前，只会先变得更糟。”
        
        “不仅仅是这样，”你向他们解释道。这些恶魔也会变形。它们可以把自己变成人类、精灵，或者其他的任何形态。”
        
        桑德斯的嘴唇紧绷起来：“那可就把事情复杂化了。”
        
        “确实有点麻烦，”加斯说道，“这个村子里的大多数人都是我认识多年的老主顾了。就连来自山谷的难民，我们也几乎不把他们当作陌生人。但即便如此……我们还是得更加谨慎一些。该死。
        
        桑德斯只是点了点头，似乎也在赞同这个抱怨。

rows.translation: 这跟怪物有什么关系吗？
村庄安全
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original:
Garth puffs his chest up. "We're old, not helpless! It would take an army to be sure we were safe, but we have enough militia to ward off most monsters. Our walls are sturdy, too. Helped raise them myself, you know!"

        "Walls don't help against demons," you say. "They fly."
        
        The old wolf rubs the back of his head sheepishly. "That... yeah, true. But the point stands."
        
        "Does it?" Sanders says. The priest folds his arms. "We can't rely on the usual means of defending ourself here, Garth. Bravado will only make the strike hurt more when it comes."
        
        "If!" Garth growls. "But you're not wrong. Still, I'm not sure what more we can do..."
rows.translation:
加斯挺起胸膛说道：“我们虽然年纪大了，但并不无能为力！要想确保我们的安全，确实需要一支军队，不过我们有足够的民兵来抵御大多数怪物。我们的城墙也非常坚固，你知道的，这些城墙可是我亲自出力帮忙修建的！”

        “但是城墙对恶魔可没什么用处，”你说道。它们会飞。”
        
        老狼有些尴尬地揉了揉后脑勺：“嗯……没错，确实是这样。但我的观点还是成立的。”
        
        “真的吗？”桑德斯问道。牧师双臂交叉抱在胸前：“在这里，我们无法依靠常规的防御手段来保护自己，加斯。逞强只会让这次打击带来的痛苦更加剧烈。”
        
        “如果真是这样的话……”加斯低吼道，“但你说得没错。不过，我确实不知道我们还能做些什么……
rows.raw:
'
        Garth puffs his chest up. "We're old, not helpless! It would take an army to be sure we were safe, but we have enough militia to ward off most monsters. Our walls are sturdy, too. Helped raise them myself, you know!"

        "Walls don't help against demons," you say. "They fly."
        
        The old wolf rubs the back of his head sheepishly. "That... yeah, true. But the point stands."
        
        "Does it?" Sanders says. The priest folds his arms. "We can't rely on the usual means of defending ourself here, Garth. Bravado will only make the strike hurt more when it comes."
        
        "If!" Garth growls. "But you're not wrong. Still, I'm not sure what more we can do..."'

rows.original: Is the village going to be okay?
rows.translation: 这个村庄会没事吧？
rows.raw: "Is the village going to be okay?"

rows.translation: 你刚才不是说过……吗？
加斯与桑德斯

rows.original: You cross your arms. "Weren't you just talking about not waiting around for somebody to solve your problems for you, and now you're trying to aim me right at them..." Garth scratches his head. "Hey, we aren't— ah, hell. Look, it would be a huge help to the town knowing you were on top of the problem. I won't bullshit you. But we aren't sitting idle here, either. Gwyn and I are sparing every moment we can to training the village kids to shoot, and Sanders has been looking after refugees coming up from the valley. Everyone's doing their part, but it's not enough." "It's never enough, but it has to do," Sanders says. "Still, your help in finding out what's wrong in the east would be invaluable. If the village isn't under immediate threat, we can go back to trying to help people, and spend less time paranoid. And if it is..." "Better to know," Garth says. "An early warning could save lives." [party.has cait |"We should help," Cait says, fixing you with those big blue eyes. "It's the right thing to do." ]
