Then I remember that my father would have probably told me I wasn't fit for running the business and probably have been stuck marrying some other merchant's son. That'd be one boring way to live out a life — rich and stuck at home? No thank you!\""

rows.original: Sluts aside, what do you think about orders like Mallach's slutty servants? I mean, back home it's more about worshipping Tira but those orders are more practical. Our commander and the lieutenant both are super scary when they call on their training — what good is a holy whore sitting on a dick compared to someone bulking up and becoming unfazed by any hopeless battle? I'd say Lieutenant Jen is way scarier than any orc when she gets serious!"
rows.translation: “先不说那些荡妇，你怎么看马拉克那种淫荡仆从的教团？我的意思是，在家乡人们更注重崇拜蒂拉，但那种教团更实用。我们的指挥官和副官一旦动用训练出来的本事都可怕得很——跟一个锻炼得强壮、面对任何绝望战斗都面不改色的人相比，一个只会坐在鸡巴上的神圣妓女有什么用？我得说，珍副官认真起来的时候比任何兽人都要可怕！”
rows.raw: " Sluts aside, what do you think about orders like Mallach's slutty servants? I mean, back home it's more about worshipping Tira but those orders are more practical. Our commander and the lieutenant both are super scary when they call on their training — what good is a holy whore sitting on a dick compared to someone bulking up and becoming unfazed by any hopeless battle? I'd say Lieutenant Jen is way scarier than any orc when she gets serious!" "

rows.original: People always tell me I'm really great with kids! Maybe when I hang up my sword one day, I'll take care of them for others. And mine, of course. I want lots of kids too!"
rows.translation: “人们总是说我很适合照顾孩子！也许有一天我金盆洗手之后，会帮别人带孩子。当然，也会带自己的孩子。我也想要很多孩子！”
rows.raw: "\n People always tell me I'm really great with kids! Maybe when I hang up my sword one day, I'll take care of them for others. And mine, of course. I want lots of kids too!\""

rows.original: I don't really understand why anyone kills their opponent; there used to be a few mercenaries with us who were really kill-happy until Commander Leofric cut them down personally. Something about murderers 'losing pieces' of themselves over time. If that's true, that'd explain why the Commander's axe is blunted these days. Back when he was younger, he worshipped Tira vehemently so he must understand more about death or something."
rows.translation: “我实在不明白为什么有人会杀死自己的对手；曾经有几位雇佣兵跟我们在一起，他们极其嗜杀，直到利奥弗里克指挥官亲手把他们斩了。据说杀人者会逐渐“失去自我的一部分”。如果真是这样，就能解释为什么指挥官的斧头如今已经变钝了。在他年轻的时候，他曾经狂热地崇拜蒂拉，所以他肯定更懂死亡之类的事。”
rows.raw: "\n            I don't really understand why anyone kills their opponent; there used to be a few mercenaries with us who were really kill-happy until Commander Leofric cut them down personally. Something about murderers 'losing pieces' of themselves over time. If that's true, that'd explain why the Commander's axe is blunted these days. Back when he was younger, he worshipped Tira vehemently so he must understand more about death or something.\""

rows.original: We mercenaries wear a lot of armor but it's actually more common to not see us wearing it back home. Unless we're patrolling, abroad on jobs or... nevermind. We wear our armor a lot is the point! We just don't wear as much of it since it's so much warmer."
rows.translation: “我们这些雇佣兵会穿很多护甲，但在家乡其实更常见的是看不到我们穿。除非我们在巡逻、在国外出任务，或者……算了。重点是我们穿护甲的时候很多！只是这里暖和得多，所以我们才穿得没那么多。”
rows.raw: "\n            We mercenaries wear a lot of armor but it's actually more common to not see us wearing it back home. Unless we're patrolling, abroad on jobs or... nevermind. We wear our armor a lot is the point! We just don't wear as much of it since it's so much warmer.\""

rows.original: That spooky castle up on the hill kinda freaks me out. Back in Tronarii, we didn't really do castles — they always end up broken and hard to maintain in the middle of a desert. It's actually easier to use oasis-grown lumber, believe it or not!"
rows.translation: “那座坐落在山丘上的阴森城堡真让我发毛。在特洛纳里，我们其实并不怎么建造城堡——沙漠里的城堡最后总是会损坏，而且很难维护。说实话，用绿洲里长出来的木材反而更省事，信不信由你！”
rows.raw: "\n That spooky castle up on the hill kinda freaks me out. Back in Tronarii, we didn't really do castles — they always end up broken and hard to maintain in the middle of a desert. It's actually easier to use oasis-grown lumber, believe it or not!\""

rows.original: Apart from the other type of elves back home, Tronarii is actually kinda like the Frost Marches: diverse. It's a lot of humans, lupine and both wyld elf and dusk elf. The last one is one you folks may not see a ton of — think an elf who looks like they're covered in soot or smoke! Those are definitely the four biggest races in number but there's also catfolk and centaurs. And orcs... but those aren't exactly native. Just rowdy neighbors."
rows.translation: 除了家乡的那些其他种类的精灵之外，特洛纳里地区其实和霜冻边境地区很相似：种族种类繁多。这里有很多人类、狼族，还有荒野精灵和暮色精灵。最后这种精灵你们可能不太常见——想象一下，那些看起来像被煤灰或烟雾覆盖的精灵吧！这四种种族确实是数量最多的，不过这里还有猫族、半人马，还有兽人……不过那些其实并不是这里的原住民，只不过是些爱闹事的邻居罢了。
rows.raw: "\n            Apart from the other type of elves back home, Tronarii is actually kinda like the Frost Marches: diverse. It's a lot of humans, lupine and both wyld elf and dusk elf. The last one is one you folks may not see a ton of — think an elf who looks like they're covered in soot or smoke! Those are definitely the four biggest races in number but there's also catfolk and centaurs. And orcs... but those aren't exactly native. Just rowdy neighbors.\""

rows.original: Horses in Tronarii aren't necessarily rare but they're definitely weird — most of them are hard to get. Commander Leofric really worked his butt off to get all those horses... it's a shame we lost them. The lieutenant's horse is lucky it wasn't caught up in all that bad luck — she's raised it so long that it would probably be a fine stud for some lucky mares! If it's a guy. I don't really look around at horse junk."
rows.translation: “在特洛纳里，马匹并不一定稀少，但它们确实有些奇特——大多数都很难搞到。利奥弗里克指挥官为了弄到那些马可真是拼了老命……可惜我们最终还是失去了它们。那位中尉的马还算幸运，没被卷进那场霉运里——她养了它这么久，要是它是公的，说不定能成为某些幸运母马的好种马！不过说实话，我不太会去盯着马的家伙看。”
rows.raw: "\n            Horses in Tronarii aren't necessarily rare but they're definitely weird — most of them are hard to get. Commander Leofric really worked his butt off to get all those horses... it's a shame we lost them. The lieutenant's horse is lucky it wasn't caught up in all that bad luck — she's raised it so long that it would probably be a fine stud for some lucky mares! If it's a guy. I don't really look around at horse junk.\""

rows.original: Supposedly, Tronarii used to produce most of the bronze used around the world. Entire armies, legendary projects, and backs for coins — you name it, we did it. The rumors aside, we've definitely downscaled these days. We still produce just as much as ever but we're more focused on preserving or selling it rather than giving it away. Arms and armor given freely might land us back under someone's thumb!"
rows.translation: 据说，特洛纳里曾经生产了世界上大部分的青铜制品。无论是整支军队的装备，还是那些传奇项目所需的材料，甚至是硬币的铸造原料——但凡你需要，我们都能提供。不过，这些传闻也就罢了。如今，我们的生产规模确实有所缩小。我们仍然在生产与过去一样多的产品，但更多的精力是放在如何保存这些资源或将其出售出去，而不是免费赠送它们。如果把武器和盔甲都免费分发出去，恐怕又会让我们重新陷入别人的控制之下！
rows.raw: "\n            Supposedly, Tronarii used to produce most of the bronze used around the world. Entire armies, legendary projects, and backs for coins — you name it, we did it. The rumors aside, we've definitely downscaled these days. We still produce just as much as ever but we're more focused on preserving or selling it rather than giving it away. Arms and armor given freely might land us back under someone's thumb!\""

rows.original: Everyone looks at me funny anytime I speak Tronariiani. You'd think they'd have heard it at least once with all the merchants doing business abroad. I guess this part of Savarra is just too out of the way. And cold. Not that I mind with these fuzzy legs of mine!"
rows.translation: “每次我说特洛纳里语，大家都会用奇怪的眼神看着我。想想看，这么多在国外做生意的商人，他们应该至少听过一次才对。我想，萨瓦拉的这个地区实在太偏远了——而且也很寒冷。不过，我这双毛茸茸的腿倒是不介意！”
rows.raw: "\n            Everyone looks at me funny anytime I speak Tronariiani. You'd think they'd have heard it at least once with all the merchants doing business abroad. I guess this part of Savarra is just too out of the way. And cold. Not that I mind with these fuzzy legs of mine!\""

rows.original: Get this — I ran into this weird blonde catfolk merchant the other day! Normally no one would ever dream of turning their nose up to true Tronarii bronze but she — and her bodyguards — were trying to make offers on iron! Who would use that scrap compared to a well-made Tronarii blade?"
rows.translation: 你听好了——前几天我遇到了一个奇怪的金发猫族商人！通常来说，没人会拒绝真正的特洛纳里青铜制品，但她和她那些保镖却试图用低价来出售这些商品。铁比起一把制作精良的特洛纳里刀刃，谁会去使用那种破旧的东西呢？
rows.raw: '\n Get this — I ran into this weird blonde catfolk merchant the other day! Normally no one would ever dream of turning their nose up to true Tronarii bronze but she — and her bodyguards — were trying to make offers on iron! Who would use that scrap compared to a well-made Tronarii blade?"'

rows.original: With how often people wear or carry bronze, coloring it is an important job! You can actually apply a ton of patina finishes with the right metallurgy mage... or blacksmith. Honestly, if there's magic to work on armor then I'd bet it came from Tronarii!"
rows.translation: 由于人们经常佩戴或携带青铜制品，因此对其进行着色是一项非常重要的工作！只要拥有精通冶金技术的法师……或者铁匠，就完全可以通过各种工艺为青铜制品添加各种锈色效果。说实在的，如果盔甲的制作过程中真的涉及魔法元素的话，我敢打赌这些魔法技术肯定源自特洛纳里！
rows.raw: "\n            With how often people wear or carry bronze, coloring it is an important job! You can actually apply a ton of patina finishes with the right metallurgy mage... or blacksmith. Honestly, if there's magic to work on armor then I'd bet it came from Tronarii!\""

rows.original: Merchants are a lot less fickle here than back home; my dad wouldn't have sold anyone a horse as easily as some of the lot here! I mean, I get some of them are stuck and all... but like come on!"
rows.translation: “在这里，商人们可没有家乡的那些人那么善变；我爸爸可不会像这里的一些商人那样轻易地把马卖给别人！当然，我明白有些人是走投无路了……但拜托，这也太随便了吧！”
rows.raw: "\n Merchants are a lot less fickle here than back home; my dad wouldn't have sold anyone a horse as easily as some of the lot here! I mean, I get some of them are stuck and all... but like come on!\""

rows.original: One of these days I'm going to return home and see if there is a nice slut of Mallach out there for me... nah, just messing with you. I'm desperate but not that desperate."
rows.translation: “总有一天，我会回家看看，看看马拉克那边有没有哪个漂亮的荡妇适合我……算了，逗你玩的。我是很饥渴，但还没那么饥渴。”
rows.raw: " One of these days I'm going to return home and see if there is a nice slut of Mallach out there for me... nah, just messing with you. I'm desperate but not that desperate." "

rows.original: Not everything works against every opponent, you know. Slimes aren't going to be cut by any regular blade like you or me! If you want to beat an opponent, try experimenting! That's the first lesson for any mercenary; think on your feet! Or hooves!"
rows.translation: 要知道，并不是所有手段对每个对手都管用。像你我这样的普通刀刃，是砍不动史莱姆的！想打赢对手，就试着多尝试！这是每个雇佣兵的第一课：随机应变！或者随蹄应变！
rows.raw: "\n            Not everything works against every opponent, you know. Slimes aren't going to be cut by any regular blade like you or me! If you want to beat an opponent, try experimenting! That's the first lesson for any mercenary; think on your feet! Or hooves!\""

rows.original: Have you ever tried drinking until you pass out? Don't. It's not worth the hangover!"
rows.translation: 你有没有试过喝到昏过去为止？千万别这么干，那样只会让第二天醒来后头痛难忍，根本不值得！
rows.raw: "\n            Have you ever tried drinking until you pass out? Don't. It's not worth the hangover!\""

rows.original: A full pack is a beginner's trap! If you head out somewhere, you should consider offloading some gear at the nearby stores or something first — you wouldn't want to have to choose between your [pc.weapon] and something else, right?"
rows.translation: 装满的行囊是新手的陷阱！如果你要出远门，应该先考虑把一些装备寄放在附近的商店之类的地方——你总不会想在自己的[pc.weapon]和别的东西之间二选一吧？
rows.raw: "\n            A full pack is a beginner's trap! If you head out somewhere, you should consider offloading some gear at the nearby stores or something first — you wouldn't want to have to choose between your [pc.weapon] and something else, right?\""

rows.original: When you're on the road as much as we are, you learn to keep a tent or some camping supplies on you all the time. Even just getting a small window of rest when traversing rough terrain can be invaluable!"
rows.translation: 当你像我们一样经常在路上旅行时，你就会明白为什么必须随时携带帐篷或一些露营用品。即使在穿越崎岖地形时能获得短暂的休息时间，也是极其宝贵的！
rows.raw: "\n            When you're on the road as much as we are, you learn to keep a tent or some camping supplies on you all the time. Even just getting a small window of rest when traversing rough terrain can be invaluable!\""

rows.original: Think before you touch stuff! Whether it's a sword buried in rock, an abandoned estate's door in the middle of nowhere or a girl's chest it doesn't matter — one wrong touch and you could be dead! Or grabbing some nice, soft girl-pillows. Not that it's an invite... just part of the example."
rows.translation: 在触碰任何东西之前，先好好想想吧！无论是埋在岩石中的剑，还是偏远地区某座废弃宅邸的门，又或是某个女孩的胸部——都无所谓。只要触碰不当，你就可能有生命危险！当然，也有可能只是抓到一些柔软可爱的女孩枕头……不过这倒也不是在邀请你……只是这个例子中的一部分而已。
rows.raw: "\n            Think before you touch stuff! Whether it's a sword buried in rock, an abandoned estate's door in the middle of nowhere or a girl's chest it doesn't matter — one wrong touch and you could be dead! Or grabbing some nice, soft girl-pillows. Not that it's an invite... just part of the example.\""

rows.original: Some substances are best avoided — and I don't just mean the kind that are questionable drugs. I've heard some forms of cum are dangerous for consumption! Sex can already be a big deal but be careful before you go gulping down every fat load or eating a girl out through her whole orgasm; last thing anyone wants is to get hooked on a bad lay!"
rows.translation: 有些东西最好还是避开——我指的可不只是那些来路不明的药物。我听说，某些形式的精液吞下去是有危险的！性本身就已经是件大事了，但在你把每一发浓精都咕咚咽下去、或者用嘴把女孩舔到高潮结束之前，还是小心点；谁都不想因为一场烂炮而上瘾！
rows.raw: "\n            Some substances are best avoided — and I don't just mean the kind that are questionable drugs. I've heard some forms of cum are dangerous for consumption! Sex can already be a big deal but be careful before you go gulping down every fat load or eating a girl out through her whole orgasm; last thing anyone wants is to get hooked on a bad lay!\""

rows.original: A rule of thumb in any negotiation: choose wisely when revealing your hand. My father and his father made a real steal off the backs of foolish merchants and nobles because we didn't show them our entire plan. Giving them pieces of details can make an opponent sloppy and assume you don't really have a trick up your sleeve!"
rows.translation: 在任何谈判中，都有一个基本的准则：在透露自己的计划时必须谨慎选择时机。我的父亲和他的父亲之所以能够从那些愚蠢的商人和贵族手中获得巨大的利益，正是因为我们没有向他们透露全部计划。只向对方透露部分细节，就能让对手放松警惕，从而以为你其实并没有什么隐藏的招数！
rows.raw: "\n            A rule of thumb in any negotiation: choose wisely when revealing your hand. My father and his father made a real steal off the backs of foolish merchants and nobles because we didn't show them our entire plan. Giving them pieces of details can make an opponent sloppy and assume you don't really have a trick up your sleeve!\""

rows.original: Touching elf ears is super special! I mean, they're so sensitive so... you know... it's really nice of us to trust people with our ears. You should respect that trust!"
rows.translation: 摸精灵的耳朵可是非常特别的！我是说，它们实在太敏感了，所以……你懂的……我们愿意让人碰自己的耳朵，可是真的很信任对方。你应该尊重这份信任！
rows.raw: "\n Touching elf ears is super special! I mean, they're so sensitive so... you know... it's really nice of us to trust people with our ears. You should respect that trust!\""

rows.original: Something about you seems really charismatic — I bet sparing people would net you a lot of new friends! A bloody battlefield is one full of lost chances, you know!"
rows.translation: 你身上似乎有种很不寻常的魅力——我敢打赌，要是你饶过别人的性命，一定能交到不少新朋友！要知道，血腥的战场可是充满了错失的机会啊！
rows.raw: '\n            Something about you seems really charismatic — I bet sparing people would net you a lot of new friends! A bloody battlefield is one full of lost chances, you know!"'

rows.original: Orcs are strong so if you're going to fight them, get someone big and beefy to stand in the way! [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|Someone like that big [brint.isBrienne|cowgirl|minotaur] friend of yours would do a good job of facing them head on!|Maybe a[pc.ra minotaur|nother] minotaur helping you would be a good idea!] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|Your big orcish friend would also be a good help, I guess.|Or you could try turning one of them against them. Orcs that don't raid are pretty popular for adventurer parties from what I've heard!]"
rows.translation: 兽人非常强壮，所以如果你打算与他们战斗，那就找一个体型高大、力量强大的家伙来挡在前面吧！ [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|像那样高大的人[brint.isBrienne|女牛仔|弥诺陶洛斯]你的那位朋友肯定能够勇敢地面对他们！|也许吧。[pc.ra minotaur|另一个]让弥诺陶洛斯来帮助你，肯定是个好主意！] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|我想，你那个高大的兽人朋友也会帮上大忙的。|或者，你可以试着让他们中的某一方与另一方为敌。据我所知，那些不参与袭击的兽人，对于冒险者团队来说可是相当受欢迎的！]"
rows.raw: "\n            Orcs are strong so if you're going to fight them, get someone big and beefy to stand in the way! [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|Someone like that big [brint.isBrienne|cowgirl|minotaur] friend of yours would do a good job of facing them head on!|Maybe a[pc.ra minotaur|nother] minotaur helping you would be a good idea!] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|Your big orcish friend would also be a good help, I guess.|Or you could try turning one of them against them. Orcs that don't raid are pretty popular for adventurer parties from what I've heard!]\""

rows.original: Forests are so gloomy but my kind love to run around in them. I bet there are wyld elves hanging out there right now!"
rows.translation: 森林这么阴森，可我的同类却爱在林子里到处跑。我敢打赌，这会儿肯定就有荒野精灵在那儿晃悠！
rows.raw: '\n Forests are so gloomy but my kind love to run around in them. I bet there are wyld elves hanging out there right now!"'

rows.original: Wyld elves aren't always the same you know — our Wyld Marks can generate different effects for each of us! Not only that but they don't always appear in the same place, so even if we exhibit the same transformations we might not even have our marks in the same place. It's probably why you almost never meet twins of our race!"
rows.translation: 你知道，荒荒野精灵并不总是完全相同的——我们的“野生印记”会为我们每个人带来不同的效果！不仅如此，这些印记出现的部位也不一定总是一样的，因此即使我们展现出相同的变形，这些印记的位置也可能不同。这大概就是为什么你几乎从来见不到我们种族中的双胞胎吧！
rows.raw: "\n            Wyld elves aren't always the same you know — our Wyld Marks can generate different effects for each of us! Not only that but they don't always appear in the same place, so even if we exhibit the same transformations we might not even have our marks in the same place. It's probably why you almost never meet twins of our race!\""

rows.original: The fey are an interesting thing between the truth and myths, particularly if you believe wyld elves are connected to them. Pixies and fairies are so much more different than us but we exhibit a beautiful closeness with nature almost identically. Well... normally. Sometimes there are fey born without any real connection to nature. Given how attuned we are, they must have a rough time living in woods when creatures aren't as friendly..."
rows.translation: 妖精是介于事实与神话之间的有趣存在，尤其是当你相信荒野精灵与他们有关联的时候。小妖精和仙子跟我们差别太大了，但我们与自然的亲密关系却几乎一模一样。嗯……通常是这样。有时候会有一些妖精天生就与自然毫无真正的联系。鉴于我们与自然如此契合，当周围的生灵不那么友善时，他们住在树林里肯定很难熬……
rows.raw: "\n            The fey are an interesting thing between the truth and myths, particularly if you believe wyld elves are connected to them. Pixies and fairies are so much more different than us but we exhibit a beautiful closeness with nature almost identically. Well... normally. Sometimes there are fey born without any real connection to nature. Given how attuned we are, they must have a rough time living in woods when creatures aren't as friendly...\""

rows.original: I heard there are some really cold woods further north, out beyond the forest. Do you think that there are really cuddly things out there with tons of warm fur, too?"
rows.translation: 我听说在森林之外、更北边的地方，有些非常寒冷的树林。你觉得那儿会不会也有一些长着厚厚暖毛、特别适合抱在怀里的生物呢？
rows.raw: '\n            I heard there are some really cold woods further north, out beyond the forest. Do you think that there are really cuddly things out there with tons of warm fur, too?"'

rows.original: All of those orcs looked like they were up to no good — I saw them ferrying a big troll or some monstrosity into their camp! You don't think it's some sex thing, do you? Orcs really love sex... or so Jen tells me."
rows.translation: 那些兽人看着就不怀好意——我看见他们把一个巨魔还是什么怪物运进了营地！你不会觉得这是什么跟性有关的勾当吧？兽人真的很爱性爱……至少珍是这么跟我说的。
rows.raw: " All of those orcs looked like they were up to no good — I saw them ferrying a big troll or some monstrosity into their camp! You don't think it's some sex thing, do you? Orcs really love sex... or so Jen tells me." "

rows.original: Those tricky orcs have a big horned wolf! Or some of them do. They looked a bit different from the normal lot we run into. Like crafty priests or something... but what kind of worship do orcs have time for between all the sex and battling?"
rows.translation: 那些狡猾的兽人有一只长角的大狼！或者说有些兽人有。它们跟我们平时遇到的普通家伙不太一样，像是些狡猾的祭司之类的……可兽人在性爱与厮杀之余，哪还有时间搞什么崇拜呢？
rows.raw: ' Those tricky orcs have a big horned wolf! Or some of them do. They looked a bit different from the normal lot we run into. Like crafty priests or something... but what kind of worship do orcs have time for between all the sex and battling?" '

rows.original: I hear this place has a gymnasium or something — rather rare when you think about it, though. Back in Tronarii, we had a few of them but that was because we used to need to prove our armor was fit for battle. We had... lots of battles back then. If Hawkethorne — or this part of the Frost Marches — has one, it probably needs some work before it looks even half as good as ours!"
rows.translation: 我听说这个地方有健身房之类的设施——不过仔细想想，这种设施还挺少见的。在特洛纳里，我们那里倒是有一些这样的地方，但那是因为我们当时需要证明自己的盔甲确实适合战斗使用。我们当时…… 很多那些过去的战斗场景啊。如果鹰棘镇——或者弗罗斯特边境的这一地区——也有这样的场景，那么它很可能还需要进行一些修改才能达到我们这里的效果的一半呢！
rows.raw: '\n I hear this place has a gymnasium or something — rather rare when you think about it, though. Back in Tronarii, we had a few of them but that was because we used to need to prove our armor was fit for battle. We had... lots of battles back then. If Hawkethorne — or this part of the Frost Marches — has one, it probably needs some work before it looks even half as good as ours!"'

rows.original: Dealing with all of us mercenaries can be tough regardless of whether or not we're your allies. People always expect us to be some sort of organized army but they don't realize that we left Tronarii because we follow the money. All the lack of pay, though, makes me wonder why we even came here... "
rows.translation: 不管我们是否是你的盟友，要管理我们这些雇佣兵确实是一件棘手的事情。人们总以为我们是一支有组织的军队，但他们却不知道，我们之所以离开特洛纳里，只是因为钱。然而，现在连工资都发不到了，这让我开始怀疑，我们当初究竟为什么要来到这里……
rows.raw: "\n            Dealing with all of us mercenaries can be tough regardless of whether or not we're your allies. People always expect us to be some sort of organized army but they don't realize that we left Tronarii because we follow the money. All the lack of pay, though, makes me wonder why we even came here... \""

rows.original: I ran into some bull guards, talking about some city or something. I didn't really pay attention because only a few moments later we got jumped by harpies and had to fend them off. If you want you can go check it out — I think they're not entirely full of it but this part of Savarra isn't exactly well-known to someone from an entirely different continent."
rows.translation: 我碰到几个弥诺陶洛斯守卫，他们在谈论什么城市之类的事。我没太在意，因为没过多久我们就遭到鹰身女妖袭击，不得不把她们打退。你要是想去，可以去看看——我觉得他们说的倒也不全是胡扯，不过对来自另一块大陆的人来说，萨瓦拉的这一带确实算不上有名。
rows.raw: "\n            I ran into some bull guards, talking about some city or something. I didn't really pay attention because only a few moments later we got jumped by harpies and had to fend them off. If you want you can go check it out — I think they're not entirely full of it but this part of Savarra isn't exactly well-known to someone from an entirely different continent.\""

rows.original: You know, I don't really have anything against harpies... per se... but um... do you ever wonder why they're all girls? It seems really weird that the gods or whatever powers are out there didn't make bird boys. Man... could you imagine one of them slinging a dick around, as virile as those sluts are fertile? Fuck, I could get behind that you know; some big and hung bird hunk, laying me down in his nest and telling me he's going to fertilize my eggs... yeah, that'd be great."
rows.translation: 你知道，我其实并不反感鹰身女妖……严格来说……不过，呃……你有没有想过，为什么她们全是女的？神明或者别的什么掌权的力量居然没造出鸟男孩，这也太奇怪了。老天……你能想象吗，其中一个甩着根屌四处晃荡，劲头十足，正如那些荡妇一样多产？操，我可太能接受这个了，你知道吗；一个高大、家伙又大的鸟族壮汉，把我按在他巢里，告诉我他要给我的蛋受精……对，那就太棒了。
rows.raw: "\n You know, I don't really have anything against harpies... per se... but um... do you ever wonder why they're all girls? It seems really weird that the gods or whatever powers are out there didn't make bird boys. Man... could you imagine one of them slinging a dick around, as virile as those sluts are fertile? Fuck, I could get behind that you know; some big and hung bird hunk, laying me down in his nest and telling me he's going to fertilize my eggs... yeah, that'd be great.\""

rows.original: Sometimes, I actually miss having sand in my boots. The only place in this place that had it was that shoreline we landed at ages ago. Being so far from the desert sure is strange..."
rows.translation: 有时候，我其实挺怀念靴子里进沙子的日子。这地方唯一有沙子的，就是我们很久以前登陆的那片海岸。离沙漠这么远，还真是不习惯……
rows.raw: '\n Sometimes, I actually miss having sand in my boots. The only place in this place that had it was that shoreline we landed at ages ago. Being so far from the desert sure is strange..."'

rows.original: Do you think there are cute cow-boys like there are hunky minotaurs? I'm a fan of muscle but those minotaurs are just too big for me... a pint-sized one would be just right though! If they exist, they must be somewhere in the mountains or to the north — otherwise, we'd see them all over for sure!"
rows.translation: 你认为也会存在像那些肌肉发达的弥诺陶洛斯一样可爱的牛仔吗？我确实喜欢有肌肉的男人，但那些弥诺陶洛斯对我来说实在太大了……要是有个体型像品脱杯那么小的就好了只是不过没错！如果它们真的存在的话，肯定会在山区或者北方某个地方——否则的话，我们早就到处都能看到它们了！
rows.raw: " Do you think there are cute cow-boys like there are hunky minotaurs? I'm a fan of muscle but those minotaurs are just too big for me... a pint-sized one would be just right though! If they exist, they must be somewhere in the mountains or to the north — otherwise, we'd see them all over for sure!" "

rows.original: The two of you look back at Brint, hoping the minotaur himself might have an idea. Instead, you catch him staring at the two of you with a frown. "There's... probably another group out there. We hear about it every once in a while but it's no big deal." Lusamine lights up and can't help herself from clapping. "Oooooyes! I totally can-" Brint interrupts her by simply raising a finger in front of her face, the hunk leaning over and whispering to you. "If she goes to find them or to Khor'minos, she's going to be someone's cumdump in a day."
rows.translation: 你们俩回头看向布林特，希望这个弥诺陶洛斯自己能想出办法来。然而，你们却看到他正皱着眉头盯着你们看。 “有…… 大概吧还有另外一群人……我们偶尔会听到关于他们的消息，但那也没什么大不了的。” 露萨敏顿时兴奋起来，忍不住拍起手来：“太棒了！我绝对可以……” 但布林特突然在她面前竖起一根手指，然后凑近她的耳边低声说道： “如果她去找他们，或者去科尔米诺斯的话，用不了一天，她就会变成别人的玩物罢了。
rows.raw: " The two of you look back at Brint, hoping the minotaur himself might have an idea. Instead, you catch him staring at the two of you with a frown. "There's... probably another group out there. We hear about it every once in a while but it's no big deal." Lusamine lights up and can't help herself from clapping. "Oooooyes! I totally can-" Brint interrupts her by simply raising a finger in front of her face, the hunk leaning over and whispering to you. "If she goes to find them or to Khor'minos, she's going to be someone's cumdump in a day.""

rows.original:
"Yeah, yeah — don't overthink it, elf girl."

        Brint stays away and only earns a scowl from Lusamine; the wyld elf gently runs her hand through her hair and leans back, grumbling and looking at you.
        
        "Are all minotaurs sour sports about a girl who has dreams? Eugh."
rows.translation:
是啊，是啊——别想得太复杂了，精灵女孩。”

        布林特躲得远远的，结果只换来了卢萨米的怒视；那位荒野精灵轻轻抚摸着她的头发，然后靠在椅背上，嘟囔着看着你。
        
        “难道所有弥诺陶洛斯都是因为一个有梦想的女孩而变得这么小气、这么狭隘吗？真恶心。

rows.original: The oases back in Tronarii used to flood once or twice a year for up to a week! Normally farmers in other places might celebrate but back in Tronarii, they hire mercenaries to defend their fields! Tin washing through the waters occasionally draws in the beggars and slaves — those who don't have bronze — so they tend to trudge through fields searching for just a bit to put toward their own knives! It's a really nice time for us mercenaries! Not uh... so great for everyone else, though."
rows.translation: 在特洛纳里，那些绿洲每年都会有一两次被洪水淹没，持续时间甚至可达一周！通常情况下，其他地方的农民会为此庆祝，但在特洛纳里，人们却要雇佣雇佣兵来保护自己的田地。偶尔有从水中冲上来的锡块，会吸引那些没有青铜的乞丐和奴隶——他们就会跋涉穿过田地，试图找到一些锡块来制作自己的刀具。对我们这些雇佣兵来说，这确实是一段不错的时光……不过，对其他人来说，就不那么美好了。
rows.raw: "\n            The oases back in Tronarii used to flood once or twice a year for up to a week! Normally farmers in other places might celebrate but back in Tronarii, they hire mercenaries to defend their fields! Tin washing through the waters occasionally draws in the beggars and slaves — those who don't have bronze — so they tend to trudge through fields searching for just a bit to put toward their own knives! It's a really nice time for us mercenaries! Not uh... so great for everyone else, though.\""

rows.original: A while back, I thought I met a fox person with a big pack! She seemed startled or something but when I turned my head, she was gone! The guys made fun of me for the rest of our patrol after that... urgh."
rows.translation: 前不久，我好像遇到过一个背着大背包的狐狸人！她看起来像是受了惊吓，可我一转头，她就不见了！那之后，接下来的整趟巡逻里那些家伙都在拿我开玩笑……呃。
rows.raw: '\n            A while back, I thought I met a fox person with a big pack! She seemed startled or something but when I turned my head, she was gone! The guys made fun of me for the rest of our patrol after that... urgh."'

rows.original: There's talk of people having filthy dreams more than usual; think it has anything to do with all the sluts in town, grinding up and down all over the men and women? I'm not a prude or nothing, just saying that might be part of it."
rows.translation: 有人传言说，最近大家做下流的梦比平时要多；你们觉得这会不会和镇上那些骚货有关，她们在男男女女身上蹭来蹭去？我可不是什么古板的人，只是说这可能是原因之一。
rows.raw: "\n            There's talk of people having filthy dreams more than usual; think it has anything to do with all the sluts in town, grinding up and down all over the men and women? I'm not a prude or nothing, just saying that might be part of it.\""

rows.original: Have you ever wondered why the gods are supposedly living and among us, yet no one really actually sees or can prove they're real? Why is that? Wouldn't the gods care more for us if they could walk among us? I bet the 'gods' are actually some illusion from some crafty mage!"
rows.translation: 你有没有想过，为什么那些所谓的神明明明被认为是在我们中间生活的，却没有人真正见过他们，也没有人能够证明他们的存在？这是为什么呢？如果神明真的能够生活在我们中间，他们难道不会更关心我们吗？我敢打赌，那些“神明”其实只是某个狡猾的法师创造出来的幻觉罢了！
rows.raw: "\n            Have you ever wondered why the gods are supposedly living and among us, yet no one really actually sees or can prove they're real? Why is that? Wouldn't the gods care more for us if they could walk among us? I bet the 'gods' are actually some illusion from some crafty mage!\""

rows.original: My first crush said I was pretty tight. I told him his dick would Lus-ta-mine! I hadn't seen someone run so fast but thinking on it, he must have thought I had a dick. My mistake... yeesh."
rows.translation: 我第一次喜欢上的人居然说我下面很紧。我当时就告诉他，他那话儿会把我撸-死-的！我从没见过有人跑得那么快……不过仔细想想，他肯定是以为我长了那话儿。是我搞错了……呃。
rows.raw: "\n My first crush said I was pretty tight. I told him his dick would Lus-ta-mine! I hadn't seen someone run so fast but thinking on it, he must have thought I had a dick. My mistake... yeesh.\""

rows.original: If you'd like, we could have some tea sometime! Sorry, I won't bring any sugar though — you're already sweet enough for two!"
rows.translation: 如果你愿意的话，我们可以找个时间一起喝喝茶！不过抱歉，我不会带糖的——你本来就甜得够两个人用了！
rows.raw: "\n If you'd like, we could have some tea sometime! Sorry, I won't bring any sugar though — you're already sweet enough for two!\""

rows.original: Wyld marks are finicky things; about two or three years ago, I hadn't even manifested furry legs. Now I couldn't even imagine if I Lusa-mine!"
rows.translation: 野性特征这类东西可不太容易掌控；大概两三年前，我甚至连长出毛茸茸的腿这种变化都还没发生呢。可如今我甚至无法想象会失去卢萨了！
rows.raw: "\n Wyld marks are finicky things; about two or three years ago, I hadn't even manifested furry legs. Now I couldn't even imagine if I Lusa-mine!\""

rows.original: You know what I said to my last boyfriend? You can either be Lusamine or I'm Lusagone! Yeah... he... he didn't like that one. Didn't think he'd call my bluff."
rows.translation: 你知道我上次对男朋友说了什么吗？你要么是我的卢萨，要么就没了卢萨！是啊……他……他可不吃这一套。没想到他真的敢接招。
rows.raw: "\n You know what I said to my last boyfriend? You can either be Lusamine or I'm Lusagone! Yeah... he... he didn't like that one. Didn't think he'd call my bluff.\""

rows.raw: "\n Bet you can't guess the difference between a soldier wearing bronze and one wearing iron! If you're the one in bronze, I-RON! Ha!\""

rows.translation: “现在我明白利奥弗里克为什么喜欢蒂拉了！这些双关语真是笑死我了！懂了吗？因为她可是死亡女神啊？”露萨敏哼了一声，翻了个白眼。“利奥弗里克肯定特别喜欢那个笑话。”
rows.raw: '\n Now I know why Leofric loves Tira! These puns are killing me! Get it? Because she\'s the goddess of death?" Lusamine snorts and rolls her eyes. "Leofric sure loves that one."'

rows.original: I don't have a great story or anything. But I do want you to know that you're still deer to me, no matter what!"
rows.translation: 我并没有什么了不起的故事。但我真的想让你们知道，无论如何，你对我来说始终是小鹿！
rows.raw: "\n I don't have a great story or anything. But I do want you to know that you're still deer to me, no matter what!\""

rows.translation: 你尝过这里的面包吗？我总听说这里的面包有特别之处！

rows.translation: 就咱俩知道，我其实挺喜欢双关语的。只是……嗯，就咱俩知道，明白吗？我要是跟别人承认了，肯定会被狠狠嘲笑一顿。
rows.raw: "\n Between you and me, I like puns. Just uh... between you and me, got that? I'd get so much crap if I admitted that to everyone else.\""

Thankfully for everyone hanging around, Lusamine's smug smirk and well-received deliver satisfies her to simply enjoy the moment rather than drop another pun.

rows.translation: “呃……”露萨敏把拇指按在鼻梁上，过了几秒钟才把手拿开，然后摇了摇头。“对不起，我实在想不出什么。下次你再问的话，我肯定能想出点东西来！”
rows.raw: '\n            Uh..." Lusamine presses her thumb against the bridge of her nose. After a few seconds, she lets it drop and shakes her head. "Sorry, I got nothing. I\'m sure I\'ll think of something the next time you ask!"'

rows.original: You have this friend... She listens raptly as you tell her about Lusamine, her sterility, and how she's gone to great lengths to try and fix herself. "While I understand her desire to be a mother, there's nothing wrong with her; motherhood can come in all shapes and sizes. That being said, I have something that can help her out and get her squared right away." The goddess gives you a soft smile before holding her hand out, light coalescing on her palm and solidifying into a small pendant. Lumia places the small thing delicately in your hand and closes your fingers around it. "Give that to your friend, and she'll be able to carry. I wish her the best of luck in her matronly endeavors."

rows.original:
You aren't sure if it'll help with her sterility issue, but there's a witch by the name of Evergreen that lives just past the Wayfort to the north of Hawkethorne. She specializes in fertility and is known to work with and cut deals with people at the end of their ropes. She could probably fix her right up, but her prices aren't steep.
    
    "First off, who just starts a conversation like that?" She huffs, though the indignant act quickly disappears as she gives you a grateful look. "Secondly, I appreciate you trying to help. At this point, I'll take anything I can get. I've got the next few days off, so I'm gonna set off now. Thanks, Champ!" 
    
    Lusamine heads towards the entrance to the Frost Hound, stopping briefly to chat with Garth and hand him a few coins — for which he hands her some salted meat right after — and vanishes out the front door.
    
    With what you know of Evergreen, you don't think you'll see the wyld elf again.
rows.translation:
你不确定这种方法是否能够帮助她解决不孕的问题，但在鹰棘镇北部、荒废驿堡镇不远处，住着一位名叫“常青女士”的女巫。她专门研究生育问题，以能够帮助那些走投无路的人而闻名，也愿意与他们协商达成各种协议。她大概可以把它修好，而且她的收费也不高。
    
    “首先，谁会这样突然开始谈话呢？”她哼了一声，不过这种不满的情绪很快就消失了，因为她露出了感激的神情。“其次，我很感谢你想要帮忙。在这种情况下，什么机会我都会抓住。接下来几天我有空，所以现在就出发吧。谢谢，冠军！”
    
    露萨敏朝着霜犬酒馆号的入口走去，途中停下来和加斯聊了几句，还给了他几枚硬币——作为回报，加斯立刻给了她一些腌肉——然后她就从前门离开了。
    
    以你对常青女士族的了解，你应该不会再见到那些荒野精灵了吧。

rows.translation: “据说这里也有一些和他们很相似的精灵，只不过颜色不同而已。但我怀疑，他们肯定没有家乡的那些精灵那么酷吧！”
rows.raw: "There's supposedly some elves pretty similar to them here but different colors? I doubt they're nearly as cool as the ones back home!\""

rows.original: Did you know that wyld elf alchemist in this town is blind? Who would think I'd meet another wyld elf that's blind. Crazy right? No?"
rows.translation: 你知道吗，这个镇子上那位荒荒野精灵炼金术士其实是盲人。谁能想到我会遇到另一个这样的荒荒野精灵呢盲的太疯狂了吧？对吧？
rows.raw: "\n Did you know that wyld elf alchemist in this town is blind? Who would think I'd meet another wyld elf that's blind. Crazy right? No?\""

rows.original: [flags.EVELYN_INTRO_FUCKED|You know, I saw a girl the other day — she went right into a room almost immediately. And then I heard a lot of gagging and moaning. Pretty sure we can figure out what's going on in there.|All of these rooms but it seems like no one even gets horny and fucks their brains out in them. I mean... not often? Or... urgh. I don't know — it just seems like the only ones I see doing anything are you and your friends.]"
rows.translation: “[flags.EVELYN_INTRO_FUCKED|你知道，前几天我看见一个女孩，她很快就走进了一个房间。然后我就听到了很多干呕声和呻吟声。我觉得我们肯定能猜出里面发生了什么。|所有这些房间，但看起来似乎根本没有人会在里面性欲高涨、把对方操到神志不清。我的意思是……这种情况不常有吧？还是……唉，我也不清楚——反正我看到的只有你和你的朋友们在那些房间里有所行动。]”
rows.raw: "\n            [flags.EVELYN_INTRO_FUCKED|You know, I saw a girl the other day — she went right into a room almost immediately. And then I heard a lot of gagging and moaning. Pretty sure we can figure out what's going on in there.|All of these rooms but it seems like no one even gets horny and fucks their brains out in them. I mean... not often? Or... urgh. I don't know — it just seems like the only ones I see doing anything are you and your friends.]\""

rows.original: Leorah would probably get along well with Janeen! They're both so... outdoorsy! Yeah, that's it! And they both probably like eating girls out too. Not that I'd know — I'm not really playing for that crowd!"
rows.translation: “莱奥拉和贾宁肯定能相处得很好！她们两个都那么……喜欢户外活动！对，就是这个意思！而且她们应该也都喜欢舔女孩的下面。不过我也不太清楚——我其实并不属于那个圈子的人！”
rows.raw: "\n            Leorah would probably get along well with Janeen! They're both so... outdoorsy! Yeah, that's it! And they both probably like eating girls out too. Not that I'd know — I'm not really playing for that crowd!\""

rows.original: Ogrish — the town blacksmith — reminds me of this one, huge orcish raider back in Tronarii! Do you think it's a coincidence or is he secretly a warlord? I mean, how do you explain him repairing gear for us? Only someone from Tronarii would have that kind of skill!"
rows.translation: “奥格里什——镇上的铁匠——让我想起了在特洛纳里遇到的那个巨大的兽人掠夺者！你觉得这是巧合吗，还是说他其实是个隐秘的军阀？我的意思是，他为什么要为我们修理装备呢？只有来自特洛纳里的人才会有这样的技艺啊！”
rows.raw: "\n            Ogrish — the town blacksmith — reminds me of this one, huge orcish raider back in Tronarii! Do you think it's a coincidence or is he secretly a warlord? I mean, how do you explain him repairing gear for us? Only someone from Tronarii would have that kind of skill!\""

rows.original: I heard from a certain lupine that Hawkethorne used to have lots of lupines! And — get this — Garth was even married! I mean, obviously, he had to have been since he's a dad! Unless he had kids out of wedlock... which... is common... forget that bit."
rows.translation: 我听某个朋友说，鹰棘镇以前养了很多狼族！而且——你猜怎么着——加斯甚至还结过婚呢！当然，他肯定结过婚，毕竟他现在已经是父亲了。除非他是非婚生子……不过这种情况也挺常见的……算了，先不提这个吧。
rows.raw: "\n            I heard from a certain lupine that Hawkethorne used to have lots of lupines! And — get this — Garth was even married! I mean, obviously, he had to have been since he's a dad! Unless he had kids out of wedlock... which... is common... forget that bit.\""

rows.original: Sanders is such a nice guy! He gave me advice on how to trim my legs the other day! Those pesky men of the cloth are always so knowledgeable, I bet you could count on him for help!"
rows.translation: “桑德斯真是个好人！前几天他还给了我一些关于如何修剪腿毛的建议呢！那些烦人的神职人员总是这么博学多才，我相信你完全可以向他寻求帮助的！”
rows.raw: '\n            Sanders is such a nice guy! He gave me advice on how to trim my legs the other day! Those pesky men of the cloth are always so knowledgeable, I bet you could count on him for help!"'

rows.original: I bet I can drink more than you! Okay, that's not gossip. I just think having a few drinks could really help loosen you up. Getting someone drunk can really mess with their decision-making, too; Janeen got so hammered one time, she actually sucked a dick! And she vehemently says she's into girls! Although, the guy bragged about it and a day later she beat him senseless. I think she actually doesn't like guys... so um... don't try tricking her."
rows.translation: “我打赌我喝得比你多！好吧，这不算闲话。我只是觉得喝上几杯确实能让你放松下来。不过，把人灌醉也确实会搞乱对方的判断力——有一次贾宁喝得烂醉，居然给一个男人口交！而她还信誓旦旦地说自己喜欢女生！不过，那个男的还为此吹嘘了一番，结果第二天她就把他打得不成人样。我觉得她其实并不喜欢男人……所以嗯……别想着算计她。”
rows.raw: "\n I bet I can drink more than you! Okay, that's not gossip. I just think having a few drinks could really help loosen you up. Getting someone drunk can really mess with their decision-making, too; Janeen got so hammered one time, she actually sucked a dick! And she vehemently says she's into girls! Although, the guy bragged about it and a day later she beat him senseless. I think she actually doesn't like guys... so um... don't try tricking her.\""

rows.original: The mercenaries actually consist of two halves right now — the veterans and the most recent recruits. Boomer and I are part of the latter but most of the veterans are indistinguishable from us. Sometimes I think it's mostly just posturing on their part to act tough when most of them just aren't as talented as we are. Some of them didn't even understand knife-fighting when I joined!" Lusamine frowns, grumbling and looking away. "Most of them don't want to learn after I [silly|shanked that bitch|cut someone on accident.]"
rows.translation: 这些雇佣兵目前实际上可以分为两部分——老兵和新招募的成员。布默和我属于后者，但大多数老兵与我们并没有什么区别。有时候我觉得，他们装出一副强硬的样子，其实只是在做作而已，因为大多数他们的能力其实并不像我们这么强。甚至在我加入的时候，他们中还有一些人根本不懂如何使用刀进行战斗！”露萨敏皱着眉头，抱怨着，然后将目光移开了。“大多数他们其实都不愿意学习[silly|干掉了那个贱人|不小心撞到了某人。]"
rows.raw: "\n            The mercenaries actually consist of two halves right now — the veterans and the most recent recruits. Boomer and I are part of the latter but most of the veterans are indistinguishable from us. Sometimes I think it's mostly just posturing on their part to act tough when most of them just aren't as talented as we are. Some of them didn't even understand knife-fighting when I joined!\" Lusamine frowns, grumbling and looking away. \"Most of them don't want to learn after I [silly|shanked that bitch|cut someone on accident.]\""

rows.original: Garth's daughter seems pretty nice — everyone in town says she has a hard time saying no to someone if they want to start a family, though. Not sure how I feel about that... apart from being jealous that lupine can have so many kids effortlessly and rebound like her. Phew, what I wouldn't do to get that sort of talent..."
rows.translation: 加斯的女儿看起来人挺好的——不过镇上的人都说，如果有人想组建家庭，她很难拒绝他们。对于这一点，我也不知道自己该作何感想……除了会嫉妒那些像她这样能够轻松生下很多孩子并且迅速恢复元气的女性之外。唉，要是我也有这样的能力该多好啊……
rows.raw: "\n            Garth's daughter seems pretty nice — everyone in town says she has a hard time saying no to someone if they want to start a family, though. Not sure how I feel about that... apart from being jealous that lupine can have so many kids effortlessly and rebound like her. Phew, what I wouldn't do to get that sort of talent...\""

rows.original: One of these days, someone is going to talk to Dale and really open his confidence back up. Believe it or not, he and Janeen were some of the first mercenaries to join the commander! They even knew Jen when she was still small! Or... well... younger."
rows.translation: “总有一天，会有人去找戴尔谈话，让他重新建立起信心。信不信由你，他和贾宁其实是最早加入指挥官团队的雇佣兵之一！他们甚至在珍还小的时候就认识她了……或者说，那时候她还更年轻一些。”
rows.raw: '\n            One of these days, someone is going to talk to Dale and really open his confidence back up. Believe it or not, he and Janeen were some of the first mercenaries to join the commander! They even knew Jen when she was still small! Or... well... younger."'

rows.original: Sometimes, I wonder what life would have been like if I stayed back home. Then I remember that my father would have probably told me I wasn't fit for running the business and probably have been stuck marrying some other merchant's son. That'd be one boring way to live out a life — rich and stuck at home? No thank you!"
rows.translation: “有时候，我会想如果自己留在家里，生活会变成什么样。但很快我就想起来，我的父亲肯定会告诉我，我不适合经营这家生意，然后我可能就会被迫嫁给某个其他商人的儿子。那样的生活未免太无聊了——虽然有钱，但却被困在家里？算了，我可不愿意！”
rows.raw: "\n            Sometimes, I wonder what life would have been like if I stayed back home. Then I remember that my father would have probably told me I wasn't fit for running the business and probably have been stuck marrying some other merchant's son. That'd be one boring way to live out a life — rich and stuck at home? No thank you!\""

rows.original: Sluts aside, what do you think about orders like Mallach's slutty servants? I mean, back home it's more about worshipping Tira but those orders are more practical. Our commander and the lieutenant both are super scary when they call on their training — what good is a holy whore sitting on a dick compared to someone bulking up and becoming unfazed by any hopeless battle? I'd say Lieutenant Jen is way scarier than any orc when she gets serious!"
rows.translation: “先不说那些荡妇，你怎么看马拉克那种淫荡仆从的教团？我的意思是，在家乡人们更注重崇拜蒂拉，但那种教团更实用。我们的指挥官和中尉一旦动用训练出来的本事都可怕得很——跟一个锻炼得强壮、面对任何绝望战斗都面不改色的人相比，一个只会坐在鸡巴上的神圣妓女有什么用？我得说，珍中尉认真起来的时候比任何兽人都要可怕得多！”
rows.raw: "\n Sluts aside, what do you think about orders like Mallach's slutty servants? I mean, back home it's more about worshipping Tira but those orders are more practical. Our commander and the lieutenant both are super scary when they call on their training — what good is a holy whore sitting on a dick compared to someone bulking up and becoming unfazed by any hopeless battle? I'd say Lieutenant Jen is way scarier than any orc when she gets serious!\""

rows.original: People always tell me I'm really great with kids! Maybe when I hang up my sword one day, I'll take care of them for others. And mine, of course. I want lots of kids too!"
rows.translation: “人们总是说我很适合照顾孩子！也许有一天我金盆洗手之后，会帮别人带孩子。当然，也会带自己的孩子。我也想要很多孩子！”
rows.raw: "\n People always tell me I'm really great with kids! Maybe when I hang up my sword one day, I'll take care of them for others. And mine, of course. I want lots of kids too!\""

rows.original: I don't really understand why anyone kills their opponent; there used to be a few mercenaries with us who were really kill-happy until Commander Leofric cut them down personally. Something about murderers 'losing pieces' of themselves over time. If that's true, that'd explain why the Commander's axe is blunted these days. Back when he was younger, he worshipped Tira vehemently so he must understand more about death or something."
rows.translation: “我实在不明白为什么有人会杀死自己的对手；曾经有几位雇佣兵跟我们在一起，他们极其嗜杀，直到利奥弗里克指挥官亲手把他们斩了。据说杀人者会逐渐“失去自我的一部分”。如果真是这样，就能解释为什么指挥官的斧头如今已经变钝了。在他年轻的时候，他曾经狂热地崇拜蒂拉，所以他肯定更懂死亡之类的事。”
rows.raw: "\n            I don't really understand why anyone kills their opponent; there used to be a few mercenaries with us who were really kill-happy until Commander Leofric cut them down personally. Something about murderers 'losing pieces' of themselves over time. If that's true, that'd explain why the Commander's axe is blunted these days. Back when he was younger, he worshipped Tira vehemently so he must understand more about death or something.\""

rows.original: "I heard Janeen, Dale, and some of the less shitty mercs have been hired by the Baroness here. You know, Miss Carmen? They all grouped up and drove the awful mercs out of town. It's sad to see how our band all fell apart, but it is what it is. Nothing lasts forever."
rows.translation: “我听说贾宁、戴尔还有那些还算不错的雇佣兵都被这位女男爵雇用了。你知道的，卡门小姐？他们联合起来，把那些糟糕的雇佣兵赶出了小镇。看到我们原来的团队就这样分崩离析，确实让人感到难过，但事实就是如此——没有什么能永远持续下去。”
rows.raw: '\n            "I heard Janeen, Dale, and some of the less shitty mercs have been hired by the Baroness here. You know, Miss Carmen? They all grouped up and drove the awful mercs out of town. It\'s sad to see how our band all fell apart, but it is what it is. Nothing lasts forever."'

rows.original: "That stylist couple — Aurera and Claire, I think it was — just opened up here recently. They've got all types of make-up, facial scrubs, hair dyes and more." She hums, crossing her arms. "We don't get many Anubians in Tronarii, except the occasional merchant or trader. I wonder what she's doing up so far away from Jassira?"
rows.translation: “那对从事美妆工作的情侣——我记得他们叫奥蕾拉和克莱尔——最近刚在这儿开了店。他们有各种各样的化妆品、面部磨砂膏、染发剂等等。”她一边说着，一边交叉双臂。“在特洛纳里，我们很少见到阿努比亚人，除了偶尔会有商贩经过。我想知道，她为什么会在离贾西拉这么远的地方开店呢？”
rows.raw: '\n            "That stylist couple — Aurera and Claire, I think it was — just opened up here recently. They\'ve got all types of make-up, facial scrubs, hair dyes and more." She hums, crossing her arms. "We don\'t get many Anubians in Tronarii, except the occasional merchant or trader. I wonder what she\'s doing up so far away from Jassira?"'

rows.original: "I heard Garth's wife came back from wherever she was. People around here are surprisingly tight-lipped, if they even know anything about it. I don't think she gets along well with Gwyn though. Poor thing was really upset that she showed up."
rows.translation: “我听说加斯的妻子从她之前所在的地方回来了。这里的人们出奇地守口如瓶，就算他们知道些什么，也不肯透露。不过我觉得她和格温关系并不好……那个可怜的女人，因为她的出现而变得非常难过。”
rows.raw: "\n        \"I heard Garth's wife came back from wherever she was. People around here are surprisingly tight-lipped, if they even know anything about it. I don't think she gets along well with Gwyn though. Poor thing was really upset that she showed up.\""

rows.original: We mercenaries wear a lot of armor but it's actually more common to not see us wearing it back home. Unless we're patrolling, abroad on jobs or... nevermind. We wear our armor a lot is the point! We just don't wear as much of it since it's so much warmer."
rows.translation: “我们这些雇佣兵会穿很多护甲，但在家乡其实更常见的是看不到我们穿。除非我们在巡逻、在国外出任务的时候……算了。重点是我们穿护甲的时候很多！只是因为这里暖和得多，所以我们才穿得没那么多。”
rows.raw: "\n            We mercenaries wear a lot of armor but it's actually more common to not see us wearing it back home. Unless we're patrolling, abroad on jobs or... nevermind. We wear our armor a lot is the point! We just don't wear as much of it since it's so much warmer.\""

rows.original: That spooky castle up on the hill kinda freaks me out. Back in Tronarii, we didn't really do castles — they always end up broken and hard to maintain in the middle of a desert. It's actually easier to use oasis-grown lumber, believe it or not!"
rows.translation: “那座坐落在山丘上的阴森城堡真让我发毛。在特洛纳里，我们其实并不怎么建造城堡——沙漠里的城堡最后总是会损坏，而且很难维护。说实话，用绿洲里长出来的木材反而更省事，信不信由你！”
rows.raw: "\n That spooky castle up on the hill kinda freaks me out. Back in Tronarii, we didn't really do castles — they always end up broken and hard to maintain in the middle of a desert. It's actually easier to use oasis-grown lumber, believe it or not!\""

rows.original: Apart from the other type of elves back home, Tronarii is actually kinda like the Frost Marches: diverse. It's a lot of humans, lupine and both wyld elf and dusk elf. The last one is one you folks may not see a ton of — think an elf who looks like they're covered in soot or smoke! Those are definitely the four biggest races in number but there's also catfolk and centaurs. And orcs... but those aren't exactly native. Just rowdy neighbors."
rows.translation: 除了家乡的那些其他种类的精灵之外，特洛纳里地区其实和霜冻边境地区很相似：种族种类繁多。这里有很多人类、狼族，还有荒野精灵和暮色精灵。最后这种精灵你们可能不太常见——想象一下，那些看起来像被煤灰或烟雾覆盖的精灵吧！这四种种族确实是数量最多的，不过这里还有猫族、半人马，还有兽人……不过那些其实并不是这里的原住民，只不过是些爱闹事的邻居罢了。
rows.raw: "\n            Apart from the other type of elves back home, Tronarii is actually kinda like the Frost Marches: diverse. It's a lot of humans, lupine and both wyld elf and dusk elf. The last one is one you folks may not see a ton of — think an elf who looks like they're covered in soot or smoke! Those are definitely the four biggest races in number but there's also catfolk and centaurs. And orcs... but those aren't exactly native. Just rowdy neighbors.\""

rows.original: Horses in Tronarii aren't necessarily rare but they're definitely weird — most of them are hard to get. Commander Leofric really worked his butt off to get all those horses... it's a shame we lost them. The lieutenant's horse is lucky it wasn't caught up in all that bad luck — she's raised it so long that it would probably be a fine stud for some lucky mares! If it's a guy. I don't really look around at horse junk."
rows.translation: “在特洛纳里，马匹并不一定稀少，但它们确实有些奇特——大多数都很难搞到。利奥弗里克指挥官为了弄到那些马可真是拼了老命……可惜我们最终还是失去了它们。那位中尉的马还算幸运，没被卷进那场霉运里——她养了它这么久，要是它是公的，说不定能成为某些幸运母马的好种马！不过说实话，我不太会去盯着马的家伙看。”
rows.raw: "\n            Horses in Tronarii aren't necessarily rare but they're definitely weird — most of them are hard to get. Commander Leofric really worked his butt off to get all those horses... it's a shame we lost them. The lieutenant's horse is lucky it wasn't caught up in all that bad luck — she's raised it so long that it would probably be a fine stud for some lucky mares! If it's a guy. I don't really look around at horse junk.\""

rows.original: Supposedly, Tronarii used to produce most of the bronze used around the world. Entire armies, legendary projects, and backs for coins — you name it, we did it. The rumors aside, we've definitely downscaled these days. We still produce just as much as ever but we're more focused on preserving or selling it rather than giving it away. Arms and armor given freely might land us back under someone's thumb!"
rows.translation: 据说，特洛纳里曾经生产了世界上大部分的青铜制品。无论是整支军队的装备，还是那些传奇项目所需的材料，甚至是硬币的铸造原料——但凡你需要，我们都能提供。不过，这些传闻也就罢了。如今，我们的生产规模确实有所缩小。我们仍然在生产与过去一样多的产品，但更多的精力是放在如何保存这些资源或将其出售出去，而不是免费赠送它们。如果把武器和盔甲都免费分发出去，恐怕又会让我们重新陷入别人的控制之下！
rows.raw: "\n            Supposedly, Tronarii used to produce most of the bronze used around the world. Entire armies, legendary projects, and backs for coins — you name it, we did it. The rumors aside, we've definitely downscaled these days. We still produce just as much as ever but we're more focused on preserving or selling it rather than giving it away. Arms and armor given freely might land us back under someone's thumb!\""

rows.original: Everyone looks at me funny anytime I speak Tronariiani. You'd think they'd have heard it at least once with all the merchants doing business abroad. I guess this part of Savarra is just too out of the way. And cold. Not that I mind with these fuzzy legs of mine!"
rows.translation: “每次我说特洛纳里语，大家都会用奇怪的眼神看着我。想想看，这么多在国外做生意的商人，他们应该至少听过一次才对。我想，萨瓦拉的这个地区实在太偏远了——而且也很寒冷。不过，我这双毛茸茸的腿倒是不介意！”
rows.raw: "\n            Everyone looks at me funny anytime I speak Tronariiani. You'd think they'd have heard it at least once with all the merchants doing business abroad. I guess this part of Savarra is just too out of the way. And cold. Not that I mind with these fuzzy legs of mine!\""

rows.original: Get this — I ran into this weird blonde catfolk merchant the other day! Normally no one would ever dream of turning their nose up to true Tronarii bronze but she — and her bodyguards — were trying to make offers on iron! Who would use that scrap compared to a well-made Tronarii blade?"
rows.translation: 你听好了——前几天我遇到了一个奇怪的金发猫族商人！通常来说，没人会拒绝真正的特洛纳里青铜制品，但她和她那些保镖却试图用低价来出售这些商品。铁比起一把制作精良的特洛纳里刀刃，谁会去使用那种破旧的东西呢？
rows.raw: '\n Get this — I ran into this weird blonde catfolk merchant the other day! Normally no one would ever dream of turning their nose up to true Tronarii bronze but she — and her bodyguards — were trying to make offers on iron! Who would use that scrap compared to a well-made Tronarii blade?"'

rows.original: With how often people wear or carry bronze, coloring it is an important job! You can actually apply a ton of patina finishes with the right metallurgy mage... or blacksmith. Honestly, if there's magic to work on armor then I'd bet it came from Tronarii!"
rows.translation: 由于人们经常佩戴或携带青铜制品，因此对其进行着色是一项非常重要的工作！只要拥有精通冶金技术的法师……或者铁匠，就完全可以通过各种工艺为青铜制品添加各种锈色效果。说实在的，如果盔甲的制作过程中真的涉及魔法元素的话，我敢打赌这些魔法技术肯定源自特洛纳里！
rows.raw: "\n            With how often people wear or carry bronze, coloring it is an important job! You can actually apply a ton of patina finishes with the right metallurgy mage... or blacksmith. Honestly, if there's magic to work on armor then I'd bet it came from Tronarii!\""

rows.original: Merchants are a lot less fickle here than back home; my dad wouldn't have sold anyone a horse as easily as some of the lot here! I mean, I get some of them are stuck and all... but like come on!"
rows.translation: “在这里，商人们可没有家乡的那些人那么善变；我爸爸可不会像这里的一些商人那样轻易地把马卖给别人！当然，我明白有些人是走投无路了……但拜托，这也太随便了吧！”
rows.raw: "\n Merchants are a lot less fickle here than back home; my dad wouldn't have sold anyone a horse as easily as some of the lot here! I mean, I get some of them are stuck and all... but like come on!\""

rows.original: One of these days I'm going to return home and see if there is a nice slut of Mallach out there for me... nah, just messing with you. I'm desperate but not that desperate."
rows.translation: “总有一天我要回家乡，看看马拉克那边有没有哪个标致的荡妇适合我……算了，逗你玩的。我是挺急的，但还没那么急。”
rows.raw: "\n One of these days I'm going to return home and see if there is a nice slut of Mallach out there for me... nah, just messing with you. I'm desperate but not that desperate.\""

rows.original: Not everything works against every opponent, you know. Slimes aren't going to be cut by any regular blade like you or me! If you want to beat an opponent, try experimenting! That's the first lesson for any mercenary; think on your feet! Or hooves!"
rows.translation: “要知道，并不是所有手段对每个对手都管用。像你我这样的普通刀刃，是砍不动史莱姆族的！想打赢对手，就试着多尝试！这是每个雇佣兵的第一课：随机应变！或者随蹄应变！”
rows.raw: "\n            Not everything works against every opponent, you know. Slimes aren't going to be cut by any regular blade like you or me! If you want to beat an opponent, try experimenting! That's the first lesson for any mercenary; think on your feet! Or hooves!\""

rows.original: Have you ever tried drinking until you pass out? Don't. It's not worth the hangover!"
rows.translation: 你有没有试过喝到昏过去为止？千万别这么干，那样只会让第二天醒来后头痛难忍，根本不值得！
rows.raw: "\n            Have you ever tried drinking until you pass out? Don't. It's not worth the hangover!\""

rows.original: A full pack is a beginner's trap! If you head out somewhere, you should consider offloading some gear at the nearby stores or something first — you wouldn't want to have to choose between your [pc.weapon] and something else, right?"
rows.translation: “装满的行囊是新手的陷阱！如果你要出远门，应该先考虑把一些装备寄放在附近的商店之类的地方——你总不会想在自己的[pc.weapon]和别的东西之间二选一吧？”
rows.raw: "\n            A full pack is a beginner's trap! If you head out somewhere, you should consider offloading some gear at the nearby stores or something first — you wouldn't want to have to choose between your [pc.weapon] and something else, right?\""

rows.original: When you're on the road as much as we are, you learn to keep a tent or some camping supplies on you all the time. Even just getting a small window of rest when traversing rough terrain can be invaluable!"
rows.translation: 当你像我们一样经常在路上旅行时，你就会明白为什么必须随时携带帐篷或一些露营用品。即使在穿越崎岖地形时能获得短暂的休息时间，也是极其宝贵的！
rows.raw: "\n            When you're on the road as much as we are, you learn to keep a tent or some camping supplies on you all the time. Even just getting a small window of rest when traversing rough terrain can be invaluable!\""

rows.original: Think before you touch stuff! Whether it's a sword buried in rock, an abandoned estate's door in the middle of nowhere or a girl's chest it doesn't matter — one wrong touch and you could be dead! Or grabbing some nice, soft girl-pillows. Not that it's an invite... just part of the example."
rows.translation: 在触碰任何东西之前，先好好想想吧！无论是埋在岩石中的剑，还是偏远地区某座废弃宅邸的门，又或是某个女孩的胸部——都无所谓。只要触碰不当，你就可能有生命危险！当然，也有可能只是抓到一些柔软可爱的女孩枕头……不过这倒也不是在邀请你……只是这个例子中的一部分而已。
rows.raw: "\n            Think before you touch stuff! Whether it's a sword buried in rock, an abandoned estate's door in the middle of nowhere or a girl's chest it doesn't matter — one wrong touch and you could be dead! Or grabbing some nice, soft girl-pillows. Not that it's an invite... just part of the example.\""

rows.original: Some substances are best avoided — and I don't just mean the kind that are questionable drugs. I've heard some forms of cum are dangerous for consumption! Sex can already be a big deal but be careful before you go gulping down every fat load or eating a girl out through her whole orgasm; last thing anyone wants is to get hooked on a bad lay!"
rows.translation: “有些东西最好还是避开——我指的可不只是那些来路不明的药物。我听说，某些形式的精液吞下去是有危险的！性本身就已经是件大事了，但在你把每一发浓精都咕咚咽下去、或者用嘴把女孩舔到高潮结束之前，还是小心点；谁都不想因为一场烂炮而上瘾！”
rows.raw: "\n            Some substances are best avoided — and I don't just mean the kind that are questionable drugs. I've heard some forms of cum are dangerous for consumption! Sex can already be a big deal but be careful before you go gulping down every fat load or eating a girl out through her whole orgasm; last thing anyone wants is to get hooked on a bad lay!\""

rows.original: A rule of thumb in any negotiation: choose wisely when revealing your hand. My father and his father made a real steal off the backs of foolish merchants and nobles because we didn't show them our entire plan. Giving them pieces of details can make an opponent sloppy and assume you don't really have a trick up your sleeve!"
rows.translation: 在任何谈判中，都有一个基本的准则：在透露自己的计划时必须谨慎选择时机。我的父亲和他的父亲之所以能够从那些愚蠢的商人和贵族手中获得巨大的利益，正是因为我们没有向他们透露全部计划。只向对方透露部分细节，就能让对手放松警惕，从而以为你其实并没有什么隐藏的招数！
rows.raw: "\n            A rule of thumb in any negotiation: choose wisely when revealing your hand. My father and his father made a real steal off the backs of foolish merchants and nobles because we didn't show them our entire plan. Giving them pieces of details can make an opponent sloppy and assume you don't really have a trick up your sleeve!\""

rows.original: Touching elf ears is super special! I mean, they're so sensitive so... you know... it's really nice of us to trust people with our ears. You should respect that trust!"
rows.translation: “摸精灵的耳朵可是非常特别的！我是说，它们实在太敏感了，所以……你懂的……我们愿意让人碰自己的耳朵，可是真的很信任对方。你应该尊重这份信任！”
rows.raw: "\n Touching elf ears is super special! I mean, they're so sensitive so... you know... it's really nice of us to trust people with our ears. You should respect that trust!\""

rows.original: Something about you seems really charismatic — I bet sparing people would net you a lot of new friends! A bloody battlefield is one full of lost chances, you know!"
rows.translation: “你身上似乎有种很不寻常的魅力——我敢打赌，要是你饶过别人的性命，一定能交到不少新朋友！要知道，血腥的战场可是充满了错失的机会啊！”
rows.raw: '\n            Something about you seems really charismatic — I bet sparing people would net you a lot of new friends! A bloody battlefield is one full of lost chances, you know!"'

rows.original: Orcs are strong so if you're going to fight them, get someone big and beefy to stand in the way! [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|Someone like that big [brint.isBrienne|cowgirl|minotaur] friend of yours would do a good job of facing them head on!|Maybe a[pc.ra minotaur|nother] minotaur helping you would be a good idea!] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|Your big orcish friend would also be a good help, I guess.|Or you could try turning one of them against them. Orcs that don't raid are pretty popular for adventurer parties from what I've heard!]"
rows.translation: 兽人非常强壮，所以如果你打算与他们战斗，那就找一个体型高大、力量强大的家伙来挡在前面吧！ [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|像那样高大的人[brint.isBrienne|女牛仔|弥诺陶洛斯]你的那位朋友肯定能够勇敢地面对他们！|也许吧。[pc.ra minotaur|另一个]让弥诺陶洛斯来帮助你，肯定是个好主意！] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|我想，你那个高大的兽人朋友也会帮上大忙的。|或者，你可以试着让他们中的某一方与另一方为敌。据我所知，那些不参与袭击的兽人，对于冒险者团队来说可是相当受欢迎的！]"
rows.raw: "\n            Orcs are strong so if you're going to fight them, get someone big and beefy to stand in the way! [flags.BRINT_RECRUITED|Someone like that big [brint.isBrienne|cowgirl|minotaur] friend of yours would do a good job of facing them head on!|Maybe a[pc.ra minotaur|nother] minotaur helping you would be a good idea!] [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|Your big orcish friend would also be a good help, I guess.|Or you could try turning one of them against them. Orcs that don't raid are pretty popular for adventurer parties from what I've heard!]\""

rows.original: Forests are so gloomy but my kind love to run around in them. I bet there are wyld elves hanging out there right now!"
rows.translation: “森林这么阴森，可我的同类却爱在林子里到处跑。我敢打赌，这会儿肯定就有荒野精灵在那儿晃悠！”
rows.raw: '\n Forests are so gloomy but my kind love to run around in them. I bet there are wyld elves hanging out there right now!"'

rows.original: Wyld elves aren't always the same you know — our Wyld Marks can generate different effects for each of us! Not only that but they don't always appear in the same place, so even if we exhibit the same transformations we might not even have our marks in the same place. It's probably why you almost never meet twins of our race!"
rows.translation: 你知道，荒荒野精灵并不总是完全相同的——我们的“野生印记”会为我们每个人带来不同的效果！不仅如此，这些印记出现的部位也不一定总是一样的，因此即使我们展现出相同的变形，这些印记的位置也可能不同。这大概就是为什么你几乎从来见不到我们种族中的双胞胎吧！
rows.raw: "\n            Wyld elves aren't always the same you know — our Wyld Marks can generate different effects for each of us! Not only that but they don't always appear in the same place, so even if we exhibit the same transformations we might not even have our marks in the same place. It's probably why you almost never meet twins of our race!\""

rows.original: The fey are an interesting thing between the truth and myths, particularly if you believe wyld elves are connected to them. Pixies and fairies are so much more different than us but we exhibit a beautiful closeness with nature almost identically. Well... normally. Sometimes there are fey born without any real connection to nature. Given how attuned we are, they must have a rough time living in woods when creatures aren't as friendly..."
rows.translation: “妖精是介于事实与神话之间的有趣存在，尤其是当你相信荒野精灵与他们有关联的时候。小妖精和仙子跟我们差别太大了，但我们与自然的亲密关系却几乎一模一样。嗯……通常是这样。有时候会有一些妖精天生就与自然毫无真正的联系。鉴于我们与自然如此契合，当周围的生灵不那么友善时，他们住在树林里肯定很难熬……”
rows.raw: "\n            The fey are an interesting thing between the truth and myths, particularly if you believe wyld elves are connected to them. Pixies and fairies are so much more different than us but we exhibit a beautiful closeness with nature almost identically. Well... normally. Sometimes there are fey born without any real connection to nature. Given how attuned we are, they must have a rough time living in woods when creatures aren't as friendly...\""

rows.original: I heard there are some really cold woods further north, out beyond the forest. Do you think that there are really cuddly things out there with tons of warm fur, too?"
rows.translation: 我听说在更北边的地方，森林之外，有一些非常寒冷的树林。你认为在那些地方，也会有一些拥有柔软温暖毛皮的生物吗？
rows.raw: '\n            I heard there are some really cold woods further north, out beyond the forest. Do you think that there are really cuddly things out there with tons of warm fur, too?"'

rows.original: All of those orcs looked like they were up to no good — I saw them ferrying a big troll or some monstrosity into their camp! You don't think it's some sex thing, do you? Orcs really love sex... or so Jen tells me."
rows.translation: 那些兽人看起来肯定在密谋什么坏事——我看见他们把一只巨大的巨魔或者某种怪物带到了他们的营地里！你不会认为这是什么与性有关的事情吧？兽人嘛真的喜欢性爱……至少珍是这么告诉我的。
rows.raw: "\n All of those orcs looked like they were up to no good — I saw them ferrying a big troll or some monstrosity into their camp! You don't think it's some sex thing, do you? Orcs really love sex... or so Jen tells me.\""

rows.original: Those tricky orcs have a big horned wolf! Or some of them do. They looked a bit different from the normal lot we run into. Like crafty priests or something... but what kind of worship do orcs have time for between all the sex and battling?"
rows.translation: “那些狡猾的兽人有一只长角的大狼！或者说有些兽人有。它们跟我们平时碰到的那群不太一样，像是些狡猾的祭司什么的……可兽人在没完没了的性爱与打斗之间，哪还有空搞什么崇拜呢？”
rows.raw: '\n Those tricky orcs have a big horned wolf! Or some of them do. They looked a bit different from the normal lot we run into. Like crafty priests or something... but what kind of worship do orcs have time for between all the sex and battling?"'

rows.original: I hear this place has a gymnasium or something — rather rare when you think about it, though. Back in Tronarii, we had a few of them but that was because we used to need to prove our armor was fit for battle. We had... lots of battles back then. If Hawkethorne — or this part of the Frost Marches — has one, it probably needs some work before it looks even half as good as ours!"
rows.translation: 我听说这个地方有健身房之类的设施——不过仔细想想，这种设施还挺少见的。在特洛纳里，我们那里倒是有一些这样的地方，但那是因为我们当时需要证明自己的盔甲确实适合战斗使用。我们当时…… 很多那些过去的战斗场景啊。如果鹰棘镇——或者弗罗斯特边境的这一地区——也有这样的场景，那么它很可能还需要进行一些修改才能达到我们这里的效果的一半呢！
rows.raw: '\n I hear this place has a gymnasium or something — rather rare when you think about it, though. Back in Tronarii, we had a few of them but that was because we used to need to prove our armor was fit for battle. We had... lots of battles back then. If Hawkethorne — or this part of the Frost Marches — has one, it probably needs some work before it looks even half as good as ours!"'

rows.original: Dealing with all of us mercenaries can be tough regardless of whether or not we're your allies. People always expect us to be some sort of organized army but they don't realize that we left Tronarii because we follow the money. All the lack of pay, though, makes me wonder why we even came here... "
rows.translation: 不管我们是否是你的盟友，要管理我们这些雇佣兵确实是一件棘手的事情。人们总以为我们是一支有组织的军队，但他们却不知道，我们之所以离开特洛纳里，只是因为钱。然而，现在连工资都发不到了，这让我开始怀疑，我们当初究竟为什么要来到这里……
rows.raw: "\n            Dealing with all of us mercenaries can be tough regardless of whether or not we're your allies. People always expect us to be some sort of organized army but they don't realize that we left Tronarii because we follow the money. All the lack of pay, though, makes me wonder why we even came here... \""

rows.original: I ran into some bull guards, talking about some city or something. I didn't really pay attention because only a few moments later we got jumped by harpies and had to fend them off. If you want you can go check it out — I think they're not entirely full of it but this part of Savarra isn't exactly well-known to someone from an entirely different continent."
rows.translation: “我碰到了一些牛头人守卫，他们在谈论某个城市之类的东西。我没怎么在意，因为没过多久，我们就遭到了鹰身女妖的袭击，不得不把她们打退。你要是想去的话，可以去看看——我觉得他们说的那些并不全是胡扯，不过对来自另一块大陆的人来说，萨瓦拉的这一带本来就不太为人所知。”
rows.raw: "\n            I ran into some bull guards, talking about some city or something. I didn't really pay attention because only a few moments later we got jumped by harpies and had to fend them off. If you want you can go check it out — I think they're not entirely full of it but this part of Savarra isn't exactly well-known to someone from an entirely different continent.\""

rows.original: You know, I don't really have anything against harpies... per se... but um... do you ever wonder why they're all girls? It seems really weird that the gods or whatever powers are out there didn't make bird boys. Man... could you imagine one of them slinging a dick around, as virile as those sluts are fertile? Fuck, I could get behind that you know; some big and hung bird hunk, laying me down in his nest and telling me he's going to fertilize my eggs... yeah, that'd be great."
rows.translation: “你知道吗，我其实并不怎么反感鹰身女妖……严格来说……但是嗯……你有没有想过，为什么她们全是女的？神明也好，外面别的什么力量也好，居然都没造出鸟男孩来，这也太奇怪了吧。老天……你能想象吗，他们当中有人甩着鸡巴到处晃，那些荡妇有多能生，他们就有多能操？操，说真的，我挺乐意的；来个又大又壮的鸟汉子，把我按进他的窝里，告诉我他要给我的蛋受精……嗯，那可就太棒了。”
rows.raw: "\n You know, I don't really have anything against harpies... per se... but um... do you ever wonder why they're all girls? It seems really weird that the gods or whatever powers are out there didn't make bird boys. Man... could you imagine one of them slinging a dick around, as virile as those sluts are fertile? Fuck, I could get behind that you know; some big and hung bird hunk, laying me down in his nest and telling me he's going to fertilize my eggs... yeah, that'd be great.\""

rows.original: Sometimes, I actually miss having sand in my boots. The only place in this place that had it was that shoreline we landed at ages ago. Being so far from the desert sure is strange..."
rows.translation: “有时候，我其实真怀念靴子里进沙子的感觉。这地方唯一有沙子的地方，就是我们很久以前登陆的那片海岸。离沙漠这么远，确实挺奇怪的……”
rows.raw: '\n Sometimes, I actually miss having sand in my boots. The only place in this place that had it was that shoreline we landed at ages ago. Being so far from the desert sure is strange..."'

rows.original: Do you think there are cute cow-boys like there are hunky minotaurs? I'm a fan of muscle but those minotaurs are just too big for me... a pint-sized one would be just right though! If they exist, they must be somewhere in the mountains or to the north — otherwise, we'd see them all over for sure!"
rows.translation: 你认为也会存在像那些肌肉发达的弥诺陶洛斯一样可爱的牛仔吗？我确实喜欢有肌肉的男人，但那些弥诺陶洛斯对我来说实在太大了……要是有个体型像品脱杯那么小的就好了只是不过没错！如果它们真的存在的话，肯定会在山区或者北方某个地方——否则的话，我们早就到处都能看到它们了！
rows.raw: "\n Do you think there are cute cow-boys like there are hunky minotaurs? I'm a fan of muscle but those minotaurs are just too big for me... a pint-sized one would be just right though! If they exist, they must be somewhere in the mountains or to the north — otherwise, we'd see them all over for sure!\""

rows.original: The oases back in Tronarii used to flood once or twice a year for up to a week! Normally farmers in other places might celebrate but back in Tronarii, they hire mercenaries to defend their fields! Tin washing through the waters occasionally draws in the beggars and slaves — those who don't have bronze — so they tend to trudge through fields searching for just a bit to put toward their own knives! It's a really nice time for us mercenaries! Not uh... so great for everyone else, though."
rows.translation: “在特洛纳里，那些绿洲过去每年都会泛滥一两次，最长能淹上一周！一般来说，别处的农民遇上这种事也许会庆祝，可在特洛纳里，人们却雇雇佣兵来守自己的田地！随着水流冲下来的锡偶尔会引来乞丐和奴隶——那些没有青铜的人——于是他们往往会在田里跋涉，只为找到一点点锡，好拿去换把属于自己的刀！对我们这些雇佣兵来说，那真是一段美好的时光！不过呃……对其他人来说可就不怎么样了。”
rows.raw: "\n            The oases back in Tronarii used to flood once or twice a year for up to a week! Normally farmers in other places might celebrate but back in Tronarii, they hire mercenaries to defend their fields! Tin washing through the waters occasionally draws in the beggars and slaves — those who don't have bronze — so they tend to trudge through fields searching for just a bit to put toward their own knives! It's a really nice time for us mercenaries! Not uh... so great for everyone else, though.\""

rows.original: A while back, I thought I met a fox person with a big pack! She seemed startled or something but when I turned my head, she was gone! The guys made fun of me for the rest of our patrol after that... urgh."
rows.translation: 不久前，我好像遇到了一个带着一大群同伴的狐狸人！她看起来似乎有些惊慌，但当我转过头去的时候，她已经不见了！从那以后，在我们接下来的巡逻中，那些家伙一直取笑我……真是烦人。
rows.raw: '\n            A while back, I thought I met a fox person with a big pack! She seemed startled or something but when I turned my head, she was gone! The guys made fun of me for the rest of our patrol after that... urgh."'

rows.original: There's talk of people having filthy dreams more than usual; think it has anything to do with all the sluts in town, grinding up and down all over the men and women? I'm not a prude or nothing, just saying that might be part of it."
rows.translation: “有人说最近大家做下流梦的次数比平时多了；你们觉得这跟镇上那些荡妇有没有关系？她们整天在男人女人身上磨来蹭去的。我可不是什么老古板，只是说这也许算个原因吧。”
rows.raw: "\n            There's talk of people having filthy dreams more than usual; think it has anything to do with all the sluts in town, grinding up and down all over the men and women? I'm not a prude or nothing, just saying that might be part of it.\""

莉里克

rows.original: Now that everything is said and done, and all the celebrations are over, and you finally have a moment to yourself to wind down from everything that's happened, you take a seat and you let your pack hit the floor with a hard, thick 'flump.' It feels like it's been an eternity since you've had a moment of peace and quiet to yourself. And even longer since you've had a damn nap. Except... as soon as your pack settles on the floor, the leathery burlap begins to shake and shift, bulging in different parts. Eventually, a finger pokes out the opening to your pack from the inside; it crooks down, pulling the straps apart and widening the hole, followed by a second finger from the other hand. When the bag's opening is split open, a snout juts straight up through the hole, sniffing at the air before the rest of the creature's face emerges from the pack. Its bright golden eyes scan the room, curiously taking in its surroundings, before it makes eye contact with you. It's a kobold, from a cursory glance. You try to remember all the times you had any interactions with kobolds – and you remember, way back in the Glacial Rift, that you tripped over one in the snow. You literally had a kobold in your pack this entire time, and you forgot. "Heya!" the little thing chirps happily, a wide smile spreading across its diminutive muzzle. It stretches its arms and legs – not that you see them too well, still inside your pack from the neck down. "Great nap," it sighs, and then licks at its chops before looking up at you again. "I feel like I must have slept for weeks!" It looks around the room once more. "So, what'd I miss?"
rows.translation: 现在，所有的庆祝活动都已经结束，所有的事情也都说完了，你终于有属于自己的时间，可以放松一下，从这一切中恢复过来。你坐下来，然后让你的背包重重地摔在地板上，发出“砰”的一声。感觉你已经很久没有享受过片刻的宁静了，而真正睡个午觉更是遥遥无期。 然而……只要你的背包一被放在地上，那些皮革制的麻布包就立刻开始晃动、变形，各个部位还会出现凸起。最终，有根手指从背包的内部伸了出来，它弯曲着将背带的扣子拉开，使洞口变得更大，紧接着，另一只手上的另一根手指也跟了上来。 当背包的开口被完全撑开时，一个兽鼻从洞口中探了出来，它先嗅了嗅空气，随后这个生物的其余面部也从背包里露了出来。它那明亮金色的眼睛在房间里扫视着四周，好奇地观察着周围的环境，最终与你目光相对。 从它的外表来看，这是一只狗头人。你努力回忆起自己曾经与狗头人有过哪些接触——果然，你想起来了。方式在冰川裂谷里，你曾经被雪中的某样东西绊倒了。 其实整个过程中，你身边一直都有一个狗头人啊……你真的没注意到吗？忘了。 嘿呀！”这个小家伙开心地叫着，它那小小的嘴巴里绽开了灿烂的笑容。它伸了伸胳膊和腿——不过你其实看不太清楚，因为它的身体从脖子以下还被放在你的背包里呢。“睡得真好啊，”它叹了口气，然后舔了舔自己的下巴，又抬头看着你：“我感觉自己好像睡了好几个星期呢！” 它又环顾了一下房间，然后问道：“那么，我错过了什么事情呢？
