rows.original: Your tromping through the soft snow of the rift is difficult enough; it reaches up to your shins and [dayNight |the sun reflects off the snow harshly enough that you have to cover your eyes and squint to see which was is forward |whatever moonlight you're given is swallowed by the darkness surrounding you ]. Your footing is consistently uneven, which, in a way, is better than it being slippery. You aren't mindful of what's at your feet as you push your legs through the powder, and you trip over what you mistake to be just a mound of snow in the middle of whatever recessed path there is. You land harshly on your hands and knees, your limbs sinking into the snow up to your waist and shoulders, and on top of having lost your footing, now you're cold and wet. When you flip yourself over, your eye happens to catch a glimpse of what was buried in the snow, now slightly unearthed to the chilly, biting wind. You were expecting it to be a large stone, or a chunk of bone discarded from a recent hunt – but most of what's visible to your eye has a scaly, dark-green texture to it, standing apart from the bright whites of the snow like a sore thumb. You brush away the rest of the snow, digging up whatever it is. When you make out the shape of a tail, then a hand and an arm, your [pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |breath catches in your throat: you hope you didn't find what you think you found. When the last of the snow is brushed away, your fears are confirmed: you've found a frozen body in the middle of the road |curiosity is piqued: it's probably too late for this poor bastard, but hell, they might be carrying something you could use. When the last of the snow is brushed away, you confirm what you kind of suspected: a frozen body, left to turn to ice in the middle of the road ]. With a heft, you hook your arm underneath the body's shoulders and you turn it over, hoping to get a better look at its face. It's a kobold: a diminutive thing, couldn't be taller than four feet from sole to scalp, covered head to toe in dark, jungle-green scales. It has a pair of stubby, triangular-but-blunt horns jutting up from above its forehead, pointed backwards and flanked by a number of smaller thorns and spikes framing its skull. It's wearing a unique full-body tunic of faded leather tanned dull reds and greens, hemmed together not with thread, but with hemp and metal; and it's wearing a thin lattice of chains around its feet, but not around the soles, apparently meant to be some kind of covering or fashion statement around its ankles. All in all, it's a terrible choice of wear for the area; the tunic would provide next to no protection from the cold and the metal would actively make things worse. [pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |Fearing the worst, you put your ear to its mouth, listening for any breathing |The first thing any proper looter does is make sure their target really is dead before looting them. You put your ear to its mouth ] – and you're frankly shocked to hear the whistle of its breath through its nostrils, and the rush of wind against your cheek. Its breathing is very, very shallow, but against all odds, it's alive. But it won't be for long if you don't do something. There's not a lot you can do, exposed to the cold wind as you both are. You look up and down the path and see nothing but craggy cliffs, frozen gravel, and fields upon rolling fields of snow. Put on the spot as you are, you do the one thing you can think to do, and you slip the kobold into your pack. It's small enough that it'll fit. It's hardly the perfect solution, but it'll at least buy you some time until you can get something a bit more potent into it. A fire might be useful, but it'd be impossible to find dry kindling this deep into the rift, and you doubt a conjured fireball could last longer than a few seconds in this environment. Perhaps sharing your body heat could be the answer? As soon as you find, or establish, a safe place to sleep, you could warm the kobold back up with your body.
rows.translation: 在裂隙中踩着柔软的积雪前行已经够艰难了——雪水几乎没到你的小腿部位。 [dayNight |阳光在雪地上反射出的光芒十分刺眼，以至于你必须遮住眼睛、眯起眼睛才能看清前方的路。 |无论你得到了多少兼职工作，那些收入最终都会被你周围的黑暗所吞噬。 ]你的脚步总是不稳，不过从某种意义上说，这总比路面过于湿滑要好。 当你将双腿踏入积雪中时，你根本没有注意自己脚下究竟有什么，结果被那堆看似只是普通的雪堆给绊倒了——而那堆雪其实就位于那条蜿蜒的小路中间。你重重地摔在双手和双膝上，四肢陷在雪中，雪深及腰、甚至覆盖了你的肩膀。不仅失去了平衡，此刻你还感到寒冷且浑身湿透。 当你翻过身来时，你的目光偶然瞥见了那些被雪覆盖的东西——如今，在凛冽的寒风中，它们已经有了一丝暴露在外的痕迹。你原本以为那会是一块巨大的石头，或者是最近狩猎时丢弃的骨头残片——但事实上，你眼前看到的大部分物体都呈现出鳞片状的深绿色质地，这种颜色与雪地中明亮的白色形成了鲜明的对比，显得格外突兀。 你把剩下的雪都扫开，试图挖出那些被雪覆盖的东西。当你看清那是一个尾巴的形状，接着是一只手和一条胳膊时，你[pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |你顿时屏住了呼吸：你希望自己并没有看到自己所看到的东西。当路上的积雪都被清理干净后，你的恐惧得到了证实——你在马路中间发现了一具冻僵的尸体。 |好奇心被激起了：对这个可怜的家伙来说，现在可能为时已晚，但谁知道呢，他们身上或许带着你需要的东西。当路上的积雪都被清理干净后，你证实了自己的猜测——那是一具冻僵的尸体，被遗弃在路中间，早已变成了冰块。 ]你用力将手臂伸到它的肩膀下方，然后将其翻过来，希望能更清楚地看到它的脸。原来是一只狗头人：个头极小，从脚底到头顶的高度肯定不超过四英尺，全身覆盖着深绿色的鳞片。它的前额上方长着一对短而呈三角形、但末端较为钝的角，这些角朝后弯曲，其两侧还分布着许多较小的刺和尖刺，这些刺刺构成了它头骨的边缘。 它穿着一件独特的全身长袍，这种长袍由褪色的皮革制成，呈现出暗红色和绿色的色调。长袍的边缘并不是用线缝制的，而是用大麻纤维和金属丝固定在一起的。它的脚上戴着一层细密的链条，但这些链条并没有绕在脚掌上，显然这些链条是用来装饰脚踝的，或者起到某种保护作用。总而言之，这是一款糟糕透了在这个地区，人们可以选择什么样的衣物来保暖；束腰外衣几乎无法提供任何防寒效果，而金属制品反而会让情况变得更糟。 [pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |担心最坏的情况发生，你把耳朵贴在它的嘴边，仔细聆听是否有呼吸声。 |任何称得上是专业的掠夺者，首先会确认他们的目标确实已经死亡，才会开始掠夺他们的财物。你会把耳朵贴在它的嘴边，确认它确实已经没有气息了。 ] – 说实话，你也是这样。震惊了你能听到它通过鼻孔呼出的气息，以及风掠过脸颊时的声响。它的呼吸极其微弱，但尽管如此，它依然活着。 不过，如果你不采取任何行动，这种状态不会持续太久。 在这种情况下，你们俩也实在无计可施，只能任由寒风肆虐。你们沿着小路四处张望，却只见崎岖的悬崖、结冰的碎石，以及连绵不断的雪原。 在这种紧迫的情况下，你们只能想到唯一能做的事情——把那只狗头人塞进背包里。它的尺寸足够小，可以装得下。虽然这并不是完美的解决方案，但至少能为你争取一些时间，直到你能找到更合适的替代品。强大的入手吧。 虽然火或许能派上用场，但在裂隙这么深的地方，根本找不到干燥的引火物；而且在这种环境中，即使是施放出的火球，也撑不过几秒钟吧。也许，用自己的体热来帮助它才是解决办法吧？一旦你找到了一个安全的地方休息，就可以用自己的身体为那只狗头人取暖了。

rows.translation: 存放狗头人

rows.original: Just before you crawl into bed and try and get some rest, you open the mouth to your pack and rummage through your things, searching for the kobold you had found in the snow. It's pretty easy to find, all things considered. [pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |What you're about to do is a pretty risky move. Kobolds aren't exactly wild creatures or anything, but they have a bit of a reputation for being... well, frankly, the worst of them can be real rascals, to put it lightly. But you couldn't just let this one freeze to death in the snow. Your conscience would never let you live it down. |Honestly, you don't really know why you're doing this or what you have to gain from going through the effort. Kobolds have a reputation for not exactly making great company, and you're about to pull this one into your bed with you, when you'd realistically be at your most vulnerable. But there's something of a spark inside you that would never let you live it down if you just let the poor, dumb thing freeze to death in the snow. It'd be like letting a child die of neglect. No matter how fucked up you might get, there's just some lines you can't cross. ] While you know that heat transfers better between naked bodies, you're not about to do that with a completely strange kobold. You pull the frozen, still-breathing lump of kobold into the bed with you, both of you still fully-clothed, and you hope for the best from there. At least it's dry frozen.
rows.translation: 就在你准备上床休息的时候，你打开背包，开始翻找里面的东西，试图找到在雪地里找到的那个狗头人。考虑到所有因素，其实找到它并不难。 [pc.corruptionRange 0 33 |你即将采取的行动确实相当冒险。狗头人虽然算不上什么野兽，但它们确实有那么一点“名声”……坦白说，最恶劣的狗头人简直就是些无赖。但你总不能让这只狗头人在雪中冻死吧？你的良心绝对不允许你这样做的。 |说实话，你其实并不清楚自己为什么要这么做，也不明白通过这些努力能获得什么。狗头人们向来以不怎么出色而闻名公司，就在你即将把这件事也牵扯进自己的生活中，而此时你其实正处于最脆弱的状态时…… 但是你内心深处有一股力量，绝不会允许你就这样让那个可怜的东西在雪中冻死。这就好比让一个孩子因为被忽视而死去一样。无论你变得多么堕落，总有些底线是不能触碰的。 ] 虽然你知道裸露的肌肤之间热量传递得更快，但你总不会对一个完全陌生的狗头人这么做吧。你把那个已经冻僵但仍在呼吸的狗头人拖到床上，自己和它都还穿着衣服，然后只能寄希望于最好的结果了。至少现在它只是被冻僵了而已。

rows.original:
You dozed off faster than you were expecting, and when you wake, you judge that it must have been a few hours since you got into bed, based on [dayNight
            |the light of the sun shining[atFH
                | through your bedroom window
                | through the fabric of your tent
            ]
            |the dark of night [atFH
                |coming in through your bedroom window
                |surrounding the fabric of your tent
            ]
        ]. At first, you think to get up as if nothing was different... before you feel a weight on your chest and a grip wrapping around your ribs.
        
        You move your hands along the weight, and in your mind's eye, you make out the distinct shape of two arms, each of them clinging to your torso. The air of the room is ambient with the sound of light, airy trilling, almost like a steady purr, rising in pitch with every breath in and lowering with the following exhale. And you feel the distinct, excited-but-relaxed wagging of a tail[pc.hasTail
            | distinct from your own
        ] wagging between your legs.
        
        Cautiously, you lift the cover of your bed – and the first thing you see are a pair of huge, golden eyes staring right back at you, turned into crescents from a pair of rising cheeks lifted from one of the biggest smiles you've seen. As soon as you make eye contact, the tip of its snout presses forward, emerging from underneath the cover, and pressing gently against yours. And the purring suddenly gets much louder; loud and intense enough that you feel it reverberate straight through your chest.
        
        "Hi," the kobold says through its own purring. The pitch of its voice is a bit on the higher side. "Maybe a stupid question, but, were you the one that rescued me from the snow?"
 
        You hesitate before you answer. "Yeah," you say eventually.
         
        "I love you," the kobold suddenly blurts, its tail wagging so quickly that it's shifting the whole bed[atFH||roll] with its motions. There was no filter put into that statement: it was a raw, pure declaration, straight from the heart and bypassing all social cues. You can't help but believe it. "My name's Lyric."
         
        Your face scrunches and your lips curl upward in confusion before you respond with your own name. Lyric says it a few times, getting used to the feel of your name on its lips. Clearly, the feeling isn't mutual. You tell the kobold – you tell Lyric that you only did it because you couldn't just leave the poor thing to freeze in the snow like that. It would have been inhumane.
         
        "I know it's a bit sudden," Lyric says, completely undeterred by your body language. "That word has just as much potency for kobolds as it does for [pc.race]s. But you're my hero. I would have frozen to death if you didn't rescue me. How else am I supposed to feel towards my hero?"
         
        "You don't know the first thing about me," you respond.
         
        "Do I need to?" Lyric asks, head tilting to the side. Its smile hasn't waned; its purring hasn't lowered; and its tail is still wagging just as hard. "I know all I need to know, I think."
         
        A part of you can't help but think that you might have made a huge mistake. You're caught off-guard, especially now that you're fresh from a long sleep and your mind is still a bit groggy, so you try and handle this new development one step at a time. Lyric watches you with undivided attention, every expression you make absorbed by those bright-gold eyes.
         
        You raise your hand and pat the kobold's head, and you call Lyric a good—
rows.translation:
你比预期更快地进入了梦乡，醒来后，根据一些迹象，你判断自己上床睡觉应该已经有几个小时了。 [dayNight
            |阳光洒满大地[atFH
                | 从你卧室的窗户那里
                | 穿过你的帐篷布料
            ]
            |深夜[atFH
                |从你卧室的窗户进入
                |围绕着你的帐篷布料
            ]
        ]起初，你试图像什么都没发生一样站起来……但随后，你感到胸口有重物压着，肋骨也被什么东西紧紧抓住了。
        
        你用手去触碰那个重物，在脑海中，你清晰地辨认出了那两只手臂的轮廓——它们每一只都紧紧地缠着你的躯干。房间里的空气中弥漫着轻柔的声音，那种清脆的颤音，仿佛是一种持续的轻哼声，随着每一次的吸气声音调会上升，而随着呼气声音调又会下降。你能感受到那种既兴奋又放松的尾巴摇动的感觉。[pc.hasTail
            | 与你自身截然不同
        ]它正悬挂在你的双腿之间。
        
        你小心翼翼地掀开床罩——首先映入眼帘的是那双巨大的金色眼睛，它们正紧紧地注视着你；那双因灿烂的笑容而高高扬起的脸颊，使得那双眼睛看起来更加像新月一般。一旦你们目光相遇，它的鼻子前端就会向前伸出，从遮盖物下面探出来，轻轻触碰到你的鼻子。而那种呼噜声也会突然变得响亮许多——响亮而强烈，仿佛能直接震彻你的胸腔。
        
        嗨，”那只狗头人用它那特有的低沉声音说道。它的音调有点偏高。“也许是个愚蠢的问题，但是……是不是你把我从雪地里救出来的？”
 
        你犹豫了一下，才回答道：“是的，是我。
         
        我爱你，”那只狗头人突然说道，它的尾巴快速地摇动着，以至于整个床都在随之晃动。[atFH||翻滚]她的话语伴随着那些动作。这句话没有经过任何修饰，就是一份纯粹、直白的表白，出自内心，完全忽略了所有社交礼仪。你不由得相信了她。“我叫莉里克。”
         
        你的脸微微皱起，嘴唇困惑地向上翘了翘，然后你才回答了自己的名字。莉莉克反复说着这些话，渐渐习惯了将你的名字念出口的感觉。然而，显然这种感觉并不是相互的。你告诉那个狗头人——你告诉莉莉克，你之所以那么做，只是因为不能眼睁睁看着那个可怜的家伙在雪中冻死。那样做未免太不人道了。
         
        “我知道这个决定有点突然，”莉里克说道，她的态度丝毫没有因为你的肢体语言而动摇。“这个词对狗头人而言，和对[pc.race]而言一样意义重大。但是你就是我的英雄。如果没有你救我，我早就冻死了。对于这样的英雄，我还能有别的感受吗？”
         
        “你根本不了解我，”你回答道。
         
        “真的有必要了解我吗？莉里克歪着头问道。它的笑容依然灿烂，呼噜声也没有减弱，尾巴也还在拼命地摇动。‘我想，我已经知道我需要知道的一切了。’”
         
        在内心深处，你不禁会怀疑自己可能犯了一个巨大的错误。你完全措手不及，尤其是现在你刚睡醒，头脑还有些昏沉，因此你决定一步一个脚印地应对这一突如其来的情况。莉里克全神贯注地注视着你，你脸上的每一个表情都被她那双金色的眼睛牢牢地记住了。
         
        你举起手，轻拍了一下那只狗头人的脑袋，然后称赞莉里克是个好孩子——
rows.raw:
'
        You dozed off faster than you were expecting, and when you wake, you judge that it must have been a few hours since you got into bed, based on [dayNight
            |the light of the sun shining[atFH
                | through your bedroom window
                | through the fabric of your tent
            ]
            |the dark of night [atFH
                |coming in through your bedroom window
                |surrounding the fabric of your tent
            ]
        ]. At first, you think to get up as if nothing was different... before you feel a weight on your chest and a grip wrapping around your ribs.
        
        You move your hands along the weight, and in your mind's eye, you make out the distinct shape of two arms, each of them clinging to your torso. The air of the room is ambient with the sound of light, airy trilling, almost like a steady purr, rising in pitch with every breath in and lowering with the following exhale. And you feel the distinct, excited-but-relaxed wagging of a tail[pc.hasTail
            | distinct from your own
        ] wagging between your legs.
        
        Cautiously, you lift the cover of your bed – and the first thing you see are a pair of huge, golden eyes staring right back at you, turned into crescents from a pair of rising cheeks lifted from one of the biggest smiles you've seen. As soon as you make eye contact, the tip of its snout presses forward, emerging from underneath the cover, and pressing gently against yours. And the purring suddenly gets much louder; loud and intense enough that you feel it reverberate straight through your chest.
        
        "Hi," the kobold says through its own purring. The pitch of its voice is a bit on the higher side. "Maybe a stupid question, but, were you the one that rescued me from the snow?"
 
        You hesitate before you answer. "Yeah," you say eventually.
         
        "I love you," the kobold suddenly blurts, its tail wagging so quickly that it's shifting the whole bed[atFH||roll] with its motions. There was no filter put into that statement: it was a raw, pure declaration, straight from the heart and bypassing all social cues. You can't help but believe it. "My name's Lyric."
         
        Your face scrunches and your lips curl upward in confusion before you respond with your own name. Lyric says it a few times, getting used to the feel of your name on its lips. Clearly, the feeling isn't mutual. You tell the kobold – you tell Lyric that you only did it because you couldn't just leave the poor thing to freeze in the snow like that. It would have been inhumane.
         
        "I know it's a bit sudden," Lyric says, completely undeterred by your body language. "That word has just as much potency for kobolds as it does for [pc.race]s. But you're my hero. I would have frozen to death if you didn't rescue me. How else am I supposed to feel towards my hero?"
         
        "You don't know the first thing about me," you respond.
         
        "Do I need to?" Lyric asks, head tilting to the side. Its smile hasn't waned; its purring hasn't lowered; and its tail is still wagging just as hard. "I know all I need to know, I think."
         
        A part of you can't help but think that you might have made a huge mistake. You're caught off-guard, especially now that you're fresh from a long sleep and your mind is still a bit groggy, so you try and handle this new development one step at a time. Lyric watches you with undivided attention, every expression you make absorbed by those bright-gold eyes.
         
        You raise your hand and pat the kobold's head, and you call Lyric a good—
        '

rows.original: While you're not against having someone like Lyric tag along with you[party.solo|| and your companions], [lyric.heShe] still needs to be able to pull [lyric.hisHer] weight somehow. Like you had said, you weren't in the Rift for the pleasure of it, and your 'line of work' is likely going to take you to more dangerous locations to meet dangerous people. Lyric squints [lyric.mf|his|her] eyes and purses [lyric.mf|his|her] lips as [lyric.mf|he|she] tries to come up with some way that [lyric.mf|he|she] could be of use to you. "Umm," [lyric.mf|he|she] hums, [lyric.mf|his|her] eyes quickly scanning across yours, back and forth. "I could... carry–" You tilt your head to one side and you narrow your own eyes. [lyric.mf|He|She] doesn't finish the sentence, because [lyric.mf|he|she] has the same thought you have: carry what, exactly? Your pack is meant for someone your size, not [lyric.mf|his|hers]. "Oh!" [lyric.mf|he|she] pips, straightening [lyric.mf|his|her] back. [lyric.mf|His|Her] tail stands upright behind [lyric.mf|him|her]self, tenting the sheet to your bed[atFH||roll]. "Okay, hear me out on this one," [lyric.mf|he|she] says, [lyric.mf|his|her] smile from before creeping across [lyric.mf|his|her] lips once again. "So, I'm pretty small, right? There aren't a lot of tall kobolds running around, and if you find one, be sure to shake their hand, because they are very lucky and you'll want to rub some of that luck onto yourself. Anyway, yeah, I'm a small [lyric.mf|[silly|boi|boy]|girl]; I'm small enough to fit into your pack and I'm light enough for you to carry around." You cock an eyebrow, waiting for [lyric.mf|him|her] to get to [lyric.mf|his|her] point. "So, in a direct fight, kobolds aren't capable of a whole lot unless we have numbers on our side. That's why most of us prefer to fight unfairly: coming in from the shadows, or doing it with a height advantage, and if the fight lasts longer than a few seconds, we're probably going to run. I'm not much use in a direct fight like that." "But what if you threw me?" You don't answer, and you try to keep your expression unchanged. It's a ridiculous idea, but you don't want to dismiss it right away. It's certainly a unique take on combat. "I got claws," [lyric.mf|he|she] says, "and sharp teeth. Throw me right at someone's head, and I could mess them up really fast. And like I said, I got a mind for the scholarly stuff – like, if I had a bit of oil on me or something, I could splash it on a guy, then burp up an ember, and bam, problem solved. Or," [lyric.mf|he|she] continues, [lyric.mf|his|her] eyes wandering as [lyric.mf|he|she] lets [lyric.mf|his|her] imagination get the better of [lyric.mf|him|her]. "If I had the time, I could rub my feet in the grass, and when I next touch a guy, I'll give them a wicked shock! It wouldn't be as effective as the oil strategy, but hey, whatever gives us the advantage. Ooh, and I could–" You interrupt [lyric.mf|him|her] before [lyric.mf|he|she] starts on another wild strategy involving parlor tricks. [lyric.mf|He|She] stops immediately, [lyric.mf|his|her] eyes wide as [lyric.mf|he|she] awaits your decisions. It's obvious to you that [lyric.mf|he|she] wants to be with you more than anything else, and that turning [lyric.mf|him|her] away would break [lyric.mf|his|her] little scaly heart. But, frankly, [lyric.mf|his|her] immediate declaration of [lyric.mf|his|her] heartfelt love for you is honestly off-putting, and you don't want to encourage that sort of behavior or relationship. So, you lay down two ground rules. At that, Lyric's body straightens out once again, [lyric.mf|his|her] tail nearly poking a hole straight through the bedsheet. First: while you don't mind the affection, [lyric.mf|he|she] has to not be clingy about it. You lead a very polyamorous life[pc.isVirgin| (which, despite the literally hundreds of opportunities you've had by now, is a lie that you tell Lyric to calm down)]; you've taken many lovers before and you're likely to take many more in the future. [lyric.mf|He|She] needs to not only be okay with that, but [lyric.mf|he|she] needs to not be jealous when [lyric.mf|he|she]'s not included. "Oh, really?" Lyric says, tilting [lyric.mf|his|her] head to one side and his mouth turning crooked. "Kobolds usually only pick one mate and stick with them. That's not the same for [pc.race]s?" You reply that the world is a complicated place when it comes to individuals and their needs and emotions. Some people and some races prefer monogamy, and you are not one of them. Lyric absorbs what you're saying for a moment, [lyric.mf|his|her] expression unchanging. "Well, if that's how you live your life, then I can live like that, too," [lyric.mf|he|she] says. "I'll do whatever it takes to be with you, [pc.name]." You hammer in the point by saying that, if you ever have sex with [lyric.mf|him|her], that doesn't necessarily mean you love [lyric.mf|him|her] back. "You want to have sex with me?!" [lyric.mf|he|she] nearly shouts, and suddenly, [lyric.mf|his|her] tail is back to wagging so fast and so hard that it's about to rip the sheets right off you both. Ignoring that, you start on the second rule: if you ask Lyric to be dismissed from the group for whatever reason, [lyric.mf|he|she]'s just going to have to trust you on it. [lyric.mf|He|She] can travel to a village called Hawkethorne; your name and your deeds have some weight there, and if [lyric.mf|he|she] mentions that [lyric.mf|he|she]'s with you, then they ought to be able to accommodate [lyric.mf|him|her] until you need [lyric.mf|him|her] again. "Do they have a volcano?" Lyric asks. Uh... they have an alchemy shop that [lyric.mf|he|she] might be interested in. "Oh, that works!" Lyric lays on your chest, [lyric.mf|his|her] chin resting against your collarbone. [lyric.mf|He|She] stares deeply into your eyes with a wide, placid smile on [lyric.mf|his|her] face. [lyric.mf|He|She] sighs wistfully, enjoying your company. [lyric.mf|His|Her] tail continues to wag, swishing between your legs the entire time. "So what now?" [lyric.mf|he|she] asks. Now, [lyric.mf|he|she] gets off you. "Oh!" [lyric.heShe] chirps. "Right. Sorry. Right."

You step over [lyric.hisHer] kneeling form as you untie your coin pouch from your hip, and you spread open the mouth of the pouch with your fingers, before you turn it upside down and you let the coins shower down onto [lyric.himHer] from up above. The electrum coins crash and jingle all over [lyric.hisHer] upturned face and into [lyric.hisHer] cupped palms, each one making a new sound as they hit [lyric.hisHer] face, or the horns and spikes on [lyric.hisHer] head, and against each other, all on the way down. At first, Lyric's caught by surprise and is paralyzed with indecision on how [lyric.heShe] should react – but, once [lyric.heShe] gets [lyric.hisHer] bearings on the situation, [lyric.heShe] lazily opens [lyric.hisHer] mouth and extends [lyric.hisHer] tongue. Your payload bounces off [lyric.hisHer] wet tongue; it pools into the crooks between [lyric.hisHer] neck and shoulders; coins slide down [lyric.hisHer] tunic and across [lyric.hisHer] chest; some of them land squarely inside [lyric.hisHer] mouth, and [lyric.heShe] lets them pool in [lyric.hisHer] cheeks until they begin to sag with the weight of the electrum gathering inside them. Still, for as much as Lyric is enjoying [lyric.hisHer] electrum shower, you can't exactly have all of your money going towards feeding [lyric.hisHer] gluttonous, electrum-starved belly. You turn the pouch back up and cut off the flow before you accidentally give up more than you meant. Another moment passes before [lyric.heShe] realizes that there isn't any more coming, and, as soon as [lyric.heShe] does, [lyric.heShe] brings [lyric.hisHer] cupped hands to [lyric.hisHer] mouth, letting all of the coins that's landed in [lyric.hisHer] palms waterfall into [lyric.hisHer] open mouth. When [lyric.heShe] tries to bite down, there's just too much metal in [lyric.hisHer] mouth to chomp through in one pass. The wet, muffled sound of metal being ripped apart by teeth is the only drawback to the sight of your deliriously-satisfied kobold, on [lyric.hisHer] knees, covered and surrounded by glinting electrum coins, all for [lyric.himHer] to eat. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are nearly shut, but [lyric.hisHer] pupils are widely dilated, and drool seeps from the corners of [lyric.hisHer] mouth as [lyric.heShe] struggles to chew through the immense amount of money still inside [lyric.hisHer] cheeks. Lyric offers no word of thanks – not surprising, given how full [lyric.hisHer] mouth is – but, instead, gives you one, elongated, guttural sigh, mostly through [lyric.hisHer] throat and nose. [lyric.HisHer] hands and fingers run through the piles of electrum coins splashed all around [lyric.hisHer] kneeling body, playing with the money still lying there. With another rough bite, [lyric.heShe] manages to swallow a chunk of the metal already in [lyric.hisHer] mouth – and it's quickly replaced with another fistful. [lyric.HeShe]'ll be there for a little while, you think.

rows.translation: [lyric.HimHer]自己

rows.original: Ask Lyric about [lyric.himHer]self. Surely a spritely little kobold like [lyric.himHer]self has quite the story to tell!
rows.translation: 去问问莉里克吧。[lyric.himHer]自己嘛。像这样活泼可爱的小狗头人，肯定[lyric.himHer]的背后有着一段不为人知的故事！
rows.raw: "Ask Lyric about [lyric.himHer]self. Surely a spritely little kobold like [lyric.himHer]self has quite the story to tell!"

rows.translation: 狗头人

rows.original: Ask Lyric about all there is to know about kobolds. [lyric.HeShe] could give you some valuable information on everything from their biology to their culture.
rows.translation: 向莉里克咨询关于狗头人的所有信息吧。[lyric.HeShe]我可以为您提供一些关于它们的生物学特征以及文化习俗的宝贵信息。
rows.raw: "Ask Lyric about all there is to know about kobolds. [lyric.HeShe] could give you some valuable information on everything from their biology to their culture."

rows.translation: 科学？

rows.original: Lyric likes to tell you that [lyric.heShe]'s more scientifically minded than most. What drew [lyric.himHer] to the sciences? How is it different, if it is different, from alchemy?
rows.translation: 莉里克喜欢告诉你这些。[lyric.heShe]比大多数人都更具有科学思维。真正吸引他的，是[lyric.himHer]对于科学而言，这又有什么不同呢？如果……的话，那又有什么区别呢？是与炼金术不同吗？
rows.raw: "Lyric likes to tell you that [lyric.heShe]'s more scientifically minded than most. What drew [lyric.himHer] to the sciences? How is it different, if it is different, from alchemy?"

rows.translation: 英雄崇拜

rows.original: Lyric's devotion to you is bordering on obsession. Maybe it'd be best to have a discussion about it before it gets any more overblown.
rows.translation: 莉里克对你的忠诚已经近乎痴迷了。或许在事情进一步恶化之前，最好先谈一谈这个问题。
rows.raw: "Lyric's devotion to you is bordering on obsession. Maybe it'd be best to have a discussion about it before it gets any more overblown."

rows.translation: 新陈代谢

rows.original: Kobolds can stomach a steady diet of metal, if necessary. Maybe even healthily. Ask Lyric for more information on the subject.
rows.translation: 如果有必要，狗头人们完全可以长期食用金属，甚至这样吃对他们来说可能还有益健康。关于这个话题，你可以向莉里克咨询更多详细信息。
rows.raw: "Kobolds can stomach a steady diet of metal, if necessary. Maybe even healthily. Ask Lyric for more information on the subject."

rows.translation: 吉拉娜兹
吉拉娜兹

rows.original: Jyrranaz and Lyric had a discussion recently about collaborating on a potion that could turn average vesparans and kobolds into their respective queens, and they're just missing an ingredient on Lyric's side of the bargain. Have you found anything that could help...?
rows.translation: 吉拉娜兹和莉里克最近讨论过合作制作一种药剂，这种药剂能够将普通的黄蜂族和狗头人变成他们各自种族的女王，只不过在莉里克这边，还缺少一种所需的材料。你有没有找到什么可以帮助解决这个问题的东西呢……？
rows.raw: "Jyrranaz and Lyric had a discussion recently about collaborating on a potion that could turn average vesparans and kobolds into their respective queens, and they're just missing an ingredient on Lyric's side of the bargain. Have you found anything that could help...?"

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: You ask Lyric to tell you a little bit about [lyric.himHer]self. [var0|You've run into kobolds before, but Lyric seems a bit... well, different from the chaff, and you don't mean that in a bad way. Even [lyric.hisHer] scales are a different color than what you've seen.|You've never seen a kobold before, and Lyric is quite the character – but you don't mean that in a bad way. Are all kobolds like [lyric.himHer]? Spritely, little, energetic, scientifically-minded, avaricious gremlins-but-you-mean-that-in-a-cute-way?] "Oh!" [lyric.heShe] says, perking upward: [lyric.hisHer] spine straightens and [lyric.hisHer] tail stands on-end in surprise. "I wasn't expecting you to ask me about... me. People don't usually ask me about me! Most non-kobolds I've met usually ask me for something I can do for them. Well, they usually just tell me to go away, and usually in more crass language than that. So this is new to me!" You patiently wait for Lyric to start answering your question. "Well, um... to start with, I'm not actually from... what's this region called?" "The Frost Marches," you answer. "Yeah, I'm not actually from here. I come from way, way down south, where the climate is much warmer and it rarely snows at any time of the year. It's nice and warm all year ‘round; the trees stay green and the air is usually a whole lot more humid than here in the... the Frost Marches." You ask the obvious question: if that's where [lyric.heShe]'s from, then what brings [lyric.himHer] here, so far out of [lyric.hisHer] element? At the question, Lyric, rather uncharacteristically, hesitates. [lyric.HeShe] suddenly can't bring [lyric.himHer]self to look you in the eye, and [lyric.hisHer] lips begin to tremble. [lyric.HisHer] eyelids arch upward, and [lyric.hisHer] big, golden eyes begin to water – [lyric.heShe]'s nearly about to cry. "Um," [lyric.heShe] stumbles, "I was... kidnapped. Stolen. By orcs." You interject by telling Lyric that if [lyric.heShe] doesn't want to go any further, then [lyric.heShe] doesn't have to. Which you'd think was a given, but you get the impression that [lyric.heShe] wouldn't stop unless you told [lyric.himHer] that it was okay. [lyric.HeShe] takes a deep, shuddering sigh. "I think I'm okay with talking about it. I mean, I'm here with you now, aren't I? Everything worked out in the end!" You silently remind yourself that you found Lyric nearly frozen to death in the Glacial Rift. Things went from bad to worse for [lyric.himHer] in a hurry. "So, yeah," [lyric.heShe] says, trying to buck up and swallow [lyric.hisHer] emotions, "an orc tribe raided my village and kidnapped me and my kin. The lot of us were thrown onto a ship, and we sailed north until we got... well, here. I'm, uh, not going to go into details about how the trip was." You don't blame [lyric.himHer]. "But I will say that they fed us copper to keep us going. We can eat copper, but that's not to say it's palatable, and it's not especially nutritious. And the worse quality that the metal is, the more we need to eat before we can start breathing fire." "The cuffs they put us in were made of bronze, and alloys are too tough for us to chew through. Before we made landfall, I managed to escape by stockpiling my food rations until I was starving; then, one night, I ate all of it, as quickly as I could, so I could heat the cuffs around my wrists with my fire breath. And once they were red-hot, I dunked the cuffs into the communal water trough they gave us. I did that a bunch of times until the metal was weak enough to yank apart, even with my spindly-thin arms." [lyric.HeShe] pulls back the fabric of [lyric.hisHer] bracers, showing you the underside of [lyric.hisHer] wrists. They each have long, broad, deep-red burn scars where [lyric.hisHer] cuffs used to be. "It wasn't exactly a perfect, painless process," [lyric.heShe] says with a bit of a lilt in [lyric.hisHer] voice, "but it worked." [lyric.HeShe] folds the bracers back up. "I crawled above-deck in the middle of the night, then jumped overboard." In the middle of the night? How did [lyric.heShe] know where land was? Had they even spotted land? "Well, actually, my village was on the west coast of the far-southern regions, right? And the orcs were taking us north. So I knew that land was to my east – once I was in the water, all it took was looking at the stars and the position of the moon to know which direction was east. I swam for maybe a few hours before I made landfall." You're reeling at this whole story so far, so you ask Lyric to pause so you can recap. [lyric.HeShe] lived in the southern regions of the continent when [lyric.heShe] was kidnapped by orcs. While [lyric.heShe] was on the way to being sold, [lyric.heShe] managed to escape by starving [lyric.himHer]self and rationing [lyric.hisHer] food; then eating it all at once; then using the sudden burst of metal in [lyric.hisHer] gut to breathe fire on [lyric.hisHer] handcuffs before dunking them in water over and over until they were weak enough to snap. After that, [lyric.heShe] snuck above-deck in the middle of the night; jumped overboard; used the stars to determine which way was east; and then swam for over an hour until [lyric.heShe] made landfall. You ask Lyric if that's all correct. "Yep!" [lyric.heShe] says, wagging [lyric.hisHer] tail. [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|... you ask if [lyric.heShe] knew who [lyric.heShe] was being sold to. "As I understood it, another tribe of orcs in the northern regions. I don't know their tribe name or anything." ... this is probably a conversation you're going to have with Arona sooner or later. ]You ask Lyric to continue. How did [lyric.heShe] end up in the Glacial Rift? You'd have thought that the first place [lyric.heShe]'d want to go was south, not farther north. At that question, Lyric once again hesitates – although, this time, [lyric.heShe] stares off into the distance rather than get emotional. "I'm... still trying to decide if I want to go back," [lyric.heShe] says. "The raid proved that it wasn't safe to live there. And if I did, I'd have to live with the fact that I was the only one to escape." [lyric.HeShe] opens [lyric.hisHer] mouth to say more, but no more words come out. [lyric.HeShe] stops, casting [lyric.hisHer] eyes downward in solemn thought. [lyric.HisHer] tail lies motionless behind [lyric.himHer]. "So, um, I had heard that there was another... gathering of kobolds somewhere farther north. In a place that they called Undermountain. They had a queen, which, from what I heard, sounded just like how we had a Village Mother. It was underground, where it was hot all year ‘round. And best of all, they had all the gold you could ask for! Gold, the most delicious of all the metals! It honestly sounded too good to be true!" Remembering the Undermountain causes Lyric to get more animated and excited once again; [lyric.hisHer] earlier despondence replaced with excitement and eagerness. "It took me a lot of effort and research, but I found it! I managed to find my way to the Undermountain, and... my word, [pc.name], it was paradise! I was surrounded by kobolds! It was warm as could be! And the gold! The place was lit with the stuff! I could see it gleaming off the walls as soon as I found my way in!" Lyric's body slowly begins to relax, and [lyric.hisHer] smile stays on [lyric.hisHer] face... but it's clear that the elation is short-lived. Lyric was freezing in the snow for a reason, after all. "It was everything I could have wanted," [lyric.heShe] says quietly. "I could have started a new life there. I'd never have to worry about food, or company, or security again." You stay silent. Lyric's face turns downward, and [lyric.heShe] raises a claw to [lyric.hisHer] eye, wiping away a tear. "Turns out... the gold wasn't for eating. I lasted a day before the queen banished me." A few moments pass; Lyric's shoulders shudder and [lyric.heShe] occasionally hiccups and sniffles. When [lyric.heShe] finally looks back up, [lyric.hisHer] eyes are dry, but [lyric.hisHer] cheeks are damp. [lyric.HisHer] cheeks are raised into a forced smile. "You found me in the snow not long after that," [lyric.heShe] says, [lyric.hisHer] voice wavy and unsteady. "So, all's well that ends well, right?"
rows.translation: 你让莉里克稍微讲讲这个事情吧。[lyric.himHer]自我。 [var0|你之前应该遇到过狗头人，但莉里克似乎有点……嗯，不一样。不同把劣质的东西筛选出来，你这么说并没有什么坏意思，真的。[lyric.hisHer]这些鳞片的颜色与你之前见过的完全不同。|你以前从未见过狗头人，而莉里克确实是个与众不同的角色——不过我这么说并没有任何贬义。对吧？所有狗头人们喜欢[lyric.himHer]那些活泼、小巧、充满活力、富有科学头脑的淘气小精灵——不过我说的当然是那种可爱的方式哦？] 哦！[lyric.heShe]说道，声音陡然提高：[lyric.hisHer]脊柱挺直了，[lyric.hisHer]泰尔惊讶得呆住了。“我完全没料到你会问我关于……我自己的事情。通常没人会问我这类问题啊！我遇到的大多数非狗头人人士，通常都会问我能为他们做些什么。嗯，他们通常情况下只要你让我走开就行了通常情况下用更直白的语言来说吧。所以这对我来说真的是新鲜事！ 你耐心地等待莉里克开始回答你的问题。 “嗯，那个……首先，我其实并不是来自……这个地区叫什么来着？ 弗罗斯特马奇斯，”你回答道。 “是的，其实我并不是这里的人。我来自遥远的南方，那里的气候温暖得多，一年中很少下雪。那里一年到头都很温暖；树木始终是绿色的，空气的湿度也通常比这里高很多。……冰霜之地。” 你自然会问一个显而易见的问题：如果那就是那个地方的话[lyric.heShe]那么，究竟是什么驱使着人们去这样做呢？[lyric.himHer]在这里，却如此遥远[lyric.hisHer]元素？ 听到这个问题，莉里克一反常态地犹豫了起来。[lyric.HeShe]突然想不起来了[lyric.himHer]要勇敢地直视你的眼睛，然后[lyric.hisHer]嘴唇开始颤抖。[lyric.HisHer]眼睑向上翘起，[lyric.hisHer]那双大大的、金色的眼睛开始泛起泪光[lyric.heShe]快哭出来了……” “嗯，[lyric.heShe]结结巴巴地说：“我……被绑架了。被兽人抓走了。” 你插话告诉莉里克，如果[lyric.heShe]如果不想再继续下去的话，那就[lyric.heShe]没有必要这样做。你可能会认为这是理所当然的，但实际情况却并非如此。[lyric.heShe]除非你下令停止，否则它们就不会停下来。[lyric.himHer]那没什么问题。 [lyric.HeShe]深深地叹了口气，身体不由自主地颤抖起来。“我想，现在谈论这件事也没关系了。毕竟，我现在不是和你在一起吗？最终，一切都不算太糟！” 你暗自提醒自己：你是在冰川裂谷中发现莉里克几乎冻死的。情况本来就已经越来越糟了[lyric.himHer]所以，没错。[lyric.heShe]说道，努力让自己振作起来，强忍着泪水继续说下去。[lyric.hisHer]那些兽人袭击了我的村庄，绑架了我和我的族人。我们被关在一艘船上，然后一路向北航行，最终来到了……嗯，就是这里。关于这段旅程的细节，我就不详细说了。” 你也不会责怪我吧[lyric.himHer]但我必须说，他们给我们提供了铜，让我们能够继续前进。我们可以吃铜，但这也并不意味着它可口的，美味的。而且这种食物并没有什么营养价值。金属的质量越差，我们就需要吃更多的量才能开始释放火焰。” “他们给我们的手铐是由青铜制成的，而各种合金材料对我们来说太坚硬了，根本无法咬碎。在我们成功登陆之前，我设法通过囤积食物来维持生存，直到快要饿晕过去；然后有一天晚上，我以最快的速度吃光了所有食物，这样就可以用我的火息将手腕上的手环加热到炽热的状态。等它们变得通红之后，我就把它们浸入他们提供给我们的公共水槽里。我反复做了很多次，直到那块金属变得足够脆弱，即使用我那双细瘦的手臂也能把它扯开。 [lyric.HeShe]掀开[lyric.hisHer]护腕的布料，向你露出[lyric.hisHer]手腕内侧。它们的每一处手腕上都有长长的、宽宽的、深红色的烧伤疤痕。[lyric.hisHer]这个过程其实并不完美，也没有那么顺利。[lyric.heShe]带着一丝俏皮的语气说道[lyric.hisHer]但是，它确实起作用了。[lyric.HeShe]把护腕重新折起来，说道：“我在半夜爬上了甲板，然后跳进了海里。” 半夜？他是怎么做到的？[lyric.heShe]知道这片土地的来历吗？他们甚至被发现的陆地？ “嗯，其实我的村庄位于最南端地区的西海岸，对吧？而那些兽人正把我们往北带。所以我知道陆地应该在我的东边——一旦我进入水中，只需要观察星星和月亮的方位，就能确定东边的方向。我游了大概几个小时，终于到达了陆地。” 你听完这个故事后有些晕头转向，于是让莉里克暂停一下，好让你能整理一下思路。[lyric.HeShe]当时，我居住在这片大陆的南部地区。[lyric.heShe]被兽人绑架了。当时[lyric.heShe]正在准备出售的过程中。[lyric.heShe]通过绝食成功逃脱了。[lyric.himHer]自我限制与资源分配[lyric.hisHer]先把食物准备好，然后一次性全部吃掉；接着，利用这种突如其来的金属质感来[lyric.hisHer]有胆量对……发火[lyric.hisHer]把它们反复浸在水中，直到它们变得脆弱到足以折断为止。之后再给它们戴上手铐。那就是。 [lyric.heShe]在半夜悄悄爬上甲板，跳入海中，借助星星来确定东方在哪里，然后游了一个多小时直到[lyric.heShe]成功登陆了。 你询问莉里克是否一切正常。 “没错！[lyric.heShe]说着，还摇着尾巴。[lyric.hisHer]尾巴。 [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|…你问到是否[lyric.heShe]知道是谁[lyric.heShe]据我所知，是北方地区另一个兽人部落。我不知道他们的部落名称之类的信息。” ……这很可能是你迟早会与阿罗娜进行的对话。 ]你让莉里克继续说下去。那是怎么发生的呢？[lyric.heShe]最终落入了冰川裂谷？你可能会认为，第一个应该出现的地方应该是[lyric.heShe]我想去的方向是南方，而不是更往北。” 听到这个问题，莉里克再次犹豫了——不过，这一次，[lyric.heShe]望着远方，没有流露出任何情绪。“我……还在犹豫是否应该回去。[lyric.heShe]说：“那次袭击证明，住在那里并不安全。如果我继续留在那里，我就不得不面对这样一个事实：我是唯一一个成功逃脱的人。 [lyric.HeShe]打开[lyric.hisHer]想说更多，但却再也说不出任何话来了。[lyric.HeShe]停止施法[lyric.hisHer]低头沉思，神情肃穆。[lyric.HisHer]尾巴静止地悬在身后[lyric.himHer]所以，嗯，我听说在更北边的某个地方，还有另一个……狗头人聚居地。他们把那个地方叫做‘山腹深域’。那里有一位女王，据我所知，她的地位就相当于我们这里的村长。那是在地下，那里一年到头都很热。而且最棒的是，那里有你能想到的所有黄金！黄金，所有金属中最珍贵的那种！说实话，这听起来好得简直不像是真的！ 一想到地下城，莉里克又变得兴奋起来，情绪也更加高涨了。[lyric.hisHer]先前的沮丧早已被兴奋与期待所取代。“我花费了大量的时间和精力进行研究，终于找到了！我成功找到了通往山腹深域的路，而且……真的，我做到了！[pc.name]，就是那样天堂啊！我被狗头人们包围了！那里的温度高得惊人……而且黄金！那个地方点亮那些东西！我一进去就能看到它们在墙上闪闪发光！” 莱瑞克的身体慢慢放松下来，[lyric.hisHer]笑容始终挂在脸上[lyric.hisHer]脸上露出了喜悦的表情，但显然这种兴奋感并没有持续太久。毕竟，莉里克在雪中等待，是有着原因的。 “这正是我梦寐以求的一切。[lyric.heShe]轻声说道：“我在那里本可以开始新的生活。再也不用为食物、陪伴或安全问题而担忧了。” 你沉默不语。莉里克的低头露出了[lyric.heShe]伸出爪子来[lyric.hisHer]擦去泪水，说道： “原来……那些黄金并不是用来吃的。我在那里待了一天，之后女王就把我赶走了。” 过了一会儿，莉里克的肩膀开始颤抖[lyric.heShe]偶尔会打嗝或流鼻涕。当[lyric.heShe]时终于又抬起头来。[lyric.hisHer]眼睛干涩，但[lyric.hisHer]脸颊湿润了。[lyric.HisHer]脸颊被强行挤成了一丝微笑。 “就在那之后不久，你在雪地里找到了我。[lyric.heShe]说道，[lyric.hisHer]声音颤抖而不稳定。“所以，只要结局好，一切就都值得了，对吧？
rows.raw: ' You ask Lyric to tell you a little bit about [lyric.himHer]self. [var0|You've run into kobolds before, but Lyric seems a bit... well, different from the chaff, and you don't mean that in a bad way. Even [lyric.hisHer] scales are a different color than what you've seen.|You've never seen a kobold before, and Lyric is quite the character – but you don't mean that in a bad way. Are all kobolds like [lyric.himHer]? Spritely, little, energetic, scientifically-minded, avaricious gremlins-but-you-mean-that-in-a-cute-way?] "Oh!" [lyric.heShe] says, perking upward: [lyric.hisHer] spine straightens and [lyric.hisHer] tail stands on-end in surprise. "I wasn't expecting you to ask me about... me. People don't usually ask me about me! Most non-kobolds I've met usually ask me for something I can do for them. Well, they usually just tell me to go away, and usually in more crass language than that. So this is new to me!" You patiently wait for Lyric to start answering your question. "Well, um... to start with, I'm not actually from... what's this region called?" "The Frost Marches," you answer. "Yeah, I'm not actually from here. I come from way, way down south, where the climate is much warmer and it rarely snows at any time of the year. It's nice and warm all year ‘round; the trees stay green and the air is usually a whole lot more humid than here in the... the Frost Marches." You ask the obvious question: if that's where [lyric.heShe]'s from, then what brings [lyric.himHer] here, so far out of [lyric.hisHer] element? At the question, Lyric, rather uncharacteristically, hesitates. [lyric.HeShe] suddenly can't bring [lyric.himHer]self to look you in the eye, and [lyric.hisHer] lips begin to tremble. [lyric.HisHer] eyelids arch upward, and [lyric.hisHer] big, golden eyes begin to water – [lyric.heShe]'s nearly about to cry. "Um," [lyric.heShe] stumbles, "I was... kidnapped. Stolen. By orcs." You interject by telling Lyric that if [lyric.heShe] doesn't want to go any further, then [lyric.heShe] doesn't have to. Which you'd think was a given, but you get the impression that [lyric.heShe] wouldn't stop unless you told [lyric.himHer] that it was okay. [lyric.HeShe] takes a deep, shuddering sigh. "I think I'm okay with talking about it. I mean, I'm here with you now, aren't I? Everything worked out in the end!" You silently remind yourself that you found Lyric nearly frozen to death in the Glacial Rift. Things went from bad to worse for [lyric.himHer] in a hurry. "So, yeah," [lyric.heShe] says, trying to buck up and swallow [lyric.hisHer] emotions, "an orc tribe raided my village and kidnapped me and my kin. The lot of us were thrown onto a ship, and we sailed north until we got... well, here. I'm, uh, not going to go into details about how the trip was." You don't blame [lyric.himHer]. "But I will say that they fed us copper to keep us going. We can eat copper, but that's not to say it's palatable, and it's not especially nutritious. And the worse quality that the metal is, the more we need to eat before we can start breathing fire." "The cuffs they put us in were made of bronze, and alloys are too tough for us to chew through. Before we made landfall, I managed to escape by stockpiling my food rations until I was starving; then, one night, I ate all of it, as quickly as I could, so I could heat the cuffs around my wrists with my fire breath. And once they were red-hot, I dunked the cuffs into the communal water trough they gave us. I did that a bunch of times until the metal was weak enough to yank apart, even with my spindly-thin arms." [lyric.HeShe] pulls back the fabric of [lyric.hisHer] bracers, showing you the underside of [lyric.hisHer] wrists. They each have long, broad, deep-red burn scars where [lyric.hisHer] cuffs used to be. "It wasn't exactly a perfect, painless process," [lyric.heShe] says with a bit of a lilt in [lyric.hisHer] voice, "but it worked." [lyric.HeShe] folds the bracers back up. "I crawled above-deck in the middle of the night, then jumped overboard." In the middle of the night? How did [lyric.heShe] know where land was? Had they even spotted land? "Well, actually, my village was on the west coast of the far-southern regions, right? And the orcs were taking us north. So I knew that land was to my east – once I was in the water, all it took was looking at the stars and the position of the moon to know which direction was east. I swam for maybe a few hours before I made landfall." You're reeling at this whole story so far, so you ask Lyric to pause so you can recap. [lyric.HeShe] lived in the southern regions of the continent when [lyric.heShe] was kidnapped by orcs. While [lyric.heShe] was on the way to being sold, [lyric.heShe] managed to escape by starving [lyric.himHer]self and rationing [lyric.hisHer] food; then eating it all at once; then using the sudden burst of metal in [lyric.hisHer] gut to breathe fire on [lyric.hisHer] handcuffs before dunking them in water over and over until they were weak enough to snap. After that, [lyric.heShe] snuck above-deck in the middle of the night; jumped overboard; used the stars to determine which way was east; and then swam for over an hour until [lyric.heShe] made landfall. You ask Lyric if that's all correct. "Yep!" [lyric.heShe] says, wagging [lyric.hisHer] tail. [flags.ARONA_RECRUITED|... you ask if [lyric.heShe] knew who [lyric.heShe] was being sold to. "As I understood it, another tribe of orcs in the northern regions. I don't know their tribe name or anything." ... this is probably a conversation you're going to have with Arona sooner or later. ]You ask Lyric to continue. How did [lyric.heShe] end up in the Glacial Rift? You'd have thought that the first place [lyric.heShe]'d want to go was south, not farther north. At that question, Lyric once again hesitates – although, this time, [lyric.heShe] stares off into the distance rather than get emotional. "I'm... still trying to decide if I want to go back," [lyric.heShe] says. "The raid proved that it wasn't safe to live there. And if I did, I'd have to live with the fact that I was the only one to escape." [lyric.HeShe] opens [lyric.hisHer] mouth to say more, but no more words come out. [lyric.HeShe] stops, casting [lyric.hisHer] eyes downward in solemn thought. [lyric.HisHer] tail lies motionless behind [lyric.himHer]. "So, um, I had heard that there was another... gathering of kobolds somewhere farther north. In a place that they called Undermountain. They had a queen, which, from what I heard, sounded just like how we had a Village Mother. It was underground, where it was hot all year ‘round. And best of all, they had all the gold you could ask for! Gold, the most delicious of all the metals! It honestly sounded too good to be true!" Remembering the Undermountain causes Lyric to get more animated and excited once again; [lyric.hisHer] earlier despondence replaced with excitement and eagerness. "It took me a lot of effort and research, but I found it! I managed to find my way to the Undermountain, and... my word, [pc.name], it was paradise! I was surrounded by kobolds! It was warm as could be! And the gold! The place was lit with the stuff! I could see it gleaming off the walls as soon as I found my way in!" Lyric's body slowly begins to relax, and [lyric.hisHer] smile stays on [lyric.hisHer] face... but it's clear that the elation is short-lived. Lyric was freezing in the snow for a reason, after all. "It was everything I could have wanted," [lyric.heShe] says quietly. "I could have started a new life there. I'd never have to worry about food, or company, or security again." You stay silent. Lyric's face turns downward, and [lyric.heShe] raises a claw to [lyric.hisHer] eye, wiping away a tear. "Turns out... the gold wasn't for eating. I lasted a day before the queen banished me." A few moments pass; Lyric's shoulders shudder and [lyric.heShe] occasionally hiccups and sniffles. When [lyric.heShe] finally looks back up, [lyric.hisHer] eyes are dry, but [lyric.hisHer] cheeks are damp. [lyric.HisHer] cheeks are raised into a forced smile. "You found me in the snow not long after that," [lyric.heShe] says, [lyric.hisHer] voice wavy and unsteady. "So, all's well that ends well, right?" '

rows.original: You ask Lyric about kobolds in general. They aren't an especially common species in this corner of Savarra, and you're sure [lyric.heShe]'d be a valuable resource on everything there is to know about [lyric.himHer] and [lyric.hisHer] scaly kind. "Well, I'll give you the cheat sheet answer first," [lyric.heShe] says with a laugh and a smile. "Do you want to get on a kobold's good side real fast? Give them food and warmth. We're very basic like that. Our favorite snack is metal, particularly gold and electrum. Give us food and a hug and you'll have a friend for life." That explains why [lyric.heShe] was so quick to profess [lyric.hisHer] love to you once you thawed [lyric.himHer] out. "Having scales means we tend to get cold a lot faster than anyone with skin or fur or feathers, so we generally prefer warmer areas and climates to what you'll primarily find in this region, which is why kobolds are so rare here. Myself, I'm from way down south; coming here was the first time I've ever actually seen snow. And, between you and me, I don't see the hype. Can't say I'm a fan." You tell Lyric that it may come as a shock for [lyric.himHer] to hear, but most races, including your own, aren't exactly big fans of colder climates either. "Then why live here?" [lyric.heShe] asks earnestly. Excellent question. But this isn't about you and your kind; you want to learn more about kobolds. [lyric.HeShe] just mentioned that kobolds like to eat metal? "Oh yes! Some types of metal are actually considered to be part of a staple diet for us. We can eat meat and fruit, which are much easier to come by, but you can tell if a kobold's gotten a steady input of the good stuff by the glow of their scales and the shape of their bodies. I think [pc.race]s are the same way, too?" You answer that, in your culture, the saying is that 'abs start in the kitchen.' Eating healthy is as important to a strong, shapely body as proper exercise is. [lyric.electrumRange 0 50 |You ask what a 'well fed' kobold that's been fed a steady diet of 'the good metal' is supposed to be shaped like. "I'll give you three guesses, and the first two don't count," [lyric.heShe] answers with an overly-exaggerated sway of [lyric.hisHer] hips, causing the fat of [lyric.hisHer] thighs to jiggle, sway, and clap together at the apex of each swing. ... interesting to note. |You ask Lyric if eating metal makes every kobold's thighs explode with girth and mass like [lyric.mf |his |hers ] did. "Where I come from, yep," [lyric.heShe] answers, turning around and lifting [lyric.hisHer] tail, giving you an unimpeded look at [lyric.hisHer] fat kobold ass, [lyric.hisHer] tights audibly creaking to contain it all. "Big booties like this baby," [lyric.heShe] says, slapping [lyric.hisHer] right ass cheek for emphasis, "are considered attractive to kobolds from my region, because it means they're well-off and that their mates and children would probably be well-fed, too.[lyric.electrumRange 0 100 | | Send me into a kobold camp or village looking like this, and we'd have a whole harem of little ankle-biters looking to get in on what we have, [pc.name]. ] I dunno if it's the same deal with your northern kobolds, but based on the Undermountain's queen and the bottom she's got, I'm gonna go with a yes." ... something to keep in mind for later. ] For your follow-up question, you ask Lyric what metals are the most delicious and nutritious for kobolds. "Gold. Gold, gold, gold, gold!" Lyric chants, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute and a strand of drool dripping down the corner of [lyric.hisHer] mouth. "Gold is far and away the most delicious, the most nutritious, the most incredible of the metals for us to eat. It's like some kind of do-it-all superfood! Feeling tired and weak? Just eat some gold! Just got a bit of a sweet-tooth? Eat all the gold you want, it's not unhealthy for you! There's nothing it doesn't do and we can survive entirely on gold alone." [lyric.HeShe] pauses, [lyric.hisHer] eyes drifting to one said and [lyric.hisHer] mouth twisting in thought. "Maybe that's why gold is so difficult to come by nowadays. Maybe we mighta, kinda, sorta ate it all." [lyric.HisHer] eyes go back to you. "A distant second is electrum. Still just as nutritious, and plenty tasty all on its own, but it just doesn't have that 'zing' that gold has, you know? There isn't a kobold alive that, if presented with gold and electrum, would choose the electrum." [lyric.HeShe] tilts [lyric.hisHer] head and rests [lyric.hisHer] chin on [lyric.hisHer] hand. "Silver is pretty hit-or-miss depending on things like where it was found, whether it was polished, and on and on. Nickel is [silly |probably a D on the tier list |pretty low-bar ], and at that point, you're probably just hungry for anything. Most 'brown' metals, like copper, are edible but they're strictly a last resort – it'd be like you eating leaves off a tree to survive. And finally, we can't eat alloys like brass and bronze, because they're too tough for us to chew through." Can kobolds eat anything other than metal? "Oh, yes. Metal isn't something you grow on a farm, after all – we'd be in a tough spot if our settlements ran out of metal to eat. As delicious and nutritious as it is, metal isn't actually our primary source of food. We can eat dairy, meat, and fruit just fine, but we can't digest grains and most vegetables, so feeding me bread is a good way to make me die. Well, figuratively. I'd wish I was dead with the stomach ache it'd give me." Well, now you know quite a bit about the dietary habits of a kobold. You want to get a bit into their culture next: what is it that kobolds do all day? They have a reputation for being sneaky thieves outside of their own settlements; you'd like to think they don't just steal from each other to get back all the time. "We're good at sneaking and stealing because the outside world isn't built for us to have an easy life in, not because we like it" [lyric.heShe] says with some disdain. "Just so you know." [lyric.HeShe] takes a deep breath through [lyric.hisHer] nose. "I don't know, I don't think it's too terribly different from what you're used to in your [pc.race] villages and settlements. Most of us are miners looking for metals to add to our stockpiles, but you also have your wet-nurses; your warriors; your occasional carpenters... every settlement has a village mother, but they sometimes go by different-but-the-same titles, like the queen of the Undermountain, and she's always the one in charge." It's always a queen? There's never a king kobold? "Kobolds get larger with every pregnancy they see through," Lyric explains. "But it's a pretty slow process. The village – sorry, the queens are always the largest, the strongest, and, very often, the oldest and most experienced. They're usually the protection and intimidation against raiders, along with our warriors. And in exchange, everyone underneath them does whatever they say." Sounds more like a beehive to you.[pc.hasCock |[lyric.mf | | So... how many pregnancies would she need to have in order to become a queen herself? "Oh... a hundred, maybe? Maybe more?" she answers. And how often can kobolds be pregnant in a year? "Once a month. It takes another month for the egg to hatch, but we're good to go almost as soon as the egg is laid." You ask if she'd like to be a queen someday. "Yeah, sounds like a pretty nice lifestyle to me!" she answers, her eyes wandering and lighting up with fantasies of being waited on hand-and-foot. "All the attention you could ask for; all the food you could want; and everybody does whatever you say? Yeah, sign me up!" How soon would she like to get started? She hesitates at the question. "I don't know. Once I'm done traveling with you?" As soon as the words leave her mouth, she startles herself. "Oh, goodness... I've never thought that far ahead. I don't think I want to stop traveling with you, [pc.name]." Her brow furrows in thought. "So... never, I guess?" What if she could be a queen with you? I like to think I'm being good to you. I mean...." She pauses again, trying to put her thoughts into words. "I guess I'd make a good queen for you. You're already a good queen to me[pc.mf |," she says without a moment's hesitation. " |. ]Maybe nothing would change?" This is more difficult than you expected, so you change subjects. ] ] You ask if they do anything for recreation. "What do you mean?" Like, music, art, poetry? [lyric.HeShe] said that they had carpenters; have they ever built statues or commemorative buildings that served a purpose other than to just be a building? "No, nothing like that," Lyric answers. "We just like to live, is all." That... hardly sounds like living to you. That sounds like surviving. "Right. We just like to survive, is all." You aren't sure how to feel about that.

That explains why [lyric.heShe] was so quick to profess [lyric.hisHer] love to you once you thawed [lyric.himHer] out. "Having scales means we tend to get cold a lot faster than anyone with skin or fur or feathers, so we generally prefer warmer areas and climates to what you'll primarily find in this region, which is why kobolds are so rare here. rows.original: When you two first got acquainted with each other, [lyric.heShe] said that [lyric.heShe] was interested in the 'sciences,' and then [lyric.heShe] started spouting some trivia about science that, honestly, just sounded like magic to you. You ask [lyric.himHer] if [lyric.heShe] could elaborate on what [lyric.heShe] was talking about. "See, the big difference between magic and science is that magic requires a focus of some kind. It could be a gemstone, or something as simple as a tattoo or whatever. A mage could conjure a fireball from between their hands or shoot lightning from their fingertips, but ask yourself: why is it that lightning strikes during a thunderstorm? Why is it that, when nature 'casts' magic, the rules for it are different?" You admit that you had never considered that angle. When something happens in nature that you can't explain and nobody was around to cast a spell, was it a magician that did it? "My fascination with the sciences started when I was much younger: I was playing in a field of grass, and then I touched a metal chunk that I got for my afternoon snack. I got such a shock, I can still feel it!" [lyric.heShe] laughs as [lyric.heShe] wrings [lyric.hisHer] fingers as if [lyric.heShe] was just shocked by something. "I remember asking myself, 'why did that happen?' So, I tried doing everything that I did again, in order to replicate the shock when I touched the knob – and it worked!" "Ever since then, I've had two objectives to my life's mission: the first," [lyric.heShe] says, extending [lyric.hisHer] index finger, "is to learn how, on a more... 'mechanical' level, I guess? I want to learn how magic really works. We know a magician needs a focus, and that magic can take so many different forms, and that all you need to cast a bit of it is a focus and some knowledge on what you're doing. But I want to know how a focus and an understanding of the laws of our universe causes fire to be conjured between our palms, or for a summoner to create a primitive life form out of some rocks or something. Nature can cast lightning from some clouds in the sky, and it doesn't use a focus – if I can understand how it does that, I'll be one step closer to understand how we can do it from our fingertips and a pretty rock." "And the second," [lyric.heShe] says, extending [lyric.hisHer] middle finger, "is to see if there are other methods of magic that we haven't found yet." You ask [lyric.himHer] if [lyric.heShe] has any ideas on what a 'new form of magic' could be. "Not a one!" [lyric.heShe] admits with a cheery laugh. "We already have people that can make golems from nothing with a basic form of sentience and we can already shoot fire, and cold, and lightning from our hands. I have no idea where we could go from here!" [lyric.HisHer] eyes light up, growing larger with excitement. "But that's what makes it so exciting to me, [pc.name]: there's so much that we don't know about the world already. All it would take is a small discovery – like, I don't know, maybe metal can still hold a charge of electricity after a bolt passes through it – and that'd start a snowball of discoveries towards a new, more exciting world." From the sounds of things, [lyric.heShe]'s very excited about this mission of [lyric.mf |his |hers ], and [lyric.heShe]'s really committed to seeing it through. You ask if [lyric.heShe]'s been keeping any notes on [lyric.hisHer] progress – discoveries, ideas, progresses, anything that [lyric.heShe] could reference later, and anything that someone else could reference and continue on from. "Nope!" [lyric.heShe] answers with a wide smile. "I can't read. Everything I know," [lyric.heShe] says, tapping at [lyric.hisHer] skull, "is in here." That's a shame, and [lyric.heShe] should really put [lyric.hisHer] effort into learning. It's a macabre thought, but it'd be a huge loss to the world if something happened to [lyric.himHer] before [lyric.heShe] managed to put [lyric.hisHer] discoveries to parchment. You offer to teach Lyric how to read and write someday. At the suggestion, Lyric's smile shrinks to nothing; [lyric.hisHer] golden eyes get as wide as can be; and [lyric.hisHer] tail starts thumping against the ground at a remarkably fast pace. "I'd love nothing more," [lyric.heShe] says with no small amount of reverence and awe. "Me, learning how to read...?" For someone like Lyric, it makes sense that [lyric.heShe]'d be as excited for it as [lyric.heShe] is. Before you wrap up, you ask Lyric one last question: if [lyric.heShe]'s as focused on the sciences as [lyric.heShe] says [lyric.heShe] is, then what does [lyric.heShe] think of alchemy, a proven school of study for the not-strictly-magical? "Well, the reason why I don't focus on alchemy now is because I'm too deep into my studies to want to switch," [lyric.heShe] answers. "But the reason why I didn't focus on alchemy back then is because, where I come from, all things alchemy wasn't very easy to come by: anything from equipment to reagents was a difficult find. But you know what we did have?" You say nothing, allowing Lyric to answer [lyric.hisHer] surely-rhetorical question for you. "D-do...," [lyric.heShe] stutters, "do... you not know what we had?" Oh, apparently it wasn't rhetorical. You think about it for a moment. "Metal?" you ask tentatively. "Yes!" [lyric.heShe] answers, breathing a sigh of relief that you were smart enough to answer. "It turns out, metal is a pretty good jumping point for getting started on learning the material beginnings to science and magic. 你承认自己之前从未从这个角度思考过这个问题。当自然界中发生一些你无法解释的现象，而且当时也没有任何人在进行魔法施法时，难道真的是有魔法师在背后操纵这一切吗？ 我对科学的兴趣其实早在很小的时候就产生了：那时我正在草地上玩耍，无意中碰到了那块被我当成下午零食的金属块。当时我受到了极大的惊吓，那种感觉至今依然清晰地留在我的记忆中！[lyric.heShe]笑着说[lyric.heShe]拧紧[lyric.hisHer]手指仿佛在动[lyric.heShe]我当时真的被这件事震惊了。我记得自己当时在想：“为什么会发生这种事？”于是，我尝试再次做所有那些事情，就是为了重现当初触摸那个旋钮时所感受到的那种震惊——结果真的成功了！ “而第二点[lyric.heShe]说道，并继续说道[lyric.hisHer]竖中指，其实是为了看看是否还有其他我们尚未发现的魔法手段。[lyric.himHer]如果[lyric.heShe]对于“新的魔法形式”会是什么样，你有什么想法吗？ “没错！[lyric.heShe]答案就在这里，”他松了一口气，心想你果然够聪明，能够想出这个答案。“事实上，金属是了解科学和魔法的基本原理的一个很好的切入点。而我们手头也有大量的金属——任何没有被用来制作食物的金属都可以用来研究。所以，我就从手头现有的这些金属开始研究。” 这对你来说确实很容易理解。

rows.original: You broach to Lyric that it isn't really a secret to you, to [lyric.himHer], or to anyone, that [lyric.hisHer] opinion of you is... rather high. "Of course! Why wouldn't it be?" [lyric.heShe] asks with absolute sincerity. [lyric.HeShe] smiles at you with narrowed eyes, raised cheeks, and a rosy smile – the kind of smile a lover gives to tell another that they feel like they're home. [lyric.HisHer] tail gently sways back and forth, the tip lightly dusting the ground behind [lyric.himHer] with every swish. As nice as it is to have such an adoring fan in [lyric.himHer], it's almost as if [lyric.heShe]'s basing [lyric.hisHer] whole personality and reason for being with you on yourself. Isn't there more to [lyric.hisHer] life than just clinging to you and being at your every beck and call? Lyric's face visibly contorts as [lyric.heShe] tries to process the question. "Are you trying to say that you'd rather I leave?" [lyric.heShe] asks, [lyric.hisHer] voice wilting in pain from the thought. You answer that, no, that's not what you want – if you want [lyric.himHer] to leave, you'll say it outright. But you also don't appreciate that [lyric.heShe] just tried to deflect the question. You decide to try and rephrase it, to hopefully get a more expedient answer out of [lyric.himHer]: why is it that [lyric.heShe] is with you? "I mean...." Lyric wraps [lyric.hisHer] tail around [lyric.hisHer] waist, bringing it up for [lyric.himHer] to hold onto and clutch closer to [lyric.hisHer] chest. "I like being with you. You saved me from the ice of the Glacial Rift and you did it by putting me in your bed and sharing your warmth with me. Do I need a better reason than that?" Perhaps not, but if [lyric.heShe] doesn't have one, then it almost sounds like [lyric.heShe]'s your pet, rather than your friend and ally. "That doesn't sound so bad to me," [lyric.heShe] answers with all honesty. "If that's what you'd rather call me, I'm all for it. I'll do whatever it takes to stay with you, [pc.name]." You tell Lyric to think about what it is [lyric.heShe]'s saying. Pets aren't really known for their autonomy and freedom. And, if you're honest, you aren't certain how willing you are to have someone as both a pet and a lover – roleplay is one thing, but Lyric lives in your backpack, eats your food, does what you say, and is willing to forgo [lyric.hisHer] own autonomy to have that all. If you had to clean up after [lyric.himHer], there truly wouldn't be a difference between [lyric.himHer] and a common house pet. "I guess that just doesn't sound so weird to me, is all," [lyric.heShe] answers with an earnest shrug. "We kobolds tend to live in hierarchical societies, [pc.name]. Where I came from, we had a village mother, and the Undermountain has a queen. Answering to and obeying the whims and commands of someone above us is just... a thing in our culture. It's not about 'autonomy;' if we were someplace warmer, I could probably survive on my own. But I'd rather be with you." You crook your head to one side in thought. Were you overthinking this? Lyric's implying that it's not about being something of a lost puppy that clings to the first thing that shows it affection, and that it's just the culture of how kobolds function. Is that what this is? Culture shock? "Kobolds... we're not exactly the most imposing of creatures, you know," [lyric.heShe] says with a bit of a laugh. "We get by on numbers, mostly. And when there's an alpha that we can cling to – usually a female that's gotten larger through repeated breeding – we tend to crowd and gather around them. You're my alpha, [pc.name], and you and I make two, which is more than if I went on my own. It just makes more sense to stay with you. At least, to me, it does." "And besides, on top of us not being very scary, we're also very simple," [lyric.heShe] laughs again. "The best way to have a kobold as your friend for life is to feed them and keep them warm and safe. If you hadn't already saved my life, then I would have left if I thought the food was going to run out[pc.hasCredits 400 |. And luckily, we're not going to have to worry about that either for some time ]." [pc.corruptionRange 0 66 | |Lyric's innocence-bordering-naivety towards the subject brings you to a rare moment of clarity, and you ask [lyric.himHer] what [lyric.hisHer] opinion is on... some of the more radical ideas you've had and the options you've taken. You know you aren't exactly a pious person. Not everything you've done is what a normal person would call 'good.' Would [lyric.heShe] really be okay with staying with someone like you? At that, Lyric hesitates, wondering to [lyric.himHer]self if [lyric.heShe] should be totally honest with both you and [lyric.himHer]self. "Honestly," [lyric.heShe] stammers, "I'd... rather that you didn't do and say some of the things that you do. But in the end, that's not what matters to me. It... might be selfish to say, but you're a good person to me, [pc.name], and you haven't given me a reason to think otherwise." "And besides," [lyric.heShe] says, smiling sweetly at you, "the fact that you asked means that you aren't as bad a person as you think you are. If my opinion didn't matter to you, you wouldn't have asked." [flags.LYRIC_HERO_WORSH|Maybe that's true. But being told that again and again is only going to stroke your humility so much.|Maybe [lyric.heShe]'s right about that. Maybe some part of you can still be redeemed.] ]... you're still not comfortable with calling [lyric.himHer] your pet, though. As accurate as it might be. It's one thing to roleplay, but if you're going to maintain the relationship that you have – where you fuck [lyric.himHer] and you throw [lyric.himHer] at your enemies during combat[var0| and you feed [lyric.himHer] electrum so [lyric.heShe] gets a fatter ass] – you don't want to think of Lyric as your literal pet, of all things. "Then don't," [lyric.heShe] answers plainly. "Just think of me as Lyric." You can do that. "And if it'll make you feel better," [lyric.heShe] continues, "I won't think of you as my village mother. I'll just think of you as [pc.name]." [pc.mf |Yes, you would really rather prefer it if Lyric did not call you [lyric.hisHer] mother. That would be great. |... perhaps it's a little late to suggest that [lyric.heShe] call you [lyric.hisHer] queen. ]

rows.raw: " You broach to Lyric that it isn't really a secret to you, to [lyric.himHer], or to anyone, that [lyric.hisHer] opinion of you is... rather high. "Of course! Why wouldn't it be?" [lyric.heShe] asks with absolute sincerity. [lyric.HeShe] smiles at you with narrowed eyes, raised cheeks, and a rosy smile – the kind of smile a lover gives to tell another that they feel like they're home. [lyric.HisHer] tail gently sways back and forth, the tip lightly dusting the ground behind [lyric.himHer] with every swish. As nice as it is to have such an adoring fan in [lyric.himHer], it's almost as if [lyric.heShe]'s basing [lyric.hisHer] whole personality and reason for being with you on yourself. Isn't there more to [lyric.hisHer] life than just clinging to you and being at your every beck and call? Lyric's face visibly contorts as [lyric.heShe] tries to process the question. "Are you trying to say that you'd rather I leave?" [lyric.heShe] asks, [lyric.hisHer] voice wilting in pain from the thought. You answer that, no, that's not what you want – if you want [lyric.himHer] to leave, you'll say it outright. But you also don't appreciate that [lyric.heShe] just tried to deflect the question. You decide to try and rephrase it, to hopefully get a more expedient answer out of [lyric.himHer]: why is it that [lyric.heShe] is with you? "I mean...." Lyric wraps [lyric.hisHer] tail around [lyric.hisHer] waist, bringing it up for [lyric.himHer] to hold onto and clutch closer to [lyric.hisHer] chest. "I like being with you. You saved me from the ice of the Glacial Rift and you did it by putting me in your bed and sharing your warmth with me. Do I need a better reason than that?" Perhaps not, but if [lyric.heShe] doesn't have one, then it almost sounds like [lyric.heShe]'s your pet, rather than your friend and ally. "That doesn't sound so bad to me," [lyric.heShe] answers with all honesty. "If that's what you'd rather call me, I'm all for it. I'll do whatever it takes to stay with you, [pc.name]." You tell Lyric to think about what it is [lyric.heShe]'s saying. Pets aren't really known for their autonomy and freedom. And, if you're honest, you aren't certain how willing you are to have someone as both a pet and a lover – roleplay is one thing, but Lyric lives in your backpack, eats your food, does what you say, and is willing to forgo [lyric.hisHer] own autonomy to have that all. If you had to clean up after [lyric.himHer], there truly wouldn't be a difference between [lyric.himHer] and a common house pet. "I guess that just doesn't sound so weird to me, is all," [lyric.heShe] answers with an earnest shrug. "We kobolds tend to live in hierarchical societies, [pc.name]. Where I came from, we had a village mother, and the Undermountain has a queen. Answering to and obeying the whims and commands of someone above us is just... a thing in our culture. It's not about 'autonomy;' if we were someplace warmer, I could probably survive on my own. But I'd rather be with you." You crook your head to one side in thought. Were you overthinking this? Lyric's implying that it's not about being something of a lost puppy that clings to the first thing that shows it affection, and that it's just the culture of how kobolds function. Is that what this is? Culture shock? "Kobolds... we're not exactly the most imposing of creatures, you know," [lyric.heShe] says with a bit of a laugh. "We get by on numbers, mostly. And when there's an alpha that we can cling to – usually a female that's gotten larger through repeated breeding – we tend to crowd and gather around them. You're my alpha, [pc.name], and you and I make two, which is more than if I went on my own. It just makes more sense to stay with you. At least, to me, it does." "And besides, on top of us not being very scary, we're also very simple," [lyric.heShe] laughs again. "The best way to have a kobold as your friend for life is to feed them and keep them warm and safe. If you hadn't already saved my life, then I would have left if I thought the food was going to run out[pc.hasCredits 400 |. And luckily, we're not going to have to worry about that either for some time ]." [pc.corruptionRange 0 66 | |Lyric's innocence-bordering-naivety towards the subject brings you to a rare moment of clarity, and you ask [lyric.himHer] what [lyric.hisHer] opinion is on... some of the more radical ideas you've had and the options you've taken. You know you aren't exactly a pious person. Not everything you've done is what a normal person would call 'good.' Would [lyric.heShe] really be okay with staying with someone like you? At that, Lyric hesitates, wondering to [lyric.himHer]self if [lyric.heShe] should be totally honest with both you and [lyric.himHer]self. "Honestly," [lyric.heShe] stammers, "I'd... rather that you didn't do and say some of the things that you do. But in the end, that's not what matters to me. It... might be selfish to say, but you're a good person to me, [pc.name], and you haven't given me a reason to think otherwise." "And besides," [lyric.heShe] says, smiling sweetly at you, "the fact that you asked means that you aren't as bad a person as you think you are. If my opinion didn't matter to you, you wouldn't have asked." [flags.LYRIC_HERO_WORSH|Maybe that's true. But being told that again and again is only going to stroke your humility so much.|Maybe [lyric.heShe]'s right about that. Maybe some part of you can still be redeemed.] ]... you're still not comfortable with calling [lyric.himHer] your pet, though. As accurate as it might be. It's one thing to roleplay, but if you're going to maintain the relationship that you have – where you fuck [lyric.himHer] and you throw [lyric.himHer] at your enemies during combat[var0| and you feed [lyric.himHer] electrum so [lyric.heShe] gets a fatter ass] – you don't want to think of Lyric as your literal pet, of all things. "Then don't," [lyric.heShe] answers plainly. "Just think of me as Lyric." You can do that. "And if it'll make you feel better," [lyric.heShe] continues, "I won't think of you as my village mother. I'll just think of you as [pc.name]." [pc.mf |Yes, you would really rather prefer it if Lyric did not call you [lyric.hisHer] mother. That would be great. |... perhaps it's a little late to suggest that [lyric.heShe] call you [lyric.hisHer] queen. ] "

rows.original: You slow your stride before coming to a full stop. Your body feels different. You can't really describe it all that well; it feels like your center of gravity is a bit off, and that a part of you drags downward with every other step you take. It doesn't feel bad, but your balance being off is perhaps not the best affliction to have when you're expected to engage in combat from time to time. Hopefully you're just coming down with something, and a quick rest ought to set you straight. But a part of your mind instinctually knows that this isn't going to go away anytime soon....

rows.translation: 你将手掌平放在腹部，轻轻揉搓着。你的身体感觉比以前更加结实了，这种感觉并非源于肌肉的增长，而更像是……仿佛你穿上了一件护胸甲，只不过它穿在你皮肤的里面，而不是外面。你的肚子比几天前大了，之前那种沉重的感觉也变得更加明显了。 你怀孕了。从这种像“套着护甲”的感觉来看，你很可能怀着一颗卵。而在你开始出现这些变化的那段时间里，唯一和你做过爱、并且靠产卵繁殖的生物就是…… [var0 |到目前为止，莉里克在为人父母这件事上表现得比你预想的更加成熟稳重，但即便如此，你还是觉得应该再等一阵子再和[lyric.himHer]谈这件事。免得[lyric.heShe]因为你在孕期这么早就怀上一颗新的、更脆弱的卵而担心。 |……莉里克就算在状态最好的时候也相当……容易激动。也许你该过一阵子再和[lyric.himHer]谈这件事。好给自己点时间，想想该怎么向[lyric.himHer]开口。 ]
rows.raw: " You rest the flat of your palm against your stomach, and you give it a rub. Your body feels tougher than before, and not in the sense that you've built up some musculature: more in the sense that... it's like you're wearing a chestplate, but on the inside of your skin, rather than the outside. Your stomach is larger than it was a few days ago, and that bounding weight from before has only gotten worse. You're pregnant. And judging from the 'suit of armor' feeling, you're probably carrying an egg. And the only creature that you've had sex with that reproduces via eggs around the time you started feeling these changes is.... [var0 |Lyric has so far proven to be rather more mature and collected than you had expected about parenthood, but all the same, you feel like you should put off talking to [lyric.himHer] about it for a little while longer. Just so [lyric.heShe] doesn't fret about you carrying a new, more fragile egg this early in the pregnancy. |... Lyric is rather... excitable at the best of times. Maybe you'll put off talking to [lyric.himHer] about it for a little bit. To give yourself some time to figure out how to break it to [lyric.himHer]. ] "
