You aren't sure if you've ever eaten the kind of food you have a craving for... but you have noticed that you've been putting your electrum in between your teeth whenever you're bored and need something for your hands to do. [var0 |[var1 |Lyric is usually rather excitable when it comes to you and things involving you, but when it comes to parenting, [lyric.heShe] tends to take on a more mature, serious, and considerate demeanor. Which you appreciate – you knew after you first met Lyric that kobolds could be a handful[lyric.isTall|, to say nothing of the fact that [lyric.heShe]'s a big, tall dragon now], and you didn't need the parent of your kid to be just as energetic as the child. [lyric.isTall |With a deep sigh, you call Lyric to you. Within seconds, your dragon is jogging up to you, bounding on [lyric.hisHer] feet like [lyric.heShe]'s lighter than air |You set down your pack and you call Lyric out. Within seconds, you see [lyric.hisHer] scaly finger poke through the opening to your pack, followed by the rest of [lyric.hisHer] hand and wrist ]. Once the opening is wide enough to pass over [lyric.hisHer] shoulders, [lyric.heShe] leaps out, planting both [lyric.hisHer] feet on the ground in front of you. "Yes, hello, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] says, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute. [lyric.HisHer] large, bright golden eyes are locked onto yours. "How can I help you?" You tell [lyric.himHer] that you're pregnant. Again. Lyric's eyes stay wide, quickly flitting back and forth between your belly and your eyes, and [lyric.hisHer] smile slowly shrinks. "Yes, it's yours," you say. At the news, Lyric steps into your personal space and wraps [lyric.hisHer] arms around your body, hugging you tightly to [lyric.himHer]self. For a moment, [lyric.heShe] doesn't say anything; [lyric.heShe] just hugs you, [lyric.hisHer] cheek against [lyric.isTall |[pc.heightRange 0 93 98 |the top of your head |your cheek |your shoulder ], [lyric.hisHer] hand feeling along your belly for the egg within you |your belly, feeling for the egg underneath your clothes ]. "How far along are you?" "About a month," you answer. "So, another month to go," [lyric.heShe] says. "You'll let me know if you need anything, right?" You get [lyric.himHer] to relax by saying that yes, of course, if you need anything, the first person you'd be going to is your egg's [lyric.mf |father |mother ]. Lyric might not be the most help when it comes to getting you the succulent foods that you want... but, well, in a few days, there's going to be a certain other need that'll need satisfying, and your [lyric.isTall|dragon|kobold] will be right there to help you out with it. [lyric.HisHer] tail beats roughly and loudly against the ground with how quickly [lyric.heShe]'s wagging it. "Oh my gosh, congratulations!" [lyric.heShe] says, rushing forward to wrap [lyric.hisHer] arms around your [lyric.isTall |shoulders |waist ]. ……你在回答之前犹豫了一下。[lyric.himHer]那就是[lyric.hisHers]突然间，莱瑞克的欢乐戛然而止，[lyric.heShe]离你只有几步之遥。[lyric.HisHer]眼睛仍然睁得大大的，但是[lyric.hisHer]笑容消失了，取而代之的是一种更为严肃、深思的神情。“哦，[lyric.heShe]说：“是啊……时机把握得差不多。如果是我来做，也会这么安排。[lyric.HeShe]向前迈出一步，[lyric.hisHer]用手触碰自己的腹部，感受它的存在。[pc.upperGarment]我应该更认真地对待这件事。” “对，很可能是金属。[lyric.heShe]哈哈，你的性欲是不是突然高涨了？” “还没有……至少现在还没有。那种感觉会有多强烈呢？” “强烈到足以让人注意到了。不过也没关系。”莉里克又一次走进了你的私人空间。[lyric.hisHer]再次将脸颊贴在肚子上。“就是这样的[lyric.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ]莉里克就在这里。 ]你产生了这种渴望，但性欲却没有随之增加，所以我觉得你目前还处于孕育过程的中间阶段。狗头人的妊娠期通常约为两个月，而卵子孵化可能还需要另外两年的时间。 [lyric.isTall|再说一次，我们两个人都不是狗头人。|你可不是什么狗头人。]所以这些数字可能会有些偏差，但……大致就是我的估算结果。 还有一个月的时间。这个时间长度听起来还不算太糟，尤其是与之前需要的时间相比的话。[pc.race]怀孕通常会持续一段时间。你是否应该担心孩子的安全问题？是否应该减少争吵之类的行为呢？ “减少争吵对你的健康总体来说是有益的。[pc.name]，” [lyric.heShe]笑着说：“不过，目前来说，我并不认为我们的‘宝宝’处于任何危险之中。这个时候，卵壳应该已经完全形成了，所以……嗯，我们可以认为这个蛋应该是安全的，就这样吧。” 好吧，那么接下来再有半个月的时间，你得把一个狗头人的蛋放在肚子里带着到处走……应该没什么问题吧。 现在，要是你能找到一些生肉该多好啊。 ] |下次有机会的时候，你得提醒自己一定要去和莉里克聊聊。[lyric.HeShe]应该是在炼金术士的商店里，就是你上次离开的地方。[lyric.himHer]与此同时……你现在真的应该去吃点生肉了。 ]

Within seconds, you see [lyric.hisHer] scaly finger poke through the opening to your pack, followed by the rest of [lyric.hisHer] hand and wrist. Once the opening is wide enough to pass over [lyric.hisHer] shoulders, [lyric.heShe] leaps out, planting both [lyric.hisHer] feet on the ground in front of you. ] "Yes, hello, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] says, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute. [lyric.HisHer] large, bright golden eyes are locked onto yours. "How can I help you?" There's no real way to sugarcoat what you're about to say to [lyric.himHer]. You tell Lyric that you're pregnant. At that, [lyric.hisHer] smile grows wider, wide enough to feel like they're about to overtake [lyric.hisHer] whole face. [lyric.HisHer] tail beats roughly and loudly against the ground with how quickly [lyric.heShe]'s wagging it. "Oh my gosh, congratulations!" [lyric.heShe] says, rushing forward to wrap [lyric.hisHer] arms around your [lyric.isTall |shoulders |waist ]. [lyric.HisHer] cheek rests against [lyric.isTall |[pc.heightRange 0 93 98 |the top of your head |your cheek |your shoulder ] |your stomach ], and [lyric.heShe] nuzzles against it, [lyric.isTall |rubbing the flat of [lyric.hisHer] palm against your belly to feel for the baby |feeling the egg's hard shell through your skin ]. "Do you know who's it is?" ... You hesitate before telling [lyric.himHer] that it's [lyric.hisHers]. All at once, Lyric's merriment comes to a halt, and [lyric.heShe] steps away from you. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are still wide, but [lyric.hisHer] smile is gone, replaced with something a bit more serious and contemplative. "Oh," [lyric.heShe] says. "Yeah... the timing is about right. It'd make sense if it were me." [lyric.HeShe] steps forward, [lyric.hisHer] hand reaching for your stomach and feeling it through your [pc.upperGarment]. "I should take this more seriously." You tell [lyric.himHer] that [lyric.heShe]'s more knowledgeable on [lyric.isTall|dragon|kobold] pregnancies than you are. What should you expect? "Do you have cravings for fruit and meat?" You answer that, yes, actually, you were just thinking of eating something juicy and succulent before you called [lyric.himHer] out. And... maybe metal? You have another craving you can't quite place. "Yeah, it's probably metal," [lyric.heShe] laughs. "Has your libido spiked?" Not... yet. How intense is that going to be? "Intense enough. But that's okay." Lyric steps into your personal space again, [lyric.hisHer] cheek resting against your stomach once more. "That's what [lyric.mf |papa |momma ] Lyric is here for." [lyric.HeShe] stays like that against your body for a few moments longer. "[lyric.isTall |So, good news, and... well, I don't want to call it ‘bad' news, but... less good news," [lyric.heShe] starts. "The less good news is that... I'm not strictly a kobold anymore. I know about kobold pregnancies, but not dragon pregnancies. So there might be some hiccups in my knowledge, on when things start and end." And what's the good news? "The good news is that you're experiencing the same, uh, symptoms, I guess, of a kobold pregnancy," [lyric.heShe] answers. "So... odds are good that it's going to be another kobold. Or maybe kobolds and dragons just share the same symptoms and timings. We won't know until you've laid the egg." And... how long is that going to take from now? " ]You've gotten the cravings, but not the libido, so I'd say you're about halfway done incubating. Kobold pregnancies usually last about two months, and it takes maybe another two for the egg to hatch. [lyric.isTall|Again, neither of us are kobolds|You're not a kobold], so the numbers might be skewed a little bit, but... that's about my estimate." Another month to go. That doesn't sound so bad, especially compared to how long [pc.race] pregnancies usually last. Should you be worried about the safety of the kid? Should you be fighting less or something? "Fighting less is good for your health in general, [pc.name]," [lyric.heShe] laughs. "But, no, at this point, I wouldn't say our baby is in any particular danger. The eggshell would be fully formed by now, so, well... let's just say that the egg ought to be safe and leave it at that." Okay. So just another half a month of lugging around a kobold egg inside your belly. That's easy. Now, if only you could find yourself some raw meat. ] |You'll have to remind yourself to talk to Lyric when you next get the chance. [lyric.HeShe] ought to be at the Alchemist's shop, where you last left [lyric.himHer]. In the meantime... you could really go for some raw meat right about now. ] '

rows.original: Holy shit, you're horny. You feel like you could [pc.hasCock |fuck a hole through a tree |crush a rock to dust with your thighs ]. This change practically happened overnight; just yesterday, you weren't nearly this... needful, and now, here you are, in desperate need of some kind of outlet. You're caught between wondering what kind of purpose it could serve – maybe it's to help keep your body loose and ready to pass an egg through you? – and keeping your eyes peeled for the nearest body with a pulse that can help you with this little issue. Is this what kobold women have to go through with every pregnancy they have? [var0 |Luckily for you, your baby's [lyric.mf |daddy |mommy ] is [lyric.isTall|within striking distance|sitting in your pack] right now, completely oblivious at the state you're in. rows.original:
Your stride is interrupted by a surge inside your body, followed by a rough, sudden contraction around your waistline that persists for longer than you think it should. The egg is ready, and you're about to lay it!
    
    [atFH
        |Thankfully, with the help of [party.solo
            |some kind inn patrons
            |your friends
        ], you manage to make your way back up to your room so that you can get this thing out of you in its relative peace and privacy
        |You're not in Hawkethorne, and the wilds of Savarra are not a place to birth a child. Thanks to your sheer, indomitable motherly willpower[party.solo
            |
            |; your companions, [party.compNames]
        ], and a bit of waystone magic, you manage to make it back to town just in time
    ].
    
    [var0
        |[party.solo
            |That is – you don't have anyone with you other than Lyric, the sire to your child
            |And, on top of [party.compNames] being with you, you have Lyric, the sire to your child, as well
        ]. As soon as you [lyric.isTall
            |urgently call [lyric.hisHer] name
            |(rather unceremoniously) drop your sack to the hard [atFH
                |floor
                |ground
            ]
        ], [lyric.heShe] seems to know exactly what's going on, and [lyric.heShe], like the good [lyric.mf
            |father
            |mother
        ] [lyric.heShe] ought to be, is with you through it all, holding your hand and reminding you to take long, deep breaths.
    ]

    Somewhat surprisingly, the egg is rather easy to pass: [lyric.isTall|despite Lyric's new draconic nature, you're still laying an egg befitting a kobold, not a dragon. Kobolds|kobolds] are smaller than most races, and the egg's smooth surface makes passing it through your body a seamless procedure. You're still giving birth, of course, and it's not the easiest or least painful thing you've ever done, but once you get past the width of the shell, the rest of it comes out of you without any additional difficulty.

    [var0
        |Lyric, meanwhile dotes over you the entire time: [lyric.heShe] keeps your focus on [lyric.himHer] and [lyric.heShe] helps to remind you to keep breathing through the whole ordeal. When the egg finally comes out of you, [lyric.heShe] scoops it up, wipes it down, and brings it to you. There isn't a lot to see beyond its white, solid, smooth texture, but, there it is – it's the egg you had been carrying inside you the last month, and there it'll be for a month more.
        |You spend the next few moments recovering. Your breathing is fast and deep and your limbs keep shaking from the exertion. [party.solo
            |It takes you another few moments to gather the strength to pick up (and wipe down) the egg, and there isn't much of it to look at, beyond its pale-white, smooth surface. But it's yours. Your child is in there. And you'll finally get a good look at them after two more months.
            |[comp1.name] is quick to scoop up and wipe down the egg for you while you gather your strength, and when you're presented with the egg, you... well, you don't know what you expected.         ]
    ]
    
    You just laid an egg. That's enough adventuring for one day.

            |[comp1.name]在你恢复体力的时候，它会迅速帮你把鸡蛋捡起来并擦干净。当你拿到鸡蛋时，你会……嗯，你其实并不知道自己原本期待着什么。这个鸡蛋看起来并没有什么特别之处——它只是个颜色呈淡白色、表面光滑的鸡蛋罢了。但它属于你，你的孩子就在里面。再过两个月，你终于可以好好看看他们了。

    你刚刚“下了一个蛋”而已。一天内的冒险活动就到此为止吧。

rows.original: You take the day off, resting in the Frost Hound. You spent the remainder of the day in your room, lounging with both Lyric and your egg in your arms; eventually, you pass out, and when you come to the next morning, you find that the egg is missing, but Lyric is not. In fact, [lyric.heShe]'s wide awake, resting [lyric.hisHer] chin on your [pc.chest], watching you sleep, and as soon as your eyes open, [lyric.hisHer] tail begins to swish, shaking the whole bed and messing up your covers as it goes. "Hi," [lyric.heShe] says light-heartedly. [lyric.HisHer] pupils slowly dilate. "How did you sleep? Are you okay?" You answer that you're about as okay as you could hope to be, considering you laid a [lyric.isTall|dragon|kobold] egg just yesterday. Lyric's tail swings and swishes so hard back and forth that [lyric.heShe]'s shaking [lyric.hisHer] whole body with the motion. You ask [lyric.himHer] where the egg is; you distinctly remember falling asleep with it and [lyric.himHer] in your arms. "That wolf lady took it," Lyric answers. [var0 |Oh, Gwyn? "Yes, Gwyn! The wolf lady with the real big... um, bushy tail. She took it again. She did a real good job last time, so I just kinda trusted her when she came in and offered to take it." Well, that's good to know, that Gwyn is looking after your egg again. |... You ask [lyric.himHer] to elaborate. "Tall? Got a real long, bushy tail? Oh, she had some real big boobies, too. Said something about running a nursery nearby?" Oh, that'd be Gwyn. "Yes, thank you! I forgot her name." Gwyn came into the room while you were asleep, and Lyric just... let her take the egg? Not that you don't trust Gwyn, but.... "I checked to make sure they were being honest first, of course!" [lyric.heShe] pouts. "We have nurseries in the south jungles too, you know. Although they're not the same. Kinda not even a little bit. But we have them! And that Gwyn lady, she seemed like a good matron, and she knew you, so I figured it'd be okay." Well... it was, at least. It's good to know that Gwyn is taking care of your egg. ] It'll be another two months before your egg hatches and you get to see your kobold child for real. In the meantime, you have a duty to get back to.
rows.translation: 你休息了一天，留在霜犬酒馆静养。当天剩余的时间里，你一直待在房间，怀中同时抱着莉里克和你的蛋，悠闲地躺着；最后，你沉沉睡去，等到第二天早晨醒来时，发现蛋已经不见了，莉里克却还在。事实上，[lyric.heShe]早已完全清醒，正把[lyric.hisHer]下巴搁在你的[pc.chest]上，看着你熟睡；你的眼睛刚一睁开，[lyric.hisHer]尾巴便开始来回摆动，把整张床摇得晃个不停，连被褥也弄得乱七八糟。 “嗨，”[lyric.heShe]轻快地说道。[lyric.HisHer]瞳孔缓缓放大。“睡得怎么样？你还好吗？” 你回答说，考虑到自己昨天才刚生下一枚[lyric.isTall|龙|狗头人]蛋，现在已经好得不能再好了。 莉里克的尾巴用力来回甩动，甚至带得[lyric.heShe]整个[lyric.hisHer]身体都跟着摇晃。你问[lyric.himHer]蛋去了哪里；你清楚记得，入睡时自己把蛋和[lyric.himHer]都抱在怀中。 “那个狼女把它拿走了，”莉里克回答道。 [var0 |哦，是格温吗？ “对，就是格温！那个尾巴非常……呃，非常蓬松的狼女。她又把蛋带走了。上次她照顾得特别好，所以她进来提出要带走它时，我也就直接相信她了。” 很好，看来格温又在替你照料这枚蛋。 |……你请[lyric.himHer]说得详细一点。 “个子很高？有一条又长又蓬松的尾巴？哦，她还有一对特别大的胸部。好像还说过什么在附近经营育儿室？” 哦，那就是格温。 “对，谢谢！我忘了她的名字。” 格温在你睡着时走进房间，而莉里克就这么……任由她把蛋带走了？倒不是说你不信任格温，不过…… “我当然先确认过她说的是实话！”[lyric.heShe]撅起嘴。“你知道吗，南方丛林里也有育儿室。虽然和这里的不一样。甚至可以说几乎没有一点相似。但我们确实有！而且格温女士看起来是个很称职的保育员，又认识你，所以我觉得应该没问题。” 嗯……至少确实没问题。知道格温正在照料你的蛋，也算是件好事。 ] 再过两个月，你的蛋才会孵化，到时你才能真正见到自己的狗头人孩子。在那之前，你还得回去履行自己的职责。
rows.raw: ' You take the day off, resting in the Frost Hound. You spent the remainder of the day in your room, lounging with both Lyric and your egg in your arms; eventually, you pass out, and when you come to the next morning, you find that the egg is missing, but Lyric is not. "Hi," [lyric.heShe] says light-heartedly. [lyric.HisHer] pupils slowly dilate. "How did you sleep? Are you okay?" You answer that you're about as okay as you could hope to be, considering you laid a [lyric.isTall|dragon|kobold] egg just yesterday. Lyric's tail swings and swishes so hard back and forth that [lyric.heShe]'s shaking [lyric.hisHer] whole body with the motion. [lyric.HeShe] closes [lyric.hisHer] eyes and takes a deep breath, in through [lyric.hisHer] nose and out through [lyric.hisHer] mouth. "I'm pregnant," [lyric.heShe] eventually says. This isn't the time to get excitable, after all – and when it is, you're sure Lyric will be excited enough for the both of you. "That's," Lyric says haltingly. Later in the hour, you hear a gentle knock on the door, and you invite whoever's out there inside. The door swings open, and there stands Gwyn, peering into the room from the door frame.
        
        "I heard all of the excitement downstairs," she says with a warm, gentle smile. "It seems everything worked out in the end for you two."
        
        Lyric is still fast asleep in your arms[lyric.isTall|, naked and under the covers], and even in [lyric.hisHer] sleep, [lyric.heShe]'s gently clutching the egg close to [lyric.hisHer] chest. You say that, yes, it looks like it.
        
        [var0
            |"Should I go ahead and assume you'd like to speak with Lyric before I take this one into my care, too?"
            
            You tell her that, yes, that's a conversation you'd like to have with Lyric again. You can't imagine that [lyric.heShe]'ll say no, but still, you don't want [lyric.himHer] to wake up and realize that the egg is missing.
            
            "I understand completely," Gwyn says, reaching for the handle of the door as she steps out of the room. "Let me know what you two decide when [lyric.heShe] wakes up."
            
            You tell her that you appreciate it as she gently shuts the door.
            |"The nursery can incubate eggs for you, you know," she continues. "I'd imagine you'd rather not carry around an egg while you're out in the field. I can look after it like it's one of my own, if you'd like."
            
            While you tell her that you'd prefer that, you also don't want to say yes or no without Lyric being awake for it.             You tell her that you appreciate it as she gently shuts the door.
        ]

[lyric.HeShe]'s mumbling something underneath [lyric.hisHer] breath – something sonorous and rhythmic, but you can't make out the words. A lullaby from where [lyric.heShe] comes from, maybe?
        
        You give [lyric.himHer] a gentle squeeze, letting [lyric.himHer] know that you're awake. "Oh, [pc.name]," [lyric.heShe] says, turning [lyric.hisHer] head to see you over [lyric.hisHer] shoulder. "Sleep well?"
        
        "About as well as I could ask for," you answer.
        
        Lyric leans into you and takes a deep sigh through [lyric.hisHer] nose. "I'm glad."
        
        You two enjoy each other's company for a moment longer with your egg. You and your [lyric.isTall|dragon|kobold] family, right here, just enjoying each other.
        
        [var0

            You take that to mean that Lyric is still okay with her looking after your egg.
            
            "Yes, sorry," [lyric.heShe] answers. "Our egg would be much safer here than out there. And it's not like we won't be able to visit whenever we want!"
            |Eventually, you tell [lyric.himHer] that Gwyn had visited, and that she had offered to take the egg into her care while you and [lyric.himHer] continued on your quest. Gwyn runs a nursery in Hawkethorne and her reputation is beyond repute.

[lyric.HeShe] isn't difficult to find; [lyric.heShe]'s tucked [lyric.himHer]self into a corner of the shop, away from where all the sellable wares are, sitting at a desk that is maybe too large for [lyric.hisHer] body, but too small for the amount of projects [lyric.heShe]'s got lined up for [lyric.himHer]self. Thick parchments lie scattered around the desk and the floor, each of them filled with anything from blueprints for machines and devices that you don't recognize, to mathematical equations and other scribbling, to hand-written notes on various different topics and subjects. Scattered around with the parchments are hand-crafted measurement tools that help [lyric.himHer] with whatever [lyric.heShe]'s trying to figure out. [var0 |[var1 |As soon as Lyric sees you, however, it's as if none of that exists, and the only thing suddenly on Lyric's mind is you. "Oh, hello, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] says, standing upright and at attention for you. [lyric.HisHer] golden eyes grow into large discs, and [lyric.hisHer] tail begins rapidly wagging back and forth behind [lyric.himHer]self. [lyric.HisHer] stomach is noticeably distended inside [lyric.hisHer] tunic – it looks like [lyric.heShe]'s been, uh, eating well since you last visited. "Actually, I'm pregnant!" [lyric.heShe] chirps happily. "And it's yours! Surprise!" ... That explains that, too. "Yeah! I've been lugging around this hefty boy for over a month, now. Living here in Hawkethorne is great! I never have to worry about predators or slavers or whatever while I'm pregnant. You'd be surprised just how far a little peace of mind can take a [lyric.mf |guy |girl ] in [lyric.hisHer] studies and research!" Well, it's good to hear that [lyric.heShe]'s well looked after, here in Hawkethorne, while [lyric.heShe]'s expecting. You ask [lyric.himHer] if there's anything you can do for [lyric.himHer] to help with her baby. At the question, Lyric's whole demeanor changes suddenly. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are wide open, with [lyric.hisHer] black pupils dilated, and the smile vanishes from [lyric.hisHer] mouth. "Do you have any raw meat?" [lyric.heShe] asks. Um... not on you, no. "Damn," [lyric.heShe] says under her breath. "I've been craving raw meat for a while now." And, just like that, [lyric.hisHer] demeanor switches back to what it was before. "Oh well, I'll survive, I'm sure! How can I help you today?" ] |As soon as Lyric sees you, however, it's as if none of that exists, and the only thing suddenly on Lyric's mind is you. "Oh, hello, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] says, standing upright and at attention for you. [lyric.HisHer] golden eyes grow into large discs, and [lyric.hisHer] tail begins rapidly wagging back and forth behind [lyric.himHer]self. "It's good to see you again! How can I help you today?" ] [flags.LYRIC_EGG_PEND |As soon as Lyric sees you, however, it's as if none of that exists, and the only thing suddenly on Lyric's mind is you. The paunch of Lyric's swollen belly is noticeably absent. "Oh, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] chirps, coming straight to you. "The egg! The egg that I had, the one that you put in me! I laid it! It's in the nursery! That nice wolf lady with the big boobies offered to help me out!" Whoa, okay, that's a lot of information to be taking in so quickly. Lyric was pregnant; then, since you last saw [lyric.himHer], [lyric.heShe] had laid it; then, shortly after that, Gwyn, the wolf lady running Hawkethorne's nursery, took the egg to look after for you both. Is that all correct? "Yep!" [lyric.heShe] answers, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute behind [lyric.himHer]self with enough energy to swing [lyric.hisHer] entire ass. [pc.isDK |Well. Glad it all worked out, then. |You feel like you should have been there, to help Lyric with laying the egg. But, like... the baby isn't born yet. All you two have is an egg right now, not a baby. Maybe it's not as big of a deal as you think it is. ] "So, what can I do for you today, [pc.name]?" [lyric.heShe] asks. ]
rows.translation: 你决定联系莉里克，看看情况如何。[lyric.heShe]正在做的事情。 [lyric.HeShe]很容易就能找到。[lyric.heShe]被收了起来[lyric.himHer]把自己挤到了商店的一个角落里，远离所有可供销售的商品，坐在一张可能有点太大的桌子旁。[lyric.hisHer]虽然空间足够，但相对于所要开展的项目数量来说，还是太小了。[lyric.heShe]已经安排好了[lyric.himHer]桌子和地板上散落着厚厚的羊皮纸，每一张纸上都写满了各种各样的内容：有你根本看不懂的机器和设备的设计图，有数学方程式和其他杂七杂八的笔记，还有涉及各种不同主题的手写资料。在这些羊皮纸的周围，还散放着一些手工制作的测量工具，这些工具显然也是用来辅助研究的。[lyric.himHer]无论以什么方式[lyric.heShe]正在试图弄清楚这件事。 [var0 |[var1 |然而，当莉里克看到你的那一刻，仿佛所有那些事情都不存在了，她脑海中唯一浮现的念头就是你。“哦，你好[pc.name]！" [lyric.heShe]站得笔直，认真地为你说道。[lyric.HisHer]金色的眼睛逐渐变成了巨大的圆盘状，而[lyric.hisHer]尾巴开始快速地来回摆动。[lyric.himHer]自我。[lyric.HisHer]腹部明显出现了胀大的现象。[lyric.hisHer]束腰外衣——看起来就是这样的。[lyric.heShe]自从你上次来访之后，它的饮食状况一直都很好。” “其实，我怀孕了！[lyric.heShe]开心地叽叽叫着。‘而且这是你的了！惊喜吧！’” ……原来如此。 “太好了！这个大家伙已经跟着我一个多月了。现在住在鹰棘镇真是太棒了！怀孕期间，我再也不用担心会有捕食者或者奴隶贩子之类的东西来打扰我。你可能会惊讶于，拥有这样的平静环境，真的能让一个人走多远啊[lyric.mf |伙计 |女孩 ]在[lyric.hisHer]里面进行研究与探索！” 嗯，听到这个消息真是太好了。[lyric.heShe]在鹰棘镇，这里的一切都得到了精心的照料与维护。[lyric.heShe]正在等待中。你问吧。[lyric.himHer]如果你能做些什么来帮助的话[lyric.himHer]为了帮助她照顾宝宝。 当听到这个问题时，莉里克的整个态度突然发生了变化。[lyric.HisHer]眼睛大睁着，满脸惊愕。[lyric.hisHer]黑眼圈变得明显，脸上的笑容也消失了。[lyric.hisHer]你们有生肉吗？[lyric.heShe]嗯……不是让你来的，不是的。” “该死。[lyric.heShe]小声说道：“我已经有段时间特别想吃生肉了。”就这样，[lyric.hisHer]举止又恢复到了之前的样子。“好吧，我肯定能挺过去的！今天有什么可以帮到您的吗？ ] |然而，当莉里克看到你的那一刻，仿佛所有那些事情都不存在了，她脑海中唯一浮现的念头就是你。“哦，你好[pc.name]！" [lyric.heShe]站得笔直，认真地为你说道。[lyric.HisHer]金色的眼睛逐渐变成了巨大的圆盘状，而[lyric.hisHer]尾巴迅速地开始来回摆动。[lyric.himHer]很高兴再次见到你！今天有什么可以帮到你的吗？ ] [flags.LYRIC_EGG_PEND |然而，当莉里克看到你时，仿佛所有那些事情都不存在了，她脑海中唯一浮现的念头就是你。莉里克那凸出的腹部也仿佛消失得无影无踪。“哦，[pc.name]！" [lyric.heShe]啾啾声，直接传到了你的耳边：“那个蛋！就是你放在我体内的那个蛋！是我自己下的蛋！它现在在育婴室里！那个胸部很大的漂亮狼女士还主动提出要帮我呢！” 哇，好吧，这么多信息一下子涌入脑海确实有点让人难以消化。莉里克怀孕了；那么，自从你上次见到她之后[lyric.himHer]， [lyric.heShe]就是这么回事；不久之后，负责照看鹰棘镇育儿室的格温把那个蛋拿去帮你们保管了。这样讲对吗？” “没错！[lyric.heShe]答案，[lyric.hisHer]兴奋得尾巴都快摇到屁股后面了[lyric.himHer]拥有足够的精力去尽情享受生活[lyric.hisHer]整个屁股。 [pc.isDK |嗯，很高兴一切都顺利解决了。 |你觉得自己本应该在那里，帮助莉里克把蛋产下来。但是，嗯……那个宝宝其实还没出生呢。出生然而，现在你们俩拥有的只是一个蛋，而不是一个婴儿。也许这件事并没有你们想象中那么严重。 ] 那么，今天我能为您做些什么呢？[pc.name]？" [lyric.heShe]询问。 ]

rows.original: Bring Lyric with you on your journey. On [lyric.hisHer] own suggestion, you can throw [lyric.himHer] at your enemies to do damage – there's always room on your team for someone who can throw their weight around like that!
rows.translation: 在你的旅程中，让莉里克陪伴你吧。出发吧。[lyric.hisHer]根据我的建议，你可以把它扔掉。[lyric.himHer]让你的敌人受到伤害吧——在你的团队中，总是需要这样有能力的人来发挥作用啊！
rows.raw: "Bring Lyric with you on your journey. On [lyric.hisHer] own suggestion, you can throw [lyric.himHer] at your enemies to do damage – there's always room on your team for someone who can throw their weight around like that!"

rows.original: Lyric would travel in your pack rather than alongside you in your journey, and, as such, you need space in your inventory to carry [lyric.himHer] around with.
rows.translation: 莉里克会放在你的背包里，而不是陪伴你一起踏上旅程。因此，你的背包中需要预留空间来存放它。[lyric.himHer]处理中。
rows.raw: "Lyric would travel in your pack rather than alongside you in your journey, and, as such, you need space in your inventory to carry [lyric.himHer] around with."

rows.translation: 离开

rows.original: You tell Lyric that you've reconsidered [lyric.hisHer] offer, and that you have some empty space in your pack that's about [lyric.hisHer] shape and size that could use filling. Lyric gasps, long and deep, as [lyric.hisHer] entire face completely lights up. [lyric.HisHer] eyes grow as wide as dinner plates, with [lyric.hisHer] dilated pupils pushing aside [lyric.hisHer] golden irises until they're thin as string; [lyric.hisHer] mouth breaks into a wide, slack-jawed smile; and [lyric.hisHer] tail wags hard enough to beat against the floor of the alchemy shop behind [lyric.himHer]self. "Yes, yes, a hundred times, a thousand times, yes!" Lyric says. "I'd love nothing more than to be with you, [pc.name]! Yes, please, I'm ready right now, let's go right now!" As soon as you set down your pack and you pull open the pinch point, Lyric dives in, head-first; [lyric.heShe] is small enough to easily fit into the pack, and with a bit of room to spare. "Let's go!" Lyric says, thrusting [lyric.hisHer] arm up and out of the pinch point with [lyric.hisHer] thumb pointed upward. "Anywhere you are, I want to be, [pc.name]. I'll be with you for as long as you'll have me, 'till the ends of the earth!" You can appreciate that kind of enthusiasm.
rows.translation: 你告诉莉里克，自己重新考虑了[lyric.hisHer]提议；背包里恰好还有一块空地方，形状和大小都与[lyric.hisHer]相仿，正需要有人填进去。 莉里克深深倒吸一口长气，[lyric.hisHer]整张脸都彻底亮了起来。[lyric.HisHer]眼睛睁得像餐盘一样大；[lyric.hisHer]扩张的瞳孔把[lyric.hisHer]金色虹膜挤得细若丝线；[lyric.hisHer]嘴巴张成一个松弛而灿烂的笑容；[lyric.hisHer]尾巴更是用力摇摆，拍得[lyric.himHer]身后炼金商店的地板砰砰作响。 “愿意，愿意，一百个愿意，一千个愿意！”莉里克说道。“没有什么比和你在一起更令我开心了，[pc.name]！拜托，我现在就准备好了，我们马上走吧！” 你刚放下背包、拉开束口，莉里克便一头钻了进去；[lyric.heShe]身材足够娇小，能轻松装进背包，甚至还留有一点空间。 “出发吧！”莉里克说道，将[lyric.hisHer]一条手臂从束口高高伸出，[lyric.hisHer]拇指直指上方。“只要你在那里，我就想去那里，[pc.name]。只要你还愿意收留我，我就会一直陪着你，直到世界尽头！” 你很欣赏这份热情。

rows.original:
You enter the Hawkethorne nursery.
    
    "Hey, [pc.name], it's about time you got here!" says Gwyn, greeting you with a warm smile. "That egg from before – it's hatched! You've got yourself a brand new little kobold running around my nursery!"
    
    [lyric.around
        ||That's big news, and it wouldn't do for the child to be born without both of its parents there to greet it! You [party.solo
            |run out of the nursery and across the street to Ivris' alchemy shop, where you know Lyric is, and you bring [lyric.himHer] right back to the nursery
            |get [comp1.name] to run to Ivris' alchemy shop as quickly as they can and bring Lyric back; and, within the minute, Lyric is by your side, ready for the egg to hatch with you.
        ]
    ]
    
    It isn't difficult to find the new kobold: it's the smallest, scaliest kobold in the nursery, after all. It has dark, jungle-green scales all along its body, but its pocked with splotches of yellow, everywhere from its chest and stomach, to dotted randomly across its back and face and limbs. It being a jungle kobold, you can't tell at a glance what sex it is.
    
    "It's a [var0
        |boy
        |girl
    ]!" [lyric.heShe] shouts gleefully. That answers that, at least. "Ooh, [pc.name], [var0|he's|she's] beautiful, look at [var0
        |him
        |her
    ]!"
    
    Lyric can hardly contain [lyric.himHer]self; [lyric.heShe] snatches up your baby kobold, holding [var0
        |him
        |her
    ] close to [lyric.hisHer] chest and purring [lyric.hisHer] proud [lyric.mf
        |dad
        |mom
    ] lungs out. [lyric.HeShe] snuggles [lyric.hisHer] face up to your baby's, nuzzling their snouts together.
    
    "What should we name [var0
        |him
        |her
    ]?" [lyric.heShe] asks you, [lyric.hisHer] eyes wide as saucers and [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute. "I was thinking... maybe [var1]. What do you think? Is that a good name?"
    
    You're... too caught up in the moment to think about what might be a good name for your new kobold baby. You instead acquiesce and agree that [var1] is a good name for [var0
        |him
        |her
    ].
    
    You and Lyric spend the next few minutes playing with your new spawn, but only for a few minutes: the combined energy of both [var0
        |his
        |her
    ] parents is more than the little tyke can keep up with, and pretty soon, all [var1] wants to do is curl up into a disc and fall asleep.
    
    You and Lyric stay together for a moment longer: you wrap yourself around Lyric, holding [lyric.himHer] close, and Lyric holds your new baby [var1] close to [lyric.himHer]. You and your kobold family.
    
    "[var1] will be safe here, right?" Lyric asks softly. You aren't sure if the question is directed to you, or to Gwyn, or if it's meant to be answered at all. But you do: you tell [lyric.himHer] that Hawkethorne is the safest place you know, and that Gwyn would protect [var1] like she would her own family.
    
    It's enough to placate Lyric, and [lyric.heShe] relaxes in your arms. Your kobold child squirms and adjusts in [lyric.hisHer] embrace, before [var0
        |he
        |she
    ], too, calms down and relaxes. After all, [var0
        |he
        |she
    ] just had a much bigger day than either of you two.
    
    "Good," Lyric sighs.
rows.translation:
你走进了鹰棘镇苗圃。

“嘿，[pc.name]，你终于来了！”格温微笑着迎接你，“之前你给的那个蛋，已经孵化了！现在你有一个全新的小狗头人在我家里到处跑了哦！
    
    [lyric.around
        ||这可真是件大喜事，孩子出生时，父母都应该在场迎接它才对啊！你说是不是？ [party.solo
            |你跑出婴儿房，穿过街道，来到艾薇莉丝的炼金术商店——你知道莉里克就在那里，于是你走了过去。[lyric.himHer]直接回到婴儿房去
            |获得[comp1.name]他们必须尽快跑到艾薇莉丝的炼金术商店，把莉里克带回来；不到一分钟，莉里克就会出现在你身边，与你一起等待那个蛋孵化。
        ]
    ]
    
    找到这只新的狗头人并不难：毕竟，它是育婴室里最小、鳞片也最密集的那只狗头人。它的身体覆盖着深绿色的鳞片，但胸部、腹部以及背部、面部和四肢上还散布着黄色的斑点。由于它属于丛林狗头人，因此一眼是无法分辨它的性别的。

“就是它。 [var0
        |男孩
        |女孩
    ]！" [lyric.heShe]们高兴地欢呼起来。至少，这就说明了一切。“哦，[pc.name]， [var0|他是|她是]太美了，快看！ [var0

        |他
        |她
    ]接近[lyric.hisHer]胸腔震动，发出呼噜声[lyric.hisHer]自豪的[lyric.mf

Something that huge and heavy can't be easy to lug around. "I have learned a total of one-thousand-two-hundred-fifty-one ways to not create the potion that I'm searching for. Of those, it has been one-hundred-ninety-five since you and I first met, [pc.name]." She reaches up to brush a strand of hair from her eyes. She's exhausted, but you can tell from her body language and the smile on her face that she enjoys your company enough to take a break from all the science. "It's a reductive process," she continues. "I know of nearly two-thousand ways to fail... which means I am two-thousand steps closer to succeeding." She can't help but giggle to herself slightly, but the laugh quickly turns into exasperation. "I just wish 'success' would hurry it up a little, you know?" Last time you were here, she mentioned that the 'adrenaline' from your first encounter made her venom have a thicker, more potent consistency, and that– "Um," Jyrranaz interrupts, pointing to something behind you. "Is your pack supposed to be doing that?"
rows.translation: 走进吉拉娜兹的书房时，你把背包放到入口旁的地板上。这里依然如你记忆中那般杂乱而繁忙：桌面和地板散落着纸张，蒸馏器里则盛着颜色各异、翻腾冒泡的液体。这位黄蜂族甚至没有注意到你进来，直到背包落地的动静惊得她浑身一颤。 “啊，[pc.name]，原来只是你。”她松了口气，双肩也再次放松下来。“欢迎再次来到我的书房。” 出于好奇，你问她打算怎样整理这些笔记。记录着详尽内容的纸张散落得到处都是，吉拉娜兹当然也知道这一点，可她从未费心收拾，更别说将它们放回原处了。 她嗤了一声，继续照料一只小瓶；她将它从自制的喷灯上拿下来，隔着透明玻璃检查里面液体的稠度。“计划？你是说算法之类的东西？”她不屑地问道。“我随时都知道每样东西在哪里，[pc.name]。反正我待在这间书房里也不做别的事。”她头也不回地敲了敲自己的太阳穴。“况且，全都记在这里了。” 你想这倒也说得通，不过没有把对她生活方式是否健康的评价说出口。你知道她有多么重视自己的工作；再说，要是更健康、更积极的生活方式能让她产出品质更高的毒液，供她用于实验，她恐怕早就开始锻炼了。 顺着这个话题，你问起她个人研究的进展——那种能把任何黄蜂族变成女王的药剂。她有没有取得什么突破？ “很遗憾，没有。”她嘟囔着把小瓶放回原位，又吹灭喷灯。她转身面对你时，动作缓慢且略显吃力，还得小心维持膨大腹部的平衡，免得它从脊柱上晃落下来。如此庞大沉重的东西，带着四处走动肯定并不轻松。“为了不做出我要找的那种药剂，我总共学会了一千二百五十一种方法。其中有一百九十五种，是从你我初次见面之后才发现的，[pc.name]。” 她抬手将一缕头发拨离眼前。她已经精疲力竭，但从肢体动作和脸上的笑容便能看出，她很享受你的陪伴，甚至愿意为你暂时放下全部科学研究。“这是个不断排除错误的过程，”她继续说道，“我已经知道将近两千种失败的方法……这也意味着，我离成功又近了两千步。”她忍不住轻笑一声，可笑声很快便化作烦躁的叹息。“我只是希望‘成功’能稍微快一点到来，你懂吧？” 上次来这里时，她提到你们第一次相遇所带来的“肾上腺素”，让她的毒液变得更加浓稠、更加强效，而且—— “呃，”吉拉娜兹打断你，指向你身后的某样东西，“你的背包本来就会那样吗？”
rows.raw: ' You set your pack onto the floor beside the entrance to Jyrranaz's study as you enter it. The place is as disheveled and busy as you remember it, with papers strewn all about the desks and floor and alembics filled with different colors of bubbling liquids. The vesparan herself doesn't even notice you enter until you set your pack down, which makes her jump in surprise. "Ah, [pc.name], it's just you," she says as she lets out a sigh. Her shoulders untense once more. "Welcome to my study once again." Out of curiosity, you ask her what her sorting plans are for her notes. Highly-detailed papers are strewn all over the place, and surely Jyrranaz knows that, but she's never made the effort to clean any of it up or put them back into place. She snorts as she tends to one vial, lifting it off a homemade burner to inspect the consistency within the clear glass. "Plans? Like algorithms?" she asks derisively. "I know where everything is at all times, [pc.name]. It's not like I do anything else in this study." Without turning to face you, she taps on the side of her head. "It's all up here, anyway." You suppose that's fair, although you keep back any comments about how healthy her lifestyle might be. You know how important her work is to her, and, well, if having a healthier, more active lifestyle led to higher-grade venom for her to perform her experiments with, she probably would have gotten to it earlier than this. To that end, you ask her if she's made any progress in her personal journey, in creating a brew that could turn any vesparan into a queen. Has she had any breakthroughs? "Unfortunately not," she grumbles, setting the vial back into place and blowing the burner out. When she turns to face you, it's with a slow, somewhat strained motion as she maintains careful balance of her engorged thorax, to keep it from bounding off her spine. Something that huge and heavy can't be easy to lug around. "I have learned a total of one-thousand-two-hundred-fifty-one ways to not create the potion that I'm searching for. Of those, it has been one-hundred-ninety-five since you and I first met, [pc.name]." She reaches up to brush a strand of hair from her eyes. She's exhausted, but you can tell from her body language and the smile on her face that she enjoys your company enough to take a break from all the science. "It's a reductive process," she continues. "I know of nearly two-thousand ways to fail... which means I am two-thousand steps closer to succeeding." She can't help but giggle to herself slightly, but the laugh quickly turns into exasperation. "I just wish 'success' would hurry it up a little, you know?" Last time you were here, she mentioned that the 'adrenaline' from your first encounter made her venom have a thicker, more potent consistency, and that– "Um," Jyrranaz interrupts, pointing to something behind you. "Is your pack supposed to be doing that?" '

rows.original: Glancing over your shoulder to see what it is she's pointing at, the pack you had set on the floor beside the entrance to her study has started to shift and jostle, its fabric bending out of place as if something inside was pushing against it. Soon, a green, scaly, clawed finger pokes up from the mouth of the bag's opening, widening the gap before the rest of the hand, then the forearm, comes out. "Oh, that's just [pc.isDK |my pet kobold |Lyric ]," you say to Jyrranaz. It takes [lyric.himHer] a bit of effort and time to open the bag wide enough to poke [lyric.hisHer] head from the opening, but when [lyric.heShe] does, [lyric.hisHer] eyes quickly go wide with wonder and excitement at the sight of Jyrranaz's study. "Oh my goodness," [lyric.heShe] says underneath [lyric.hisHer] breath as [lyric.heShe] takes in the sights of the laboratory. "Oh my goodness!" [lyric.heShe] says again, getting more and more excited, fighting with the fabric of your pack to break out and explore the room more thoroughly. "I didn't know you had a[pc.isDK |... pet, you said? A pet kobold? | kobold in your pack. ]" Jyrranaz regards Lyric with a combination of curiosity and amusement as [lyric.heShe] eventually tumbles out of your pack. "Is that a thing you adventuring types normally do? Never leave your home without your kobold?" [pc.isDK |That very much depends on what the kobold's purpose is. |You tell Jyrranaz the short version: you rescued this one from freezing to death, and ever since, [lyric.heShe]'s been attached to you. Not at the hip, or anything – you could tell [lyric.himHer] to stay at Hawkethorne, where it's safe, if you wanted – but [lyric.heShe]'s proven [lyric.himHer]self valuable in your travels, so, [lyric.heShe] gets to stay. ] Once Lyric is out of your pack, [lyric.heShe] picks up one of the strewn pieces of paper, giving it a read. [lyric.HisHer] eyes widen as [lyric.heShe] absorbs the information and notes on the page, devouring everything it has to offer before placing it exactly where [lyric.heShe] found it and starting again with another. "Whoa," [lyric.heShe] gasps, marveling at all the detailed diagrams and all the associated notes. [lyric.HisHer] pupils dilate to nearly the size of [lyric.hisHer] whole eyeball as [lyric.heShe] takes it all in. "Hey! Uh," Jyrranaz starts, making Lyric jump, then hesitates before turning to you. "What's its name?" Lyric. And 'it' is a [lyric.himHer]. "Hey, Lyric!" Jyrranaz calls out, making Lyric jump. "Careful with those, that's important stuff on that paper!" Lyric looks up at Jyrranaz, then down to the paper, giving it another quick skim. "Did you author these?" [lyric.heShe] asks, almost breathlessly, as if [lyric.heShe] had just met [lyric.hisHer] hero. Or, well, [lyric.hisHer] second-favorite hero, anyway. "Yes, I did," Jyrranaz responds, "and it's important that everything stays exactly where they are. I can't afford to spend the time sorting through all of it just because [pc.name]'s [pc.isDK |pet ]kobold got a little handsy." Lyric, as instructed, carefully sets the second piece of paper down, exactly where [lyric.heShe] left it, and approaches you and Jyrranaz with a bright smile, unfazed by being talked down to like that. "Hi," [lyric.heShe] says, parking [lyric.himHer]self next to you, but within arm's reach of Jyrranaz. [lyric.HeShe] extends [lyric.hisHer] right hand in greeting. "Let's start over and do this right. My name's Lyric." Jyrranaz tilts her head as she accepts the handshake. "You're awfully well-spoken for a kobold," she remarks. "I haven't encountered many, but from the few that I have, I got the impression that Savarran wasn't their first language." "Probably because it wasn't," Lyric answers. "And you thought that applies to all kobolds?" Jyrranaz blushes, flustered at herself. "Well–" "It's okay, I'm used to it," Lyric laughs. "But look, that's all beside the point. You're a chemist!" [lyric.heShe] exclaims, spreading [lyric.hisHer] arms and pivoting [lyric.hisHer] head around the room, taking in all the sights – the books, the notes, the shelves stocked with ingredients, each of them kept in containers, sorted between raw and processed first, then alphabetically second. "It's such a rare sight to see anyone else interested in them at all! I was starting to think that Ivris and I were the only ones in the world that gave half a dang! Everyone else is all ‘magic this' and ‘cantrips that'; it's exciting to finally meet someone else that's put as much time and focus into the sciences like you have!" Throughout all of Lyric's excited chittering, Jyrranaz regards [lyric.himHer] with an amused, but easygoing expression. "You?" she asks with a lower tone, bordering on condescension. "A chemist? I didn't know kobolds could even read." "Oh, I can't. Never learned how. Nobody in my clan could. We live in jungles and huts – well, actually, I lived in the jungle before, uh, things beyond my control happened. Kobolds here in the Marches all live in holes in the ground. Jungles and caves aren't the best places for studying!" Lyric laughs, then continues [lyric.hisHer] spiel without even taking a breath in between sentences. "I'm not a magician, unfortunately. I admit, if I could use magic at all, I'd probably be way more interested in that. I can breathe fire, but that's biology – and it takes a bit of maybe-unhealthy dietary changes. If I could throw fireballs from my palms, I'd be all about figuring out how to do it the most efficiently. Science is the next best thing!" Jyrranaz's mouth twists as she listens to Lyric ramble on about [lyric.hisHer] interests. Her earlier snarky expression, looking more like she was a parent entertaining a child's incessant ramblings and make-believe stories, softens into something more amicable. "You say you're interested in the sciences, but you can't read?" "Oh, make no mistake!" [lyric.heShe] chitters excitedly, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging behind [lyric.electrumRange 0 200 |[lyric.himHer]self |[lyric.hisHer] substantial ass with enough force to wag [lyric.hisHer] hips ]. [lyric.HeShe] raps all four fingers on [lyric.hisHer] right hand against [lyric.hisHer] head. "Everything I ever learned, I kept up here. I have my own system for mnemonics and memorization that don't need ink and paper." After an awkward pause, [lyric.heShe] giggles. "Although, I'll admit, it would help, sometimes." Jyrranaz hums as she crosses her arms, regarding the excited kobold between you and her. "Alright. I'll play along." She turns her head and eyes the strewn stacks of paper beside her, searching their contents; after a moment, she picks one from the pile and reads it over to herself before continuing her conversation. "What happens when you mix sulfur with iron fillings and then heat them together?" "You get iron sulfide," Lyric answers quickly, taking Jyrranaz by surprise. "That's a basic one, but, well, you need to know the basics before you get to the good stuff! Iron sulfide is a good starting point in making things like tools and dyes. It can also be polished and is very pretty, which makes it a popular choice for some decorations. And," [lyric.heShe] continues, holding up a hand between you and [lyric.hisHer] mouth, as if [lyric.heShe] was trying to share a secret just between [lyric.himHer] and Jyrranaz, "it tastes delicious." Jyrranaz tilts her head and crooks her mouth in thought. Going by her body language, she's been caught off-guard from Lyric's readiness to answer her question, and, if you had to guess from how she's not immediately refuting [lyric.himHer], [lyric.heShe] got the correct answer. "One more," Jyrranaz says, undaunted. "Using chemistry, how can you get the rust off, say, an iron sword?" Lyric scratches at [lyric.hisHer] chin. "Well, it'd be kind of tough, depending on the size of the sword. You'd need a big ol' burner and, like, a cauldron or something to sit it in. But you'd use calcium carbonate – which is usually in limestone, seashells, marble if you can find it, stuff like that. And it wouldn't, like, destroy the rust; it'd turn it into slag, which is easy to remove... but not as tasty." You're not a chemist. You have people like Ivris and Lyric do all the hard thinking, and any alchemy that you do is mixing ingredients together to get results that other people have already gotten. But, you say, this all sounds like... trivia, really, and not actual, applicable science. Well, except the de-rusting stuff. You could think of a practical application for that. "It can sound like that from the outside looking in," Jyrranaz admits. "Fine, I'll give you one more, Lyric, and this one is a bit more related to what I'm doing here." Lyric's tail wags incessantly behind [lyric.himHer]self. "Yes, of course, ask away!" "What happens when you mix sodium chloride with ethanol?" Lyric's tail stops wagging, but [lyric.hisHer] scaly brow crooks diagonally. "Ooh, you're trying to trick me," [lyric.heShe] says, holding up [lyric.hisHer] finger and wagging it back and forth at Jyrranaz, as if scolding her for doing something naughty. "Salt doesn't dissolve in ethanol, but even 'pure' ethanol still has a water content of roughly four-parts-per-hundred. It would react with that itty-bitty water content rather than the alcohol." Finally, Jyrranaz's unsure body posture changes and relaxes, and a small smile creeps across her face. "You're a fascinating little kobold," she says. "I'm sorry for doubting you." "Oh, it's fine!" Lyric's tail starts wagging once more. "I'm used to people doubting me for one reason or another. It's fun talking with someone that likes what I like! Like [pc.name]. I like talking about [pc.name] to whoever will listen." Jyrranaz's eyes go from [lyric.hisHers] to yours. "That's cute," she says. "Sort of reminds me of me when [pc.name] and I first met." "Oh! Did [pc.heShe] rescue you from mortal peril, too? [pc.HeShe] is really good at that!" "Something like that."
rows.translation: 你回头一看，发现她所指的方向正是你放在她书房入口旁的那个包。那个包开始移动、摇晃，包布也变形了，仿佛里面有什么东西在用力推挤。不久，一只绿色的、长满鳞片、带着爪子的手指从包口探了出来，它逐渐把包口撑开，接着整个手掌和前臂也陆续露出了外面。 “哦，原来是这样[pc.isDK |我的宠物狗头人 |莉里克 ]你说，”你对吉拉娜兹说道。 这需要一些时间。[lyric.himHer]需要花一些时间和精力把袋子撑开，才能把东西拿出来。[lyric.hisHer]一开始进展顺利，但后来却[lyric.heShe]是的。[lyric.hisHer]看到吉拉娜兹的书房，她的眼睛立刻因惊奇和兴奋而睁得大大的。“天啊，”她说道。[lyric.heShe]在下方写着[lyric.hisHer]随着呼吸[lyric.heShe]将实验室内的景象尽收眼底。“天啊！[lyric.heShe]又说道，肌肉度越来越兴奋，拼命挣扎着想要挣脱背包的束缚，以便能够更彻底地探索这个房间。 “我之前都不知道你还有这个[pc.isDK |……宠物？你是说一只宠物狗头人吗？ | 你的背包里有一只狗头人。 ]吉拉娜兹看待莉里克时，心中既有好奇，也带着一丝乐趣。[lyric.heShe]最终，它还是从你的背包里掉了出来。“冒险家平时都是这么做的吗？出门的时候从来不带上你的小狗头人伙伴吗？ [pc.isDK |这很大程度上取决于那些狗头人的目的究竟是什么。 |你只需要告诉吉拉娜兹简单版本的事情：你救了这个家伙，让他免于冻死，从那以后[lyric.heShe]被附着在了你身上。并不是紧贴在你的腰间，也不是以其他任何方式固定的——你能感觉到它的存在。[lyric.himHer]如果你愿意的话，也可以待在鹰棘镇那里，那里很安全——但是[lyric.heShe]事实已经证明[lyric.himHer]在您的旅途中，这些东西会派上大用的，所以[lyric.heShe]可以留下来。 ] 一旦莉里克从你的背包中取出，[lyric.heShe]捡起其中一张散落的纸条，读了起来。[lyric.HisHer]眼睛瞪得大大的[lyric.heShe]吸收页面上的信息与内容，彻底消化其中所有有用的信息，然后将其准确地放置在该位置上。[lyric.heShe]找到了它，然后又开始使用另一个了。“哇哦，[lyric.heShe]人们不禁惊叹于那些详尽的图表以及所有相关的注释。[lyric.HisHer]瞳孔几乎扩张到占满[lyric.hisHer]整个眼球，[lyric.heShe]目不转睛地看着这一切。“嘿！嗯，”吉拉娜兹开口道，这一下让莉里克吓了一跳，然后他犹豫了一下才转向你：“它叫什么名字？” 莉里克。而“它”，其实就是[lyric.himHer]嘿，莉里克！”吉兰纳兹喊道，把莉里克吓了一跳。“小心那些，纸上的东西可很重要！” 莉里克抬头看了看吉兰纳兹，然后又低头看了看那张纸，快速地扫了一眼。“这些都是你写的吗？[lyric.heShe]几乎喘不过气来地问道，仿佛[lyric.heShe]刚刚相识[lyric.hisHer]英雄。或者说，嗯[lyric.hisHer]至少，那是我第二喜欢的英雄。 “是的，我这么做了，”吉拉娜兹回答道，“而且确保一切保持原样非常重要。正是如此那些东西就在它们应该在的地方。我可没有时间去一一整理它们，仅仅因为[pc.name]的[pc.isDK |宠物 ]那个狗头人有点太冒失了……” 按照指示，莉里克小心翼翼地将第二张纸放在了指定的位置。[lyric.heShe]放下手里的东西，面带灿烂的笑容走向你和吉拉娜兹，完全不在意别人那样居高临下地与他说话。“嗨，[lyric.heShe]上面写着：“停车”。[lyric.himHer]你就在自己身边，而吉拉娜兹也在触手可及的范围之内。[lyric.HeShe]扩展[lyric.hisHer]伸出手来握手，说道：“让我们重新开始，把这件事做好。我叫莉里克。” 吉兰娜兹歪了歪头，握住了她的手，说道：“对于一个狗头人来说，你的说话方式真是太优雅了。我遇到的狗头人并不多，但从那些有限的接触中，我感觉到萨瓦兰语并不是他们的母语。可能是因为它并不是这样的吧，”莱瑞克回答道，“而你以为这种情况适用于所有的狗头人吗？” 吉兰纳兹的脸颊顿时涨红了，她有些尴尬：“嗯……” “没关系，我已经习惯了，”莱瑞克笑着说，“不过，这些其实都跟主题无关了。你可真是个化学家啊！[lyric.heShe]惊呼着，四散奔逃[lyric.hisHer]武装并准备行动[lyric.hisHer]环顾房间，观察着周围的一切——那些书籍、笔记，还有摆满各种食材的架子，所有这些食材都被整齐地收纳在容器中，首先按照原材料和加工过的食材进行分类，然后再按字母顺序排列。“真难得见到还有其他人对这些东西感兴趣！我开始觉得，世界上可能只有我和艾薇莉丝真正投入了这么多时间和精力去研究这些科学领域。其他人都在谈论什么“魔法”和“法术”，能遇到你这样同样投入如此多精力的人，真是太令人兴奋了！在莉瑞克兴奋地叽叽喳喳说个不停的过程中，吉拉纳兹始终保持着专注的目光。[lyric.himHer]带着一丝兴味却随和的表情说道：“你？”她压低了声音，几乎带着一丝居高临下的意味，“一个化学家？我以前都不知道狗头人居然还会读书。” “哦，我不会啊。从来没学过。我们族里也没人会。我们生活在丛林里，住在简陋的小屋里——嗯，其实也就是这样。我以前在丛林里生活过，嗯，那时候发生了一些我无法控制的事情。这里的狗头人们都住在地洞里。丛林和洞穴确实不是最适合学习的场所啊！”莱瑞克笑了笑，然后继续说道。[lyric.hisHer]一口气说了这么多话，甚至没有停下来喘息。“不幸的是，我并不是魔术师。我得承认，如果我真的会魔法的话，我可能会对它产生更大的兴趣。我确实能喷火，但那只是生物学的现象——而且还需要改变一些可能不太健康的饮食习惯。如果我能从手掌中抛出火球，我肯定会想尽办法来提高这种能力的效率。科学，才是仅次于魔法的最好的东西！” Soon, a green, scaly, clawed finger pokes up from the mouth of the bag's opening, widening the gap before the rest of the hand, then the forearm, comes out. "Oh, that's just [pc.isDK |my pet kobold |Lyric ]," you say to Jyrranaz. It takes [lyric.himHer] a bit of effort and time to open the bag wide enough to poke [lyric.hisHer] head from the opening, but when [lyric.heShe] does, [lyric.hisHer] eyes quickly go wide with wonder and excitement at the sight of Jyrranaz's study. "Oh my goodness," [lyric.heShe] says underneath [lyric.hisHer] breath as [lyric.heShe] takes in the sights of the laboratory. "Oh my goodness!" [lyric.heShe] says again, getting more and more excited, fighting with the fabric of your pack to break out and explore the room more thoroughly. "I didn't know you had a[pc.isDK |... pet, you said? A pet kobold? | kobold in your pack. ]" Jyrranaz regards Lyric with a combination of curiosity and amusement as [lyric.heShe] eventually tumbles out of your pack. "Is that a thing you adventuring types normally do? Never leave your home without your kobold?" [pc.isDK |That very much depends on what the kobold's purpose is. |You tell Jyrranaz the short version: you rescued this one from freezing to death, and ever since, [lyric.heShe]'s been attached to you. [lyric.HisHer] eyes widen as [lyric.heShe] absorbs the information and notes on the page, devouring everything it has to offer before placing it exactly where [lyric.heShe] found it and starting again with another. "Whoa," [lyric.heShe] gasps, marveling at all the detailed diagrams and all the associated notes. [lyric.HisHer] pupils dilate to nearly the size of [lyric.hisHer] whole eyeball as [lyric.heShe] takes it all in. "Hey! Uh," Jyrranaz starts, making Lyric jump, then hesitates before turning to you. "What's its name?" Lyric. And 'it' is a [lyric.himHer]. "Hey, Lyric!" Jyrranaz calls out, making Lyric jump. "Careful with those, that's important stuff on that paper!" Lyric looks up at Jyrranaz, then down to the paper, giving it another quick skim. "Did you author these?" [lyric.heShe] asks, almost breathlessly, as if [lyric.heShe] had just met [lyric.hisHer] hero. Or, well, [lyric.hisHer] second-favorite hero, anyway. "Yes, I did," Jyrranaz responds, "and it's important that everything stays exactly where they are. I can't afford to spend the time sorting through all of it just because [pc.name]'s [pc.isDK |pet ]kobold got a little handsy." Lyric, as instructed, carefully sets the second piece of paper down, exactly where [lyric.heShe] left it, and approaches you and Jyrranaz with a bright smile, unfazed by being talked down to like that. "Hi," [lyric.heShe] says, parking [lyric.himHer]self next to you, but within arm's reach of Jyrranaz. [lyric.HeShe] extends [lyric.hisHer] right hand in greeting. "Let's start over and do this right. My name's Lyric." Jyrranaz tilts her head as she accepts the handshake. "You're awfully well-spoken for a kobold," she remarks. "I haven't encountered many, but from the few that I have, I got the impression that Savarran wasn't their first language." "Probably because it wasn't," Lyric answers. "And you thought that applies to all kobolds?" Jyrranaz blushes, flustered at herself. "Well–" "It's okay, I'm used to it," Lyric laughs. "But look, that's all beside the point. You're a chemist!" [lyric.heShe] exclaims, spreading [lyric.hisHer] arms and pivoting [lyric.hisHer] head around the room, taking in all the sights – the books, the notes, the shelves stocked with ingredients, each of them kept in containers, sorted between raw and processed first, then alphabetically second. "It's such a rare sight to see anyone else interested in them at all! I was starting to think that Ivris and I were the only ones in the world that gave half a dang! Everyone else is all ‘magic this' and ‘cantrips that'; it's exciting to finally meet someone else that's put as much time and focus into the sciences like you have!" Throughout all of Lyric's excited chittering, Jyrranaz regards [lyric.himHer] with an amused, but easygoing expression. "You?" she asks with a lower tone, bordering on condescension. "A chemist? I didn't know kobolds could even read." "Oh, I can't. Never learned how. Nobody in my clan could. We live in jungles and huts – well, actually, I lived in the jungle before, uh, things beyond my control happened. Kobolds here in the Marches all live in holes in the ground. Jungles and caves aren't the best places for studying!" Lyric laughs, then continues [lyric.hisHer] spiel without even taking a breath in between sentences. "I'm not a magician, unfortunately. I admit, if I could use magic at all, I'd probably be way more interested in that. I can breathe fire, but that's biology – and it takes a bit of maybe-unhealthy dietary changes. If I could throw fireballs from my palms, I'd be all about figuring out how to do it the most efficiently. Science is the next best thing!" Jyrranaz's mouth twists as she listens to Lyric ramble on about [lyric.hisHer] interests. Her earlier snarky expression, looking more like she was a parent entertaining a child's incessant ramblings and make-believe stories, softens into something more amicable. "You say you're interested in the sciences, but you can't read?" "Oh, make no mistake!" [lyric.heShe] chitters excitedly, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging behind [lyric.electrumRange 0 200 |[lyric.himHer]self |[lyric.hisHer] substantial ass with enough force to wag [lyric.hisHer] hips ]. [lyric.HeShe] raps all four fingers on [lyric.hisHer] right hand against [lyric.hisHer] head. "Everything I ever learned, I kept up here. I have my own system for mnemonics and memorization that don't need ink and paper." After an awkward pause, [lyric.heShe] giggles. "Although, I'll admit, it would help, sometimes." Jyrranaz hums as she crosses her arms, regarding the excited kobold between you and her. "Alright. I'll play along." She turns her head and eyes the strewn stacks of paper beside her, searching their contents; after a moment, she picks one from the pile and reads it over to herself before continuing her conversation. "What happens when you mix sulfur with iron fillings and then heat them together?" "You get iron sulfide," Lyric answers quickly, taking Jyrranaz by surprise. "That's a basic one, but, well, you need to know the basics before you get to the good stuff! Iron sulfide is a good starting point in making things like tools and dyes. It can also be polished and is very pretty, which makes it a popular choice for some decorations. And," [lyric.heShe] continues, holding up a hand between you and [lyric.hisHer] mouth, as if [lyric.heShe] was trying to share a secret just between [lyric.himHer] and Jyrranaz, "it tastes delicious." Jyrranaz tilts her head and crooks her mouth in thought. Going by her body language, she's been caught off-guard from Lyric's readiness to answer her question, and, if you had to guess from how she's not immediately refuting [lyric.himHer], [lyric.heShe] got the correct answer. "One more," Jyrranaz says, undaunted. "Using chemistry, how can you get the rust off, say, an iron sword?" Lyric scratches at [lyric.hisHer] chin. "Well, it'd be kind of tough, depending on the size of the sword. You'd need a big ol' burner and, like, a cauldron or something to sit it in. But you'd use calcium carbonate – which is usually in limestone, seashells, marble if you can find it, stuff like that. And it wouldn't, like, destroy the rust; it'd turn it into slag, which is easy to remove... but not as tasty." You're not a chemist. You have people like Ivris and Lyric do all the hard thinking, and any alchemy that you do is mixing ingredients together to get results that other people have already gotten. But, you say, this all sounds like... trivia, really, and not actual, applicable science. Well, except the de-rusting stuff. You could think of a practical application for that. "It can sound like that from the outside looking in," Jyrranaz admits. "Fine, I'll give you one more, Lyric, and this one is a bit more related to what I'm doing here." Lyric's tail wags incessantly behind [lyric.himHer]self. "Yes, of course, ask away!" "What happens when you mix sodium chloride with ethanol?" Lyric's tail stops wagging, but [lyric.hisHer] scaly brow crooks diagonally. "Ooh, you're trying to trick me," [lyric.heShe] says, holding up [lyric.hisHer] finger and wagging it back and forth at Jyrranaz, as if scolding her for doing something naughty. "Salt doesn't dissolve in ethanol, but even 'pure' ethanol still has a water content of roughly four-parts-per-hundred. It would react with that itty-bitty water content rather than the alcohol." Finally, Jyrranaz's unsure body posture changes and relaxes, and a small smile creeps across her face. "You're a fascinating little kobold," she says. "I'm sorry for doubting you." "Oh, it's fine!" Lyric's tail starts wagging once more. "I'm used to people doubting me for one reason or another. It's fun talking with someone that likes what I like! Like [pc.name]. I like talking about [pc.name] to whoever will listen." Jyrranaz's eyes go from [lyric.hisHers] to yours. "That's cute," she says. "Sort of reminds me of me when [pc.name] and I first met." "Oh! Did [pc.heShe] rescue you from mortal peril, too? [pc.HeShe] is really good at that!" "Something like that." '

Jyrranaz drums her fingers along the edge of the bench as she looks over her shoulder towards her work. "I'm, ah... trying to find a way to create a concoction that would turn any vesparan into a queen," she answers. "The only thing that separates a vesparan queen from any drone, scholar, warrior, is birthright – but there's still a biological difference between a queen and any of the proles. "And any kobold can be made a queen over time, but only the girls, obviously. There's no such thing as a kobold 'king'." rows.raw: ' "So, what is it that you're trying to do?" Lyric asks, standing on the tips of [lyric.hisHer] clawed toes to look up over the edge of the bench Jyrranaz is leaning against. Behind her is an alembic, its burners turned off and its vials still filled with steaming chemicals; although each of the vials are clear, you couldn't begin to discern exactly what is in what. Jyrranaz drums her fingers along the edge of the bench as she looks over her shoulder towards her work. "I'm, ah... trying to find a way to create a concoction that would turn any vesparan into a queen," she answers. "The only thing that separates a vesparan queen from any drone, scholar, warrior, is birthright – but there's still a biological difference between a queen and any of the proles. Only a queen can make another queen." "Oooooh," Lyric hums, [lyric.hisHer] eyes going wide as saucers as [lyric.heShe] studies the alembic on the desk. "Vesparans have queens, too?" Jyrranaz starts, looking over her shoulder incredulously. "What do you mean, 'too'?" "Kobolds have queens!" [lyric.heShe] answers. "And any kobold can be made a queen over time, but only the girls, obviously. There's no such thing as a kobold 'king'." [lyric.hasVagina |At that, [pc.hasCock |[lyric.heShe] looks at you expectantly, [lyric.hisHer] eyes narrowing. Seductively, challenging, both, you can't really tell. |Lyric sighs wistfully her tail drooping down onto the floor flatly. ] "We'd need to have lots of kids. And I mean a lot. Kobold ladies get bigger with every kid they have." Jyrranaz can't help but snicker[pc.hasCock | as Lyric stares you down ]. "Sounds like fun." |At that, Lyric sighs wistfully, his tail drooping down onto the floor flatly. ‘King Lyric' would be quite the title. ] "But... yeah!" [lyric.heShe] continues without skipping another beat. "That makes sense to me. If we can make an alchemical potion where a person eats a pepper and starts growing fur, then turning a vesparan into a queen shouldn't be too far away, right?" "You'd think." Jyrranaz grits her teeth, chewing through her words as she stares at the strewn papers and burnt flasks littering her laboratory, each one a signpost pointing to her thousands of failures. Another few seconds pass awkwardly between the three of you. "Can I help?" Again, Jyrranaz is caught off-guard, constantly put on the back foot by Lyric and [lyric.hisHer] energy and knowledge. "Excuse me?" "I wanna help!" [lyric.heShe] continues. "Making a potion that could turn a vesparan into a queen sounds like fun, and you and I are friends now, and I like helping my friends. Unless I'm overstepping something here. We're friends now, right?" [lyric.HeShe] continues before Jyrranaz can respond. "And, well, if I'm honest, if we can figure out a way to make a vesparan into a queen, then we could use that knowledge to turn a kobold into one, too. And, I dunno, I wouldn't mind being [lyric.hasVagina |a queen |royalty ], I guess. That sounds like a good time to me." Jyrranaz scratches her chin as she regards Lyric. She doesn't immediately say no. You remind her that Lyric passed her quizzes with flying colors. At the sound of your voice and your accolades, [lyric.hisHer] back and tail both straighten, making [lyric.himHer]self as presentable as possible. "The fact that you can't read is a bit of a hurdle," she says. "I'd have to explain everything to you verbally." "Well– yeah," Lyric replies dejectedly, the air puffing [lyric.hisHer] chest leaving [lyric.himHer] in a huff. "But I'm good at listening! And I can pick up lessons really quickly! It wouldn't be hard, I promise." "I'm not against it, Lyric." At that, Lyric's posture corrects itself once more – but Jyrranaz still doesn't say yes. "My research uses a flower colloquially known as a ‘Hornet Sting' as its base ingredient. Its properties can be used as a transformative to alter a person's biological composition into that of a vesparan. Do kobolds have something similar?" [pc.ra dragon |Maybe. You're a dragon, and you accomplished that by taking a transformative. Dragons and kobolds aren't that different, are they? ] "Not at all!" Lyric answers, [lyric.hisHer] tail thumping against the floor of Jyrranaz's laboratory. "Well, yes, they're different, but dragons and kobolds are neighbors on the evolutionary line." Just as quickly, [lyric.hisHer] tail goes still and limp against the floor. "But... the question wasn't about dragons, it was about kobolds. Even the biggest, most dragonly-dragon to ever dragon isn't the same thing as a Village Mother. So I dunno if that's what Jyrranaz is looking for in her research." [lyric.HeShe] tilts [lyric.hisHer] head to one side, closing one eye as [lyric.heShe] considers the question. "Well – I uhh... I'm... not sure[pc.ra dragon | if a kobold equivalent exists ]. I've never looked into ingredients to turn myself into myself, y'know?" She hums. "Indeed." She takes a big sigh, in and out through her nose. "As I said, I'm not against the idea of having an assistant. Perhaps a second head could give me the breakthrough I need to cross that gap. And – well, I haven't gone beyond the hive in an age. Your insight could prove invaluable." Lyric's tail wags hard enough to beat against the floor of her laboratory. "But we're getting ahead of ourselves. We need to take this one step at a time. We need to learn if there's an ingredient that exists that could alter a person into a kobold." "Couldn't we just start with that Hornet Sting flower you mentioned?" "I don't think there's anything about it you could teach me. Starting with a different ingredient, in the hopes of achieving a similar result, would get us much more valuable information." Lyric's eyes wander the laboratory as [lyric.heShe] thinks as hard as [lyric.heShe] can. You can practically see the wheels spinning behind [lyric.hisHer] eyes. [pc.ra dragon | "Well, like I said earlier, dragons and kobolds are directly related, and [pc.name] is a whole dragon! Well, maybe not a whole dragon, but [pc.heShe]'s a dragon! That's a good place to start, if you ask me. As good a place as any!" You sort of tuned in and out of the conversation since it didn't really apply to you, but you picked up on that last part, especially when Lyric said your name. You ask [lyric.himHer] to repeat what [lyric.heShe] just said. "I was more just thinking out loud, really," [lyric.heShe] admits, "but kobolds and dragons aren't that biologically dissimilar. If we can't find anything for transforming a person into a kobold – or if that's just plain ol' not good enough – then some Dragonsblood ought to be a good jumping point instead." They would like some Dragonsblood to further their research? You may be able to do something about that. | "This would be much easier if dragons still existed," [lyric.heShe] laments. "Kobolds are an evolutionary offshoot of dragons, and legends say that drinking the blood of a dragon could turn you into one. It's a lot harder to find a dragon's blood than a flower nowadays." "But hey!" [lyric.heShe] continues, giving Jyrranaz a hearty thumbs-up and a heavy wink, one that wrinkles [lyric.hisHer] entire face with its enthusiasm. "[pc.name] and I are wanderers. We'll probably find something somewhere. Probably!" She smiles sweetly down at Lyric. "Your optimism is envious." [var0 |You sort of tuned in and out of the conversation since it didn't really apply to you, but you caught that last part. “哦，我怎么可能会忘记呢？[lyric.heShe]认真地回复道，[lyric.hisHer]尾巴摇得飞快，显得非常兴奋[lyric.heShe]回忆道：“在这个世界上，对科学感兴趣的人实在太少了。我觉得她和我的想法非常契合！契合到让我愿意忽略她对狗头人的那些偏见和刻板印象！” 嗯，看到这种态度确实挺不错的。[lyric.heShe]至少在这一点上，你还是相当开明的。你承认自己在大部分对话中都没有认真听，因为那些内容与你无关，所以你让莉里克提醒你：他们到底在寻找什么来着？” rows.raw: " You ask Lyric if [lyric.heShe] remembers the conversation [lyric.heShe] had with Jyrranaz, the vesparan chemist in the hive. "Oh, how could I forget?" [lyric.heShe] replies earnestly, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging a mile a minute as [lyric.heShe] recalls it. "There are so few of us in the world that are interested in the sciences. I think she and I hit it off really well! So well that I'm willing to look past her biases and stereotypes towards kobolds!" Well, uh, it's nice to see that [lyric.heShe]'s so open-minded about that, at least. You admit that you tuned out for most of the conversation since it didn't involve you, so you ask Lyric to remind you: what is it they were looking for, again? "Jyrranaz was doing research on how to make a normal vesparan into a queen through biology and chemistry," [lyric.heShe] answers, in a roundabout way. "Kobolds have queens, too. Well, technically, I had a Village Mother, but that's the same thing by a different name. Anyway, I'm interested in learning if kobolds could be made into queens or capital-M mothers, too, and if it's possible without giving birth to hundreds of kids[lyric.hasVagina |[pc.hasCock |." [lyric.HeShe] unsubtly glances at your crotch, and the tip of [lyric.hisHer] tail fidgets slightly. "Not that I'd be against that. That sounds like a lot of fun ] ]." So, they're looking for more information on how to make vesparan and kobold queens[lyric.mf |. Is that even something that he would want? He's not a girl[lyric.hasVagina |. Or, he doesn't identify as one, anyway ]. "Are you kidding? The fact that I'm not a lady kobold makes me want it more!" he exclaims. "That'd make me the first kobold king in history! King Lyric the First! Wouldn't you want that for yourself?" ... Alright, point made ]. [var0 |What about that {item} that you had found? It has transformative properties to turn people into kobolds, when it's alchemized properly. Would it work for their research? Lyric doesn't immediately respond: [lyric.hisHer] mouth opens, and [lyric.heShe] takes a deep breath, and [lyric.hisHer] index finger extends straight up into the air, and a bright smile crosses [lyric.hisHer] mouth, but no words come out. [lyric.HeShe] freezes in place like that for a moment as [lyric.heShe] processes [lyric.hisHer] own answer. "I'm not so sure," [lyric.heShe] eventually says, relaxing [lyric.hisHer] body, crossing [lyric.hisHer] arms, and frowning contemplatively. "I mean... what would we learn from {item} that Jyrranaz doesn't already know from that flower she said could affect a person's biology to take on a more vesparan appearance? She'd just learn what she already knows, but for kobolds." So, {item} wouldn't be any help in their research? "If we could refine it or make it much, much stronger, then maybe, but... I dunno, I don't really want to go back to Jyrranaz with something so... basic, I guess?" Alright, so {item} isn't what they're looking for as an alchemical reagent. Lyric, at least, would like something a bit stronger to present to Jyrranaz. You recall their initial conversation, particularly the very end of it, where Lyric lamented that dragons used to exist, and drinking the blood of one had transformative properties – maybe something like that would be sufficient. Dragons and kobolds are at least somewhat similar, right? But where are you going to find something like that? Dragons are... rather hard to come by, nowadays. |You do happen to recall that Lyric lamented that dragons didn't exist anymore, because their blood had transformative properties. [pc.ra dragon | "Well, it's obviously not such a stretch anymore," [lyric.heShe] says, motioning to you top-to-bottom with [lyric.hisHer] open palm. "Once again, [pc.name], you've made the impossible possible. All we need is a second helping of whatever turned you into you, and we ought to be off to a good start!" ‘Turning you into you' is an interesting way to phrase it, but, | "Yeah, it would have helped a bunch," [lyric.heShe] says. "Dragons and kobolds are closely related, biologically-speaking. I don't think it'd be a huge stretch, I think, to learn something about kobolds and their evolution if we could find, you know, a dragon to bleed and start drinking from." That's quite the way to phrase it, but, ] in any case, you withdraw a small crystal from your affects – less than the size of your thumbnail; blood-red; and faintly glowing from the inside, as if powered by a single firefly. Would something like this work? Lyric leans in to get a better look at the tiny crystal. When [lyric.heShe] realizes what it is [lyric.heShe]'s looking at, [lyric.hisHer] eyes widen, [lyric.hisHer] pupils dilating to the size of dinner plates. "Is this what I think it is?" If [lyric.heShe] thinks that it's the crystalized blood of a dragon, then– "We need to go back to Jyrranaz!" [lyric.heShe] interrupts, [lyric.hisHer] hands reaching forward to urgently grip onto your [pc.lowerGarments], giving them a rough shake. "As soon as we can! This could be the breakthrough she's looking for!" Well, you're convinced. |So, just to recap, [lyric.heShe] and Jyrranaz are looking for an item closely linked with kobolds and have transformative capabilities? If eating a certain kind of pepper can turn you into a dog-person, then, surely, something like that exists. "I've actually been thinking about that," [lyric.heShe] says quickly, as if waiting for you to say just that. "And I don't think that finding something to turn a person into a kobold is actually the right move." Really? After all that discussion they had? "Jyrranaz already knows everything there is to know about the Hornet Sting, right? An item to turn a person into a 'common' vesparan? But she's looking for a way to turn a common vesparan into a queen." [lyric.HeShe] crosses [lyric.hisHer] arms and closes one eye as [lyric.heShe] tries to put [lyric.hisHer] thoughts to words. "And finding her something that can turn a person into a normal kobold like myself would just tell her everything she already knows, but for kobolds." So... [lyric.heShe]'d like something stronger than whatever [lyric.heShe] and Jyrranaz had discussed before. "I'm asking a lot, I realize," [lyric.heShe] interjects. "If something like that doesn't exist for vesparans, then it probably doesn't exist for kobolds." [lyric.HeShe] pauses for a second, then laughs. "If it did, she wouldn't be trying to synthesize it, then!" Lyric wants something stronger than a transformative for a kobold to present to Jyrranaz. [pc.ra dragon |But you recall in their discussion that a hit of Dragonsblood would be a ‘good starting point', since dragons and kobolds are biologically related – it wouldn't give them the information they want on kobold queens or vesparan queens, but it'd be much better than nothing. Luckily, you know just where to go to get the blood of a dragon... |You vaguely recall Lyric mentioning in their discussion that [lyric.heShe] wished that dragons still existed, because their blood had transformative properties, and dragons and kobolds are biologically related. If a transformative meant to turn a person into a kobold isn't enough, then maybe one meant for a dragon would do it. But is that really possible? It almost feels like you're making things harder for yourself by changing your goal like that. Is it possible to find a dragon, or at least a dragon's blood...? ] ] "

rows.original: Near the campfire is Lyric, [var0 |sitting next to the flame with a piece of parchment in [lyric.hisHer] hand, studying it intensely. [lyric.HisHer] face is scrunched up and [lyric.hisHer] eyes dart back and forth across the lettering on the paper. When you get a glance at the paper, it's only a few sentences long, in huge, blocky letters that make it easy to read – if you can read. That must be what [lyric.heShe]'s doing: trying to teach [lyric.himHer]self how to read. |doing laps around the perimeter of the camp. [lyric.HisHer] gait is unusually short, and [lyric.hisHer] tail keeps whipping back and forth behind [lyric.himHer]self as [lyric.heShe] walks. [lyric.HeShe]'s practicing walking in [lyric.hisHer] new body. |busy with what appears to be a makeshift alembic using sheepskin flasks in place of something proper. Ingredients that you recognize whole and individually are either pressed down into a fine powder, or placed on a spit close to the fire to melt down, before they're mixed together to make something you no longer recognize. At least [lyric.heShe]'s being very prompt with keeping [lyric.hisHer] 'ammunition' well-stocked. |lounging casually on [lyric.hisHer] [lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | |substantial ]rump, watching the campfire dance and flicker mindlessly. [lyric.HisHer] left hand is raised and cupped, and [lyric.hisHer] right continually dips into the pit of [lyric.hisHer] left's palm, plucking out tiny chunks of something and popping them into [lyric.hisHer] mouth. Whatever it is, it's metal – it glints in the light of the fire every now and again. You trust that [lyric.heShe] hasn't snuck into your electrum without your permission. But then you wonder where [lyric.heShe] got whatever it is [lyric.heShe]'s snacking on... ]
rows.translation: 篝火旁坐着莉里克。 [var0 |坐在火焰旁边，手中拿着一张羊皮纸[lyric.hisHer]正在仔细研究它。[lyric.HisHer]脸都皱成了一团[lyric.hisHer]目光在纸上的文字上来回移动。当你瞥了一眼那张纸时，会发现上面只有短短几句话，而且是用那种大而醒目的字体写成的，因此很容易阅读——如果你愿意仔细看的话。可以读一读。那肯定就是[lyric.heShe]正在做的事情：尝试进行教学。[lyric.himHer]如何阅读自己。 |在营地的周围绕圈跑。[lyric.HisHer]步幅异常短，而且[lyric.hisHer]尾巴不断地在身后来回摆动。[lyric.himHer]将自己视为[lyric.heShe]行走。[lyric.HeShe]正在练习走路呢。[lyric.hisHer]新身体。 |他们似乎正在使用羊皮瓶来制作这种临时拼凑的蒸馏器，而不是使用正规的设备。那些你能辨认出来的原材料，要么被碾成细粉，要么被放在靠近火源的支架上加热融化，之后再被混合在一起，最终变成了一种你再也认不出来的东西。至少是这样吧[lyric.heShe]在响应方面表现得非常迅速。[lyric.hisHer]弹药储备充足。 |悠闲地用[lyric.hisHer] [lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | |实质性的 ]臀部坐着，呆呆地望着篝火跳动的火焰，闪烁不定。[lyric.HisHer]左手抬起并呈杯状握住[lyric.hisHer]不断陷入深渊[lyric.hisHer]左手的掌心，取出一些细小的碎屑，然后将它们放入[lyric.hisHer]那个东西，不管它是什么，都是金属做的——在火光下，它会不时地闪烁光芒。你信任它。[lyric.heShe]并没有在未经你允许的情况下偷偷进入你的电银物品中。但随后你又会开始疑惑：它到底去哪里了？[lyric.heShe]得到了那东西。[lyric.heShe]吃着……当零食 ]

rows.original: Among the goers and customers of the tavern is Lyric, your eight-foot-tall half-dragon half-kobold. Now that [lyric.heShe]'s too big to fit into your pack, [lyric.heShe]'s free – or, perhaps more aptly, forced – to mingle and socialize with others among the bar. Thankfully, Lyric is still more kobold than [lyric.heShe] is dragon, and kobolds are yappy social butterflies, always eager to make new friends. The fact that [lyric.hisHer] attire struggles to contain all of [lyric.electrumRange 0 300 |that |that ] certainly adds to [lyric.hisHer]... magnetism.
rows.translation: 在那个酒馆里，有你的伙伴莱瑞克——那个身高八英尺、身半龙身半狗头人的家伙。现在[lyric.heShe]太大了，无法放进你的背包里。[lyric.heShe]在酒吧里，人们不得不——或者更准确地说，是被迫——与其他人交往、互动。幸运的是，莉里克依然更像一只狗头人，而不是[lyric.heShe]龙是孤独的生物，而狗头人们则是喜欢结交朋友、热衷于社交的生物，他们总是渴望结识新朋友。事实上[lyric.hisHer]这些服饰实在难以容纳所有这些元素[lyric.electrumRange 0 300 |那个 |那个 ]确实起到了增色添彩的作用。[lyric.hisHer]……这种吸引力。

        |[lyric.mf
            |King Lyric the First

        ] help you today?"

    ]
