rows.original: [rand |[lyric.HeShe] sits at the bar, mug in [lyric.hisHer] right hand, and based on the way [lyric.hisHer] wrist sags a bit when [lyric.heShe] lifts it, it's filled with liquid, but it doesn't froth like you'd expect ale to. [lyric.HeShe] speaks with [lyric.mf |a woman you haven't seen before – long, blonde hair, big tits, freckled skin |a man you haven't seen before – large, muscled, tussled hair and well-kept beard ]. Lyric looks like [lyric.heShe]'s enjoying the conversation, but [lyric.hisHer] partner looks a bit impatient. "Oh, [pc.name]!" Lyric calls when [lyric.heShe] sees you. [lyric.HeShe] waves you over as [lyric.heShe] turns back to the [lyric.mf |wo ]man [lyric.heShe] was speaking with. "This is the [pc.race] I was telling you about! I'm glad you're both here; I bet you'd really hit it off with each other!" The [lyric.mf |wo ]man instead knocks back [lyric.mf |her |his ] mug, sets it down, says something about needing to get back ‘to it', then leaves without another word. "Aw, but–!" Lyric calls after, but the [lyric.mf |wo ]man doesn't turn back. "That's weird. I thought we were off to such a good start." You [pc.isDK |bluntly tell Lyric that that [lyric.mf |wo ]man didn't want to be friends. [lyric.mf |She |He ] wanted to fuck [lyric.himHer]. [lyric.HisHer] |gently tell Lyric that not everyone in a tavern is looking to make friends. More often than not, they're looking for partners for a night. "Only for a night?" Lyric asks, bewildered, [lyric.hisHer] head turning to one side. Then, [lyric.hisHer] ] eyes widen in understanding. "Oh," [lyric.heShe] says quietly as [lyric.heShe] sets down [lyric.hisHer] own mug. "That's... man. I was looking forward to making a new friend." You peer into [lyric.hisHer] mug. It's filled with milk. "Well, I have you here now, [pc.name]," [lyric.heShe] says, adjusting [lyric.hisHer] seat on [lyric.hisHer] stool. "What's up?" |Lyric stands next to the tavern's fireplace, with a small handful of curious onlookers surrounding [lyric.himHer]. You can't quite make out the conversation that they're having, but you can tell that Lyric is having a good time: all smiles, with a relaxed posture. But then something a bit concerning happens: Lyric extends [lyric.hisHer] hand, and one of the onlookers hands [lyric.himHer] a fistful of electrum. You aren't sure if you're okay with [lyric.himHer] accepting money from strangers, but... you wait to see how this plays out. Once the money changes hands, Lyric – in a move that you should have expected – immediately brings it to [lyric.hisHer] mouth and pours every coin into it. The sound of teeth grinding through metal is just barely audible through the general rabble of the tavern, even with [lyric.hisHer] mouth closed. [lyric.HisHer] onlookers are already very impressed by the display. After [lyric.heShe] swallows, [lyric.heShe] motions for the others to take a step back. [lyric.HeShe] turns to the fireplace and, after a bit of odd heaving in [lyric.hisHer] chest, [lyric.heShe] leans forward and belches a pillar of fire into it. It's not a fearsome display, especially compared to what you know [lyric.heShe]'s really capable of, but it's enough to light the fire – and enough to get a round of applause. [lyric.HisHer] cheeks turn dull yellow and [lyric.heShe] tries to wave them off as if it were nothing, bashful that the crowd is so easily wowed by what is a basic display of biology for [lyric.himHer]. [lyric.HeShe] could even do this as a kobold; it's only now that [lyric.heShe]'s a big, tall dragon that people are paying closer attention. Once that's all done, though, [lyric.hisHer] eyes meet yours from across the room, and, after excusing [lyric.himHer]self from the crowd, [lyric.heShe]'s quick to join you. "[pc.name], did you see, did you see?" [lyric.heShe] asks as [lyric.heShe] bounds up to you. The floorboards creak from the zealous stomping of [lyric.hisHer] feet[lyric.mf | | and her boobs bounce and jostle in the already-strained top of what's left of her tunic ]. "I made a bunch of friends! One of them said ‘I heard dragons could breathe fire' and I said ‘yeah, so can kobolds' and they said ‘can you breathe fire right now?' and I said ‘yeah, if you have any metal,' and they said ‘uhhh, I have a few hawks,' and I said ‘that's not a lot but I can probably do it for that much,' and then they–" You tell Lyric that you saw the rest of the show from there. "It's crazy how much people really seem to like me more now that I'm really tall!" [lyric.heShe] says, bouncing on the spot like a kid. [lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | |[lyric.mf |Patrons of the bar turn to watch your big-assed dragon-boy bounce, giving the whole building a free show – even the definitely-straight-manly-men can't help but enjoy the display. Lyric's body is feminine enough – and plump enough in all the right places – that he'd be very convincing in the dark. |Patrons of the bar turn to watch your big-tittied dragon-girl bounce, giving the whole building a free show, and she's so focused on you that oblivious the entire time. She's going to need a bit more time getting used to her... assets. ] ] "But that's enough about them," [lyric.heShe] continues, not missing a beat. "What's up, [pc.name]? This is you time, now." |Lyric sits at the bar[lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | |, [lyric.hisHer] stool creaking and straining to contain all of that ], and [lyric.heShe] leans over the countertop as [lyric.heShe] speaks directly with Garth, the bar's owner[lyric.mf |. His tail swishes back and forth, errantly sweeping the floor of the dust and dirt around the foot of the stool. That part of the floor is noticeably cleaner than the rest |. Her boobs practically spill over themselves and strain what's left over of her already-taut tunic as she leans over the bar, but she doesn't seem to notice. Garth, being the gentlemanly proprietor that he is, does his best not to look at them ]. Lyric sees something out of the corner of [lyric.hisHer] eye, and [lyric.heShe] turns to you for a split second before double-taking once [lyric.heShe] realizes that it's you. "Oh, [pc.name]!" [lyric.heShe] says cheerily, waving you over. "Garth was just saying that he had something he wanted to talk to me about!" You pull up beside Lyric, facing the bar. Does the conversation concern you? "I mean," [lyric.heShe] responds, suddenly unsure. "I'd like it to." Garth, unphased by Lyric bringing you into the conversation, continues exactly where he had left off, without bringing you up to speed. "I just wanted to know if you've put any more thought into that position I offered you," he says. "Oh, [lyric.mf |as your busboy?" "Could always use the extra hands," Garth answers with an affirmative nod. "And – I'm not gonna sugarcoat it – a face like yours would bring in some more customers. Word of my tavern employing a cute dragon like you would get around fast." Lyric's tail wags even faster, making the poor stool creak and groan underneath himself. "It does sound like fun," he says. "It wouldn't be too hard, either. Take orders; clean tables; make friends – who doesn't like making friends? And the tips! I'd get so much free food!" Garth raises an eyebrow at that, but doesn't press. You hum as you try to imagine the sight of Lyric being Garth's busboy. It's good, honest work and it'll keep Lyric busy when [lyric.heShe]'s not with you traveling the Marches. But with [lyric.electrumRange 0 300 |a... figure like his, and with ]how exotic he and his biology are... he might get a bit more attention than he's expecting. And Garth knows that, too. |as your waitress?" "Could always use the extra hands," Garth answers with an affirmative nod. "And – I'm not gonna sugarcoat it – a, ah, body like yours would bring in some more customers. The folks, they'd appreciate a show as much as a drink." Lyric's tail wags even faster, making the poor stool creak and groan underneath herself. "It does sound like fun," she says. "It wouldn't be too hard, either. Take orders; carry drinks; make friends – who doesn't like making friends? And the tips! I'd get so much free food!" Garth raises an eyebrow at that, but doesn't press. You hum as you try to imagine the sight of Lyric being Garth's beer wench. On the one hand, it's honest work. Lyric could be putting in extra time whenever she isn't with you wandering the Marches. But on the other... you feel like Lyric is too naïve to appreciate the gravity of the atmosphere. It's not a secret that she has big tits[lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | and an ass that some women would kill to have ]. The attention she'd get from a drunken, horny farmhand or miner would be alarming, and Lyric doesn't have the constitution to defend herself physically, despite her size. That said, Garth was certainly right about one thing: it'd bring in a lot of customers. People would pay Garth and Lyric both good money to have her bend over them as she hands them their drink. ] "Something to think about!" [lyric.heShe] answers jovially. Whether [lyric.heShe] understands, or even acknowledges, the realities of someone like [lyric.himHer] working at a tavern, is beyond you. "But nah. I still want to keep traveling with [pc.name] for now, and working at a bar would get in the way of that." "I can respect that," Garth says as he stands upright, turning back to his ale mugs with a wet rag. The conversation is over for now – but if Lyric ever changes [lyric.hisHer] mind, you doubt the door is closed. With that done, Lyric pivots on [lyric.hisHer] stool to face you. "Sorry about that!" [lyric.heShe] says, [lyric.hisHer] mouth spreading into a wide, well-meaning smile. "That took a bit longer than I expected. What's up today, [pc.name]?" ] Actually, you didn't want to continue this conversation in public, and you invite Lyric up to your room. "Okay!" [lyric.heShe] answers quickly, jolting in place and waiting for you to take the lead. You lead Lyric up the stairs and down the halls of the Frosthound tavern, towards the room you've taken residence in. Once you're in, it's relatively quiet – and wholly private. "So, what now?" [lyric.heShe] asks innocently.

rows.original: Lyric isn't the short little kobold that you rescued from the snow anymore. Help yourself to taking in the sights of your combined hard work.
rows.translation: 莉莉克已经不再是那个你从雪地里救出来的小狗头人了。现在，你可以好好欣赏一下自己共同努力所带来的成果吧。
rows.raw: "Lyric isn't the short little kobold that you rescued from the snow anymore. Help yourself to taking in the sights of your combined hard work."

rows.translation: 对话
对话

rows.original: Lyric may be the same kobold in a dragon's body, but maybe being in a dragon's body has given [lyric.himHer] some new perspectives on things.
rows.translation: 莉里克或许还是那条龙躯里的狗头人，但也许待在龙的身体里，让[lyric.himHer]对许多事情有了新的看法。
rows.raw: "Lyric may be the same kobold in a dragon's body, but maybe being in a dragon's body has given [lyric.himHer] some new perspectives on things."

rows.translation: 喂食
喂食

rows.original: Lyric's always enjoyed eating electrum as a treat, and that probably hasn't changed. In fact, now that [lyric.heShe]'s so gigantic, [lyric.heShe]'d need to eat more to maintain [lyric.hisHer] physique. And if you overfeed [lyric.himHer]... well, you doubt it'll make [lyric.hisHer] body worse.
rows.translation: 莉里克一直很喜欢把琥珀金币当零食吃，这一点大概也没有变。事实上，[lyric.heShe]现在这么巨大，[lyric.heShe]就得吃得更多才能维持[lyric.hisHer]体格。而如果你喂得太多[lyric.himHer]……嗯，你估计这不会让[lyric.hisHer]身体变差。
rows.raw: "Lyric's always enjoyed eating electrum as a treat, and that probably hasn't changed. In fact, now that [lyric.heShe]'s so gigantic, [lyric.heShe]'d need to eat more to maintain [lyric.hisHer] physique. And if you overfeed [lyric.himHer]... well, you doubt it'll make [lyric.hisHer] body worse."

rows.original: Lyric enjoys eating metal, particularly your money, and you have no electrum to spare. You should look after yourself a bit before feeding your dragon your hard-earned cash.
rows.translation: 莉里克喜欢吃金属，尤其是你的钱，而你没有多余的琥珀金币。在把辛苦赚来的钱喂给你的龙之前，你还是应该先照顾好自己吧。
rows.raw: "Lyric enjoys eating metal, particularly your money, and you have no electrum to spare. You should look after yourself a bit before feeding your dragon your hard-earned cash."

rows.translation: 性行为
性行为

rows.raw: "Lyric's got a brand new body[lyric.electrumRange 0 400|,| – a whole lot of it –] and you want to explore it a little more thoroughly..."

rows.original: Lyric takes up a lot of room in your camp, now that [lyric.heShe]'s so huge. You need to make some room.
rows.translation: 现在，这些莉里克在你的营地中占用了相当多的空间。[lyric.heShe]太大了，你得腾出一些空间才行。
rows.raw: "Lyric takes up a lot of room in your camp, now that [lyric.heShe]'s so huge. You need to make some room."

rows.original:
You withdraw a single electrum coin from your pouch and pinch it between your fingers, letting it glint in the [dayNight
        |sun
        |fire
    ]light. You tell [lyric.himHer] to open wide.
    
    [lyric.isDom
        |[lyric.HeShe] scoots forward a bit, on [lyric.hisHer] hands and knees, stopping just inside your arm's reach. With lidded eyes, [lyric.heShe] arches [lyric.hisHer] back and opens [lyric.hisHer] mouth, rolling out [lyric.hisHer] long, thin, draconic tongue like a rolling carpet for you to place the coin onto.
        
        When you do, Lyric's tongue wraps around your fingers, again and again, rolling [lyric.hisHer] buds across the [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] of your digits. [lyric.HeShe] exhales, [lyric.hisHer] hot breath washing up to your wrist as [lyric.heShe] leans forward, wrapping [lyric.hisHer] soft, scaly lips around the tips of your fingers. The coin is long gone, swallowed without so much as a chew, but, apparently, [lyric.heShe]'s found something just as tasty.
        
        Lyric gives your fingers one last swipe of [lyric.hisHer] tongue to clean them of [lyric.hisHer] saliva before pulling back. "Delicious," [lyric.heShe] whispers.
        
        [lyric.HeShe] stays on [lyric.hisHer] hands and knees, looking up at you sensually, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging slowly behind [lyric.himHer]self[weightedRand 5 95
            |. Then, rather suddenly, [lyric.heShe] jolts in place, [lyric.hisHer] eyes widening, almost with panic. "Am I laying it on too thick?" [lyric.heShe] asks. "I mean, we're not having sex right now, but I thought it'd be fun if I – you know, if I–"
            
            You tell Lyric that the sexiest thing [lyric.heShe] can do is have confidence. And, yes, that whole display was... hot. Kinda hot as fuck.
            
            Lyric pauses, then narrows [lyric.hisHer] eyes seductively once more as a deep, low growl emanates from [lyric.hisHer] throat. "Of course it was," [lyric.heShe] hums.
            |. [lyric.HeShe] watches you expectantly, as if waiting for you to offer [lyric.himHer] more – or to offer something else for [lyric.hisHer] appetite.
        ]
        |Obeying your instruction immediately, Lyric skitters across the ground – an odd sight for someone so large – and sits on [lyric.hisHer] hands and knees in front of you, [lyric.hisHer] mouth open for you to place the coin into.
        
        As soon as you do, [lyric.hisHer] jaw snaps shut, skewering straight through the metal of the electrum like your own teeth would through a cube of cheese. [lyric.HeShe] chews it twice, the scraping sound of enamel against metal muffled by [lyric.hisHer] cheeks, before [lyric.heShe] swallows it. You watch [lyric.hisHer] powerful throat work down the chunk of metal before it disappears into [lyric.hisHer] chest.
        
        "Delicious," [lyric.heShe] sighs wistfully, [lyric.hisHer] tail wagging lazily across the ground behind [lyric.himHer]self. [lyric.HisHer] eyes nearly cross from the apparently-heavenly taste of electrum in [lyric.hisHer] gullet. "Thank you, [pc.name]."
    ]
rows.translation:
你从口袋里取出一枚琥珀金币，用手指捏住它，让它在阳光下闪烁光芒。 [dayNight
        |太阳
        |开火
    ]轻型。你说呢。[lyric.himHer]大敞着。
    
    [lyric.isDom
        |[lyric.HeShe]往前挪一点，继续前进。[lyric.hisHer]双手双膝着地，停在你手臂能够触及的范围之内。双眼紧闭着[lyric.heShe]拱门[lyric.hisHer]重新打开[lyric.hisHer]张着嘴，不停地说着[lyric.hisHer]一条修长、细如龙舌的舌头，就像一块可以滚动的地方，让你把硬币放在上面。

当你把硬币放在那里时，莉里克的舌头会一次又一次地绕过你的手指，不断滚动着。[lyric.hisHer]萌芽生长[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]你的手指。[lyric.HeShe]呼出气息，[lyric.hisHer]热气直扑你的手腕[lyric.heShe]身体前倾，将……紧紧抱在怀里。[lyric.hisHer]手指尖上覆盖着柔软、带有鳞片的皮肤。那枚硬币早已不见踪影，甚至都没有被咬过就吞了下去，但显然[lyric.heShe]莉里克让您的手指再轻轻滑动一次[lyric.hisHer]用舌头清理它们[lyric.hisHer]在收回舌头之前，那些唾液已经流了出来。“真美味啊[lyric.heShe]低语声。
        
        [lyric.HeShe]持续有效[lyric.hisHer]双手双膝着地，充满性感地仰望着你。[lyric.hisHer]尾巴慢悠悠地摇着跟在后面[lyric.himHer]自己[weightedRand 5 95
            |然后，突然之间，[lyric.heShe]猛地固定在了原位。[lyric.hisHer]眼睛瞪得大大的，几乎带着恐慌。“我是不是表现得太过夸张了？[lyric.heShe]问道：“我的意思是，我们现在并没有发生性关系，但我觉得如果我……你知道的，如果我……”

你告诉莉里克，最性感的事情就是[lyric.heShe]能做的就是保持自信。而且，没错，那整个表演……简直太辣了。简直热得要命。

莉里克停顿了一下，然后继续说道。[lyric.hisHer]那双眼睛再次以诱人的姿态注视着对方，与此同时，一声低沉的咆哮从那人的口中传出[lyric.hisHer]当然是了。[lyric.heShe]哼着小曲。
            |。 [lyric.HeShe]满怀期待地注视着你，仿佛在等待你给出答案或做出决定。[lyric.himHer]或者提供其他选择。[lyric.hisHer]食欲。
        ]
        |立刻遵照你的指示，莉里克快速地爬到了地上——对于这样一个体型庞大的人来说，这一幕实在显得有些奇怪——然后坐了下来。[lyric.hisHer]跪在你面前。[lyric.hisHer]张大嘴巴，等着你把硬币放进去。

一旦你这么做了，[lyric.hisHer]下巴猛地一闭，那东西就像你的牙齿咬穿一块奶酪一样，直接刺穿了那种银色金属。[lyric.HeShe]仔细考虑后再说，那金属与牙釉质相互摩擦发出的刮擦声，在这时已经被减弱了许多。[lyric.hisHer]先别急，等会儿再说。[lyric.heShe]把它吞了下去。你瞧吧。[lyric.hisHer]强有力的喉部力量将那块金属彻底吞没，随后它便消失不见了[lyric.hisHer]太美味了。[lyric.heShe]叹息着，充满了无奈[lyric.hisHer]尾巴懒洋洋地拖在身后，一瘸一拐地走着[lyric.himHer]自我。[lyric.HisHer]看到琥珀金币那仿佛来自天界的美味，我的眼睛都快瞪出来了[lyric.hisHer]谢谢。[pc.name]。"
    ]

rows.original:
You reach into your coin pouch and withdraw as many coins as you can wrap your fingers around in one pass. Lyric's a lot bigger now, which means that [lyric.hisHer] appetite's probably grown along with [lyric.himHer], and it just won't do to have your dragon go hungry.
    
    [lyric.isDom
        |Lyric, in turn, crawls toward you on [lyric.hisHer] hands and knees, [lyric.hisHer] eyes narrowed seductively. "I'm hungry for a lot of things," [lyric.heShe] says, and to emphasize [lyric.hisHer] point, [lyric.hisHer] long, thin, draconic tongue slips from between [lyric.hisHer] scaly lips to wet them. "Electrum will just have to do for now."
        
        The moment you withdraw your closed fist from the pouch, [lyric.hisHer] own hands are reaching up and forward, gently grasping you by the forearm. [lyric.HeShe] brings your closed his to [lyric.hisHer] mouth and licks at your fingers, encouraging you to open them and to let the coins fall free. They do, jingling wetly against each other as Lyric rolls them across [lyric.hisHer] tongue and lets the coins pool inside [lyric.hisHer] cheeks.
        
        [lyric.HeShe] doesn't chew, neither does [lyric.heShe] swallow: [lyric.heShe] lets the money sit in [lyric.hisHer] cheeks, [lyric.hisHer] tongue fully extended to lick and lap the residual electrum off your digits and off your palm. [lyric.HisHer] eyes are on you the entire time, narrowed, with [lyric.hisHer] brow furrowed. Your hand is in a dragon's mouth, you know it, and the dragon knows it. You know Lyric would never bite you... but [lyric.heShe] could. You know that, and [lyric.heShe] knows that.
        
        When [lyric.heShe]'s had [lyric.hisHer] fun, [lyric.heShe] gives your fingers once last wet slurp to clean the saliva off them before pulling back. [lyric.HisHer] eyes close blissfully, and, with a few chomps of [lyric.hisHer] teeth skewering through the electrum like grapes, [lyric.heShe] swallows, [lyric.hisHer] thick throat ushering down the metal. Just like that, it's all gone.
        
        Lyric opens [lyric.hisHer] eyes, keeping them narrowed on yours. [lyric.HeShe] lets out an exalted sigh, [lyric.hisHer] hot breath washing against your now-moist [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] before [lyric.heShe] finally lets you go. "Delicious," [lyric.heShe] murmurs, [lyric.hisHer] tail swishing lazily, but widely enough that [lyric.hisHer] hips move with it. "But now I'm in the mood for something else."
        
        You're caught, frozen after everything that [lyric.heShe] had just done. You can feel the blood rushing to your cheeks... and elsewhere[weightedRand 5 95
            |.
            
            "Too much? Too thick?" Lyric asks, righting [lyric.hisHer] posture and widening [lyric.hisHer] eyes with concern. "Let me know if I'm being a too forward and aggressive."
            
            You assure [lyric.himHer] that it was exactly the right amount of forwardness.
            
            "Ah," [lyric.heShe] says, narrowing [lyric.hisHer] eyes and resuming [lyric.hisHer] posture. "Perfect."
            |. Lyric hums once in smug satisfaction, [lyric.hisHer] tongue slipping out to lick [lyric.hisHer] lips once more.
        ]
        | "Oooh!" Lyric chirps as [lyric.heShe] takes one big step towards you, then kneels down in front of you, ready to receive [lyric.hisHer] reward for being such a good dragon. [lyric.HisHer] heavy tail thumbs heavily against the ground behind [lyric.himHer]self, barely able to contain itself at the idea of getting more electrum to eat.
        
        Rather than open your fist and let all the coins in your grip fall in, you inside pluck them with your free hand, feeding them to Lyric one by one. With each coin, [lyric.heShe] parts [lyric.hisHer] lips, lunges forward, and slurps the coin down, gliding it along [lyric.hisHer] tongue before the muffled grating sound of enamel on metal reaches your ears. In a flash, the coin is gone, swallowed down [lyric.hisHer] gullet, and [lyric.hisHer] mouth is open, awaiting the next.
        
        Each time the tang of the electrum hits Lyric's taste buds, [lyric.hisHer] nostrils flare and [lyric.hisHer] tail swishes against the ground once more. From the look on [lyric.hisHer] face, [lyric.heShe]'s perfectly content to sit there forever, letting you feed [lyric.himHer] coin after coin. Feeding Lyric is going to get expensive in a hurry, especially now that [lyric.heShe]'s so big...
        
        When your hands are empty and there are no more coins to feed [lyric.himHer], [lyric.hisHer] eyes open wider and [lyric.hisHer] mouth spreads into a lazy grin. "Thank you, [pc.name]," [lyric.heShe] says giddily. "You know how much I love electrum."
        
        When you have more to spend, [lyric.heShe]'ll be the first to know.
    ]
rows.translation:
你将手伸进钱袋，一次尽可能多地取出硬币——只要你的手指能够一次抓取那么多就行。如今，莉里克已经变得大很多了，这意味着[lyric.hisHer]食欲大概也是随之增加的吧。[lyric.himHer]让你的龙挨饿是绝对不可接受的。
    
    [lyric.isDom
        |而莉里克，则缓缓地向你靠近[lyric.hisHer]跪在地上。[lyric.hisHer]迷人地眯起了眼睛：“我渴望得到很多东西。[lyric.heShe]并特别强调说[lyric.hisHer]关键点，[lyric.hisHer]一条细长而仿佛属于巨龙的舌头从那里滑了出来。[lyric.hisHer]湿润那些干裂的嘴唇。“暂时就用琥珀金币吧。”

当你将紧握的拳头从袋子里抽出来的那一刻，[lyric.hisHer]自己的双手正伸向前方，轻轻握住你的前臂。[lyric.HeShe]使你的心灵得以敞开[lyric.hisHer]它们用嘴轻触你的手指，鼓励你张开手，让硬币掉落下来。硬币真的落下了，它们相互碰撞，发出清脆的声响，而莉里克则将它们轻轻滚动着[lyric.hisHer]将舌头伸出来，让硬币聚集在舌头下面。[lyric.hisHer]脸颊。
        
        [lyric.HeShe]既不咀嚼，也不[lyric.heShe]吞下：[lyric.heShe]让这笔钱继续闲置着吧。[lyric.hisHer]脸颊[lyric.hisHer]将舌头完全伸出来，舔食手指和手掌上残留的琥珀金币元素。[lyric.HisHer]所有人都在注视着你，目光紧盯着你。[lyric.hisHer]眉头紧锁。你知道自己的手现在正放在龙的嘴里，龙也明白这一点。你知道莉里克永远不会咬你……但是[lyric.heShe]你知道的，就是那样。[lyric.heShe]知道这一点。[lyric.heShe]已经有过[lyric.hisHer]有趣，[lyric.heShe]在收回手指之前，会最后用舌头再舔一遍手指，把上面的口水擦干净。[lyric.HisHer]幸福地闭上双眼，然后轻轻咬了几口[lyric.hisHer]那些牙齿像串葡萄一样嵌在琥珀金币金属上。[lyric.heShe]燕子，[lyric.hisHer]浓重的雾气顺着金属管道向下流动。就这样，一切都消失了。

——莉里克的开头[lyric.hisHer]眼睛，紧紧地盯着你的眼睛。[lyric.HeShe]发出一声愉悦的叹息，[lyric.hisHer]热气扑在你的、此刻已经湿润的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]在[lyric.heShe]之前终于可以让你走了。“太美味了。[lyric.heShe]低语声，[lyric.hisHer]尾巴懒洋洋地摆动着，但摆动的幅度足够大[lyric.hisHer]但是现在，我想要尝试一些不一样的东西。”

在经历了这一切之后，你陷入了僵局，无法动弹了[lyric.heShe]你刚刚做了那件事。你能感觉到自己的脸颊……以及其他部位都在发热、变得通红[weightedRand 5 95
            |太多了吗？太浓了么？”莉里克一边问道，一边调整着姿势。[lyric.hisHer]姿态与范围的扩大[lyric.hisHer]用担忧的眼神看着对方，说道：“如果我表现得太过主动或过于强势，请告诉我。” 

你向我保证[lyric.himHer]啊，[lyric.heShe]说着，他的眼神逐渐变得锐利起来。[lyric.hisHer]眼睛，以及继续前行[lyric.hisHer]姿势。“完美。
            |。 这首歌的旋律带着一丝得意的满足感轻轻响起，[lyric.hisHer]舌头伸出来舔食[lyric.hisHer]再次轻启双唇。
        ]
        | 哦哦哦！”莉里克兴奋地叫道。[lyric.heShe]向你迈出一大步，然后跪在你面前，准备接受你的给予。[lyric.hisHer]作为一条如此出色的龙，你理应得到这样的奖励。[lyric.HisHer]粗壮的手指用力地按在身后的地面上。[lyric.himHer]自己都几乎无法抑制住那种想要得到更多电银来吃的冲动。

它并没有张开拳头让手中的所有硬币都掉出来，而是用空闲的手一颗一颗地将它们取出，然后喂给莉里克。每一枚硬币都被它如此小心地处理[lyric.heShe]零件[lyric.hisHer]嘴唇微张，身体前倾，将硬币含在口中，轻轻一滑将其吞了下去。[lyric.hisHer]就在那金属与珐琅相互摩擦发出的沉闷声响传入你耳中之前，硬币已经消失不见了，被吞了下去。[lyric.hisHer]食道，以及[lyric.hisHer]嘴巴大张，期待着下一口。

每当那种银色的金属味道刺激到莱瑞克的味蕾时，[lyric.hisHer]鼻孔张得大大的，[lyric.hisHer]尾巴再次拍打着地面。从那样子来看[lyric.hisHer]脸庞，[lyric.heShe]完全乐意永远待在那个地方，让你来喂它。[lyric.himHer]一枚又一枚硬币……给莉里克喂食这些东西很快就会花费一大笔钱，尤其是现在这种情况。[lyric.heShe]太大了……”

当你的双手空空如也，再也没有硬币可以投入其中时[lyric.himHer]， [lyric.hisHer]眼睛瞪得更大了，[lyric.hisHer]咧开嘴，露出一个懒散的笑容：“谢谢。[pc.name]，” [lyric.heShe]兴奋地说道：“你知道我有多喜欢电银吧。”

当你有更多的钱可以花费的时候，[lyric.heShe]我会是第一个知道的人。
    ]

莉莉克已经不再是一个小小的狗头人了。她的体型已经[lyric.hisHers]它需要一些适当的“养分”——如果你营养不良，肯定不会喜欢的。而巧的是，你的袋子里还有一些琥珀金币，这些钱正好可以派上用场。你的袋子已经装好了所有需要的东西：里面装满了叮当作响的硬币，而这一切都是为了莉里克。
    
    [lyric.isDom
        |起初，莉里克并没有接受这个提议。事实上，[lyric.heShe]转动[lyric.hisHer]嗤之以鼻。但是，过了一会儿，[lyric.heShe]向前迈出一步，轻轻地将……放置到位。[lyric.hisHer]你把手放在胸前，无声地示意你向后倒下。这个要求确实有些奇怪，尤其是考虑到你们当时讨论的主题……但谁又有资格拒绝自己的龙呢？

        [lyric.HeShe]用两根手指撑开袋子的口，然后将其移到你的腹部上方，将那些闪闪发光、叮当作响的硬币轻轻撒在你的身上。[pc.skinFurScales]金属接触身体时带来的突如其来的寒意让你不由得微微一缩，结果有好几枚硬币从你身体的边缘掉落了下去，不过莉里克却毫不在意。[lyric.hisHer]最好将这些硬币尽可能平均地分配开来。[lyric.heShe]一旦袋子变空了，[lyric.heShe]考虑了一下[lyric.hisHer]先移动肩膀，然后再进行相应的操作。[lyric.himHer]压在你的身上，跨坐在你身上，用力将……压在你们两人之间[lyric.hisHer]毫无疑问，应该放在躯干的任意一侧。[lyric.hisHer]目光紧紧锁定在你的身上，[lyric.heShe]弯下身子，伸出手来[lyric.hisHer]舌头开始在你的腹部上舔来舔去，把硬币都舔掉了。

你的手指和脚趾因为感受到莉里克那温暖、湿润、蠕动着的舌头触碰到你的裸露部位而不由自主地蜷缩了起来。[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]。 [lyric.HeShe]非常仔细，会在同一个地方舔上两三次，直到硬币被完全舔干净并吞下去为止。如果你问的话[lyric.heShe]可以告诉你，这样做其实是为了舔掉你身上残留的琥珀金币味道。

每当有硬币被抛出时，这首旋律就会缓缓升高。[lyric.heShe]发现。[lyric.HisHer]背部向后拱起，同时向上抬起[lyric.hisHer]兴奋得跳了起来[lyric.electrumRange 0 200

几分钟后，你忍不住伸伸胳膊、腿，拉长身体，为莉里克腾出更多的活动空间。不过，最终还是很明显[lyric.heShe]只是轻轻舔着你的裸露部分而已[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]每一分钱都被搜刮一空了。[lyric.hisHer]那口巨口早已消失无踪，如今，你们俩正在享受着这样一个格外亲密的时刻。

你……

            |

“嗯，[lyric.heShe]开始时显得有些胆怯。[lyric.HeShe]忍不住紧张地笑了起来：“当我们单独在一起的时候，你能不能……对我做那个？”
什么，把硬币吃掉吗？[lyric.hisHer]不一定是硬币啊！[lyric.heShe]迅速说道，同时挥了挥手。[lyric.hisHer]把手指朝你伸出来，就像在说“来啊，试试看”一样。[lyric.heShe]当时正试图阻止一头冲过来的公牛。“你可以把它想象成任何你想想象的东西。只是[lyric.HisHer]脸颊变得通红，呈现出深黄色的色调[lyric.hisHer]轻轻啃咬[lyric.hisHer]下唇轻触着。“我只是希望你能对我这样做，仅此而已。我也想体验那种感觉。”

你轻笑了一声，表示会认真考虑这个请求。

要是你负担不起，就不会提出来给[lyric.himHer]了。你叫[lyric.himHer]屈下[lyric.hisHer]双膝跪好，张大嘴巴。

rows.raw: " You know what? Lyric's been especially well-behaved lately. And a body like [lyric.hisHers] needs a lot of intake to stay healthy. You think [lyric.heShe] deserves a fitting reward. From your belt, you withdraw a pouch – a particularly fat one, sagging and bulging with exactly one hundred electrum coins that you had counted when you had a free moment. The leather of the sack is barely held together with all of the coins stuffed inside of it, and the mouth of the pouch doesn't close properly. It's not meant to hold so much money – but, thankfully for it, it's not going to be stuffed so full for long. You tell [lyric.himHer] that you hope one hundred coins is a suitable 'snack'. Lyric is initially taken aback by the sheer size of the pouch[lyric.isDom |. But, at the sight of it, [lyric.heShe] quickly regains [lyric.hisHer] composure – and a smug, cocksure grin spreads across [lyric.hisHer] face. "Give it here," [lyric.heShe] says, offering [lyric.hisHer] upturned left hand, fingers splayed, expecting you to place the bag in [lyric.hisHer] palm. You do so. Rather than pull the mouth of the bag apart and dump the whole thing into [lyric.hisHer] mouth, [lyric.heShe] instead, with [lyric.hisHer] free hand, pinches [lyric.hisHer] thumb and index finger together, then reaches into the bag and withdraws a single coin. "Purse your lips," [lyric.heShe] instructs, presenting the coin's edge to your mouth. It's an unusual ask: it's supposed to be Lyric's treat. But you do as [lyric.heShe] says, and with your [pc.lipsChaste] tightened against each other, [lyric.heShe] presses the coin between them, sticking out halfway from your mouth. [lyric.HeShe] doesn't push it in any further. Then, with the coin still halfway in your mouth, [lyric.heShe] leans forward, pressing [lyric.hisHer] own scaly lips to yours. With a slow, thorough swipe of [lyric.hisHer] tongue, the coin is swished from your mouth – [lyric.hisHer] tongue dipping an inch into your maw – and pressed into [lyric.hisHer] own. Lyric leans back and shows off the coin in [lyric.hisHer] own mouth, standing on its edge between [lyric.hisHer] lips with a toothy smile. With a flip of [lyric.hisHer] lips, it vanishes into [lyric.hisHer] mouth, and [lyric.hisHer] jaw presses down, [lyric.hisHer] teeth easily cutting through the metal with a satisfying crunch. "That's one," [lyric.heShe] says as [lyric.heShe] reaches back into the pouch with [lyric.hisHer] thumb and index finger. "Only ninety-nine left to go." You two repeat the process, one coin at a time. By the tenth coin, you're on your knees, and Lyric is right down with you, sitting on [lyric.hisHer] haunches and feeding [lyric.himHer]self coins with your mouth. It's slow – what feels like half an hour later, you've only gotten through twenty coins. Lyric stops showing off the coin in between [lyric.hisHer] own lips after the first one, opting to go straight from eating the coin to putting another between your lips. Though you're comfortable and secure in the camp you've set up, you can't help but feel like there's something... off. The energy in the air is a bit more charged than you're used to, especially for what is supposed to be a more relaxed environment.

        |
        | and tending to her [arona.weapon] absentmindedly in between bites
        |, holding a one-sided conversation with [comp2.name] in between bites
    ]. The light of the fire wicks off her dark green skin[dayNight
        |
        | and casts a long shadow behind herself, disappearing into the darkness
    ].
    
    Not an unusual sight... but, just off to the side, outside of Arona's peripheral vision, is Lyric. Normally [lyric.heShe] [lyric.isTall
        |tends to [lyric.hisHer] own business, doing whatever experiments and chemical calculations that comes to [lyric.hisHer] mind
        |remains quiet and still inside your pack, keeping nice and warm in the heat of the campfire
    ], but now, [lyric.heShe]'s standing stock-still, staring daggers so sharp in Arona's direction that you can practically hear them cut the air between them. [lyric.HisHer] mouth moves on its own as [lyric.heShe] talks to [lyric.himHer]self – is [lyric.heShe] rehearsing what [lyric.heShe] wants to say?
    
    From the look on Lyric's face, there's going to be an altercation between [lyric.himHer] and Arona. [pc.isDK
        |Frankly, it ought to make for a good show: [lyric.isTall
            |Arona would sooner challenge Lyric to a fight than to justify herself for whatever it is Lyric's mad about
            |Arona is nearly twice Lyric's height, and who knows how many times [lyric.hisHer] weight. It's not going to end well for the kobold
        ]. Although, you suppose, you'd better be on-hand just to make sure Arona doesn't kill [lyric.himHer].
        |You don't know what Lyric's so mad about, but you ought to put a stop to things before it escalates: [lyric.isTall
            |[lyric.heShe] might be a touch taller[lyric.electrumRange 0 400
                |, and maybe heavier,
            ] than Arona, but Lyric isn't a fighter – if [lyric.heShe]'s looking for trouble, Arona's going to fold [lyric.himHer] in half, and then in half again
            |Lyric is half Arona's height, and Arona's idea of ‘de-escalation' usually involves her fists, if it doesn't involve her other body parts
        ].
    ]
    
    [pc.isDK
        |You let Lyric approach Arona
        |Before you can try and distract Lyric, [lyric.heShe] approaches Arona
    ], [lyric.isTall
        |[lyric.hisHer] feet stomping on the ground hard enough that you can feel the vibrations from where you are
        |lifting [lyric.hisHer] knees and stomping down with every step to try and amp [lyric.himHer]self up, but all it's really doing is hurting [lyric.hisHer] ankles
    ]. "You!" [lyric.heShe] shouts accusatorily, [lyric.hisHer] finger jutting in Arona's direction. "Arona!"

        |
        |Arona tilts her head in Lyric's direction at the sound of her name
        |[comp2.name], recognizing the posture in Lyric's gait, opts to take [comp2.hisHer] leave before things get ugly. Arona tilts her head in Lyric's direction at the sound of her name
    ], [lyric.isTall
        |tilting her gaze upward slightly to look into [lyric.hisHer] golden eyes

    ]. "Oh," she says, [lyric.isTall
        |lifting her eyebrows as she eyes Lyric. "‘Sup, [lyric.mf
            |fella
            |girl
        ]?"
        |putting her hands on her thighs as she bends at the waist, looking straight down at Lyric. "It's the team mascot! What'cha need, pint-size?"
    ]
    
    The gravity of what Lyric's just done catches up with [lyric.himHer]: [lyric.isTall
        |for as tall and draconic as [lyric.heShe] is now, [lyric.heShe] doesn't know the first thing about fighting. Arona's left bicep is the size of [lyric.hisHer] head.
        |Arona is so gigantic compared to [lyric.himHer] that she could step on [lyric.himHer] by accident
    ]. But, to [lyric.hisHer] credit – and your [pc.isDK
        |mild

    "Y-You need to answer for the... the barbaric orc practice of capturing slaves!" [lyric.heShe] demands. "How can y-you orcs think you're so high-and-mighty like that? My entire village was captured by orcs! They might all be dead, for all I know! I might never see any of them again, and for what? Money? So you can buy a bigger boat?!"

Arona said two sentences and Lyric’s green scales are already turning red from the blood rushing to [lyric.hisHer] face. Arona is being flippant; Lyric is easily distracted. Mediating the topic to stay on-course would be helpful for everyone.

“你竟敢这样！”莉里克再次大声喊道，同时将两人都拽了过来。[lyric.hisHer]全力以赴，试图取得成功[lyric.himHer]让自己显得更重要。[lyric.HeShe]不过，它可没蠢到会去招惹阿罗娜。尽管莱瑞克试图恐吓它，阿罗娜却连眼睛都没眨一下。“我可不只是个奴隶，阿罗娜，所有狗头人都是这样的！在兽人把我从家人身边夺走之前，我也有自己的生活——我有自己的社区，有属于自己的生活……我现在想要一个解释，想要知道他们去哪里了！
    
    [pc.isDK
        |虽然看着莉里克这样手忙脚乱、不知所措确实挺有趣的，但你至少应该试着调停这场冲突吧。
        |这种情况持续下去，莉里克受伤的可能性就会越大——即使不是被阿罗娜伤害，也会受到其他人的伤害。[lyric.himHer]自我。还有，其他一些东西。[lyric.heShe]从一开始，这就毫无意义。
    ]
    
    你可以采用几种不同的方法来进行调解。最简单直接的方法就是告诉莉里克[lyric.heShe]谈话是从中间开始的，所以阿罗娜自然不知道发生了什么。[lyric.hisHer]甚至为此感到沮丧。深吸一口气，重新开始，这次从头开始，才会对解决问题最有帮助。[lyric.hisHer]传达信息。
    
    [arona.isDom
        |另一种让阿罗娜听你的话的方法，就是用某种方式来吸引她——嗯，实在找不到更合适的词，就叫“用她的尊严”来吸引她吧。虽然你永远不会当面这么说，但她其实是个很简单的人：她喜欢拥有权力、喜欢掌控一切，而你也已经了解到，利用这一点来吸引她的注意，是很容易让她听你说话的。用甜言蜜语总比严厉斥责更有效，就是这个道理。
        |另一种方法是，你可以迫使阿罗娜保持安静，让莉莉克来发言。[lyric.hisHer]阿罗娜是个身材高大的女人，她在同龄人中享有很高的威望——但她会听从你的命令。莉里克需要重新开始这段对话，但如果你出面要求阿罗娜尊重莉里克，至少让她停止那种称呼方式，应该会有效果。[lyric.himHer]无论是你的宠物还是别的什么，她都会这么做的。
    ]
    
    第三种方法是继续探讨谈话中明显涉及的主题：奴隶制。这个话题对阿罗娜来说非常重要，而对莉里克来说更是如此。阿罗娜只说了两句话，但莉里克的绿色鳞片就已经因为血液涌动而变成了红色。[lyric.hisHer]面对这种情况，阿罗娜表现得太过轻率，而莉里克也容易分心。如果有人能适时引导讨论，让话题回到正轨上，对大家来说都会很有帮助。
rows.raw:
"
    Though you're comfortable and secure in the camp you've set up, you can't help but feel like there's something... off. The energy in the air is a bit more charged than you're used to, especially for what is supposed to be a more relaxed environment.
    
    Off on the other side of the campfire is Arona, minding her own business: she's busy devouring a slab of nondescript meat by whole mouthfuls[party.som
        |
        | and tending to her [arona.weapon] absentmindedly in between bites
        |, holding a one-sided conversation with [comp2.name] in between bites
    ]. The light of the fire wicks off her dark green skin[dayNight
        |
        | and casts a long shadow behind herself, disappearing into the darkness
    ].
    
    Not an unusual sight... but, just off to the side, outside of Arona's peripheral vision, is Lyric. Normally [lyric.heShe] [lyric.isTall
        |tends to [lyric.hisHer] own business, doing whatever experiments and chemical calculations that comes to [lyric.hisHer] mind
        |remains quiet and still inside your pack, keeping nice and warm in the heat of the campfire
    ], but now, [lyric.heShe]'s standing stock-still, staring daggers so sharp in Arona's direction that you can practically hear them cut the air between them. [lyric.HisHer] mouth moves on its own as [lyric.heShe] talks to [lyric.himHer]self – is [lyric.heShe] rehearsing what [lyric.heShe] wants to say?
    
    From the look on Lyric's face, there's going to be an altercation between [lyric.himHer] and Arona. [pc.isDK
        |Frankly, it ought to make for a good show: [lyric.isTall
            |Arona would sooner challenge Lyric to a fight than to justify herself for whatever it is Lyric's mad about
            |Arona is nearly twice Lyric's height, and who knows how many times [lyric.hisHer] weight. It's not going to end well for the kobold
        ]. Although, you suppose, you'd better be on-hand just to make sure Arona doesn't kill [lyric.himHer].
        |You don't know what Lyric's so mad about, but you ought to put a stop to things before it escalates: [lyric.isTall
            |[lyric.heShe] might be a touch taller[lyric.electrumRange 0 400
                |, and maybe heavier,
            ] than Arona, but Lyric isn't a fighter – if [lyric.heShe]'s looking for trouble, Arona's going to fold [lyric.himHer] in half, and then in half again
            |Lyric is half Arona's height, and Arona's idea of ‘de-escalation' usually involves her fists, if it doesn't involve her other body parts
        ].
    ]
    
    [pc.isDK
        |You let Lyric approach Arona
        |Before you can try and distract Lyric, [lyric.heShe] approaches Arona
    ], [lyric.isTall
        |[lyric.hisHer] feet stomping on the ground hard enough that you can feel the vibrations from where you are
        |lifting [lyric.hisHer] knees and stomping down with every step to try and amp [lyric.himHer]self up, but all it's really doing is hurting [lyric.hisHer] ankles
    ]. "You!" [lyric.heShe] shouts accusatorily, [lyric.hisHer] finger jutting in Arona's direction. "Arona!"
    
    [party.som
        |
        |Arona tilts her head in Lyric's direction at the sound of her name
        |[comp2.name], recognizing the posture in Lyric's gait, opts to take [comp2.hisHer] leave before things get ugly. Arona tilts her head in Lyric's direction at the sound of her name
    ], [lyric.isTall
        |tilting her gaze upward slightly to look into [lyric.hisHer] golden eyes
        |looking around in confusion for a moment before tilting her head down towards the diminutive kobold
    ]. "Oh," she says, [lyric.isTall
        |lifting her eyebrows as she eyes Lyric. "‘Sup, [lyric.mf
            |fella
            |girl
        ]?"
        |putting her hands on her thighs as she bends at the waist, looking straight down at Lyric. "It's the team mascot! What'cha need, pint-size?"
    ]
    
    The gravity of what Lyric's just done catches up with [lyric.himHer]: [lyric.isTall
        |for as tall and draconic as [lyric.heShe] is now, [lyric.heShe] doesn't know the first thing about fighting. Arona's left bicep is the size of [lyric.hisHer] head.
        |Arona is so gigantic compared to [lyric.himHer] that she could step on [lyric.himHer] by accident
    ]. But, to [lyric.hisHer] credit – and your [pc.isDK
        |mild 
    ]surprise – after a brief moment's hesitation, Lyric doesn't back down.
    
    "Y-You need to answer for the... the barbaric orc practice of capturing slaves!" [lyric.heShe] demands. "How can y-you orcs think you're so high-and-mighty like that? My entire village was captured by orcs! They might all be dead, for all I know! I might never see any of them again, and for what? Money? So you can buy a bigger boat?!"
    
    Arona's brow furrows, not in anger or frustration, but in confusion. She narrows her eyes as she tries to parse what it is that Lyric is even shouting about. Out of the corner of her eye, she sees you, and her attention quickly diverts to you from Lyric. "Hey, [pc.name]," she calls, crooking her finger for you to approach. "Your pet is barking at me for some reason."
    
    "How dare you!" Lyric shouts again, reeling both of [lyric.hisHer] arms back to try and make [lyric.himHer]self seem bigger. [lyric.HeShe]'s smarter than to try and make a swing at Arona, though, and despite Lyric's attempts at intimidation, Arona doesn't even blink. "I'm m-more than a slave, Arona, all kobolds are! I had a life before the orcs tore me from my family – my entire community apart, and I... I want closure! Answers! I want you to tell me where they went!"
    
    [pc.isDK
        |As amusing as it is to see Lyric flail and flounder like this, you should probably at least try and mediate this conflict a bit.
        |The longer this goes on, the more liable that Lyric is to get hurt, if not from Arona, then from [lyric.himHer]self. That, and [lyric.heShe]'s not making sense from the start.
    ]
    
    There are a few different ways you could approach your mediation. The easiest and most direct way is to tell Lyric that [lyric.heShe]’s started the conversation from the middle – it’s natural that Arona has no idea what [lyric.hisHer]'s even upset about. Taking a breath and starting over, this time from the beginning, would be most beneficial to getting [lyric.hisHer] message across.
    
    [arona.isDom
        |Another way to try and get Arona to listen is to appeal to her – well, for lack of a better word, her majesty. Although you’d never say this to her face, she’s a pretty simple woman: she likes being large and in charge, and you’ve learned that appealing to that side of her is an easy way to get her attention. Lyric will attract more flies with honey than with vinegar, and all that.
        |Another way is for you to compel Arona to be quiet and let Lyric say [lyric.hisHer] piece. Arona is a large woman, and commands a lot of respect from her peers – but she answers to you. Lyric will need to start the conversation over, but if you were to take charge and tell Arona to respect Lyric, at least enough to stop calling [lyric.himHer] your pet or whatever, she would do it.
    ]
    
    The third approach is to press on what the topic of conversation is apparently about: slavery. It's a salient, relevant topic to both Arona and especially Lyric. Arona said two sentences and Lyric’s green scales are already turning red from the blood rushing to [lyric.hisHer] face. Arona is being flippant; Lyric is easily distracted. Mediating the topic to stay on-course would be helpful for everyone.
    "

rows.original: [var0 |You tell Lyric to take a breath. Arona was minding her own business, when [lyric.heShe] started shouting at her as if they were already knee-deep in a conversation. It’s natural that she’d be confused and disoriented. Keeping a steady tone, you tell Lyric to start the conversation from the beginning. Despite the frustration in [lyric.hisHer] voice and in [lyric.hisHer] body language, [lyric.heShe] listens to you, finding guidance and direction in your words and voice. Although [lyric.heShe]’s visibly upset, [lyric.heShe] closes [lyric.hisHer] eyes and takes a long, deep breath before opening them again. |You interrupt Lyric, waving your hand in front of [lyric.hisHer] face to get [lyric.hisHer] attention. You tell [lyric.himHer] that Arona likes it when people try to appeal to her particulars and sensibilities – everyone likes compliments, and all. You even try the flies-and-honey line with [lyric.himHer]. "[pc.name] gets it," Arona says with a smug grin on her face. "Good boys and girls get the attention from their big boss lady." "No chance!" Lyric shouts, turning [lyric.hisHer] icy, sharp stare in your direction. "[pc.name], you don't even know what it is I'm angry about, and you want me to start licking her boots before I even start to say my piece?!" [lyric.HisHer] eyes shut and [lyric.heShe] lowers [lyric.hisHer] head, pinching the bridge of [lyric.hisHer] snout in frustration. This, uh, didn't quite go the way you thought it would. Arona snorts derisively, and you worry that she'll end the conversation right then and there, but, fortunately, she remains still while Lyric collects [lyric.himHer]self. |You preface what you're about to say by clarifying that you're not taking sides. You haven't heard the argument one way or the other; you don't even know what Lyric is mad about, aside from it being something over slavery. That said, you tell Arona that she needs to be more courteous. Lyric is clearly upset, and whipping out pet names and belittling language isn't going to make things any better. You tell Lyric to start from the beginning of the conversation – the very beginning. [lyric.HeShe] came at Arona halfway through having already made up [lyric.hisHer] mind – and you tell Arona to let Lyric speak [lyric.hisHer] whole piece before responding. "Thank you, [pc.name]," Lyric says, giving Arona a smarmy grin. [pc.isDK |You tell [lyric.himHer] to wipe it off [lyric.hisHer] face: you just said you're not taking sides. |You remind [lyric.himHer] that you're not taking sides, and to not assume that you're immediately on [lyric.hisHers]. ] The smile evaporates. Arona snorts, then rights her posture, remaining silent while Lyric collects [lyric.himHer]self before starting over. |[pc.isDK |You tell Arona to stop being a shit-disturber, and you tell Lyric to start over |You ask Arona to be patient, and to calm down with the name-calling, and you ask Lyric to start the conversation from the beginning ]. [lyric.HeShe] came into the conversation acting as though [lyric.heShe] and Arona were already knee-deep in it. Whatever it is that [lyric.heShe]'s upset about, it clearly has something to do with slavery and orcish slave trades, which is a deeply relevant topic to them both. Arona can't listen if Lyric can't form a clear thought, and neither of them will come to a resolution the way this is going. Arona [pc.isDK |snickers, but takes your words at their face value |hums as she considers your input, then decides to act on your council ] and keeps her mouth shut, righting her posture as she waits for Lyric to start castigating her properly. Lyric, likewise, closes [lyric.hisHer] eyes, takes a breath, and motions to the ground, as if trying to talk [lyric.himHer]self down from saying or doing anything drastic. After a few breaths, [lyric.heShe]'s ready to start again. ] "I used to live in the jungles down south," Lyric starts, [lyric.hisHer] eyes remaining steadfast on Arona's. "I lived in a village with a community of other kobolds. We had a Village Mother that looked after us all." "Uh-huh," Arona says. "Then, one day, an orc raiding party invaded my village. They burnt our homes and captured every kobold there. Even our Village Mother, the biggest and strongest of us all, even though she was twice the height of the tallest orc, she didn't stand a chance." "Uh-huh," Arona says with a low, dull tone. Her eyes are starting to cross and you watch her do her best to stifle a yawn. [arona.isDom |You ask her, politely, to try and keep her focus a little longer – this is important to Lyric. Arona sighs hard enough that her nostrils flare, but, at least, her eyes widen and her stance changes to give Lyric a bit more attention. |You snap your fingers and tell Arona to focus. The sound startles her slightly, and she jolts upright a bit; she gives you a wary look before turning her attention back to Lyric, giving your [lyric.isTall |dragon |kobold ] the attention [lyric.heShe] asked for. ] Lyric isn't amused: [lyric.hisHer] lips shut and curl as [lyric.heShe] tries to bite back a more scathing statement. "The point is," [lyric.heShe] continues with a frustrated, downward tone, "my friends and family were kidnapped by orcs and made into slaves. I want to know, Arona, how you could abide by such an evil practice. And if you know where my family was taken, I want you to tell me." Arona's borderline-disinterested expression doesn't change. The most she does is give Lyric a single raised eyebrow. "You think that just because I'm an orc, that means that I had anything to do with the ones that kidnapped your village?" Lyric doesn't answer, and while [lyric.hisHer] back remains straight, [lyric.hisHer] expression falters a bit. "Well–" "For that matter," she continues, her eyebrows arching downward, "you think that, just because I'm an orc, I have anything to do with the slave trade at all?" She crosses her arms [lyric.isTall |as she looks up at Lyric |as she bends over to stare down at Lyric ] judgmentally. "I never would have thought that a kobold, of all things, would be the one to be racist to orcs to my face. I always thought it was gonna be [party.has Kiyoko |that Kiyoko [arona.isDom |bitch |lady ] |one of those uptight kitsune folks ]." As soon as Arona uses that word, Lyric's posture deflates entirely. [lyric.HeShe] had approached Arona with such [pc.isDK |piss and vinegar |a fire in [lyric.hisHer] belly ] that [lyric.heShe] didn't entertain the idea that Arona not only had nothing to do with it, but didn't even practice the slave trade like other tribes did. [pc.isDK |Of course, you know better. You don't know if Arona had anything to do with Lyric's community, but you know that her tribe is involved in the slave trade, and she's just making Lyric take the piss. |But... you're pretty sure that Arona's tribe does work in– ] "I-I'm sorry," Lyric stutters. [lyric.HisHer] shoulders slump and [lyric.isTall |[lyric.heShe] slouches a bit, to bring [lyric.himHer]self to Arona's eye level |[lyric.hisHer] tail coils defensively around [lyric.hisHer] ankles ]. "I didn't mean to be so–" "I mean," Arona shrugs hard enough to make her tits bounce in her bandeau, "I am involved in the slave trade. But it ain't ‘cause I'm an orc." Lyric's eyes go wide and [lyric.heShe] visibly recoils, as if [lyric.heShe] had just been slapped. Arona scratches at her chin thoughtfully. "Or maybe ‘cause it is?" she muses. "We're the best in the business at it, and all. I don't know who else does it like we do." "What the... heck!" Lyric yells, lifting both of [lyric.hisHer] palms upward in disbelief. "Arona!" "If you're looking for an apology, you're not getting one," Arona states flatly. "What would you even want me to apologize for? Look, I can at least tell you this much–" Arona [lyric.isTall |leans backward, almost casually, |rightens her posture ] as she rolls her wrist, as if trying to dismiss Lyric. "Far as I'm aware, the Kervus tribe has never dealt in kobolds. So I'm not involved with your village." From the look in Lyric's eyes, you can't tell if that's good news to [lyric.himHer], or bad news. It means that Lyric can't get personally upset with Arona, but it also means that [lyric.heShe] has one less lead on where [lyric.hisHer] family went, or who they were sold to. "How can you be so cold about this?" [lyric.heShe] asks, [lyric.hisHer] voice lilting slightly as if [lyric.heShe]'s a sentence away from crying. "How can an orc just... wake up one day and say 'I'm going to sell someone smaller than me to someone else'?" Arona's lips curl downward as she seriously considers the question. She crosses her arms and narrows her eyes – her expression isn't easily readable. Almost like she wants to feel sorry for Lyric, but, for whatever reason, she can't. "You know how farmers aren't supposed to name their cows and their chickens?" she asks. "Because that means they're bonding with animals that they're meant to slaughter?" The second Arona equates slaves to farm animals, you decide that now might be a good time to interrupt. On the one hand, Lyric has every right to be angry. Arona just called [lyric.himHer] and [lyric.hisHer] people livestock. Lyric had to live through the experience of [lyric.hisHer] entire village being raided, captured, chained up, abused, and sold off. The ones that died in the raid might have been the lucky ones. Slavery is one of the deepest, most sinister evils in the world, and while you're still just trying to mediate the conversation to make sure things don't escalate, you could side with Lyric, at least insofar as not comparing kobolds to chattel. On the other... slavery is simply a fact of the world. Orcs are 'the best in the business at it'. Nothing short of a revolution would stop the orcish slave trade, and Lyric getting mad at it, while understandable, would be like trying to push the tides back in, especially given that Arona is just one woman in one tribe[arona.isChief |, even if she was the boss of them all ]. Arona is approaching this conversation very flippantly and casually, because she understands that there's nothing to be done about it. It's like getting mad at the weather. Maybe siding with Arona would help convince Lyric to end the conversation before [lyric.heShe] gets even madder over something [lyric.heShe] has no control over. Alternatively, you could say nothing. Take no sides and continue to observe and mediate. After all, you have no skin in the slave trade on either side.

Lyric shouts, turning [lyric.hisHer] icy, sharp stare in your direction. "[pc.name], you don't even know what it is I'm angry about, and you want me to start licking her boots before I even start to say my piece?!" You haven't heard the argument one way or the other; you don't even know what Lyric is mad about, aside from it being something over slavery. That said, you tell Arona that she needs to be more courteous. Lyric is clearly upset, and whipping out pet names and belittling language isn't going to make things any better. You tell Lyric to start from the beginning of the conversation – the very beginning. [lyric.HeShe] came at Arona halfway through having already made up [lyric.hisHer] mind – and you tell Arona to let Lyric speak [lyric.hisHer] whole piece before responding. "Thank you, [pc.name]," Lyric says, giving Arona a smarmy grin. [pc.isDK |You tell [lyric.himHer] to wipe it off [lyric.hisHer] face: you just said you're not taking sides. |You remind [lyric.himHer] that you're not taking sides, and to not assume that you're immediately on [lyric.hisHers]. ] The smile evaporates. Arona snorts, then rights her posture, remaining silent while Lyric collects [lyric.himHer]self before starting over. |[pc.isDK |You tell Arona to stop being a shit-disturber, and you tell Lyric to start over |You ask Arona to be patient, and to calm down with the name-calling, and you ask Lyric to start the conversation from the beginning ]. [lyric.HeShe] came into the conversation acting as though [lyric.heShe] and Arona were already knee-deep in it. Whatever it is that [lyric.heShe]'s upset about, it clearly has something to do with slavery and orcish slave trades, which is a deeply relevant topic to them both. Arona can't listen if Lyric can't form a clear thought, and neither of them will come to a resolution the way this is going. Arona [pc.isDK |snickers, but takes your words at their face value |hums as she considers your input, then decides to act on your council ] and keeps her mouth shut, righting her posture as she waits for Lyric to start castigating her properly. She crosses her arms [lyric.isTall |as she looks up at Lyric |as she bends over to stare down at Lyric ] judgmentally. I always thought it was gonna be [party.has Kiyoko |that Kiyoko [arona.isDom |bitch |lady ] |one of those uptight kitsune folks ]." As soon as Arona uses that word, Lyric's posture deflates entirely. [lyric.HeShe] had approached Arona with such [pc.isDK |piss and vinegar |a fire in [lyric.hisHer] belly ] that [lyric.heShe] didn't entertain the idea that Arona not only had nothing to do with it, but didn't even practice the slave trade like other tribes did. [pc.isDK |Of course, you know better. You don't know if Arona had anything to do with Lyric's community, but you know that her tribe is involved in the slave trade, and she's just making Lyric take the piss. |But... you're pretty sure that Arona's tribe does work in– ] "I-I'm sorry," Lyric stutters. [lyric.HisHer] shoulders slump and [lyric.isTall |[lyric.heShe] slouches a bit, to bring [lyric.himHer]self to Arona's eye level |[lyric.hisHer] tail coils defensively around [lyric.hisHer] ankles ]. "I didn't mean to be so–" "I mean," Arona shrugs hard enough to make her tits bounce in her bandeau, "I am involved in the slave trade. But it ain't ‘cause I'm an orc." Lyric's eyes go wide and [lyric.heShe] visibly recoils, as if [lyric.heShe] had just been slapped. Arona scratches at her chin thoughtfully. "Or maybe ‘cause it is?" she muses. "We're the best in the business at it, and all. I don't know who else does it like we do." "What the... heck!" Lyric yells, lifting both of [lyric.hisHer] palms upward in disbelief. "Arona!" "If you're looking for an apology, you're not getting one," Arona states flatly. "What would you even want me to apologize for? Look, I can at least tell you this much–" Arona [lyric.isTall |leans backward, almost casually, |rightens her posture ] as she rolls her wrist, as if trying to dismiss Lyric. "Far as I'm aware, the Kervus tribe has never dealt in kobolds. So I'm not involved with your village." From the look in Lyric's eyes, you can't tell if that's good news to [lyric.himHer], or bad news. It means that Lyric can't get personally upset with Arona, but it also means that [lyric.heShe] has one less lead on where [lyric.hisHer] family went, or who they were sold to. "How can you be so cold about this?" [lyric.heShe] asks, [lyric.hisHer] voice lilting slightly as if [lyric.heShe]'s a sentence away from crying. "How can an orc just... wake up one day and say 'I'm going to sell someone smaller than me to someone else'?" Arona's lips curl downward as she seriously considers the question. She crosses her arms and narrows her eyes – her expression isn't easily readable. Almost like she wants to feel sorry for Lyric, but, for whatever reason, she can't. "You know how farmers aren't supposed to name their cows and their chickens?" she asks. "Because that means they're bonding with animals that they're meant to slaughter?" The second Arona equates slaves to farm animals, you decide that now might be a good time to interrupt. On the one hand, Lyric has every right to be angry. Arona just called [lyric.himHer] and [lyric.hisHer] people livestock. Lyric had to live through the experience of [lyric.hisHer] entire village being raided, captured, chained up, abused, and sold off. The ones that died in the raid might have been the lucky ones. Slavery is one of the deepest, most sinister evils in the world, and while you're still just trying to mediate the conversation to make sure things don't escalate, you could side with Lyric, at least insofar as not comparing kobolds to chattel. On the other... slavery is simply a fact of the world. Orcs are 'the best in the business at it'. Nothing short of a revolution would stop the orcish slave trade, and Lyric getting mad at it, while understandable, would be like trying to push the tides back in, especially given that Arona is just one woman in one tribe[arona.isChief |, even if she was the boss of them all ]. Arona is approaching this conversation very flippantly and casually, because she understands that there's nothing to be done about it. It's like getting mad at the weather. Maybe siding with Arona would help convince Lyric to end the conversation before [lyric.heShe] gets even madder over something [lyric.heShe] has no control over. Alternatively, you could say nothing. Take no sides and continue to observe and mediate. After all, you have no skin in the slave trade on either side. "

rows.original: [var0 |You raise your hands and step between Arona and Lyric. "Whoa," you say a few times as you insert yourself. You tell Arona that, no matter her stance on the subject, equating a person – and that's what kobolds are, they are people – to farm animals is a line too far. You get that she's blunt and honest and is talking from the perspective of the orcs, but in order to have this conversation honestly, she needs to have at least a little bit of empathy. "What other words would you like me to use?" Arona asks simply. "If slaves aren't like cows and chickens, then what are they? Possessions? Pets?" She scratches her chin thoughtfully. "That comes down to the people that buy them, I suppose. Maybe a handful of Lyric's kobold friends were sold to people that treated them like pets. Wouldn't be a bad life, I'd guess[lyric.electrumRange 0 300 | |, especially if they're fed as well as you feed yours, [pc.name] ]." You open your mouth to respond, but Arona jolts in place as she comes to a sudden realization. "Oh, inventory!" she says. "If slaves aren't like farm animals, then that makes them inventory!" She smiles genuinely, as if she had honestly found a middle ground between herself and Lyric. "How does that work instead?" |You raise your hands and step between Arona and Lyric. You tell Lyric that, although she phrased it... probably the worst way she could have phrased it, you understand what it is that she means. What she means is that... slavery... it's not something that either of them have any control over. The orcish slave trade is too ingrained in their society and too widespread for it to stop overnight. Getting mad at one orc isn't going to change anything. And, if Arona is telling the truth, [arona.isChief |she and her tribe |Kervus ] had nothing to do with Lyric's village. "So, what," Lyric starts indignantly, [lyric.hisHer] golden eyes narrowing into thin slivers as [lyric.heShe] stares you down. It's the most aggressive look [lyric.heShe]'s ever given you. "Kobolds should just lie down and let themselves be made into chattel, is that it? Nothing can be done about being kidnapped and sold, so we might as well just let it happen?" Arona laughs slightly behind you. "Damn," she says. "Imagine if a cow talked that way to its farmer." |You can see both sides of the argument. rows.original: Arona pauses her shouting and berating for a moment, watching Lyric cry and cower in front of her[lyric.isTall |. Even after [lyric.hisHer] transformation into a tall dragon, taller than even the towering Arona, [lyric.heShe]'s still the little kobold you knew when you first found [lyric.himHer] ]. But, despite her loud castigations, she doesn't look at Lyric judgmentally or unfavorably. Again, her expression is hard to read. "Tell me something," she begins, her voice returning to the calmer, steadier tone it had before. "I know that girl kobolds can grow to be pretty fuckin' gigantic. Your... Village Mother. Did she put up a fight?" Lyric doesn't answer immediately. "What do you care?" "Just humor me," she sighs. Her patience remains as... well, as thick as it'll ever be. Lyric takes a deep sniff and lets out a shaky sigh. "Yeah." "Yeah?" Arona repeats. "She take out any?" Another pause. "Like... four or five." "Your one kobold Village Mother killed five orc raiders? By herself?" "For all the good it did." Arona hums through pursed lips as she considers how to approach her next sentence. "Bear with me on this, I'm gonna try and make a point," she starts. Which makes a cold jolt run up your spine – opening a statement like that is never a good sign. "Kobolds are worth about eight grand a head[lyric.electrumRange 0 300 |. You... would probably get a little more, with the weight on you ]." Lyric's eyes dart back up to Arona's. Just a second ago, [lyric.heShe] had conceded defeat and just wanted the conversation to end. But with a sentence like that, the fight returns to [lyric.himHer] pretty quickly – that [lyric.heShe] and [lyric.hisHer] people could have their lives be... evaluated like that. "And your Village Mother? She would have been worth... man, hard to say. Tens of thousands." She whistles as she considers it. "She might have been impossible to sell, actually. A kobold that big and that fierce would be more of a commodity – something that would be traded between tribes rather than something we could reasonably sell on a market somewhere." [pc.isDK |You, again, say nothing, and continue to watch the conversation unfold from the sideline. "She is not a 'thing', you jerk!" Lyric bites, [lyric.hisHer] voice breaking from [lyric.hisHer] crying. |You tell Arona to [arona.isDom | |hurry and ]make her point before she makes things worse. And you remind her that kobolds aren't 'things'. Although Lyric still looks like [lyric.heShe]'d get physical with Arona if [lyric.heShe] thought [lyric.heShe]'d stand a chance, [lyric.heShe] relaxes very slightly knowing that [lyric.heShe] has you beside [lyric.himHer]. ] "How much do you think a single orc is worth?" Arona asks. "Serious question." The question takes [pc.isDK | |you and ]Lyric aback. "Uhh," [lyric.heShe] hums, [lyric.hisHer] bloodshot eyes staring at the space around Arona as [lyric.heShe] tries to answer it. "I don't know... I've never considered how much money a person is worth." "Orc slaves are worth a whole lot more than eight thousand," she answers for Lyric. "And, depending on the orc, more than a Village Mother." "Please make your point," Lyric whimpers. "Now that you know how much kobolds are worth, and how much orcs are worth, and how many orcs your Village Mother took out, do you think the orc raiders that kidnapped your village made a profit?" "Even if they didn't, is that supposed to make me feel better?" Arona grunts at Lyric diverting her question like that. "I say this as an orc, knowing that your village was kidnapped by orcs, but it's not orcs you should be blaming," she says with a low growl. "And it's not yourself and your kind for being weaker than orcs. You should be blaming the fact that there's a market for slaves at all. I guarantee that, if slave trading weren't worth so much money, no tribe in the world would have picked a fight with a Village Mother, or the village she was mothering, just for their own stock of slaves." Lyric pauses as [lyric.heShe] considers Arona's viewpoint. [lyric.HeShe]'s still a shaken, sodden, emotional mess, but the more casual tone – and, perhaps, remembering the fight that [lyric.hisHer] Village Mother put up – seems to have relaxed [lyric.himHer] enough that [lyric.heShe] can at least approach the conversation with a slightly more level head. And, knowing that you're standing next to [lyric.himHer] and ensuring that things don't escalate probably helps. "I don't know how easy it's going to be for me to direct my hatred from orcs to [silly |systemic capitalism |the concept of commerce ]," Lyric admits.[pc.ra orc | Then, [lyric.heShe] turns to you sheepishly. "Not counting you, [pc.name]." ] Arona laughs. "I don't blame you. I'd be fuckin' pissed, too. If some rival tribe managed to enslave all of Kervus overnight, but they missed me, the first thing I'd want is revenge. I'd rather level every other stronghold until I got them back than try and, I dunno, steal every coin ever made and melt them all down." Arona extends a finger and places it on Lyric's chin[lyric.isTall | |, lifting [lyric.hisHer] eyes back up to look into hers ]. "Look, Lyric, you don't have to like orcs. You don't have to like me. If you slit my throat in my sleep, I'd get it." She frowns. "You'd better make sure the first slice counts, though." It's one of those absurd, off-the-cuff, and inappropriate jokes that even Lyric can't help but giggle through [lyric.hisHer] wavering breathing. "And, yeah, this sucks to hear and it sucks to say, but orc slave trade isn't stopping[arona.isChief |. Kervus isn't about to stop buying them, and other tribes aren't about to stop selling them ]. We orcs, we're big, we're strong, and we're stupid. It's what we're best at. It's what brings in money. [arona.isChief |I can't just go back home and tell everyone |Even if I were chief, I couldn't just go back home to Kervus and tell everyone ] that the women are picking up sewing and the men are picking up personal training." You have to hand it to Arona: the tension in the air, while not fully evaporated, has eased. Lyric is still uncomfortable and still wants the conversation to be over, but the conversation isn't a total, unmitigated disaster anymore, and everyone can leave dour and frustrated as opposed to angry and hopeless. There's one thing that you've been wondering since you first saw Lyric approach Arona. You ask Lyric what, exactly, [lyric.heShe] hoped [lyric.heShe]'d get out of this conversation. Lyric sniffles again, rubbing [lyric.hisHer] nose with the back of [lyric.hisHer] arm. "I don't know..." [lyric.heShe] admits. "I was hoping... to know where my family was taken, at least." Arona shrugs. "Like I told you, as far as I know, Kervus hasn't dealt with any big shipments of kobolds, so I'm no good there. And even if [arona.isChief |we |they ] did, unless [arona.isChief |we |they ] kept the whole village for [arona.isChief |our |their ] camp, the kobolds would have sold off pretty quick." "I know we ain't friends, Lyric," Arona says with a sigh, her shoulders relaxing. From the tone in her voice, she's looking to wrap the conversation. "The slave trades aren't gonna stop just because one of the slaves didn't like it. Like I said before, you might as well get mad at farmers for raising cows for their meat. And I know you don't like being compared to cows and chickens, but, well..." She stutters as she tries to think of some way to finish that thought without riling Lyric up again. "The best thing I can think to say is that... there are worse evils in the world." "Worse than slavery? Like what?" Lyric asks incredulously. Arona frowns. "I don't know, don't put that shit on me. I'm trying to end this conversation without making things worse." The air hangs heavy and stale between your orc and your [lyric.isTall |dragon |kobold ] for a long moment. You can tell that Lyric is still emotionally [pc.isBimbo |tumul– tummytul– upset |tumultuous ], and that this conversation didn't go even remotely the way [lyric.heShe] wanted, and you don't know if Arona's finishing remarks made things better. Arona, for all her faults, recognizes the same thing: she's unrepentant, blunt, and unabashed about the realities of orc culture, but she's not unsympathetic, and she doesn't want to end this conversation in a worse way than it started. She places her hand on Lyric's [lyric.isTall |shoulder, giving [lyric.himHer] a friendly squeeze |head, giving [lyric.himHer] a reassuring pat, like a pet. ] "And like I said about farmers not naming their animals... I dunno what this means to you, coming from me, but [arona.isDom |[pc.name] is mine, and you belong to [pc.name], which means that you belong to me, too. And that |[pc.name] likes you, and if [pc.name] likes you, that ] means that you're under my protection, too. You don't have to worry about [arona.isDom |belonging to |being stolen by ] anyone else." Lyric hums... but the 'reassurance' does little to assuage [lyric.himHer][lyric.isTall | |. And the longer that Arona's hand rests on [lyric.hisHer] head and pats [lyric.himHer] like a dog, the more [lyric.heShe] gets visibly uncomfortable. It's a tangible relief for [lyric.himHer] when she finally lifts it away ]. [arona.isChief |"You're the chief of the Kervus tribe," [lyric.heShe] says. "Can you at least promise me that you'll... stop kidnapping kobolds?" "Nnnnnn," Arona starts, then has the last-second sensibility to pull back. She's already botched the landing on this conversation enough; denying Lyric this last bit would set her back completely. "Kervus doesn't actually, uh... 'obtain the inventory'. Kervus buys and trades, but we're not the ones that, you know, do the deed." Lyric recognizes the deflection for what it is. "Okay, then can you promise me that you won't do that, then?" Arona briefly hesitates. "I'll, uh... look into it." ] Without anything more to say, Lyric turns about and goes back the way [lyric.heShe] came, without so much as a farewell to either of you.
