rows.original:
"This one's local fare," River says. "Composed this myself couple years ago."

    In the spring of the year
    Our inhibitions disappear
    And our shyness is swept clean away.
    Mallach's soft hand
    Is felt over the land
    And our desires doth go both astray.
    
    The birds and the bees
    Whisper to us on the breeze
    Our bodies are sudden aflame.
    If your loins are stirred,
    You can let yourself be lured
    For in springtime there is no shame.
    
    Young couples run in the fields, seeded in rows
    And perchance do some ploughing without all their clothes.
    
    Now the north wind howls
    The last snaps of its jowls
    And old frost forms on the new grass.
    Huddled by fire and hearth
    There a maid seeks to serve
    ...Her lord by presenting her ass.
    
    People of good Hawkethorne
    No longer feel forlorn
    As the days lengthen and grow bright.
    The season doth inspire
    Them to hold and not tire
    As they make love throughout the night.
    
    Oh, to kiss your man upon his so-called nose,
    Perhaps you're doing such without any clothes?
    
    The baroness does play
    With men coming her way,
    And tease them for the size of their stake.
    She invites them to her keep
    And for the night they do sleep,
    Though in the morning how they do ache!
    
    Passions Mallach brings forth
    Even this far up north
    As this is his hour in the world.
    It's a time to sing and carouse
    And gleefully bring down the house
    As our ardors and affections unfurl!
    
    Ah, to give your lady a single perfect rose,
    Then drag her to bed and tear off her clothes!
    
    The forest is alive
    As the beasts within thrive
    And make up for the lost cold season.
    Not stopping even to sup
    They ensure there'll be pups
    As caution is thrown away with reason.
    
    All this Mallach sees and smiles
    As he employs song and wiles
    To bring love to all who may be found.
    With the wink of an eye
    And an exhausted sigh
    Autumn bellies will be full and round!
    
    For spring is the time to shed your cares and fears and woes
    And with Mallach's proud blessing, also shed your clothes!
rows.translation:
“这是本地的曲子，”瑞弗说道，“几年前由我亲自谱写。”

    每当一年春日来到，
    我们的拘束烟消云消，
    羞怯也被彻底扫掉。
    马拉克温柔的手掌，
    抚遍这一方土壤，
    让我们的欲望双双脱缰。
    
    鸟雀与蜜蜂成群，
    在微风里向我们低吟，
    身体忽然燃起欲火熊熊。
    若你胯间已经骚动，
    就任自己受诱惑放纵，
    春日里何须羞赧惶恐。
    
    年轻情侣在田间奔跑，作物成行播种，
    或许还会赤身裸体，做些犁地的活儿。
    
    如今北风呼啸，
    巨口发出最后的撕咬，
    新生草叶上结起残霜。
    人们挤在炉火旁，
    那里一位侍女想要侍奉，
    ……便将屁股献给她的主人享用。
    
    善良的鹰棘镇居民，
    不再感到孤苦伶仃，
    白昼渐长，阳光日益明亮。
    季节唤起他们的激情，
    让他们相拥而不知疲倦，
    整夜不停交欢缠绵。
    
    哦，亲吻你男人那所谓的“鼻子”，
    也许你正浑身赤裸地如此行事？
    
    女男爵寻欢作乐，
    与送上门的男人逐个取乐，
    还取笑他们肉桩的大小。
    她邀男人们进堡，
    让他们在那里共度良宵，
    可清晨到来时，他们该有多么酸痛！
    
    马拉克唤起的激情，
    即便遥远北方也会降临，
    因为这是他在世间的时辰。
    此刻理当歌唱狂欢，
    欢声笑语掀翻屋梁，
    任热情与爱意尽情绽放！
    
    啊，送给你的女士一朵完美玫瑰，
    再把她拖上床，将她的衣裳尽数撕碎！
    
    森林生机勃发，
    林中野兽茁壮繁衍，
    弥补寒冷季节失去的时光。
    连进食也不肯停下，
    务必确保幼崽降生，
    将谨慎与理智一并抛光。
    
    马拉克看见这一切，笑意盈盈，
    施展歌谣与花言巧语，
    把爱情带给他所找到的每一个人。
    伴着一道眨眼秋波，
    以及一声疲惫叹息，
    秋日里的肚子将会饱满圆润！
    
    春日正该抛却烦恼、恐惧与忧愁，
    在马拉克骄傲的祝福下，也把衣服脱个精光！

rows.original:
"I was inspired when walking through Harvest Valley some years back," River says. " I think you'll like this one."

    As summer draws close, and the days grow warm,
    And the fields grow over with zest,
    My body I rouse, without so much as 'grouse,
    To continue on my yearly quest.
    
    Oh to find a sweet melon, that delicious fruit,
    So full and abundant and lush,
    Oh to hold in your hand, that produce so grand,
    So supple and rich and plush.
    
    A connoisseur of fine melons that I am,
    —To run my hands across smooth skin,
    To nip and squeeze, as I do please,
    And milk the sweet juice within.
    
    If it's melons you speak of, you'd best get a pair,
    For a single melon may as well not be there!
    
    So I put on my best suit, and head out to town,
    Skipping my way to my favorite store.
    The madame I greet as the two of us meet,
    And ask her if she's got melons galore.
    
    "Why, yes!" she tells me, her eyes are alight.
    "I'll have my girls bring them out!
    The melons this year are so precious and dear!
    I'll personally lead you about!"
    
    So the madame brings me upstairs
    To see the melons for show,
    Big and small, fresh and plump all,
    Down the displays I go.
    
    Oh, there's no sight more worthy 'a stare,
    Than a lass with a pair of melons laid bare!
    
    Each fruit I sniff and smell, I touch and feel,
    With love and affection I doth caress.
    Yet something's lacking, for they're not packing
    The qualities they need to possess.
    
    They're proud and plump, firm and full,
    Bearing perfectly right rounded shapes.
    But 'tis to be expected, to not be dejected,
    And not something to cause one to gape.
    
    "Madame, your wares have no great fault.
    And certainly will sell just fine.
    But a gourmet like me, you must agree,
    Needs exceptional fare to dine."
    
    Oh, melons so heavy, with their flesh so pink
    Would one squeeze out their juice, and have a long drink!
    
    With a heavy heart, I leave the city
    Once more my quest has failed.
    My time I bide, in the rolling fields wide
    For my luck has not availed.
    
    The warm noon sun beats down on me
    And in the distance, the bleating of sheep.
    I close my eyes, and let out a sigh
    And before I know it, I'm fast asleep.
    
    I know not what dreams I must have had
    Yet when I wake, the first thing I see
    Are melons so rich, that jiggle and twitch,
    As they hang large and low over me.
    
    Oh, to be so pleasantly surprised,
    To wake up to a rich melon prize!
    
    The fruits belonged to a country lass,
    A tanned girl of the fields and wild.
    She held them back in a thin cloth sack
    For the first in a long time I smiled.
    
    The fine melons she'd brought with her 
    Were doubtless a precious treasure.
    The wild had grown, ones that far outshone
    Store-bought ones for pleasure.
    
    Slowly the lass breathed in and out
    The melons did slightly descend.
    And then I knew, through and through,
    That my quest was at an end.
    
    Oh, melons, this fine fruit we love
    More than any precious golden trove!
      
    I move to free them from their cloth,
    The lass flushes, and does not resist.
    I stroke their tips, then press my lips
    To their smooth skin in a long kiss.
    
    As I behold the melons before my eyes
    And I place one end in my mouth,
    Their firm, ripe meat, it tastes so sweet,
    And I feel a stirring deep down south.
    We find our hands move fine and fast,
    And begin with much ardor and zeal.
    The lass and I, under summer's warm sky,
    Make of her fine melons a meal.
    
    Oh, melons make a fine first course
    Fresh and firm from their very source!
    
    Though I put not much stock in faith,
    Such a thing was surely fated,
    Though a glutton I was, for melons in force,
    My hunger was finally sated.
    
    The best melons ever I did behold,
    No greater ones would I ever taste,
    There and then, in that split second
    I vowed they would not go to waste.
    
    So today the summer sun rises, 
    And the lass, well, she's my wife.
    I wake up each dawn with a lazy yawn
    To enjoy her sweet melons for life.
rows.translation:
几年前，当我漫步在收获谷时，我获得了灵感，”瑞弗说道，“我想你会喜欢这个故事的。”

随着夏天的临近，天气逐渐变暖，
田野里也充满了生机与活力，
我无需任何催促，便立刻起身，
继续我每年都会进行的这段旅程。
    
    哦，能找到那么美味的甜瓜，那种香甜可口的果实，
如此饱满、多汁、鲜嫩，
哦，能将它们握在手中，感受这种丰饶的馈赠，
如此柔软、甘美、诱人。

我可是真正懂得如何品尝美味的甜瓜的人啊，
——我喜欢用手指轻轻抚摸那光滑的果皮，
随意地捏一捏、压一压，然后挤出那甜美的汁液来品尝。
    
    如果你说的是甜瓜，那你最好买上几颗，
因为单独一颗甜瓜的话，其实根本不算什么！

于是我穿上了最漂亮的衣服，前往镇上，
径直去了我最喜欢的那家商店。
当我们见面时，我向那位女店主打了招呼，
然后问她有没有很多甜瓜出售。
    
    哎呀，当然可以！”她兴奋地告诉我，“我会让我的女儿们把它们拿出来给你们看！今年的西瓜真是又珍贵又美味，我亲自带你们去参观吧！”

于是，那位女士带着我上了楼，让我看到了那些陈列出来的西瓜——有大的，有小的，全都新鲜饱满，看起来非常诱人。
    
    哦，没有什么景象比这样一幅画面更值得人们凝视了：
一个少女，那双饱满的乳房完全裸露在空气中！

我仔细地嗅着、触摸着每一个部位，
满怀爱意与温柔地抚摸着它们。
然而，总觉得有些欠缺……因为它们并没有具备
那些应有的特质。
    
    它们饱满而结实，形状圆润美观。
这样的外观本就是理所当然的，不必为此感到沮丧，
更不会让人感到惊奇。

“夫人，您的商品确实没有什么瑕疵，
肯定能卖得很好。但像我这样的美食家，您也必须认同，
需要一些特别精致的食物才能满足我的口味。
    
    哦，那些如此重型的甜瓜，果肉呈现出粉红色的色调，
要是能榨出它们的汁液，喝上一大口该多好啊！

怀着重型的心情，我离开了这座城市，
又一次，我的追求失败了。
我只能在广阔的田野中等待，
因为我的运气始终没有眷顾我。
    
    温暖的午阳照在我身上，  
远处传来羊群的叫声。  
我闭上眼睛，轻轻叹了口气，  
不知不觉中，我就进入了梦乡。  

我不知道自己做了些什么梦，  
但醒来后，我首先看到的是那些鲜嫩多汁的西瓜——它们悬挂在上方，轻轻摇晃着。
    
    哦，真是太令人惊喜了，
一觉醒来，竟然得到这么丰厚的礼物！

这些水果属于一个乡村女孩，
一个皮肤黝黑、生活在田野与大自然中的女孩。
她用一个薄布袋将它们装好带了过来，
因为这一次，我终于露出了久违的微笑。

她带来的这些美味的甜瓜，
无疑是一份珍贵的礼物。
这些在野外生长出来的甜瓜，
品质远胜于市场上购买的那些甜瓜。
    
    少女缓缓地呼吸着，
那些瓜果确实稍微下降了一些。
于是我彻底明白了，
我的追求已经结束了。

哦，这些瓜果啊，我们如此喜爱的美味，
它们比任何珍贵的黄金财宝都要珍贵！

我动手将它们从包裹中取出来，
少女的脸颊泛起了红晕，但她并没有反抗。
我轻轻抚摸着它们的果柄，然后把嘴唇贴在它们光滑的果皮上，
久久地吻着它们。
    
    当我看着眼前的这些甜瓜，
把其中一根放进嘴里，
它们那紧实、成熟的果肉，味道如此甜美，
让我感到一股暖流在体内涌动。
我们的双手动作变得熟练而迅速，
满怀热情与干劲地开始加工这些甜瓜。
在夏日的温暖阳光下，
我和那个女孩一起，将这些美味的甜瓜做成了美食。
    
    哦，瓜果真是完美的开胃菜——
新鲜可口，直接从产地采摘而来！

虽然我并不太相信命运这种东西，
但这样的缘分想必是注定的；
虽然我是个贪吃的人，特别爱吃瓜果，
但这一次，我的饥饿终于得到了满足。

我见过的最美味的瓜果，再没有比这更好的了；
我再也不会品尝到更美味的东西了；
就在那一瞬间，我发誓绝不能让它们被浪费掉。
    
    所以，今天夏日的阳光升起了，  
而那个女孩，她就是我的妻子。  
每个清晨，我都会懒洋洋地打了个哈欠，  
然后开始享受她带来的甜蜜与幸福，一生一世。
rows.raw:
"
    "I was inspired when walking through Harvest Valley some years back," River says. " I think you'll like this one."

    As summer draws close, and the days grow warm,
    And the fields grow over with zest,
    My body I rouse, without so much as 'grouse,
    To continue on my yearly quest.
    
    Oh to find a sweet melon, that delicious fruit,
    So full and abundant and lush,
    Oh to hold in your hand, that produce so grand,
    So supple and rich and plush.
    
    A connoisseur of fine melons that I am,
    —To run my hands across smooth skin,
    To nip and squeeze, as I do please,
    And milk the sweet juice within.
    
    If it's melons you speak of, you'd best get a pair,
    For a single melon may as well not be there!
    
    So I put on my best suit, and head out to town,
    Skipping my way to my favorite store.
    The madame I greet as the two of us meet,
    And ask her if she's got melons galore.
    
    "Why, yes!" she tells me, her eyes are alight.
    "I'll have my girls bring them out!
    The melons this year are so precious and dear!
    I'll personally lead you about!"
    
    So the madame brings me upstairs
    To see the melons for show,
    Big and small, fresh and plump all,
    Down the displays I go.
    
    Oh, there's no sight more worthy 'a stare,
    Than a lass with a pair of melons laid bare!
    
    Each fruit I sniff and smell, I touch and feel,
    With love and affection I doth caress.
    Yet something's lacking, for they're not packing
    The qualities they need to possess.
    
    They're proud and plump, firm and full,
    Bearing perfectly right rounded shapes.
    But 'tis to be expected, to not be dejected,
    And not something to cause one to gape.
    
    "Madame, your wares have no great fault.
    And certainly will sell just fine.
    But a gourmet like me, you must agree,
    Needs exceptional fare to dine."
    
    Oh, melons so heavy, with their flesh so pink
    Would one squeeze out their juice, and have a long drink!
    
    With a heavy heart, I leave the city
    Once more my quest has failed.
    My time I bide, in the rolling fields wide
    For my luck has not availed.
    
    The warm noon sun beats down on me
    And in the distance, the bleating of sheep.
    I close my eyes, and let out a sigh
    And before I know it, I'm fast asleep.
    
    I know not what dreams I must have had
    Yet when I wake, the first thing I see
    Are melons so rich, that jiggle and twitch,
    As they hang large and low over me.
    
    Oh, to be so pleasantly surprised,
    To wake up to a rich melon prize!
    
    The fruits belonged to a country lass,
    A tanned girl of the fields and wild.
    She held them back in a thin cloth sack
    For the first in a long time I smiled.
    
    The fine melons she'd brought with her 
    Were doubtless a precious treasure.
    The wild had grown, ones that far outshone
    Store-bought ones for pleasure.
    
    Slowly the lass breathed in and out
    The melons did slightly descend.
    And then I knew, through and through,
    That my quest was at an end.
    
    Oh, melons, this fine fruit we love
    More than any precious golden trove!
      
    I move to free them from their cloth,
    The lass flushes, and does not resist.
    I stroke their tips, then press my lips
    To their smooth skin in a long kiss.
    
    As I behold the melons before my eyes
    And I place one end in my mouth,
    Their firm, ripe meat, it tastes so sweet,
    And I feel a stirring deep down south.
    We find our hands move fine and fast,
    And begin with much ardor and zeal.
    The lass and I, under summer's warm sky,
    Make of her fine melons a meal.
    
    Oh, melons make a fine first course
    Fresh and firm from their very source!
    
    Though I put not much stock in faith,
    Such a thing was surely fated,
    Though a glutton I was, for melons in force,
    My hunger was finally sated.
    
    The best melons ever I did behold,
    No greater ones would I ever taste,
    There and then, in that split second
    I vowed they would not go to waste.
    
    So today the summer sun rises, 
    And the lass, well, she's my wife.
    I wake up each dawn with a lazy yawn
    To enjoy her sweet melons for life."

rows.original:
"Sausages are marvelous, aren't they?" River says as he starts up a tune. "You can put anything in them!"

    Oh, what goes into a sausage?
    It truly puzzles me!
    For a tube of meat, that's such a treat,
    Pink stuff is all I can see!
    
    You stick them on a skewer,
    And roast them o'er the flame,
    So nice and thick, you eat till you're sick,
    Without any hint of shame!
    
    But I cut one open and looked in,
    To see the stuff inside,
    Is that a spleen? That stuff that's green?
    Or is it a bit of hide?
    
    The butcher called it long pork,
    I think the bugger lied,
    But I can't deny, no matterI try,
    That they taste amazing fried!
    
    So what goes into a sausage?
    Maybe I shouldn't ask,
    For deciphering, all the stuff within
    That sure ain't my task!
    
    You get them from the market,
    Then slather on honey and sauce,
    Buy 'em cheap, don't look too deep,
    And you'll eat like a horse!
    
    They're quite famous, really -
    They love the things down south,
    Rolled intestine, to serve as skin,
    For a dish that pleases the mouth.
    
    Sometimes peppers are in them,
    Onions and garlic, too!
    It's so thrilling, discovering their filling,
    Mixing the old with the new!
    
    But the mainstay of the sausage,
    Is the meat within,
    None can tell, and it's best not to dwell
    Where that odd stuff's been!
    
    So what goes into a sausage?
    Don't give it too much thought,
    Tuck in and relish, in a meal so delish,
    But do mind that burned spot... 
    
    Today I cooked up some sausage
    Cut in, and what did I see?
    Half an eye, looking oh so sly,
    Winking right back at me!
    
    Oh — 
    
    So what goes into a sausage?
    You should quiet that hunch,
    Pipe down and sit, hush now and eat,
    Lest you lose your lunch!
rows.translation:
“香肠真是太美味了，不是吗？”瑞弗边说边开始哼起曲子来，“里面可以加任何东西呢！”

    哦，香肠里到底放了什么啊？
    这真让我感到困惑！
    就那么一小管肉，就已经是如此美味了，
    我看到的全都是粉红色的东西！
    
    把它们串在烤肉签上，
    然后在火焰上烤制，
    香肠又厚又好吃，吃到撑肚子都无所谓，
    一点也不会觉得不好意思！
    
    但我切开其中一个看了看里面，
    想看看里面是什么东西，
    那是脾脏吗？那绿色的东西？
    还是某种皮革？
    
    屠夫把它叫做“长猪肉”，
    我觉得那家伙在撒谎，
    但我不得不承认，无论我怎么想，
    炸起来确实非常美味！
    
    那么，香肠里到底包含了什么呢？
    也许我不该去问这个问题，
    因为要弄清楚其中的所有成分，
    那确实不是我的职责！
    
    你从市场上买到这些香肠，
    然后涂上蜂蜜和酱料，
    买便宜点的就行，不必太挑剔，
    这样你就能大吃特吃了！
    
    它们确实非常有名——
    人们特别喜欢南方地区的这些食材，
    用卷起来的肠子来代替外皮，
    做出一道能让人垂涎欲滴的菜肴。
    
    有时候里面还会加入辣椒，
    还有洋葱和大蒜！
    发现这些食材的搭配方式，真是太令人兴奋了，
    将传统与创新完美地结合在一起，真是太棒了！
    
    但香肠最主要的成分，
    就是里面的肉，
    没人能真正弄清楚其中的具体成分，
    最好也别去深究那些奇怪的配料吧！
    
    那么，香肠里到底放了些什么呢？
    别想得太复杂，
    尽情享用这份美味吧，
    不过还是要注意那个被烤焦的地方…… 
    
    今天我做了一些香肠，
    切开一看，里面是什么呢？
    半只眼睛，看起来狡猾极了，
    还在向我眨眼呢！
    
    哦—— 
    
    那么，香肠里到底有什么呢？
    你最好别再胡思乱想了，
    闭上嘴乖乖坐下，安静地吃，
    免得你把吃下去的午饭全吐出来！

rows.original:
There was an old fisher,
    Who lived by the dock
    He'd spend all his days
    Proudly stroking his
    
    Hair as he fished in
    The fast-flowing creek
    Getting water all over
    His rod and his
    
    Tackle when he saw his
    Neighbour out to hunt
    A buxom young lady
    With a right massive
    
    Bow and he asked her
    If she'd had any luck
    She told him not much
    But asked him to
    
    A picnic that afternoon
    Right about half-past four
    He'd need to clean up
    And she'd dress like a
    
    Lady and soon it was time
    So they met on the grass
    She hiked up her skirt
    And spread out her
    
    Cloth to cover the dirt
    Then at the lady's behest
    The fisher reached out
    And grabbed tight her
    
    Basket that was full
    Of meatballs and bits,
    With their soft squishy shape
    They looked just like
    
    Pearls and there were also
    Tarts made with plum,
    They were white 'cause
    She'd doused them with
    
    Sugar in handfuls
    And also a dash
    Of yummy, sweet cream
    Straight from her
    
    Cow in the old barn
    Which gave butterscotch,
    She'd brought some over
    To smear on her
    
    Toast and the picnic
    Really tasted quite good
    If you thought anything else
    Then you're rather quite lewd!
rows.translation:
从前有位老渔夫，
    住在码头旁，
    他整天都在
    自豪地抚摸着他的
    
    头发，一边在
    湍急的小溪里捕鱼，
    水溅得到处都是，
    打湿了他的鱼竿和
    
    渔具，这时他看见
    邻居出门去打猎，
    一位身材丰满的年轻姑娘，
    带着一副硕大无比的
    
    弓。他问她
    运气如何，
    她说没打到什么，
    但邀请他去
    
    那天下午野餐，
    大约四点半。
    他得先收拾干净，
    而她要打扮得像个
    
    淑女。很快时间就到了，
    于是他们在草地上碰面。
    她撩起裙子，
    铺开了她的
    
    布，垫在脏地上。
    然后应那位淑女的吩咐，
    渔夫伸出手，
    紧紧抓住了她的
    
    篮子，里面装满了
    肉丸和碎肉，
    它们柔软而有弹性，
    看起来简直就像
    
    珍珠。里面还有
    李子做的馅饼，
    它们是白色的，因为
    她往上面浇了
    
    一把把的糖，
    还加了一点
    美味的甜奶油，
    直接从她的
    
    老牛棚里那头奶牛身上挤出来的，
    那头牛产的是奶油糖，
    她带了一些过来，
    要抹在她的
    
    吐司上。这顿野餐
    味道真的挺不错。
    如果你想到了别的什么，
    那你就未免太淫荡了！

rows.original:
"Sometimes a spin on old mainstays isn't so bad. Why don't you consider the following, then..." 

    Roses are red,
    Violets are blue,
    Take off your clothes
    For I'm going to have you.
    
    Red is the rose,
    Brown is the buck,
    Go get upstairs
    And prepare for a fuck.
    
    Orchids are dove-white
    Their petals so fine
    Just like your ripe ass
    That I'm claiming as mine.
    
    Daisies are lovely
    A cool shade of cream
    Same as your face
    When you present and scream.
rows.translation:
“有时候，对一些经典歌曲进行一些改编也并不坏。那么，你为什么不考虑试试下面这些改编版本呢……” 

    玫瑰是红色的，
    紫罗兰是蓝色的，
    脱掉你的衣服吧，
    因为我要占有你。
    
    红色是玫瑰的颜色，
    棕色是公鹿的皮毛，
    上去吧，
    准备好好挨一顿操吧。
    
    兰花是雪白的，
    它们的花瓣如此细腻，
    就像你那成熟的屁股，
    我想要将它据为己有。
    
    雏菊非常可爱，
    它们有着清新的奶油色，
    就像你的脸庞，
    当你撅起屁股放声尖叫的时候。

rows.original:
"Ah, the high life of the rich," River muses. "Ever wonder what it was like?"

    I rise at eleven, I dine about two,
    I get drunk before seven, and the next thing I do,
    I send for my whore, when for fear of the clap,
    I spend in her hand and I spew in her lap;
    Then we quarrel and scold, till I fall fast asleep,
    When the bitch growing bold, to my pocket does creep.
    Then slyly she leaves me, and to revenge the affront,
    At once she bereaves me of money and cunt.
    If by chance when I wake, hot-heated and drunk,
    What a coil do I make for the loss of my spunk!
    I storm, and I roar, and I fall in a rage.
    And missing my whore, I bugger my page.
    Then dog-sick all morning I rail at my men,
    And in bed I lie yawning till eleven again.
rows.translation:
“啊，富人的奢华生活，”瑞弗沉思道，“有没有想过那是什么样的体验？”

    我十一点起床，两点左右吃饭，
    七点之前就会喝得酩酊大醉，然后接下来要做的，
    就是去叫我的妓女……毕竟害怕染上性病嘛。
    我射在她手里，又喷在她腿上；
    然后我们就会争吵、责骂，直到我昏昏睡去；
    而那个贱人却趁机大胆起来，偷偷地把我的钱偷走了。
    之后她又会偷偷离开我，为了报复这种羞辱，
    她立刻就把我的钱和屄都一并夺走。
    要是我一觉醒来，还带着酒劲、浑身发热，
    为了白白损失的那些精液，我会闹出多大的乱子啊！
    我暴跳如雷，怒吼连连，完全陷入疯狂。
    找不到我的妓女，我就操了我的侍童。
    然后一整个早上，我都难受得要命，不停地责骂我的手下们。
    然后我又躺在床上，打哈欠，一直睡到十一点。

rows.original:
"I like this one," River says with a wistful smile. "It's a children's counting game rhyme dating at least 200 years before the fall of the Belhar Empire. Brings back memories of better times."

    One is for the Emperor upon the Ruby Throne,
    Two is for the great treasures the Imperium owns,
    Three is for the number of Estelore's great seers,
    Four is for seasons as they turn throughout the year,
    Five is for the Empire's lands oh so far and wide,
    Six is for the great races all living side by side,
    Seven is for the Living Gods who guide us through our days,
    Eight is for the books of law which set us in our ways,
    Nine is for the guiding stars by which we sail the seas,
    Ten is for the fingers I count on, one two, three!
rows.translation:
“我喜欢这个，”瑞弗带着一丝怀旧的微笑说道，“这是一首儿童计数游戏歌谣，其历史可以追溯到贝尔哈帝国灭亡之前至少200年。它让我回想起那些美好的时光。”

    一代表坐在红宝石王座上的皇帝，
    二代表帝国拥有的那些珍贵宝藏，
    三代表埃斯托洛尔那些伟大的先知们，
    四代表一年中不断更迭的四季，
    五代表帝国那辽阔无垠的疆域，
    六代表那些共同生活的各种伟大种族，
    七代表那些引导我们度过每一天的现世神祇，
    八代表那些规定我们行为准则的法律条文，
    九代表那些引领我们航行的指路明灯，
    十代表我用来计数的手指，一、二、三！
rows.raw:
"
    "I like this one," River says with a wistful smile. "It's a children's counting game rhyme dating at least 200 years before the fall of the Belhar Empire. Brings back memories of better times."

    One is for the Emperor upon the Ruby Throne,
    Two is for the great treasures the Imperium owns,
    Three is for the number of Estelore's great seers,
    Four is for seasons as they turn throughout the year,
    Five is for the Empire's lands oh so far and wide,
    Six is for the great races all living side by side,
    Seven is for the Living Gods who guide us through our days,
    Eight is for the books of law which set us in our ways,
    Nine is for the guiding stars by which we sail the seas,
    Ten is for the fingers I count on, one two, three!"

rows.original:
Served she is for some coin
    At the local inn or bar,
    Sometimes she hails from within town
    And sometimes from afar.
    
    Barrels and casks she doth ride in
    And when those are unearthed
    Out she flows, and there she goes
    Up front to be served.
    
    Sometimes she's wearing white or red
    And sometimes she dons yellow,
    Watch her froth as she strides forth
    What a sassy fellow!
    
    Her skin so smooth — is it light?
    Or is it a deep, deep dark?
    One thing though, we know for sure
    She's definitely no simple lark!
    
    For today she is here to trip you up
    And she will torture you tomorrow,
    Yet she is also there to ease the pain
    When you are lost in grief and sorrow.
    
    Her body yearns for a touch,
    Her lips a kiss to be sealed.
    Go on, then, take her up,
    And let your glass be filled.
    
    Raise your hand, draw her close,
    And look deep upon her face.
    Heed the lesson, seize your passion
    And enter her great embrace.
    
    Is she bitter? Is she dry?
    Or is she homely sweet?
    Maybe she's an acquired taste
    Or some exotic treat.
    
    As the last drop drains from the mug,
    So does her soft caress.
    And one can't help but feel this choice
    Was made under some duress.
rows.translation:
只需付出几枚钱币
    她便在本地旅店或酒吧奉上；
    有时她来自城镇之内
    有时则来自远方。
    
    她乘木桶与酒桶而来
    待那些容器重见天日
    她便汩汩流淌，径直来到
    柜台前供人享用。
    
    有时她身披白衣或红装
    有时又穿一袭金黄；
    看她迈步时泡沫翻涌
    真是位泼辣姑娘！
    
    她的肌肤如此光滑——是浅色？
    还是深得不见微光？
    不过有件事我们十分确定：
    她绝非寻常玩笑！
    
    今天她来这里绊住你的脚步
    明日又会令你备受煎熬；
    可当你迷失在悲伤痛苦之中
    她也会替你抚慰伤口。
    
    她的身体渴望有人触碰，
    她的双唇等待一吻封缄。
    来吧，将她拿起，
    任她斟满你的酒杯。
    
    抬起手来，将她拉近，
    深深凝视她的容颜。
    牢记教训，抓住激情，
    投入她宽广的怀抱。
    
    她是苦涩？还是干冽？
    抑或质朴甜美？
    也许她的滋味需慢慢适应
    又或是某种异域珍馐。
    
    当杯中最后一滴流尽，
    她温柔的爱抚也随之消散。
    而人总不免觉得，这项选择
    多少是在压力之下作出。

rows.original:
"This one's really old," River muses. "Even I don't know where it came from."

    A maiden's first confession of love,
    Whispered under the leaves.
    A vow made before the Living Gods,
    Within the temple's eaves.
    
    It's the one cornerstone of a people,
    And defend it they must.
    For more precious than gold or gems
    Is each others' trust.
    
    Words spoken from one to another
    Promises of action on the morrow.
    To hold fast to one's given pledge
    Is to avoid one's future sorrow.
    
    It can be kept close to the heart,
    Yet only after being given away.
    The faithful hold onto it for years,
    The fickle forget it within a day.
    
    "I can." "I shall." "I will." These words
    Carry more weight than they seem,
    They have the power to change lives
    Or make real our fever dreams.
    
    So hold your tongue until you've thought
    And take not lightly your word,
    For who knows what ominous fates
    Easy promises have 'ere stirred.
rows.translation:
“这个真的很古老了，”瑞弗沉思道，“就连我也不知道它是从哪里来的。”

    一位少女初次表白爱意，
    在树叶的掩映下低声诉说。
    在众神面前许下的誓言，
    就在寺庙的屋檐下。
    
    这是一个民族赖以生存的基石，
    人们必须为之守护。
    因为比起黄金或宝石，更重要的是
    彼此之间的信任。
    
    人们彼此之间说出的话语，
    是明天就要履行的承诺。
    人们必须坚守自己许下的誓言。
    这是为了避免未来的悲伤。
    
    它可以被紧紧地珍藏在心中，
    但只有在被给予之后，它才能真正属于自己。
    忠诚的人会将其珍藏多年，
    而善变的人却会在一天之内就将其遗忘。
    
    “我能行。”“我会的。”“我一定做到。”这些话语
    蕴含的力量远超表面看上去的那样，
    它们拥有改变命运的力量，
    也能让我们的狂热梦想成为现实。
    
    所以，想清楚之前先别开口，
    也别把自己的承诺当儿戏，
    谁知道轻率的承诺
    曾经招来过怎样不祥的命运。

rows.original:
"An old lupine song," River says, and is surprisingly tight-lipped as he begins.

    When we are but pups, we learn that fairies glow,
    And this is good as everyone knows.
    But when we are grown, we drink deep of our ale,
    Though we know fairies only exist in fevered tales... 
    We cry, though we rarely let it show,
    Our tears falling like the first dust of snow.
    But still the fairies dance in the night
    Casting forth their fleeting fae light.
    Save for the few with the proper eyes to perceive
    And also the minds and hearts suited to receive
    As we grow older and bolder and drawn,
    The fairies visit us less till, alas, they are gone.
    For our offspring the fairies will still glow,
    And this is good as every pup knows.
    But we keep partaking deeply of our ales
    For we know that fairies only live in fevered tales...
rows.translation:
一首古老的狼族歌曲，”瑞弗说道，开始唱的时候，出人意料地保持了沉默。

    当我们还是幼崽的时候，我们就知道精灵们会发光，  
    这一点大家都心知肚明。  
    但当我们长大后，就会深深地品尝那种属于我们的酒……
    虽然我们知道，精灵只存在于那些充满幻想的故事之中……  
    我们还是会哭泣，尽管很少会表露出来；  
    我们的泪水，就像初冬的第一场雪。  
    但即便如此，精灵们依然在夜色中舞蹈，  
    散发着他们那转瞬即逝的光芒。
    只有那些拥有能够感知它们的眼睛，  
    以及那些心灵和思想能够接受它们的人，才能看到它们。  
    随着我们渐渐长大、变得勇敢，那些仙女们也会更少地出现在我们面前，  
    最终，它们就会消失得无影无踪。  
    但对于我们的后代来说，那些仙女们的光芒仍将永远闪耀。
    这一点，每个孩子都心知肚明。  
    但我们依然会尽情享用这些麦芽酒，  
    因为我们知道，仙女只存在于那些充满幻想的故事里罢了……

rows.original:
"This one's been around for more than a couple centuries. Fitting, really..." 

    Perchance you remember stories you were told?
    Tales of towering spires amidst fine cities of old?
    Dreaming of treasures, of ancient artefacts,
    Left in the remains of keeps ruined and sacked.
    
    But how this happened, how this came to pass, 
    How the grand Belhar Empire fell at last, 
    The roads still wind, but they lead nowhere,
    Many search the wastes, but find nothing there.
    
    (Refrain)
    For we reached too high, and the magic goes away,
    Twisting and unravelling as its tattered ends fray... 
    The few of us left huddle about the fires,
    Sifting through the ashes of the empire.
    
    Who still remembers the isle of Estelore?
    Jewel of the empire, even in days of yore?
    Who still recalls the suffering they wrought?
    Searching for things that ought not be sought?
    
    Time was when simple forest and field
    Could be crossed without sword and shield,
    Alas, those days are long since past,
    And to travel we must face ghoul and ghast.
    
    (Refrain)
    For we reached too high, and the magic goes away,
    Twisting and unravelling as its tattered ends fray... 
    The few of us left huddle about the fires,
    Sifting through the ashes of the empire.
    
    You can still see the temples, once built tall and proud,
    For our forebears built them as grand as their skill allowed,
    Now they lie broken, their stones ruined and scattered,
    For their builders forgot about what truly mattered.
    
    Great glittering fountains, streets shod with gold,
    For even the poorest possessed riches untold,
    But comfort and plenty oft makes one sick,
    And they were but meat for wraiths so quick.
    
    (Refrain)
    For we reached too high, and the magic goes away,
    Twisting and unravelling as its tattered ends fray... 
    The few of us left huddle about the fires,
    Sifting through the ashes of the empire.
    
    The natural order twisted, love turned to lust,
    Leaves warped to thorns, and stone into dust,
    Nags and crones and bumps in the night,
    Strange new illnesses, limb-rotting blight... 
    
    With the wraiths' passsing, fell beasts arise,
    Lurking in the corners under shadowed skies.
    Armed with tooth and claw and blood and bite,
    Filled with lust and hatred, and eager to fight.
    
    (Refrain)
    For we reached too high, and the magic goes away,
    Twisting and unravelling as its tattered ends fray... 
    The few of us left huddle about the fires,
    Sifting through the ashes of the empire.
    
    With the gods' help, we combat the rot,
    Yet we cannot undo all that the wraiths begot,
    Their evil is rooted and here with us to stay,
    Ever reminding us of that fateful, cursed day.
    
    So we mill about the cursed land,
    Toying with things we don't understand,
    For once we were singed, and twice we were burned,
    Yet we're doomed to ever forget lessons hard-learned.
    
    (Refrain)
    For we reached too high, and the magic goes away,
    Twisting and unravelling as its tattered ends fray... 
    The few of us left huddle about the fires,
    Sifting through the ashes of the empire.
rows.translation:
“这个已经存在了几个世纪之久。真是再合适不过了……” 

    或许你还记得那些别人告诉你的故事吧？
    那些关于古老城市中高耸尖塔的故事？
    那些关于宝藏、关于古代文物的传说，
    它们就埋藏在那些被毁坏、被洗劫一空的遗迹之中。
    
    但这一切究竟是如何发生的， 
    伟大的贝尔哈帝国又是如何最终覆灭的…… 
    那些道路依然蜿蜒延伸，却通向无垠的荒芜；
    许多人在这片废墟中四处寻找，却一无所获。
    
    （副歌）
    因为我们攀登得太高，那些魔法也随之消失了，
    它们在扭曲中逐渐消散，残余的部分也渐渐破碎…… 
    如今，我们这些幸存者只能围坐在篝火旁，
    在帝国的废墟灰烬中寻找着些什么。
    
    还有谁记得埃斯托洛尔岛吗？
    那片帝国的珍宝，即使在远古的时代？
    还有谁还记得他们曾经造成的苦难吗？
    他们一直在追寻那些本不该被追寻的东西……
    
    曾经有那么一段时光，只需穿过简单的森林和田野，
    就可以不用剑和盾来保护自己，
    可惜，那些日子早已一去不复返了，
    如今要想出行，就必须面对各种恐怖的怪物和危险。
    
    （副歌）
    因为我们攀得太高，魔法也随之消逝，
    那些扭曲的痕迹在残破的边缘逐渐消失…… 
    我们这些幸存者围坐在篝火旁，
    在帝国的废墟中寻找着些什么。
    
    那些曾经高耸入云的神庙依然可见，
    因为我们的先祖们尽他们所能，用精湛的技艺建造了它们；
    如今它们已支离破碎，石块散落一地，
    因为建造者们忘记了真正重要的东西。
    
    璀璨夺目的喷泉，铺满黄金的街道，
    即便是最贫穷的人，也拥有数不尽的财富；
    然而，过多的舒适与富足往往会使人感到厌烦，
    而这些，终究只是那些迅速消逝的幽灵们所需的养料罢了。
    
    （副歌）
    因为我们攀登得太高，魔法也随之消失了，
    它那破败的边缘正在不断扭曲、解开…… 
    我们这些幸存者，只能围在篝火旁，
    在帝国的废墟中寻找着些什么。
    
    自然的秩序被扭曲了，爱情变成了欲望，
    树叶变成了荆棘，石头化作了尘土，
    劣马、老妪与夜半的异响，
    还有那些奇怪的新疾病、会腐蚀肢体的瘟疫…… 
    
    随着幽灵的离去，邪恶的生物纷纷涌现，
    它们潜伏在阴暗的角落里。
    这些生物手持利齿与爪子，浑身是血，
    充满欲望与仇恨，随时准备战斗。
    
    （副歌）
    因为我们攀登得太高，那些魔法也随之消逝了，
    它们扭曲着、破碎着，那些残破的痕迹正在逐渐消失…… 
    我们这些幸存者聚集在篝火旁，
    在帝国的废墟中寻找着些什么。
    
    在众神的帮助下，我们努力对抗那些腐朽与邪恶，
    但却无法消除那些幽灵所造成的一切……
    它们的恶意早已根深蒂固，与我们同在，
    永远提醒着我们那个命运多舛、被诅咒的日子。
    
    所以我们在这片被诅咒的土地上徘徊，
    摆弄那些我们根本无法理解的东西，
    我们曾一次被灼伤，两次被烧毁，
    然而，我们注定永远无法忘记那些惨痛的教训。
    
    （副歌）
    因为我们追求得太高，那些魔法也随之消失了，
    它们扭曲着、解开着，那些破烂的残端正在逐渐消失…… 
    剩下的我们几个人围在篝火旁，
    在帝国的废墟中寻找着些什么。

rows.original:
"A cautionary Lupine rhyme telling of elemental spirits," River begins. "How much truth there's to be had... well, take it all with a pinch of salt."

    Far up north, upon peaks so high,
    Where the whitened caps touch the sky,
    Spirits of ice and sleet and snow
    Leap and dance and twist and flow.
    They leap from crevices, worm forth from cracks,
    Move silently through snow leaving no tracks,
    Full of vigor, so vital and spry,
    Spirits lure the unwary out to die.
    Promises and sweet words meant to endear,
    All these and more they put in your ear.
    Thin and wispy, so full of grace,
    Inviting you into their cold embrace,
    Yet their touch is but a silver knife
    Stealing your blood and wits and life.
    Should you be on the peaks with no flame
    And hear called on the gale your whole name
    Do not reply, but tarry first
    Lest you invite in the worst.
    Do not speak, do not laugh
    But turn slowly and only half.
    Should you see no one there
    Leave not a split second to spare.
    For the spirits of skies so gray
    Are always looking for easy prey.
rows.translation:
“这是一首狼族的警示童谣，讲述的是元素精灵，”瑞弗开始说道，“其中究竟有多少真实的内容……嗯，还是对此持保留态度为好。”

    在遥远的北方，那些高耸入云的山峰之上，
    那里雪白的山顶仿佛触到了天空……
    冰之精灵，雨雪之精魄，
    跳跃着、舞动着、扭曲着、流淌着。
    它们从裂缝中跃出，从裂隙中钻出，
    悄无声息地在雪地中移动，不留下任何痕迹，
    充满活力，如此生机勃勃、敏捷灵活，
    这些精灵会诱使那些毫无戒备的人走向死亡。
    那些用来博取你喜爱的承诺与甜言蜜语，
    他们把这一切都倾诉在你耳边。
    它们纤细而轻盈，却充满诱惑力，
    仿佛在邀请你投入它们冰冷的怀抱之中，
    然而，它们的触碰其实就像一把银刀，
    正在偷走你的血液、智慧，乃至你的生命。
    若你身处峰顶，身边没有火焰，
    却听见狂风呼唤着你的全名，
    不要回应，而是先稍作停留；
    以免招致更糟糕的后果。
    不要说话，也不要笑；
    只需缓缓转身，转半身而已。
    如果你在那里没有看到任何人，
    千万不要浪费一秒钟。
    因为那些灰蒙蒙的天空中的幽灵，
    总是在寻找容易捕捉的猎物。
rows.raw:
'
    "A cautionary Lupine rhyme telling of elemental spirits," River begins. "How much truth there's to be had... well, take it all with a pinch of salt."

    Far up north, upon peaks so high,
    Where the whitened caps touch the sky,
    Spirits of ice and sleet and snow
    Leap and dance and twist and flow.
    They leap from crevices, worm forth from cracks,
    Move silently through snow leaving no tracks,
    Full of vigor, so vital and spry,
    Spirits lure the unwary out to die.
    Promises and sweet words meant to endear,
    All these and more they put in your ear.
    Thin and wispy, so full of grace,
    Inviting you into their cold embrace,
    Yet their touch is but a silver knife
    Stealing your blood and wits and life.
    Should you be on the peaks with no flame
    And hear called on the gale your whole name
    Do not reply, but tarry first
    Lest you invite in the worst.
    Do not speak, do not laugh
    But turn slowly and only half.
    Should you see no one there
    Leave not a split second to spare.
    For the spirits of skies so gray
    Are always looking for easy prey.'

rows.original:
"An ancient lupine chant dating from before the Godswar," River says as he begins. "They were more...organised then. And even so..." 

    Come! Enter into the grand halls of the Wolf.
    Open your ears and minds,
    Learn the meaning of strength and truth!
    We are now, and always have been
    Welcome in these ancient arches.
    If we forge ourselves with snow and steel
    And fortify our bodies with drink and meal
    One day soon, we will be more than flesh.
    When that day comes at hand
    A new hope descends upon the land
    Providing warmth and green riches
    Driving away the sorcery of foul witches.
    We shall share in gifts of the harvest moon
    And revel in the merriment of song and tune
    Drink of the sweet early morning dew
    And as a people be born anew.
    To dance on the hills with wreaths of holly
    And finally be free of Belhar's Folly.
    Oh, to dwell in the halls of the Wolf
    To live by sword, claw and tooth
    To die by the same and pass into the after
    To ride on lightning and harness the thunder.
    These are the hopes to of which the least
    We raise our tankards, break bread and feast.
    We stand on the ramparts to watch twilight's last never
    For within the halls of the Wolf we shall dwell forever.
rows.translation:
这是一首起源于神战之前的古老狼族吟唱，”瑞弗开始说道，“那时候的他们……组织得更加严密。即便如此……”

    来吧！走进狼族宏伟的殿堂，
    敞开你的双耳与心灵，
    去领悟力量与真理的真谛吧！
    我们现在如此，过去也始终如此。  
    欢迎来到这些古老的拱门之中。  
    如果我们用冰雪与钢铁来塑造自己，  
    用食物与饮品来强化我们的身体，  
    那么不久的将来，我们必将超越肉体的局限。  
    当那一天真正来临时……
    新的希望降临在这片土地上，
    带来了温暖与丰富的资源，
    驱散了邪恶女巫的诅咒与魔法。
    我们将共同分享丰收之月的馈赠，
    沉浸在歌声与欢乐之中，
    品尝那清晨甜美的露水。
    而作为一个全新的民族诞生，
    在冬青花环的装饰下在山丘上起舞，
    最终摆脱贝尔哈尔的愚行与束缚。
    哦，能够居住在狼族的殿堂中，
    以剑、爪与牙齿为生，
    也以同样的方式死去，然后进入来世……
    乘风破浪，驾驭雷霆。  
    这些便是我们最深切的渴望。  
    我们举杯欢庆，共享美食。  
    我们站在城墙上，凝视着暮色的最后一缕光芒，  
    因为在我们狼族的大厅里，我们将永远安居。

rows.original:
"Marching song of the Red Dragons, second imperial infantry company," River tells you as he begins. "Their insignia, was, unsurprisingly, that of a red dragon, and they were said to only take orders directly from the reigning emperor or empress."

    Drink deep of the blood, churning and red
    Taste of the power that is at hand
    Burning veins and burning souls
    Changing one's heart and bones
    
    Back into the fire, now with our swords
    Follow us through our lands
    Burning away rot and chaff alike
    In the raging flames that cleanse
    
    (Refrain)
    Now brave our fury, brave our flame
    Dragons' blood burns, heart untamed
    Stone we crush and steel we rend
    For we red wyrms bring world's end
    
    From the mountains, red dragons fly
    Sweeping 'round plains and hills
    Kissed by the sun, kissed by the forge
    Claws and maw of blaze and burn
    
    For the Empire, for the land, for the seas
    For the golden valleys and cities
    For the glory of flame which we call our own
    For the sake of Belhar's Ruby Throne
    
    (Refrain)
    So brave our fury, brave our flame
    Dragons' blood burns, heart untamed
    Stone we crush and steel we rend
    For we red wyrms bring world's end
rows.translation:
“红龙军团第二帝国步兵连的行进曲，”瑞弗开始介绍道，“他们的标志自然也是红龙图案，据说这些士兵只听从当朝皇帝或皇后的直接命令。”

    深饮那炽热而红色的鲜血，
    体验手中所握的力量吧；
    它会灼烧你的血管，点燃你的灵魂，
    让你的内心与骨骼都发生改变。
    
    现在，让我们手持剑刃，重返那烈火之中；
    跟随我们，穿越我们的家园吧。
    将腐朽与杂质一同烧尽，
    在那些能够净化一切的烈焰之中……
    
    （副歌）
    现在，勇敢面对我们的愤怒，勇敢面对我们的火焰吧！
    龙之血液在燃烧，心灵依旧狂野不羁；
    我们能粉碎石头，也能撕裂钢铁——
    因为我们这些赤红的巨龙，将会带来世界的终结……
    
    从群山之中，红龙腾飞，
    掠过平原与丘陵，
    它们被阳光沐浴，也被烈火灼烧，
    它们的爪子与巨口散发着炽热的光芒。
    
    为了帝国，为了这片土地，为了海洋，
    为了那些金色的山谷与城市……
    为了我们称之为荣耀的火焰，
    为了贝尔哈的红宝石王座，
    
    （副歌）
    那么，勇敢面对我们的愤怒，勇敢面对我们的火焰吧！
    龙之血液在燃烧，心灵依旧狂野不羁；
    我们能粉碎石头，也能撕裂钢铁——
    因为我们这些赤红的巨龙，将会带来世界的终结……

rows.original: You're in a more melancholy mood right now...
rows.translation: 你现在的心情似乎更加忧郁了一些……
rows.raw: "You're in a more melancholy mood right now..."

rows.original:
You ask River if he has a moment to speak in private. The town square's pretty open, and you don't want what you're about to say to be heard by the wrong ears.
    
    The little bard-boy gives you a friendly smile, although his gaze clearly betrays his confusion in a moment of unguardedness. Nevertheless, he snaps his fingers — and the hubbub of the square and nearby marketplace immediately vanish, heavy silence rushing in to press in upon [party.hasCompanions
        |all
        |the both
    ] of you.
    
    "A little cantrip I learned back in my younger days, quite suited for creating a proper atmosphere for an impromptu performance without distractions. Very good for acoustics, too." He sets down his lute on his lap and folds his fingers, one of the few times he isn't speaking without any kind of musical accompaniment. "You look serious, it really doesn't suit your face. What's the matter?"
    
    You know about Gweyr. She told you everything.
    
    "Oh."
    
    All of it.
    
    "Yes." River leans back in his bench. "So, now you know. And?"
    
    And everything! Why did he, Garth and Sanders conspire to keep this from everyone? From Cait and you when she was going from door to door, knocking and asking for something, anything about the cult?
    
    "...It would have broken Hawkethorne. It nearly did. Of the people who were there that day and still remember the events, only the three of us remain in the village, [pc.name]. Well, the baroness and those in her employ knew too, of course — we informed her after the fact. Everyone else left over the following months, years. They couldn't... wouldn't bear what had happened here. If not for Ivris arriving with a bunch of settlers in tow, we'd have been done for. The three of us agreed to not tell anyone, to bury the matter like all the bodies Gweyr left in her wake."
    
    ... 
    
    River thins his lips and meets your gaze staunchly, daring you to rebut him. "I don't regret what I did, what I've done. And if I could go back, I'd do it again, to save this village as it is. Tollus boasted that if he couldn't take Hawkethorne, he'd destroy it one way or the other; even though we beat him, he nearly got his wish. Ivris and her people wouldn't have chosen to settle here if they'd known what had happened on these streets and without her, no one else would have come. All this — the homes, the Frost Hound, the people — they were worth fighting for, sacrificing for. And that's why Gweyr didn't resist us when Sanders exiled her."
    
    And after that? Keeping all this from Cait and you when you were trying to dig out something, anything about Tollus and his cult?
    
    "What could we have told you that would've changed anything? We didn't catch him, obviously, and he didn't even tell the kids what he was about beyond planning to take the castle and loot the baroness's vaults. Maybe Leold would have known something, but Gweyr killed him."
    
    Maybe, maybe not, but you do feel a bit lied to. And Cait!
    
    "It was over. We buried it. Gweyr... like I said, everyone from back then left. She could come home if she wanted to, I know she's been meeting Garth from time to time beyond the gates. But she won't. Not until her unfinished business is done. That, and she works up the courage to face her kids.
    
    "This isn't a nice and comfortable story like the ones I tell people to raise their spirits, [pc.name]. It's dirty, ugly and disgusting. Everyone who gets close to it ends up stained. I don't want this town or its people to end up with that stain on them, you get me? That's for the three of us to bear — Hawkethorne was, and still is a nice place, and I'd like to keep it that way."
rows.translation:
你询问瑞弗是否有片刻时间可以私下谈谈。镇广场上人并不多，你肯定不希望自己要说的话被别人听到。

那个年轻的吟游诗人对你露出了友好的微笑，不过在他稍显失措的瞬间，他的眼神明显流露出困惑。不过，他还是打了个响指——顿时，广场上以及附近市集的喧闹声全都消失了，一片沉寂降临了下来。 [party.hasCompanions
        |所有
        |两者
    ]这是我年轻时学会的一个小把戏，非常适合用来营造即兴表演所需的氛围，让观众不会分心。而且，这个把戏对音效效果也有很好的帮助。”他将鲁特琴放在膝盖上，双手交叉握住琴弦——这也是为数不多的几次他在没有音乐伴奏的情况下讲话的时候。你看起来很严肃，这种表情实在不太适合你。出了什么事吗？”

你知道关于格维尔的事吧？她把一切都告诉了你。

“哦。”

所有的事情。

“是的。”瑞弗靠在长椅上说道，“所以，现在你知道了。然后呢？”

“所有的事情啊！为什么加斯和桑德斯要合谋隐瞒这些事情，不让任何人知道？当凯特一家挨家挨户地去询问、寻找关于那个邪教的任何线索时，他们为什么也不告诉她和你呢？”

“…………那件事本会毁掉鹰棘镇，差点就真的发生了。在那天在场并且至今还记得那些事情的人中，只有我们三个人还留在这个村庄里。[pc.name]嗯，女男爵以及她手下的那些人当然也知道这件事——事后我们才告诉她的。在接下来的几个月、几年里，其他所有人都离开了。他们无法……也不愿意承受这里发生的一切。要不是艾薇莉丝带着一群移民来到了这里，我们早就完蛋了。我们三个人一致同意不告诉任何人，把这件事像格维尔留下的那些尸体一样埋葬在心底。
    
    瑞弗紧抿着嘴唇，坚定地与你的目光对视，仿佛在挑衅你反驳他。“我并不后悔自己所做过的事。如果能够重来，我还会再那么做，就是为了保护这个村庄，让它保持现在的样子。托勒斯曾扬言，如果他无法夺取鹰棘镇，就会想方设法毁掉它；尽管我们打败了他，但他几乎得逞了。如果艾薇莉丝和她的族人早知道这些街道上曾经发生过什么，他们就不会选择在这里定居；而如果没有她，也不会有其他人来到这里。这一切——那些房屋、那些“霜犬酒馆”，还有这些人们——都值得我们为之奋斗、为之牺牲。这就是为什么当桑德斯将格维尔流放时，她并没有反抗我们。
    
    那之后呢？当你们试图查明关于托勒斯和他的邪教组织的任何线索时，为什么要把这些事情都隐瞒起来，不告诉凯特？

“我们能告诉你们什么，才能真正改变什么局面呢？显然我们没有抓住他，而且他本身也没有向孩子们透露他的真正目的——除了打算夺取城堡并洗劫女男爵的金库之外。也许莱奥德会知道些什么，但格维尔杀了他。
    
    也许吧，也许也不一定，但你确实觉得自己被欺骗了。还有凯特！

“一切都结束了。我们把那段往事埋在了心底。格维尔……就像我说的，那些人都已经离开了。如果她想回家的话，她是可以的；我知道她有时会偷偷地去见加思。但她不会回去的。直到她那些未了的事情解决，直到她有勇气去面对自己的孩子们之前，她都不会回去的。
    
    这个故事并不像我那些用来振奋人们情绪的故事那样温馨舒适。[pc.name]它又脏又丑，还令人作呕。任何靠近它的人都会被弄得浑身脏兮兮的。我不想让这个小镇和它的居民也沾上这样的污点，你明白我的意思吗？这是我们三个人必须共同承担的责任——鹰棘镇曾经是个美好的地方，现在依然如此，我也希望它能继续保持这样的状态。

rows.translation: 猫人男孩

rows.original: You have a strange dream that night... You feel the warm sun on your face, and at first you think it's morning and it's time to get up. Then as you realize the sunlight's far too bright for early morning and you're supposed to be [atCamp |in your tent |indoors ] anyway, you open your eyes and find yourself not quite where you're supposed to be. "Have some spice coffee, [pc.mf |sir |miss ]?" A small voice inquires by your side, and you roll your head over to take in a diminutive, blue-haired catboy with a silvered tray in his arms. Right, you're lying down... but instead of your bed, you're on a luxurious cushioned recliner by the edge of a adobe-brick pool. "You won't get this anywhere else." You eye the varnished clay mug on offer, filled with thick, dark, and above all aromatic brew; the spicy smell rising into the air along with the steam strong enough to knock out a minotaur. Another quick look at your surroundings reveals perhaps two dozen people — catfolk, dark-skinned elves, and anubians — lounging in and around the water in various states of undress, chatting idly while cute cat valets serve them anything they might desire. And on the other side of the pool courtyard... oh yes, that has got to be the most beautiful, ostentatious palace you've ever seen in your life. With Cait's temple built, you've seen enough of Jassiran architecture to readily if not easily recognize it... the minarets are something else, though. Turning back to the catboy valet at your side, you see him give you an encouraging smile and nudge the tray ever so slightly towards you. "His Holiness cordially requests your presence in his audience chamber, [pc.name]. This should shake off any disorientation you may have as a result of the sudden change of scenery, or your sleepiness. Spice coffee, as it is served by the roadside in Jassira." Well... do you chance it?
rows.translation: 那个夜晚，你做了一个奇怪的梦…… 你感受到温暖的阳光洒在脸上，起初你以为已经是早晨，该起床了。但随后你意识到，这样的阳光强度对于清晨来说实在太强烈了，而你现在应该还在[atCamp |在你的帐篷里 |室内 ]无论如何，当你睁开眼睛时，会发现自己并不在应该在的地方。 “来喝点香料咖啡吧， [pc.mf |先生 |错过 ]？”一个微弱的声音在你耳边响起，你转过头，看到一个蓝发的小猫族正抱着一个银色的托盘站在你身边。对了，你当时正躺着……不过你并不是躺在床上，而是坐在一个铺着柔软垫子的躺椅上，旁边是一个用土砖砌成的池塘。“这种东西在其他地方是找不到的。” 你看着那个涂了漆的陶制杯子，里面盛着那种浓稠、颜色深沉的液体芳香的一股浓烈的辛辣气味伴随着蒸汽升入空中，那气味之浓烈，简直足以让一头弥诺陶洛斯昏厥过去。再仔细观察周围的环境，你会看到大概有二十来个人——有猫族、深肤色的精灵以及阿努比斯族的人——他们或半裸着或穿着随意，悠闲地躺在水边或周围，闲聊着，而那些可爱的猫仆则随时为他们准备他们想要的东西。而在泳池庭院的另一边……哦，没错，那绝对是你这辈子见过的最美丽、最奢华的宫殿了。既然你已经参观了凯特的神庙，那么你对贾西兰的建筑风格已经有了足够的了解，因此应该能够很容易地认出它来。不过，那些宣礼塔确实别具一格。 当你回头看向身旁的猫族侍从时，看到他向你露出了鼓励的微笑，然后轻轻地将托盘往你这边推了推。“教皇陛下诚挚地邀请您前往他的接见厅。[pc.name]这应该能帮助你摆脱因环境突然变化而产生的迷失感，或者缓解你的困意。就像在贾西拉路边卖的那种加了香料的咖啡一样。” 那么……你愿意试试吗？
rows.raw: " You have a strange dream that night... You feel the warm sun on your face, and at first you think it's morning and it's time to get up. Then as you realize the sunlight's far too bright for early morning and you're supposed to be [atCamp |in your tent |indoors ] anyway, you open your eyes and find yourself not quite where you're supposed to be. You eye the varnished clay mug on offer, filled with thick, dark, and above all aromatic brew; the spicy smell rising into the air along with the steam strong enough to knock out a minotaur. Another quick look at your surroundings reveals perhaps two dozen people — catfolk, dark-skinned elves, and anubians — lounging in and around the water in various states of undress, chatting idly while cute cat valets serve them anything they might desire. And on the other side of the pool courtyard... oh yes, that has got to be the most beautiful, ostentatious palace you've ever seen in your life. With Cait's temple built, you've seen enough of Jassiran architecture to readily if not easily recognize it... the minarets are something else, though. Turning back to the catboy valet at your side, you see him give you an encouraging smile and nudge the tray ever so slightly towards you. "His Holiness cordially requests your presence in his audience chamber, [pc.name]. This should shake off any disorientation you may have as a result of the sudden change of scenery, or your sleepiness. Spice coffee, as it is served by the roadside in Jassira." Well... do you chance it? "

rows.original:
Inside the palace?
        
        "Just so."
        
        Looking at that place from the outside, it must be huge! How are you supposed to find anywhere in particular within it?
        
        "Just think of where you need to be, and you will find yourself there; that's how things work around here. I hope you have a pleasant stay here in the garden of passionate luxuries, [pc.mf
            |sir
            |miss
        ]."
        
        With another bow, the catboy valet turns tail and swishes off, his tail swaying delectably over that skin-tight thong of his. You lie there a minute or so longer, soaking in the warm sun, then reluctantly heave your leaden body out of the soft recliner and cross the pool towards the palace. No one pays you any mind as you do so, the other guests talking animatedly amongst themselves as they partake of drink, drugs and other delightful forms of passionate hedonism. It's not long before you find yourself under an alabaster and gold archway — some sort of side entrance — and step into the palace proper.
        
        Just think of where you need to be, and you'll find yourself there, huh? Picking a corridor, you set off at random and start padding along the spacious, well-lit hallways.

        猫男侍者又鞠了一躬，然后转身离去，他的尾巴在紧身的丁字裤上摇摆着，显得格外迷人。你又在那里躺了一分钟左右，享受着温暖的阳光，最后终于勉强从柔软的躺椅上爬起来，穿过游泳池，朝着宫殿的方向走去。你这样做时，没有人会注意到你。其他宾客们一边喝酒、服用各种药物，一边兴致勃勃地交谈着，尽情享受着这种充满激情的享乐时光。不久之后，你便发现自己站在一座由雪花石膏和黄金打造的拱门下——那应该是某条侧门——然后走入了宫殿的内部。
        
        只要想象自己应该去的地方，你就会立刻出现在那里，对吧？你随意选择了一条走廊，然后开始沿着这些宽敞明亮的大厅走去。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: To say that this is a pleasure palace would be an understatement — the scene by the pool was mild compared to the veritable font of hedonism that's contained within these white walls. The air's heavy with pipesmoke, yet the large windows allow a floral scent to blow in from the garden courtyards that intersperse the complex. Soft music lingers all about you, emanating from some unseen source, and catfolk valets run up and down the halls, fetching, carrying, serving, and sometimes disappearing into side chambers. All of them sport heart-shaped tattoos on their lower bellies of some sort, brands of the harlot like Cait and Sally's... ... And then there're the guests, of course. Like the valets, they all carry Mallach's brand, but also wear the white cloaks of office of the Mallachite clergy, complete with red clasps. They cavort, they laugh, they drink and do all kinds of drugs, they openly engage in all sorts of public affections, completely uncaring for who might be looking on. It's not quite an open orgy, that's to be sure, but it's pretty damn close; the veneer of culture here is the only thing that's keeping the entire scene from just descending into a fit of bestial rutting. [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |And strangely enough, a familiar face amongst the lot. Laid out under a gazebo is an ophidian figure you'll never forget — Nareva herself looks extremely comfortable, her human half laid out in a small heap of perfumed pillows while her serpentine half basks atop sun-warmed brick. The goddess of knowledge, magic and secrets has even got into the spirit of things, having donned a ludicrous amount of gaudy black metal and amethyst jewelry in addition to a camel-wool sock that fits over her snake tail all the way to her waist. As you approach, she looks over the top of the book she's reading, then hurriedly moves to obscure the title from sight. There's no hiding the warm, fuzzy sock she's wearing, though, and Nareva bites her lip as you approach, clearly trying very hard not to skulk. Fancy meeting her here, of all places. "I could say the same for you. The kitten said he was having a guest over today, but he didn't mention who it was. Are you enjoying the party?" Is that what it is? You're a bit confused about all this — you just woke up by the poolside, and got told he wanted to meet you in his audience chamber. And what's she doing here? Here for the party, too? "The party?" Nareva scoffs. "Please. Do you see anyone else around here? No, of course not. I don't do parties, they're so uncouth. Maybe a professional convocation or seminar, but at least I'd attempt to try and disguise the rampant hedonism. "No, I'm here to read. The kitten is not just the god of lust, my dear, he's also the god of art and beauty and inspiration and all other kinds of passions. There's a lot of copulation going on in his demesne but it's not everywhere, and let's face it, the poor boy has got the best collection of art from the world before, as it were. All replicas, of course, but they'd have to be in here; he does have a lovely aesthetic sense and knows how to decorate. Comes with the portfolio. "Once you put enough walls between you and the incessant moaning of his high clergy, it's actually a very comfortable place in which to get some reading done. It's the atmosphere, you see — I can't recreate that something or the other that he can over in my Dream, and maybe it's for the best. I'd never leave the house otherwise." Right. If she's familiar with this place, could she direct you to [silly |Mallach and his boithrone |the audience chamber ], then? "Just think of where you need to be, and you'll find yourself there. That's how things work around here." Yeah, you've heard that one before. No, seriously. Isn't she supposed to be the dry and aloof one? A sigh. "Spoilsport. Fine. Go that way, then second corridor on the left, then the next one on the right. You can't miss it." See, that wasn't that hard, was it? "If you say so. Now, run along now, would you?" The goddess of knowledge, secrets and magic dismisses you with an airy wave of a hand. "I really want to get this volume inside of me before I have to get back to work." ] Just think of where you need to be, and you'll find yourself there... Eventually though, the music slowly fades and the dancers become fewer in number; the guests retreat into private chambers and the air clears of smoke. Cushions and recliners are replaced with curtains of silk, paintings and old sculptures from what looks to be a myriad of cultures, ancient art from what can only be before the Godswar. Slowly, the hallway broadens, and opens up into a rotunda lit by the sun shining down on panels upon panels of pink-hued stained glass. And in the middle of it all, his heavily cushioned throne facing you despite the round chamber, is [flags.RIVER_TLK_SCRT|the familiar sight of|a small catboy who can only be] Mallach. He lazes about in a stereotypically feline fashion, draped over the seat with his tail flowing down onto the mosaic-tiled floor. The golden citole he's usually depicted with isn't in his hands, but lying against his throne, and his ears perk up as you draw near, the godling making an attempt to sit up in his throne as you approach. [flags.RIVER_TLK_SCRT |"Welcome! Welcome to my home away from home — our last meeting was quite abrupt, but I think here we have some time and space to be able to have a more in-depth discussion |"Welcome! I was afraid you wouldn't accept my invitation and simply decide to lounge by the pool, but I'm glad we're able to meet face to face like this ]. Don't mind my other guests — ranking amongst the highest of the high clergy and paladins of mine has its benefits. I am the god of art and beauty and inspiration and all other kinds of passions. Not just fucking." But fucking's what he's most infamous for. A sly smile. "That's a reputation I'm not ashamed of. But first! Business before pleasure, or at least when the business isn't pleasure. On behalf of myself, I'd like to thank you for looking out for Caitriss Zethra and her junior Salwah Amin. That, and building them their temple. It means a lot to me, too." A temple to Mallach in the Marches. Yes, you can see the implications of that, too. "Why, there are many catfolk of Jassiran descent up in that corner of the world who would dearly love to rekindle the faith of their ancestors. I even hear there're some people from Tronarii loitering about, aren't there? Whatever could I mean?" Mallach's eyes twinkle mischievously. "Certainly a formal temple would not be a perfect foothold to expand my influence within what has traditionally been Lumia's domain, would it? After all, she can hardly complain about what people do of their own accord." Hmph, you're glad to have been of such use to him. "Come now, don't be such a grump." Purring softly, the catboy god flows off his throne, golden jewelry clinking as he stretches and approaches you with arms spread to give you a friendly hug. "I really do just want to thank you for caring for Cait and hers in her time of need, and building the temple she needs to truly get her faith off the ground. Enjoy yourself! Be merry! Have some fun in the sun! Jassira's sun never sets here in my Dream, until it's time for the nighttime orgies under the stars. "Or should I show my appreciation to you in some other way?" From the way the godling's wiggling his hips and tail at you, it's clear what Mallach means by showing his appreciation. You could go along with it, ask for something else, or just decline and be done with this place...
rows.translation: 说这里是一座享乐的天堂都算是轻描淡写了——与这些白色墙壁所围成的真正享乐之地相比，泳池边的场景简直算不上什么。空气中弥漫着烟味，但大窗户让花园里散发出的花香飘了进来，这些花园遍布在整个建筑群中。轻柔的音乐在空气中回荡，仿佛源自某个看不见的地方。猫族侍从们在走廊中来来去去，或是取来物品，或是搬运东西，或是提供服务，有时也会消失在侧厅里。他们的腹部都纹有某种心形的图案，这些图案代表着像凯特和莎莉这样的妓女。……当然，还有那些宾客们。他们和侍从们一样，都佩戴着马拉克的品牌标志，同时也穿着马拉克教士们特有的白色礼服，礼服上还配有红色的扣件。他们嬉戏、欢笑、饮酒，甚至服用各种药物，公然表现出各种亲密的行为，完全不在意周围有没有人在注视着他们。虽然这算不上是一场彻底的放纵狂欢，但已经非常接近了；这里的文化表象才是唯一能阻止整个场面陷入野蛮的混乱状态的因素。 [flags.ARCHWAY_BOTH_SAVED |说来也怪，在那些人当中有一张熟悉的面孔。在凉亭下，摆放着一个你绝对不会忘记的蛇形雕像——娜瑞瓦本人看起来非常惬意，她的人类部分躺在一堆芳香四溢的枕头上，而她的蛇形部分则盘踞在被阳光晒热的砖块上。这位掌管知识、魔法与秘密的女神，甚至将自己的灵魂也融入了这些物品之中——她佩戴了大量华丽的黑色金属饰品与紫水晶首饰，还穿了一只骆驼毛制成的袜子，这只袜子一直延伸到她的蛇尾，覆盖了她的整个腰部。当你靠近时，她从正在阅读的书上抬起头，然后急忙把书名遮住，不让别人看到。不过，她脚上那双暖和的毛线袜却无处可藏。当你走近时，娜瑞瓦咬住了嘴唇，显然在努力克制自己不要躲起来。 真没想到会在这里遇见她。 “我也有同感。那只小猫说今天会有客人来，但却没说是谁。你喜欢这个派对吗？ 就是这么回事吗？你对这一切感到有点困惑——你刚刚在泳池边醒来，然后有人告诉你他想在会客室见你。那么，接下来会发生什么呢？她来这里干什么？也是来参加派对的吗？” “派对？”娜瑞瓦嗤笑道。请。你看到这里还有其他人吗？没有，当然没有。我可没看到。派对他们真是太粗俗无礼了。或许应该举办一场专业的会议或研讨会，至少这样我还能试着掩盖那种肆无忌惮的享乐主义。 “不，我是来读书的。那只小猫不在这里。只是亲爱的，欲望之神同时也是艺术、美、灵感以及各种激情的神。在他的领地里，发生着大量的交配行为，但那并不是到处说实话，这个可怜的男孩以前确实拥有过世界上最精美的艺术收藏品。当然，那些都是复制品，但它们肯定应该被放在这里；他的审美眼光确实很棒，他也懂得如何装饰随附作品集。 “只要你在自己与那些高阶神职人员的无休止抱怨之间建立起足够的‘隔墙’，这个地方其实就非常适合用来阅读。关键在于那种氛围——我在自己的梦境中无法重现那种感觉，或许这样反而是好事。否则，我根本就不会离开这个房子。” 对了，如果她熟悉这个地方，应该能帮你找到去那里的路吧。 [silly |马拉克和他的王位 |观众席 ]那又怎样？ “只要想着自己应该去的地方，你就会到达那里。这里就是这么运作的。” 是啊，这种话你以前也听过吧。不过说真的，她不是应该表现得冷淡疏离一些吗？ 叹了口气。“真扫兴。好吧，你去吧。那个那么，先往左走第二个走廊，然后再往右转进入下一个走廊。你肯定不会迷路的。” “看吧，其实并没有那么难，对吧？” “你这么说的话……现在快去吧。”这位掌管知识、秘密与魔法的女神随意地挥了挥手，示意你离开。“在我回去工作之前，我真的必须把这本书的内容记在心里。 ] 只要想象自己应该去的地方，你就会立刻出现在那里…… 然而，最终，音乐渐渐消失了，跳舞的人也越来越少；宾客们纷纷退回到各自的房间，空气中再也没有烟雾了。靠垫和躺椅被丝绸帘子所取代，墙上挂满了来自各种文化的绘画和古老雕塑，还有一些显然诞生于“神战”之前的古代艺术品。走廊逐渐变宽，最终通向一个圆形大厅——阳光透过一层层粉红色的彩玻璃照射进来，照亮了整个大厅。 而在这一切的中心，尽管大厅是圆形的，他的王座依然被厚厚的软垫包裹着，正对着你而立。 [flags.RIVER_TLK_SCRT|那熟悉的景象|一个只能……的小猫族]马拉克。它以典型的猫科动物姿态懒洋洋地躺在座椅上，尾巴垂落在铺着马赛克瓷砖的地板上。它通常会手持的那把金色竖琴此刻并没有拿在手中，而是放在它的王座旁边。当你靠近时，它的耳朵会立刻竖起来，这个小神明还会试图从王座上坐起来迎接你。 [flags.RIVER_TLK_SCRT |欢迎来到我的第二个家——我们上次的会面很突然，但我想在这里，我们应该有足够的时间和空间来进行更深入的讨论。 |欢迎来到这里！我本来担心你不会接受我的邀请，而是会选择在泳池边休息，不过很高兴我们终于能够这样面对面地见面了。 ]别在意我的其他客人——能够与我最尊贵的高阶神职人员及骑士们为伍，确实有一些好处。我是艺术与美、灵感以及各种激情的神明。而不仅仅是“性爱”而已。 但恰恰是“性爱”，让他声名狼藉。 他狡黠地笑了笑：“这个名声，我并不感到羞耻。不过首先——先谈正事，至少在谈正事之前不是非常感谢。我代表自己，想要感谢你们对凯特丽丝泽特拉以及她的同伴萨尔瓦 Amin的关心与帮助，还有为她们建造寺庙这件事。这对我也意义重大。 在边境地区为马拉克建造一座寺庙，真是太好了。是的，你也可以看出这其中所蕴含的意义。 “嗯，在世界的那个角落，有很多具有贾西兰血统的猫族，他们非常希望能够重新唤醒他们祖先的信仰。我甚至听说还有一些来自特洛纳里的人也在那里活动，对吧？我这话到底是什么意思呢？”马拉克的眼睛里闪烁着调皮的光芒。“显然，一个正式的寺庙并不会成为我在传统上属于卢米娅的领域里扩大影响力的理想基地，对吧？毕竟，人们自愿做的事情，她总不能去抱怨吧？哼，看来你能对他有所帮助，让他挺高兴的嘛。” rows.original: You follow Mallach out of the audience chamber and down the endless hallways of his perfumed palace; at length, white tiles give way to plush purple and red carpets, with all traces of the party-cum-orgy that's going on in his demesne faded away. This is clearly some kind of inner sanctum for the catboy godling, beams of light falling down upon the soft rug and birdsong from the gardens your only accompaniment. Works of incredible art adorn stands and hang from the walls, but Mallach pays them no heed; whatever he intends to show you, it's clearly not his private museum. But eventually, you step out onto a high balcony overlooking the pool that wasn't there when you were viewing the palace from the outside; you can see Mallach's faithful milling about below you as tiny dots, oblivious as to your presence. Out over the distance and away from the palace, a river winds its way through the unending sands, boats plying up and down its waters and lush greenery following its banks as it flows... wherever it flows in this otherworldly realm. There are only two things here: an artist's easel, complete with everything one needs to draw from charcoal to paints, and a clay sculptor's workbench, on which several miniature figurines stand in various stages of completion. "I like to watch my people when I work," Mallach explains, curling his tail about one of his legs. "It's inspiring." Work at... oh. That explains the sculptures on the bench, the drawing on the easel. "We didn't have much time to talk about River back then. I got the feeling that you were hoping for a more thorough explanation when we met, but the circumstances weren't right for it. But here... it's finally cathartic in a way to be able to talk to someone, someone new about all of this." You have to wonder about all of this — Nareva is the goddess of knowledge, magic and secrets. By her reputation, she should've been able to defeat you soundly in that kind of argument. And yet you managed to corner her in an impromptu verbal debate. "Mm." It feels like at some point, she wanted the truth to come out, and that's why you were able to talk her down in the first place. And if that were the case — not saying that it was, of course — is this something like that, too? "Maybe. Or if you'd rather, consider this your reward for what you've done for me and mine, [pc.title]. It may sit better on your sensibilities that way, or it might not. That's the wonder of you people." Crossing over to the easel, Mallach passes his hand over the canvas. The half-drawn picture of a catgirl shimmers, ripples and is replaced with another one, and another one, and yet another one, changing like the turning of words on a page. "Yes, here is where River — every iteration — is shaped before being born. First shaped in pencil and paint, then in clay... "...In perfect detail..." There's something in the way that he says those last three words that sends a shiver racing up your spine, completely at odds with the beauty and revelry of the glorious white and gold palace under the warm sun. Sighing, Mallach crosses over to the clay figurine of his latest River and strokes it lovingly. "Fashioned from dust and clay, brought to life with a single divine breath. Romantic and poetic, but also not quite true." You remember him saying back in Hawkethorne's square that he wanted to understand mortals better through River — an authentic expression of all the passions of people from all walks of life, to quote him. Mallach doesn't reply at first, stepping over to the balcony railing to watch his faithful at play, then raises his gaze into the sun of Jassira. "Even after experiencing all that I have, even after living life after life, long and short, in the flesh as every iteration of River across the face of this world, I still cannot comprehend how you can consider any part of your lives mundane. Well, I can, but the incredulity of the way you take everything about you for granted stretches my sensibilities to their breaking point. I can only imagine that becoming so inured to everything about you is a defensive mechanism to prevent your minds from being overwhelmed. And yet... "Imagine, then, that every drop of water that passed your lips tasted like the richest wine. That dry bread was the greatest delicacy, that the warmth of the sun on your body filled you with such intense yearning that you were left breathless, that the sight of a star-filled night sky moved you to tears. You pass by these things every day, not realizing how rare they are in the scheme of things, how desperate the beings that exist in the void between the spheres are to experience them, to taste of these delights you consider everyday and humdrum. It's something that you can never appreciate in the same way as I do unless you've known what extremes of dark emptiness are possible. Maybe this will give some perspective on why portals are such dangerous occurrences, why the creatures like I once was were driven to them like moths to a flame. "Knowing all this, how can I be anyone but myself?"
rows.translation: 你跟随马拉克走出观众厅，沿着他那充满香气的宫殿里无尽的走廊前行；最终，白色的瓷砖被柔软的紫色和红色地毯所取代，而他领地里正在进行的那些派对与狂欢活动，也早已消失得无影无踪了。这里显然就是那个猫人神童的私人圣地，柔和的灯光洒在柔软的地毯上，花园里传来的鸟鸣声则是唯一的伴奏。各种令人惊叹的艺术品陈列在架子上或悬挂在墙上，但马拉克根本没有注意到它们；他想要向你展示的，显然并不是他的私人博物馆。 但最终，你会走到一个高高的阳台上，从这里可以俯瞰游泳池——而在你从外面观看宫殿时，是看不到这个游泳池的；你会看到马拉克的那些忠诚追随者们，在你下方忙碌地活动着，他们就像一个个小小的点，完全没有注意到你的存在。远远地，在宫殿的另一侧，一条河流蜿蜒着穿过无边无际的沙丘，船只在这条河上往来穿梭，河岸两侧长满了茂密的绿植……无论这条河流在这个超凡脱俗的世界中最终流向何方。 这里只有两样东西：一个艺术家的画架，上面配备了从木炭到颜料所需的一切绘画工具；还有一个陶艺师的的工作台，上面摆放着几尊处于不同完成阶段的微型雕像。 “我在工作的时候喜欢观察我的‘人们’，”马拉克解释道，他的尾巴缠在一条腿上，“这真的很有启发性。 在……工作啊。原来如此，这就解释了长椅上的那些雕塑以及画架上的那幅画了。 “那时候我们并没有太多时间来谈论瑞弗的事情。我感觉你希望在我们见面时能得到更详细的解释，但当时的环境并不适合讨论这个话题。不过现在……能够和某个人倾诉这些，终于让人感到如释重负了。新的关于这一切，实在让人不得不深思。” 你确实有必要仔细思考这些事情——娜瑞瓦可是知识、魔法与秘密的女神。以她的名声来看，她在那样的辩论中本应该能够轻松击败你。然而，你却设法在一场即兴的口头辩论中将她逼入了绝境。 “嗯。” 感觉在某个时刻，她通缉中真相终会大白，这就是你当初能够说服她的原因。如果真是这样的话——当然，我并不是说一定是这样——那么这也算是一种对你为我以及我所关心的人所做的一切的奖励吧？[pc.title]这样可能会更符合你的审美，也可能不会。这就是人类的奇妙之处吧。”马拉克走到画架前，用手轻轻抚过画布。半完成的那幅猫娘画像开始闪烁、变幻，很快被另一幅画面取代，又是一幅，再是一幅，画面不断变换，就像书页上文字的流转一样。“没错，就在这里，每一个‘瑞弗’的形象在诞生之前都会被逐渐塑造出来。首先用铅笔和颜料勾勒轮廓，然后再用黏土进行塑造…… ……每一个细节都刻画得如此精致……” 他说出最后这三个字时的语气，让人不寒而栗——这与在温暖阳光下，那座金碧辉煌的白色宫殿所散发出的美丽与欢乐氛围截然相反。马拉克叹了口气，走到自己最新创作的泥人面前，满怀爱意地抚摸着它。 由尘土与黏土塑造而成，凭借那一口神圣的气息而被赋予生命。充满浪漫与诗意，却又并非完全真实。” 你还记得他在鹰棘镇广场上说过，他想通过《河流》来更好地理解凡人——用它来真实地展现各行各业人们的所有情感，他是这么说的。 马拉克起初没有回答，他走到阳台的栏杆旁，注视着自己那些忠实的伙伴们正在玩耍，然后将目光投向贾西拉的阳光下。“即使经历了这一切，即使以这个世界上河神的每一次化身，在漫长或短暂的生命中一次次地体验人生，我仍然无法理解——你们怎么会认为自己生活中的任何一部分是平凡的。嗯，我可以但你那种将身边的一切都视为理所当然的态度，实在让我难以忍受。我只能认为，你之所以会对自己身边的一切如此习以为常，其实是一种防御机制，目的是防止自己的心灵被这些事物压得喘不过气来。然而…… “想象一下，每一滴流过你嘴唇的水都带着最浓郁的美酒滋味；那干面包成了最美味的食物；阳光洒在身上的温暖会让你产生如此强烈的渴望，以至于让你屏住呼吸；而满天繁星的夜空会让你感动得落泪。你每天都会经过这些事物，却从未意识到，在整个宇宙的尺度来看，它们是多么稀有啊绝望的那些存在于各个领域之间的虚无中的生物，正是为了体验这些、品味你们认为平凡而琐碎的乐趣而存在的。除非你亲身经历过那种极度的暗影与空虚，否则你永远无法像我一样真正理解这些。也许，这能帮助你理解为什么传送门会如此危险，为什么像我这样的生物会像飞蛾扑火般被它们吸引。 “了解了这一切之后，我怎么可能成为别人呢？
rows.raw: " You follow Mallach out of the audience chamber and down the endless hallways of his perfumed palace; at length, white tiles give way to plush purple and red carpets, with all traces of the party-cum-orgy that's going on in his demesne faded away. This is clearly some kind of inner sanctum for the catboy godling, beams of light falling down upon the soft rug and birdsong from the gardens your only accompaniment. Works of incredible art adorn stands and hang from the walls, but Mallach pays them no heed; whatever he intends to show you, it's clearly not his private museum. But eventually, you step out onto a high balcony overlooking the pool that wasn't there when you were viewing the palace from the outside; you can see Mallach's faithful milling about below you as tiny dots, oblivious as to your presence. Out over the distance and away from the palace, a river winds its way through the unending sands, boats plying up and down its waters and lush greenery following its banks as it flows... wherever it flows in this otherworldly realm. There are only two things here: an artist's easel, complete with everything one needs to draw from charcoal to paints, and a clay sculptor's workbench, on which several miniature figurines stand in various stages of completion. "I like to watch my people when I work," Mallach explains, curling his tail about one of his legs. "It's inspiring." Work at... oh. That explains the sculptures on the bench, the drawing on the easel. "We didn't have much time to talk about River back then. I got the feeling that you were hoping for a more thorough explanation when we met, but the circumstances weren't right for it. But here... it's finally cathartic in a way to be able to talk to someone, someone new about all of this." You have to wonder about all of this — Nareva is the goddess of knowledge, magic and secrets. By her reputation, she should've been able to defeat you soundly in that kind of argument. And yet you managed to corner her in an impromptu verbal debate. "Mm." It feels like at some point, she wanted the truth to come out, and that's why you were able to talk her down in the first place. And if that were the case — not saying that it was, of course — is this something like that, too? "Maybe. Or if you'd rather, consider this your reward for what you've done for me and mine, [pc.title]. It may sit better on your sensibilities that way, or it might not. That's the wonder of you people." Crossing over to the easel, Mallach passes his hand over the canvas. The half-drawn picture of a catgirl shimmers, ripples and is replaced with another one, and another one, and yet another one, changing like the turning of words on a page. "Yes, here is where River — every iteration — is shaped before being born. First shaped in pencil and paint, then in clay... "...In perfect detail..." There's something in the way that he says those last three words that sends a shiver racing up your spine, completely at odds with the beauty and revelry of the glorious white and gold palace under the warm sun. Sighing, Mallach crosses over to the clay figurine of his latest River and strokes it lovingly. "Fashioned from dust and clay, brought to life with a single divine breath. Romantic and poetic, but also not quite true." You remember him saying back in Hawkethorne's square that he wanted to understand mortals better through River — an authentic expression of all the passions of people from all walks of life, to quote him. Mallach doesn't reply at first, stepping over to the balcony railing to watch his faithful at play, then raises his gaze into the sun of Jassira. "Even after experiencing all that I have, even after living life after life, long and short, in the flesh as every iteration of River across the face of this world, I still cannot comprehend how you can consider any part of your lives mundane. Well, I can, but the incredulity of the way you take everything about you for granted stretches my sensibilities to their breaking point. I can only imagine that becoming so inured to everything about you is a defensive mechanism to prevent your minds from being overwhelmed. And yet... "Imagine, then, that every drop of water that passed your lips tasted like the richest wine. That dry bread was the greatest delicacy, that the warmth of the sun on your body filled you with such intense yearning that you were left breathless, that the sight of a star-filled night sky moved you to tears. You pass by these things every day, not realizing how rare they are in the scheme of things, how desperate the beings that exist in the void between the spheres are to experience them, to taste of these delights you consider everyday and humdrum. It's something that you can never appreciate in the same way as I do unless you've known what extremes of dark emptiness are possible. Maybe this will give some perspective on why portals are such dangerous occurrences, why the creatures like I once was were driven to them like moths to a flame. "Knowing all this, how can I be anyone but myself?" "

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The both of you stand there awhile, and then Mallach finally sighs. "The spirits of those I had consumed — reliving their existences like reading a book entertained me for a while, but it wasn't enough. I was but a passive observer, looking on from the outside. I wanted... no, I was inspired to participate. To finally create and experience authentic situations of my own making. Even something as simple as waking up, toiling the day away and then returning to sleep... to say that was tantalizing is a terrible understatement. And oh, did I get so much more." He shivers. "Such excitement. Such passion. Such sorrow and bitterness. All of it better than the painful nothing that was before. A dozen or two Rivers bringing me continuous insight as to the nature of mortals... "It's intoxicating. Addictive, even." Before you've realized it, another of Mallach's many valets has arrived with a cup of something strong-smelling and faintly floral. The catboy god nods, receives the offering, and takes a sip. But when you take a closer look at the servant, he is nothing like the multitude of catboys and catgirls that ply the corridors and terraces of Mallach's perfumed palace, the silks bound about his body cover up the worst of his features in much the same was as a Jassiran mummy, but what gets through is... broken, for lack of a better word to put it. Mismatched, uneven eyes and ears, one spindly leg that forces him to totter around, and a stubby, half-formed tail to complement his twisted yet earnest smile — one can only wonder what's under those tightly-bound wrappings that these are the most presentable parts of this particular catboy. "[pc.name], allow me to present the first River." River bows. This... this is... "I had practiced, of course, but you must understand that given the subject matter, one can only go so far while keeping within the boundaries of what you might consider humane. Using the memories of the people I had consumed, who were now part of me, my first genuine attempt creating an avatar, a homunculus, was healthy and functional, for a definition of functional. His body was healthy enough to survive, but little more." "River manifested at an approximate biological age of fifteen in a dirty alleyway in the ruined capital of Jassira, still reeling from the Godswar. He quickly learned that his appearance caused others to consider him a leper, or worse, wraith-touched; on that latter account, they were not completely wrong. To show his face in public without being stoned for indecency and insulting the modesty of the public, he wrapped himself from head to toe in dirty rags, and sang for a living. While he had all the ability of thousands pressed into that little body of his, River's defects prevented him from ever leaving the streets. Throughout his existence, River found happiness in having a roof over his head, a warm bed, and a full belly. "Through some quirk of fate, River lived to the approximate age of seventy, which is far more than might have been expected of a catfolk leper. His existence was miserable by the standards of most Jassirans — [pc.bg slumrat |as someone who lived tooth and nail on the streets before becoming [a] [pc.title], you should understand that |at least in the decade or so that he spent as a slave, he could count on being fed and sheltered ]. By all means, the being that I was before would have concluded that the only rational recourse for River would have been to end his own miserable life and save himself a lengthy — by a mortal's reckoning — existence of deformed misery. Yet as I told you in our previous meeting, the sixty-odd years I spent as River were far happier than the eternity that I spent as what I was. While I had understood what it meant from viewing the memories of others, it was not until River came along that I truly comprehended what it meant to hope: this strange, unique irrationality, no, insanity that inflames the passions against the inevitable. "Can there really be hope without madness?"
rows.translation: 你们俩站在那里好一会儿，最后马拉克终于叹了口气。 “那些我吞噬过的灵魂——重新体验他们的存在，就像读一本书一样，让我感到有些乐趣，但这种感觉并没有持续太久。足够了我只不过是一个旁观者，从外部看着这一切。我想要……不，我其实是受到启发参与其中。终于能够参与。创建以及体验这些都是我亲自创造的真实体验。哪怕是像起床、一整天忙碌工作然后再次入睡这样简单的事情……说这些体验令人兴奋，都算是轻描淡写了。哦，其实还有更多……”他颤抖着继续说道，“如此多的激情、如此强烈的情绪，还有悲伤与苦涩……所有这些，都比之前那种毫无意义的空白状态要好得多。十几位‘河流’让我不断深入地理解了人类的本质…… 这种味道令人陶醉，甚至会上瘾。” 还没等你反应过来，马拉克的另一个侍从又端来一杯散发着浓烈香气、带有淡淡花香的饮品。这位猫族形态的神明点了点头，接过了饮品，然后喝了一口。但当你仔细观察这个仆从时，你会发现他与那些在马拉克芬芳宫殿的走廊和露台上四处活动的猫族男孩和猫族女孩们完全不同。缠绕在他身上的丝绸掩盖了他最丑陋的特征，这一点与贾西兰的木乃伊颇为相似。然而，有些东西还是能够被看出来的。…可以用“残缺的”这个词来形容。他的眼睛和耳朵大小不一、不对称；一条细长的腿让他走路时总是摇摇晃晃；还有一条短粗的、尚未发育完全的尾巴。再加上他那扭曲却充满真诚的笑容，人们不禁会好奇：在这层紧紧包裹着他的外皮之下，究竟隐藏着什么？而这些，其实就是这个特别的猫族少年最显眼、最引人注目的特征了。 "[pc.name]，请允许我为大家介绍第一位‘河流’。” 河流鞠了一躬。 这……这实在是…… “我当然已经练习过了，但你们必须明白，考虑到这个主题，一个人在遵守你们所认为的‘人道’准则的前提下，所能做的也仅限于此而已。借助那些被我吸收、如今已成为我一部分之人的记忆，我第一次真正尝试创造了一个化身——一个具有实际功能的生物。从功能的角度来看，它确实是可以生存的，但也就仅此而已。它的身体虽然足够健康，能够维持生命，但除此之外并没有其他特别之处。" 瑞弗在贾西拉这座饱经战乱、满目疮痍的首都的一条肮脏小巷中诞生，那时他的生理年龄大约只有十五岁。他很快发现，自己的外貌让别人将他视为麻风病人，甚至更糟——他们认为他是被怨灵侵扰了；而从这个角度来看，他们的判断也并非完全错误。为了能在公开场合露面而不会因为行为不端或侮辱公众的尊严而遭到石刑，他从头到脚都裹着肮脏的破布，以唱歌为生。尽管他拥有成千上万普通人所拥有的各种能力，但河神的缺陷却使他永远无法离开街头。在整个人生中，瑞弗觉得拥有一个遮风挡雨的住所、一张温暖的床铺以及一顿饱饭，这些就是幸福。 由于命运的某种奇妙安排，瑞弗活到了大约七十岁的年纪，这对于一个患有麻风病的猫族来说，无疑是出乎意料的。按照大多数贾西兰人的标准来看，他的生活无疑是悲惨的—— [pc.bg slumrat |在我能够拥有现在的生活之前，我曾经在街头艰难地求生。[pc.title]你应该明白这一点。 |至少在他那大约十年的奴隶生活中，他可以有饭吃、有地方住。 ]毫无疑问，以前的我一定会认为，对瑞弗来说，唯一的理性选择就是结束自己痛苦的生命，从而避免那种在凡人看来漫长而充满畸形的苦难。然而，正如我们在上次会议中讨论过的，我以瑞弗的身份度过的六十多年，远比以原来的那个身份度过的永恒时光要快乐得多。虽然通过观察他人的记忆，我曾经理解过这种感受的含义，但直到瑞弗出现，我才真正体会到了这一点。明白了希望意味着什么：这种奇怪的、独一无二的非理性行为，不疯狂行为那种只会激起人们对不可避免之事的愤怒与反抗。 “如果没有疯狂，真的还有希望存在吗？
