rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: More and more valets have streamed in onto the balcony at this point, quietly standing in neat, military ranks, listening to Mallach's tale as the godling stands by your side watching the Jassiran sun begin to set, amber rays casting shadows upon the palace while the lanterns light up one by one. "After some tries, I got better at... manipulation. Simply existing out of nothing was not sufficient; the experience was not authentic enough. I took those unborn kittens who would have been miscarriages or stillborn and altered them in the womb, gave them another chance at life; it was the method that weighed least on my conscience, and they could have souls as opposed to the first River. They were born. They lived. They died. And as with the first River, I invited them here to my Dream, where they can stay for all eternity if they desire. This is not an afterlife... we are not in the habit of keeping souls and spirits en masse in our domains. But River... ah, River is special. Each one is an extension of me, an avatar, a son or daughter in the sense that I will ever have any." So... all these catboys and catgirls are every single River to have lived? Can't be more than three dozen of them here. "There are more," Mallach replies, sweeping a hand theatrically over the river and the boats that ply along its waters. "Not all want to live here with me in this palace. Others wish to move on, and I don't deny them that desire; they are free to face oblivion when they grow tired of existence. But do remember what I said, that there are usually only two dozen Rivers at any one time at most, and it has only been a little over two centuries since I started doing this." You move to pick up the little white clay figurine of River on the workbench, and Mallach doesn't stop you. Turning it over in your hands, you're made aware of the large hole in its back through which you can see into its form — [pc.bgMulti scholar acolyte arcanist soldier |while you didn't go too deep into anatomical studies at the academy, it was impossible to not have a passing knowledge of such from how it was being spoken of in the halls |tending to the local sick and injured at the monastery required that you have at least a passing knowledge of basic anatomy, and it all comes rushing back to you as you look closer |while you didn't go too deep into anatomical studies with your mentor, it was impossible to not have a passing knowledge of such as a result of your education |what you see is nothing strange for anyone who's spent long enough on battlefields to experience the gruesome nature of the corpses left in war's wake ]. The spine, the ribs, what organs you recognize... in an ordinary figurine, there would be little need to sculpt such internals, and yet there they are. Back then, you asked about River; now that we've had some time together, I've answered in as complete a fashion as I can. Consider this my thanks for your help in not just taking care of mine, but establishing a foothold for my influence in a place that's ripe for the pickings. rows.translation: 此时，越来越多的侍从们陆续来到阳台上，他们安静地排成整齐的队列，聆听马拉克的故事。而那个小神明则站在你的身旁，注视着贾西兰的太阳渐渐落山——琥珀色的光芒在宫殿上投下阴影，而一盏盏灯笼也陆续被点亮。 经过几次尝试，我在……这种操控技巧上取得了进步。仅仅凭无中生有是远远不够的，那种体验显得太不真实了。于是我选取那些本会流产或死产的小猫，在它们还在母体中的时候对它们进行改造，让它们获得第二次生命的机会；这种做法对我的良心的负担最小，而且这些小猫也能拥有灵魂，这与第一次尝试的方式截然不同。他们诞生了，他们活着，他们也去世了。和最初的那些人一样，我邀请他们来到我的梦境之中，如果他们愿意，就可以在这里永远停留。这并不是来世……我们并没有将众多灵魂和灵体聚集在我们的领域中的习惯。但是瑞弗……啊，瑞弗与众不同。每一个角色都是我的延伸，都是我的化身，都是我在这个世界上拥有的儿子或女儿。 所以……所有这些猫男猫女都是历史上曾经存在过的吗？这里最多也就三十来个人吧。 “其实还有更多，”马拉克一边说，一边戏剧性地将手挥向那条河流以及沿岸行驶的船只。并不是所有人都愿意和我一起生活在这座宫殿里。有些人希望继续自己的旅程，我并不否认他们的这种愿望；当他们厌倦了现有的生活时，他们完全可以选择走向遗忘。但请记住我说过的话：通常任何时候最多也只有二十几条‘河流’存在而已。而我开始做这件事，也才刚刚超过两个世纪而已。" 你走到工作台前，拿起那个小小的白色陶土雕像——那是瑞弗的雕像，马拉克并没有阻止你。你把雕像在手中翻来覆去，发现它的背面有一个很大的洞，透过这个洞，你可以看到它的内部构造[pc.bgMulti scholar acolyte arcanist soldier |虽然你在学院里并没有深入研究解剖学，但鉴于课堂上经常提到这些内容，你不可能对它们一无所知。 |在修道院里照顾当地的伤病者，至少需要你对基础解剖学有一定的了解，而当你仔细观察时，这些知识就会立刻浮现在你的脑海中。 |虽然你并没有与导师深入探讨解剖学的相关知识，但由于你所接受的教育，你对这些内容也必然会有一些基本的了解。 |对于那些在战场上待过足够长时间、亲眼目睹过战争留下的那些惨状的人来说，你所看到的这一切根本不算什么奇怪的事情。 ]脊柱、肋骨，还有那些你能辨认出来的器官……在普通的雕像中，其实几乎没有必要雕刻这些内部结构，但它们确实被雕刻出来了。 你必须竭尽全力，才能不让自己颤抖的手部把雕像弄掉，然后小心翼翼地把它放回原来的位置。细节详尽至极…… 就是这样。当初你问过关于瑞弗的事情；现在我们已经有了一些相处的时间，我也尽我所能给出了最完整的回答。就把这当作我对你的感谢吧——感谢你不仅照顾了我，还帮助我在一个机会众多的地方建立了自己的影响力。这总比和神进行普通的性行为要好吧？” “嗯……也许确实如此。” “那么，谢谢你的倾听。让我送你出去吧？其实我可以直接把你送回去，但我知道大家都喜欢有人客气地送自己离开。"
rows.raw: " More and more valets have streamed in onto the balcony at this point, quietly standing in neat, military ranks, listening to Mallach's tale as the godling stands by your side watching the Jassiran sun begin to set, amber rays casting shadows upon the palace while the lanterns light up one by one. "After some tries, I got better at... manipulation. Simply existing out of nothing was not sufficient; the experience was not authentic enough. I took those unborn kittens who would have been miscarriages or stillborn and altered them in the womb, gave them another chance at life; it was the method that weighed least on my conscience, and they could have souls as opposed to the first River. They were born. They lived. They died. And as with the first River, I invited them here to my Dream, where they can stay for all eternity if they desire. This is not an afterlife... we are not in the habit of keeping souls and spirits en masse in our domains. But River... ah, River is special. Each one is an extension of me, an avatar, a son or daughter in the sense that I will ever have any." So... all these catboys and catgirls are every single River to have lived? Can't be more than three dozen of them here. "There are more," Mallach replies, sweeping a hand theatrically over the river and the boats that ply along its waters. "Not all want to live here with me in this palace. Others wish to move on, and I don't deny them that desire; they are free to face oblivion when they grow tired of existence. But do remember what I said, that there are usually only two dozen Rivers at any one time at most, and it has only been a little over two centuries since I started doing this." You move to pick up the little white clay figurine of River on the workbench, and Mallach doesn't stop you. Turning it over in your hands, you're made aware of the large hole in its back through which you can see into its form — [pc.bgMulti scholar acolyte arcanist soldier |while you didn't go too deep into anatomical studies at the academy, it was impossible to not have a passing knowledge of such from how it was being spoken of in the halls |tending to the local sick and injured at the monastery required that you have at least a passing knowledge of basic anatomy, and it all comes rushing back to you as you look closer |while you didn't go too deep into anatomical studies with your mentor, it was impossible to not have a passing knowledge of such as a result of your education |what you see is nothing strange for anyone who's spent long enough on battlefields to experience the gruesome nature of the corpses left in war's wake ]. rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You follow Mallach out of the audience chamber and down the endless hallways of his perfumed palace; at length, white tiles give way to plush purple and red carpets, with all traces of the party-cum-orgy that's going on in his demesne faded away. This is clearly some kind of inner sanctum for the catboy godling, beams of light falling down upon the soft rug and birdsong from the gardens your only accompaniment. "As you can guess, I'm rather passionate about art in all its forms. Though they've long since deteriorated in the material sense, I've done my best to save so many pieces and their meanings as replicas here in my Dream. These tapestries, paintings, sculptures, ancient instruments and more... all of them are recreations based on memories that my followers have had of them. This does lend itself to highly idealized depictions of many pieces, that my worshippers' imaginations should add or take away bits and bobs from them to better suit their sensibilities, but faithful recreations are not the point of this effort of mine." What is, then? Mallach steps up to a nearby tapestry depicting a particularly rotund catfolk sultan and strokes its surface lovingly. "To inspire passion, of course. I have my valets change out the decorations in the more public areas of my Dream on a regular basis, such that all who visit may never lack inspiration for their efforts. That's the whole point of it all — the art, the music, the constant flow of psychedelics and other drugs." And the sex? A small, wry smile plays across Mallach's lips. "Well, that sort of happens as a side effect of all the music and drugs. But people will be who they are." Uh-huh. "Not all of it has to be beautiful, of course, although I by far prefer it to be. Even so, disgust, revulsion, ugliness — " he crosses over to a sculpture that looks to be no more than a couple crude copper blocks squashed together — "these can inspire passions that are just as valid, if of a different sort. Oh, if I could show you the great and terrible works some people have made out of sheer spite, bending such malicious creativity to the effort of spitting in the faces of others. Either is preferable to emptiness. You don't have to agree, of course, but given who I am that's something I have to say, isn't it?" So then, this is his palace? His realm? Nice desert theme he's got going here. "As you know, my power base and bulk of my worshippers lies in Jassira — I don't really have the kind of all-encompassing reach that, say, Lumia or Tira do. Everyone watches the sun rise every day, everyone is intimately acquainted with births and deaths as part of their lives. I do have to cater to those who follow me and their sensibilities, after all. Others enjoy the exotic aesthetic, so everyone goes away happy. I certainly haven't received any complaints about the comforts to be had in my realm." The catboy godling leads you out onto one of the palace's many balconies — although you're pretty sure that this one wasn't there when you looked upon the building from the poolside. That being said, all the hallways you've crossed up to this point have left you certain that the inside of Mallach's palace is far larger than its outside would suggest. It shouldn't be surprising; this is a deity's divine realm, and the usual rules of time and space probably shouldn't apply. So as far as you understand it, the point of all this is to bring his faithful here, surround them with great art and music, ply them with drugs and sex, and then send them back suitably inspired and full of creative energy to do their thing in the waking world. "That's exactly right. It's not a perfect system by far, but it works well enough and people like coming here. Of course, only my most faithful get to do that, but I've got to give them something back for their devoted service, don't I?" You take a moment to consider your reply, letting your gaze wander out and away; Mallach's faithful milling about below you as tiny dots, oblivious as to your presence as the unending party-cum-orgy proceeds apace. Out over the distance and away from the palace, a river winds its way through the unending sands, boats plying up and down its waters and lush greenery following its banks as it flows... wherever it flows in this otherworldly realm. So... could Cait and Sally end up here someday? "If they work hard to distinguish themselves in my service, yes, they'll be invited to the party. It's a long road, but they've taken the first steps — with your help, of course. Which is why you're here today. You didn't have to help, you didn't have to save Caitriss, you didn't have to give her the money she wanted for her — aha — passion project. But since you went above and beyond everything to give me what might be something big down the road. Lumia has traditionally dominated in this region, after all." And he's not worried about ticking off the chief goddess of the pantheon? "Oh, so long as everything progresses organically, she doesn't really have any recourse. As I understand it, her followers used to be — and still are — far more aggressive in their conversions, so she doesn't really have a leg to stand on. But don't worry about it, the true ramifications of your combined actions are likely to only manifest beyond your lifetime. In the meantime, I'd suggest that you really dig in and enjoy the fruits of your labor. With the Marches as inhospitable as they naturally are, everyone could do with a little relaxation every now and then. "Well then, thanks for listening. Why don't I show you out? I could just send you back as you are, but I know people enjoy the courtesy of being sent off."
rows.translation: 你跟随马拉克走出观众厅，沿着他那充满香气的宫殿里无尽的走廊前行；最终，白色的瓷砖被柔软的紫色和红色地毯所取代，而他领地里正在进行的那些派对与狂欢活动所留下的一切痕迹也都消失了。这里显然就是这位猫族神明的私人圣所，柔和的光线洒在地毯上，而花园里传来的鸟鸣声则是你唯一的陪伴。 正如你们所猜测的，我对各种形式的艺术都充满了热情。虽然这些艺术品在物质形态上早已损毁，但我还是尽了自己最大的努力，将许多作品及其背后的意义以复制品的形式保存在我的“梦境”之中。这些挂毯、绘画、雕塑、古老的乐器等等，都是我的珍藏。所有这些再现内容都是基于我的追随者们对它们的记忆所创作出来的。因此，这些描绘往往带有很强的理想化色彩；我的信徒们可以根据自己的喜好对这些内容进行补充或删减，以便更好地符合他们的审美观念。不过，我进行这些努力的目的，并不是为了做出完全忠于原型的再现作品。" 那么，是什么呢？ 马拉克走到附近一幅描绘着一只圆滚滚的猫族苏丹的挂毯前，满怀爱意地抚摸着它的表面。“当然是为了激发人们的热情。我会让我的仆人们定期更换‘梦境’中那些公共区域的装饰，这样所有来访的人都能不断获得激励，去努力追求自己的目标。这才是这一切的意义所在——艺术、音乐，以及不断提供的致幻剂和其他药物。 那么性方面呢？ 马拉克嘴角浮现出一丝苦笑：“嗯，那些事情嘛，往往都是音乐和毒品带来的副作用罢了。但人终究还是他们自己。” 嗯，原来如此。 当然，并不是所有东西都必须是美丽的，尽管我个人更倾向于它们是美丽的。即便如此，厌恶、反感、丑陋——”他走到一座雕塑前，那座雕塑看起来只不过是由几块粗糙的铜块拼凑而成的——“这些也能激发同样强烈的情感，只不过是另一种类型的情感罢了。哦，要是我能让你看看有些人出于纯粹的恶意所做出那些既伟大又可怕的事情该多好——他们将这种恶意的创造力用来侮辱他人。这样的行为总比什么都不做要好吧。当然，你不必同意我的看法，但考虑到我的身份，这些话我是必须说出来的，不是吗？" 那么，这就是他的宫殿？他的领地？这里的沙漠主题设计真是不错啊。 “如你们所知，我的势力基地以及大部分信徒都位于贾西拉——我的影响力确实没有卢米娅或蒂拉那么广泛。每天，每个人都会看到太阳升起；每个人也都深刻地体验着生命的诞生与终结。毕竟，我必须考虑到那些关注我的人们以及他们的审美需求。也有人喜欢那种异国情调的美感，所以最终，大家都能开心地离开。我确实没有收到过任何关于我的领地所提供的舒适设施的投诉。 那个猫族小神灵带你来到了宫殿的其中一个阳台上——不过你很确定，当你在泳池边眺望这座建筑时，这个阳台是并不存在的。不过，到目前为止，你走过的所有走廊都让你确信：马拉克的宫殿内部面积其实比从外观上看要大得多。这也并不奇怪是在一位神明的神圣领域里，通常的时间与空间规则恐怕是不适用的。 所以，按照你的理解，这一切的目的就是将他的信徒们带到这里，用精美的艺术和音乐包围他们，用药物和享乐满足他们的需求，然后让他们在得到充分的启发、充满创造力的状态下回到现实世界，去完成他们应该做的事情。 “没错。这个系统远称不上完美，但它的效果已经足够好了，人们喜欢来到这里。当然，只有我最忠实的追随者们才能获得这个机会，但我必须为他们如此忠诚的服务给予一些回报，不是吗？” 你花了一点时间思考该如何回答，目光随意地游移着；而马拉克那些忠实的追随者们，在你下方忙碌着，他们只是一个个小小的点，完全没有注意到你的存在，因为那场永无止境的派对与狂欢仍在如火如荼地进行着。在远离宫殿的远方，有一条河流蜿蜒穿过无边无际的沙丘，船只在这条河上往来穿梭，河岸两侧长满了茂密的绿植……无论这条河流在这个超凡脱俗的世界中流向何方。 那么……凯特和莎莉有朝一日也会来到这里吗？ “如果她们在我手下努力工作，努力脱颖而出，那么是的，她们会被邀请参加这次聚会。这条路还很长，但她们已经迈出了第一步——当然，这也要归功于你的帮助。这就是你们今天来到这里的原因。你们本不必帮忙，本不必拯救凯特，也本不必为她提供她用来实现自己那份——啊哈——热情事业所需的资金。但既然你们不惜付出额外的努力，为我带来了未来可能带来重大收获的东西，那么…… 毕竟，卢米娅在这一地区一直占据着主导地位。 他难道不担心会惹恼七神中的主神女吗？ “哦，只要事情发展得自然些，她其实也没什么办法。据我所知，她的追随者们过去——现在依然——在传教时表现得更加激进，所以她确实没有什么立足之地。但别担心，你们这些行为的真正影响很可能要等到你们去世后才会显现出来。在此之前，我建议你们好好享受自己努力换来的成果吧。鉴于那些边境地区本来就环境恶劣，大家确实都需要偶尔放松一下。 那么，谢谢大家的聆听。让我来送你们吧。其实可以直接让你们原路返回，但我知道大家都喜欢这种被悉心送行的礼节。

rows.original: While it's very flattering that the god of passion himself would offer to reward you in a way befitting him, you're more interested in him as a person. Why doesn't he give you a little tour of his palace, and you can have a friendly chat?

rows.raw: "While it's very flattering that the god of passion himself would offer to reward you in a way befitting him, you're more interested in him as a person. Why doesn't he give you a little tour of his palace, and you can have a friendly chat?"

rows.translation: 拒绝

rows.original:
Sorry about that, but you've got to decline. While he's got a very nice place here and everyone present is getting into the full swing of the party, you've got to be facing down all kinds of adventures tomorrow and need your beauty sleep. Pleasure is nice and all but the shine does fade a little when it's potentially your life on the line.
        
        "Ah well, if that's how you feel about it." Mallach gives you a sad little shrug. "Not as if I'm going to force you if you aren't up to having fun; I'm all about consent, as Caitriss has no doubt told you."
        
        Look, you're glad that he invited you to his personal pleasure palace just to convey his thanks and all, and you appreciate the thought. Nevertheless, you're not interested in having sex with him, sorry. Really, you just need your sleep.
        
        "Well then, consider the thanks delivered. Since there's no further reason for you to linger, I guess I should return you to your bed, shouldn't I? Yes my friend, rest and be refreshed, so that you are strong and able to face the perils before you. 
        
        "Pleasant dreams."
        
        Slinking back to his throne, the catboy god claps his hands, and the opulent palace about him begins to fade, the music and whispers of the partygoers dissolving into nothingness on the edges of your hearing.
        
        Slumber returns...
rows.translation:
很抱歉，但你必须拒绝。这里确实美妙，在场众人也都沉浸在派对的狂欢中；可你明天还得面对各种冒险，需要好好睡一场美容觉。享乐当然美好，但一想到它可能让你在生死关头状态不佳，光彩便难免褪去几分。
        
        “唉，既然你是这样想的。”马拉克略显失落地耸耸肩。“你不想玩，我当然不会强迫你；我最重视双方同意，凯特丽丝肯定已经告诉过你。”
        
        听着，他特意邀请你来到自己的欢愉宫殿，只为传达谢意，你很高兴，也领受这份心意。可你并不想与他发生关系，抱歉。你真的只需要睡觉。
        
        “那么，就当我的谢意已经传达。既然你没有理由继续逗留，我想自己该把你送回床上，对吧？是的，我的朋友，好好休息，恢复精神，如此才能保持强壮，面对前方的危险。”
        
        “愿你做个好梦。”
        
        猫男神祇悄然回到王座，拍了拍手；周围奢华的宫殿随即开始褪去，音乐与派对宾客的低语也在听觉边缘消融于虚无。
        
        睡意再度袭来……

rows.original:
[var0
        |The entrance foyer to Cait's temple is nothing but grand. Floored with white and pink marble in a checkerboard pattern, the chamber is suffused with a light, sweet smell, barely perceptible unless one is looking for it; heavy, gold-trimmed draperies hang from the walls, keeping out the cold of the Marches. Save for the couple of braziers doused with aromatic oils and dancing with flame, the rest of the entryway is lit by crystal lamps, no doubt imported all the way from Tychris at great expense; a glass-domed roof lets in the [dayNight|sun|moon]light after suitable filtering. The end result is a softly flickering and extremely sensual luminescence that works with the aforementioned aroma to create the mood one would expect of a Mallachite temple. Whatever one might think, it's clear that Cait knows her stuff and spared no expense to create a good first impression to all who would enter her little demesne.
        
        [dayNight
            |Off by the rear of the entrance Foyer, you can see Salwah lounging around on several heavy cushions, the temple's grand cleric relaxing in an appropriately feline fashion and poised to greet anyone entering the temple. It's clear that the chococat absolutely loves her job — or maybe it's just the spice speaking... 
        ]
        |[flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_TS
            |Day or night, the old temple is being renovated and refurbished at breakneck speed, every free iota of space abuzz with activity. The air is heavy with the scent of stone dust and cement, and several lifts and pulleys have been set up in order to move hefty blocks of marble and stone where they need to be. While much of the structure is still intact, it needs to be shored up in order to last any length of time, and the exterior needs to be completely remodeled from its doom-and-gloom gargoyle motif to something more suiting Jassiran sensibilities.

            Even so, there's a lot of work to be done — debris carted away, pillars reinforced, holes in the roof that need patching up. It's dangerous work, especially on a structure this unstable, and you'd only get in the way of the workmen.
            
            [party.has cait|Even if she doesn't give voice to her thoughts, Cait herself looks particularly pleased at the brisk pace of work. It won't be long now before your pink kitten will have a little slice of home away from home.]
            |You stand at the foot of a pair of huge, sweeping marble stairs leading up to the entrance of an ancient stone temple. The arched entrance is flanked by monstrous stone gargoyles, each holding a barbed trident and shield in its hands; the filigree on the shields has long since been worn away by time, though you think you can vaguely see the outline of a hawk on one of them. The temple's roof seems to have caved in at some point, letting in the fury of the elements; wind howls and whips through the open-standing doorway.
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |凯特神庙的入口大厅堪称宏伟壮观。地面铺着白色和粉红色的大理石，呈现出棋盘状的图案，室内弥漫着一种淡淡而甜美的香气，除非刻意去留意，否则几乎察觉不到这种气味；墙壁上悬挂着装饰着金色边纹的厚重帷幔，将边境地区的寒冷隔绝在外。除了那几盏浇上了芳香油、火焰跳跃的火盆外，入口处的其他地方都是用水晶灯照亮的——这些水晶灯无疑是花费巨资从提克里斯进口而来的；玻璃穹顶的设计使得光线能够自由穿透进来[dayNight|太阳|月亮]经过适当的过滤处理后，光线会呈现出柔和的闪烁效果，这种极其迷人的光芒与前述的香气共同营造出人们所期望的马拉克信徒神殿应有的氛围。无论人们有何看法，显而易见，凯特确实非常精通这方面的技艺，她不惜投入大量精力，只为给所有进入她这片小领地的人留下良好的第一印象。
        
        [dayNight
            |在入口大厅的后面，你可以看到萨尔瓦趴在几块厚厚的垫子上休息，这位寺庙的高阶神职人员以一种十足的猫性风格悠闲地躺着，随时准备迎接任何进入寺庙的人。显然，这只巧克力猫非常热爱自己的工作——或者，也许只是它的“香料”在起作用吧…… 
        ]
        |[flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_TS
            |无论白天还是夜晚，这座古老的寺庙都在以惊人的速度进行翻修和重建，每一个空闲的地方都充满了忙碌的身影。空气中弥漫着石粉和水泥的气味，为了将那些沉重的大理石和石块运送到需要的地方，人们还安装了几台升降机和滑轮系统。虽然大部分结构仍然完好无损，但为了使其能够长期使用，还是需要对它们进行加固处理；同时，外部装饰也必须进行全面改造，将那些阴森恐怖的石像鬼图案替换成更符合贾西兰审美的设计。

            即便如此，仍有许多工作需要完成——清理掉碎片，加固柱子，修补屋顶上的漏洞。这些工作非常危险，尤其是在如此不稳定的结构上进行，而你只会妨碍工人们的作业。
            
            [party.has cait|即使她没有将自己的想法说出来，但凯特本人看起来也对这种高效的工作节奏感到非常满意。不久之后，你的粉色小猫就能拥有一个属于自己的小家了。]
            |你站在一对巨大的大理石楼梯的脚下，这些楼梯通向一座古老石庙的入口。拱形的入口两侧矗立着巨大的石制怪兽雕像，每个雕像手中都握着带刺的三叉戟和盾牌；尽管岁月无情地侵蚀了盾牌上的花纹，但你还是隐约能辨认出其中一个盾牌上似乎刻着一只鹰的轮廓。这座寺庙的屋顶似乎在某个时候坍塌了，使得大自然的力量得以肆意侵袭；狂风呼啸着，从敞开的门口灌了进来。
        ]
    ]

rows.original: A small shop sits kitty-corner to the Frost Hound, its wooden walls adorned with living rose vines that have been carefully cultivated. The flowers are in full bloom despite the season, giving the store a radiant red color. A small sign hangs above the door, with a carefully drawn depiction of a glass vial and a bunch of herbs, possibly wolfsbane, beside it.
rows.translation: 有一家小店与“霜犬酒馆”餐厅成对角线方向相邻，它的木墙上爬满了精心培育的玫瑰藤。尽管已经过了花期，这些花朵依然盛开，为小店增添了一层绚丽的红色。店门上方挂着一个小招牌，上面仔细地画着一个玻璃小瓶和一束草药，旁边可能还画着狼毒草的图案。
rows.raw: "\n    A small shop sits kitty-corner to the Frost Hound, its wooden walls adorned with living rose vines that have been carefully cultivated. The flowers are in full bloom despite the season, giving the store a radiant red color. A small sign hangs above the door, with a carefully drawn depiction of a glass vial and a bunch of herbs, possibly wolfsbane, beside it. "

rows.original:
You stride up to the lordly statue in the middle of town, reaching for the waystone charm around your neck. As you approach, you notice several villagers giving you askance looks, but much as when you first saw Cait bumbling into the tavern in the blizzard, the townsfolk astutely avoid meeting your eyes and hurriedly go about their business. [pc.isDK|To hell with them. Cowards!|You sigh and shake your head... someday they'll wake up!] You turn your attention back to the statue and raise up your charm, holding it aloft. 

        The statue depicts some ancient lord, axe aloft and shield at hand... and in that shield is a blue gemstone, covered with dust and spiderwebs. But the moment you hold up your own charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.
        
        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and the wind howls through the town square. The gemstone in the center of the old shield shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. Evergreen was right: you're attuned to the statue now.
rows.translation:
你大步走向镇中心那座威严的雕像，同时伸手去摸脖子上的路石护符。靠近雕像时，你注意到有几个村民正用异样的目光看着你，但就像当初你在暴风雪中看到凯特跌跌撞撞地走进酒馆时一样，这些镇民都巧妙地避开了与你的视线接触，继续忙着自己的事情。 [pc.isDK|去他们的吧。一群胆小鬼！|你叹了口气，摇了摇头……总有一天他们会醒悟过来的！]你将注意力重新转向那座雕像，举起手中的法杖，高高举过头顶。

        这座雕像描绘的是一位古代领主，他手持斧头，身披盾牌……而那面盾牌上镶嵌着一颗蓝色的宝石，上面积满了灰尘和蜘蛛网。但就在你展现出自己的魅力的那一刻，你感觉到空气中弥漫着一种紧张的气氛，整个氛围仿佛都在充满了力量。你咬紧牙关，向前迈出一步，强迫自己朝着那座古老的偶像走去。
        
        然后，突然间，那种压力消失了，狂风在镇广场上呼啸着刮过。那面古老盾牌中央的宝石开始闪烁，内部的光芒不断脉动……它觉醒了！你露出微笑，将那枚护身符握在拳头中，注视着光芒逐渐消退。常青女士说得对：你现在已经与那座雕像产生了共鸣。
rows.raw:
"
        You stride up to the lordly statue in the middle of town, reaching for the waystone charm around your neck. As you approach, you notice several villagers giving you askance looks, but much as when you first saw Cait bumbling into the tavern in the blizzard, the townsfolk astutely avoid meeting your eyes and hurriedly go about their business. [pc.isDK|To hell with them. Cowards!|You sigh and shake your head... someday they'll wake up!] You turn your attention back to the statue and raise up your charm, holding it aloft. 

        The statue depicts some ancient lord, axe aloft and shield at hand... and in that shield is a blue gemstone, covered with dust and spiderwebs. But the moment you hold up your own charm, you feel a tension rising in the air, and the atmosphere crackles with power. You grit your teeth and step forward, forcing yourself towards the ancient idol.
        
        And then, suddenly the pressure breaks, and the wind howls through the town square. The gemstone in the center of the old shield shines and begins to pulse with inner light... it's awake! You grin and close your fist around the charm, watching as the light fades. Evergreen was right: you're attuned to the statue now.
        
        "

rows.original:
The village's southern gate leads out onto a sloping road, descending into a little valley beneath Hawkethorne. It's protected on three sides by mountains and high hills, and in the distance to the south, you can catch sight of a glistening lake in the distance. At the moment, the gate's standing wide open and unguarded — it doesn't seem like the villagers expect anybody but friends to come from this direction.

    To the east, there's a small secondary street lined with homes and small shops. Back north, of course, is the town square.
rows.translation:
村庄的南门通向一条倾斜的道路，这条道路一直延伸到鹰棘镇山下的一个小山谷中。道路的三面都被山脉和高丘环绕着，而在南方的远处，你可以看到一片波光粼粼的湖泊。目前，大门大开着，也没有人看守——看来村民们并不认为会有除了朋友之外的其他人从这个方向过来。

    向东走，有一条两边排列着住宅和小商店的小巷。往北走，当然就会来到镇中心广场。
rows.raw:
"
    The village's southern gate leads out onto a sloping road, descending into a little valley beneath Hawkethorne. It's protected on three sides by mountains and high hills, and in the distance to the south, you can catch sight of a glistening lake in the distance. At the moment, the gate's standing wide open and unguarded — it doesn't seem like the villagers expect anybody but friends to come from this direction.

    To the east, there's a small secondary street lined with homes and small shops. Back north, of course, is the town square."

rows.original: As you're heading towards the north gate, you spy a figure staggering down the road towards you with a hand on his stomach — a very large, visibly pregnant stomach that juts forward from an otherwise athletic figure. As the stranger draws near, you see it's a lupine with a dusty gray-brown coat of fur that's been streaked with something golden-colored and sweet smelling... and nearer still, you see that it's clearly a male of the species. His clothes are tattered and the copper hatchet on his belt has been dented so heavily that it's nearly folded in on itself. "H-hey, you!" the wolf-man says, slumping against the side of a house with a grunt as you walk past. "If you're going out in the woods... think again! The hornets out there, they've gone nuts! Laughed something about their queen and eggs when they jumped me. My axe didn't even scratch them! Their armor's so thick I bent my blade before it broke through." He shudders and clutches at his swollen stomach. The skin beneath his shredded leather vest seems uneven and distended, like his gut's full of objects rather than a baby. You glance down and see that his pants have been ripped around the rear, and the honey smeared in his fur looks like he was practically swimming in it on his legs. Oh, dear... "Ugh. If you run into those damned bimbo bugs, you'd better run or find some way to drive 'em off that isn't your weapon. Unless you want to end up like me." The poor egg-stuffed lupine pushes himself unsteadily off the wall. "Oh and if you see my brother, June... tell him I'm still missing. Gonna go hide in the cellar for a few days..." You watch as he staggers off through a doorway before returning your attention to the town gates. Seems like Garth wasn't kidding about people being attacked.

Well, that and lots of golden jewellery ranging from the tight studded top that barely constraints her soft rack to the armlets and anklets, not to mention the jewelled circlet and collar adorning her head and neck respectively. 这句话让两位猫女都笑了起来，过了好几秒钟，萨尔瓦才重新开口说道： “当我沿着他的足迹来到这个小村庄时，河边的那个人告诉我，你最近经常出现在这一带，一直待在‘霜犬酒馆’旅馆里。反正我本来也打算在这里休息一段时间，所以等你并没有给我带来什么麻烦——结果你竟然这么快就出现了！ 见到你真是太高兴了，莎莉。但是……你为什么跟着我？还有我爸爸？” “你不是在从事传教工作吗？” 凯特的笑容瞬间消失了，取而代之的是一丝疑惑：“传教工作？” “就是寺庙的女主管告诉我的——你说想和爸爸还有卡拉一起在国外从事传教工作，所以他们提前几个小时为你举行了仪式，然后在你和他们一起离开这个小镇之前，就让你跟他们一起走了。我的入会仪式比你晚了一个月，但我还是非常想参与这类活动！一旦我正式成为会员，我就得到了大牧师的许可，可以去寻找你，并传播关于玛拉赫的消息！ 凯特愣住了，随后不禁皱起了眉头。 “怎么了，凯特？” “莎莉……我并不是来执行传教任务的。也不是以官方身份来的，尽管我一直在尽力把马拉克的精神传播出去。我……甚至还没有被正式任命为正式的女祭司，就在我应该宣誓成为祭司的那一天，我就离开了小镇。我离开后，我妈妈应该没有什么事情发生吧？毕竟，是她让我离开的…… 萨尔瓦的表情变得严肃起来。“我觉得我们最好边喝点东西边谈谈，凯特。这里面肯定有什么不对劲的地方。” 凯特点了点头，然后突然[party.has cait |让你时刻感受到自己的存在 |在人群中看到了你 ]你轻轻松了口气，那只粉红色的小猫走到你身边，抓住你的手臂，拉着你朝着萨尔瓦和吧台的方向走去。“你愿意陪我一会儿吗？[pc.name]如果你能在场的话，我会感觉好一些。” “这是谁？”[pc.name]。 [pc.HeShe]在迄今为止发生的所有事情中，她一直是我非常亲密的朋友。” “啊，我一位学长的女朋友也是我的朋友。”她带着一丝俏皮而略带担忧的笑容，轻轻点了点头，“我叫萨尔瓦·阿明——凯特和我在贾西拉的同一座寺庙里长大的。不如一起来喝一杯吧，两位年轻女士？ [pc.dcb |只要他们愿意支付费用的话。 |当然，为什么不呢？ |当然啦！ ] 当萨尔瓦用轻声细语和安抚的语气尽力让凯特平静下来时，加斯则为你们三人准备了加了香料的葡萄酒。 [party.has cait |[party.manyCompanions |以及[companion2.name] ] |以及[party.compNames] ]然后他从柜台上拿了一包东西递给她。她从自己的物品中拿出一瓶棕色、香气浓郁的粉末，这种粉末既有辛辣的味道，又带有甜味；她往每个人的杯子里都倒了一些这种粉末，而给凯特的量显然比给其他人要多得多。 “来，尝尝这个，会有点家的味道，凯特丽丝。现在，你不妨把发生的一切都告诉我吧。
rows.raw: " Stepping into the warm and familiar confines of the Frost Hound, you're greeted by the sound of cheering and clapping from within the common room, accompanied by the tune of music distinctly foreign to the Marches. The music itself is provided by [flags.RIVER_MET|River|the white kitten of a bard-boy] in a corner on his lute, but the cheering and clapping... well, there's a sight you don't see that often in this part of the world. Dancing atop one of Garth's sturdier tables is a catgirl dressed in little more than a heavy shawl, a jewelled thong, and black tattoos upon her milk-chocolate skin that run along her limbs and across her breastbone. Well, that and lots of golden jewellery ranging from the tight studded top that barely constraints her soft rack to the armlets and anklets, not to mention the jewelled circlet and collar adorning her head and neck respectively. The slow, exotic movements of the purple-furred catgirl's dance are mystically hypnotic — and strangely arousing too, for just looking at her causes your loins to warm and tighten. N-no, your mind hasn't even begun to stray to the lewd yet; there's something more to her movements than the simple sexuality that she has in practised spades. One of Garth's patrons holds out a mug of mead to the tan-skinned kitten, who proceeds to pluck it from his grasp with a languid sweep of her tail and down it in several gulps. [pc.bgMulti acolyte scholar nobleScion courtesan |You've only read of them in the texts, but you're pretty sure that this sexy kitten right here is a sacred harlot of Mallach in full ritual garb. A junior priestess, by the looks of her tattoos and her youth, but one nevertheless; what one of these is going tabletop dancing in the Frost Hound miles away from Jassira is anyone's guess, but it ought to be good. |You've only read of them in the texts, but you're pretty sure that this sexy kitten right here is a sacred harlot of Mallach in full ritual garb. The deeper meanings of the tattoos, the dance itself or the catgirl's rank and station are lost upon you as a scholar of the secular world, but the fact that she's so far from home in the first place ought to be good. |You've heard of dancers like this mentioned from time to time in the past whenever the matter of politics with Jassira was brought up — though you've never actually seen one, you're pretty sure this is a sacred harlot of Mallach in full ritual garb. They used to have these around to entertain diplomatic guests who visited temples... not that you ever had the pleasure of meeting one in the flesh until now. |You've heard of dancers like this mentioned from time to time in the past whenever the matter of politics with Jassira was brought up — though you've never actually seen one, you're pretty sure this is a sacred harlot of Mallach in full ritual garb. They used to have these around to entertain diplomatic guests who visited temples... not that you ever had the pleasure of meeting one in the flesh until now. |The whole scene is quite stereotypically Jassiran to you, or at least from what you've heard of the place, but you don't have the wherewithal to figure out much more from your knowledge. ] As the catgirl waggles her hips and twirls her lithe gymnast's body towards you, the tattoo emblazoned just above her crotch makes her allegiances clear: while the other markings upon her skin are black, this one is a deep red, and shaped like a heart in a circle — the exact same symbol atop Cait's staff. Throughout all this, Garth's watching passively from behind the counter; while the crowd getting a bit rowdy, the proportionally increased patronage has stayed the grizzled wolf's hand from actually putting a stop to the display. [party.has cait |Cait, however, has other ideas |His guests, though, might have other ideas considering the commotion in the barroom. Yawning and murmuring, still rubbing her eyes with sleep, Cait appears in the stairway entrance, sporting a moderate case of bedhead. That soon becomes insignificant, though, as she catches sight of the dancer on the table. ]. Several emotions flit across her face, starting with wide-eyed disbelief, followed by a dreamy smile and finally, wide-mouthed, giggly excitement. Possessed of a fervor [cait.fucked|you've only seen from her during sex|you've rarely seen], your pink kitten elbows her way through the throng and makes a beeline for the dancing cat in the midst of it all. "Sally!" That gets the chocolate kitten's attention. With a final twirl and risque waggle of her hips and tail, she hops off the table with feline grace. The crowd pulls back to let her pass before the two catgirls collide with each other in a burst of girlish glee. Cait's considerably more ample chest presses itself against Sally's as the two embrace. "Caitriss! There you are! [cait.cupRange EE F FF G |Full and ample as ever, I see! |Have you grown since the last time we met? You're definitely squishier up there now. |Oh my, you've certainly grown since you left the temple. I'll have to ask all about that later... |Oh, Mallach's grace, how you've grown! Just what have you been eating in these foreign lands to get so big and full? ]" Cait just laughs, leans into the hug once more, and finally parts, tail swishing. "No, no, I get to go first. What are you doing here? You were slated to be — no, you are a sacred harlot now. How in the names of all the Seven did you find me?" "Your dad isn't a hard person to track down, Caitriss. The name Barnaphous Zethra leaves an impression wherever he goes — it's got a certain weight to it, a gravitas, if you will." That sets both catgirls to giggling, and it's several seconds until Salwah's able to speak again. "When I followed his trail to this little hamlet, River here told me that you'd been hanging around these parts of late, staying here in the Frost Hound. I was going to rest here a while anyway, so waiting for you was no skin off my nose — and scarcely a day's passed before you show up!" "Am I glad to see you, Sally. But... why are you following me? My dad?" "Aren't you doing missionary work?" Cait's smile turns into a small frown. "Missionary work?" "That's what the temple matron told me — you wanted to do missionary work in foreign lands with your father and Calla, so they initiated you in a private ceremony a few hours early and sent you packing with them before they left town for good. My initiation was a month behind yours, but I still wanted to do that sort of thing, too! Once I was fully initiated, I got the Grand Cleric's permission to go after you and spread the word of Mallach!" Cait freezes, then winces. "What's the matter, Caitriss?" "Sally... I'm not here on missionary work. Not in an official capacity, even if I've been trying to spread Mallach's love here and there where I can. I... I'm not even ordained as a full priestess, I skipped town the day I was supposed to take my vows. Nothing... nothing happened to my mother after I disappeared, did it? She was the one who told me to leave, after all..." Salwah's expression turns serious. "I think we'd better talk over a drink, Caitriss. Something's wrong here." Cait nods, then suddenly [party.has cait |remembers you're around |catches sight of you in the crowd ]. Heaving a small sigh of relief, your pink kitty steps up to you and grabs you by the arm, pulling you with her to Salwah and the bartop. "Do you mind being with me for a while, [pc.name]? I'd feel better if you were around for this." "Who's this?" "[pc.name]. [pc.HeShe]'s been a great friend to me throughout everything that's happened so far." "Ah. A friend of my senior's is a friend of mine." She gives you a coy, if worried smile and a little dip of her head. "I'm Salwah Amin — Caitriss and I grew up in the same temple back in Jassira. Join two young ladies for a drink, perhaps?" [pc.dcb |If they're paying. |Sure, why not? |Like, totally! ] While Salwah does her best to calm Cait down with hushed words and soothing tones, Garth draws up spiced wines for the three of you [party.has cait |[party.manyCompanions |as well as [companion2.name] ] |as well as [party.compNames] ] and passes a pack over the counter to her. She reaches into her belongings and draws out a shaker of brown, rich-smelling powder, spicy and sweet; she applies a helping of this to everyone's mugs, Cait's far more liberally than most. "There, a taste of home, Caitriss. Now, why don't you tell me everything that happened?" "

rows.original: "...And that's about it," Cait finishes, polishing off the last of her spiced wine. "Calla's gone. Dad wants to look into the portal but doesn't think we can actually do anything to help, and I've been with [pc.name] here trying to fight the creeps and the demon bitch, make them give Calla back. I don't want to give up hope, but with every additional day that passes..." "There, there." "Don't you 'there, there' me, Sally. I studied soothing platitudes too, and right by your side to boot." Cait sighs, mumbling out a hushed apology for snapping as she rubs her own ears in frustration. Her tail coils around one of the chair legs beneath her. "Now that I've poured out my side of the story, it's your turn to tell me what happened back at the temple after I left." Salwah hesitates, flicking a purple-furred ear in Cait's direction. "You really ran away on the day of the initiation, Caitriss? You didn't have a private ceremony earlier so you could follow your Dad and Sis onto the boat?" "Mom told me to go, if that was what I really wanted." "Okay, then. Can — can I see your Brand of the Harlot?" [var0 |Yeah, that. Cait told you about it, the reason why she couldn't have children. And come to think of it, Cait's is usually invisible and a series of swirling dark lines much like Salwah's tattoos, while Salwah's own is pinkish-red and distinctly bears Mallach's symbol. Is something up? Cait looks between you and her childhood friend, swallows hard and nods to the chococat. "Go ahead. It's the only way you'll be convinced, right?" "All right, then." Using the cover of the bar countertop, Salwah discreetly pulls down Cait's skirts from the front and raises two fingers to your pink kitten's crotch. There's that slow glow of magic, and Cait's brand emerges once more. "There." Cait snatches away Salwah's fingers and pulls up her skirts, looking most uncharacteristically ashamed. "That enough for you, Sally?" |"Uh — " Cait steals a glance in your direction, then swivels the other way so that her back's facing you. "Could you give me a little privacy, [pc.name]? Please? I don't mean to leave you out of the loop, but this is between me and Sally." [pc.isBimbo |For her? Like, totally, sure. |Of course. ] "Thanks." Her back still to you, Cait takes a deep breath, squares her shoulders and gives Salwah a nod. "Go ahead. It's the only way you'll be convinced, right?" "All right, then." You're not sure what's going on there, but you see a faint glow of magic from around Cait's sides, down by her crotch. Abruptly, Salwah draws back, clearly shaken by whatever she's seen. "There. That enough for you, Sally?" ] Salwah raises her hands to her cheeks beneath the gold-threaded shawl. "Oh. Oh no. You really didn't — " "I really didn't, yes! That's what I've been trying to tell you!" "B-but then that means the Matron and Grand Cleric lied!" [var0 |Uh, not to interject, but just what is it about Cait's brand that has her so worked up?[pc.bg acolyte scholar | While you may have had some religious education as part of your background, you're not well-versed in the intricacies of Mallachite mysteries for obvious reasons. ] Pink and purple kittens share a glance, then Cait palms her face and folds her ears against her hair. "Tell [pc.himHer], Sally. I... there's no point in hiding it from [pc.himHer]. I'm sorry to have kept the whole truth from you for so long, [pc.name]." "It's customary for the Grand Cleric to come and put the Brand of the Harlot on each initiate on the morning of the ceremony. Or at least, what will become the brand proper. What Caitriss bears is a Brand of the Harlot, but nascent — an initiate's brand. During the ceremony, when our order and vocation are revealed to us, the new brand transforms into one indicative of our calling in the temple." Salwah gestures down to the pinkish-red holy symbol of Mallach burned into her skin just above her jewelled thong, blatantly visible for all to see without the need for magical aid. "One look at Caitriss' brand, and any junior priest or priestess — let alone the Grand Cleric — would know that she had begun, but not completed, the initiation rites. Questions would be asked." "Questions I don't want asked." Cait hugs herself, and looks down. "Questions that could cause a lot of trouble for me and everyone around me, you included, [pc.name]. That's why I asked you not to press me about getting it removed. I can't risk what the clerics would do, not until we get Calla back. Maybe then... I'll face down what I have to. But not now." Salwah gives Cait a pat on the shoulder, and turns to you. "Please do as she asks, [pc.name]. Caitriss is wearing the white cloak of office, which by rights she shouldn't be wearing, since she was never initiated. You can see how that would be a problem." "I told you mom was helping me get dressed for the ceremony, right, [pc.name]? It was on me, and I never took it off all the way out of the temple..." "...Mere moments away from being able to wear it for real." ] Cait straightens up and squares her shoulders, clearly steeling herself. "Now then, Sally. About my mother..." Salwah's deep emerald eyes wander away from Cait's piercing gaze. "Your mom is... diminished, Caitriss." "Please, don't beat around the bush. Tell me. I can take bad news." Cait's trying to be brave, but you can see her ears flattening, tail coiled tight. "If she told you to leave, that explains why she suddenly found considerable disfavor with the Matron and Grand Cleric. I... I see now, it's all falling into place. Yes, you were of your majority and could leave the temple at any time before being formally initiated, but if the word got out that Barnaphous Zethra's daughter had not just absconded, but been encouraged to do so by a senior priestess..." "No noble would want to pay for a holy heir from our temple any more; the tithes and donations would dry up like spit on a hot stove. Calla constantly running away was enough of a danger, but me as well... no. S-so, what happened to my mother?" "She was reassigned to another vocation, which suited her just fine. She said that after having raised two daughters to adulthood, she was starting to feel her age and was willing to hang up her shawl and veil... don't worry, Caitriss, she's not being hurt or mistreated or anything. Just... demoted in the temple hierarchy. The law is what it is, and neither the Matron nor the Grand Cleric can do anything to her openly. But in Jassira there's the written law, there's the spoken law, and there's the law that's neither written nor spoken." Cait's silent for a long while, staring into the bottom of her mug. Garth helpfully comes over and refills it, and Salwah dusts it liberally with more spice powder. Eventually, your pink kitten takes a swig and sighs, tears forming in the corners of her eyes. "Mother's fine, you say?" Salwah nods. "Even sacred harlots have to retire someday. Given how much favor she's found amongst the country's nobility over the years, she'll do pretty well teaching the initiates how to turn her tricks." Cait sighs. "Mom..." All right, you've got to do something. Reaching over to Cait, you wrap your arms around her in a great big hug, squeezing her warm body tight against yours, [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] against skin. Moments later, Salwah joins in the hug too, [pc.ra catfolk |three cats |two cats and [a] [pc.race] ] in a pile; it's all very warm[cait.isLeothran | and furry | and fuzzy ].
rows.translation: 就这些了，”凯特说完，喝完了杯里的香料葡萄酒。“卡拉已经走了。爸爸想研究一下那个传送门，但他认为我们实际上并没有办法确实只要能提供帮助，我一定会全力以赴。[pc.name]在这里，我一直在努力与那些怪物以及那个恶魔女巫战斗，希望他们能把卡拉还回来。我不想放弃希望，但是随着时间的推移……” “别这样，别这样。” “莎莉，别对我这么说啊。我也学过一些用来安抚别人的客套话，而且还一直陪在你身边呢。”凯特叹了口气，懊恼地揉着自己的耳朵，小声地为自己的冲动行为道歉。她的尾巴缠在了身下椅子的一条腿上。“现在我把自己的事情都讲完了，该轮到你告诉我了——在我离开之后，寺庙里发生了什么。萨尔瓦犹豫了一下，然后将那只紫色毛发的耳朵朝凯特的方向甩了甩。“凯特，你真的在入会仪式当天逃走了吗？难道是因为之前没有举行私人仪式，所以你才有机会跟着你爸爸和姐姐上船的吗？妈妈告诉我，如果那真的是我想要的，那就去吧。” “好吧，那我就……可以看看你的‘妓女品牌’吗？ [var0 |是的，就是那个。凯特告诉过你，关于她为什么不能生育的原因。仔细想想，凯特身上的图案通常是看不见的，只是一系列旋转的暗线，和萨尔瓦身上的纹身很相似；而萨尔瓦身上的图案则是粉红色的，上面清晰地印着马拉克的符号。出什么问题了吗？” 凯特看了看你，又看了看她儿时的朋友，艰难地咽了口唾沫，然后点了点头，指向那块巧克力。“吃吧。只有这样你才会相信的，对吧？” “那好吧。萨尔瓦借着吧台台面的掩护，悄悄地从前面拉开了凯特的裙子，然后将两根手指伸向她那粉红色的内裤部位。顿时，那熟悉的魔法光芒再次闪现，凯特的纹身也随之显现了出来。 就是那里。”凯特一把抓住萨尔瓦的手指，掀起自己的裙子，露出了难得的羞涩表情。“这样够你满足了吗，莎莉？ |呃——”凯特偷偷瞥了你一眼，然后立刻转过头去，背对你说道：“能给我一点私人空间吗？[pc.name]求你了？我并不是想瞒着你，但这件事只是我和莎莉之间的事情。 [pc.isBimbo |给她吗？当然可以，完全没有问题。 |当然可以。 ] 谢谢。”凯特仍然背对着你，深吸一口气，挺直肩膀，向萨尔瓦点了点头。“去吧，只有这样你才会相信的，对吧？” “好吧，那我就去。”你虽然不明白发生了什么，但看到凯特的身体两侧、靠近胯部的地方散发出一丝微弱的魔法光芒。突然，萨尔瓦退了回去，显然她所看到的一切让她受到了惊吓。 “就这样吧，莎莉，够了吗？ ] 萨尔瓦在金线织成的披肩下将双手举到脸颊旁。“哦，不，你真的没有——” “我真的没有，没错！这就是我一直想告诉你的！” “但那样的话，那就意味着女院长和大牧师撒谎了！" [var0 |呃，我并不是想插嘴，但究竟是凯特的品牌中的哪些方面让她如此激动呢？[pc.bg acolyte scholar | 虽然你可能在成长过程中接受过一些宗教教育，但出于显而易见的原因，你对马拉克信徒教派的神秘传说并不十分了解。 ] 粉色和紫色的小猫对视了一眼，然后凯特用手捂住脸，把耳朵贴在头发上。“告诉[pc.himHer]吧，莎莉。我……再瞒着[pc.himHer]也没有意义。很抱歉，我这么长时间以来都没有向你坦白全部真相。[pc.name]按照惯例，大祭司会在仪式当天的早晨为每一位新成员施加‘妓女印记’。至少，应该是这样的。变成这个烙印本身代表着某种身份。凯特身上的这个烙印属于“妓女之族”，但还处于初期阶段——只是一个入门者的烙印。在仪式中，当我们的组织身份与使命被揭晓时，这个新的烙印会转变为象征我们在神殿中肩负使命的标志。萨尔瓦指向她皮肤上、那条镶满宝石的丁字裤上方、被灼烧而成的淡红圣符，这个符号清晰可见，无需任何魔法辅助就能让所有人看到。“只要看一眼凯特里斯身上的这个烙印，任何初级祭司或女祭司——更不用说大祭司了——都会立刻知道她已经开始了入门仪式，但还没有完成。会有人提出一些问题。” “而我，却不知道那些问题会是什么想要这些问题可能会给我以及我身边的所有人带来很多麻烦，包括你也在内。”凯特抱住自己，低下了头。[pc.name]这就是为什么我之前请求你不要催我处理这件事。在把卡拉找回来之前，我不敢冒险去面对神职人员可能会采取的行动。也许到那时……我才会勇敢面对自己必须面对的事情。但现在还不是时候。” 萨尔瓦轻拍了一下凯特的肩膀，然后转向你说道：“请按照她的要求去做吧。[pc.name]凯特穿着那件象征职位的白色长袍，但实际上她根本不应该穿它，因为她从未被正式授予这个职位。你们应该能理解，这到底会带来多大的麻烦。” “我早就告诉过你们，是妈妈帮我准备仪式服装的，对吧？[pc.name]它一直在我身上，从离开神庙的那一刻起，我就再也没有摘下来过……” “……再过短短的几分钟，我就能真正戴上它了。 ] 凯特挺直身子，双肩绷紧，显然是在努力让自己冷静下来。“那么，莎莉，关于我母亲的事……” 萨尔瓦那双深绿色的眼睛从凯特那锐利的目光中移开了。“你的母亲……已经不再像从前那样了，凯特。拜托，别拐弯抹角了。直接告诉我吧。我能够承受坏消息。”凯特努力表现出勇敢的样子，但你可以看出她的耳朵已经贴在身上，尾巴也紧紧地卷了起来。 “如果她是让你离开的，那么这就解释了为什么她突然会遭到女院长和大牧师的厌恶了。我……现在我明白了，一切都在慢慢变得清晰起来。没错，你在达到法定年龄后随时都可以离开神庙，但在正式接受仪式之前，如果有人知道了巴纳福斯·泽特拉的女儿不仅擅自离开了神庙，而且还受到鼓励要由一位资深的女祭司来执行这一仪式……” “再也没有哪个贵族愿意为我们寺庙支付圣嗣的费用了；那些什一税和捐赠也会像热锅上的唾沫一样消失得无影无踪。卡拉经常逃走已经够危险了，现在连我也要面临同样的危险……不，我的母亲到底发生了什么？ 她被调到了另一个更适合她的岗位。她说，在把两个女儿抚养长大成人之后，她开始感觉到自己年纪大了，也愿意放下那些传统的束缚……别担心，凯特丽丝，她并没有受到任何伤害或虐待。只是……在寺庙的等级体系中被降级了。规则就是规则，无论是女祭司还是大祭司，都无法公然对她采取任何行动。但在贾西拉，有成文的法律，有口头的传统，还有那些既没有写下来也没有被人们口头上提及的规则。" 凯特沉默了很久，只是盯着自己杯中的液体。加斯贴心地走过来为她的杯子重新倒满了水，而萨尔瓦则往里面撒了大量的香料粉。最终，那只粉红色的小猫喝了一口，叹了口气，眼角顿时泛起了泪光。 你说，你母亲应该没啥问题吧？” 萨尔瓦点了点头：“就算是那些神圣的妓女，也有有一天会退休的。考虑到这些年来她在全国贵族中赢得了如此多的支持，她教那些新入会的人如何运用她的技巧，应该会过得相当不错吧。 凯特叹了口气：“妈妈……” “好吧，你必须采取点行动了。”你伸出手，将凯特紧紧抱在怀里，把她温暖的身体紧紧贴在自己的身上。[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]紧紧相拥。片刻之后，萨尔瓦也加入了这个拥抱。 [pc.ra catfolk |三只猫 |两只猫……还有[pc.race] ]堆成一堆，一切都暖暖的。[cait.isLeothran | 还有那些毛茸茸的生物…… | 还有些模糊不清…… ]。
rows.raw: ' "...And that's about it," Cait finishes, polishing off the last of her spiced wine. "Calla's gone. Dad wants to look into the portal but doesn't think we can actually do anything to help, and I've been with [pc.name] here trying to fight the creeps and the demon bitch, make them give Calla back. I don't want to give up hope, but with every additional day that passes..." "There, there." "Don't you 'there, there' me, Sally. I studied soothing platitudes too, and right by your side to boot." Cait sighs, mumbling out a hushed apology for snapping as she rubs her own ears in frustration. Her tail coils around one of the chair legs beneath her. "Now that I've poured out my side of the story, it's your turn to tell me what happened back at the temple after I left." Salwah hesitates, flicking a purple-furred ear in Cait's direction. "You really ran away on the day of the initiation, Caitriss? You didn't have a private ceremony earlier so you could follow your Dad and Sis onto the boat?" "Mom told me to go, if that was what I really wanted." "Okay, then. Can — can I see your Brand of the Harlot?" [var0 |Yeah, that. Cait told you about it, the reason why she couldn't have children. And come to think of it, Cait's is usually invisible and a series of swirling dark lines much like Salwah's tattoos, while Salwah's own is pinkish-red and distinctly bears Mallach's symbol. Is something up? Cait looks between you and her childhood friend, swallows hard and nods to the chococat. "Go ahead. It's the only way you'll be convinced, right?" "All right, then." Using the cover of the bar countertop, Salwah discreetly pulls down Cait's skirts from the front and raises two fingers to your pink kitten's crotch. There's that slow glow of magic, and Cait's brand emerges once more. "There." Cait snatches away Salwah's fingers and pulls up her skirts, looking most uncharacteristically ashamed. "That enough for you, Sally?" |"Uh — " Cait steals a glance in your direction, then swivels the other way so that her back's facing you. "Could you give me a little privacy, [pc.name]? Please? I don't mean to leave you out of the loop, but this is between me and Sally." [pc.isBimbo |For her? Like, totally, sure. |Of course. ] "Thanks." Her back still to you, Cait takes a deep breath, squares her shoulders and gives Salwah a nod. "Go ahead. It's the only way you'll be convinced, right?" "All right, then." You're not sure what's going on there, but you see a faint glow of magic from around Cait's sides, down by her crotch. Abruptly, Salwah draws back, clearly shaken by whatever she's seen. "There. That enough for you, Sally?" ] Salwah raises her hands to her cheeks beneath the gold-threaded shawl. "Oh. Oh no. You really didn't — " "I really didn't, yes! That's what I've been trying to tell you!" "B-but then that means the Matron and Grand Cleric lied!" [var0 |Uh, not to interject, but just what is it about Cait's brand that has her so worked up?[pc.bg acolyte scholar | While you may have had some religious education as part of your background, you're not well-versed in the intricacies of Mallachite mysteries for obvious reasons. ] Pink and purple kittens share a glance, then Cait palms her face and folds her ears against her hair. "Tell [pc.himHer], Sally. I... there's no point in hiding it from [pc.himHer]. I'm sorry to have kept the whole truth from you for so long, [pc.name]." "It's customary for the Grand Cleric to come and put the Brand of the Harlot on each initiate on the morning of the ceremony. Or at least, what will become the brand proper. What Caitriss bears is a Brand of the Harlot, but nascent — an initiate's brand. During the ceremony, when our order and vocation are revealed to us, the new brand transforms into one indicative of our calling in the temple." Salwah gestures down to the pinkish-red holy symbol of Mallach burned into her skin just above her jewelled thong, blatantly visible for all to see without the need for magical aid. "One look at Caitriss' brand, and any junior priest or priestess — let alone the Grand Cleric — would know that she had begun, but not completed, the initiation rites. Questions would be asked." "Questions I don't want asked." Cait hugs herself, and looks down. "Questions that could cause a lot of trouble for me and everyone around me, you included, [pc.name]. That's why I asked you not to press me about getting it removed. I can't risk what the clerics would do, not until we get Calla back. Maybe then... I'll face down what I have to. But not now." Salwah gives Cait a pat on the shoulder, and turns to you. "Please do as she asks, [pc.name]. Caitriss is wearing the white cloak of office, which by rights she shouldn't be wearing, since she was never initiated. You can see how that would be a problem." "I told you mom was helping me get dressed for the ceremony, right, [pc.name]? It was on me, and I never took it off all the way out of the temple..." "...Mere moments away from being able to wear it for real." ] Cait straightens up and squares her shoulders, clearly steeling herself. "Now then, Sally. About my mother..." Salwah's deep emerald eyes wander away from Cait's piercing gaze. "Your mom is... diminished, Caitriss." "Please, don't beat around the bush. Tell me. I can take bad news." Cait's trying to be brave, but you can see her ears flattening, tail coiled tight. "If she told you to leave, that explains why she suddenly found considerable disfavor with the Matron and Grand Cleric. I... I see now, it's all falling into place. Yes, you were of your majority and could leave the temple at any time before being formally initiated, but if the word got out that Barnaphous Zethra's daughter had not just absconded, but been encouraged to do so by a senior priestess..." "No noble would want to pay for a holy heir from our temple any more; the tithes and donations would dry up like spit on a hot stove. Calla constantly running away was enough of a danger, but me as well... no. S-so, what happened to my mother?" "She was reassigned to another vocation, which suited her just fine. She said that after having raised two daughters to adulthood, she was starting to feel her age and was willing to hang up her shawl and veil... don't worry, Caitriss, she's not being hurt or mistreated or anything. Just... demoted in the temple hierarchy. The law is what it is, and neither the Matron nor the Grand Cleric can do anything to her openly. But in Jassira there's the written law, there's the spoken law, and there's the law that's neither written nor spoken." Cait's silent for a long while, staring into the bottom of her mug. Garth helpfully comes over and refills it, and Salwah dusts it liberally with more spice powder. Eventually, your pink kitten takes a swig and sighs, tears forming in the corners of her eyes. "Mother's fine, you say?" Salwah nods. "Even sacred harlots have to retire someday. Given how much favor she's found amongst the country's nobility over the years, she'll do pretty well teaching the initiates how to turn her tricks." Cait sighs. "Mom..." All right, you've got to do something. Reaching over to Cait, you wrap your arms around her in a great big hug, squeezing her warm body tight against yours, [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] against skin. Moments later, Salwah joins in the hug too, [pc.ra catfolk |three cats |two cats and [a] [pc.race] ] in a pile; it's all very warm[cait.isLeothran | and furry | and fuzzy ]. '

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "That's the Caitriss I know!" "And Sally, if you're determined on staying here in Hawkethorne, I think I do have a job for you. I've been planning on it since the night Calla got taken, but since I've been adventuring all over with [pc.name] I couldn't justify it to myself. But with another Mallachite around to oversee my plans... I think now it could actually work out, even if I can't always be around to take care of things myself!" "Oooh! What're you planning?" "I'll tell you later. For now, you've had enough excitement for one [dayNight |day |night ], Sally. I'm sure you have a room here at the Hound?" "River was a big help in getting me one long-term!" "Then I'll meet up with you later and fill you in. For now... I'd like to be alone [party.has cait |with [pc.name] ]for a while, please." "It was great catching up with you, Caitriss! I'll see you soon, okay?" The two of you — and several other patrons — watch Salwah's lush chocolate butt wiggle and sway as she disappears up the stairwell to the Frost Hound's guest rooms. When she's sure you're alone, Cait polishes off her refill and shakes her head with a sigh. "She must've been asking inconvenient questions about me around the temple. Getting approval for missionary work takes weeks, if not months, and that's assuming it gets okayed in the first place — which given her inexperience shouldn't have happened at all. A junior priestess sent alone out into the far north? The temple must've really wanted to bury my disappearance." Well, it all turned out for the better, didn't it? "It... it did." Cait smiles weakly. "Mom... no, I can't keep moping and waste the chance she gave me. [party.has cait |We've got to be on our way, [pc.name]. I'm done feeling sorry for myself! |I'm done feeling sorry for myself, but I've got to have a little time to myself, figure out what to do next! ] Sally showing up here safe and sound has to be some kind of sign from Mallach that I'm on the right path, and I've got to make the most of it!" There's the Cait you know and love. You missed her. [party.has cait | | The smile turns sheepish. "All right, all right. I'm going upstairs and getting that me time. First catching up with Dad, and now this — I've gotten a lot to think about of late, huh?" With that, she's gone, leaving you at the bar counter with her empty mug. ] "This one's on the house," Garth says. "That story alone was worth it. Beats most of those people tell me to try and get a free drink, so you've earned your keep." Well, time to get a move on. You should probably give Cait's old friend a little time to settle in, as well as for Cait to sort out her own thoughts and feelings after receiving this kind of news. Maybe checking in with the inn's guests a day from now would be helpful.
rows.translation: 这才是我认识的凯特！” “还有莎莉，如果你真的决定留在鹰棘镇的话，我想我确实有份工作适合你。从卡拉被抓走的那个晚上起，我就一直在考虑这个事情，不过因为这些天我一直在四处冒险[pc.name]我实在无法说服自己这样做。但是如果有另一位马拉克信徒来监督我的计划……我想现在这件事应该能够成功，即使我不能总是亲自处理所有事情。” “哦哦！你到底在策划什么？” “稍后我会告诉你的。现在，你已经经历了够多的刺激了[dayNight |天 |夜晚 ]莎莉，我肯定你在‘猎犬’俱乐部这里有房间吧？” “瑞弗在帮我解决住宿问题上帮了大忙，让我能够在这里长期居住！” “那晚些时候我会去找你，再详细告诉你情况。现在……我想先独自待一会儿。 [party.has cait |与[pc.name]一起 ]请稍等一会儿。” “能和你聊天真是太开心了，凯特丽丝！我们很快还会见面的，好吗？” 你们两个，还有其他几位顾客，都看着萨尔瓦那蓬松的巧克力色假发随着她的动作一晃一摆的，然后她便沿着楼梯走向霜犬酒馆酒店的客房去了。当她确定你独自一人时，凯特喝完了剩下的酒，叹了口气，摇了摇头。 “她肯定在寺庙里问了一些关于我的尴尬问题。要想获得从事传教工作的许可，至少需要几周，甚至几个月的时间，而且前提还是这些申请能够被批准——以她那种缺乏经验的情况来看，根本就不应该得到批准才对。一位年轻的女祭司被单独派往遥远的北方？神庙肯定是真的我本来想隐瞒自己的失踪这件事。” “不过，结果终究还是好的，不是吗？” “是……是的。”凯特虚弱地笑了笑，“妈妈……不，我不能一直沉浸在悲伤中，浪费她给我的这个机会。 [party.has cait |我们得马上出发了。[pc.name]我再也不想自怨自艾了！ |我不再自怨自艾了，但我确实需要一些时间来好好想想接下来该做什么！ ]萨莉能够安全地出现在这里，肯定是一种来自马拉克的信号，说明我走在了正确的道路上，我必须好好利用这个机会！ 还有你熟悉且喜爱的凯特，你一定很想念她吧。 [party.has cait | | 她的笑容顿时变得有些尴尬。“好吧好吧，我上楼去好好想想自己的事情了。先去陪陪爸爸，现在又遇到这种事——最近确实有太多事情需要考虑了，对吧？” 说完，她就离开了，只留下你独自站在吧台前，手里还拿着她那空杯子。 ] 这个就免费用了，”加斯说，“就那个故事本身就值得这个优惠。比起那些人为了让我免费喝东西而编的故事，这个可要靠谱多了，所以你确实赚到了这份‘报酬’。” 嗯，是时候继续前进了。你或许应该给凯特的老朋友一些时间来适应新环境，同时也让凯特有时间整理自己收到这样的消息后所产生的各种想法和情绪。或许一天后去询问一下旅馆里的客人，会有一些帮助。

rows.original: [party.has cait |"Looks like this is the place," Cait says, her eyes lighting up with excitement as you approach the door. "I can smell Sally's perfume from inside." You sniff the air and shake your head. No, you don't smell anything. Your pink kitten's smile broadens into a grin. "That's the point. Come on, then — I've had the time to think things through, and won't be any more ready than I am now." Placing her staff in the crook of her elbow, Cait clasps her hands in front of her and says a few words in what must be Jassiran. A few moments later, a muffled reply comes from behind the door in that same language, and Cait grabs the handle. "After you." The door swings open, and you're greeted with the sight of Salwah stretching herself in a pose fit for a contortionist — she's wearing little more than a thong and chestwraps as she balances herself on her elbows atop one of Garth's bearskin rugs, back arched and feet well above her head. As Cait shuts the door behind the two of you, she tumbles forward onto her feet with all the grace of a... well, cat and rushes forward to give your pink kitten a big hug. "Caitriss! I thought you'd never come!"[var0|The dark-skinned kitten looks her senior up and down and raises her hands to her mouth. "And you look absolutely amazing in your formal silks! I knew lugging them all the way from Jassira would be worth it!"] Cait sinks forward into her junior's embrace and sighs happily, ruffling Salwah's deep purple hair. Her junior's only an inch or two shorter than her, but happily bows her head to accept the scritches. "I'm here now, Sally. Sorry it took so long, I had to get everything lined up in my head first. But here I am, and we can get on with it!" "Oh, okay!" Plopping down onto the big bed, Salwah pats the mattress, inviting Cait to join her. "Um, is it okay if [pc.name] is here for this, too?" |Looks like this is the place. You reach out and knock on the door, and what resounds from within the inn room isn't Salwah's voice, but Cait's. "Come in!" Well, looks like you've been invited. You grab the handle and push open the door to find pink and tanned kittens alike spread out in poses fit for contortionists — which is doubly more impressive considering Cait's considerable rack. They're both wearing little more than a thong and chestwraps as they balance themselves on their elbows atop one of Garth's bearskin rugs, backs arched and feet well above their heads. "Your balance's as great as ever, Caitriss.[cait.cupRange F | No, it's better than I remember it being! ]" "That's just because I've [cait.cupRange F |gained |got ] more weight in the right spots," Cait replies with a chuckle. rows.original:
Sounds like a plan, and a fun one at that. Sure, you're in!
        
        Salwah speaks up a moment later, eyes wide. "You... you want to build a temple to Mallach, Caitriss? Here?"
        
        "Yes!"
        
        "But then..." Salwah's deep emerald eyes are as big as dinner plates. "If we did this, you'd be a matron!"
        
        "And you'd be my grand cleric!"
        
        "Matron Zethra... ooh, I'm getting dizzy..."
        
        Cait stands and grabs her junior by the shoulders as she sits, shaking the younger kitten until she vibrates. "Sally, we can do it. I know that Mallach is with us — it's only by his grace that I've lasted as long as I have. This must be what he wants, or I'd have broken or fallen long ago. Are you with me?"
        
        "I-I'm in, [silly
            |Cait-Senpai
            |Caitriss
        ]!"
        
        Well. You step in, reminding the girls that if nothing else, it'll cost money, time, materials and labour — not to mention, the land on which the ruins sit. Knowing what Tollus and his goons were up to over there, as well as the blast of magic that was released on the premises, you'll need to make sure it's safe, too.
        
        Cait scratches her head. "Yeah, that's the first thing we need to deal with, getting the land. [var0
            |We're going to ask Garth for permission to use it... after all, he passes for the local leader about these parts.
            |We're going to have to ask the baroness for permission to use it... after all, it does lie in her jurisdiction.
        ] Sally, you stay here while I get this done, okay? Make yourself comfortable and useful, get familiar with the land and people, and don't do anyone I wouldn't."
        
        "O-okay!"

        "All right then, it looks like we're done for now; I'll be back later after we've heard what [var0|Garth|the baroness] has had to say. You'll have no problems settling in, right, Sally?"
        
        "Nope!"
        
        Her gaze gleaming with renewed purpose, Cait turns to you as she stands from the bed. "Well, I guess that's where we're going next; we should [var0
            |see Garth
            |secure an audience with the baroness
        ] and explain our case. [party.has cait
            |We'll go together, okay
            |I'll meet you up at the bar and we'll go together, okay
        ]?"

        片刻后，萨尔瓦睁大双眼开口说道：“你……你想在这里为马拉克建一座神殿，凯特丽丝？”
        
        “对！”
        
        “可是那样的话……”萨尔瓦那双深翠色眼睛瞪得像餐盘一样大。“要是我们真这么做，你就会成为女族长！”
        
        “而你会成为我的大祭司！”
        
        “泽特拉女族长……哦，我开始头晕了……”
        
        凯特站起身，抓住坐着的晚辈双肩，把这只年幼猫女摇得全身发颤。“莎莉，我们能做到。我知道马拉克与我们同在——我能坚持这么久，全赖他的恩典。这一定是他的意愿，否则我早就崩溃或堕落了。你愿意和我一起吗？”
        
        “我、我愿意，[silly
            |凯特学姐
            |凯特丽丝
        ]！”
        
        好吧。你上前提醒两个姑娘，不说别的，建造神殿就得耗费金钱、时间、材料与劳力——更别说还得取得废墟所在的土地。考虑到托勒斯和手下曾在那里干过什么，以及那片场地释放过的魔力冲击，你们也必须确认那里足够安全。
        
        凯特挠挠头。“对，取得土地是我们首先得解决的问题。[var0
            |我们得去征求加斯的许可……毕竟，他在这一带就算是当地领袖了。
            |我们得去征求女男爵的许可……毕竟，那片土地确实属于她的管辖范围。
        ]莎莉，我去办这件事的时候，你留在这里，好吗？让自己过得舒适些，也派上点用场，熟悉这里的土地和居民；别跟任何连我都看不上的人上床。”
        
        “好、好的！”

        “那就这样吧，看来眼下的事情已经办完了；等我们听过[var0|加斯|女男爵]的答复，我会再回来。你能顺利安顿下来，对吧，莎莉？”
        
        “没问题！”
        
        凯特从床上站起，眼中闪耀着重新找到的目标；她转向你。“好吧，我想我们接下来就去那里；我们应该[var0

        ]，说明我们的请求。[party.has cait

            |我会在酒吧和你会合，然后一起去，好吗
        ]？”

rows.original: You shake your head and tell Cait that you're not going to help her with this. She's mentioned the politics and backstabbing of a grand, organized clergy more than just the once now, and you know the how and why of her own lineage through the temple, too. These Mallachite temples don't seem like the sorts of things you'd want to inflict on the Marches, and besides, the way she's talking, what matters to Cait more here is just being there to make sure the portal, and her chance at seeing Calla again, are kept safe. That, at least, you can help with. Cait's shoulders slump, ears flattening. "Y-you're not wrong... on either count. There's a reason Calla kept running away from the temple, but we could... I could..." Sally puts a hand on Cait's shoulder, reassuring her senior by entwining their tails. "[pc.HeShe]'s right, Caitress, I mean, you're not even a proper priestess, and I'm just a first-year missionary. We can spread the good word, and our legs, for Mallach's glory like missionaries ought to... but trying to build our own temple is just [silly |taking the piss |hubris ]! neither of us are even qualified to hold services!" Cait might know you're both right, but that doesn't stop the disappointment creeping into her voice. "I know, I know... this was stupid. And it'd be unfair to dad and Calla both, if I was tied down here. Dad needs his heir to come home with him when this is all over, doesn't he?" "That's right!" Sally nods, patting Cait's back. "Now let's focus on ways we can praise the prince of passions within our means, huh?"
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，告诉凯特你不会帮她处理这件事。她已经不止一次地提到那些庞大而组织严密的教会中的政治斗争与暗中算计，而你也清楚她自己的家族血统与这座神殿的渊源。这些马拉克神殿似乎并不是那种你会想让它们出现在边境地区的东西……更何况，从她说话的态度来看，对凯特来说，真正重要的是别的什么。在场为了确保那个通道，以及她再次见到卡拉的机会能够得到保护——至少这一点，你是可以帮忙的。 凯特的肩膀耷了下来，耳朵也贴在了身上。“你……你说得没错……这两点都是事实。卡拉之所以一直逃离那座神殿，肯定是有原因的，但我们……我本可以……” 莎莉把手放在凯特的肩上，通过将它们的尾巴缠在一起来安慰这位年长的女孩。“[pc.HeShe]没错，凯特，你甚至都算不上是一名真正的祭司，而我也只是个一年级传教士。我们可以像传教士应该做的那样，为了玛拉赫的荣耀，通过自己的行动来传播善意……但试图建造属于我们自己的神殿，那就有点过分了。 [silly |开玩笑而已 |傲慢 ]我们俩其实都不具备主持仪式的资格！” 凯特或许明白你们俩都是对的，但这并不能阻止失望情绪渗入她的声音中。“我知道，我知道……这样做真的很愚蠢。如果我被束缚在这里，对爸爸和卡拉来说都不公平，对吧？等这一切结束后，爸爸需要他的继承人回到他身边，不是吗？” “没错！”莎莉点点头，轻拍着凯特的背说：“现在，让我们想办法，在我们能力范围之内，去赞美那位‘激情王子’吧，好吗？”

I guess you're here as a missionary and not just for the missionary." Salwah sticks her tongue out at Cait, then grins and ushers the both of you to sit on the bed's edge with her. |Cait's already up at the door before you, but before she can reach the handle it creaks open and a [rand |dazed-looking lupine man |rather flushed catgirl |sweat-soaked wyld elf |very satisfied-looking orc ] steps out, pushing past your pink kitten during their egress. The chocokitty's ears perk up and she raises her gaze, but her apprehension melts away into cheekiness as she throws on her shawl. Excuse me, I — my head's just a little preoccupied at the moment. Come in! I'll put this away." Is there something I can do for you today, [pc.name]? Or if you'd rather, do with you, do to you, or just plain do you?" |You're about to knock on the door when it opens of its own accord and a [rand |dazed-looking lupine man |rather flushed catgirl |sweat-soaked wyld elf |very satisfied-looking orc ] steps out, pushing past you before stumbling across the hallway and wobbling down the stairs. Seeing this as an invitation, you step into the room to find Salwah fully dressed — for a very loose definition of %"dressed" — and curled up on a very messed-up bed, counting a small purse of coin. The dark-skinned kitten's ears twitch, and her apprehension melts away as she looks up, regaining plenty of her characteristic cheeky humor. "Oh, it's you, [pc.name]! Hope you're not interrupting her. "For someone whom my senior owes so much to? I'll make the time for you, [pc.name]. Just sit on the bed's edge and make yourself comfortable, and we'll see about what your desires are..." |You give the door a knock, and are a little startled to hear not Salwah's but Cait's voice from within the room. "Oh no," Cait replies with one of her trademark bubbly smiles. "We were just finishing up, and I was just about to leave anyway. Why don't you deal with [pc.name] here to the fullest of your abilities, Sally? Do it as a favor for me." As Cait stands and heads for the door, Salwah gives you a cheeky, fang-toothed smile and thumps the mattress with her tail, inviting you over. "Come on then, friend of my senior's. I've been asked to be nice to you... don't worry, I'm very comfy and won't bite." ] ]
rows.translation: [party.has cait |[rand |你还没来得及敲门，凯特就已经起床把门推开了——嗯，考虑到她们俩的关系如此亲密，世界上肯定也只有凯特能这么做吧。 你悄悄走进去，发现萨尔瓦正躺在熊皮毯子上做一系列伸展运动；她突然做一个后空翻，稳稳地站到了地上。这时凯特也冲了过来，两人紧紧拥抱在一起，亲吻着，当然，还有一点点调情的行为……嗯，真是看起来就像在摸索一样。你可以想象，当问候结束后，萨尔瓦会点头并带着调皮的笑容向你表示认可，然后熟练地披上她的披肩和斗篷，接着邀请你们俩坐在床上。 |当你走到门口时，凯特已经先你一步到了那里——你的粉色小猫用指关节敲打着门，然后用Jassiran语叫了起来。里面传来了回应声，凯特便推开了门，让你们俩进去。 里面，你看到萨尔瓦刚刚把一本厚厚的皮面书从她刚才坐着的桌子上拿下来。她微笑着向你们俩打招呼，然后拉开她的羊毛披肩，让凯特能够轻松地用头部轻触她的头发——这个动作显然已经练习得很熟练了。 啊，还在读祈祷书啊，莎莉？看来你是专门来这里的如同不仅是一名传教士为了那个传教士。” 萨尔瓦吐了吐舌头，冲凯特做了个鬼脸，然后笑着邀请她们俩和她一起坐在床边。 |在你之前，凯特就已经站在门口了，但还没等她碰到门把手，门就“吱呀”一声打开了，然后[rand |那个神情恍惚的狼族男子 |脸有点发红的猫娘 |被汗水浸透的荒野精灵 |那个看起来非常满意的兽人 ]她走出来时，从你那只粉红色的小猫身边挤了过去。凯特完全不在意，径直穿过敞开的门，看到萨尔瓦赫正半裸着蜷缩在那张大床上，手里还数着一小袋硬币。那只巧克力色的小猫立刻竖起了耳朵，抬起头看着你，但很快她的紧张情绪就被顽皮的笑容取代了，她披上披肩，笑着拍了拍自己躺着的床垫，邀请你们俩坐下。 ] 凯特[silly |-学长 ]！ [pc.name]你们是来看我的吧！” “我们正好路过，就想着顺便来看看你近况如何，”凯特回答道。 “嗯，我过得非常好！来吧，你们俩都进来！有好多事情要聊呢！ |[rand |你敲了敲门，里面传来一个显然是用贾西兰语说出的声音。当然，你根本无法用同一种语言回应，但不一会儿，萨尔瓦的声音就从门里传了出来：“喂？” “是你啊[pc.name]哦，对了！不好意思，我刚才有点走神了。进来吧，我把这个收起来。” 你走进房间，看到萨尔瓦正在把一个看起来像大玻璃瓶、上面连接着管子的装置放在桌子上。确认周围环境安全后，她微笑着拍掉手上的灰尘，邀请你和她一起坐在床边。 “别介意我偶尔会放纵一下，那些香料的味道很快就会散去的。今天有什么我可以帮您的吗？[pc.name]或者，如果你更愿意的话，就与你一起做，为你做，或者干脆就做你想要做的事吧？ |你正准备敲门时，门却自己打开了[rand |那个神情恍惚的狼族男子 |脸有点发红的猫女 |被汗水浸透的荒野精灵 |那个看起来非常满意的兽人 ]她走出来，从你身边挤过去，然后在走廊里踉踉跄跄地走下了楼梯。 你将这视为一个邀请，于是走进房间，发现萨尔瓦已经穿好了衣服——虽然按照某种非常宽松的标准来定义“穿好了”吧——她蜷缩在一张乱七八糟的床上，正在清点着一小袋硬币。这只皮肤黝黑的小猫耳朵动了动，当她抬起头时，之前的担忧立刻消失了，她又恢复了那副典型的调皮幽默模样。 “哦，原来是你啊[pc.name]我还以为又是一个……”她用贾西兰语说了些什么，“就在上一个事件发生后这么快又发生了。我差点没看到是谁之前，就打算把你打发走了呢！” 希望你没有打扰到她。 “对于我的上级来说，这个人竟然如此重要？我一定会抽时间陪你的。[pc.name]你就坐在床边，放松下来，我们再看看你到底有什么需求…… |你敲了敲门，却听到房间里传来的不是萨尔瓦的声音，而是凯特的声音：“进来吧！” 推开门后，你看到两位马拉克信徒女祭司正坐在床上整理衣服。你是不是打断了她们的什么事情？ “哦，没有啊，”凯特带着她那标志性的灿烂笑容回答道，“我们刚刚忙完，而且我本来也打算马上离开的。你先处理你的事情吧[pc.name]萨莉，就尽你最大的能力来帮忙吧？这可是求你帮忙的。” 当凯特站起身走向门口时，萨尔瓦冲你露出了一个调皮的笑容，还用尾巴在床垫上敲了敲，邀请你过去。“来吧，我学长的女朋友。有人让我对你好一点……别担心，我可舒服了，绝对不会咬人的。 ] ]

rows.original:
Salwah Amin is a mostly lithe, but also more bottom-heavy catgirl standing at five feet six, not counting her tall, thin ears. Skin the color of rich milk chocolate covers her body from head to toe, the result of the stereotypical dark-skinned Jassiran staying indoors and out of the sun, as would be expected from someone destined for divine harlotry since a young age. Her face is a little bit long and her chin more pointed, giving her a more feline appearance, and wide eyes of deep emerald sit above her small nose, bearing vertical slits like those of an actual cat.
    
    Deep purple-dyed hair spills from her head, down her shoulders and right up to the small of her back; it's held somewhat in check by the ruby-red hooded camel-wool shawl that she wears, threaded with gold along the edges and with flaps cut into the front to accommodate her feline ears. Aiding it is a circlet of banded gold that adorns her brow, the symbol of the Jassiran sun with the heart of Mallach prominent upon her forehead in red garnet. Around her shoulders, she's got a copy of the same white priestesses' cloak Cait wears, held in place by an identical gemstone clasp. Even if it stands out against the rest of her colors, it is, after all, her badge of office. 
    
    That's about all that she wears, though. Save for a thong and an equally skimpy top of that same gold-threaded camel wool, Salwah wears absolutely nothing else; in lieu of clothing, midnight-black tattoos crawl across her skin. They start from a circular pattern painted atop her generous D-cup rack and stretch out across her breastbone before running down her back and sides; they creep down her arms and legs like vines over branches, swirling and flowing, forever in flux before ending at a set of golden bracelets and anklets that adorn her wrists and calves. The only parts of Salwah's body that doesn't bear any kind of ink are her crotch and belly — and the former's occupied by her Brand of the Harlot, a simple pink outline of Mallach's heart emblazoned just a couple inches above her thong.[var0| Unlike Cait's brand, which is usually hidden, Salwah's is visible unaided, advertising her vocation for all to see.]
