“既然有了这样的名字，我就知道人们会期待我能够名副其实，而不得不说，这样的结果我并不反感。萨尔瓦赫露出了她那副俏皮的笑容，甚至还在咬着嘴唇。我得说，过去这招确实引发过不少对话呢。 |要达到这样的状态，我付出了很多努力，而且现在还在继续付出很多努力。不仅仅是在毛发上涂抹各种油剂和香料，还必须在不工作的时候进行大量的拉伸和锻炼。你不会认为这个身材是自然而然就形成的吧？” 她做得如此轻松自然，简直让人以为这是天生的。她完全有可能骗过你呢。 [party.has cait |萨尔瓦说得没错，”凯特插话道，“我们确实需要花很多精力来让自己看起来更好，尤其是那些为富人和权贵提供高级陪护服务的人。我和你一起四处走动，睡前也会做一些伸展运动来保持身材，但像莎莉这样平时活动较少的人，就有更多时间来完成各种基本锻炼动作了。 ] 萨尔瓦轻声笑了起来，她的耳朵像那些充满好奇的猫一样向前竖了起来。“在特洛纳里，人们传说马拉克信徒族的女巫和男巫会利用他们守护神的神圣魔法来让自己看起来更加迷人。就像所有流传广泛的谣言一样，其中确实包含着一丝真相。但是像我这样的初级女祭司，仅仅穿着白色法袍才几个月而已，根本没有能力获得这样的恩惠。我需要经常进行伸展运动和保持身体平衡，注意自己的饮食——尤其是在这个食物如此丰富的地方——当然，还需要合理使用各种香料。还有就是，当其他方法都无效时，适当运用化妆品，以及巧妙地选择服装来掩盖自己的不完美之处。” 哇，原来要想像马拉克的手下们那样看起来漂亮，其实需要考虑这么多因素啊。 如果你只是想要一个温暖的地方来休息，那么在任何地方都能以便宜得多的价格找到这样的地方。人们之所以去寺庙，正是因为在那里他们能得到在其他地方得不到的东西。 |我业余时间都做些什么呢？嗯，我会抽烟，还得保持身材，当然还要每天进行宗教仪式。即使我是一个远离任何宗教场所的传教士，也绝不能错过这些仪式。 [var0 |等凯特到了，就会有很多事情要做了。[silly |-学长 ]她让自己的生活恢复了正常的节奏，所以在我还能享受这种较慢的生活节奏的时候，我对此感到非常满意。 [party.has cait |别犯傻了。太别担心，莎莉，”凯特眨了眨眼，还摇着尾巴说，“等你知道的时候，我们的神庙就已经建成并开始运作了！ ] ] 你明白的。 “我也喜欢去找瑞弗聊聊。那个小家伙个子那么小，看起来就像个可爱的小弟弟，而且他总能了解到来自世界各地的最新消息！我从来没见过他离开过鹰棘镇，但以他的工作性质，肯定会在人们进出这个小镇的时候接触到各种各样的人。就在不久前，人们还指责各种类型的猫族吟游诗人和歌手是神庙的间谍呢。” “他是吗？” “我不知道，就算我知道，也不会告诉你的。萨尔瓦吐出了她那小小的粉红色舌头。‘总之，就是这么回事。我能够理解凯特为什么喜欢这里，但这里也太容易让人产生满足感了。 [var0|我希望她能尽快让这座寺庙恢复正常运转。 ]只有当我开始忙碌起来时，我才能发挥出最好的状态！你知道的，像我这样的女孩很容易感到无聊。 |我的衣服吗？除了那件标准的贾西兰女祭司长袍——”她指了指自己脖子上那件带有红色宝石扣饰的白色长袍，“其余的都是我自己制作的。当然，作为寺庙的一员，还是需要遵守一些规定的，但至少在我们履行职责所要求的范围内，我们在穿着打扮上还是有一定的自由度的。可以说，这就是我的个人品牌。从我还是个小猫的时候起，我就一直在构思这个造型——你可以去问问凯特丽丝，我以前总是缠着她还有卡拉，不断地向她们提出各种想法。终于，当我得到了驼毛和针线这些制作材料后，我就开始动手将这个想法变为现实了！ 有些事情，你就是不能交给别人去做，你知道吗？这些事情太重要了，不能冒险犯错，也不能让结果偏离你的预期。至少这样，如果出了什么问题，你只能怪自己。 [party.has cait | 莎莉一直都是这样一个动手能力很强的女孩，这也让她的动手技巧相当娴熟，”凯特苦笑着补充道，“不过，至少穿上那样的衣服，她应该和我一样冷吧[cait.isLeothran |是 |是 ]就在这里的边境地区！ ] ]
rows.raw: " "Myself? Hrrrmmm... most of the supplicants would rather talk about themselves than listen to the sound of my voice, regardless of how pleasant it is." To be fair, you're not a temple supplicant, and you're here on business, not pleasure. Like you said, you're not here to have your sensibilities soothed — you're here to try and understand the people in Cait's life better. "Yeah, sorry. Sometimes you just get too used to it. That, or maybe I'm liking this kind of evangelising a little too much." Salwah chuckles lightly and wiggles her ears. "About me, then... let's see..." You're all ears. [rand |"My hair and fur's actually black. As black as my tattoos — it's beautiful in its natural color, really, but given that so much of my getup is traditional it'd be pretty bad to break from it on that one detail by not dying my hair, right? A really dark purple isn't that bad, and the colors aren't that far off. Having to dye it all the time so the roots don't show is a bit of a bother, but you have to keep up appearances in my line of work." |"The tattoos on me aren't strictly necessary — or at least, not to this extent. But... I really do like how they look, and they add quite a bit to my personal mystique, don't they? They don't actually have any power or anything, but the patterning is something to look at. Totally worth the pain and weeks of work it took to get them inscribed on my skin." |"My name means 'comfort' in Jassiran. Well, 'true comfort' if you take my full name, but I'm not really that big of a deal to have an actual surname like Caitriss does; my mother just tacked it on because it sounded nice. She was rather enamored of the idea of a meaningful name for her dear daughter." A sacred courtesan named 'true comfort'... now there's something to turn heads. "Given the name, I'd always known that I'd be expected to live up to it, and I can't say I dislike the results." Salwah gives you one of those cheeky toothed smiles of hers, lip-biting and all. "It's opened a few conversations in the past, I can say as much." |"It's taken a lot, and keeps taking, a lot of work for me to look this good. It's not just the oils and scents I've got to apply along with the dye into my fur, but also plenty of regular stretching and exercise when I'm not on the job. You don't think that this figure just came about by itself, did it?" With how easy she makes it look? She could've fooled you. [party.has cait |"Salwah's not wrong," Cait interjects. "We have to put a lot of work into making ourselves look good, especially those who do high-class escort work for the rich and powerful. I keep in shape by walking all over the place with you and do some of the stretches before sleeping, but someone like Sally, who's more sedentary, has the time to go through all the basic forms, if not more." ] Salwah titters, her ears pointing forward in the manner of interested felines. "They say in Tronarii that Mallachite witches and warlocks employ the divine magic of their patron deity to appear attractive. As with all effective rumours, there's a kernel of truth in there... but the likes of a junior priestess like me with barely a couple of months on her white cloak wouldn't have the means to earn such favor. Plenty of stretching and balancing, watching what I eat — especially important in this land of rich food — and of course, a good spice regimen. That, and when all fails, a little judicious use of makeup, and using clothes to the best effect to cover up your imperfections." Wow, you'd never known so much goes into just looking good as one of Mallach's flock. "If you want but a warm hole, you can get that anywhere and for a much cheaper price. People go to the temple to get what they can't anywhere else." |"What I do in my spare time? Well, I smoke, I have to keep in shape, and there're the daily devotions to be taken care of, too. No excuse for missing those even if I'm a missionary far away from any established temple. [var0 |There'll be a lot to do once Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] gets her temple up and running, so I'm perfectly content with enjoying the slower pace of life while I can." [party.has cait |"Don't get too comfortable, Sally," Cait says with a wink and tap of her tail. "We'll have the temple up and running before you know it!" ] ] You see. "I also like to head down and talk to River. The little guy's short enough to be a cute little brother, and he always has the latest news from all over the world! I've never seen him actually leave Hawkethorne, but someone in his line of work must talk to all kinds of people as they come in and out of town. It wasn't that long ago that people were accusing catfolk bards and minstrels of all stripes for being spies for the temple, after all." Is he? "I don't know, and if I did, I wouldn't tell you." Salwah sticks her little pink tongue out. "Anyway, that's that. I can get why Caitriss likes it here, but it's also too easy to get complacent. [var0|I hope she gets the temple running pretty soon; ]I'm at my best when I'm up and getting busy! Girls like me get bored easily, you know." |"My clothes? The standard-issue Jassiran priestess' cloak aside — " she indicates the white cloak with the red jewelled clasp about her neck — "I put together the rest myself. Of course, there're certain standards to be met as part of the temple, but at the very least we have some freedom in how we'd like to present ourselves within the limits and expectations set by our vocation. Our personal brand, as it were. I've had my particular look in mind ever since I was just a kitten — you can ask Caitriss all about it, I used to bother her and Calla all the time with ideas. Once I got my hands on the camel wool and needlework to make it a reality, I did! "Some things you just can't leave to other people, you know? Too important to risk a mistake or have it not turn out exactly as you envisioned. At least like this, you only have yourself to blame if something goes wrong." [party.has cait | "Sally's always been a very hands-on girl like that. It's made her good with her hands, too," Cait adds with a wry smile. "Well, at least with an outfit like that she's as cold as I [cait.isLeothran |was |am ] up here in the Marches!" ] ] "

rows.translation: 她自己

rows.original: Salwah flicks a ear at you lazily. "Hmm?" It's that reddish-brown stuff that she spiked Cait's drink — and yours, too — with on the day you met. Looked like powdered rust to you, only lighter and a lot finer. "Oh, you mean the spice?" Spice? The comfy chocokitty taps you on the [pc.ass] with the tip of her tail. "Right, of course you wouldn't know if you've never been to Jassira. Basically, spice is a mixture of cinnamon, cloves, and — " she pauses for a moment — "a certain very hard-to-grow herb, all ground up to a very fine powder. That last one gives the mixture much of its kick, and prevents the lot from caking. So long as you keep it in a tightly sealed container away from the light, spice can more or less last forever." It tasted kind of weird when mixed in your wine. Not in a bad way, yes, but still weird. "It's everywhere in Jassira, [pc.name], what with it being a crucial spiritual, medical and social thing. You add it to all sorts of things — spice bread, curry and beer for the common people, spice wine, coffee and smokables for the upper classes." She indicates the hookah on the desk. "It adds flavor to food, and helps keep it from spoiling; perfectly safe for most races, but it gives feline peoples like catfolk a pleasant buzz and makes one just a bit more receptive to advances. Jassiran Mallachites are certainly no stranger to the stuff — I just wanted to give Caitriss a taste of home, given how down she looked after explaining all about poor Calla." [party.has cait |You look askance at Cait. Certainly, she hadn't explained as much about something so important to her culture. "Well, it's never really come up before now, [pc.name]. You can't get spice anywhere outside of Jassira, except maybe a little bit that's exported to Tronarii because of the many catfolk there. Dad never liked being dependent on anything he couldn't reasonably expect to stock up on in his travels, so he didn't bring any with him when we left." ] You see. "Yeah, as far as I know, Jassira's the only place that grows the herb, [pc.name]. They have to do it in caves with crystal tops to filter out the harmful rays of the sun or something, and the cave walls keep the moisture in, otherwise it'd all dry out in the desert heat. Spicetenders have lots of money and clout, but given how tightly their lives are controlled by the Sultanate I'm not sure it's worth it." Salwah gives you a cheeky grin. "As Cait'll tell you, I like to play too much for that kind of stuffy life." [party.has cait |Cait shares the grin. "That she does, [pc.name]." ] It's not addictive or anything, is it? "Not physically, but well, make anything pleasurable and people'll want more of it. It's not considered any more odd than alcohol back home. Well, some kinds of refined spice are concentrated with alchemical techniques, but unless you're the matron or grand cleric of a temple and need to open your mind to Mallach's presence, you're never going to touch the stuff. "Given how tightly I've been rationing my spice, I'll be sad when the last of my supply goes, but it's not as if I'll die or anything without it. I'll manage[party.has cait |, right, Caitriss? |. ]" [party.has cait |Cait clears her throat awkwardly. "Well, about that, Sally. You may not need to go dry." "Hmm? Don't tell me they have spicetenders in this land, too? That can't be right — [pc.name] didn't even know what it was." "No, no. The — " Cait says a few words in Jassiran — "grows quite profusely in this part of the world. I didn't quite believe it myself to begin with, but there's no doubt about it. The locals call it manticore nip." Salwah's eyes grow as big as dinner plates, and in a flash the younger kitty is upright on the bed, ears stiff and alert. She looks poised to pounce on Cait at any moment, but surely she would never do such a thing to her senior, right? "That's — I mean, how — " "I tried some myself to be sure, Sally. It is manticore nip. Maybe it's a different cultivar back home, but I'm willing to stake my word on it." "But... they have to grow them in those caves, Caitriss! You remember when our mothers took Calla and us to — " It makes perfect sense that a plant native to this cool part of the world would need special conditions to even have a chance of being cultivated in a place as warm as Jassira. "Well. I..." Salwah's ears flatten atop her shawl. "Ha, I made it out to be this mystical, magical thing, and it turns out the stuff's growing all over this part of the world! Maybe I'd have known if I hadn't been spreading my legs so much and taken a walk around the forest." "Don't worry, that's my job." Smiling, Cait gives her sheepish junior a pat between the ears. "You stay here and do your missionary work, okay?" |You see. "Yep. The spice must flow, so on and so forth. Always thought the saying was blowing it up a little, but after seeing what happened the other day when Garth ran out of mead maybe it isn't that far off after all. ] "So... anything else you'd like to discuss?"
rows.translation: 萨尔瓦懒洋洋地甩了甩耳朵，说道：“嗯？” 就是那种红棕色的粉末——在你们见面的那天，她把它加到了凯特的饮料里，也加到了你的饮料里。你当时觉得它就像锈粉，只不过颜色更浅，颗粒也更细而已。 “哦，你是说那种调味料吗？” 调味料？ 那只可爱的巧克力猫轻轻敲了敲你的[pc.ass]她用尾巴尖轻轻一碰。“对，当然了，如果你从未去过贾西拉，你就不会知道这些。基本上，这种香料是由肉桂、丁香，还有——”她停顿了一下，“一种非常难以种植的草本植物混合而成的，然后将它们全部研磨成非常细的粉末。最后那一种成分为这种混合物增添了独特的风味，同时也防止了混合物结块。只要将其保存在密封良好的容器中，远离光线，这种香料基本上可以永久保存。 当把它加入葡萄酒中后，味道确实有点奇怪。并不是说坏事，只是感觉有点奇怪而已。 “在贾西拉，这种东西到处都是[pc.name]，毕竟，它在精神、医疗和社会层面都扮演着至关重要的角色。人们会将它添加到各种各样的食物中——对于普通人来说，有加香料的面包、咖喱和啤酒；而对于上层阶级来说，则有加香料的葡萄酒、咖啡以及各种可吸食的物品。”她指了指桌上的水烟筒。它能为食物增添风味，还能防止食物变质；对大多数种族来说都是完全安全的，但对于猫族这样的猫科种族来说，它会带来一种愉悦的感觉，让人对各种诱惑更加容易接受。贾西兰·马拉克信徒们对此当然非常熟悉——我只是想让凯特感受到一丝家的味道，毕竟在听完关于可怜的卡拉的那些事情后，她看起来显得非常沮丧。" [party.has cait |你用怀疑的目光看着凯特。显然，对于对她文化来说如此重要的事情，她并没有详细解释过。 “嗯，直到现在，这个话题也从来没有人提起过。[pc.name]在贾西拉以外的任何地方，你都找不到这种香料，也许只有因为特洛纳里地区有大量的猫族，才会有一些这种香料被出口到那里。爸爸从来不喜欢依赖那些他在旅行中无法合理预期能够搞到的东西，所以当我们出发的时候，他并没有带这种香料。 ] 你明白的。 “是的，据我所知，只有贾西拉地方才会种植这种草药。[pc.name]他们必须在那些顶部装有水晶的洞穴里生活，这样才能过滤掉太阳的有害光线；而且洞穴的墙壁还能保持湿润，否则在沙漠的炎热中，一切都会干枯殆尽。那些负责提供辛辣食物的人虽然拥有很多金钱和影响力，但考虑到他们的生活受到苏丹国的严格控制，我实在不确定这样的生活是否值得。”萨尔瓦坏笑着说道，“就像凯特会告诉你的那样，我可不喜欢这种压抑的生活环境，所以我更喜欢玩游戏。 [party.has cait |凯特也露出了同样的笑容。“她确实这么做了。[pc.name]。" ] 它并不会让人上瘾，对吧？” “从生理上来说不会，但是，任何让人感到愉悦的东西，人们都会想要更多。在咱们家乡，这种东西并不被认为比酒精更奇怪。当然，有些经过特殊工艺提纯的香料确实含有类似的成分，但除非你是某个寺庙的主持或者高级神职人员，需要通过这些香料来开启自己的心灵，否则你根本不会去接触这些东西的。 由于我一直非常节制地使用这些香料，当它们全部用完的时候，我肯定会感到难过，但并不是说没有它们我就会活不下去。我肯定能应付得来的。[party.has cait |对吧，凯特？ |。 ]" [party.has cait |凯特尴尬地清了清嗓子，说道：“嗯，关于这个，莎莉……你可能不需要去卖酒了。” “嗯？该不会说这个地方也有卖酒的摊位吧？那不可能吧—— [pc.name]我甚至都不知道那是什么。” “不，不是的。那种植物——”凯特用贾西兰语说了几句话——“在这个地区生长得非常茂盛。一开始我也不敢相信，但事实确实如此。当地人把这种动物叫做“曼提科尔尼普”。 萨尔瓦的眼睛瞪得像餐盘一样大，转眼间，那只小猫就站在了床上，耳朵竖得笔直，显得十分警觉。它看起来随时都会扑向凯特，但想必它不会真的对自己的长辈做出这种事情吧？那其实是……我的意思是，该怎么说呢……” “为了确认这一点，我自己也试过一些方法，莎莉。真的。是曼提科尔辣椒。也许在它的原产地那是另一种品种，但我敢打赌就是这种。” “但是……它们肯定是在那些洞穴里种植的，凯特！你还记得我们妈妈带着卡拉和我们去…… 对于一种原产于这个世界如此寒冷地区的植物来说，要想在像贾西拉这样温暖的地方成功栽培，确实需要特殊的条件，这一点再合理不过了。 “嗯……我……”萨尔瓦的耳朵在披肩的遮盖下显得更加扁平了。哈，我还把它想象成了一种神秘而神奇的东西，结果却发现这种植物其实遍布世界的这个地区！要是我没有到处乱跑，而是去森林里走走，或许就能早知道了。别担心，那个我的干得好。”凯特微笑着，轻拍了一下那个有些害羞的年轻同事的耳朵。“你留在这里继续你的‘传教工作’吧，好吗？ |你明白的。 “没错，‘香料必须不断流动’，诸如此类的说法。我一直觉得这种说法有点夸张，但前几天看到加斯喝光了蜂蜜酒后的反应后，我觉得这种说法其实也有一定道理。 ] 那么……还有其他你想讨论的事情吗？
rows.raw: ' Salwah flicks a ear at you lazily. "Hmm?" It's that reddish-brown stuff that she spiked Cait's drink — and yours, too — with on the day you met. Looked like powdered rust to you, only lighter and a lot finer. "Oh, you mean the spice?" Spice? The comfy chocokitty taps you on the [pc.ass] with the tip of her tail. "Right, of course you wouldn't know if you've never been to Jassira. Basically, spice is a mixture of cinnamon, cloves, and — " she pauses for a moment — "a certain very hard-to-grow herb, all ground up to a very fine powder. That last one gives the mixture much of its kick, and prevents the lot from caking. So long as you keep it in a tightly sealed container away from the light, spice can more or less last forever." It tasted kind of weird when mixed in your wine. Not in a bad way, yes, but still weird. "It's everywhere in Jassira, [pc.name], what with it being a crucial spiritual, medical and social thing. You add it to all sorts of things — spice bread, curry and beer for the common people, spice wine, coffee and smokables for the upper classes." She indicates the hookah on the desk. "It adds flavor to food, and helps keep it from spoiling; perfectly safe for most races, but it gives feline peoples like catfolk a pleasant buzz and makes one just a bit more receptive to advances. Jassiran Mallachites are certainly no stranger to the stuff — I just wanted to give Caitriss a taste of home, given how down she looked after explaining all about poor Calla." [party.has cait |You look askance at Cait. Certainly, she hadn't explained as much about something so important to her culture. "Well, it's never really come up before now, [pc.name]. You can't get spice anywhere outside of Jassira, except maybe a little bit that's exported to Tronarii because of the many catfolk there. Dad never liked being dependent on anything he couldn't reasonably expect to stock up on in his travels, so he didn't bring any with him when we left." ] You see. "Yeah, as far as I know, Jassira's the only place that grows the herb, [pc.name]. They have to do it in caves with crystal tops to filter out the harmful rays of the sun or something, and the cave walls keep the moisture in, otherwise it'd all dry out in the desert heat. Spicetenders have lots of money and clout, but given how tightly their lives are controlled by the Sultanate I'm not sure it's worth it." Salwah gives you a cheeky grin. "As Cait'll tell you, I like to play too much for that kind of stuffy life." [party.has cait |Cait shares the grin. "That she does, [pc.name]." ] It's not addictive or anything, is it? "Not physically, but well, make anything pleasurable and people'll want more of it. It's not considered any more odd than alcohol back home. Well, some kinds of refined spice are concentrated with alchemical techniques, but unless you're the matron or grand cleric of a temple and need to open your mind to Mallach's presence, you're never going to touch the stuff. "Given how tightly I've been rationing my spice, I'll be sad when the last of my supply goes, but it's not as if I'll die or anything without it. I'll manage[party.has cait |, right, Caitriss? |. ]" [party.has cait |Cait clears her throat awkwardly. "Well, about that, Sally. You may not need to go dry." "Hmm? Don't tell me they have spicetenders in this land, too? That can't be right — [pc.name] didn't even know what it was." "No, no. The — " Cait says a few words in Jassiran — "grows quite profusely in this part of the world. I didn't quite believe it myself to begin with, but there's no doubt about it. The locals call it manticore nip." Salwah's eyes grow as big as dinner plates, and in a flash the younger kitty is upright on the bed, ears stiff and alert. She looks poised to pounce on Cait at any moment, but surely she would never do such a thing to her senior, right? "That's — I mean, how — " "I tried some myself to be sure, Sally. It is manticore nip. Maybe it's a different cultivar back home, but I'm willing to stake my word on it." "But... they have to grow them in those caves, Caitriss! You remember when our mothers took Calla and us to — " It makes perfect sense that a plant native to this cool part of the world would need special conditions to even have a chance of being cultivated in a place as warm as Jassira. "Well. I..." Salwah's ears flatten atop her shawl. "Ha, I made it out to be this mystical, magical thing, and it turns out the stuff's growing all over this part of the world! Maybe I'd have known if I hadn't been spreading my legs so much and taken a walk around the forest." "Don't worry, that's my job." Smiling, Cait gives her sheepish junior a pat between the ears. "You stay here and do your missionary work, okay?" |You see. "Yep. The spice must flow, so on and so forth. Always thought the saying was blowing it up a little, but after seeing what happened the other day when Garth ran out of mead maybe it isn't that far off after all. ] "So... anything else you'd like to discuss?" '

rows.original: [rand |"Oh, it's pretty great! The weather's cool all the time and it's pretty comfy!" Cool... shouldn't she be cold? As impossible as it sounds, Salwah's wearing even less than Cait usually does in her passion priestess clothes. Even the sun-dancer's silks she brought for her senior all the way from Jassira are more modest than this! "Weeeell, I'm kinda used to it. The desert isn't all hot — things get awfully cold at night. Besides, if you're chilly it just means you're not moving vigorously enough. That, and I take a moment to turn up my body temperature a bit before I get started for the day. It makes me get hungry a lot faster, but it's well worth my supplicants telling me I'm a warm, comfy cat when they snuggle with me under the sheets." [party.has cait |Cait clears her throat. "Sally was trained to have considerably more control over her own body than most people do. It's not that strange a concept — since coming here, I've heard local legends of lupines who trained themselves to beat the cold by consciously turning up their body heat. ] Even so... "You know what they say, that most of the heat that leaves your body goes through the head," Salwah continues, one of her cheeky toothed smiles stretching itself across her face. "Since I've got a really warm shawl, I'm sure I could go about naked if I liked and still be totally fine." |"I have no complaints. The people are really nice and direct about what they want in life. Up here, if you care about someone, you go up to them and tell as much, and if they feel the same way about you, then things are settled. It's a very forthright kind of love, and while I think it takes a lot of the excitement out of it I also understand that things up here are such that people get a lot of unwanted excitement in their daily lives. It also makes my business a lot simpler." That's about the long and short of love in many Marcher cultures, yeah. She's cute to have picked up on it so quickly. "The Grand Cleric told me that when we proselytize to the natives, we have to keep their sensibilities in mind. I've done my best to adjust my methods to what people do around these parts instead." [party.has cait |"Oh?" Cait raises an eyebrow. "Could you show me, Sally?" "Sure!" Salwah gives Cait a cheeky, mischievous smile. "Hey, wanna fuck?" Cait giggles. "That's a bit too direct, even for up in this part of the world. Well, except maybe amongst orcs and the like; I can see that one working on [arona.recruited|a particular one I know.|them at least!]" ] Well, love comes in all sorts of forms, and it's good that she understands that. "Your one true love is just that — your one true love. Mallachites understand that the method in which love expresses itself differs from person to person — within reason, of course. Just ask Caitriss — she'll be willing to give you a long lecture all about consent." |"River has been really useful in getting me set up here; it's nice to have a friendly face around who likes to make himself helpful. I don't think he's officially connected to any of the Jassiran temples, but he's helped me out to the point where I wouldn't be surprised if he were. Right from the outset, he helped negotiate my room and board, smoothed over a couple of problems with Garth and helped things keep discreet so my activities wouldn't sully the good name of his establishment. Not that they should by rights, but I fully understand that people outside Jassira often confuse what we Mallachites do with simple prostitution. Tronariians have been spreading the most horrible rumours about us for generations now, after all." Looks like she's made a friend already. "Well, he made the first move instead of me, so I can't be given credit for that. I was initially wondering why he was cosying up to me, if he just wanted the usual — but as far as I can tell he's just made himself helpful without expecting anything in return. It's a breath of fresh air, I tell you." [party.has cait |"River likes to make himself useful to everyone," Cait agrees. "He's a bit of an enigmatic person, but I've never known the little bard-boy to act against anyone. Even if I don't fully understand what he wants, why he's here or how he knows all the things he knows, I've known him long enough to at least be able to trust him." ] Mm-hm. That's a bit of cloaked bragging right there, isn't it? That she's so attractive that she can't help but keep on drawing unwanted attention? "Ah well, it can't be helped, can it?" Fluttering her dark eyelashes at you, Salwah raises a hand to her tanned cheek and flashes you a toothy smile. "Is it a sin to be fetching to the point where the matron wants your looks and figure to be bred into the next generation of sacred harlots?" |"Yes, I know of Leorah and her resentment against the temple. It's a little sad, but at the same time practical considerations have to be taken into account. I'm not justifying what happened to her in the least, but we have to eat, dress, and pay for necessities at the same time. Anyone can walk up to a temple of Mallach and expect a bath and a safe place to rest for the night in the courtyard, but that's all that can be had for free. Sometimes, we waive the tithes in cases like diseases or life-threatening issues if the supplicant can't pay, but those are always understood to be at the temple's discretion. Turning away someone who feels lonely and seeks us out for solace is certainly against the spirit of things, but..." Yes, you understand how it is. [party.has cait |"I didn't quite understand it myself when I was a kitten," Cait adds. "Calla took it as an eternal testament to the temple's hypocrisy. When I got older, I came around to the reasoning of why some people were sent away... Calla didn't. But then, she was the idealist amongst us two." ] "The least I can do now is to see if I can't offer to make it up to her in some small fashion," Salwah says with a sigh. "It's unlikely to change her mind — by the looks of it, too much of her history and personality is wrapped up in her resentment of Mallachites, and Jassiran ones in particular, to ever truly forgive us. But perhaps some of these wrongs can be redressed, and perhaps Leorah won't hate us as vehemently..." |"Hawkethorne? Oh, I like the place. It's very warm and comfy, and people aren't as leery of strangers as I'd been led to believe natives in foreign small towns were. Then again, this place is a crossroads, so it can only be expected, right?" The populace have been very kind to you and Cait since your arrival, yes. Generally, unless there's reason to cast shade on oneself, the folk of Hawkethorne are great. "Sometimes I go down to the native chapel and talk to the priest there. It seems strange to me that a chapel of Velun would have places for each of the Seven, but if that's how people conduct their worship here then I don't have any complaints. Seeing Mallach pictured as foreigners view him is an interesting perspective — he is familiar, yet the distinctive flavor of this part of the world clings to him. Much like love, really." She goes down and talks to Sanders? "He's very supportive of what Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] and I intend to do, which is a little strange given what the whole Tronarii-Jassira situation led me to believe, but then again he is a man who honors all the gods despite explicitly stating his devotion to one. He said... ah, right. He said that it was nice to see young people as fervent about their faith as he was in his youth, to come halfway across the world to lands unknown in order to spread the word. I tried teasing him a little, but all that got me was a smile and a pat on the head." Yep, that sounds like Sanders all right. ]
rows.translation: [rand |哦，这里真的太棒了！天气一直都很凉爽，穿着也很舒服！” 凉爽……按常理来说，她应该会感到寒冷才对吧？但出乎意料的是，萨尔瓦穿着的热情牧师服装，甚至比凯特平时穿的还要少。就连那位从贾西拉特意为她的上级带来的太阳舞者的丝绸，也比这个保守多了！ “嗯，我已经习惯了。沙漠并不总是炎热的——夜晚会变得非常寒冷。而且，如果你觉得冷，那只是说明你运动得还不够充分而已。另外，我会在开始一天的活动之前，花点时间让自己体温稍微升高一些。这样会让我更快感到饥饿，但当他们在被子里依偎在我身边时，他们会说我是只温暖又舒适的猫，这种感觉绝对值得。" [party.has cait |凯特清了清嗓子，说道：“莎莉接受过训练，因此她对自己身体的控制能力比大多数人都要强。这个概念其实并不奇怪——自从来到这里之后，我就听说过一些当地的传说，讲的是那些通过有意识地提高体温来抵御寒冷的狼人。 ] 即便如此…… “你知道人们是怎么说的吧，说人体散发的热量大部分都是从头部散发出去的，”萨尔瓦继续说道，她脸上浮现出一丝顽皮的微笑。“既然我围着一条非常暖和的围巾，那我就算光着身子出门也没关系，肯定也不会有什么问题。 |我没有任何怨言。这里的人们都非常友善，也会直截了当地表达自己的人生追求。在这里，如果你关心某个人，你就会直接去找他们，把你的想法告诉他们；如果他们也有同样的感受，那么事情就会得到解决。这种爱情表达方式非常直接，虽然我认为这种方式会减少一些浪漫的激情，但我也能理解，在这里的环境下，人们确实更倾向于这种坦诚的表达方式。不需要的这为他们的日常生活带来了许多乐趣，也让我的工作变得轻松许多。” “在许多马彻人的文化中，爱情大致就是这样的。她能这么快就理解这一点，真是太聪明了。” “大牧师告诉我，在向当地人传播信仰时，我们必须考虑到他们的文化习俗。因此，我也尽力调整自己的传播方式，以适应这些地区人们的习惯。 [party.has cait |哦？”凯特挑了挑眉毛，“你能给我看看吗，莎莉？” “当然可以！”萨尔瓦坏笑着对凯特说道，“嘿，想不想来点什么？” 凯特轻笑出声：“这个说法有点太即使是在这个地区，这种表达方式也是直接明了的。嗯，也许兽人之类的种族除外；我想他们对这种表达方式会感到习惯。 [arona.recruited|我认识的一个特定的人。|至少也要他们吧！]" ] 嗯，爱情有多种形式，她能够理解这一点，真是太好了。 “你真正的真爱，其实就是这样的你的一段真正的爱情。马拉克信徒族人们明白，爱情的表达方式因人而异——当然，这种差异是在合理的范围内。你不妨去问问凯特，她肯定会给你讲上一大通关于同意的重要性的话。 |瑞弗在帮助我适应这里的环境方面真的帮了大忙；有这样一个乐于提供帮助、态度友善的人在身边，真是太好了。虽然我觉得他并没有正式隶属于任何Jassiran寺庙，但他帮助我的程度已经到了这样的地步：如果他真的与那些寺庙有联系，我也不会感到惊讶。从一开始，他就帮忙为我安排了住宿和饮食，解决了与加斯之间的一些矛盾，还确保我的活动不会损害他经营的场所的声誉。虽然严格来说这些事情本不应该发生，但我完全理解：在贾西拉之外的人，往往会把我们马拉克信徒的行为误认为是普通的卖淫活动。毕竟，特罗纳里安人几代以来一直在散布关于我们的最可怕的谣言。” 看来她已经交到一个朋友了。 “嗯，是他先采取行动的，而不是我，所以这个功劳不能算在我的头上。起初我还在想，他为什么这么讨好我，是不是只是为了得到那些常规的东西……但据我观察，他只是无私地提供帮助，并没有期待任何回报。说实话，这种行为真的让人感到耳目一新。 [party.has cait |瑞弗总是愿意帮助别人，”凯特同意道，“他这个人有点神秘，但我从不知道这个年轻的吟游诗人会做出伤害别人的事。虽然我并不完全明白他的目的，也不明白他为什么来到这里，更不明白他是怎么知道那些事情的，但毕竟我们认识他已经很久了，至少我可以信任他。 ] 嗯，这其实也算是一种隐晦的炫耀吧？就是那种‘自己太有魅力了，以至于不得不不断吸引那些不想要的注意’的炫耀。” “唉，也没办法嘛，对吧？”萨尔瓦眨动着她那双深色的睫毛，把手放在自己晒黑的脸上，然后露出一个灿烂的笑容：“如果一个人漂亮到连女祭司都想要把你的外貌和身材遗传给下一代‘神圣的妓女’，这算是一种罪过吗？ |是的，我知道莱奥拉以及她对神庙的怨恨。这确实有点令人难过，但同时我们也必须考虑现实生活中的种种需求。我绝不是在为她所遭遇的一切找借口，但我们毕竟需要吃饭、穿衣，还需要支付各种生活开支。任何人都可以走进玛拉赫的神庙，期望在庭院里得到沐浴的机会，以及一个安全的地方过夜，但这些服务都是免费提供的。当然，在某些情况下，比如当事人患有疾病或面临生命危险而无法支付费用时，我们会免除他们应缴纳的贡金，但这些决定始终由神庙自行裁量。拒绝那些感到孤独、前来寻求慰藉的人，确实违背了这种初衷，但是…… 是的，你明白我的意思。 [party.has cait |我小时候其实也不太明白其中的意思，”凯特补充道，“卡拉则将这件事视为对这座寺庙虚伪行径的永恒见证。等我长大后，我才逐渐理解了为什么有些人会被赶走……但卡拉并没有。毕竟，在我们两个当中，她才是那个理想主义者。 ] 现在我至少可以试着想办法弥补她的损失，”萨尔瓦叹了口气说道，“不过这不太可能改变她的想法——从目前的情况来看，她对马拉克信徒家族，尤其是贾西兰家族的怨恨，已经深深植根于她的过去和性格之中，她恐怕永远也无法真正原谅我们。不过，或许有些冤屈是可以得到弥补的，也许莱奥拉也不会再那么恨我们了…… |鹰棘镇？哦，我挺喜欢这个地方的。那里非常温暖舒适，人们对待陌生人的态度也不像我之前以为的那些外国小城镇的本地人那样警惕。不过，毕竟这个地方是个十字路口，这样的态度也是情有可原的，对吧？自从你们来到这里，当地的人们对你们和凯特一直非常友善。一般来说，除非有什么理由让自己显得不那么讨人喜欢，否则鹰棘镇的居民都是很不错的。 “有时候我会去当地的教堂，和那里的牧师聊聊天。在我看来，维伦的小教堂里能为七神各自设立祭坛，这似乎有点奇怪；但既然人们就是这么进行宗教仪式的，那我也没有任何意见。将马拉克视为外来者来观察他，这个视角确实很有趣——他虽然让我们感到熟悉，但这个世界这一地区的独特风格依然在他身上体现得淋漓尽致。真的，和爱情很相似。” 她下去了，和桑德斯谈了谈？ “他对凯特的想法非常支持。[silly |-学长 ]而我确实打算这么做，考虑到特洛纳里和贾西拉之间的那些事情让我原本抱有其他的想法，这个决定确实有点奇怪。不过，他毕竟是一个尊重所有神明的人，尽管他也明确表示自己只信仰其中一位神明。他说过……啊，对了。他说，看到年轻人像他年轻时那样对自己的信仰充满热忱，不远万里来到陌生的地方去传播信仰，真是太好了。我试着逗了他几句，但他只是笑了笑，然后拍了拍我的头。嗯，这听起来确实很像桑德斯的做法。 ]

萨尔瓦微笑着说道：“当然，还有其他的事情。女主管喜欢让我们和凯特一起担任‘媒人’的角色——专业地为那些彼此合适的人牵线搭桥，帮助他们找到爱情，这也是寺庙提供的一项服务。凯特[silly |-学长 ]她长着一张可爱的脸，也很擅长与来访的客户交流；我凭借这张漂亮的脸庞帮助我们完成了交易，而且对我们的客户了如指掌。我们真的是一个非常出色的团队。 [party.has cait |那真的是我们女孩们度过的最开心、最愉快的时光了，”凯特带着一丝怀旧之情说道，“看到几个月后那些情侣们前来感谢我们，说我们让他们走到了一起，那种感觉真是太棒了——没有什么比改变人们的生活、让他们变得更好更令人欣慰的了。虽然我们安排的有些配对并没有成功，但我们的成功率还是比大多数人要高的；要是卡拉能看到我们所做的一切该多好啊…… ] 嗯，你懂的……这确实是一个新的视角。 “其他地方的人们认为我们只知道追求性爱，因为这才是关于我们寺庙活动的最吸引眼球的新闻点。更令人震惊的是，一场月光下的狂欢派对，或者两个女孩帮助人们找到真爱，这些事情难道不比那些更值得关注吗？啊……更不用说那些Tronariians总是喜欢把我们描绘成那些稍受刺激就会脱光衣服的放荡女人——不过，直到你先付清钱款之前，这种说法根本就不是事实。 |在寺庙中，是如何被选中去从事某些特定职业的呢？你对这个过程了解得并不多，但觉得它似乎相当不透明。 “对于那些成年后才加入寺庙的人，我无法发表意见，因为我是从那里出生并长大的。但当你十三、十四岁的时候，女院长和高级神职人员通常已经能够大致了解你的性格特点以及你的真实身份了。当然，还有其他一些因素也会影响这一结果，比如你的出生背景——那些出身于高级妓女和贵族家庭的小猫，往往也会继承她们母亲的职业。其中一些人甚至会离开寺庙，加入自己贵族父亲的家族，从而完全避开这一过程。 “当然，在你接受入会仪式、被烙上印记之前，一切都还没有最终确定。即便在那时之后，如果有充分的理由，也是可以改变职业的，比如如果你在寺庙的等级体系中获得了晋升的话。你该不会认为，那些寺庙的女主管在加入组织的第一天就穿着那种华丽精致的服装吧？” “嗯，你以前应该从来没见过这些寺庙的女主管吧。 [var0|另外，当你完成凯特的神庙任务后，她就会获得这个身份，到时候可能根本没有人能够用女祭司应有的身份来取代她现在的地位…… 萨尔瓦听到这里似乎有些担心，但她眨了眨眼睛，摇了摇头说：“这个问题等到到时候再解决也不迟，现在担心也没什么意义。|莎莉咯咯笑了起来：“总有一天我们会解决这个问题的！]还有其他你想问的问题吗？ ]
rows.raw: " [rand |You've noticed something — that her Brand of the Harlot is quite visible on her crotch. She mentioned different vocations having different brands, right? "That's correct. People don't just come to the temple for sex — that'd make us no different from any brothel in the slums. There're all kinds of things we do for supplicants willing to pay the tithes, and while all of us had the same education in the basics, things got different from there on out." [party.has cait |"For example, because of who my parents are, I was raised to be an intimate escort and companion to the higher classes," Cait adds. "I was taught to make conversation, recite poetry, play instruments, dance — even a little formal magic. Heh, the holy fire I had to beg the paladins to teach me, most of what the temple taught was illusions for the bedroom. If I hadn't gone off with Dad and Calla, I'd be hanging off the arm of some noble at a party in the Sultana's court right now, playing the part of their beloved mistress for the night." ] You see. "Some people actually come to the temple for baths and massages, and not as a euphemism for sexual services. Others come to enjoy music and poetry so that they can feel highbrow and cultured, or to pass the spice plate in the company of attractive people. Several want embarrassing diseases tended to with Mallach's magical touch... and still yet more want someone to pretend to be interested in them and their boring lives for a few hours. Then there're outside calls like escort services for events... "Even when it comes down to sex, there are those who favor certain acts over others. The different brands help people understand which of the courtesans specialise in what, to help prevent embarrassing situations. The colors and shapes differ, but the Heart of Mallach forms the core of every brand. Some, like the escorts', aren't openly visible for obvious reasons, but if you're the kind of person who can pay for that stuff you contract one of the courtesans from the temple's matron." You see. "Color-coded for your convenience," Salwah quips lazily. "Anyway, is there anything else you'd like to know?" |You have to ask... what exactly was the vocation that Salwah was slated for? What would she be doing if she weren't here in the Marches with Cait and you? "Hm?" Salwah looks down at the purple-pink heart emblazoned on her crotch, appears confused for a moment, then breaks into a smile as realization dawns. "Of course. You wouldn't know." [pc.bg acolyte |You may have had a religious upbringing, but your education didn't go as far as to cover the different orders and vocations of Jassiran Mallachite sacred harlots. |Yeah, obviously. It's not the kind of thing they teach at the local temples and churches. ] "Give me a moment to formulate my answer." Silence fills the room as Salwah ponders, then her expression brightens. "Well, to put it simply, I am a garden of children." A what?! [party.has cait |Cait rolls her eyes, but keeps her smile. "To put it simply, [pc.name], she's a breeder." ] "The needs of those who come to the temple are many. Amongst those are the desire to pursue dalliances with a pregnant woman, or plant kittens in a fertile womb. For more generous donations to the temple's upkeep, those and more can be arranged. We are responsible for the creation and upbringing of a goodly portion of the next generation's initiates... to say the least. "When I was thirteen, the matron told me that like my mother, I was beginning to show very fetching traits that the temple would like to perpetuate. She asked if I wanted to eventually take on the same vocation when the time came for me to be initiated as an acolyte and give my body for Mallach. Of course I said yes, and from that day my education began to differ quite considerably from Caitriss[silly |-Senpai's |' ] and Calla's." So... was Cait's mom one of those, too? "Oh no. Because it was BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, THE MOST MAJOR OF THE MINOR PRESTIDIGITATORS [party.has cait | — " Cait giggles at this very passable imitation of her father's voice. " — W |w ]ho made the request and the attendant tithe, the matron and grand cleric were more than willing to temporarily override the brand of any sacred harlot for him. Caitriss' mother was quite the high-class courtesan, and the usage of her womb cost him a pretty copper. Not as much as the matron herself, but certainly far more than the likes of me could command." So... she's not going to be littering all over the place, is she? Are you going to start seeing kittens showing up in Gwyn's nursery? "Mallach's balls, forbid that I do such an irresponsible thing! That's what the brand is for — the grand cleric can't be running up every night to rip it away for the likes of us, so those in my vocation can turn it on and off as we like. Obviously no girl's going to end up pregnant if someone hasn't paid for the service, and I'd be ridiculously remiss if I plied my specialty trade without a proper temple to perform the rites and raise my offspring in. Being a garden of children is more about just popping them out, you know. Part of why it's so expensive is because the cost of raising the kitten to majority is included in the fee. "Anyways, enough about that. We can discuss it in more detail when the time comes, but it's a no-go for now. Anything else?" |What sort of education did she receive from the temple in preparation for her, uh, role? "Aside from the basics that every Mallachite knows? A bunch. Mostly, I was trained to have complete mastery of my body and its workings; all Jassiran Mallachites know of the seventy-two secrets, the thirteen positions and six sexual chakra, but few are schooled in the use of all of them. Unlike Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ], I didn't learn any poetry, just enough dance to be passable, didn't bother keeping up with current events in order to make small talk at parties, and the magic I know isn't the sort where you throw gouts of flame at people." [party.has cait |"Even after all this while, my chants are still a bit sloppy," Cait adds. "I really should practise when we have the free time." ] So what did she learn? "I can't go too deeply in detail, but it started a mere week or two after I'd accepted my future vocation — roused in the midst of the cold desert night and doused with water in the temple pools. The objective was to slowly condition me to recognise and master my reflexes, to stop shivering from the cold despite what my body wanted. Other techniques for simple things our bodies do that we take for granted; to slow or speed my heartbeat while sitting calmly, to fall asleep within minutes anywhere, anytime, to consciously control muscles I didn't even know I had. All of it in the service of learning how to better milk cock and smash clams." Well, that sounds pretty damn detailed to you. Is she sure she should be telling you all this? "I haven't even gotten into pressure points and the six sexual chakra." [party.has cait |"Trust me, [pc.name]," Cait says with a grin, wiggling her ears. "That's the stuff that's openly known to those outside the temple; we've taken the art of love and made it into an entire spiritual practice. When all of this is over, you should come to Jassira sometime and see what we have to offer." ] Huh. Color you skeptical. "I know what I know, and know what you don't know," Salwah replies lazily, reaching out with her tail to caress your thigh. "Perhaps it's a little convenient that I'm not allowed to perform the more esoteric rituals outside of properly consecrated ground — things can get dangerous when you're dealing with the body's finer workings. [var0 |But maybe that's an incentive for you to help out Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ], right? |Perhaps my senior and I will whisk you away back to Jassira someday and show you properly... ]" |Sex aside, what sort of duties was she expected to take on in her future role as a temple harlot? You'd like to know more. "Well, given the nature of my future vocation, childcare. Quite a bit of it — a not insignificant number of the temple's next generation of initiates are birthed within its walls. Also there are those who want heirs, but either can't raise the kittens themselves, like in Caitriss and Calla's case, or wouldn't be bothered to dirty their hands with childcare. Raising a kitten to majority within the temple's protection is rather pricey, to say the least. "Since Lumia doesn't have that much dominance in the region — it's mostly Tira and Mallach down south — Mallachite temples also provide the services that the lady of light's people would otherwise offer. Like Caitriss will tell you, she and Calla were but the obvious natural result of her parents' love. All will know some basic midwifery, but when complications arise it's best to have an expert summoned." For a harlot-in-training, she sure was expected to perform a lot of chores that weren't related to sex. Salwah smiles. "There was more, of course. The matron liked to put Caitriss and I on matchmakers' duty — professionally introducing people who're compatible with each other and helping them find love is also a service the temple provides. Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] had a cute face and was great at talking to the people who came in; I had the pretty face to seal the deal and knew our clients inside-out. We made a great team." [party.has cait |"That was some of the best fun we had as girls," Cait adds with a wistful sigh. "It was great to have couples come in months later and thank us for bringing them together; there's nothing better than changing peoples' lives for the better. Not all of the matches we made worked out, but we had a better track record than most — if only Calla could have seen what we did in it." ] Hmm, you see. Well, that's a new perspective. "People in other lands think we're all about sex, because that's the most newsworthy part about the temple's doings. What's more shocking, a moonlight orgy or two girls helping people find lasting love? Aaaand... that's not to mention that the Tronariians always like to paint us as wanton sluts who'll get naked at the slightest provocation — well, that's hardly true at all, until you've paid up first." |How do you get picked for certain vocations in the temple? You don't know much about it, but the process seems quite opaque to you. "I can't speak for those who joined the temple after they were grown, since I was born and bred within those walls. But by the time you're thirteen or fourteen, the matron and senior clergy generally have some kind of handle on who you are and what kind of personality you have. There're other things that factor into it, too, like the circumstances of your birth; kittens born of high-class harlots and noblemen tend to end up following in their mothers' footsteps. Some of them even leave the temple, joining their noble sire's household, and so avoid the process entirely. "Of course, nothing's set in stone until the day of your initiation where you take the brand. Even after that, it's possible to change vocations if there's sufficient reason to do so, like if you were to be promoted in the temple hierarchy. You don't think temple matrons start off wearing that enormous, exquisite brand of theirs the day they were initiated, do you?" Well, you've never seen a temple matron before. [var0|Plus, when Cait becomes one when you complete her temple, there probably isn't going to be anyone to replace her current brand with whatever a matron's brand is supposed to be... Salwah looks a little worried at that, but squeezes her eyes and shakes her head. "That's a problem we'll have to deal with later when the time comes, but there's no point in worrying about it for now.|Sally giggles. "We'll fix that someday!] Is there something else you'd like to ask?" ] "

rows.original: [rand |"A little crowded, if I'll be honest. Mother was a garden of children like I am, so I naturally had plenty of brothers and sisters, seven of them in total; I don't have a single memory from when I was a kitten where she wasn't either pregnant or breastfeeding. After I turned twelve or thirteen, things began to slow down, and it was a year before I was set to be initiated that the grand cleric finally removed her Brand of the Harlot, for she was confirmed to be too old to be able to bear kittens. When I left, she was teaching the younger acolytes something of her skills. "She was also friends with Cait and Calla's mom, which is how we got to know each other. Cait's mom needed someone to watch over her kittens, the precious children of BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, THE MOST MAJOR OF THE MINOR PRESTIDIGITATORS [party.has cait | — " Cait giggles. " — W |w ]hile she was out of the temple about her work doing, uh, house calls. As luck would have it, one thing led to another, and so here we are today." [party.has cait |Cait's blue eyes glint with mischief. "I regret nothing!" "Neither do I!" The two catgirls collapse against each other on the bed, tails lashing back and forth as they giggle away. This is probably some kind of in-joke you're not privy to, you're sure. ] "Not that I didn't love my siblings, but Cait and Calla were people from a different social class — or at least, what passed for social classes within the temple. No doubt their mom schooled them in conversation beyond what the temple taught as basics — they always had the funniest things to say. It wasn't long before I started seeing them as big sisters to add to those I already had... only far more interesting." |"Calla was a very energetic kitten, and she absolutely had to work that energy off or else she wouldn't be able to fall asleep at night. Show her anything tall enough, and she'd attempt to climb it, be it a tree or the temple's exterior. There was that time when she got into trouble for climbing all the way up one of the temple's spires before she finally remembered just how far she was above the ground and froze up." [party.has cait |"I remember that," Cait says with a sigh. "People were asking me where Calla was all day and where I'd seen her last, and I had no more idea than they did. We searched the vestibule, the courtyard, the pools, even the private rooms until someone thought to look up." ] Cats climbing up things they later can't get down from. Why, you've never heard of such things before. Salwah rolls her deep emerald eyes. "You may jest, but it was quite the serious thing. Once she was discovered, there was the problem of coaxing her down — not an easy task, given then she'd wrapped her arms and legs about the peak in a death grip. Eventually, the grand cleric got sick of it all and levitated all the way up there to personally pry her free; Calla was screaming and crying her eyes out all the way down as she got floated tumbling head-over-heels to the ground. I think the grand cleric did that on purpose." [party.has cait |"Calla wasn't, and still isn't, afraid of very much," Cait adds. "Seeing her like that for the first time was eye-opening. Sobering stuff! But looking back on it, that whole incident made me realize that Calla's brave but not foolhardy — after all, being brave is defeating fear and acting in spite of it, not its absence. That's something we can all remember, especially now." ] So, what happened after? "Let's just say that Calla got it, and spare the details," Salwah replies, swishing her tail back and forth. "They're... unpleasant. Cait's mom also got a bit of blowback and her dad was certainly informed of her misbehavior the next time he visited. I think he had a talk with her after that, which settled her down some, but... well. She was Calla." |"It was a decent childhood, all in all. The temple staff kept a tighter leash on Cait and Calla — after all, they were the daughters of BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, THE MOST MAJOR OF THE MINOR PRESTIDIGITATORS. He's like, the third son of the Sultana's minister of agriculture and spice or something — high enough that people would take notice of him and his daughters." Why so? "A good number of Jassira's wealthy and powerful have their kittens raised in the temple for numerous reasons. Some are men who have an abundance of money, but lack charisma. Others are women who cannot bear kittens of their own, or would rather not put their bodies through the rigors of childbirth. Yet others want the prestige of having a holy heir descended from one of the temple matrons, while some just want the surety of a spare heir or two; or just to prove that they can pay the exorbitant fee to have a Mallachite play surrogate — even one born of a junior priestess like me is more than what a commoner would ever hope to earn in their lifetime. All sorts of reasons. "Some kittens are claimed shortly after birth, to grow up in the households they will eventually represent. Most, though, end up like Cait and Calla — raised within the temple's walls by their birth mothers until they come of age. And why not? They receive an education, are loved by their birth mothers, and they are free to say no to leaving if they aren't enamored of the life that awaits them outside the temple. After generations of this, it's not surprising that a good proportion of the clergy and nobility are related, sometimes quite closely." After hearing all this in addition to that story about Cait's mom that day Salwah arrived, you're beginning to piece together the picture here. Yes, it would be really awkward if something happened to a noble's get while under the care of the temple. "Given the steep cost, a great deal of income springs from that particular service. Partly for the labor — ha! — of the mother, for the cost of raising a kitten to adulthood, and to ensure the household waiting for the child upon their majority is adequate and welcoming. After all, the creation of another person should not be taken lightly, and a hefty price drives home that fact." So in the end, it all boils down to money? "That, and prestige," Salwah adds lazily. "Don't get me wrong, the kittens born within the temple's walls are all loved. However, there's no denying that there are other reasons why some kittens are watched more closely than others. If word got out that, say, a certain nobleman's daughter by one of the sacred courtesans had climbed up the temple spire and fallen to her death... it would be even more of a terrible tragedy than it was already." It's cynical, that's what it is. "We aren't supposed to be of this world, that is true... but we nevertheless have to live in it. Politics infects everything the world over, [pc.name]." |"Our temple was the grand one in the capital, " Salwah begins. "The super-big grand marble affair that the sultana and her entourage go to for their devotions. As a result, we wanted for little, and our mothers would coordinate their days off in order to take the three of us down into the marketplace in the afternoons. It never changed all the while we were kittens: I would get a honeyed fig, Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] would get sweetened yoghurt and Calla would content herself with watching the merchants pass by on their way into the capital, carrying goods from Tronarii and beyond. "The spice merchants would be at work at the time of day — and so the plazas were always heavy with its scent. Trading in spice requires a permit notarised by both secular and religious authorities, and more than once our mothers were approached by merchants trying to get a foot into the door. They'd try to ply us with sweets and little trinkets, but earning the favor of a future Mallachite takes more than empty, self-serving gestures." [party.has cait |Cait giggles. "Don't be giving yourself airs, Sally. You were totally swooning over that little glass figurine until your mom told you to give it back." "It was very nice, you'll have to admit..." "You know the place where they make those things, Sally? It's called Tychris, and it's about a two-day ride from here. If you could get someone to take you there, you could get all the little glass knick-knacks you can buy." ] It sounds like a very idyllic childhood. "We were lucky. The capital was large enough to have some sense of adventure on its streets to sate Calla's nature, but we were fortunate to be separated from its seedier districts. That, and the sultana's administration takes good care of the spicetenders, lest their plates run dangerously empty. Even the commoners were reasonably well-off by their standards, and there weren't any problems so serious as to be insurmountable by another dusting of spice in the hookah or plate." |Given her upbringing in the temple, was her childhood very religious? [pc.bg acolyte |You've had some experience with a religious life if not necessarily upbringing yourself, and would like to compare notes. |You'll admit to being curious as to what growing up in a Mallachite temple means for the spiritual side of one's upbringing. ] "It's about what you might expect," Salwah replies. "We were obligated to join the prayers at dawn and dusk, and religious schooling was part of our education — both the Seven in general, and Mallach in particular. That aside, though... nothing major was forced on us. We'd be given the chance to participate in the festivities the temple would organise throughout the year — sans the more adult ones, of course — but it really wasn't much more than that as an obligation. That suited Calla just fine, for she never had much heart for that kind of thing. "Those who showed more of an interest in a religious future — like Caitriss and me — voluntarily attended more of the rites and services as was appropriate for our age, the number and scope of which expanded as we approached our majority and after we accepted future vocations within the temple." Any examples? "Not that I feel I'm at liberty to discuss, at least in my case. Maybe Caitriss will be comfortable speaking about hers — after all, her education involved fewer explicit temple mysteries than mine." ]
