|说实话，家里有点太拥挤了。我的母亲就像我一样，也是一个生了很多孩子的母亲，所以我也自然而然地有了很多兄弟姐妹，一共有七个；在我还是小猫的时候，我的母亲从来都没有不怀孕或者不哺乳的时候。在我十二三岁之后，事情的发展速度逐渐放缓了。直到一年后我即将接受入会仪式时，那位大祭司才最终撤销了她的“妓女烙印”——因为人们确认她年纪太大，已经无法生育后代了。当我离开的时候，她正在教那些年幼的学徒一些她的技能。 “她还和凯特、卡拉的妈妈是朋友，我们就是这么认识彼此的。凯特的妈妈需要有人帮忙照看她的孩子——巴纳福斯·泽特拉的宝贝孩子，小魔术师中最了不起的那一位[party.has cait | ——” 凯特咯咯笑了起来。 “——W |w ]她当时不在神殿里，正忙着她的工作，呃，上门服务。碰巧的是，一件事接着一件事，于是我们就走到了今天这一步。” [party.has cait |凯特那双蓝色的眼睛里闪烁着调皮的光芒。“我一点也不后悔！” “我也不会后悔！” 两个猫娘一起倒在床上，尾巴不停地甩来甩去，咯咯地笑个不停。你确信，这大概是某种你无缘知晓的内部笑话。 ] “倒不是我不爱我的兄弟姐妹，但凯特和卡拉是来自另一个社会阶层的人——至少是神殿内部算是社会阶层的那种东西。毫无疑问，她们的母亲教给她们的谈吐远超神殿所传授的基础——她们总有最有趣的话可说。没过多久，我就开始把她们当作姐姐，加进我原本就有的那些姐姐里……只不过她们要有趣得多。” |“卡拉是只精力极其旺盛的小猫，她非得把那股精力发泄掉不可，否则晚上就睡不着。只要给她看到什么足够高的东西，她就会试着往上爬，不管是树还是神殿的外墙。有一次她因为一路爬上了神殿的一座尖塔而惹了麻烦——直到她终于想起自己离地面有多高，然后就僵在那儿了。” [party.has cait |“我记得那件事，”凯特叹了口气说，“一整天都有人问我卡拉在哪儿、我最后一次见到她是什么时候，而我和他们一样毫无头绪。我们找遍了门厅、庭院、水池，甚至那些私人房间，直到有人想到该往上看。” ] 猫总会爬上那些它们后来下不来的东西。哎呀，这种事你以前可从没听说过。 萨尔瓦翻了个深绿色的白眼。“你尽管开玩笑，可那件事相当严重。她一被发现，接下来的麻烦就是怎么把她哄下来——这可不是件容易事，因为她手脚并用死死缠在塔尖上。最后，大祭司实在受够了，直接飘上去亲自把她掰开；卡拉被倒栽葱似的飘落到地面，一路尖叫着哭得眼泪直流。我觉得大祭司是故意的。” [party.has cait |“卡拉以前不怕什么，现在也依然不怕，”凯特补充道，“第一次看到她那个样子真让人大开眼界。发人深省！但回想起来，那整件事让我意识到，卡拉很勇敢但并不莽撞——毕竟，勇敢是战胜恐惧、在恐惧面前依然行动，而不是没有恐惧。这是我们都该记住的，尤其是现在。” ] 那么，后来呢？ “这么说吧，卡拉后来吃了教训，细节就免了，”萨尔瓦答道，尾巴来回摆动着。“那些事……很不愉快。凯特的妈妈也受了些牵连，她爸爸下次来看她的时候肯定也被告知了她的不端行为。我想他之后找她谈过，让她收敛了一些，不过……唉。她就是卡拉。” |“总的来说，我的童年还算不错。神殿的人对凯特和卡拉看管得更严——毕竟，她们是巴纳福斯·泽特拉的女儿，小魔术师中最了不起的那一位。他好像是苏丹娜的农业与香料大臣的第三个儿子之类的——地位高到人们会留意他和他女儿的程度。” 为什么？ “贾西拉有不少有钱有势的人都把自家的小猫送进神殿抚养，原因多种多样。有些是有钱却没什么魅力的男人。有些是不能生育自己的小猫，或者不愿让身体经受生育之苦的女人。还有些人想要一位出身于神殿主母的神圣继承人所带来的声望，也有人只是想要一两个备用继承人的保障；又或者只是想证明自己付得起那笔高昂的费用，让一位马拉克信徒来充当代理孕母——即便这个孩子是由像我这样的低级女祭司所生，那也远超一个平民一生所能指望挣到的钱。各种各样的理由。” “有些小猫出生后不久就被认领，去将来要代表的家族里长大。不过大多数最终都像凯特和卡拉一样——在神殿的高墙内由生母抚养到成年。这又有什么不好呢？她们接受教育，被生母疼爱，如果不喜欢神殿外等待她们的生活，也完全可以拒绝离开。这样传承了几代人之后，神职人员和贵族中有相当一部分人有亲属关系，有时还相当近，也就不足为奇了。” 听完这些，再加上萨尔瓦来的那天讲的那个关于凯特妈妈的故事，你开始把整幅图景拼起来了。没错，要是某位贵族的子嗣在神殿照看期间出了什么事，那确实会非常尴尬。 “鉴于费用高昂，这项服务能带来一大笔收入。一部分是付给母亲的辛劳——哈！——一部分是抚养小猫成年的开销，还有一部分是为了确保等孩子成年时等待他们的家庭足够体面、乐于接纳。毕竟，创造另一个生命不应被轻率对待，高昂的价格正能让人牢记这一点。” 所以说到底，这一切都归结为钱？ “还有声望，”萨尔瓦懒洋洋地补充道。“别误会，在神殿高墙内出生的小猫都受到疼爱。不过，不可否认，有些小猫受到更密切的关注确实另有原因。要是传出去说，比方说，哪位贵族老爷的女儿——由某位神圣女侍所生——爬上神殿尖塔摔死了……那就会比原本已经够糟的悲剧更加骇人。” 这很愤世嫉俗，就是这样。 “我们本不该属于这个世界，这话没错……可我们终究还是得活在其中。政治污染着世上的一切，[pc.name]。” |“我们那座神殿是首都里最宏伟的，”萨尔瓦开口道，就是苏丹娜和她的随从们前去礼拜的那座超大的宏伟大理石建筑。因此，我们什么都不缺，母亲们还会协调好各自的休息日，好在下午带我们三个去集市。我们还是小猫的那段日子里，这一点从未变过：我会得到一颗蜜饯无花果，凯特丽丝[silly |-学长 ]会得到加糖的酸奶，而卡拉则满足于看着商人们带着来自特洛纳里和更远地方的货物进城。 “那些香料商人在那个时辰正忙着干活——所以广场上总是弥漫着它的香气。做香料生意需要一份由世俗和宗教当局共同公证的许可证，不止一次有商人凑到我们母亲跟前，想挤进这道门。他们会拿糖果和小玩意儿来讨好我们，但要想赢得一位未来的马拉克信徒的青睐，光靠空洞自私的举动是不够的。” [party.has cait |凯特咯咯笑了起来。“别摆架子了，莎莉。你当时对那个小玻璃雕像可是迷得神魂颠倒，直到你妈妈让你把它还回去。” “那个是很不错，你得承认……” “你知道他们做那些东西的地方在哪儿吗，莎莉？那地方叫提克里斯，离这儿大约两天的路程。要是你能找人带你去，就能买下所有你能买的小玻璃玩意儿。” ] 听起来是一段非常恬静的童年。 “我们很幸运。首都足够大，街面上总有些冒险气息能满足卡拉的天性，而我们也很幸运，和那些更下等的城区隔了开来。还有，苏丹娜的政府把香料侍者照顾得很好，免得他们的盘子空得危险。按他们自己的标准，就连平民也过得相当不错，而且没什么严重到不能在烟壶或餐盘里再撒一把香料就解决的问题。” |既然她是在神殿里长大的，那她的童年宗教色彩很浓吗？ [pc.bg acolyte |你自己就算没有在宗教环境中长大，也有过一些宗教生活的经历，很想和对方交流一下心得。 |你承认自己很好奇，在马拉克信徒的神殿里长大，对一个人精神层面的教养意味着什么。 ] “差不多就是你预想的那样，”萨尔瓦答道。“我们必须参加黎明和黄昏的祈祷，宗教课程也是我们教育的一部分——既包括七神的一般教义，也包括马拉克的专门教义。不过除此之外……并没有什么东西是强加给我们的。我们有机会参加神殿全年组织的各种庆典——当然，那些更成人的除外——但作为一种义务，真的也就仅此而已。这对卡拉来说再合适不过，因为她对这类事从来就不太热心。” “那些对宗教前途表现出更多兴趣的人——比如凯特丽丝和我——会按我们年龄相宜的程度自愿参加更多的仪式和礼拜，随着我们临近成年、并在我们接受神殿内未来的圣职之后，这些仪式的数量和范围也随之扩大。” 有什么例子吗？ “至少就我而言，我觉得自己不便谈论这些。也许凯特丽丝愿意聊聊她的——毕竟，她所受的教育中涉及的神殿秘仪比我的要少。” ]
rows.raw: ' [rand |"A little crowded, if I'll be honest. Mother was a garden of children like I am, so I naturally had plenty of brothers and sisters, seven of them in total; I don't have a single memory from when I was a kitten where she wasn't either pregnant or breastfeeding. After I turned twelve or thirteen, things began to slow down, and it was a year before I was set to be initiated that the grand cleric finally removed her Brand of the Harlot, for she was confirmed to be too old to be able to bear kittens. When I left, she was teaching the younger acolytes something of her skills. "She was also friends with Cait and Calla's mom, which is how we got to know each other. Cait's mom needed someone to watch over her kittens, the precious children of BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, THE MOST MAJOR OF THE MINOR PRESTIDIGITATORS [party.has cait | — " Cait giggles. " — W |w ]hile she was out of the temple about her work doing, uh, house calls. As luck would have it, one thing led to another, and so here we are today." [party.has cait |Cait's blue eyes glint with mischief. "I regret nothing!" "Neither do I!" The two catgirls collapse against each other on the bed, tails lashing back and forth as they giggle away. This is probably some kind of in-joke you're not privy to, you're sure. ] "Not that I didn't love my siblings, but Cait and Calla were people from a different social class — or at least, what passed for social classes within the temple. No doubt their mom schooled them in conversation beyond what the temple taught as basics — they always had the funniest things to say. It wasn't long before I started seeing them as big sisters to add to those I already had... only far more interesting." |"Calla was a very energetic kitten, and she absolutely had to work that energy off or else she wouldn't be able to fall asleep at night. Show her anything tall enough, and she'd attempt to climb it, be it a tree or the temple's exterior. There was that time when she got into trouble for climbing all the way up one of the temple's spires before she finally remembered just how far she was above the ground and froze up." [party.has cait |"I remember that," Cait says with a sigh. "People were asking me where Calla was all day and where I'd seen her last, and I had no more idea than they did. We searched the vestibule, the courtyard, the pools, even the private rooms until someone thought to look up." ] Cats climbing up things they later can't get down from. Why, you've never heard of such things before. Salwah rolls her deep emerald eyes. "You may jest, but it was quite the serious thing. Once she was discovered, there was the problem of coaxing her down — not an easy task, given then she'd wrapped her arms and legs about the peak in a death grip. Eventually, the grand cleric got sick of it all and levitated all the way up there to personally pry her free; Calla was screaming and crying her eyes out all the way down as she got floated tumbling head-over-heels to the ground. I think the grand cleric did that on purpose." [party.has cait |"Calla wasn't, and still isn't, afraid of very much," Cait adds. "Seeing her like that for the first time was eye-opening. Sobering stuff! But looking back on it, that whole incident made me realize that Calla's brave but not foolhardy — after all, being brave is defeating fear and acting in spite of it, not its absence. That's something we can all remember, especially now." ] So, what happened after? "Let's just say that Calla got it, and spare the details," Salwah replies, swishing her tail back and forth. "They're... unpleasant. Cait's mom also got a bit of blowback and her dad was certainly informed of her misbehavior the next time he visited. I think he had a talk with her after that, which settled her down some, but... well. She was Calla." |"It was a decent childhood, all in all. The temple staff kept a tighter leash on Cait and Calla — after all, they were the daughters of BARNAPHOUS ZETHRA, THE MOST MAJOR OF THE MINOR PRESTIDIGITATORS. He's like, the third son of the Sultana's minister of agriculture and spice or something — high enough that people would take notice of him and his daughters." Why so? "A good number of Jassira's wealthy and powerful have their kittens raised in the temple for numerous reasons. Some are men who have an abundance of money, but lack charisma. Others are women who cannot bear kittens of their own, or would rather not put their bodies through the rigors of childbirth. Yet others want the prestige of having a holy heir descended from one of the temple matrons, while some just want the surety of a spare heir or two; or just to prove that they can pay the exorbitant fee to have a Mallachite play surrogate — even one born of a junior priestess like me is more than what a commoner would ever hope to earn in their lifetime. All sorts of reasons. "Some kittens are claimed shortly after birth, to grow up in the households they will eventually represent. Most, though, end up like Cait and Calla — raised within the temple's walls by their birth mothers until they come of age. And why not? They receive an education, are loved by their birth mothers, and they are free to say no to leaving if they aren't enamored of the life that awaits them outside the temple. After generations of this, it's not surprising that a good proportion of the clergy and nobility are related, sometimes quite closely." After hearing all this in addition to that story about Cait's mom that day Salwah arrived, you're beginning to piece together the picture here. Yes, it would be really awkward if something happened to a noble's get while under the care of the temple. "Given the steep cost, a great deal of income springs from that particular service. Partly for the labor — ha! — of the mother, for the cost of raising a kitten to adulthood, and to ensure the household waiting for the child upon their majority is adequate and welcoming. After all, the creation of another person should not be taken lightly, and a hefty price drives home that fact." So in the end, it all boils down to money? "That, and prestige," Salwah adds lazily. "Don't get me wrong, the kittens born within the temple's walls are all loved. However, there's no denying that there are other reasons why some kittens are watched more closely than others. If word got out that, say, a certain nobleman's daughter by one of the sacred courtesans had climbed up the temple spire and fallen to her death... it would be even more of a terrible tragedy than it was already." It's cynical, that's what it is. "We aren't supposed to be of this world, that is true... but we nevertheless have to live in it. Politics infects everything the world over, [pc.name]." |"Our temple was the grand one in the capital, " Salwah begins. "The super-big grand marble affair that the sultana and her entourage go to for their devotions. As a result, we wanted for little, and our mothers would coordinate their days off in order to take the three of us down into the marketplace in the afternoons. It never changed all the while we were kittens: I would get a honeyed fig, Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] would get sweetened yoghurt and Calla would content herself with watching the merchants pass by on their way into the capital, carrying goods from Tronarii and beyond. "The spice merchants would be at work at the time of day — and so the plazas were always heavy with its scent. Trading in spice requires a permit notarised by both secular and religious authorities, and more than once our mothers were approached by merchants trying to get a foot into the door. They'd try to ply us with sweets and little trinkets, but earning the favor of a future Mallachite takes more than empty, self-serving gestures." [party.has cait |Cait giggles. "Don't be giving yourself airs, Sally. You were totally swooning over that little glass figurine until your mom told you to give it back." "It was very nice, you'll have to admit..." "You know the place where they make those things, Sally? It's called Tychris, and it's about a two-day ride from here. If you could get someone to take you there, you could get all the little glass knick-knacks you can buy." ] It sounds like a very idyllic childhood. "We were lucky. The capital was large enough to have some sense of adventure on its streets to sate Calla's nature, but we were fortunate to be separated from its seedier districts. That, and the sultana's administration takes good care of the spicetenders, lest their plates run dangerously empty. Even the commoners were reasonably well-off by their standards, and there weren't any problems so serious as to be insurmountable by another dusting of spice in the hookah or plate." |Given her upbringing in the temple, was her childhood very religious? [pc.bg acolyte |You've had some experience with a religious life if not necessarily upbringing yourself, and would like to compare notes. |You'll admit to being curious as to what growing up in a Mallachite temple means for the spiritual side of one's upbringing. ] "It's about what you might expect," Salwah replies. "We were obligated to join the prayers at dawn and dusk, and religious schooling was part of our education — both the Seven in general, and Mallach in particular. That aside, though... nothing major was forced on us. We'd be given the chance to participate in the festivities the temple would organise throughout the year — sans the more adult ones, of course — but it really wasn't much more than that as an obligation. That suited Calla just fine, for she never had much heart for that kind of thing. "Those who showed more of an interest in a religious future — like Caitriss and me — voluntarily attended more of the rites and services as was appropriate for our age, the number and scope of which expanded as we approached our majority and after we accepted future vocations within the temple." Any examples? "Not that I feel I'm at liberty to discuss, at least in my case. Maybe Caitriss will be comfortable speaking about hers — after all, her education involved fewer explicit temple mysteries than mine." ] '

rows.translation: 童年

rows.original: [rand |"Leorah, huh... she spoke of a sultana who kept on changing the laws day by day to the point where no one knew what was in effect any more? Yeah, that actually happened. It was when Cait, Calla and I were very young... too young to remember very much of it, really. Still, it's not that long ago; people who lived under the rule of the mad sultana are still walking around, and not even old to boot. Thank the gods it was the shortest reign ever — it's a whole lot of recent history, but she was forced to abdicate after a whole six or seven years of rule in favor of her sister. "Usually when such silliness happens the nobles, temple and ministries all simply ignore the inane demands of the crown and go about business as usual, but that one was a bit too insistent on personally seeing her edicts carried out. Most of what I know comes from tales my mom and Cait's mom would tell us, and they always liked to say that in spite of all her nonsense, the mad sultana did manage to do one thing no ruler before her had ever managed to: unite all the political players in Jassira against her. "And that answers the question of what happens when you get a bad monarch. Comparatively bloodless and efficient when you see the other historical alternatives, really." |"Despite what you see that's presented to the rest of the world, there really isn't that much animosity between Jassira and Tronarii. Maybe it was actually serious in the past, but these days it's more a friendly religious rivalry at its most heated. You live long enough next to someone else without one side killing the other, you learn to go along to get along, if nothing else. "Personally speaking, there're a bunch of backroom negotiations and agreements between both secular and religious authorities that keep the peace despite the public show of animosity. I've never actually been to one — of course I wouldn't — but you'd hear of them within the temple's walls from time to time. It lets people on both sides get their rocks on about each other for a bit of good fun while preventing things from actually escalating into anything serious, or at least that's how it was explained to me." |"There's a lot of empty space in Jassira, mostly because of how inhospitable the interior is. Most of the major settlements are along the coast, where rain can be expected on a reasonable basis, or around major water sources. Sometimes, you'll get a village or two around an oasis or underground stream, but few people want to live in the middle of nowhere without a very good reason." With the way she says it, you'd imagine that just having water around would be sufficient cause for people to flock to a place. "It's necessary, but insufficient in and of itself. Generally you need some kind of compelling cause — a holy site, a place where trade routes cross, minerals, caves capable of growing spice, that sort of thing. If you're going to live out amongst the dunes and wake up every morning with sand in your everything, it had better be worth it, just saying." |Are there only catfolk in Jassira? "Only? No, there are humans and manticores and dune wyverns and a few dust elves, too, but there aren't enough numbers of other peoples to actually make a splash save for the anubians who form most of the spicetenders; they own almost all the caves where the herb in question is grown. That gives them a great deal of power despite their comparatively low numbers; the spice must flow, after all. "There's always been some bleed-in both ways to and from Tronarii — mostly outwards from us than the other way around, to be honest. There're probably proportionally more Tronarian catfolk than there are of humans and elves in Jassira. They're not mistreated or anything, but start to feel frisky and well, Tronarii's right across the border, which is in all likelihood where they came from in the first place." Oh. Salwah yawns lazily. "What 'oh'? The sultanate is set up by catfolk, for catfolk first and foremost. That's the understanding, and it's the other way around in Tronarii and their merchant houses. Surprisingly hard for catfolk in Tronarii to get their hands on any bronze, fancy that. We catfolk have our own thing running, and I'm not going to be guilted on it. If anything, after coming here and hearing about how the lupines lost out on much of their ancestral lands it just cements my thoughts on the matter." Harsh. "Shouldn't ask questions you might not like the answers to, then. Anything else?" |"Theoretically, the sultanate is a more-or-less secular government. Practically speaking, as with any group large and important enough anywhere, the temple has considerable political influence. Add to that generations of the rich and powerful renting the wombs of Jassiran Mallachites for the production of holy heirs and more, and the two are intermeshed so tightly that they may as well be one and the same. Ambitionless third sons and daughters of ministers are encouraged to join the temple so they give up their claim to title and lands, some of them end up fucking kittens into or having kittens fucked into them by the highborn, and the cycle repeats itself. I suppose it could be better, but it's worked for a long time now and people are generally content and stable, so it can't be all bad." That's... one way to put it. "I'm sure the way things work locally must seem strange to other people, too. Folk obeying a leader who rarely shows her face in public, commands a vast empire through proxy amirs through the fortunes her ancestors have invested across the Marches? Yes, there is the saying that a good part of rulership is staying out of the way and letting people do their jobs in peace, but even so, the [var0|lack of a single ruler in these parts is quite strange to me|local baroness is amazingly odd for a ruler from a foreigner's perspective]. Despite all this, no one questions the way things are because it works for you." ]
rows.translation: [rand |“莱奥拉，嗯……她提到过一位苏丹娜，她一天天不停地更改法律，到最后谁也不知道到底哪条还有效了？没错，这种事确实发生过。那是在凯特、卡拉和我都还很小的时候……小得实在记不清多少细节。不过，那也不算太久远；在那个疯狂苏丹娜治下生活过的人如今还在四处走动，年纪也都还不算大。谢天谢地，那是史上最短的一次统治——虽说这整段都算是近代史，但她在统治了整整六七年之后，还是被迫退位，把王位让给了她的妹妹。” “这种事通常发生的时候，贵族、寺庙和各部衙门都干脆无视王室那些荒唐的要求，照常办自己的事；可那一位却有点太较真了，非要亲自盯着自己的法令被落实不可。我所知道的大半都来自我妈妈和凯特的妈妈讲给我们听的故事，她们总爱说，尽管那个疯狂苏丹娜满口胡言，但她确实做到了一件在她之前任何统治者都没能做到的事：让贾西拉所有的政治势力联合起来反对她。” “而那个恰好回答了当你摊上一位糟糕的君主时会发生什么这个问题。跟历史上其他那些替代方案比起来，这确实相对不那么血腥，也高效得多。” |“不管向外界展示的是什么样，贾西拉和特洛纳里之间的敌意其实并没有那么深。也许过去确实很严重，但如今这最多只是一种友好宗教竞争最激烈的形态。你在别人旁边住得够久，双方都没把对方杀掉，那你至少会学会随遇而安。” “就我个人来说，尽管公开场合表现得敌意十足，世俗当局和宗教权威之间其实有一堆幕后谈判和协议在维持着和平。我其实从没参加过——当然不会去——但你在寺庙的高墙内偶尔会听人提起。它能让双方的人拿对方寻点乐子、发发牢骚，同时又防止事情真的升级成什么严重的冲突，至少别人是这么跟我解释的。” |“贾西拉有大片大片的空旷地带，主要是因为内陆太不适宜居住。大多数主要聚居地都沿海岸分布，那里降雨还算有规律，或者围绕着主要水源。有时候你会在绿洲或地下河附近看到一两个村庄，但没什么人愿意无缘无故地住在荒无人烟的地方。” 从她说话的方式来看，你会觉得只要有水存在，就足以吸引人们前往那个地方居住了。 “水是必要的，但仅凭它本身还不够。一般来说，你需要某种有说服力的理由——一处圣地、贸易路线交汇的地方、矿产、能种植香料的洞穴，诸如此类。如果你要住在沙丘之间，每天早上醒来浑身都是沙子，那最好还是值得的，我只是说说。” |贾西拉地区只有猫族吗？ “只有猫族？不，那里也有人类、蝎狮、沙丘翼龙，还有少数尘精灵，但其他族群的人数都不足以真正掀起什么波澜——除了阿努比亚人，他们构成了大部分的香料种植者；几乎所有种植这种草药的洞穴都归他们所有。尽管他们人数相对较少，这却赋予了他们巨大的权力；毕竟，香料必须不断流动。” “特洛纳里和外界的双向流入一直都有——说实话，大多是从我们这边往外流，而不是反过来。按比例算，特洛纳里的猫族大概比贾西拉的人类和精灵还多。他们并没有受到什么苛待，但一旦开始发骚，嗯，特洛纳里就在边境对面，而他们最初很可能就是从那儿来的。” 哦。 萨尔瓦懒洋洋地打了个哈欠。“什么‘哦’？这个苏丹国就是由猫族建立的，为了猫族，而且猫族优先。这是大家都明白的事，而在特洛纳里和他们的商行里，情况正好相反。奇怪的是，特洛纳里的猫族竟然很难弄到任何青铜，真是想不到。我们猫族有自己的那一套在运转，我不会为此感到愧疚。要说有什么的话，来到这里，听说狼族失去了他们大部分祖传土地之后，这反而更加坚定了我在这件事上的想法。” 太残酷了。 “那就别问那些你可能不爱听答案的问题。还有别的吗？” |“理论上，这个苏丹国大致算是一个世俗政府。但实际来说，就像任何地方任何足够庞大、足够重要的团体一样，寺庙拥有相当大的政治影响力。再加上历代权贵都会租借贾西兰的马拉克信徒的子宫来生育神圣的后嗣等等，两者已经紧密交织在一起，几乎可以说就是同一回事了。大臣们那些没有继承希望的三子、三女被鼓励加入寺庙，好让他们放弃对头衔和土地的继承权，其中有些人最终把小猫崽肏进了别人肚子里，或者被贵族把小猫崽肏进自己肚子里，而这个循环就这样不断重复。我想本可以做得更好，但它已经这样运行了很久，人们总体上满足而稳定，所以也不至于太糟。” 这……倒也不失为一种说法。 “我敢肯定，你们这里的行事方式在其他人看来也一定很奇怪。民众居然服从一位很少公开露面、凭借祖先在边境地区投下的财富、通过代理埃米尔统治一个庞大帝国的领袖？没错，是有这么一句话：统治的一大部分就是别挡道，让人们安安静静地做自己的事，但即便如此，[var0|这一带没有一位唯一的统治者，这在我看来相当奇怪|从外国人的角度来看，这位当地的男爵夫人作为统治者实在古怪得很]。尽管如此，没有人质疑现状，因为这套做法对你们行得通。” ]
rows.raw: " [rand |"Leorah, huh... she spoke of a sultana who kept on changing the laws day by day to the point where no one knew what was in effect any more? Yeah, that actually happened. It was when Cait, Calla and I were very young... too young to remember very much of it, really. Still, it's not that long ago; people who lived under the rule of the mad sultana are still walking around, and not even old to boot. Thank the gods it was the shortest reign ever — it's a whole lot of recent history, but she was forced to abdicate after a whole six or seven years of rule in favor of her sister. "Usually when such silliness happens the nobles, temple and ministries all simply ignore the inane demands of the crown and go about business as usual, but that one was a bit too insistent on personally seeing her edicts carried out. Most of what I know comes from tales my mom and Cait's mom would tell us, and they always liked to say that in spite of all her nonsense, the mad sultana did manage to do one thing no ruler before her had ever managed to: unite all the political players in Jassira against her. "And that answers the question of what happens when you get a bad monarch. Comparatively bloodless and efficient when you see the other historical alternatives, really." |"Despite what you see that's presented to the rest of the world, there really isn't that much animosity between Jassira and Tronarii. Maybe it was actually serious in the past, but these days it's more a friendly religious rivalry at its most heated. You live long enough next to someone else without one side killing the other, you learn to go along to get along, if nothing else. "Personally speaking, there're a bunch of backroom negotiations and agreements between both secular and religious authorities that keep the peace despite the public show of animosity. I've never actually been to one — of course I wouldn't — but you'd hear of them within the temple's walls from time to time. It lets people on both sides get their rocks on about each other for a bit of good fun while preventing things from actually escalating into anything serious, or at least that's how it was explained to me." |"There's a lot of empty space in Jassira, mostly because of how inhospitable the interior is. Most of the major settlements are along the coast, where rain can be expected on a reasonable basis, or around major water sources. Sometimes, you'll get a village or two around an oasis or underground stream, but few people want to live in the middle of nowhere without a very good reason." With the way she says it, you'd imagine that just having water around would be sufficient cause for people to flock to a place. "It's necessary, but insufficient in and of itself. Generally you need some kind of compelling cause — a holy site, a place where trade routes cross, minerals, caves capable of growing spice, that sort of thing. If you're going to live out amongst the dunes and wake up every morning with sand in your everything, it had better be worth it, just saying." |Are there only catfolk in Jassira? "Only? No, there are humans and manticores and dune wyverns and a few dust elves, too, but there aren't enough numbers of other peoples to actually make a splash save for the anubians who form most of the spicetenders; they own almost all the caves where the herb in question is grown. That gives them a great deal of power despite their comparatively low numbers; the spice must flow, after all. "There's always been some bleed-in both ways to and from Tronarii — mostly outwards from us than the other way around, to be honest. There're probably proportionally more Tronarian catfolk than there are of humans and elves in Jassira. They're not mistreated or anything, but start to feel frisky and well, Tronarii's right across the border, which is in all likelihood where they came from in the first place." Oh. Salwah yawns lazily. "What 'oh'? The sultanate is set up by catfolk, for catfolk first and foremost. That's the understanding, and it's the other way around in Tronarii and their merchant houses. Surprisingly hard for catfolk in Tronarii to get their hands on any bronze, fancy that. We catfolk have our own thing running, and I'm not going to be guilted on it. If anything, after coming here and hearing about how the lupines lost out on much of their ancestral lands it just cements my thoughts on the matter." Harsh. "Shouldn't ask questions you might not like the answers to, then. Anything else?" |"Theoretically, the sultanate is a more-or-less secular government. Practically speaking, as with any group large and important enough anywhere, the temple has considerable political influence. Add to that generations of the rich and powerful renting the wombs of Jassiran Mallachites for the production of holy heirs and more, and the two are intermeshed so tightly that they may as well be one and the same. Ambitionless third sons and daughters of ministers are encouraged to join the temple so they give up their claim to title and lands, some of them end up fucking kittens into or having kittens fucked into them by the highborn, and the cycle repeats itself. I suppose it could be better, but it's worked for a long time now and people are generally content and stable, so it can't be all bad." That's... one way to put it. "I'm sure the way things work locally must seem strange to other people, too. Folk obeying a leader who rarely shows her face in public, commands a vast empire through proxy amirs through the fortunes her ancestors have invested across the Marches? Yes, there is the saying that a good part of rulership is staying out of the way and letting people do their jobs in peace, but even so, the [var0|lack of a single ruler in these parts is quite strange to me|local baroness is amazingly odd for a ruler from a foreigner's perspective]. Despite all this, no one questions the way things are because it works for you." ] "

rows.translation: 贾西拉

rows.original: [rand |"In the smaller villages and towns, the temple plays a pretty big role in peoples' lives. It may be the only place where you can get a bath, free or not, and the only safe haven for travelers during the night. Sleeping in the temple courtyard with other people on the road may be harsh, but it's better than chancing it on the streets or trying to convince a stranger to rent you a room for the night. There's no ritual hospitality in Jassira! It's not surprising that Mallachite temples form the heart of many smaller towns, rather than the local ruler's residence or marketplace — if there's one to begin with." [party.has cait |"Even if you somehow happen to pay homage to another of the Seven, it's hard not to wind up at the temple sooner or later," Cait adds. "It's just that Jassiran Mallachites provide so many services that people gather around where they happen to be, and one thing leads to another." ] You see. "It's a joke that sometimes even the most prudish of people will nevertheless end up at the temple, which is perfectly fine. Passion takes many forms, and not all express themselves in the ways we're most acquainted with." |"Worship of the others of the Seven — even Tira — isn't banned or anything in Jassira; I've personally visited a couple of pantheons like the one Brother Sanders has going in this town. They're still recognised; it's just that one has primacy above the others in that part of the world, that's all. You might raise an eyebrow or two, but that's about it. The gods are mostly — mostly on cordial terms with each other, after all." |"I'm sure Cait has told you about the monthly orgies under the full moon, right? Those are the events that get talked about outside of Jassira, but pretty much every temple, major or minor, helps with organising the local festivals. Everything from simple dances to your standard harvest festival or a huge spice party for the new year. Heh, even though it's not Mallach's domain, sometimes if there hasn't been rain for a while in the coastal areas they'll actually get people together and pray for at least a quick shower." Huh. For a priestess of the patron god of art, music and love she's spending a lot of time trying to convince you he and his don't do any of those things. "Oh, it's not that we don't do them, it's that we do other things in addition to them. In the capital's palace square, there's a twice-weekly public recital or performance put on by the grand temple, for example. Not to mention the yearly art exhibition. But what we do has to be tailored to the lives of the people around us. Passion comes in many forms, after all." |"In villages so small that the closest official of the sultanate is two days' travel away, the temples tend to handle most of the civic work, even if it's but a mere pair or even a lone priest or priestess tending to that small community. Births and deaths, deeds of property ownership, marriage ceremonies, that sort of thing. Where there aren't any officials to do it, tithes and taxes essentially become one and the same because they're collected by the temple and then whatever surplus is passed on up to the secular authorities, if there's any to be had from the dirt-poor places. Most of those villages pay their tithes in produce rather than money." [party.has cait |Cait chuckles. "Couple of generations back, there was a spate of rich people suddenly finding the need to build country estates and live there because then they could avoid paying both taxes and tithes. Even though the latter was at a higher rate than they would be for city folk, it was still less than what they'd have otherwise paid. You can imagine the sultan at the time put a quick stop to that nonsense." ] An important pillar of the community, then. Salwah nods. "The civic work the temple does in the rural areas can't be understated, [pc.name]. If nothing else, it's better than relying on a bunch of old tabbies to remember who owns what and where." ]
rows.translation: [rand |在那些较小的村庄和城镇里，寺庙在人们的生活当中扮演着非常重要的角色。它可能是唯一一个可以免费洗澡的地方，也是夜间旅行者们唯一的安全庇护所。虽然在寺庙的院子里和其他路人在一起睡觉可能会有些不便，但总比在街上露宿或者试图说服陌生人借你一个房间过夜要好得多。在贾西拉，人们并没有那种繁琐的待客仪式！因此，马拉克信徒神庙成为许多小城镇的中心也就不足为奇了——毕竟，这些地方往往没有地方统治者的居所或市场场所。 [party.has cait |即使你偶然向七大势力中的另一个表示敬意，最终也很难不前往那座寺庙，”凯特补充道。“只是因为贾西兰·马拉基特提供了太多便利服务，人们自然而然地会聚集在他们的势力范围附近，于是一件事就会引出另一件事。 ] 你明白的。 “有时候，即使是最保守的人最终也会走进寺庙，这其实也没什么不妥。激情有多种表现形式，并不是所有的激情都会以我们最熟悉的方式展现出来。 |在贾西拉，人们对其他七神——甚至提拉——的崇拜并没有被禁止或受到任何限制。我个人就参观过像桑德斯修士在这个镇子上建立的那种七神。这些神明仍然被人们所认可；只不过在那个地区，有一位神明被赋予了至高无上的地位，仅此而已。你可能会对此感到有些惊讶，但也就仅此而已。大多数情况下，人们主要是毕竟，他们之间的关系还是非常友好的。 |我敢肯定，凯特已经告诉过你关于满月时举行的那些每月一次的庆典活动了吧？这些活动在贾西拉之外也广为流传，实际上，几乎所有的寺庙，无论规模大小，都会参与组织这些当地的节日活动。从简单的舞蹈表演，到传统的收获节庆典，再到新年期间举办的盛大香料派对，应有尽有。呵呵，虽然这些活动并不属于马拉克的职责范围，但有时候，如果沿海地区连续一段时间没有下雨，人们还是会聚在一起，祈祷至少能下场急雨。哈，对于一位负责侍奉艺术、音乐与爱情之神的祭司来说，她却花了大量时间试图说服你，说她和她的神并不从事那些事情。” “哦，并不是说我们不从事那些事情，而是说我们在做那些事情的同时，还会做其他的事情。例如，在首都的宫殿广场上，那座宏伟的寺庙会每两周举办一次公开演奏会或表演活动。更不用说每年举办的艺术展览了。但我们所做的事情，必须紧密结合我们周围人们的生活实际来进行。毕竟，激情有多种表现形式。 |在那些规模如此之小的村庄里，距离苏丹政权最近的官员也需要两天的时间才能到达。因此，这些村庄的宗教寺庙往往承担了大部分民政事务的管理工作——即便只有一名神父或女祭司在照顾这个小小的社区。出生与死亡、财产所有权的变更、婚礼仪式等等。在那些没有官员负责办理这些事务的地方，什一税和各种税款实际上就变成了同一回事——因为这些税款都是由寺庙来征收的，而任何剩余的部分才会被上缴给世俗政权，前提是这些偏远贫困地区真的能缴纳出一些税款来。那些村庄中的大多数都是用农产品来缴纳什一税，而不是金钱。 [party.has cait |凯特轻笑了一声：“几代人之前，有一段时间，很多富人突然觉得有必要在乡下建造庄园并住在那里，因为这样就可以逃避缴纳各种税款和什一税。虽然什一税的税率比城市居民要高一些，但仍然比他们原本需要支付的税款要低。你可以想象，当时的苏丹很快就制止了这种荒谬的行为。 ] 那么，这确实是这个社区的重要支柱。 萨尔瓦点了点头，说道：“寺庙在农村地区所开展的各项公益活动，其意义实在不容忽视。[pc.name]至少，这总比依赖一群老家伙来记住谁拥有什么、东西放在哪里要好得多。 ]

rows.original: Salwah grins lazily at the suggestion, smacking her own ample butt with her tail. "Well... I was about to light up a round for myself. You need enough to get a good density of smoke, but that usually means it's too much for a single person, so I can't justify it to myself while alone. But with [party.has cait |Caitriss and you |you ] here, I guess I have an excuse, don't I?" Well, you're glad that she's going to be so generous. "Nonsense. [party.has cait |Caitriss[silly |-Senpai's |' ] here, you're here, and three is a party. The little bit of extra spice is worth it just to have the pleasure of your company." Cait laughs and pats her junior on the head, right between the ears. "You're laying it on thickly today, Sally. I'm not a supplicant that you need to turn on the soothing platitudes towards me... or am I?" |Don't put yourself down like that, [pc.name] — it's just a few grains more for the pleasure of your company. Surely you feel that your presence is worth more than that, right?" Ahaha, when she puts it that way... ] "Now, if you'll give me a moment, I'll get this all together." It's an experience watching Salwah get everything all set up — after setting the hookah down on the bearskin rug, she opens a small hatch in the hookah's upper bowl and draws out a thin metal plate. It might have once been copper or bronze, but now is stained with various shades of red and brown; the purple-haired harlot sets this on the table and gets out a padded case, from which she draws out [party.has cait |three |two ] flexible tubes with metal mouthpieces. "Don't worry about them being clean, the mouthpieces have to be boiled in water before I put them away," she quips. "Now to tend to the spice plate. Could you fill the water bowl while I get that done? There's a jug by the bedside; fill up the bottom bulb to the mark on the glass." As you hurry to comply, Salwah gets out a glass shaker of spice from her things and unscrews the cap. The comfy choco cat gives the lid a deep sniff, sighing huskily and longingly at the scent of the heavy reddish-brown powder. A woozy smile still on her face, she thumps the shaker and sends an even dusting of spice powder atop the metal plate. "Ah, smells good," Sally says with a chuckle as she slides the spice plate back into the hookah and slams the hatch shut. "The spice must flow, and it sure flows well — nothing worse in the world than caked spice powder. How's the water looking?" You're just about done — the floral pattern on the stained glass makes things a little hard to see. After making sure everything's in order, Salwah dumps a few crumbs of charcoal into the upper bowl beneath the spice plate and [party.has cait |gives Cait a smile. "Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ], would you do the honors?" Grinning from ear to ear, Cait slinks down from the bed to take up position on the rug, selecting a mouthpiece for herself. "Gladly. It's been a while since I did this, and even longer since we did this together, Sally." "I'll leave a space open for Calla." Cait pauses, then hangs her head as her smile turns rueful. "Ah, right. Well, let's get this started." Your pink kitten mumbles a chant under her breath, and the fine charcoal suddenly bursts into gentle flame |sets them alight with a snap of her fingers ]. Before long, the room fills with a heavy, calming scent, sweet and spicy at the same time. You can't help but take great big mouthfuls of the stuff, and a pleasant albeit faint buzz starts up in the back of your head, making your muscles relax. "Come on, [pc.name]. Pick whichever one you'd like — I'll have what's remaining." The soft bubbling of red spice smoke through cooling water is something to behold. Even as you stare at it through the glass, mesmerised, Salwah opens a decanter of white wine and pours a small glass each for [party.has cait |all |the both ] of you, dusting the surface with a sprinkling of spice. She hands one to you[party.has cait |, one to Cait, and keeps the last for herself | and keeps the other for herself ], settling beside you on the rug. "I've tried several local wines Garth has, and this one's best with the smoke. Inhale first, then take a sip." [party.has cait |You chance a glance at Cait, who's already huffing away at the mouthpiece. Drawing away, your pink kitten exhales, sweet spicy scents pouring from her lips, and a dreamy smile spreads across her face. Her ears fold forward and to the sides, and her tail swishes lazily atop the bearskin rug. "Mallach's balls," she says with a sigh. "I needed this." Salwah grins and gives her senior a kiss on the cheek. "I brought the good stuff from home. Enjoy it while it lasts and all... there can be no love without pain." "No meeting without parting." "No joy that doesn't fade." Closing her eyes, Cait throws her head back and raises the mouthpiece to her lips for another deep draw of the spice smoke. Salwah's smile turns a little sad, and she gives her senior's brow a gentle brush with her fingertips. ] Well, nothing for it. You raise your own metal mouthpiece, steady yourself, and inhale. The heavy smoke first invades your mouth, leaving your tongue tingling, then rushes down your throat and into your lungs. For a moment, there's the instinct to cough and sputter, but that soon passes as your muscles relax and nothing seems to matter very much anymore. Sure, you feel calm and carefree, but it doesn't come with the dulled senses characteristic of winterstem use; instead, everything seems so much more bright and clear; you can practically envision your thoughts speeding through your mind in that one moment — and then you pull away from the mouthpiece and exhale. ...Wow. And this is the normal stuff — wonder what the concentrated, narcotic spice Jassiran Mallachites use when they want to open their minds to Mallach feels like... "Feels good, doesn't it?" Salwah purrs from beside you. Spice-scented smoke rises from her nostrils as she flashes you a grin, then takes a sip of the spiked wine. "Being able to see, think, hear and feel in so much more detail. It — aaaah." That has to be the most contentment and pleasure you've ever heard condensed into a single sigh. Eyes half-lidded, Salwah curls up on her belly atop the rug, dark emerald eyes fixed on the wineglass before her. Looks like the spice's just shorted out her brain.[party.has cait | Not that Cait's much better — as you watch, your pink kitten downs all her spiced wine in a single gulp and flops over onto her back, eyes staring up at the ceiling as she huffs steadily from the hookah's mouthpiece. ] Next round, then. You take a sip of the spiced wine, letting its bittersweet taste wash over your tongue and mix with the smoke, then raise the mouthpiece and take another drag. This time the smoke is smooth and subtle despite its heaviness, your relaxed body barely putting up any kind of fight as it slips down your throat and settles heavily in your lungs. Oh shit, oh shit, everything's starting to feel really gooood and you can't be bothered to care about much any more... there's still a half-glass of spice-sprinkled wine left in your glass, and you give that a hefty gulp before settling back against the foot of the bed to enjoy the scent of spice. The explosion of intense flavor on your tongue sears your mouth as the divine liquid runs down your throat, and your insides tie themselves in knots — in a good way — as your belly heats up in earnest.[party.has cait | Soft moaning and mewling from the other side of the rug draws your attention — Cait and Salwah are getting at each other, the temple sluts pawing at each others' clothes; perhaps you should go over and join them, but that'd mean leaving your mouthpiece unattended and besides, your body feels all heavy and runny, like molten cheese... ] ...Where did that comparison come from, anyway? And why is the world so bright, hued in such vivid detail, with lines and shadows leaping out at you from their own darkness? Wow, what a whole new perspective on the world; you're sure your mind is sloshing over with inspiration and fresh ideas, given how you can feel them roiling about in your skull! Now, if only you could just remember what they were... How much spice have you inhaled, anyway? It certainly is a lot stronger and fast-acting than if you drank it. Maybe there's something about burning it that makes it all the more — — You never get to finish that thought before passing straight out on the rug[party.has cait |, the sounds of two hungry kittens messily pawing at and slobbering all over each other lulling you into unconsciousness ].
rows.translation: 萨尔瓦听到这个建议后懒洋洋地笑了笑，还用尾巴轻轻拍了自己的肥屁股。“嗯……我本来正打算给自己点上一支烟呢。要产生足够的烟雾浓度，需要的烟量通常对一个人来说来说太多了，所以如果独自抽烟的话，我就觉得有点浪费……不过如果有其他人一起的话[party.has cait |凯特和你 |你 ]在这里，我想我确实有理由这么做，不是吗？” “嗯，你肯定很高兴她会这么慷慨吧。” “胡说八道。 [party.has cait |凯特[silly |-学长的 |' ]在这里，有你在这里，三个人在一起就成了一场聚会。多一点额外的乐趣也是值得的，只要能和你在一起就好了。” 凯特笑着拍了拍萨莉的脑袋，正好拍在她的两耳之间。“你今天真是太夸张了，萨莉。我又不是什么需要你用这些安慰的话来哄骗的人……吧？ |别这样贬低自己。[pc.name]只不过是再添几粒罢了，就是为了让您能更开心地与我们共度这段时光。您应该觉得，您的陪伴本身就远比这些更有价值，对吧？” 哈哈，她这么一说…… ] 现在，请稍等片刻，我马上就把这一切都准备好。” 看着萨尔瓦把一切都安排妥当，实在是一件很有意思的事情——她把水烟壶放在熊皮地毯上，然后打开水烟壶上部的一个小盖子，取出一块薄金属板。这块金属板原本可能是铜或青铜制成的，但现在已经被染成了各种红色和棕色的色调。这位紫发女子将这块金属板放在桌子上，接着又拿出了一个有软垫的盒子，从里面取出了[party.has cait |三 |两个 ]带有金属嘴部的柔性管子。 “别担心它们会不会不干净，我在把它们收起来之前，一定会把嘴部部分煮一下的，”她开玩笑地说。“现在该去处理那个调味料盘了。等我忙完这些，你能去把水碗倒满水吗？床边放着一个水壶，把下装的容器装满，直到玻璃杯上的刻度线为止。 你赶忙照做，而萨尔瓦则从她的物品中拿出了一个装着香料的玻璃搅拌器，并拧开了盖子。那只可爱的巧克力色猫咪深深地闻了闻盖子上的香味，然后发出一声长长的、充满渴望的叹息——它被那种深红色粉末的气息吸引住了。她脸上仍带着一丝迷醉的笑容，用力摇晃着摇酒器，然后将一层薄薄的香料粉撒在金属盘上。 “啊，闻起来真香，”莎莉轻笑着说道，随后将装着香料的盘子放回水烟筒里，然后用力关上了盖子。香料必须保持流动状态，现在它的流动情况还不错——世界上没有什么比结块的香料粉更糟糕的了。水的情况怎么样？” 你差不多快完成了——彩窗上那些花卉图案让视线有点受阻，看东西有点不方便。在确认一切准备就绪后，萨尔瓦将一些木炭碎撒在香料盘下方的那个碗里。 [party.has cait |让凯特露出了微笑。 “凯特[silly |-学长 ]你能来主持这个环节吗？” 凯特笑得合不拢嘴，从床上爬下来，坐在地毯上，选了一个话筒。“当然可以。我已经有一段时间没有这么做了，而我们上次一起做这个也是很久以前的事了。一起萨莉。” “我会为卡拉留一个位置的。” 凯特停顿了一下，然后低下头，脸上的笑容变得有些遗憾。“啊，对吧。那我们开始吧。” 你的粉色小猫低声念着某种咒语，那些细小的木炭突然燃起了温柔的火焰。 |她只需轻轻一弹手指，这些东西就立刻被点燃了。 ]不久之后，房间里弥漫起一种浓郁而令人放松的气息，这种气味既甜美又带有辛辣的味道。你忍不住会大口吸入这种气息，这时，你的后脑勺会传来一阵愉悦而轻微的嗡嗡声，让你的肌肉逐渐放松下来。 “来吧，[pc.name]你们想选哪一个都行——剩下的就归我吧。” 红色香料烟雾在冷却的水中缓缓弥漫，这一景象实在令人陶醉。当你透过玻璃凝视这一幕时，萨尔瓦突然打开了一个白葡萄酒瓶，为每个人倒了一小杯。 [party.has cait |所有 |两者 ]她从你们当中挑选了一个人，只是在他的外表上加了一些“点缀”而已。然后，她把那个被“装饰”过的人交给了你。[party.has cait |一个给了凯特，最后一个则留给了自己。 | 而把另一个留给了自己。 ]它轻轻坐在你身边的地毯上。 “我试过加斯提供的几种本地葡萄酒，这种酒搭配烟熏食物最为美味。先深吸一口气，然后再小口品尝吧。 [party.has cait |你偶然瞥见了凯特，她正在对着吹口大口喘气。你的粉色小猫慢慢走开，呼出的气息中散发着甜中带辣的香气，她的脸上浮现出梦幻般的微笑。她的耳朵向前和两侧弯曲，尾巴在熊皮地毯上懒洋洋地摆动着。 真是太好了，”她叹着气说道，“我正需要这个。” 萨尔瓦微笑着，在她的脸颊上亲了一下：“我从家里带了些好东西来。趁现在还能享受，因为……没有痛苦，就没有爱情。没有离别，就没有相聚。” “没有永恒的欢乐。” 凯特闭上眼睛，仰起头，将烟嘴送到唇边，又深深地吸了一口那带有香味的烟雾。萨尔瓦的笑容变得有些黯淡，她用指尖轻轻触了触那位前辈的眉头。 ] 嗯，其实没什么难的。你只需抬起自己的嘴唇，稳住身体，然后吸气。浓烟首先侵入你的口腔，让你的舌头感到刺痛，接着它们会涌入你的喉咙，进入你的肺部。有那么一瞬间，你会本能地想要咳嗽、咳出痰来，但很快这种感觉就会消失，因为你的肌肉会放松下来，这时似乎一切都不再那么重要了。当然，你会感到平静而无忧无虑，但这种状态并不会伴随着使用冬茎后那种感官变得迟钝的现象；相反，一切似乎都变得更加明亮、更加清晰了；在那一瞬间，你甚至能够清晰地看到自己的思绪在脑海中飞速闪过——然后，你从那个吹口处移开嘴唇，呼出一口气。 ……哇。而这些还只是普通的物品呢——真想知道，当贾西兰·马拉克信徒想要让自己的思维更加清晰、更加敏锐时，他们会使用哪种浓度更高、效果更强的麻醉性香料呢…… “感觉不错吧？”萨尔瓦在你身旁轻声说道。当她向你露出微笑时，一股带有香料的烟雾从她的鼻孔中散发出来，随后她喝了一口这种加入了香料的葡萄酒。“能够以更加细致的方式去看、去思考、去倾听、去感受。这种体验真是啊……那一定是一种将所有满足与愉悦都浓缩在一声叹息中的表达。萨尔瓦半闭着眼睛，蜷缩在地毯上，那双深绿色的眼睛紧紧盯着眼前的酒杯。看来这些香料真的让她的大脑“短路”了[party.has cait | 不过凯特也好不到哪里去——你会看到，她那只粉红色的小猫一口喝光了所有加了香料的酒，然后仰面躺在地上，双眼直直地盯着天花板，不断地从水烟筒的吸口处吸气。 ] 那么，下一轮吧。你喝了一口这种加了香料的酒，让它的苦甜味道在舌头上弥漫，与烟雾混合在一起，然后再次将烟嘴含在口中吸了一口。这一次，尽管烟雾很浓重，但它却显得十分顺滑、细腻。你放松的身体几乎没有产生任何抵抗，就让烟雾滑入喉咙，沉沉地落在肺部。哦，天啊，一切都开始变得如此太好了而你已经懒得再去关心任何事情了……你的杯子里还剩半杯撒了香料的葡萄酒，但你却对此毫不在意那个他大口喝下这杯酒，然后靠在床脚，尽情享受着那些香料的芬芳。浓郁的味道在舌头上爆发，刺激着你的味蕾，当这美妙的液体顺着喉咙流下去时，你的整个身体仿佛都被点燃了——不过这种感觉绝对是愉悦的，因为你的肚子开始热起来，说明这酒确实很有效果。[party.has cait | 地毯的另一边传来了轻柔的呻吟声和喵喵叫声，吸引了你的注意——凯特和萨尔瓦正在互相闹着玩，那些寺庙里的荡妇们正在扯对方的衣服；也许你应该过去加入她们，但那样就会让你的代言人无人看管了，而且，你的身体也感觉变得沉重而柔软，就像融化的奶酪一样…… ] ……这种比较究竟是从哪里来的呢？为什么这个世界会如此明亮，色彩如此生动逼真，线条和阴影仿佛从自身的暗影中跃了出来，如此清晰地呈现在我们眼前？哇，这种看待世界的方式真是完全不同了；考虑到你能够感受到这些想法在脑海中翻涌，你的头脑里肯定充满了灵感和新的想法吧！现在，要是你能想起它们到底是什么该多好啊…… 你到底吸入了多少这种香料啊？它的效果确实比直接饮用要强烈得多，也起效得更快。也许是因为燃烧的过程让它的效果更加显著了吧…… — 你还没来得及把那个想法说完，就直接昏倒在地板上了。[party.has cait |两只饥饿的小猫互相用爪子乱抓、口水弄得到处都是，那些声音会让你渐渐进入沉睡状态 ]。

rows.original:
Fresh air greets you as you stir on the bearskin rug — despite how you must've passed out a handful of hours ago, you feel refreshed, energised, ready to be on the road again. Salwah's moved the hookah off the rug and has taken it apart, boiling the metal mouthpieces and cleaning the glass interior when she notices you stirring[party.has cait
            |; Cait's not too far away packing away the gut tubing into the cases, and she gives you a cheery wave as you roll your gaze to her
        ].
        
        Oof. That hit hard... 
        
        "Don't try to stand all at once," Salwah says cheerily, wiggling her tall ears at you. "Yes, you probably feel clear-headed, but your body may have other ideas."
        
        Good advice. Holding onto the bed for support, you manage to lever yourself up onto its foot and take a seat on the mattress. Still, holding her cheeky smile, Salwah comes over to you and gives you a quick peck on the cheek before [pc.hasHair
            |ruffling your hair
            |patting you on the head
        ].
        
        "You have to be careful. The water cools the smoke as it bubbles through, so it's possible to inhale a lot without noticing. You want to draw it out, make it last as long as you can. Of course, [party.has cait
            |Caitriss and I have
            |I've
        ] had a lot more experience with spice. You'll get better at it with time, assuming I can find fresh supply this far from Jassira, eh?"
        
        You nod dumbly and shrug. You've got to be back on the road pretty soon... 
        
        "And I've got to be doing missionary work within an hour, so it all works out. See you around, then[party.has cait
            | — and you too, Caitriss
        ]!"
        
        It'll still be a while before the spice wears off, but you gather your things and head for the door. Gods, your mind still feels considerably expanded...

            |凯特就在不远处，正把那些肠道导管收进箱子里；当你把目光转向她时，她朝你愉快地挥了挥手
        ]。
        
        哎哟。那一下可真带劲…… 
        
        “别想着一下子站起来，”萨尔瓦愉快地说道，同时朝你晃了晃她那对高高的耳朵。“没错，你现在大概觉得头脑清醒，但你的身体可能有别的想法。”
        
        说得好。你抓住床架稳住身子，总算撑着坐到了床垫上。萨尔瓦依旧挂着那副调皮的笑容，走到你身边，在你的脸颊上飞快地亲了一口，然后[pc.hasHair
            |弄乱你的头发
            |轻拍你的脑袋
        ]。
        
        “你得小心点。烟气在冒泡穿过水的时候会被冷却，所以有可能不知不觉就吸进去很多。你要慢慢地吸，让它尽量持久一些。当然，[party.has cait

        ]！”

rows.original: Ah... this probably seems strange, but would she allow you to pet her? Salwah purrs throatily, half-lidding her eyes and giving you a cheeky, lip-biting smile. Swishing her tail back and forth, the comfy cat flexes her tanned form in a full-body stretch; the movement serves to show off her gymnast's body and the faint outline of muscles in her limbs and belly, how they shift and make the deep tattoos on her skin dance. "Ah, my friend... back in the temple, they charge people for the luxury of doing just that..." How much is she charging? "...But since my senior owes you her life and more, I'll do it pro bono," she finishes with a laugh. "No other freebies, though, okay? Body's a temple and all, and it needs tithes to keep up appearances." All right, you understand. "Very well." Turning her gaze up to you, Salwah fixes her wide, deep emerald eyes on you adoringly; the priestess lays out on her side atop the bed, idly flicking her tail as she reaches up for her shawl. In one fluid motion, she pulls it up and over her ears, shaking out her butt-length hair in a glorious toss and allowing the deep purple strands to fall all over her shoulders and side. "Please, begin as you wish." Well then, it's customary to begin from the top-down. Salwah's ears are long and thin for a feline, and a soft, sighing purr escapes her lips as you scratch their backs, starting from tip to base and back to tip again, one at a time. When you've made a few passes, you start tending to both at once, feeling them twitch and fold forward at your touch; her smile widens as she nestles further in the sheets and makes herself comfortable, tilting her head gently to follow your touch. Your thumbs find their way to the cartilaginous edges, teasing them while you scratch the soft, fine fuzz on the backs, then elicit a deeper sigh from Salwah as they invade their insides. "Be careful now... don't get overeager." Fine hairs tickle and prick at your thumbs, delicate fuzz suited to the sensing of sounds. The insides of Salwah's ears are delightfully warm as you stroke them in a circular motion, picking up sudden speed as they move beneath your touch. Abruptly, she shudders a little and sucks in a sharp breath — although given how much control over her body she boasts of having, one can only wonder if this is real or not... ...But does it matter? It's doing a very good job of egging you on — nothing's more of a turn-off than a limp, unresponsive partner, after all, and as a professional harlot she should know that. You give Salwah's ears several more scritches for good measure, then turn your attention to her hair. Ah, such luxuriant hair — no doubt carefully tended to for maximum effect, the deep purple strands scented with sweet, floral musk. Your breath catches in your throat as you run your fingers through this wondrous, luxuriant richness, pushing it against her bare shoulders, rolling it against her side. Salwah laughs at your eagerness and taps you on the side with her tail, tutting at you. "Careful now," she purrs. "You're straying close into paying territory." Really now? "Maybe. But I will tell you when you do cross the line, so you can decide whether you'd like to draw back or pay up." You note that she didn't say if, but when you crossed the line. Such confidence in her abilities... Still with her hair in your hand, you slide your touch over to Salwah's tattooed side; the curve of her body and sensuality of her skin spike over her lithe midriff, especially where it joins with her soft, generous hips. The sudden transition from lightly outlined abs to springy, breedable butt and hips is a masterpiece of the carnal arts, and even just being able to touch it, to sample a tiny fraction of that nubile warmth beneath your fingers is turning you on. Back and forth, back and forth, from shoulder to side and atop her hips and back upwards again — Salwah's purring is constant now, a deep, throaty sound that reverberates about the interior of the inn room. "Ah." Through all the warmth, her pulse is strong and steady, nubile energy to complement her alternately slender yet sumptuous form. You can't get enough of it, especially when your hand continues moving downward away from her shoulder and up the mound of one firm, tattooed asscheek, cupping its curve so that your palms and fingers are in contact with as much of that firm plushness and its dark swirls as they possibly can be — "Here, why don't you stroke this instead?" As she speaks, the chocokitty worms her tail over to you, its tip pushing against your grasp demandingly. It's impossible to say no to such a pleasant demand, and soon enough you're running your fingertips through the fine fuzz that coats Salwah's long, sinuous tail. Tip to mid-length and back again, even as more and more of it wraps about your wrist and crawls down your arm in a coil — only for the entire thing to start running back and forth about your forearm as if... as if... well, the things she could do to any rod-shaped object, come to think of it... Just as your fantasies are starting to run away with you, Salwah giggles and withdraws her tail from about your arm, giving your palm a swat before it darts around does the same to your [pc.ass]. "Well, well, I imagine that's enough for one session," Salwah says with a giggle. "I'm always happy to make you comfortable, [pc.name]... and just that."

rows.translation: 没错。无论是首都里那座宏伟的寺庙，还是偏远村庄里的小规模场所，几乎任何人都可以免费进去洗澡。当然也有一些例外——比如那些会对寺庙工作人员构成威胁的逃犯之类的——但无论是使用芳香精油和香薰浴池，还是仅仅用普通的肥皂和水，规则都是一样的。那么，我想你的愿望就是这个吧？” “要是她的手能触碰到你的皮肤，那该有多好啊……” 萨尔瓦的笑容稍微黯淡了一些：“只是想确认一下，洗澡就是洗澡而已，并不是其他更亲密行为的委婉说法。那些确实需要不同数额的捐款。如果你没有意见的话，那我就会去请加思帮忙准备一些事情。 对了，记住在水中时千万不要做出任何不当的行为。 “虽然来寺庙祈求的人在敏感度和容易感到尴尬的程度上可能会有所不同，但我说的都是真心话，也会说到点子上。你慢慢来，我们会在走廊尽头的洗手部间见面。 说着，她便先走出了门。而你确实花了些时间才取下自己的大部分物品，尽可能地脱得精光，同时又确保自己看起来还算得体，之后才离开萨尔瓦的房间，前往公共浴室。当你走向门口时，加斯正好也正要离开，他向你点了点头。 幸好在你需要的时候，格温手头正好有一些热水。铁盆也已经准备好了。我本来还担心你们两个在房间里会做一些不可告人的事情呢，但你的小猫说只是用来洗澡的，所以……嗯，她从来没骗过我。好好享受吧，听懂了吗？ 非常感谢。当你推开门时，确实看到了加思那口旧浴缸里盛满了温水；萨尔瓦也在那里等着，她准备了一些浸过灰烬的肥皂和一把刷子，除此之外没有别的东西。不过，这多少有点让人失望——毕竟这是马拉克信徒教派提供的服务，但公平地说，萨尔瓦是在资源有限的情况下从事这项工作的，而且她甚至没有属于自己的寺庙来开展这些活动。脱掉身上的最后一件衣服，你跳入水中，让这股巧克力带来的温暖感缓缓渗透到你的肌肉和骨骼中，带来无比的舒适与放松。 虽然这种沐浴体验算不上什么奢华享受，但也不算差。萨尔瓦虽然没有太多的资源，但她的手法确实很娴熟——她动作迅速，能有效地将你身上的污垢洗掉，并且还会使用足够的肥皂，显然她在这方面经验丰富。 通常都是那些刚刚脱离幼年期的小猫被派去帮忙洗澡的——当然，这一切都是在像我这样的初级助手的监督下进行的。能够与很多人接触，并以如此亲密的方式帮助他们，会让这些小猫逐渐适应与陌生人相处，同时也能帮助他们掌握许多基本的人际交往技巧。坚持这样做一两个月，你原本可能存在的害羞心理就会消失，至少你能够进行一些还算不错的交谈来打发时间了。 毫无疑问，凯特和卡拉也曾担任过寺庙朝圣者们的洗澡助手吧？ “没错。即使那些人在成年后并不打算继续留在寺庙里，也会这么做。” 萨尔瓦在手上打出泡沫，然后开始用刷子清洗起来。 [pc.skinTypeMulti skin fur scales |当她仔细地擦拭你的皮肤时，你会感到一阵刺痒感，那些坚硬的刷毛正在将旅途中的污垢和灰尘清除干净，但最终，这种体验会让你感觉更加清爽、更加干净。 |要让刷子深入你湿润的毛发中，确实需要花费一些力气——萨尔瓦手臂上的肌肉因此在用力时显得格外明显，但这种彻底的清洁过程绝对是值得的。那些坚硬的刷毛在厚厚的毛发下面触碰到皮肤时，感觉非常舒适，你几乎能感觉到旅行途中积累的污垢和灰尘正在被一点点清除掉。 |那些坚硬的刷毛在你的鳞片上顺畅地滑动，萨尔瓦巧妙地利用刷毛之间的交错结构，将旅途中所积的污垢和灰尘清除干净。有几片老旧的鳞片因此脱落，飘浮在水中，而你也能感受到萨尔瓦为为你做这些所付出的努力，这让你感到无比振奋。 ]她的手指结实而灵活，正如她所说，完全没有任何淫荡的感觉，不过你确实能感受到那种气息。非常在她与你相处结束后，她会感到轻松自在。她会对你多付出一些关心和关注。[pc.hair]她用肥皂尽力清洗，但脸上那紧绷的愁容却暴露了她对这种临时凑合办法的无奈与担忧。 终于，她洗完了。萨尔瓦让你走出浴缸，最后再冲洗一遍，然后用加思准备的那条柔软毛巾把你从头到脚擦干。 “感觉好些了吗？” 好多了。以及太感谢你了，清洁工女士。” “已经有好一阵子没有经常做这种事了。大多数人并不会来找我洗澡……知道自己仍然具备这个能力，真是件好事。”萨尔瓦微笑着对你说，“要是凯特也能和我们在一起，那就再完美不过了。” 你笑了笑，穿好衣服，然后回到萨尔瓦的房间去取剩下的东西。是时候再次上路了……
rows.raw: " "That's correct. No matter whether it's the grand temple in the capital or a one-person affair in a backwater village, almost anyone can come in and get a free bath. There are a few exceptions — outlaws and others who would pose a danger to temple staff, for example — but be it perfumed oils and scented pools or simple soap and water, that's how things are done. I suppose, then, that's what your desire is?" It would be nice to have her hands on your skin... Salwah's smile fades a little. "Just to be sure, a bath is just that — a bath, and not a euphemism for other, more intimate services. Those do require donations of varying amounts. If that's all right with you, then I'll go ask Garth to help me prepare a few things." Yeah, you get it. No getting up to any hanky-panky while in the water. "While temple supplicants may have varying sensibilities and proneness to embarrassment, I mean what I say and say what I mean. Take your time, I'll see you in the bathroom down the hall. " With that, she's out the door ahead of you. You do indeed take your time in getting most of your things off, stripping down as bare as you can while still being decent before leaving Salwah's chambers and heading for the common bathroom. Garth's just leaving as you make for the door, and he gives you a nod. "Good thing Gwyn had some hot water on hand just when you needed it. The tin bath's set up now. I was worried the two of you'd get up to some hanky-panky while in the room, but your kitten said it was just a bath, so — well, she's never lied to me. Enjoy, you hear?" Much appreciated. You push open the door and are indeed greeted with the sight of Garth's old bath filled with plenty of lukewarm water; Salwah's waiting there with some leached-ash soap, a brush, and little else. It's a bit of a letdown given — well, this being a Mallachite service and all, but it's fair to say that Salwah's out on missionary work with limited resources, and she doesn't even have a temple of her own to do this in. Throwing off the last of your clothes, you lower yourself into the water and let the chococat impart plenty of soothing comfort into your muscles and bones. While it isn't any kind of perfumed luxury, the bath's nonetheless not bad. Salwah has technique if not resources, and her hands are quick at getting the dirt off you and applying plenty of soap, clearly experienced at this matter. "It's usually the younger kittens just out of childhood who are sent out to help with the bathing — under the watchful eye of a junior acolyte such as me, of course. Being able to meet many people and aid them in such a close manner introduces them to being with strangers, and many basic interpersonal skills. Do this for a month or two, and any shyness you may have had will be gone, and you'll at least be able to make passable conversation to pass the time." No doubt Cait and Calla had their time as bath assistants to temple supplicants? "That's right. Even those who don't intend to stay on with the temple after their majority do so." Salwah works up a lather on her hands, and gets to work with the brush. [pc.skinTypeMulti skin fur scales |Your skin tingles a bit as she scrubs thoroughly, feeling the stiff bristles push away the dirt and dust of travel, but you ultimately feel better and cleaner for the experience |It takes a bit of effort to get the brush in deep through your wet fur, Salwah's muscles standing out on her arms, but the deep cleansing is definitely worth it in the end. The stiff bristles feel so good against your skin under all that fur, and you can practically feel the dirt and dust of travel washing away |The stiff bristles glide smoothly over your scales, Salwah working counter to their overlap in order to get the dirt and dust of travel out from under them. A few small pieces of old scale break away and drift off in the water, and you feel very much invigorated for the effort Salwah's putting in ]. Her fingers are strong and nimble, and just as she said, there's absolutely nothing in the way of lewdity, although you really do feel very comfortable after she's done with you. She pays a little extra attention to your [pc.hair], doing what she can with the soap, but the thin-lipped grimace on her face betrays her concern at having to make do. At last, though, she's done. Instructing you to step out of the bath, Salwah gives you a final rinse-off, and dries you off from head to toe with one of Garth's fluffy towels. "Feel better?" Better and cleaner, thank her very much. "It's been a while since I did this very often. Most people don't come to me for a bath... it's good to know I've still got it." Salwah graces you with a smile. "Only way this could be better would be if Cait were to be with us." You laugh, get dressed, and head back to Salwah's room to collect the rest of your things. Time to get on the road again, then... "

Giving the both of you a broad grin, Salwah gives the both of you a playful swat on the thigh with her tail. "Congratulations, Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ]. How does it feel to be a temple matron now?" "To be honest, Sally? Not that much different." A laugh. "Of course, you're always out on the road with [pc.name]. Maybe when this is all over and you're more settled in, you'll start feeling it." "When this is all over..." "Don't worry, I know you'll get Calla back." |you notice that she's speaking with Cait, the entirety of the delicious chococat's body alive and animated as she converses with her senior. Noticing you arrive, both temple cats turn to you and bow their heads in greeting, and the latter slips off her recliner in an appropriately feline fashion, her tattoos flowing with her movements even as she gives you a playful swat with her tail. "Ah! [pc.name]! How kind of you to drop by — Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] and I were just getting settled into the place and were talking about how much you contributed to getting the place running. We owe so much to you!" "Come now, Sally — [pc.names] not one for flattery. Lay it on any thicker, and you'll put [pc.himHer] off." Haha, it's all right. You are aware of how much you've done to help Cait this far, so Salwah's not wrong about it in the least. ] "So, how do you like the place, Sally?" Cait asks, a coy smile playing on her lips. [var0] "It's... more than what I could've imagined. The sheer size of the place is crazy — I didn't expect they'd refurbish the whole temple, it's big enough to fit a whole Jassiran missionary expedition! I thought they were just going to get something cozy for you and me, and pull down the rest of the place, but — " Salwah pauses for breath — "truly, you got your five thousand hawks' worth out of this temple and more, [pc.name]. I'm still amazed by the scope of it all, it makes my head spin. Garth's people got in all the good stuff from Tychris, I'm amazed the caravans weren't waylaid bringing it all here." Huh, he wasn't joking when he said the people he knew would be building the temple at cost. Looking at all of this... five thousand hawks from your side is really a small price to pay.[flags.CARMEN_KILLED|| You wouldn't be surprised if the baroness chipped in a little on the side without anyone noticing.] Either way, what happens now? Are they going to be doing... well, Mallachite things in here, whatever they may be? "Well, not all at once," Salwah replies, giving Cait a nod. "We've got to get the place settled in first — I'm just one kitten, and the temple is just so big. To be honest, I don't think much of the space will actually be in use until I can get more hands in to help." Cait grins and gives Salwah a poke on the belly, right above the tattoo on her womb. "That's where you come in, Sally." "O-of course, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]. But even if I got started on that right now, it'll still be some years yet, yes?" Sally turns back to you. "Well, [pc.name], Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and I have been talking, and long story short I'll be taking care of this place when the both of you are out adventuring together, so you don't have to worry about the temple. Mr. Zethra also hangs around here a lot of the time — he wants to study the portal — so there'll be another pair of hands and eyes around the place, too." You see. "Every tenday, I'll personally have the cut that Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] promised you sent down to your tribute chest. It admittedly won't be that much to begin with, but as the place grows more prosperous I'm sure that sum will grow. You should also keep an eye out for other investment opportunities in the Marches, too. The frontier has plenty of area for development." You nod. Is that all? "That's all for now," Salwah purrs, her voice rich and throaty as she slinks back onto her recliner and settles in with a happy sigh. "If you wish to make use of my services... well, I'll go into further detail if you're interested. Just ask if you are — now that there's an actual temple, I can finally make use of my talents to their fullest extent." Cait giggles and pokes Salwah right on her brand of the harlot, and the latter just purrs and looks extremely smug. [party.has cait | "Well then, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], [pc.name], feel free to take a look around the temple. I'm sure you'll agree that Jassiran Mallachites have style." Salwah goes back to her hookah, and Cait pulls you away gently into the vastness of the reception hall. The both of you wander around for a half-minute, taking in the splendor that Garth's workmen have thrown together in so short a time. "So, you like it?" Cait gives you a tap on the [pc.butt] with a tail. You certainly got your money's worth. Especially knowing that the place is in good hands. Cait chuckles, although there's a twinge of bitterness in it, then your pink kitten leans in and gives you a quick peck on the cheek. "Calla'll be comfortable when she comes back home, that's for sure. With Dad working on it, I'm sure something can be done. In the meantime, why don't we take a look around together, see the place you paid for? There's a lot of temple to go through, after all..." |Pink and chocolate kittens turn back to each other and resume their conversation, leaving you with your thoughts; you wander around for a half-minute, taking in the splendor that Garth's workmen have thrown together in so short a time. Perhaps you should take a look around, see the entirety of the place; it's really quite impressive. ]
rows.translation: 当你渐渐靠近那个躺在豪华躺椅上的萨尔瓦时[party.has cait |那只美味的巧克力猫以极具猫科动物特质的动作扭动身体，从栖息处滚了下来，它身上的纹身随着动作而流动着。萨尔瓦冲你们俩露出了灿烂的笑容，然后用尾巴轻轻拍了一下你们的大腿。 “恭喜你，凯特。[silly |-学长 ]现在担任寺庙的女管理者，这种感觉怎么样？” “说实话，莎莉？并没有什么太大的不同。” 一阵笑声。“当然了，你毕竟总是在外面奔波忙碌的[pc.name]也许等这一切都结束了，你的生活也稳定下来之后，你就会开始感受到那种感觉了。” “等这一切都结束了……” “别担心，我相信你一定能把卡拉找回来。 |你注意到，她正在和凯特交谈，那只可爱的巧克力色猫咪在整个交谈过程中都显得活力十足、生动活泼。当你出现时，两只猫咪都转过头来向你鞠躬致意，而那只年纪较大的猫咪则以一种非常符合猫的性格的方式从躺椅上站了起来，她的纹身随着她的动作而流动，同时她还用尾巴轻轻拍了你一下，显得十分顽皮。 “啊！[pc.name]你能够专程来看我，真是太好了——凯特[silly |-学长 ]我刚刚安顿下来，还在谈论你为让这个地方正常运转所做出的贡献。我们真的欠你太多！” “来吧，莎莉—— [pc.names]这个人可不吃这套奉承话。再天花乱坠地夸奖他，他也只会无动于衷。[pc.himHer]关掉。” 哈哈，没关系。你很清楚自己迄今为止为帮助凯特做了多少事，所以萨尔瓦的说法一点也没有错。 ] 那么，莎莉，你觉得这个地方怎么样？”凯特嘴角带着一丝俏皮的微笑问道。 [var0] 这……超出了我的想象。这个地方的大小简直令人难以置信——我没想到他们会翻新整座神庙，它大得足以容纳一整个贾西拉传教团！我原本以为他们只会为我们准备一些舒适的地方，然后把剩下的部分拆掉，但——萨尔瓦暂停了一下，喘了口气——“说实话，你们从这座寺庙里得到的，远远超过了五千只鹰的价值，甚至更多。[pc.name]我仍然对这一切的规模感到震惊，简直让人头晕目眩。加斯的手下们从提克里斯那里得到了所有那些珍贵的物资，我真不明白那些运送这些物资的商队怎么没有遭到劫掠。” “哼，他说他会自费建造这座神庙，看来他并不是在开玩笑。看着这一切……你们方面提供的五千只鹰，其实真的是一个小小的代价而已。[flags.CARMEN_KILLED|| 如果女男爵偷偷地拿出一些钱来帮忙，而没有人注意到，你也不会感到惊讶吧。]无论如何，现在会发生什么呢？他们会在这里做些什么……嗯，也就是那些与马拉克信徒有关的事情吧，不管那些具体是什么。 “嗯，不会一下子全部开始的，”萨尔瓦回答道，同时向凯特点了点头。“我们首先得让这个地方安定下来——我只不过是一只小猫而已，而这座寺庙也实在太大的说实话，我觉得在有更多人来帮忙之前，这些空间其实并不会被真正利用起来。” 凯特笑着，用手指轻轻戳了戳萨尔瓦的肚子，正好戳在她腹部纹身的位置。“这就是你需要发挥作用的地方了，莎莉。” “哦，当然，凯特。[silly |前辈 ]但是，就算我现在就开始着手做这件事，也还需要好几年时间吧？”莎莉转向你问道，“那么[pc.name]，凯特[silly |前辈 ]总之，等你们俩一起去冒险的时候，我会负责照看这个地方，这样你们就不用担心寺庙的事了。泽斯拉先生也经常在这里——他想要研究那个传送门——所以这里也会有人帮忙照看。” “你明白的吧……” “每天，我都会亲自处理凯特需要处理的事情。[silly |前辈 ]我答应过你会把那些东西放入你的贡品箱中。诚然，一开始这笔数目可能不会很多，但随着这个地区逐渐繁荣起来，我相信这笔金额也会逐渐增加。你同时也应该留意边境地区其他的投资机会。边境地区还有大量的发展空间。” 你点了点头。就这些吗？ “目前就这些了，”萨尔瓦轻声说道，她的声音低沉而富有韵味，她重新躺回躺椅上，满意地叹了口气，放松下来。如果您愿意利用我的服务……那么，如果您感兴趣的话，我会详细说明具体的内容。如今终于有了真正的神庙，我的本领总算可以充分发挥了。” 凯特咯咯笑着，戳了戳萨尔瓦位于她那标志性的部位，而后者只是满足地眯起眼睛，显得格外得意。 [party.has cait | 那么，凯特[silly |前辈 ]， [pc.name]，请随时在寺庙里四处看看吧。我相信你会认同，贾西兰·马拉基特族的人确实风格萨尔瓦回到了她的水烟筒旁，而凯特则轻轻地将你拉到了宽敞的接待厅里。你们俩在那里闲逛了半分钟，欣赏着加思的手下们在如此短的时间内打造出的这一片辉煌景象。 “那么，你喜欢这里吗？”凯特轻拍了一下你的肩膀，问道。[pc.butt]真是太值得了。尤其是知道这个地方被交到了可靠的人手中。 凯特轻声笑了起来，尽管其中带着一丝苦涩，然后她那只粉红色的小猫凑过来，在你的脸颊上轻啄了一下。“卡拉回家后一定会很开心的，我相信的。有爸爸在帮忙处理这些事情，肯定没问题的。某个东西可以做到。不过在此之前，我们为什么不一起先去看看你预订的地方呢？毕竟还有很多地方需要参观呢…… |粉色和巧克力色的小猫们又互相转过身来，继续它们的对话，让你陷入了沉思。你闲逛了半分钟，欣赏着加思的手下们在如此短的时间内创造出的这一片辉煌景象。或许你应该仔细看看这个地方，看看它的全貌——真的相当令人印象深刻。 ]

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: [party.has cait |[rand |As your party draws close, Salwah slinks off her recliner, the chococat's face lighting up at the sight of her senior. She's [salwah.pregStage 2 |still extremely limber and flow-y despite being so heavily pregnant |slippery and smooth in her movements as she gets to her feet ], the elaborate tattoos that cover her body only adding to that impression as they shift atop her dark, supple skin. "Welcome home, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]! Welcome, [pc.name]!" Now if that isn't a cheery welcome. Salwah purrs. "You'll find that I've been very diligent in all my duties while you were away, Matron Zethra. Very diligent indeed... is there anything I can do for the two of you?" "Now, now, Sally, save some of the fun for me." Her ears perking up, Cait looks between the both of you and pulls you close into a hug. "It's good to be amongst friends again. But yes, [pc.name], if you do have business with Sally, don't let me get in your way." |Cait's already up ahead of you as you head for her junior — your pink kitten breaks away from your group and rushes up, calling out in Jassiran. There's a moment as Salwah looks up, then sets aside her heavy, leather-bound book and slinks off her recliner to embrace her senior in a big hug. Purring, the chocokitten draws back to properly greet the both of you, then pulls back her woollen shawl to let Cait give her several headscritches in a clearly practiced motion. "Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], welcome home. [pc.Name], welcome. Make yourself comfortable, as you please." "Ah, still with the prayer book, Sally? I guess you're here as a missionary and not just for the missionary." Salwah sticks her tongue out at Cait, then grins and ushers the both of you to sit on the recliner with her, shifting [salwah.pregStage 2 |her pregnant belly ]a bit to make space for you. "Now then, what did you need of me?" |As you draw close, you find Salwah standing atop her recliner, going through a series of stretching exercises in full view of everyone entering the temple; [salwah.pregStage 2 |despite her advanced state of kitten-bearing, the delicious chocokitty's body is as limber as ever, belying the amount of work she must put into keeping it that way |it certainly is a fitting advertisement for the pleasures and passions of Mallach ]. Cait rushes up, and Sally does a small backflip and tumbles to her feet, the two embracing each other with cooing, kissing and purring aplenty. "Always a treat to see you back, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]." Turning to you, Salwah acknowledges you with a nod and cheeky smile. "And you too, [pc.name]. Come home for a spell, temple matron?" "Ah, I just wanted to see my grand cleric for a bit," Cait replies, and the two kittens giggle. Salwah throws on her shawl and cloak with practiced ease, then ushers the both of you to her side on the recliner. "So, was there something you needed with me?" ] |[rand |As you approach, you find both Cait and Salwah lounging about on the latter's recliner, taking turns to huff heavy spice smoke from a strategically-placed hookah. Sally's got her head resting against Cait's hefty rack, while your pink kitten's snuggled up against her junior's [salwah.pregStage 2 |heavily pregnant belly |plump, kitten-bearing ass ], the two of them looking very, very comfortable and stoned in full view of anyone entering the temple. You can't think of a better advertisement for what goes on in this place. Stepping up to both temple kittens, you give the so-called matron and grand cleric a smile. Were you interrupting something? "Oh no," Cait replies, her words a little slurred. "The spice plate's run dry, and I was just about to leave anyway. Why don't you help out [pc.name] here to the fullest of your abilities, Sally? Do it as a favor for me." As Cait stands a little woozily and heads down the temple corridor, Salwah gives you a cheeky, fang-toothed smile and thumps the cushions with her tail, inviting you over onto the recliner with her[salwah.pregStage 2 |, right next to her snuggly pregnant belly ]. The spice certainly affects her differently than it does Cait... "Come on then, my dear [pc.title]. I've been asked to be nice to you... don't worry, I'm very comfy and won't bite." |As you draw near, you notice a [rand |dazed-looking lupine man |rather flushed catgirl |sweat-soaked wyld elf |very satisfied-looking orc ] step away from Sally's side, pushing past you before stumbling down the temple corridors. Nothing seems to have taken place save for a small conversation, and yet there's a something or the other that lingers in the air, a sensual something redolent with the promise of sex. The chocokitty's ears twitch as you stop close and she purrs, filled with her characteristic cheeky humor; she blows a large plume of orange spice smoke into the air and snuggles up on the recliner, [salwah.pregStage 2 |cradling her big, pregnant belly in her hands |looking very pleased with herself ]. "Oh, it's you, [pc.name]! I thought it was another — "she says something in Jassiran, then catches herself — "petitioner asking for directions, and so soon after the previous one, too. Was almost tempted to send you away before I saw who it was!" Her? Send someone away? You thought temples of Mallach were supposed to be open to all. "Ah, it's been a long day. But for someone for whom we owe so much to? I'll make the time for you, [pc.name]. Just sit down right beside me and make yourself comfortable, and we'll see to your desires..." |Approaching, you find Salwah draped over the firm cushions of her recliner, a hookah pipe in one hand and her tail in the other. Despite the heavy spice smoke that hangs around her, the chocokitty's consciousness isn't impaired in the slightest as she shifts and squirms in repose; she [salwah.pregStage 2 |lets go of her tail to cradle the taut skin of her big, kitten-filled womb |rubs her tail along the supple contours of her tattooed skin ], letting you drink in the sight before throwing her head back with a happy sigh and purr. "Welcome! Welcome! Don't mind my occasional indulgence, the spice smoke will clear in a bit; not that many petitioners today so I thought I'd have a little fun myself. Is there something I can do for you today, [pc.name]? Or if you'd rather, do with you, do to you, or just plain do you?" ] ]
rows.translation: [party.has cait |[rand |当你的队伍即将靠近时，萨尔瓦从躺椅上悄悄起身，一看到她的上级，她那巧克力色的脸上立刻露出了喜悦的神情。她[salwah.pregStage 2 |尽管已经怀孕到了晚期，她的身体依然十分灵活、动作依然流畅。 |她站起身来时，动作显得既敏捷又流畅。 rows.raw: " [flags.SALWAH_TALK_FAME |"You want to know how you've been doing with the petitioners?" Sally swishes her tail at you. People have been noticing that the Wayfort across the river to the north isn't so abandoned anymore, and that its new inhabitants have begun sprucing it up. That, and levying taxes across anyone wanting to use the bridge... not that there are very many of those these days. They all look so sad, [pc.name] — which is just testament to how much of a pull you are. "So yes, you're not bad, perhaps somewhere on the level of Cait's mom, and she was one of the better sacred harlots a big temple had to offer. Not many people are blessed with this kind of raw magnetism, and those who do usually have better things to do with their lives than serve as a temple whore. But here you are, and talk about the petitioners is that they're quite enamoured of your person, [pc.name]. There're always disappointed faces when I have to explain that you're not a regular here at the temple, more of a loaner who drops in from time to time when you please. I don't like seeing those disappointed expressions when I have to ask them to pick someone else to service them, but that's the nature of the beast, isn't it? "But yes, you're an amazing pull for the temple, [pc.name] — which is why it's for the best that you're best served not being here every day. What was that the grand cleric liked to say — something about familiarity breeding contempt? You'll keep your lustre a little longer that way, so more power to you. ][var1 | "Then there's the matter of your body's natural talents." Your talents, she says. [pc.hasPerk WellHung |"Word's been getting around the petitioners about your natural proclivities towards having a tunnel snake between your legs. I've had a couple petitioners come in when you were out, asking for your milk in particular." ] [pc.hasPerk MessyOrgasm |"I've had people say that they feel quite gratified when you finally lose it — the mess you make all over the place really makes them feel great, that they managed to please even a temple harlot. And a messy release is the easiest, most visual way to create that feeling." ] [pc.hasPerk BubbleButt |"You've got a cute round butt that draws a bunch of folk who like that sort of thing — a nice rear end isn't exactly rare up here, but most people don't want to tangle with the harpies for a handful of that. Well, you are the local folk hero and problem solver, so that's something, but the shine of that wears off quickly; it'll get your foot in the door but won't carry you very far." ] Huh, now that's quite the detailed breakdown. "I said I'd give you all the reasons, and I did," Sally says smugly. "We don't have more than a handful of people at the temple, and so I'm able to keep tabs on even a moonlighter like you. It's important to know where the strengths of your subordinates lie, after all." And an overall view of your popularity with the petitioners? "Hmm..." Sally scratches her thin thoughtfully. "[var2 |I'll be blunt, you don't really stand out from the crowd very much. Not that you're hated or ugly or anything, but we do have some very good picks even amongst our small handful of Mallachites, and it's hard to rise above that kind of competition, you know? There, there — no need to be upset. Maybe if you make yourself more famous in other ways or work on improving your personal magnetism you might find more favor with the temple-goers. While you may not be able to do very much about your natural talents, you're not at the point where you've reached the limit of your potential, so don't get discouraged, okay?" Like I said, you're not just reflecting upon yourself when you put on those silks, you're also reflecting upon us. Well, what was the saying again? Absence makes the heart grow fonder? Oh yes, it certainly adds to your appeal if you're selling yourself as a rare treat. Make yourself available just often enough that petitioners don't get discouraged and give up hope, but not so often that they start taking you for granted. But you already knew that, didn't you? ]" Well, that seems to be about it. Thanks for the honest feedback. Sally blows a cloud of heavy spice smoke in your direction, and affects herself in a appropriately feline fashion. "Don't worry about it — you're Caitriss[silly |-senpai's |' ] friend and savior, and if I can't be honest with you, then who can I be honest with? "But for the favored, it means that people are willing to pay more for one's services, request you specifically, give you little gifts in the hopes of winning your favor... people have been trying to woo sacred harlots away from the temple since time immemorial, and although few have succeeded that doesn't mean that the recipients don't like the gifts." That's a fairly cynical way to put it. "The bouncers protect the harlots from those who turn creepy, that's all I'm saying. I'm glad Amina managed to drag her brother along for the ride across the ocean, or else we might've had to hire some local muscle." Back to the point, though... "Yes. You're already pretty well-known about these parts, so no bonus for that. However, as I've noted before, people will want to fuck someone notable, so if you're some kind of big shot that'll work in your favor. That, and if you have any particular quirks that the petitioners might find appealing, such as being particularly well-hung or stretchy inside.
