rows.original: Sally arches an eyebrow at you from where she's sprawled out on the couch. "You'd like to help tend to the petitioners?" Is that a problem? You'd imagine in the history of the temple there've been at least a handful of people with that particular kink, right? "Oh no, there've been more than a handful of people who want to play prostitute, and there are certain establishments who cater to that kink back home in Jassira. This, unfortunately, isn't one of them. Sacred harlots don't turn tricks; their goal is to help people channel their passions in beautiful and constructive manners, and if sex happens to be one of those avenues..." "Come on, Sally," Cait says[party.has cait | from beside you |, appearing in the western hallways with her arms crossed under her bust ]. "Letter of the word, spirit of the word. You know exactly what the old temple matron was saying underneath all those euphemisms. You don't serve the passions by putting hurdles of red tape in front of people with desires for no good reason." "Be reasonable, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]. Let's say we put aside all temple bureaucracy, mysticism, ritual and esotericism. Let's say we disregard all the training we went through for the role. If we let [pc.name] work the petitioners [pc.heShe]'s going to reflect on us, because they're going to assume [pc.heShe]'s a Mallachite. On the other side of that coin, we're also going to be responsible for what happens to [pc.himHer] while [pc.heShe]'s in our care — if a petitioner gets troublesome or [pc.heShe] happens to catch something while seeing to the faithful, we'll be liable. There's a reason why no temple ever allows freelancers." Your pink-haired kitten clearly isn't having any of it. "[pc.name] helped us build this temple, Sally; [pc.heShe]'s helped me come this far. As far as I'm concerned, [pc.heShe]'s not a freelancer and isn't to be treated like someone who just walked in off the street and asked to play the role of a sacred harlot for a day. As for being taken care of, [pc.names] proven that [pc.heShe] can take care of [pc.himHer]self, so you don't have to worry about that. If anything should happen to [pc.himHer] while in our temple, I'll personally take responsibility for it." [pc.bgMulti courtesan slumrat |Look, you aren't a complete greenhorn at this — you were a courtesan before you had to beat a quick retreat to the Marches, after all. Even if the Temple of Mallach dresses up the act in its own brand of mysticism and assigns meaning to the act which isn't usually found elsewhere, some things just don't change, do they? Rest assured, you're fully aware of the ins and outs of turning tricks, even if one pretties it up nicely with flowery words and nice silks |Look, you understand her concerns, but you're more than capable of handling yourself. You grew up on the streets, and you've had to do things which one mightn't exactly be proud of... including those of a sexual nature. While you're sure that a Mallachite temple holds itself to a higher standard than some guttersnipe sucking cocks in an alley in order to make ends meet, this isn't your first time on this ride, even if it was under different circumstances |All right, you understand Sally's concern, but at the same time you've experienced a lot while on this journey, starting with the demon cult. Suffice to say that you're not a stranger to the idea at this point, and everyone's got to start somewhere ]. "I'm just trying to keep the temple running and [pc.name] safe, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]." "And this is a temple of passion, not a counting-house! We serve a higher calling!" Salwah looks like she's going to protest further, then turns her ears down and takes a long drag on her hookah, letting thick spice smoke run through her nose. "Looks like I've been overruled, then. I don't like it one bit — you've no training in temple ways, you don't have a brand, which isn't just for show, and we have to be responsible for you while... well, whatever. Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] believes in you, and that's got to be good enough; I'll give you the same talk that my old temple matron gave me on the first day of the job: "You're not in a whorehouse or a boudoir, you're in a Temple of Mallach and you're a sacred harlot — or in your case, you're playing the role of one, I guess. That means you're here to help people find their passions in a safe and constructive manner; it's not about you, it's about them and I expect you to behave as such. On the other hand, petitioners have to respect you — if they don't, Imad's here to break their faces and send them out the door. I know people around these parts largely know of temples and the Jassiran way from sailors' stories and the like, and there's no reason we need to play into those false stereotypes of us being glorified whorehouses. Everyone's to conduct themselves appropriately as befits our patron god." Do you get paid? "Temple harlots are given a stipend from the donations received in their name, yes," Sally replies. "A small one to serve as spending money and encouragement to do their best, given that the temple takes care of all their needs. Of course, if petitioners like you enough that they want to give you trinkets and keepsakes, you're more than welcome to keep those all to yourself. Do you have any more questions?" No, that's about it. "Marvelous." Regaining some of her good humor, Salwah gives you a cheeky, fang-toothed smile and relaxes, her body slumping back into a more feline posture as the chococat leans back into her recliner. "If you want to get started, you're welcome to do so anytime during opening hours. See me, and we'll see what options you have for being put to work."

[pc.bgMulti courtesan slumrat |听着，你在这方面其实并不是完全的外行——毕竟，在被迫撤退到边境地区之前，你也曾是一名舞女。即使马拉克神殿用自己特有的神秘主义色彩来包装这一行为，并赋予它一些其他地方所没有的意义，但有些事情终究是不变的，对吧？放心，你完全了解这些把戏的来龙去脉，只不过这些说法被用华丽的辞藻和精美的丝绸包装得更加漂亮罢了。 |听着，你明白她的担忧，但你完全有能力处理好自己面临的事情。你在街头长大，不得不做一些可能并不值得骄傲的事……包括一些与性相关的事情。虽然你相信马拉克信徒神庙所坚持的标准，肯定比那些为了生存而在小巷里出卖自己的卑鄙之徒要高得多，但这对你来说已经不是第一次经历这种事了，只不过之前的环境有所不同而已。 |好吧，你理解莎莉的担忧，但同时，在这段旅程中你也经历了很多，从遇到那个恶魔崇拜组织开始。可以说，现在你对这类事情已经不再陌生了，而且每个人都不可能一开始就懂得该怎么做。 ]我只是在努力让这座寺庙能够继续运转下去而已[pc.name]安全，凯特[silly |前辈 ]这里可是充满激情的地方，而不是记账的地方！我们肩负着更崇高的使命！” 萨尔瓦似乎还想继续抗议，但最终她低下了头，深深地吸了一口水烟，让浓郁的香料烟雾充满鼻腔。“看来我的意见被否决了……我一点也不喜欢这样——你既没有接受过与这座神庙相关的训练，也没有属于自己的品牌，而品牌可不仅仅是用来做样子的。在我们照顾你的这段时间里……唉，总之，凯特，我实在无法接受这一点。[silly |前辈 ]我相信你，这就已经足够了。我会告诉你我和我以前的寺庙女主管在入职第一天时听到的同样的话： “你并不在妓院或闺房里，你是在玛拉赫的神庙里，你是一名神圣的妓女——或者说，在你的情况下，你正在扮演这样的角色吧。这意味着你的职责是帮助人们以安全、积极的方式找到自己的兴趣所在；重点在于帮助他人，而不是你自己，我也期望你能始终秉持这一宗旨来行事。另一方面，那些提出请求的人也必须尊重你——如果他们不尊重你，伊马德会在那里制止他们，把他们赶出去。我知道这一带的人们大多是通过水手们的故事之类的途径了解到寺庙以及贾西兰教义的，我们没有必要去迎合那些将我们视为“高级妓院”的错误刻板印象。每个人都应该举止得体，以符合我们守护神的尊严。你们有工资拿吗？” “是的，寺庙中的那些女侍者会从以她们的名义收到的捐款中获得一笔津贴，”莎莉回答道。小这些钱既可以作为零花钱，也可以用来激励人们更加努力地工作，因为寺庙已经满足了他们的所有需求。当然，如果那些请求帮助的人非常喜欢你，想要送你一些小礼物或纪念品，你完全可以把它们都收下。你还有其他问题吗？” “没有，就这些了。” “太好了。”萨尔瓦重新恢复了些许好心情，她调皮地露出露齿而笑的表情，放松下来，身体重新呈现出那种猫一般的姿态，而巧克力则靠在躺椅上，整个人也显得轻松自在。如果你想开始工作，欢迎在营业时间内随时来找我。我们再看看你有哪些可行的选择。
rows.raw: " Sally arches an eyebrow at you from where she's sprawled out on the couch. "You'd like to help tend to the petitioners?" Is that a problem? You'd imagine in the history of the temple there've been at least a handful of people with that particular kink, right? "Oh no, there've been more than a handful of people who want to play prostitute, and there are certain establishments who cater to that kink back home in Jassira. This, unfortunately, isn't one of them. Sacred harlots don't turn tricks; their goal is to help people channel their passions in beautiful and constructive manners, and if sex happens to be one of those avenues..." "Come on, Sally," Cait says[party.has cait | from beside you |, appearing in the western hallways with her arms crossed under her bust ]. "Letter of the word, spirit of the word. You know exactly what the old temple matron was saying underneath all those euphemisms. You don't serve the passions by putting hurdles of red tape in front of people with desires for no good reason." "Be reasonable, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]. Let's say we put aside all temple bureaucracy, mysticism, ritual and esotericism. Let's say we disregard all the training we went through for the role. If we let [pc.name] work the petitioners [pc.heShe]'s going to reflect on us, because they're going to assume [pc.heShe]'s a Mallachite. On the other side of that coin, we're also going to be responsible for what happens to [pc.himHer] while [pc.heShe]'s in our care — if a petitioner gets troublesome or [pc.heShe] happens to catch something while seeing to the faithful, we'll be liable. There's a reason why no temple ever allows freelancers." Your pink-haired kitten clearly isn't having any of it. "[pc.name] helped us build this temple, Sally; [pc.heShe]'s helped me come this far. As far as I'm concerned, [pc.heShe]'s not a freelancer and isn't to be treated like someone who just walked in off the street and asked to play the role of a sacred harlot for a day. As for being taken care of, [pc.names] proven that [pc.heShe] can take care of [pc.himHer]self, so you don't have to worry about that. If anything should happen to [pc.himHer] while in our temple, I'll personally take responsibility for it." [pc.bgMulti courtesan slumrat |Look, you aren't a complete greenhorn at this — you were a courtesan before you had to beat a quick retreat to the Marches, after all. Even if the Temple of Mallach dresses up the act in its own brand of mysticism and assigns meaning to the act which isn't usually found elsewhere, some things just don't change, do they? Rest assured, you're fully aware of the ins and outs of turning tricks, even if one pretties it up nicely with flowery words and nice silks |Look, you understand her concerns, but you're more than capable of handling yourself. You grew up on the streets, and you've had to do things which one mightn't exactly be proud of... including those of a sexual nature. While you're sure that a Mallachite temple holds itself to a higher standard than some guttersnipe sucking cocks in an alley in order to make ends meet, this isn't your first time on this ride, even if it was under different circumstances |All right, you understand Sally's concern, but at the same time you've experienced a lot while on this journey, starting with the demon cult. Suffice to say that you're not a stranger to the idea at this point, and everyone's got to start somewhere ]. "I'm just trying to keep the temple running and [pc.name] safe, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]." "And this is a temple of passion, not a counting-house! We serve a higher calling!" Salwah looks like she's going to protest further, then turns her ears down and takes a long drag on her hookah, letting thick spice smoke run through her nose. "Looks like I've been overruled, then. I don't like it one bit — you've no training in temple ways, you don't have a brand, which isn't just for show, and we have to be responsible for you while... well, whatever. Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] believes in you, and that's got to be good enough; I'll give you the same talk that my old temple matron gave me on the first day of the job: "You're not in a whorehouse or a boudoir, you're in a Temple of Mallach and you're a sacred harlot — or in your case, you're playing the role of one, I guess. That means you're here to help people find their passions in a safe and constructive manner; it's not about you, it's about them and I expect you to behave as such. On the other hand, petitioners have to respect you — if they don't, Imad's here to break their faces and send them out the door. I know people around these parts largely know of temples and the Jassiran way from sailors' stories and the like, and there's no reason we need to play into those false stereotypes of us being glorified whorehouses. Everyone's to conduct themselves appropriately as befits our patron god." Do you get paid? "Temple harlots are given a stipend from the donations received in their name, yes," Sally replies. "A small one to serve as spending money and encouragement to do their best, given that the temple takes care of all their needs. Of course, if petitioners like you enough that they want to give you trinkets and keepsakes, you're more than welcome to keep those all to yourself. Do you have any more questions?" No, that's about it. "Marvelous." Regaining some of her good humor, Salwah gives you a cheeky, fang-toothed smile and relaxes, her body slumping back into a more feline posture as the chococat leans back into her recliner. "If you want to get started, you're welcome to do so anytime during opening hours. See me, and we'll see what options you have for being put to work." "

rows.original: As Sally puffs contently from her hookah, Cait takes you aside and squeezes your arm reassuringly. "I hope Sally didn't put you off too much from that. I know someone has to balance the temple's books[party.has cait | while I'm gone ], but she just becomes so dry and humorless when it comes to money, she reminds me of my aunts from Dad's side of the family. You know, the bean-counters who run the treasury." You noticed. The usually playful Salwah turning into an accountant down to her manner of speech... "Don't you worry about it, she's like that. Tell you what — if you're worried about helping the petitioners, I'd be willing to join you anytime you're up for it. A temple matron's got to be willing to get down and dirty herself — can't ask the harlots to do anyone she wouldn't do herself, isn't that right?" Hah, that's right. "I really do think Sally's a bit too short-sighted when it comes to these things," Cait continues, bubbling over with excitement at the prospect of you dipping your toes into the waters of her trade. "She may be the reason the temple's able to run so well at cost, but at the same time she keeps on telling me that I can't keep on giving freebies... well! This isn't Jassira, things work differently here, and if we're to reach the locals sometimes the message has to be couched in terms people understand, don't you think? And that means letting petitioners see someone who's both familiar and exotic at the same time." That would mean you? "Yep!" Cait prods you straight in the [pc.chest]. "[var0 |It's not every day that people actually manage to see a godsworn, let alone have their needs tended to by one! That's something that even the grand temples in the major Jassiran cities don't have, but we have you! Sally really needs to see the opportunity in this." Mallach won't have a problem with a dedicant of another deity turning tricks in his home? "I wouldn't worry about it," Cait replies with a wink. "If I know my doctrine, he'd actually be pretty pleased about the prospect; it's not as if passion isn't something that everyone shares. You're my friend, after all, and it's not like there's a major religious conflict going on or anything. No reason why that should get in the way of you helping to minister to the dedicants." Well, you're glad to know that Cait has such faith in you. At this point, you're obligated to give it your all to prove that her confidence here isn't misplaced. |You're a marcher baron[pc.mf | |ess ], aren't you? Wouldn't that be a pleasant surprise, coming to the temple to find the local [pc.mf |lord |lady ] tending to the petitioners' needs — everyone always thinks they're the ones ordering the services, not providing them! I'm sure the tale will be carrying quite a distance through the Marches before long!" Well... it is a common pastime of people to grouse about the government fucking them. You're sure that plenty of people would line up to have the opportunity to fuck you back. "Aww, don't say that," Cait replies, giving you a friendly nudge on the shoulder. "You're not that bad of a baron[pc.mf | |ess ] yourself, I'm sure people don't outright hate you. Think of it as... as a novelty! Getting to be intimate with a bona fide blueblood!" [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat courtesan |Well, technically that's true... but then life is full of surprises. You never thought you'd end up landed, noble or not, and yet here you are today. Well, if that's something people are willing to pay for, then you're more than willing to leverage it to help Cait's temple. "Of course they are!" Cait beams. "My mother wouldn't have been able to command half the price she did if it weren't for her lineage. It may not mean much otherwise, but people will pay for the privilege, [pc.name]!" |You'd never have thought that you of all people would rise to the gutter to wind up doing what you once hated as a necessity as pleasure, but there you have it. "It just shows how much you've come up in the world since then!" Cait beams. "That's why consent and not forcing people is so important in the Mallachite faith — it poisons what would otherwise have been constructive passions into resentment and misery." Maybe having been on both sides of the fence will make you more effective as a marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ]... "That's the spirit! Now go out there and spread your passions when you're well and ready — I'll be there beside you if you need it!" |It truly is a strange feeling — that while you were working the nobles in the days before you had to leave the city, you often wanted to be one of them to be able to leave the courtesan's life. And now that you have, and by becoming one of them no less, you're heading straight back for the vestiges of your old life... ...Oh well. You can take the courtesan out of the boudoir, but you can't take the boudoir out of the courtesan. And maybe it's better this way. "Hey, nothing says you can't be both! Many initiates come from noble standing in the sultanate, I'll have you know!" Cait beams. "It's a perfectly honorable path for the spares once its become clear that, well, they'll no longer be needed as the spare... and it's a good life, I'll personally vouch for that!" |It still kind of boggles you that you've risen this far in the world in so short a time, but you think you're taking it in stride pretty well. And if blowing off a little steam by helping out at a friend's temple is what you want to do, then by the gods, if anyone has the right to do so it's you as marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ]. Certainly a little play-prostitution is tame compared to the appetites other members of your newfound social class have had. "You don't have worry about anything!" Cait beams. "I'm the temple matron here, and if you need any help from me, all you have to do is ask! I think it's a very noble and nice thing you're doing, volunteering to help out, and while Sally isn't wrong in her reasoning I know you well enough to bend the rules a little for you! You're just that special, not just to me but everyone else!" Gods, she's laying it on really thick, isn't she? "Yes, but all of it is true!" ] Cait's really enthusiastic about the prospect of you turning tricks in her temple, and hey, she might even be right about people lining up to be serviced by their marcher baron[pc.mf | |ess ]. If nothing else, it's a way of meeting your local [pc.mf |lord |lady ] that'll leave a lasting impression for a long time. |You've already established yourself as some kind of local hero — after all, the first thing you did was to help a cute pink cat whom you had absolutely no relation to and no reason to bother with!" Well, that is true, but you do think she's overselling it a little... "Then you went around town solving peoples' problems in short order, putting to rest in days troubles that had been plaguing them for weeks, months, or even years! I've lost count of all the folk whose troubles and worries you've put paid to in the last handful of days, even if it might not always have been out of pure altruism! Yes, [pc.name], you're a local hero, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise!" Looking at a beaming Cait, her sincerity smacks you upside the head like a weighted maul — she truly and really believes every word she's saying. [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan scholar acolyte slumrat |Well, being a hero to the people wasn't exactly what you had in mind when you decided to strike out on your own, but it hasn't been that bad so far. Bringing the nobility down to earth and into their lives as opposed to being some lofty, distant person one would never see — it's worked out well for you so far |For most of your career, you'd expected to be the one singing the tales or at best composing them, not doing the deeds that would form their base. That being said, one supposes there's no better way of getting material than firsthand experience of the events, is there? No, there isn't |%"Hero" was the furthest thing from your mind when you had to quit the city, but it's not that bad of a gig, and to be frank you're getting to ply your trade, just in a more freelance manner |You wouldn't have seen yourself in anything but a quiet life of academia just a couple years ago, and here you are, making the stories instead of simply archiving them. For what it's worth, it is more exciting this way, although there can be too much of a good thing, too |You wouldn't have seen yourself in anything but a quiet life of monasticism just a couple years ago, and here you are, making the legends instead of simply archiving them. For what it's worth, it is more exciting this way, although there can be too much of a good thing, too |If anyone had told you people would look up to you several years before, you'd have laughed in their face. Now, as it turns out, the gods are the ones laughing — and they've really got a sense of humor in elevating a gutter rat like you to being Hawkethorne's savior. But in a way, it does make sense. The world's taught you good and hard that no one's going to look out for the little people except maybe other little people, and if that's what you've shaped up to be, the mold you've fallen into then who are you to deny it? Not you |Cait really does mean everything she said wholeheartedly, and she's by far more willing to give voice to her actual thoughts that most people in Hawkethorne are. If she says it, most people probably believe it even if they aren't about to voice it out loud ]. Only question is, does your newfound status as a folk hero actually translate to people wanting to use your, uh, services while you're moonlighting at her temple? "Of course it will! Have you never heard of hero worship, [pc.name]? You'll be swamped in all manner of people wanting to know their local legend in a very intimate manner!" They could just come up and ask you, really... Cait's jovial face turns serious. "No, they can't. A lot of people are quite shy, especially around those they admire. Having some kind of structure, some kind of reassurance that everything won't go to pot and they won't make a fool of themselves — why, it's part of what the temple is here for, [pc.name]. To give people just that bit of confidence they need. So yes, I think it's a very noble and nice thing you're doing, volunteering to help out, and while Sally isn't wrong in her reasoning I know you well enough to bend the rules a little for you! You're just that special, not just to me but everyone else!" Gods, she's laying it on really thick, isn't she? "Yes, but all of it is true!" ] All in all, though, Salwah's right, yes? You go find her when you do want to work the petitioners? "We-ll, Sally's the one who keeps the books straight, so bothering her whenever anything involves the temple's money is a good idea. That being said, I'll always be around in some fashion, so you can ask me out if you need any moral support at any point; I'll make the time for you!" Cute. All right, then, you'll keep her offer in mind. Actually, you might take her up on that offer right now since this is about to be your first time working at her temple...
rows.translation: 当莎莉心满意足地抽着水烟时，凯特把你拉到一旁，安抚地捏了捏你的手臂：“希望莎莉没因为这个让你太反感。我知道总得有人替神庙理账[party.has cait | 我不在的时候 ]，可一谈到钱，她就变得那么干巴巴、毫无幽默感，让我想起我父亲那边的姑妈姨妈们。你知道的，就是那些管着国库的老会计。” 你注意到了。平时那么俏皮的萨尔瓦，一谈起钱来，连说话的方式都变得像会计一样…… “别为这个担心，她就是这样。这样吧——如果你在帮忙接待请愿者这件事上有顾虑，只要你有兴致，我随时都愿意陪你一起去。神庙的主母自己也得愿意亲自下场干脏活——总不能要求那些妓女去接待她自己都不肯接待的人吧，对不对？” 哈，说得对。 “我真心觉得，莎莉在这些事上有点太短视了，”凯特接着说道，一想到你要涉足她这一行的水域，她就兴奋得滔滔不绝。“她也许正是神庙能以低成本运转得这么好的原因，可同时她又老是跟我说，我不能再白送东西了……唉！这里可不是贾西拉，这儿的规矩不一样。我们要想打动本地人，有时候就得用他们听得懂的话来包装，你不觉得吗？而这就意味着要让请愿者看到一个既熟悉又带着异域风情的人。” 那说的就是你自己？ “没错！”凯特直接戳了戳你的[pc.chest]。[var0 |“人们可不是每天都能真正见到一位神誓者的，更别说让神誓者来照料自己的需求了！就连贾西拉各大城市里的宏伟神庙都没有这样的条件，可我们有你！莎莉真该看到这里头的机会。” 马拉克不会介意别的神明的信徒在他家里接客吧？ “要我说，这不用担心，”凯特眨了眨眼回答。“要是我没记错教义，他其实还挺乐见其成的；毕竟激情这东西人人都该有份。你毕竟是我的朋友，而且眼下也没什么大规模宗教冲突之类的。没道理让这种事妨碍你去帮忙照料那些信徒。” 凯特对你这么有信心，你听了很高兴。事到如今，你有义务全力以赴，证明她这份信任并没有错付。 |“你是一位边疆[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]，不是吗？来到神庙，却发现本地的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]正在照料请愿者的需求——大家总以为自己是掏钱买服务的那一方，而不是提供服务的那一方！我敢说，用不了多久，这个故事就会传遍整个边境地区！” 好吧……抱怨政府操自己，本来就是民众惯常的消遣。你确信会有不少人排着队，等着有机会反过来操你。 “哎呀，别这么说嘛，”凯特回答，友好地推了推你的肩膀。“你这位[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]也没那么糟糕，我相信大家并不会真的讨厌你。把这当成一种……新奇体验吧！能跟一位货真价实的蓝血贵族亲密接触，也算是件有趣的事吧！” [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat courtesan |嗯，严格来说这话不假……可生活总是充满意外。你从没想过自己会拥有一块封地，不管封没封爵，可如今你就站在这里。好吧，如果人们愿意为这个掏钱，那你也非常乐意拿它当筹码，去帮凯特的神庙。 “他们当然愿意！”凯特笑容满面。“要不是沾了血统的光，我母亲根本拿不到她当年那样的价钱。这身份在别处也许算不了什么，但人们就是愿意为这份特权掏钱，[pc.name]！” |你从前怎么也想不到，偏偏是你这样的人会从阴沟里爬起来，最终把当年迫于生计才做的、自己一度憎恶的事，当成了享乐；可事实就是如此。 “这恰恰说明，从那时起你在世上混得多有起色！”凯特笑容满面。“这就是为什么在马拉克教派信仰里，自愿而非强迫如此重要——强迫会把本可以富有建设性的激情毒化成怨恨与痛苦。” 也许正因为你在两边都待过，会让你做起边疆[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]来更得心应手…… “这才对嘛！等你养足了精神、准备好了，就出去把你的激情散播开来吧——你要是需要，我会陪在你身边！” |这感觉确实很奇妙——在你不得不离开那座城市之前的日子里，你周旋于那些贵族之间，常常希望自己也能成为他们中的一员，好摆脱名妓的生活。而如今你真的成了他们中的一员，还是靠变成他们中的一员做到的，你却又要径直回到旧日生活的残影里去了…… ……哦，算了。你可以把名妓带出闺房，却没法把闺房从名妓心里拿走。也许这样反倒更好。 “嘿，谁说你不能两者兼得呢！苏丹国里很多入教者本来就出身贵族，这你可得知道！”凯特笑容满面。“对那些一旦弄清楚自己不再被需要当作‘备选’的人来说，这条路完全称得上体面光荣……而且这种日子很不错，我个人可以担保！” |在这么短的时间里就在世上爬到了这个位置，这仍然让你有点难以置信，不过你觉得自己适应得还挺不错。而如果你就是想靠在朋友的神庙里帮衬一下来散散心，那么，凭诸神起誓，要说谁有这个资格，那就是身为边疆[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]的你。跟你这个新晋社会阶层里其他成员有过的胃口相比，一点小小的玩票式卖身实在算不上什么。 “你什么都不用担心！”凯特笑容满面。“我是这里的神庙主母，你要是需要我帮忙，开口就行！你自愿来帮忙，我觉得这是件非常高尚又美好的事；莎莉的推理虽然没错，但我太了解你了，愿意为你稍微破个例！你就是那么特别，不只对我来说，对所有人来说都是！” 天哪，她这话说得可真是够夸张的，不是吗？ “是啊，可这些话全都是真的！” ] 凯特对你要在她神庙里接客这件事热情高涨，而且，嘿，说不定她说得对——真会有人排队等着让他们的边疆[pc.mf |男爵 |女男爵 ]为他们服务。退一步说，这也是认识本地[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]的一种方式，能给人留下长久而深刻的印象。 |“你早就给自己树立起了某种本地英雄的形象——毕竟，你做的第一件事就是帮了一只可爱的粉色猫咪，而你跟它八竿子打不着，也完全没有理由去搭理它！” 嗯，这话不假，不过你觉得她确实吹得有点过了…… “接着你在镇上四处奔走，三下五除二就解决了人们的问题，把困扰了他们数周、数月甚至数年的麻烦在几天之内就平息了！这几天里你替多少人解决了麻烦和忧愁，我数都数不清了，哪怕你的动机并不总是那么纯粹无私！没错，[pc.name]，你就是本地的英雄，别让任何人否定这一点！” 看着笑容灿烂的凯特，她的真诚像一柄配重的重锤狠狠砸在你脑袋上——她真的、确确实实相信着自己说的每一个字。[pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan scholar acolyte slumrat |嗯，当初决定独自闯荡时，成为人民心目中的英雄并不是你的打算，不过到目前为止还不算太糟。让贵族走下神坛、走进他们的生活，而不是做一个高高在上、谁也见不着的遥远人物——到目前为止，这招对你挺管用 |在你职业生涯的大部分时间里，你本以为自己是那个传唱故事、至多是编排故事的人，而不是去做出那些构成故事底本的事迹。话虽如此，想来再没有比亲身经历事件更好的取材方式了，对吧？确实没有 |%被迫离开那座城市时，“英雄”这个念头离你最远不过了，但这活儿倒也不赖，而且说实话，你仍然能施展自己的手艺，只是方式更自由散漫了些 |就在几年前，你根本无法想象自己会过上除安静学术生活之外的日子，而如今你却在这里创造故事，而不只是把它们归档保存。不管怎么说，这样确实是更刺激，虽说好东西也可能过头 |就在几年前，你根本无法想象自己会过上除清修隐居之外的日子，而如今你却在这里创造传奇，而不只是把它们归档保存。不管怎么说，这样确实是更刺激，虽说好东西也可能过头 |要是几年前有人告诉你，人们会敬仰你，你一定会当面笑出声来。如今事实证明，笑的是诸神——他们还真有幽默感，居然把你这样一条阴沟里的老鼠抬举成鹰棘镇的救世主。 不过从某种角度说，这确实说得通。这个世界已经狠狠教会你：除了也许同样的小人物之外，没人会去照看小人物。如果那就是你长成的样子、你落进的模子，那你又凭什么否认它呢？你不会否认 |凯特说的每一句话都是真心实意的，而且她比鹰棘镇的大多数人都更愿意把真实想法说出口。只要是她说的，大多数人大概都会相信，哪怕他们自己不会说出来 ]。 唯一的问题是，你在她神庙里兼职的时候，这个新得的“民间英雄”身份，真能让人愿意来光顾你那、呃，服务吗？ “那当然会啦！你难道从没听说过英雄崇拜吗，[pc.name]？你会被各种各样的人挤破门槛，他们都想以非常亲密的方式认识一下本地的传奇人物！” 他们其实可以直接过来问你啊…… 凯特快活的表情变得严肃起来。“不，他们不能。很多人相当害羞，尤其是在自己仰慕的人面前。得有点规矩、有点保障，让他们确信一切不会搞砸、自己也不会出丑——哎呀，这正是神庙存在的意义之一啊，[pc.name]。就是为了给人们那一点点他们需要的自信。所以没错，我觉得你自愿来帮忙，是件非常高尚又美好的事；莎莉的推理虽然没错，但我太了解你了，愿意为你稍微破个例！你就是那么特别，不只对我来说，对所有人来说都是！” 天哪，她这话说得可真是够夸张的，不是吗？ “是啊，可这些话全都是真的！” ] 不过总的来说，萨尔瓦说得对，是吧？你真想接待请愿者的时候，就去找她？ “嗯——这个嘛，账目是莎莉管着的，所以凡是牵扯到神庙的钱，去烦她准没错。话虽如此，我总会以某种方式待在附近，所以你要是任何时候需要点精神支持，都可以来约我；我会为你腾出时间的！” 真贴心。好吧，那你就把她的提议记在心上。其实，你也许现在就该接受她的提议，因为这马上就要是你第一次在她神庙里干活了……
rows.raw: " As Sally puffs contently from her hookah, Cait takes you aside and squeezes your arm reassuringly. "I hope Sally didn't put you off too much from that. I know someone has to balance the temple's books[party.has cait | while I'm gone ], but she just becomes so dry and humorless when it comes to money, she reminds me of my aunts from Dad's side of the family. You know, the bean-counters who run the treasury." You noticed. The usually playful Salwah turning into an accountant down to her manner of speech... "Don't you worry about it, she's like that. Tell you what — if you're worried about helping the petitioners, I'd be willing to join you anytime you're up for it. A temple matron's got to be willing to get down and dirty herself — can't ask the harlots to do anyone she wouldn't do herself, isn't that right?" Hah, that's right. "I really do think Sally's a bit too short-sighted when it comes to these things," Cait continues, bubbling over with excitement at the prospect of you dipping your toes into the waters of her trade. "She may be the reason the temple's able to run so well at cost, but at the same time she keeps on telling me that I can't keep on giving freebies... well! This isn't Jassira, things work differently here, and if we're to reach the locals sometimes the message has to be couched in terms people understand, don't you think? And that means letting petitioners see someone who's both familiar and exotic at the same time." That would mean you? "Yep!" Cait prods you straight in the [pc.chest]. "[var0 |It's not every day that people actually manage to see a godsworn, let alone have their needs tended to by one! That's something that even the grand temples in the major Jassiran cities don't have, but we have you! Sally really needs to see the opportunity in this." Mallach won't have a problem with a dedicant of another deity turning tricks in his home? "I wouldn't worry about it," Cait replies with a wink. "If I know my doctrine, he'd actually be pretty pleased about the prospect; it's not as if passion isn't something that everyone shares. You're my friend, after all, and it's not like there's a major religious conflict going on or anything. No reason why that should get in the way of you helping to minister to the dedicants." Well, you're glad to know that Cait has such faith in you. At this point, you're obligated to give it your all to prove that her confidence here isn't misplaced. |You're a marcher baron[pc.mf | |ess ], aren't you? Wouldn't that be a pleasant surprise, coming to the temple to find the local [pc.mf |lord |lady ] tending to the petitioners' needs — everyone always thinks they're the ones ordering the services, not providing them! I'm sure the tale will be carrying quite a distance through the Marches before long!" Well... it is a common pastime of people to grouse about the government fucking them. You're sure that plenty of people would line up to have the opportunity to fuck you back. "Aww, don't say that," Cait replies, giving you a friendly nudge on the shoulder. "You're not that bad of a baron[pc.mf | |ess ] yourself, I'm sure people don't outright hate you. Think of it as... as a novelty! Getting to be intimate with a bona fide blueblood!" [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat courtesan |Well, technically that's true... but then life is full of surprises. You never thought you'd end up landed, noble or not, and yet here you are today. Well, if that's something people are willing to pay for, then you're more than willing to leverage it to help Cait's temple. "Of course they are!" Cait beams. "My mother wouldn't have been able to command half the price she did if it weren't for her lineage. It may not mean much otherwise, but people will pay for the privilege, [pc.name]!" |You'd never have thought that you of all people would rise to the gutter to wind up doing what you once hated as a necessity as pleasure, but there you have it. "It just shows how much you've come up in the world since then!" Cait beams. "That's why consent and not forcing people is so important in the Mallachite faith — it poisons what would otherwise have been constructive passions into resentment and misery." Maybe having been on both sides of the fence will make you more effective as a marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ]... "That's the spirit! Now go out there and spread your passions when you're well and ready — I'll be there beside you if you need it!" |It truly is a strange feeling — that while you were working the nobles in the days before you had to leave the city, you often wanted to be one of them to be able to leave the courtesan's life. And now that you have, and by becoming one of them no less, you're heading straight back for the vestiges of your old life... ...Oh well. You can take the courtesan out of the boudoir, but you can't take the boudoir out of the courtesan. And maybe it's better this way. "Hey, nothing says you can't be both! Many initiates come from noble standing in the sultanate, I'll have you know!" Cait beams. "It's a perfectly honorable path for the spares once its become clear that, well, they'll no longer be needed as the spare... and it's a good life, I'll personally vouch for that!" |It still kind of boggles you that you've risen this far in the world in so short a time, but you think you're taking it in stride pretty well. And if blowing off a little steam by helping out at a friend's temple is what you want to do, then by the gods, if anyone has the right to do so it's you as marcher-baron[pc.mf | |ess ]. Certainly a little play-prostitution is tame compared to the appetites other members of your newfound social class have had. "You don't have worry about anything!" Cait beams. "I'm the temple matron here, and if you need any help from me, all you have to do is ask! I think it's a very noble and nice thing you're doing, volunteering to help out, and while Sally isn't wrong in her reasoning I know you well enough to bend the rules a little for you! You're just that special, not just to me but everyone else!" Gods, she's laying it on really thick, isn't she? "Yes, but all of it is true!" ] Cait's really enthusiastic about the prospect of you turning tricks in her temple, and hey, she might even be right about people lining up to be serviced by their marcher baron[pc.mf | |ess ]. If nothing else, it's a way of meeting your local [pc.mf |lord |lady ] that'll leave a lasting impression for a long time. |You've already established yourself as some kind of local hero — after all, the first thing you did was to help a cute pink cat whom you had absolutely no relation to and no reason to bother with!" Well, that is true, but you do think she's overselling it a little... "Then you went around town solving peoples' problems in short order, putting to rest in days troubles that had been plaguing them for weeks, months, or even years! I've lost count of all the folk whose troubles and worries you've put paid to in the last handful of days, even if it might not always have been out of pure altruism! Yes, [pc.name], you're a local hero, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise!" Looking at a beaming Cait, her sincerity smacks you upside the head like a weighted maul — she truly and really believes every word she's saying. [pc.bgMulti noblescion minstrel courtesan scholar acolyte slumrat |Well, being a hero to the people wasn't exactly what you had in mind when you decided to strike out on your own, but it hasn't been that bad so far. Bringing the nobility down to earth and into their lives as opposed to being some lofty, distant person one would never see — it's worked out well for you so far |For most of your career, you'd expected to be the one singing the tales or at best composing them, not doing the deeds that would form their base. That being said, one supposes there's no better way of getting material than firsthand experience of the events, is there? No, there isn't |%"Hero" was the furthest thing from your mind when you had to quit the city, but it's not that bad of a gig, and to be frank you're getting to ply your trade, just in a more freelance manner |You wouldn't have seen yourself in anything but a quiet life of academia just a couple years ago, and here you are, making the stories instead of simply archiving them. For what it's worth, it is more exciting this way, although there can be too much of a good thing, too |You wouldn't have seen yourself in anything but a quiet life of monasticism just a couple years ago, and here you are, making the legends instead of simply archiving them. For what it's worth, it is more exciting this way, although there can be too much of a good thing, too |If anyone had told you people would look up to you several years before, you'd have laughed in their face. Now, as it turns out, the gods are the ones laughing — and they've really got a sense of humor in elevating a gutter rat like you to being Hawkethorne's savior. But in a way, it does make sense. The world's taught you good and hard that no one's going to look out for the little people except maybe other little people, and if that's what you've shaped up to be, the mold you've fallen into then who are you to deny it? Not you |Cait really does mean everything she said wholeheartedly, and she's by far more willing to give voice to her actual thoughts that most people in Hawkethorne are. If she says it, most people probably believe it even if they aren't about to voice it out loud ]. Only question is, does your newfound status as a folk hero actually translate to people wanting to use your, uh, services while you're moonlighting at her temple? "Of course it will! Have you never heard of hero worship, [pc.name]? You'll be swamped in all manner of people wanting to know their local legend in a very intimate manner!" They could just come up and ask you, really... Cait's jovial face turns serious. "No, they can't. A lot of people are quite shy, especially around those they admire. Having some kind of structure, some kind of reassurance that everything won't go to pot and they won't make a fool of themselves — why, it's part of what the temple is here for, [pc.name]. To give people just that bit of confidence they need. So yes, I think it's a very noble and nice thing you're doing, volunteering to help out, and while Sally isn't wrong in her reasoning I know you well enough to bend the rules a little for you! You're just that special, not just to me but everyone else!" Gods, she's laying it on really thick, isn't she? "Yes, but all of it is true!" ] All in all, though, Salwah's right, yes? You go find her when you do want to work the petitioners? "We-ll, Sally's the one who keeps the books straight, so bothering her whenever anything involves the temple's money is a good idea. That being said, I'll always be around in some fashion, so you can ask me out if you need any moral support at any point; I'll make the time for you!" Cute. All right, then, you'll keep her offer in mind. Actually, you might take her up on that offer right now since this is about to be your first time working at her temple... "

凯特与萨尔瓦

rows.original: "But of course," Salwah purrs, smiling broadly. "Since the matron has ordered it, I don't see how I can deny you. Come with me and let's get you looking the part, shall we?" Salwah rises from her recliner and takes you gently by the wrist, leading you to the temple's living quarters. There, the delicious chococat bids you sit down and starts her work — she begins by stripping you of your [pc.armor] and other things, then brings out a set of sheer white silks trimmed with gold for you to wear. They're fitted perfectly to your size and shape, and while you adjust them to make yourself comfortable she starts with a little foundation upon your cheeks, followed by a light touch of makeup and a squirt of perfume. "It's not the proper bath a harlot should take before going on shift, but it'll hide the worst of the dust of the road. There, now you look presentable, if not perfect." [party.has cait |Cait, who's been watching her junior doll you up all this while, takes you by the cheeks in both hands and rubs you vigorously as she giggles with glee. To your mild surprise, the fresh cosmetics don't come straight off your face despite having just been applied; yet another temple secret, you suppose. "Ohh, [pc.name]! You look absolutely stunning in a sun-dancer's silks! I'm sure the petitioners will just eat up the sight of you!" Aah, she means well, even if she's not the most objective of judges. |Salwah's just done with putting on the finishing touches on your ensemble when the door creaks open and Cait steps into the room. The pink kitten takes one look at you all dolled up and bounds over with a squeal of delight, fussing over you while taking care not to muss her junior's handiwork. "[pc.name], [pc.name]! I heard you were coming in for a stint at the temple and rushed here as soon as I could! Don't you look absolutely amazing in those sun-dancer's silks? You really do!" Aah, there she is with her usual boundless enthusiasm. ] "So... if you're going to be making the rounds with the petitioners, do you want me with you? For fun and for moral support!" There is that, you suppose. You consider the question as Salwah slips a pair of jewelled sandals on your feet — do you want to allow Cait to accompany you while you work her temple?
rows.translation: “当然可以。”萨尔瓦发出猫一般的咕噜声，笑得无比灿烂。“既然女族长已经下令，我怎么可能拒绝你？跟我来，让我们把你打扮得符合身份，好吗？” 萨尔瓦从躺椅上起身，轻轻牵住你的手腕，带你前往神殿的起居区。这位诱人的巧克力色猫女请你坐下，开始着手打扮——她先脱去你的[pc.armor]和其他衣物，随后拿出一套镶有金边的透明白色丝衣，让你穿上。衣物完美贴合你的身材与体形；你调整衣服、让自己穿得更舒适时，她先在你双颊涂上一点粉底，又化了淡妆，最后喷上香水。 “这算不上妓女上工前该洗的正式澡，不过足以遮掩一路风尘中最糟糕的部分。好了，现在就算不够完美，至少也见得了人。” [party.has cait |凯特一直在旁观看晚辈把你装扮起来；此刻她双手捧住你的脸颊，欢喜地咯咯笑着用力揉搓。令你略感惊讶的是，才刚涂好的化妆品并未从你脸上直接脱落；你想，这又是一项神殿秘术。 “哦——[pc.name]！你穿着日舞者丝衣的模样实在美极了！请愿者们一定会被你迷得神魂颠倒！” 啊，她也是一片好意，尽管绝对算不上最客观的评判者。 |萨尔瓦才刚为整套装扮添上最后几笔，房门便吱呀开启，凯特走进房间。粉色猫女看见精心打扮的你，立刻欢叫一声扑了过来；她围着你忙前忙后，却又小心不弄乱晚辈的成果。 “[pc.name]，[pc.name]！我听说你要来神殿当一阵子妓女，就尽快赶来了！你穿着那套日舞者丝衣，难道不是漂亮极了吗？真的太漂亮了！” 啊，她又拿出了平日里那股无穷无尽的热情。 ] “所以……如果你要逐一拜访请愿者，想让我陪着吗？既能一起找乐子，又能给你精神支持！” 这倒也是。萨尔瓦将一双镶嵌珠宝的凉鞋套上你的双脚时，你思考起这个问题——在神殿里工作期间，你愿意让凯特陪同吗？

rows.translation: 终于，那个猫人男孩苏醒过来，他那双蓝色的大眼睛缓缓睁开，把大理石天花板收入眼底——还有[var0 |凯特和你 |你的脸 ]。他的呼吸依然粗重，他试着把自己从石板上撑起来，没成功，转眼又倒了回去。 “哇哦，”他喃喃道，对自己身上至少有一半沾满精液这事全然无动于衷。“这可真够劲。他们没骗我——我现在放松得连起身都不想。不，是我根本起不来。” [var0 |“而且你也硬不起来了，”凯特轻笑一声，用手指拨弄着那个猫男孩逐渐软下去的阴茎。“这也不是坏事——这说明你确实被喂得饱饱的了。这是你的第一次吗？” “嗯……是的。” “那么，它和你想象的一样吗？” 猫男孩叹了口气，又倒回石板上，盯着天花板。“不，其实不止是想象的那样。它比那还要好——我想我这辈子都要被惯坏了，对吧？” 凯特和你一同俯身到他头部的两侧，齐心协力地在这个可怜的软蛋两边脸颊上各亲了一口。他扭动了一下，脸涨得比之前更红，但还是带着几分尊严接受了这个举动。 “我觉得，对自己的第一次留下美好的回忆更好！”凯特欢快地说，在猫男孩两耳之间挠了挠。“毕竟，第一印象很重要嘛！” |而且他肯定也硬不起它来，你带着一丝笑意心想，同时戳弄着那个猫男孩逐渐软下去的阴茎，感觉它的小突起在你的手指下变得软塌塌的。好吧，这就算你赢了；它证明你确实成功地把他彻底榨干了。只是想确认一下——这是他的第一次，对吧？ “嗯……是的。” 那么，它和他想象的一样吗？ 猫男孩叹了口气，又倒回石板上，盯着天花板。“不，其实不止是想象的那样。它比那还要好——我想我这辈子都要被惯坏了，对吧？” 哎呀，这么会奉承人。他要是再这样一直夸你，你都想再来一轮了。你跪到他身边，在这个可怜的软蛋脸颊上亲了一口。他扭动了一下，脸涨得比之前更红，但还是带着几分尊严接受了这个举动。 嗯，好在他的第一次以很棒的方式令人难忘——毕竟，第一印象很重要嘛。也许他还会再回来，这一次不需要人哄…… ] “要水吗？” 你转过身，发现萨尔瓦站在门口，身边放着一辆小推车。很快就看明白了，她是在对那个猫男孩说话，同时递给他一个陶制水杯，他感激地接了过去，随后她又给[var0 |凯特和 ]你，每人都递了一杯。那只安逸的巧克力猫在经过你身边时朝你点了点头，然后从腋下抓住猫男孩，轻轻把他抱起来放到推车上。他没有抱怨——事实上，这个可怜的软蛋看起来相当感激这份帮助。 “谢谢你帮忙，接下来的照料就交给我吧。之后要么是我、要么是神庙的职员会过来清理，所以你不用担心这个。看样子你们在这里玩得挺尽兴的。等你能重新站起来的时候，回大厅来找我，好吗？我们在那儿把事情收尾。[var0 |你也一样，凯特丽丝[silly |前辈 ]——你看上去真是累坏了。 ]你还需要一段时间才能重新上路呢。” 你……你会的……
rows.raw: " At length, the catboy eventually comes to, his big blue eyes rolling open and drinking in the marble ceiling — along with [var0 |Cait and you |your face ]. His breathing still heavy, he tries to push himself off the slab, fails, and flops back down in short order. "Wow," he mutters, completely nonplussed by the fact that at least half of his person is coated in cum stains. "That was something. They weren't kidding — I'm so relaxed that I don't even want to get up. No, that I can't even get up." [var0 |"And you can't get it up, either," Cait chuckles, teasing the catboy's softening prick with a finger. "Not a bad thing, too — it lets us know that you're well and truly sated. Was this your first time?" "Um... yes." "And was it everything you'd imagined it to be?" The catboy sighs, flops back onto the slab, and stares up at the ceiling. "No, actually. It was more than that. It was very good — I think I'll be spoiled for the rest of my life, won't I?" Together, Cait and you lower yourselves to either side of his head and give the poor milksop a kiss on each cheek in unison. He squirms and manages to blush even redder than before, but accepts the gesture with some measure of dignity. "I think it's better to have a good memory of your first time!" Cait chirps, giving the catboy a scritch between the ears. "First impressions matter, after all!" |And he certainly can't get it up either, you note with a hint of mirth as you poke and prod at the catboy's softening prick, feeling its nubs turn flaccid beneath your fingers. Well, you'll take that as a win; it proves that you've succeeded in well and truly exhausting him. Just to be sure — this was his first time, right? "Um... yes." And was it everything he'd imagined it to be? The catboy sighs, flops back onto the slab, and stares up at the ceiling. "No, actually. It was more than that. It was very good — I think I'll be spoiled for the rest of my life, won't I?" Aww, such flattery. If he keeps on talking you up like this, you'll be wanting to go for another round. Getting down on your knees by his side, you give the poor milksop a kiss on the cheek. He squirms and manages to blush even redder than before, but accepts the gesture with some measure of dignity. Well, it's a good thing that his first time was memorable in a great way — first impressions matter, after all. Maybe he'll even be back, this time without prodding... ] "Water?" You turn to find Salwah at the doorway, a little trolley at her side. It soon turns out that she's speaking to the catboy as she offers him a clay tumbler of water, which he grasps gratefully, then she does the same for[var0 | Cait and ] you. The comfy chococat gives you a nod as she passes you by, then grabs the catboy by under the arm and gently lifts him up and onto the trolley. He doesn't complain — in fact, the poor milksop looks quite grateful for the assistance. "Thanks for helping out, I'll handle the aftercare from here. Either I or one of the temple staff will be in here to do the cleaning up, too, so you don't have to worry about that. Looks like you got quite frisky in here. See me back in the lobby when you can stand again, okay? We'll wrap things up there.[var0 | Same goes for you, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] — you look positively bushed. ] It'll be a little while before you're fit to go on the road again." Y-you will... "

rows.original: Salwah is good to her word — when you're able to make it back to the temple foyer, she's already back in her recliner, puffing on her hookah like nothing had ever happened[var0 | while Cait chatters excitedly to her junior ]. She looks up at you as you approach, gives you a lazy flick of her tail, then beckons you closer. "Here you go. Your portion, as per Jassirite custom to encourage the harlots to do their best." The coins clink satisfactorily in your palm, and you put them away. Salwah gives you a sweet smile, then flicks an ear in your direction. "Well, was this everything you hoped it'd be? Being a sacred harlot of a Jassirite temple?" [var0 |"Hey, this was fun!" Cait says, perking up. "Not that I mind getting down to it by myself, but being able to work the petitioners with you makes it all the more special and enjoyable, doesn't it? It's like food — much better when you share the experience with someone!" Yeah, you have to admit that the experience wouldn't have been the same if not for Cait. Not that going it alone is bad, but having her by your side and in the know alongside you is great, too. "I'm glad you agree! Ask me anytime if you want me to join you — I've got to show that I'm not against getting myself dirty on the job!" |It's certainly not an experience you get to have everyday, that's for sure. [pc.bgMulti courtesan slumrat |You've done courtesan work before, and while it's similar the religious undertones of temple harlotry add a new dimension to the acts you're performing. |You've had to do things you aren't exactly proud of in order to survive in the past, turning the act into one of duress. Here... well, even if you discounted the euphoric religious experience, it's still on your own terms. ] After all, to fuck is to worship, isn't it? ] Salwah smiles and waves airily. "I'm just glad you enjoyed yourself despite all my reservations on the matter. The temple will be open to you should you have the itch to play temple harlot again." Your share of the temple's earnings comes to [var1] EC.
rows.translation: 萨尔瓦说到做到——等你终于回到神庙门厅时，她已经坐回了躺椅上，抽着水烟，仿佛什么事都没发生过[var0 |而凯特正兴奋地跟她的后辈聊个不停 ]。你走近时，她抬头看你，懒洋洋地甩了下尾巴，然后招呼你靠近些。 “给你。这是你那份，按贾西拉人的习俗，是为了鼓励妓女们尽力而为。” 硬币在你的掌中发出令人满意的叮当声，你把它们收好。萨尔瓦朝你甜甜一笑，然后朝你的方向弹了弹一只耳朵。 “那么，这一切都如你所愿吗？当一名贾西拉人神庙的神圣妓女？” [var0 |“嘿，这次真有意思！”凯特精神一振，说道。“我倒不介意自己一个人干，但能和你一起应付请愿者，让这一切更加特别、更加享受，不是吗？就像食物一样——和别人一起分享体验会好得多！” 是啊，你得承认，要不是有凯特，这次体验就不会是同一个样子。倒不是说一个人做有什么不好，但有她在你身边、和你一起知情参与，也很棒。 “我很高兴你也这么想！想让我陪你的时候就随时叫我——我得证明我不介意在工作中把自己弄脏！” |这肯定不是天天都能有的体验，这一点毫无疑问。[pc.bgMulti courtesan slumrat |你以前做过名妓的活计，虽然有些相似，但神庙卖淫的宗教意味给你所做的事增添了新的层次。 |过去你为了活下去不得不做些自己并不引以为傲的事，那成了一种被逼无奈。而在这里……嗯，就算撇开那种令人陶醉的宗教体验，这仍然是你自愿的选择。 ]毕竟，做爱就是崇拜，不是吗？ ] 萨尔瓦微笑着，轻飘飘地挥了挥手。“尽管我对这件事有种种保留，但我很高兴你玩得开心。你要是又手痒想再当一回神庙妓女，神庙随时欢迎你。” 你分得的神庙收益共计[var1] EC。

rows.original: [flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_ROOMS |"Back for more?" Sally purrs. "I can't blame you. Working the rooms is one of the most intense and personal tasks any sacred harlot can get up to, and one can get addicted to the rush if one's not careful, be it from the intensity of it all, the rush of meeting new people, or what have you. Tell me what you're up for, and I'll see you to the rooms before matching you up with an appropriate petitioner." |"Marvelous!" Sally purrs, gently rubbing her palm to your cheek and applying some kind of fragrant powder. "Personally tending to the petitioners is a more private and intense affair; even with this being a temple dedicated to the Prince of Passion, many people still feel self-conscious when they come in and the veil of privacy helps them bring out their true feelings. That being said, I ought to remind you of something." That being? "Once you agree to do this, you don't get to pick who you service[var0 |!" Cait says cheerily. |." Salwah purrs, flicking her tail at you. ] "You'll be able to pick what you want to be about — that's normally one of the brand's purposes, an advertisement — but since anyone could conceivably walk through the temple entrance and buy some passion, asking to pick and choose a client isn't quite reasonable so long as they keep within the rules and treat you with respect. Part of the point is you're consenting that it's about their passions, not yours, and that you're here as a helper to allow them to express themselves and their needs. So long as you're not being abused and they stick to what you're about, you don't get to complain about the matter. "Of course, it's always better if you're into that kind of thing... some people find it hot to let themselves get swept away by someone who might be a total stranger, to experience the thrill of wondering who might just happen to be matched up with them on a particular day. Some even go the extra mile and enjoy thinking of themselves being used as a tool to help a complete stranger realize their passions, hence giving no restrictions upon how they may be used and leaving it up to the petitioner in question to decide. Do you understand?" You see. [pc.bg scholar acolyte |This isn't completely new to you, as the Jassirites are the most prominent dedicants of Mallach that exist on Savarra. That being said, there is something to hearing it from the horse's mouth |It's certainly one way of doing things. One hears the rumors of the wanton acts that Jassirite Mallachites engage in, but this isn't quite what one might have expected from the more salacious tales ]. Sally clears her throat, breaking the silence. "It's not something that every Mallachite is comfortable with — after all, being expected to service a complete stranger with everything you have on such a personal level can be much to ask. If you're not comfortable with this, perhaps you should reconsider and help out in another fashion. This is perhaps the most personal and passionate task that you can do... and so one should do so with all of one's heart. "Are you fine with this?" ]
rows.translation: [flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_ROOMS |“还想再来一次吗？”莎莉柔声说道，“这不能怪你。在房间里接客，是任何一位神圣妓女所能从事的最紧张、最私密的职责之一，一个不小心就容易对那种刺激上瘾——无论是整件事的强度，还是结识新人的兴奋，诸如此类。告诉我你打算做什么，我会先带你去房间，再为你安排合适的求助者。” |“太棒了！”莎莉柔声说道，她用手掌轻轻抚过你的脸颊，涂上某种芳香的粉末。“亲自伺候求助者，是件更私密也更激烈的事；即便这里是献给‘激情王子’的神殿，很多人走进来时依然会感到难为情，而隐私的帷幕能帮他们展露真实的情感。话虽如此，我还是得提醒你一件事。” 那就是什么？ “一旦你同意做这件事，你就不能再挑选伺候的对象了[var0 |！”凯特高兴地说道。 |。”萨尔瓦轻声说道，朝你甩了甩尾巴。 ] “你可以选定自己要走的路数——这通常也是招牌的用途之一，相当于一份广告——但既然任何人都可能走进神殿大门买点激情，那么只要对方守规矩、尊重你，要求自己挑挑拣拣就不太合理了。这件事的关键之一在于，你是在同意：一切以他们的激情为准，而不是你的；你在这里是作为帮手，让他们得以表达自己和自己的需求。只要你不受虐待，他们也守着你的路数来，你就没资格抱怨这件事。 “当然，如果你本来就喜欢这种事，那自然更好……有些人觉得，让自己被一个可能是完全陌生的人带走很刺激；也享受着去猜某一天自己会刚好被配上谁的那种心跳。有些人甚至更进一步，乐于把自己当成一件工具，帮一个完全陌生的人实现他的激情，于是对自己会如何被使用不设任何限制，全交给那位求助者去决定。你明白了吗？” 你明白了。[pc.bg scholar acolyte |这对你来说并不是完全陌生，因为贾西拉人是萨瓦拉上最虔诚的马拉克信徒。话虽如此，亲耳听人讲出来，总归还是不一样 |这确实算是做法之一。人们都听说过贾西里特·玛拉基特干出的放荡行径，但这与那些更下流的故事里可能让人期待的情形并不太一样 ]。 莎莉清了清嗓子，打破沉默。“并不是每个玛拉基特都能接受这件事——毕竟，被指望在如此私人的层面上倾尽所有去伺候一个完全陌生的人，要求确实可能太高了。如果你对此感到不适，或许你该重新考虑，换一种方式帮忙。这大概是你所能承担的最私密、最富激情的任务了……所以做这件事时，理当全心全意。” “你对此没有意见吗？” ]

rows.original: "Most marvelous," Salwah purrs. "I take it that you'll want to get started right away, then — state what you're up for, and you can wait in one of the rooms while I see if there's anyone around who wishes their passions slaked in such a fashion. [var0 |Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], I'm sure you'll help [pc.name] through [pc.hisHer] first time working the rooms, right?" Cait beams. "You can count on me, Sally!" |It's natural to be a bit antsy during your first time working the rooms, but you'll get used to it." ] Indeed, you'd like to get started right now... so you just state what you're up for, Sally goes and finds someone who's agreeable to those terms, and then she brings that said someone to the room where you get it on. Is that it? "That's the long and short of it, yes," Salwah purrs. "You're catching on very quickly. If this were a more established temple with more manpower to spare we'd do a thing where you'd be put on display behind a veil in the spice hall and people would be able to browse your personage, maybe even bid on you if things got hot enough... but with the way things are currently we don't have the wherewithal for all that, exciting as it may be. Just state what sexual acts are acceptable to you, and I'll match you with an appropriate petitioner, simple as that." [var0 |And what about Cait? What does she want? Cait titters at that. "It's very kind of you to think of me, [pc.name], but I'm good with anything that you are. Really, don't worry about me; I'll be having fun regardless, so just enjoy yourself!     “要水吗？”
    
    你转过身，发现萨尔瓦正站在门口，身边停着一辆小推车。她不慌不忙地从水壶里给你倒了一杯陶杯的水，然后[var0
        |也给凯特倒了一杯，一边欣赏地看着你们两人心怀感激地啜饮着
        |退后一步，看着你心怀感激地啜饮这份馈赠
    ]。直到添到第三杯时，她才慢慢把你轻轻推开，缓缓朝你点了点头。
    
    “够了，你可别做过头了。干得不错，[var0
        | 你们两位
    ]你——身为申请人，对一切都非常满意，接下来的善后工作就由我在这里处理。清理工作也会由我或者寺庙里的某位工作人员来做，所以你们不用担心这个。看样子你们在这里玩得挺欢啊。等你能重新站起来的时候，到大堂来见我，好吗？我们在那里做个收尾。[var0
        | 凯特丽丝，你也是[silly
            |-前辈
        ] ——你看起来真是累坏了。
    ]还得过上一阵子，你才能重新上路。”
    
    你…你会没事的…

rows.original:
[party.has cait
        |"It's been a while since we caught up with each other." Cait says. "I'd love to hear about how you've been running the temple and anything that happened while I'm gone, and I'm sure [pc.name] would like to get to know you better, too."
        
        Salwah titters. "Well, like I've said before, any friend of my senior's is a friend of mine. I'm not going to say no to being a little closer, [pc.name]... given how much of an impression you've made on Caitriss[silly
            |-Senpai
        ], you've got to be something. Stay a while and tell me about all the adventures you've been taking my senior on!"
        
        [pc.dcb
            |Well, damn. Finally someone around here recognises your worth.
            |That kind of embarrassing, considering you've yet to go around announcing yourself as some kind of hero...
            |Like, you're totally up for being up and against this cute kitty, too!
        ]
        
        "Now then, Sally — we're actually trying to communicate, not make airheaded small talk like you do with the petitioners." Waggling a finger at her junior, Cait clears her throat and taps you on the back with her tail. "Why don't you get us started, [pc.name]?"
        |Salwah laughs. "Oh, normally charge people for that; you'd be surprised at how many people don't want sex and are willing to pay us Mallachites just to have someone pretend to care about their often mundane lives. But since my senior owes you big time, and you're a genuinely interesting person given all you're doing out there and all you've done for us... I'll do all the pleasant conversations you'd like pro bono. How's that for a freebie?"
        
        A very good deal, especially since you aren't here to have her feign interest in inane, trashy small talk. Her genuine thoughts are what you want here, not soothing platitudes — when you want that sort of stuff, you'll cut to the chase and ask her for her services directly, and even pay her for them.
        
        "Ah, even better. Mutually beneficial." Sally's expression turns serious for a moment, then melts into its usual cheeky, fang-toothed smile. "Well then. You pick the topic..." 
    ]
rows.translation:
[party.has cait
        |“我们已经有一段时间没见面了。”凯特说道，“我很想听听你这些年来是如何管理寺庙的，还有我不在的时候发生了些什么，我相信[pc.name]也想更好地了解你。”
        
        萨尔瓦轻声笑了起来。“嗯，就像我之前说的，我前辈的任何朋友都是我的朋友。我不会拒绝再亲近一点的，[pc.name]……考虑到你给凯特丽丝留下了如此深刻的印象，[silly
            |-前辈
        ]，你一定不是寻常角色。多待一会儿，跟我讲讲你带着我这位前辈经历过的所有冒险吧！”
        
        [pc.dcb
            |哎呀，总算有人认识到你的价值了。
            |说起来有点不好意思，毕竟你还没四处宣扬过自己是什么英雄……
            |而且说真的，你完全愿意跟这只可爱的小猫咪睡上一场！
        ]
        
        “好了，莎莉——我们是要好好交流，不是像你对那些请愿者那样闲聊些没头没脑的废话。”凯特朝她的后辈晃了晃手指，清了清嗓子，用尾巴轻拍了一下你的背，“不如你先给我们开个头吧，[pc.name]？”
        |萨尔瓦笑了起来。“哦，这种事平时我都是要收费的。你会惊讶地发现，有那么多人并不想要性，却愿意付钱给我们马拉克信徒，只为让别人假装关心他们往往平淡无奇的生活。但既然我前辈欠你一个大人情，而你又确实是个有趣的人——毕竟你在外头做了那么多事，也为我们做了那么多……我很乐意无偿陪你聊个尽兴。这份免费赠品怎么样？”
        
        这确实是一笔很划算的交易，尤其是你并不是来让她对那些无聊、低俗的闲聊假装感兴趣的。你真正想要的，是她真实的想法，而不是那些安抚人的客套话——等你想要那种东西的时候，你自然会直奔主题，直接开口要她的服务，甚至为此付钱给她。
        
        “啊，那更好。互惠互利。”莎莉的表情有那么一瞬间变得严肃起来，随后又化成了她惯常那副调皮、露着獠牙的笑容。“那好吧。你来选话题……” 
    ]

rows.original: "Myself? Hrrrmmm... most of the supplicants would rather talk about themselves than listen to the sound of my voice, regardless of how pleasant it is." To be fair, you're not a temple supplicant, and you're here on business, not pleasure. Like you said, you're not here to have your sensibilities soothed — you're here to try and understand the people in Cait's life better. "Yeah, sorry. Sometimes you just get too used to it. That, or maybe I'm liking this kind of evangelising a little too much." Salwah chuckles lightly and wiggles her ears. "About me, then... let's see..." You're all ears. [rand |"My hair and fur's actually black. As black as my tattoos — it's beautiful in its natural color, really, but given that so much of my getup is traditional it'd be pretty bad to break from it on that one detail by not dying my hair, right? A really dark purple isn't that bad, and the colors aren't that far off. Having to dye it all the time so the roots don't show is a bit of a bother, but you have to keep up appearances in my line of work." |"The tattoos on me aren't strictly necessary — or at least, not to this extent. But... I really do like how they look, and they add quite a bit to my personal mystique, don't they? They don't actually have any power or anything, but the patterning is something to look at. Totally worth the pain and weeks of work it took to get them inscribed on my skin." |"My name means 'comfort' in Jassiran. Well, 'true comfort' if you take my full name, but I'm not really that big of a deal to have an actual surname like Caitriss does; my mother just tacked it on because it sounded nice. She was rather enamoured of the idea of a meaningful name for her dear daughter." A sacred courtesan named 'true comfort'... now there's something to turn heads. "Given the name, I'd always known that I'd be expected to live up to it, and I can't say I dislike the results." Salwah gives you one of those cheeky toothed smiles of hers, lip-biting and all. "It's opened a few conversations in the past, I can say as much." |"It's taken a lot, and keeps taking, a lot of work for me to look this good. It's not just the oils and scents I've got to apply along with the dye into my fur, but also plenty of regular stretching and exercise when I'm not on the job. You don't think that this figure just came about by itself, did it?" With how easy she makes it look? She could've fooled you. [party.has cait |"Salwah's not wrong," Cait interjects. "We have to put a lot of work into making ourselves look good, especially those who do high-class escort work for the rich and powerful. I keep in shape by walking all over the place with you and do some of the stretches before sleeping, but someone like Sally, who's more sedentary, has the time to go through all the basic forms, if not more." ] Salwah titters, her ears pointing forward in the manner of interested felines. "They say in Tronarii that Mallachite witches and warlocks employ the divine magic of their patron deity to appear attractive. As with all effective rumours, there's a kernel of truth in there... but the likes of a junior priestess like me with barely a couple of months on her white cloak wouldn't have the means to earn such favor. Plenty of stretching and balancing, watching what I eat — especially important in this land of rich food — and of course, a good spice regimen. That, and when all fails, a little judicious use of makeup, and using clothes to the best effect to cover up your imperfections." Wow, you'd never known so much goes into just looking good as one of Mallach's flock. "If you want but a warm hole, you can get that anywhere and for a much cheaper price. People go to the temple to get what they can't anywhere else." |"What I do in my spare time? Well, I smoke, I have to keep in shape, and there're the daily devotions to be taken care of, too. No excuse for missing those even if I'm a missionary far away from any established temple. [var0 |There'll be a lot to do once Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] gets her temple up and running, so I'm perfectly content with enjoying the slower pace of life while I can." [party.has cait |"Don't get too comfortable, Sally," Cait says with a wink and tap of her tail. "We'll have the temple up and running before you know it!" ] ] You see. "I also like to head down and talk to River. The little guy's short enough to be a cute little brother, and he always has the latest news from all over the world! I've never seen him actually leave Hawkethorne, but someone in his line of work must talk to all kinds of people as they come in and out of town. It wasn't that long ago that people were accusing catfolk bards and minstrels of all stripes for being spies for the temple, after all." Is he? "I don't know, and if I did, I wouldn't tell you." Salwah sticks her little pink tongue out. "Anyway, that's that. I can get why Caitriss likes it here, but it's also too easy to get complacent.[var0| I hope she gets the temple running pretty soon; ] I'm at my best when I'm up and getting busy! Girls like me get bored easily, you know." |"My clothes? The standard-issue Jassiran priestess' cloak aside — " she indicates the white cloak with the red jewelled clasp about her neck — "I put together the rest myself. Of course, there're certain standards to be met as part of the temple, but at the very least we have some freedom in how we'd like to present ourselves within the limits and expectations set by our vocation. Our personal brand, as it were. I've had my particular look in mind ever since I was just a kitten — you can ask Caitriss all about it, I used to bother her and Calla all the time with ideas. Once I got my hands on the camel wool and needlework to make it a reality, I did! "Some things you just can't leave to other people, you know? Too important to risk a mistake or have it not turn out exactly as you envisioned. At least like this, you only have yourself to blame if something goes wrong." [party.has cait | "Sally's always been a very hands-on girl like that. It's made her good with her hands, too," Cait adds with a wry smile. "Well, at least with an outfit like that she's as cold as I [cait.isLeothran |was |am ] up here in the Marches!" ] ]
rows.translation: 我吗？嗯……大多数来寺庙祈求的人，宁愿谈论自己，也不愿听我的声音，不管我的声音有多悦耳。” 公平地说，你并不是来寺庙祈求的，你是来办事的，而不是来享受的。正如你所说，你来这里并不是为了让自己的心情得到缓解，而是为了更好地了解凯特生活中那些人。 “嗯，抱歉。有时候人们就是会对此习以为常。或者，也许是我太热衷于这种传播理念的行为了。萨尔瓦轻声笑了笑，还摇动着耳朵。‘关于我呢……让我想想……’” 你们可都竖起耳朵在听呢。 [rand |我的头发和毛发其实是黑色的，和我的纹身一样黑——这种天然的颜色其实非常漂亮。不过，由于我的整体装扮都是传统风格的，如果在这个细节上打破这种风格，不把头发染黑的话，看起来就会很奇怪，对吧？深紫色的头发其实也还不错，颜色差距也不是很大。不过，因为需要经常染发才能让发根部分看不出来，确实有点麻烦……不过，在我的工作中，保持外表整洁是必须的。 |我身上的这些纹身其实并不是绝对必要的——至少没有必要做到这种程度。但是……我真的很喜欢它们的外观，它们确实为我的个人魅力增添了不少色彩，不是吗？这些纹身其实并没有什么特殊功效，但它们的图案确实很吸引人。为了在皮肤上刻出这些图案，我忍受了痛苦，也花费了好几周的时间，这一切都绝对值得。 |在我的家乡贾西兰，我的名字意味着‘安慰’。嗯，更准确地说，是‘真正的安慰’。完整名字嘛，其实对我来说，有没有像凯特丽丝那样的正式姓氏也没什么大不了的；我妈妈只是觉得这个名字听起来不错，所以就加在了我的名字后面。她真的很希望为自己的女儿起一个有意义的名字。名为“真正慰藉”的神圣歌妓……这个名字确实足以吸引众人的目光。 “既然有了这样的名字，我就知道人们会期待我能够名副其实，而不得不说，这样的结果我并不反感。萨尔瓦赫露出了她那副俏皮的笑容，甚至微微咬着嘴唇。我得说，过去这招确实引发过不少对话呢。 |要达到这样的状态，我付出了很多努力，而且现在还在继续付出很多努力。不仅仅是在毛皮上涂抹各种油剂和香料，还有在不上班的时候进行大量的拉伸和锻炼。你不会认为这个身材是自然而然就形成的吧？” 她做得如此轻松自然，简直让人以为这是天生的。她完全有可能骗过你呢。 [party.has cait |萨尔瓦说得没错，”凯特插话道，“我们确实需要花很多精力来让自己看起来更出色，尤其是那些为富人和权贵提供高级陪护服务的人。我和你一起四处走动，睡前也会做一些伸展运动来保持身材，但像莎莉这样平时活动较少的人，就有更多时间来练习各种基本动作了。 ] 萨尔瓦兴奋地笑了起来，她的耳朵像那些充满好奇的猫一样向前竖了起来。“在特洛纳里，人们传说马拉克信徒族的女巫和男巫会利用他们守护神的神圣魔力来让自己看起来更加迷人。就像所有流传广泛的谣言一样，其中确实包含着一丝真相。但是像我这样的初级女祭司，仅仅穿着白色法袍才几个月而已，根本没有能力获得这样的恩惠。我需要经常进行伸展运动和保持身体平衡，注意自己的饮食——尤其是在这个食物如此丰富的地方——当然，还需要合理使用各种香料。还有就是，当其他方法都无效时，适当运用化妆品，以及巧妙地选择服装来掩盖自己的不完美之处。” 哇，原来要想像马拉克的手下们那样看起来漂亮，其实需要考虑这么多因素啊。 如果你只是想要一个温暖的地方来休息，那么在任何地方都能以便宜得多的价格找到这样的地方。人们之所以去寺庙，正是因为在那里他们能得到在其他地方得不到的东西。 |我在业余时间都做些什么呢？嗯，我会抽烟，还得保持身材，当然还要每天进行宗教仪式。即使我是一个远离任何宗教场所的传教士，也绝不能错过这些仪式。 [var0 |等凯特到了，就会有很多事情要做了。[silly |-学长 ]她让自己的生活恢复了正常的节奏，所以在我还能享受这种慢节奏生活的时候，我对此感到非常满意。 [party.has cait |别犯傻了。太别担心，莎莉，”凯特眨了眨眼，还摇着尾巴说，“等你知道的时候，我们的神庙就已经建成并开始运作了！ ] ] 你瞧， “我也喜欢去找瑞弗聊聊。那个小家伙个子那么小，看起来就像个可爱的小弟弟，而他总能了解到来自世界各地的最新消息！我从来没见过他离开过鹰棘镇，但以他的工作性质，肯定会在人们进出这个小镇的时候接触到各种各样的人。就在不久前，人们还指责各种类型的猫族吟游诗人和歌手是神庙的间谍呢。” “他是吗？” “我不知道，就算我知道，也不会告诉你的。萨尔瓦吐出了她那小小的粉红色舌头。‘总之，就是这样吧。我能够理解凯特为什么喜欢这里，但这里也太容易让人产生满足感了。[var0| 我希望她能尽快让这座寺庙恢复正常运转。 ]只有当我开始忙碌起来时，我才能发挥出最好的状态！你知道的，像我这样的女孩很容易感到无聊。 |我的衣服吗？除了那件标准的贾西兰女祭司长袍——”她指了指自己脖子上那件带有红色宝石扣饰的白色长袍，“其余的都是我自己制作的。当然，作为寺庙的一员，还是需要遵守一些规定的，但至少在我们履行职责所要求的范围内，我们在穿着打扮上还是有一定的自由度的。可以说，这就是我的个人品牌。从我还是个小猫的时候起，我就一直在构思这个造型——你可以去问问凯特丽丝，我以前总是缠着她还有卡拉，不断地向她们提出各种想法。终于，当我得到了驼毛和针线这些制作材料后，我就开始动手将这个想法变为现实了！ 有些事情，你就是不能交给别人去做，你知道吗？这些事情太重要了，不能冒险犯错，也不能让结果偏离你的预期。至少这样，如果出了什么问题，你只能怪自己。 [party.has cait | 莎莉一直都是这样一个动手能力很强的女孩，这也让她的手艺相当不错，”凯特苦笑着补充道，“不过，至少穿上那样的衣服，她应该和我一样冷吧[cait.isLeothran |是 |是 ]就在这里的边境地区！ ] ]
rows.raw: " "Myself? Hrrrmmm... most of the supplicants would rather talk about themselves than listen to the sound of my voice, regardless of how pleasant it is." To be fair, you're not a temple supplicant, and you're here on business, not pleasure. Like you said, you're not here to have your sensibilities soothed — you're here to try and understand the people in Cait's life better. "Yeah, sorry. Sometimes you just get too used to it. That, or maybe I'm liking this kind of evangelising a little too much." Salwah chuckles lightly and wiggles her ears. "About me, then... let's see..." You're all ears. [rand |"My hair and fur's actually black. As black as my tattoos — it's beautiful in its natural color, really, but given that so much of my getup is traditional it'd be pretty bad to break from it on that one detail by not dying my hair, right? A really dark purple isn't that bad, and the colors aren't that far off. Having to dye it all the time so the roots don't show is a bit of a bother, but you have to keep up appearances in my line of work." |"The tattoos on me aren't strictly necessary — or at least, not to this extent. But... I really do like how they look, and they add quite a bit to my personal mystique, don't they? They don't actually have any power or anything, but the patterning is something to look at. Totally worth the pain and weeks of work it took to get them inscribed on my skin." |"My name means 'comfort' in Jassiran. Well, 'true comfort' if you take my full name, but I'm not really that big of a deal to have an actual surname like Caitriss does; my mother just tacked it on because it sounded nice. She was rather enamoured of the idea of a meaningful name for her dear daughter." A sacred courtesan named 'true comfort'... now there's something to turn heads. "Given the name, I'd always known that I'd be expected to live up to it, and I can't say I dislike the results." Salwah gives you one of those cheeky toothed smiles of hers, lip-biting and all. "It's opened a few conversations in the past, I can say as much." |"It's taken a lot, and keeps taking, a lot of work for me to look this good. It's not just the oils and scents I've got to apply along with the dye into my fur, but also plenty of regular stretching and exercise when I'm not on the job. You don't think that this figure just came about by itself, did it?" With how easy she makes it look? She could've fooled you. [party.has cait |"Salwah's not wrong," Cait interjects. "We have to put a lot of work into making ourselves look good, especially those who do high-class escort work for the rich and powerful. I keep in shape by walking all over the place with you and do some of the stretches before sleeping, but someone like Sally, who's more sedentary, has the time to go through all the basic forms, if not more." ] Salwah titters, her ears pointing forward in the manner of interested felines. "They say in Tronarii that Mallachite witches and warlocks employ the divine magic of their patron deity to appear attractive. As with all effective rumours, there's a kernel of truth in there... but the likes of a junior priestess like me with barely a couple of months on her white cloak wouldn't have the means to earn such favor. Plenty of stretching and balancing, watching what I eat — especially important in this land of rich food — and of course, a good spice regimen. That, and when all fails, a little judicious use of makeup, and using clothes to the best effect to cover up your imperfections." Wow, you'd never known so much goes into just looking good as one of Mallach's flock. "If you want but a warm hole, you can get that anywhere and for a much cheaper price. People go to the temple to get what they can't anywhere else." |"What I do in my spare time? Well, I smoke, I have to keep in shape, and there're the daily devotions to be taken care of, too. No excuse for missing those even if I'm a missionary far away from any established temple. [var0 |There'll be a lot to do once Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ] gets her temple up and running, so I'm perfectly content with enjoying the slower pace of life while I can." [party.has cait |"Don't get too comfortable, Sally," Cait says with a wink and tap of her tail. "We'll have the temple up and running before you know it!" ] ] You see. "I also like to head down and talk to River. The little guy's short enough to be a cute little brother, and he always has the latest news from all over the world! I've never seen him actually leave Hawkethorne, but someone in his line of work must talk to all kinds of people as they come in and out of town. It wasn't that long ago that people were accusing catfolk bards and minstrels of all stripes for being spies for the temple, after all." Is he? "I don't know, and if I did, I wouldn't tell you." Salwah sticks her little pink tongue out. "Anyway, that's that. I can get why Caitriss likes it here, but it's also too easy to get complacent.[var0| I hope she gets the temple running pretty soon; ] I'm at my best when I'm up and getting busy! Girls like me get bored easily, you know." |"My clothes? The standard-issue Jassiran priestess' cloak aside — " she indicates the white cloak with the red jewelled clasp about her neck — "I put together the rest myself. Of course, there're certain standards to be met as part of the temple, but at the very least we have some freedom in how we'd like to present ourselves within the limits and expectations set by our vocation. Our personal brand, as it were. I've had my particular look in mind ever since I was just a kitten — you can ask Caitriss all about it, I used to bother her and Calla all the time with ideas. Once I got my hands on the camel wool and needlework to make it a reality, I did! "Some things you just can't leave to other people, you know? Too important to risk a mistake or have it not turn out exactly as you envisioned. At least like this, you only have yourself to blame if something goes wrong." [party.has cait | "Sally's always been a very hands-on girl like that. It's made her good with her hands, too," Cait adds with a wry smile. "Well, at least with an outfit like that she's as cold as I [cait.isLeothran |was |am ] up here in the Marches!" ] ] "

rows.original:
Salwah flicks a ear at you lazily. "Hmm?"
    
    It's that reddish-brown stuff that she spiked Cait's drink — and yours, too — with on the day you met. Looked like powdered rust to you, only lighter and a lot finer. That, and she smokes it all the time in the temple in that hookah of hers.
    
    "Oh, you mean the spice?"
    
    Spice?
    
    Sally taps you on the [pc.ass] with the tip of her tail. "Right, of course you wouldn't know if you've never been to Jassira. Basically, spice is a mixture of cinnamon, cloves, and — " she pauses for a moment — "a certain very hard-to-grow herb, all ground up to a very fine powder. That last one gives the mixture much of its kick, and prevents the lot from caking. So long as you keep it in a tightly sealed container away from the light, spice can more or less last forever."
    
    It tasted kind of weird when mixed in your wine. Not in a bad way, yes, but still weird.
    
    "It's everywhere in Jassira, [pc.name], what with it being a crucial spiritual, medical and social enabler. You add it to all sorts of things — spice bread, curry and beer for the common people, spice wine, coffee and smokables for the upper classes." She indicates the hookah on the desk. "It adds flavor to food, and helps keep it from spoiling; perfectly safe for most races, but it gives feline peoples like catfolk a pleasant buzz and makes one just a bit more receptive to advances. Jassiran Mallachites are certainly no stranger to the stuff — I just wanted to give Caitriss a taste of home back then, given how down she looked after explaining all about poor Calla."
    
    [party.has cait
        |You look askance at Cait. Certainly, she hadn't explained as much about something so important to her culture.
        
        "Well, it's never really come up before now, [pc.name]. You can't get spice anywhere outside of Jassira, except maybe a little bit that's exported to Tronarii because of the many catfolk there. Dad never liked being dependent on anything he couldn't reasonably expect to stock up on in his travels, so he didn't bring any with him when we left."
        
    ]
    You see.
    
    "Yeah, as far as common knowledge goes, Jassira's the only place that grows the herb, [pc.name]. They have to do it in caves with crystal tops to filter out the harmful rays of the sun or something, and the cave walls keep the moisture in, otherwise it'd all dry out in the desert heat. Spicetenders have lots of money and clout, but given how tightly their lives are controlled by the Sultanate I'm not sure it's worth it." Salwah gives you a cheeky grin. "As Cait'll tell you, I like to play too much for that kind of stuffy life."
    
    [party.has cait
        |Cait shares the grin. "That she does, [pc.name]."
        
    ]
    It's not addictive or anything, is it?
    
    "Not physically, but well, make anything pleasurable and people'll want more of it. It's not considered any more odd than smokes or drink back home. Well, some kinds of refined spice are concentrated with alchemical techniques, but unless you're the matron or grand cleric of a temple and need to open your mind to Mallach's presence, you're never going to touch the stuff.
    
    "Of course, all that changed when Cait and I figured out the stuff was growing all over the place in this part of the world! They call the herb manticore nip here, but it's the same stuff. The crystal-roofed caves back home, they simulate the environment you have here so the herb grows. Cinnamon and cloves are a little harder to get, but not impossible when you have people from Tychris passing on through. So... the spice must flow! Join me for a smoke sometime?" 
    
    You'll consider it.
    
    "As you wish. Anything else you'd like to discuss?"
rows.translation:
萨尔瓦懒洋洋地朝你甩了甩耳朵：“嗯？”
    
    就是那种红棕色的东西——在你们见面的那天，她把那种东西加到了凯特的饮料里，也加到了你的饮料里。你当时觉得它就像锈粉，只不过颜色更浅，颗粒也更细而已。而且，她总是在寺庙里用她的水烟筒吸那种东西。
    
    “哦，你是说那种香料吗？”
    
    香料？
    
    莎莉轻敲了敲你的肩膀[pc.ass]她轻轻一甩尾巴，说道：“没错，如果你从未去过贾西拉，当然也不会知道这些。其实，这种香料是由肉桂、丁香，还有——”她停顿了一下，“一种非常难以种植的草本植物混合而成的，然后将它们全部研磨成非常细的粉末。最后那一种成分为这种混合物增添了独特的风味，同时也防止了混合物结块。只要将其保存在密封良好的容器中，远离光线，这种香料基本上可以永久保存。
    
    当把它加入葡萄酒中后，味道确实有点奇怪。并不是说坏事，只是感觉有点奇怪而已。
    
    “在贾西拉，这种东西到处都是[pc.name]，因为它在精神、医疗和社会层面都起着至关重要的作用。人们会将它添加到各种各样的食物中——对于普通人来说，有加香料的面包、咖喱和啤酒；而对于上层阶级来说，则有加香料的葡萄酒、咖啡以及各种可吸食的物品。”她指了指桌上的水烟筒。它能为食物增添风味，还能防止食物变质；对大多数种族来说都是完全安全的，但对于猫族这样的猫科种族来说，它会带来一种愉悦的感觉，让人对各种诱惑更加容易接受。贾西兰·马拉克信徒们对此当然非常熟悉——当时我只是想让凯特感受到一丝家乡的气息，毕竟在听完关于可怜的卡拉的那些事情后，她看起来心情非常低落。"
    
    [party.has cait
        |你用怀疑的目光看着凯特。显然，对于对她文化来说如此重要的事情，她并没有详细解释过。
        
        “嗯，直到现在，这个话题也从未被提起过。[pc.name]在贾西拉以外的任何地方，你都找不到这种香料，也许只有因为特洛纳里地区有大量的猫族，才会有一些这种香料被出口到那里。爸爸从来不喜欢依赖那些他在旅行中无法合理预期能够搞到的东西，所以当我们出发的时候，他并没有带这种香料。
        
    ]
    你明白的。
    
    “没错，就一般常识而言，贾西拉是唯一一个能够种植这种草药的地区。[pc.name]他们必须在那些顶部装有水晶的洞穴里生活，这样才能过滤掉太阳的有害光线；而且洞穴的墙壁还能保持湿度，否则在沙漠的炎热环境中，一切都会干枯殆尽。那些负责提供辛辣食物的人虽然拥有很多金钱和影响力，但考虑到他们的生活受到苏丹国的严格控制，我实在不确定这样的生活是否值得。”萨尔瓦坏笑着说道，“就像凯特会告诉你的那样，我可不喜欢这种压抑的生活环境，所以我更喜欢玩游戏。
    
    [party.has cait
        |凯特也露出了同样的笑容。“她确实这么做了。[pc.name]。"
        
    ]
    它并不会让人上瘾，对吧？”
    
    “从生理上来说不会，但是，任何能让人们感到愉悦的东西，人们都会想要更多。这种东西并不比我们家乡的烟草或酒更奇怪。当然，有些经过特殊工艺提纯的香料确实含有浓缩的成分，但除非你是某个寺庙的主持或高级神职人员，需要通过这些香料来开启自己的心灵，否则你根本不会去接触它们。
    
    当然，当凯特和我发现这种植物在这个地区到处都在生长时，一切都变了！在这里，人们把这种草药叫做‘曼蒂科尔尼普’，但其实就是同一种植物。我们家乡那些有水晶屋顶的洞穴，正是模拟了这里的环境，才让这种草药能够生长出来的。肉桂和丁香有点难以获取，但如果有来自提克里斯的人经过，这些香料也不是不可能买到的。所以……让这些香料的交易能够顺利进行吧！有空一起抽根烟吧？”
    
    你会考虑我的邀请的。
    
    “如你所愿。还有其他你想讨论的事情吗？
