I spent a number of my younger years as a temple greeter — it's one of the simpler tasks the younger acolytes are able to do, and I got very good at it. When you enjoy showing off your body, making others feel welcome is a natural matter of course! Technically, I wouldn't need to do this as grand cleric... but let's face it, being so full of kittens has made me so comfortable and happy that I can't help but want to spread this passion to everyone who sets foot in these halls, hmm?" ] |[rand |Oh wow, she looks like she swallowed an entire melon. It's about time for her to pop, isn't it? "Might be a little while longer," Salwah replies, tapping her chin. "It hasn't escaped my notice that each kitten of mine is getting a little bigger, staying in a little longer before being born — I guess it's got to do with the way my body and brand are changing, but I don't mind it one bit, not in the least." If anything, it just drags out the best part of the whole thing, doesn't it? "Now you're thinking like I am," Salwah replies, purring. "To say it would be the best part of kitten-making is debatable... but being so round and full is certainly something I don't mind enjoying just a bit longer before it ends." |Wow, with how big Salwah gets at this point with just one kitten inside of her, you have to wonder what she'd look like if she ever conceived twins like Cait and Calla. "I don't know!" comes the cheery reply. "But I wouldn't mind finding out!" Is she for real, though? She might end up having the kittens prematurely, or get so big she ends up bedridden, or — "You need to have more faith in Mallach, [pc.name]," Sally says, smacking you on the back with her tail for good measure. "He may not be Lumia, but he sure looks after his own, and wouldn't ask anything of me that I wasn't capable of doing!" If only you had her kind of faith... "It's hard not to have it, after I've clearly been guided all this way from Jassira to this very recliner here. Bearing twins for the future of this temple is a small thing to ask of me at this point! If it happens, it happens, and I'll take it in stride when it comes. Besides, feeling twice as good as I am right now... I'm not sure if my mind would melt from how good it'd feel!" |"Being so big was a little uncomfortable the first time around, maybe the second. But now that my body and brand have grown used to it, I can't help but feel glamorous. I want to show off this body and have all the supplicants walking in mistake this for a Lumian temple, ahaha!" She certainly seems a lot more jovial when she's all ripe and swollen with kittens, you've noticed. "It's what a garden of children is meant to do, meant to be; I chose to serve the temple in this way all those years back, and there's no point in second-guessing myself anyway. Just lose yourself to your passions for a bit, a flash of wild, unfettered desire — just a bit, to be doled out like fine spice, and that's enough to keep me smiling all day. I wouldn't be much of a mother to my kittens and the future of the temple if the mere act of carrying out my duties made me all dour-faced and grumpy, right?" ] |[rand |Ye gods, she's massive, and her tattoos and crest alike are stretched out like... like something that's horribly lusty and perverse. How does she even walk with that enormous dome of a belly sticking out from her? Is she sure she isn't having twins? "Trust me, I'd know if I were having twins, and I'd be sure to tell you if you were getting a two-for-one deal on renting my womb. And as for getting around... well, I try to do it as little as possible outside of my exercises, which are designed for this kind of me anyway. Mr Zethra is nice enough to make the walk down to your tribute chest to drop off your cut of the temple's takings — although it is but a ten minute walk, it's also along a mountain path that doesn't have an inch of flat ground on it. I'd hate to fall as I am right now, ahaha." Yeah, you'd hate to see for that to happen. Doubly so, given how wide her hips are at the moment; no doubt she's had to change her gait multiple times over the last few kittens. "Ah, a small price to pay for the glories of serving Mallach and the glory of the Temple, a small price indeed to feel so good. Don't worry about me, [pc.name] — chances are that by the next time you come up here, I'll be holding yet another kitten to add to the lot." |"Ah, I see your eyes are drawn to my brand," Salwah purrs, pointing down at the crawling, mystical mass of burning pink lines stretched out over her overstuffed womb, the core a solidly filled-in heart. "I'm pretty proud of it, too." It's grown so much. You remember its appearance when she arrived in Hawkethorne, when it was just a simple heart-shaped outline on her crotch. And now this... it must have gradually crept up on you, just like the changes to Sally's body, and now both are enormous and enchanting, overflowing with sultry energy from every fiber of their being. [party.has cait |"It's an old wives' tale in Jassira that a Jassiran's brand changes to reflect the Mallachite themselves," Cait muses. "I know it isn't true, but looking at Sally right now I could believe it." ] "Well, the grand cleric and matron alike told me before I left that missionary work changes people by its very nature. Spreading passion in a foreign land and all that... the way they said it, those changes were expected to be for the worse, not the other way around like what's actually happened. I'm just glad I wasn't dissuaded from catching up to Mr. Zethra and making something of myself in this part of the world! Not that life back at the temple would have been uncomfortable, probably more so than what I have now, but I wouldn't give it up for anything in the world. Not even the richest of the rich would keep on paying me to be pregnant over and over again, I tell you!" |"Ah, my belly, so big, so ripe, so full of kitten..." Taking your hand, Salwah guides it down to the taut skin of her belly and rubs your palm all over it in the most shameless manner possible for an otherwise innocuous act. The warm stirrings of her womb, the shifting of the kitten inside and the heartbeat-like pulsating of her brand — it's all so wholesome and perverse at the same time, you can't believe it. Or maybe you can. "This is all thanks to you. I don't imagine anyone else in the Marches would have had that much money to throw at merely making a temple cat pregnant over and over again, but you did, and for that I've got to thank you." Ah... well, you certainly got your money's worth out of it all. That, and both she and Cait are safe, secure and warm in their own place. "It truly is our home now, I don't think we could ever return to Jassira, except maybe for a visit to make our temple official and everything. There's just so much to be done here, and so many kittens to raise — and make, of course. Being so pregnant so often is a temple cat's dream come true." ] |[rand |A mischievous little grin crosses Salwah's plush lips as she places both hands on her stretched-out womb in response to your question. "Come feel for yourself, then." If she insists — reaching out, you do just that. Salwah's womb is stretched taut and hard, bigger than you'd expect for a woman as far along as she is. There's a full sense of warm weight inside of her, and as you press your palm to the rounded surface you feel a squirming inside of her, followed by a strong kick. Wow. "Isn't it great? Even if this kitten doesn't choose to stay on in the temple after majority, I'm sure he or she'll have a good life ahead. And after this... I'm looking forward to being an actual mother instead of a sister for once. Hmm... you wouldn't be averse to coughing up another fifteen thousand hawks for me to have the pleasure of going through this all over again, would you?" Ah-ah-ah. She can place a price on the joys of temple motherhood? "I can, my dear [pc.title], and it's fifteen thousand hawks." You'll see about that... |"It feels so good," Salwah purrs as she stretches out languidly on her recliner and pushes out her enormous belly at you, so big that it sticks out even on her lush frame. The temple kitten's getting really big at this point, and the fully-filled crest on the underside of her overstuffed womb is burning an intense, lusty pink. "I just feel so warm and full and most importantly, horny all day. Even after taking care of supplicants all day, I just feel so unfulfilled..." Is that an itch you can help her scratch? Or any of your companions, for that matter... "Maybe later, we're talking right now." Salwah replies with a faint smile. "I know, an odd thing to say given that I just complained about having needs, but... it's been like that all day. The weight on my mind is more than the weight of this little one on my body, and I both love and hate it alike. If there were more hands around the temple I could just let loose and allow my passions to run unfettered, but alas! Someone has to make sure your cut of the temple's proceeds is counted out and delivered to your tribute chest every tenday." Money or making a kitten like her happy... you think you've proven which you'd rather prefer. Salwah swats you with her tail. "Yes, yes. But duties are duties, aren't they? Even if it's a pittance, even if you're willing to forego the sum, you will be paid, no matter how far I have to waddle down the mountain like I am right now." |It's almost time for her first kitten to be born; Sally's going to be a mother just about any day now. She's grown so massively big that you're worried there might be twins in there like what happened with Cait and her sister. "Ah, this little kitten just has a strong mother trained in the temple arts and mysteries, don't you worry. And some good seed to start off with, of course. Then there's the matter of the brand... it's not going to be effortless, I know, but neither is it going to kill me. Don't you worry now — if there's anyone qualified to have kittens around these parts, it's me." Seeing Salwah rub her hands all over her gleaming, taut belly like that, drumming the stretched surface with her fingers and taking an obvious perverse pleasure from it... seeing you watching her, the temple kitten slides her hands over to her breasts and cups the swollen milk-makers, causing beads of kitty cream to well up and drip onto the full shelf of her overstuffed womb. "Like them? I'll never be as big as Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], of course, but they're still not to be underestimated..." You paid for them, so of course they're good. Salwah laughs at that. "Ask for a drink, if you will. Just leave enough for the kitten..." ] ] ] "

rows.translation: 怀孕

rows.original: [salwah.numKids 1 3 5 |[rand |"Now that there's a kitten in the temple, I've given some thought as to keeping them out of the parts where they aren't supposed to be. It'll be some years yet, sure, but remembering Calla trying to get to all the places where she wasn't supposed to be and seeing things she wasn't supposed to see yet was quite troublesome. I'll have to give some thought as to kitten-proofing the living quarters after the fashion of the temples back in Jassira." [party.has cait |"Remember that time Calla climbed up the temple spire and couldn't get back down, Sally?" "That was the exact thing that got me worried about keeping the place safe." Cait sighs. "Oh, that was quite the mess. They'd have kicked her out for that, if it wasn't exactly what she wanted." ] You have to admit, it feels kind of strange discussing the matter of kittens running around in a temple of Mallach. Yes, you'd known this would happen and was expected, but even so... "Well, if you take even the Tronariian view and think of the Temple as little more than a collection of whorehouses, it still isn't that much of a stretch to imagine. There are children who have to grow up in whorehouses, I know as much. At this point, the way things are have become more or less entrenched, and a sizable proportion of the next generation of Mallachites are born within the temple walls. So long as they stay where they're meant to be — quite the thing to ask of a kitten, I know — they have a much better life than most." |"Oof. Having a little energetic thing to care for all the time is certainly an experience. It's not that I'm any stranger to that kind of thing given I did a lot of it as a girl, but at the same time there's a difference between minding someone else's kittens and minding your own, you know? Worse than even the neediest and clingiest of supplicants, I tell you — wanting to be fed, held, sung to, and generally looked after all the time, and I can't even put down the little one for a moment while they're awake, heh!" Well, as the saying goes, nothing worth doing is ever easy. "Oh, I know, I know. If there were more hands around the place, it'd be easier, but I don't have the benefit of an established temple and hence have to make do with what I have. Plant trees now so that my children will be able to sit in their shade and all that. At least I'm still getting a start on the kitten-making while I'm young and have the energy to get all this done — by the time my own mother had her last, we were doing a lot of the work for her!" It's good to hear that the kitten you paid for is doing very well; the little fluffball has to be healthy in order to be this much of a handful. "I know, right? Yes, it's good for a kitten to be so curious about the world at so young an age, but at the same time it's so tiring for me. Well, nothing for it; chin up and nose to the grindstone.[party.has cait | Hey, Caitriss[silly |-senpai ], you're going to be joining me in the kitten-making when your job is over, aren't you? Can't have a matron of a Jassiran temple be barren, you know. What would the folks back in Jassira think if we weren't important enough for someone to rent your womb even once?" "W-what? I — " "We can take a quick trip back home, get ourselves made official — well, more official than my simple missionary work request — and we can get your brand fixed while we're at it. You can be just like me, and we'll make kittens for the future of your temple together!" Cait is edging away slowly at this point, but Salwah catches her by the arm with a laugh. "Ahaha, don't worry, I was only teasing you. But seriously, though, when you're done with all this... it's something that you're more than likely to end up doing, and I'll be there by your side when it happens." "I'll cross that bridge when I get to it, Sally, and not one moment before." ] |"The kitten you paid for is just the most adorable little fluffball in all of existence! Sure, there're those difficult moments, especially at the end of a long day running the temple, but when all's said and done just seeing my kitten makes at least some of the tiredness go away." Hah, that's often in direct contrast to what most people think of young children. "Well, I do have experience. And even if the brand does make sure they come out as catfolk, the kitten sure does have all of your energy! There's more to inheritance than just looks, after all!" Ah. "I'd be tempted to say I'd do it even if you didn't pay me, but rules are rules and there're standards and appearances to be upheld. That, and there's always the matter of the temple's upkeep to consider..." |So, to get this right — the kittens you paid for will live in the temple until they reach their majority, and then they're free to make the choice whether to stay on or leave? Salwah nods. "That's about the long and short of it, yes; it's what happened with Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and Calla alike. One chose to stay and the other to leave... until the other chose to leave at the last moment, too. We don't throw them out with just the clothes on their backs — the Jassiran Mallachites still have many connections about the sultanate, and not just because the progeny of surrogates come from moneyed families. Some return to the households they're nominally a part of, but even if they don't their so-called families do sometimes help the temple to get them an in somewhere. Generally speaking, temple kittens tend to have better lives than most, even if they don't stay on." Ah... but such connections don't exist for this temple, do they? "They will by the time we're done. That's what Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and you are working hard to do, aren't you? It's not like she's busy ingratiating herself to the village down below or anything... sure, we won't measure up to the generations of interwoven relationships between the Temple and the sultanate, but trust me when I say we're sparing no expense in setting down good foundations for the future of the temple." Which, of course, means roughing it now. Salwah laughs and waves a hand at her luxuriant surroundings. "I wouldn't quite call this roughing it, not in the physical sense of things, but yes, I do get your point. Catnaps are all I've been able to have these days, jugging both the demands of kittens and supplicants alike." ] |[rand |"Mr. Zethra is kind of glad there's a bit more life about the temple these days — so long as the kittens stay out of his way while he's working in the back by the portal that may or may not be there, the way he puts it. He says it reminds him of when Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and Calla were younger..." Ah... "I don't mind him being a father figure to the kittens — they need one, after all. The man's getting to the age where he instinctively dotes on children, and in the absence of Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] or Calla having any of their own, mine are the next best choice. There really isn't much to spoil them on over here in this desolate part of the world, but he does his best anyway." [party.has cait |Speaking of which, since her dad's really getting into the spirit of things, what does Cait herself think of having some kittens after all this is over? Salwah and you can find some way to get that brand off her, or more likely, get a proper one inscribed that she can turn on and off at will, and then make her father happy while also earning income for the temple? Cait just sticks out her tongue. "I'm not a garden of children, that'll always be Sally's [silly |baby ]bag, even when someday I have the chance to devote myself wholly to the temple. I was trained to be a nobleman's arm candy, and a big baby belly hardly fits my aesthetic..." And what if it was the same wealthy client who'd bought her services that wanted to breed her? Say a long-term patron of her temple...? Cheeks flushing, Cait glances between you and Sally's stomach. "Maybe... maybe when all this wicked business with Kasyrra's done... when I have Calla back... maybe then we can talk about it. But I wouldn't do it for some random client, you know. I'd hate to take Sally's business like that." So only for a special someone, then? Like her parents' arrangement? "D-don't get ahead of yourself! But maybe. Just maybe..." |Cait's dad is a really jovial man, the kind of man who really loves life, and you can't see anything but good coming from him being around kittens. So long as he doesn't go too far in his efforts to entertain and spoil them, it should give him something to fill his hours with when he's not working at the portal. ] |With more kittens around and presumably more yet to come, has she ever considered asking the nursery down in town for help? Salwah shakes her head most emphatically. "Oh no, can't do that. Temple kittens abide by temple rules and live temple lives. As well-meaning as you might have been, such a thing just wouldn't work. The tradition of the Jassirans means that being raised within these walls is more than simple caregiving, and it's something that Gwyneth, as capable as she might be, wouldn't be able to provide." Yes, but you didn't mean for her to take over all of it, just perhaps have someone help with the more mundane tasks so that — "No. It has to all be done within these walls. There is value in doing even menial tasks that may appear pointless at a first glance." You're just worried that this might all be too much for Salwah. Cait might be gone at a moment if you ask her to join you, Barney is busy with his own work, and there generally aren't that many hands around this temple to do everything that needs to be done, let alone care for a handful of kittens in the bargain. "And I appreciate the thought, but I already knew that when I gave my answer. What happens within these walls, stays within these walls, and that goes for more than the services provided to supplicants. I don't deny that it would be nice to have some hired help, but there's a reason why these things are done the way they are. Do pardon me." |"Now that the eldest kittens are getting a little older, I'll have to consider their future education. It's a little troublesome... I only know so much of the temple traditions and secrets that're relevant to my vocation, and the same goes for Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]. When the kittens get older, they may have to be sent back to Jassira for a while to truly get schooled in the secrets before returning to their posts here." Would that be a problem? The whole returning to Jassira thing, that is. "It'd have to be done sooner or later. There's the matter of Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and her brand which will have to be dealt with, and getting some measure of legitimacy — and hence support — in the eyes of the Temple structure that's expected of even a missionary outpost like this." You wouldn't call the glory of the restored temple %"just" a missionary outpost, but do go on. "There's no getting around it. If we're actually going to make this a proper Jassiran temple, it has to be done. Not right now, not even for some years, but we can't run away from it forever. Not without the experience and know-how that are needed for things to be done properly. The only way to get around it would be for Mallach himself to come down and teach us the mysteries, but I wouldn't put any money on that happening." [party.has cait | "Sally's right," Cait adds, settling back on the recliner with a sigh. "We'll have to go back... if anything, ever since the temple got built it's been pressed deeply upon me that I really don't know very much about being a matron or running a house of worship. It's way different than just trying to spread Mallach's word on street corners and tavern beds. I just hope that a couple of years has caused whatever anger they may have for me running away like that to die down somewhat. Maybe, just maybe, my achievements can outweigh my transgressions..." ] |"I can't wait for the kittens to be old enough to be able to help me out about the temple. That's still years off, yes, but I'm already looking forward to it." That sounds — "Yeah, I know. I'm just being a little grumpy today, that's all, and you're the first person to come around whom I'm not obliged to greet with a smile at all times. You've got to take life with the ups and downs, but the kittens have really got me down today; thank the gods that they've deigned to fall asleep at their usual time, if nothing else." Is there anything you can do to help? "It's not necessary — although if you really insist, you can make me feel good," Salwah replies with a small chuckle. "I'm sure I could use some time just for me, where I don't have to put on a face for everyone... just say the word, maybe make a donation, hmm?" ] |[rand |"It's good that Garth's people converted an entire wing of the ruins into living quarters — that there's actual flowing water and other small conveniences makes everything so much easier than it was back home. The running water was reserved for the baths only, and everything else had to be drawn from the well..." [party.has cait |"I remember all the wellside conversations we had with Calla," Cait adds with a laugh. "That, and the lady who'd sell spice bread in the evenings." ] You can imagine. Without adequate space and conveniences, Salwah's job would be more exhausting than it is already. "I just want enough space for the kittens to live, play and grow in peace for a while, and there's more than enough of that, if nothing else. They're the inquisitive, energetic type, and with so many of them at hand they're going to need plenty of space per kitten. That, and I'm sure there'll be a lot more of them coming in the future, not just from me but from others, too..." |There're certainly far more kittens about the place than there were before, aren't there? "I don't know where you're getting all this money to throw at me and my services, but whatever you're doing, I'd advise you to keep it up," Salwah replies with a giggle. "It's not just that I don't enjoy the work... but we're set for a little while now. I've written to the bank in Tychris, made an account with them and everything... as you've invested in us and our future, so are we going to invest in the Marches. And of course, the returns will go towards caring for the kittens and temple — better to put the money to work than let it sit around in the vault doing nothing." Wait, there's a vault in this temple? "Not one built to purpose, but yes. Tell a kitten not to go somewhere, and that just makes them want to do so all the more. Cheeky handful, the lot of them, and their number just keeps on growing..." Thanks to you. "Yes, thanks to us. If I could, I'd allow you a regular patron's discount... but alas, such shows of special favor aren't done in this context." |"Ah, now that the older ones are able to get around and talk a bit, I'm surprised at how bright some of the kittens are turning out to be. It's actually a little scary as to how quickly they're picking up on things and trying to help out about the temple — of course, since they're still so young, they usually wind up making more of a mess than they meant to clean up in the first place." It's the thought that counts, isn't it? That the kittens are as perky as their mother bodes well for the future. Salwah gives you a rueful smile. "The thought is nice, to be sure, but if they could get the act down as well... and as for that, I'd say their quick learning and intuition is better for the years to come than just mischievous energy. I can't wait to start their education in earnest... perhaps by then we'll have a couple more hands around the temple so that I don't have to lounge here in the daytime and play greeter, hmm?" |Is she sure that the coin you paid will be enough to raise the kittens to majority? There're already an ample number of the little mewling furballs around the temple, and that count is only set to grow in the future. "Ah, don't worry about it. Like I told you, the service is deliberately overpriced to begin with. That, and the kittens can share some of their needs, and the money you've been so kind to donate isn't just sitting somewhere gathering dust — it's making more money in Tychris for us. Assuming you can keep the peace, things are going to be looking up and rightfully prosperous for this little temple, and if you can't keep the peace... well, then the issue of money doesn't even come into question, does it?" You're just a little concerned — you've seen how much one of those little furballs eats. That, and the temple funding isn't segregated in such a rigorous fashion, you think. "You'd think right, we are flexible in our accounts — after all, I'm the one doing them. At the same time, I'd like to imagine that I'm not that irresponsible with our money. Don't worry, [pc.name] — no one here will be going hungry in the years to come, so don't worry about that. Focus on getting out there with Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and making sure there're years to come to begin with." ] ]
rows.translation: [salwah.numKids 1 3 5 |[rand |既然庙里现在有了一只小猫，我就得考虑一些办法，防止它们进入那些不该去的地方。当然，现在还早着呢，但回想起来，卡拉总是试图跑到那些不该去的地方，看到一些本不该看到的东西，那可真是让人头疼。以后我得参考贾西拉那些寺庙的做法，想办法让居住区适合小猫生活了。 [party.has cait |还记得那时候吗？卡拉爬上了寺庙的尖塔，却怎么也下不来了，对吧，莎莉？” “正是这件事让我开始担心这个地方的安全问题。” 凯特叹了口气：“哦，那场面真是乱七八糟的。如果不是因为那正是她自己想要做的，他们早就把她赶下去了。 ] 你得承认，讨论小猫在马拉克的神庙里乱跑这件事，确实有点奇怪。没错，你早就知道会发生这种事，也预料到了，但即便如此…… “嗯，就算从特罗纳里安的角度来看，把这座神庙看作是一系列妓院的集合体，这种想象也并不算太离谱吧。我知道，有些孩子不得不在妓院中长大。目前，这种状况已经根深蒂固，下一代马拉克信徒中有相当一部分都是在神庙中出生的。只要它们待在该待的地方——我知道，这对一只小猫来说确实是个很高的要求——它们的生活就会比大多数动物都要好得多。 |哎呀，整天都要照顾这么一个充满活力的小家伙，确实是一种特别的体验。说起来，我对此并不陌生，因为小时候我也经常照顾小动物，但照顾别人的孩子和照顾自己的孩子，还是有点不一样的，你知道吧？说实话，这个小家伙比那些最需要关心、最黏人的生物还要麻烦——它总是想让人喂它、抱它、给它唱歌，总之就是想让人一直照顾它。而且当它醒着的时候，我甚至一刻都不能把它放下，呵呵！ But seriously, though, when you're done with all this... it's something that you're more than likely to end up doing, and I'll be there by your side when it happens." "I'll cross that bridge when I get to it, Sally, and not one moment before." ] |"The kitten you paid for is just the most adorable little fluffball in all of existence! Sure, there're those difficult moments, especially at the end of a long day running the temple, but when all's said and done just seeing my kitten makes at least some of the tiredness go away." Hah, that's often in direct contrast to what most people think of young children. "Well, I do have experience. And even if the brand does make sure they come out as catfolk, the kitten sure does have all of your energy! There's more to inheritance than just looks, after all!" Ah. "I'd be tempted to say I'd do it even if you didn't pay me, but rules are rules and there're standards and appearances to be upheld. That, and there's always the matter of the temple's upkeep to consider..." |So, to get this right — the kittens you paid for will live in the temple until they reach their majority, and then they're free to make the choice whether to stay on or leave? Salwah nods. "That's about the long and short of it, yes; it's what happened with Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and Calla alike. One chose to stay and the other to leave... until the other chose to leave at the last moment, too. We don't throw them out with just the clothes on their backs — the Jassiran Mallachites still have many connections about the sultanate, and not just because the progeny of surrogates come from moneyed families. Some return to the households they're nominally a part of, but even if they don't their so-called families do sometimes help the temple to get them an in somewhere. Generally speaking, temple kittens tend to have better lives than most, even if they don't stay on." Ah... but such connections don't exist for this temple, do they? "They will by the time we're done. That's what Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and you are working hard to do, aren't you? It's not like she's busy ingratiating herself to the village down below or anything... sure, we won't measure up to the generations of interwoven relationships between the Temple and the sultanate, but trust me when I say we're sparing no expense in setting down good foundations for the future of the temple." Which, of course, means roughing it now. Salwah laughs and waves a hand at her luxuriant surroundings. "I wouldn't quite call this roughing it, not in the physical sense of things, but yes, I do get your point. Catnaps are all I've been able to have these days, jugging both the demands of kittens and supplicants alike." ] |[rand |"Mr. Zethra is kind of glad there's a bit more life about the temple these days — so long as the kittens stay out of his way while he's working in the back by the portal that may or may not be there, the way he puts it. He says it reminds him of when Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and Calla were younger..." Ah... "I don't mind him being a father figure to the kittens — they need one, after all. The man's getting to the age where he instinctively dotes on children, and in the absence of Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] or Calla having any of their own, mine are the next best choice. There really isn't much to spoil them on over here in this desolate part of the world, but he does his best anyway." [party.has cait |Speaking of which, since her dad's really getting into the spirit of things, what does Cait herself think of having some kittens after all this is over? Salwah and you can find some way to get that brand off her, or more likely, get a proper one inscribed that she can turn on and off at will, and then make her father happy while also earning income for the temple? Cait just sticks out her tongue. "I'm not a garden of children, that'll always be Sally's [silly |baby ]bag, even when someday I have the chance to devote myself wholly to the temple. I was trained to be a nobleman's arm candy, and a big baby belly hardly fits my aesthetic..." And what if it was the same wealthy client who'd bought her services that wanted to breed her? Say a long-term patron of her temple...? Cheeks flushing, Cait glances between you and Sally's stomach. "Maybe... maybe when all this wicked business with Kasyrra's done... when I have Calla back... maybe then we can talk about it. But I wouldn't do it for some random client, you know. I'd hate to take Sally's business like that." So only for a special someone, then? Like her parents' arrangement? "D-don't get ahead of yourself! But maybe. Just maybe..." |Cait's dad is a really jovial man, the kind of man who really loves life, and you can't see anything but good coming from him being around kittens. So long as he doesn't go too far in his efforts to entertain and spoil them, it should give him something to fill his hours with when he's not working at the portal. ] |With more kittens around and presumably more yet to come, has she ever considered asking the nursery down in town for help? Salwah shakes her head most emphatically. "Oh no, can't do that. Temple kittens abide by temple rules and live temple lives. As well-meaning as you might have been, such a thing just wouldn't work. The tradition of the Jassirans means that being raised within these walls is more than simple caregiving, and it's something that Gwyneth, as capable as she might be, wouldn't be able to provide." Yes, but you didn't mean for her to take over all of it, just perhaps have someone help with the more mundane tasks so that — "No. It has to all be done within these walls. There is value in doing even menial tasks that may appear pointless at a first glance." You're just worried that this might all be too much for Salwah. Cait might be gone at a moment if you ask her to join you, Barney is busy with his own work, and there generally aren't that many hands around this temple to do everything that needs to be done, let alone care for a handful of kittens in the bargain. "And I appreciate the thought, but I already knew that when I gave my answer. What happens within these walls, stays within these walls, and that goes for more than the services provided to supplicants. I don't deny that it would be nice to have some hired help, but there's a reason why these things are done the way they are. Do pardon me." |"Now that the eldest kittens are getting a little older, I'll have to consider their future education. It's a little troublesome... I only know so much of the temple traditions and secrets that're relevant to my vocation, and the same goes for Caitriss[silly |-senpai ]. When the kittens get older, they may have to be sent back to Jassira for a while to truly get schooled in the secrets before returning to their posts here." Would that be a problem? The whole returning to Jassira thing, that is. "It'd have to be done sooner or later. There's the matter of Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and her brand which will have to be dealt with, and getting some measure of legitimacy — and hence support — in the eyes of the Temple structure that's expected of even a missionary outpost like this." You wouldn't call the glory of the restored temple %"just" a missionary outpost, but do go on. "There's no getting around it. If we're actually going to make this a proper Jassiran temple, it has to be done. Not right now, not even for some years, but we can't run away from it forever. Not without the experience and know-how that are needed for things to be done properly. The only way to get around it would be for Mallach himself to come down and teach us the mysteries, but I wouldn't put any money on that happening." [party.has cait | "Sally's right," Cait adds, settling back on the recliner with a sigh. "We'll have to go back... if anything, ever since the temple got built it's been pressed deeply upon me that I really don't know very much about being a matron or running a house of worship. It's way different than just trying to spread Mallach's word on street corners and tavern beds. I just hope that a couple of years has caused whatever anger they may have for me running away like that to die down somewhat. Maybe, just maybe, my achievements can outweigh my transgressions..." ] |"I can't wait for the kittens to be old enough to be able to help me out about the temple. That's still years off, yes, but I'm already looking forward to it." That sounds — "Yeah, I know. I'm just being a little grumpy today, that's all, and you're the first person to come around whom I'm not obliged to greet with a smile at all times. You've got to take life with the ups and downs, but the kittens have really got me down today; thank the gods that they've deigned to fall asleep at their usual time, if nothing else." Is there anything you can do to help? "It's not necessary — although if you really insist, you can make me feel good," Salwah replies with a small chuckle. "I'm sure I could use some time just for me, where I don't have to put on a face for everyone... just say the word, maybe make a donation, hmm?" ] |[rand |"It's good that Garth's people converted an entire wing of the ruins into living quarters — that there's actual flowing water and other small conveniences makes everything so much easier than it was back home. The running water was reserved for the baths only, and everything else had to be drawn from the well..." [party.has cait |"I remember all the wellside conversations we had with Calla," Cait adds with a laugh. "That, and the lady who'd sell spice bread in the evenings." ] You can imagine. Without adequate space and conveniences, Salwah's job would be more exhausting than it is already. "I just want enough space for the kittens to live, play and grow in peace for a while, and there's more than enough of that, if nothing else. They're the inquisitive, energetic type, and with so many of them at hand they're going to need plenty of space per kitten. That, and I'm sure there'll be a lot more of them coming in the future, not just from me but from others, too..." |There're certainly far more kittens about the place than there were before, aren't there? "I don't know where you're getting all this money to throw at me and my services, but whatever you're doing, I'd advise you to keep it up," Salwah replies with a giggle. "It's not just that I don't enjoy the work... but we're set for a little while now. I've written to the bank in Tychris, made an account with them and everything... as you've invested in us and our future, so are we going to invest in the Marches. And of course, the returns will go towards caring for the kittens and temple — better to put the money to work than let it sit around in the vault doing nothing." Wait, there's a vault in this temple? "Not one built to purpose, but yes. Tell a kitten not to go somewhere, and that just makes them want to do so all the more. Cheeky handful, the lot of them, and their number just keeps on growing..." Thanks to you. "Yes, thanks to us. If I could, I'd allow you a regular patron's discount... but alas, such shows of special favor aren't done in this context." |"Ah, now that the older ones are able to get around and talk a bit, I'm surprised at how bright some of the kittens are turning out to be. It's actually a little scary as to how quickly they're picking up on things and trying to help out about the temple — of course, since they're still so young, they usually wind up making more of a mess than they meant to clean up in the first place." It's the thought that counts, isn't it? That the kittens are as perky as their mother bodes well for the future. Salwah gives you a rueful smile. "The thought is nice, to be sure, but if they could get the act down as well... and as for that, I'd say their quick learning and intuition is better for the years to come than just mischievous energy. I can't wait to start their education in earnest... perhaps by then we'll have a couple more hands around the temple so that I don't have to lounge here in the daytime and play greeter, hmm?" |Is she sure that the coin you paid will be enough to raise the kittens to majority? There're already an ample number of the little mewling furballs around the temple, and that count is only set to grow in the future. "Ah, don't worry about it. Like I told you, the service is deliberately overpriced to begin with. That, and the kittens can share some of their needs, and the money you've been so kind to donate isn't just sitting somewhere gathering dust — it's making more money in Tychris for us. Assuming you can keep the peace, things are going to be looking up and rightfully prosperous for this little temple, and if you can't keep the peace... well, then the issue of money doesn't even come into question, does it?" You're just a little concerned — you've seen how much one of those little furballs eats. That, and the temple funding isn't segregated in such a rigorous fashion, you think. "You'd think right, we are flexible in our accounts — after all, I'm the one doing them. At the same time, I'd like to imagine that I'm not that irresponsible with our money. Don't worry, [pc.name] — no one here will be going hungry in the years to come, so don't worry about that. Focus on getting out there with Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and making sure there're years to come to begin with." ] ] "

rows.translation: 小猫们

rows.original: Salwah grins lazily at the suggestion, smacking her ample butt with her tail. "Well... I was about to light up another round for myself. You need enough to get a good density of smoke, but that usually means it's too much for a single person, so I can't justify it to myself while alone. But with [party.has cait |Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and you |you ] here, I guess I have an excuse, don't I?" How generous of her. "Nonsense. [party.has cait |Caitriss[silly |-Senpai's |' ] here, you're here, and three is a party. The little bit of extra spice is worth it just to have the pleasure of your company." Cait laughs and pats her junior on the head, right between the ears. "You're laying it on thickly today, Sally. I'm not a supplicant that you need to turn on the soothing platitudes towards me... or am I?" |Don't put yourself down like that, [pc.name] — it's just a few grains more for the pleasure of your company. Surely you consider your presence worth more than that, right?" When she puts it that way... ] [pc.isPregnant |Question, though, it's fine for you to do this while pregnant, right? "Only asking now? But yes, don't worry about it. [salwah.isPregnant |Look at me with a kitten inside of me, and I'm smoking the stuff all day. Spice is harmless to a growing kitten; it's used all over Jassira |We even give spice bread to kittens in Jassira, so there's nothing to worry about at all ]. ] "Now, if you'll give me a moment, I'll get this all together." It's an experience watching Salwah refill her hookah — after setting her mouthpiece on the recliner, she opens a small hatch in the hookah's upper bowl and draws out a thin metal plate. It might have once been copper or bronze, but now is stained with various shades of red and brown; the comfy cat sets this on a side table and gets out a padded case from a drawer, from which she draws out [party.has cait |three |two ] flexible tubes with metal mouthpieces. "Don't worry about them being clean, the mouthpieces have to be boiled in water before I put them away," she quips. "Now to tend to the spice plate. Could you fill the water bowl while I get that done? There's a jug on the plinth over by the temple entrance; fill up the bottom bulb to the mark on the glass." As you hurry to comply, Salwah gets out a glass shaker of spice from the drawer and unscrews the cap. She gives the lid a deep sniff, sighing huskily and longingly at the scent of the heavy reddish-brown powder; a woozy smile still on her face, she thumps the shaker and sends an even dusting of spice powder atop the metal plate. "Ah, smells good," the chocokitty says with a chuckle as she slides the spice plate back into the hookah and slams the hatch shut. "The spice must flow, and it sure flows well — nothing worse in the world than caked spice powder. How's the water looking?" You're just about done — the floral pattern on the stained glass makes things a little hard to see, but you're done. After making sure everything's in order, Salwah dumps a few crumbs of charcoal into the upper bowl beneath the spice plate and [party.has cait |gives Cait a smile. "Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ], would you do the honors?" Grinning from ear to ear, Cait slinks down from the bed to take up position on the rug, selecting a mouthpiece for herself. "Gladly. It's been a while since I did this, and even longer since we did this together, Sally." "I'll leave a space open for Calla." Cait pauses, then hangs her head as her smile turns rueful. "Ah, right. Well, let's get this started." Your pink kitten mumbles a chant under her breath, and the fine charcoal suddenly bursts into gentle flame |sets them alight with a snap of her fingers ]. Before long, the surrounding air fills with a heavy, calming scent, sweet and spicy at the same time. You can't help but take great big mouthfuls of the stuff, and a pleasant albeit faint buzz starts up in the back of your head, helping your muscles relax. "Come on, [pc.name]. Take up your mouthpiece." The soft bubbling of red spice smoke through cooling water is something to behold. Even as you stare at it through the glass, mesmerised, Salwah opens a decanter of white wine and pours a small glass each for [party.has cait |all |the both ] of you, dusting the surface with a sprinkling of spice. She hands one to you[party.has cait |, one to Cait, and keeps the last for herself | and keeps the other for herself ], the three of you settling side by side on the recliner. Just three cats getting high, in full, glorious view of anyone entering the temple. "I've tried several local wines Garth has, and this one's best with the smoke. Inhale first, then take a sip." [party.has cait |You chance a glance at Cait, who's already huffing away at the mouthpiece. Drawing away, your pink kitten exhales, sweet spicy scents pouring from her lips, and a dreamy smile spreads across her face. Her ears fold forward and to the sides, and her tail swishes lazily atop the recliner's heave cushion. "Mallach's balls," she says with a sigh. "I needed this." Salwah grins and gives her senior a kiss on the cheek. "The stuff I brought from home's long since run out. Good thing that the locals don't really know what manticore nip is, so I can get it cheaply." "No meeting without parting." "No joy that doesn't fade." Closing her eyes, Cait throws her head back and raises the mouthpiece to her lips for another deep draw of the spice smoke. Salwah's smile turns a little sad, and she gives her senior's brow a gentle brush with her fingertips before parting. ] Well, nothing for it. You raise your own metal mouthpiece, steady yourself, and inhale. The heavy smoke first invades your mouth, leaving your tongue tingling, then rushes down your throat and into your lungs. For a moment, there's the instinct to cough and sputter, but that soon passes as your muscles relax and nothing seems to matter very much anymore. Sure, you feel calm and carefree, but it doesn't come with the dulled senses characteristic of winterstem use; instead, everything seems so much more bright and clear; you can practically envision your thoughts speeding through your mind in that one moment — and then you pull away from the mouthpiece and exhale. ...Wow. And this is the normal stuff — wonder what the concentrated, narcotic spice Jassiran Mallachites use when they want to open their minds to Mallach feels like... "Feels good, doesn't it?" Salwah purrs from beside you. Spice-scented smoke rises from her nostrils as she flashes you a grin, then takes a sip of the spiked wine. "Being able to see, think, hear and feel in so much more detail. It — aaaah." That has to be the most contentment and pleasure you've ever heard condensed into a single sigh. Eyes half-lidded, Salwah melts into a tanned puddle atop the recliner, dark emerald eyes fixed on the wineglass before her. Looks like the spice's just shorted out her brain.[party.has cait | Not that Cait's much better — as you watch, your pink kitten downs all her spiced wine in a single gulp and flops over onto her back, eyes staring up at the temple's high ceiling as she huffs steadily from the hookah's mouthpiece. ] Next round, then. You take a sip of the spiced wine, letting its bittersweet taste wash over your tongue and mix with the smoke, then raise the mouthpiece and take another drag. This time the smoke is smooth and subtle despite its heaviness, your relaxed body barely putting up any kind of fight as it slips down your throat and settles heavily in your lungs. Oh shit, oh shit, everything's starting to feel really gooood and you can't be bothered to care about much anymore... there's still a half-glass of spice-sprinkled wine left in your glass, and you give that a hefty gulp before settling back against the foot of the bed to enjoy the scent of spice. The explosion of intense flavor on your tongue sears your mouth as the divine liquid runs down your throat, and your insides tie themselves in knots — in a good way — as your belly heats up in earnest.[party.has cait | Soft moaning and mewling from either side of you draws your attention — Cait and Salwah are getting at each other, the temple sluts pawing at each others' clothes over your lap; perhaps you should join them in their amorous fun, but that'd mean leaving your mouthpiece unattended and besides, your body feels all heavy and runny, like molten cheese... ] ...Where did that comparison come from, anyway? And why is the world so bright, hued in such vivid detail, with lines and shadows leaping out at you from their own darkness? Wow, what a whole new perspective on the world; you're sure your mind is sloshing over with inspiration and fresh ideas, given how you can feel them roiling about in your skull! Now, if only you could just remember what they were... How much spice have you inhaled, anyway? It certainly is a lot stronger and fast-acting than if you drank it. Maybe there's something about burning it that makes it all the more — — You never get to finish that thought before passing straight out on the recliner[party.has cait |, the sounds of two hungry kittens messily pawing at and slobbering all over each other lulling you into unconsciousness ].
rows.translation: 萨尔瓦听到这个建议后懒洋洋地笑了笑，用尾巴轻轻拍打着自己丰满的臀部。“嗯……我本来正打算再点上一轮烟呢。要产生足够的烟雾密度，需要的烟量通常对一个人来说来说太多了，所以如果只有我一个人，我就觉得不划算……不过如果有你的话[party.has cait |凯特[silly |前辈 ]还有你 |你 ]在这里，我想我确实有理由这样做，不是吗？” 她真是太慷慨了。 “胡说八道。 [party.has cait |凯特[silly |-学长的 |' ]在这里，有你在这里，三个人在一起就成了一场聚会。多一点额外的乐趣也是值得的，只要能和你在一起就好了。” 凯特笑着轻拍了一下莎莉的脑袋，正好拍在她的耳朵旁边。“你今天真是太夸张了，莎莉。我又不是什么需要你用这些安慰的话来哄骗的人……吧？ |别这样贬低自己。[pc.name]只不过是再添几粒罢了，就是为了能与您共度这段时光。您应该觉得自己的陪伴远比这些更有价值吧？” 当她这么说的时候…… ] [pc.isPregnant |不过，我想问一下，你在怀孕期间做这个应该没有问题吧？ “现在才问？其实没有问题的，不用担心。 [salwah.isPregnant |你看我，内心仿佛住着一只小猫，一整天都在抽烟。对于正在成长的小猫来说，这种香料是完全无害的；在贾西拉，人们到处都在使用它 |在贾西拉，我们甚至会给小猫们喂食香料面包，所以完全没有什么可担心的 ]。 ] 现在，请稍等片刻，我马上就把这些准备妥当。” 看着萨尔瓦重新组装她的水烟筒，实在是一件很有意思的景象——她将吸嘴放在躺椅上，然后打开水烟筒上部的一个小盖子，取出一块薄金属板。这块金属板原本可能是铜或青铜制成的，但现在已经被染成了各种红色和棕色的痕迹。萨尔瓦把这块金属板放在旁边的桌子上，然后从抽屉里拿出一个有软垫的盒子，从中取出了其他所需的物品。 [party.has cait |三 |两个 ]带有金属嘴部的柔软管子。 “别担心它们会不会不干净，我在把它们收起来之前，一定会把嘴部部分煮沸消毒的，”她开玩笑地说。“现在该去处理那个调味料盘了。等我处理完那个，你能去把水碗装满水吗？寺庙入口旁的基座上有一个水壶，把下装的容器装满到玻璃杯上的刻度线为止。 你急忙去照做时，萨尔瓦从抽屉里拿出了一个装着香料的玻璃搅拌器，拧开了盖子。她深深地吸了一口容器里的香气，那浓郁的红棕色粉末散发出的味道让她不禁发出一声叹息，脸上还带着陶醉的笑容。然后她用力摇晃搅拌器，将一层均匀的香料粉末撒在金属盘子上。 啊，闻起来真香，”巧克力猫笑着说，一边把香料盘重新放回水烟筒里，然后关上了盖子。“香料必须能够顺畅流动，现在看来流动得确实很好——世界上没有什么比结块的香料粉更糟糕的了。水看起来怎么样？” 你差不多完成了——彩窗玻璃上的花纹让视线有些模糊，但总之你已经完成了。在确认一切无误后，萨尔瓦在香料盘下方的碗里撒了几粒木炭，然后[party.has cait |让凯特露出了微笑。 “凯特[silly |-学长 ]你能来主持这个环节吗？” 凯特笑得合不拢嘴，从床上爬下来，坐在地毯上，选了一个话筒。“当然可以。我已经有一段时间没有这么做了，而我们上次一起做这个也是很久以前的事了。一起萨莉。” “我会为卡拉留一个位置的。” 凯特停顿了一下，然后低下头，脸上的笑容变得有些遗憾。“啊，对了。那么，我们开始吧。” 你的粉色小猫低声念着某种咒语，那些细小的木炭突然燃起了柔和的火焰。 |她只需轻轻一弹手指，这些东西便立刻被点燃了。 ]不久之后，周围的空气中弥漫起一种浓郁而令人放松的气息，这种气味既甜美又带有辛辣的味道。你忍不住会大口吸入这种空气，这时，你的后脑勺会传来一阵愉悦而轻微的嗡嗡声，这种感觉能够帮助你的肌肉放松。 “来吧，[pc.name]请站出来发声吧。” 红色香料烟雾在冷却水中缓缓弥漫，这一景象实在令人陶醉。当你透过玻璃凝视这一幕时，萨尔瓦突然打开了一个白葡萄酒瓶，为在场的每个人倒了一小杯酒。 [party.has cait |所有 |两者 ]她从你们当中挑选了一个人，只是在他的外表上加了一些“点缀”而已。然后，她把那个被“装饰”过的人交给了你。[party.has cait |一个给了凯特，最后一个则留给了自己。 | 而把另一个留给了自己。 ]你们三个并排坐在躺椅上，就像三只陶醉其中的猫，任何人走进这个房间，都能清楚地看到这一幕。 “加斯提供的几种本地葡萄酒我都试过了，这种酒搭配烟雾效果最好。先深吸一口气，然后再小口品尝。 [party.has cait |你随意瞥了眼凯特，她正在对着吹口大口喘气。你的粉色小猫慢慢退开一些，呼出的气息中散发着甜中带辣的香气，她的脸上浮现出梦幻般的微笑。她的耳朵向前并向两侧耷拉下来，尾巴则懒洋洋地在躺椅的靠背上摆动着。 真是太好了，”她叹着气说道，“我正需要这个呢。” 萨尔瓦笑了起来，然后在她的脸颊上亲了一下：“我从家里带来的那些东西早就用完了。幸好当地人并不了解‘曼提科尔尼普’是什么，所以我可以便宜地买到它。没有离别，就没有相聚。” “没有会消逝的欢乐。” 凯特闭上眼睛，仰起头，将烟斗送到唇边，又深深地吸了一口那带有香味的烟雾。萨尔瓦的微笑中带着一丝忧伤，在告别之前，她用指尖轻轻触了触那位前辈的眉头。 ] 嗯，其实没什么难的。你只需要抬起自己的嘴唇，稳住身体，然后吸气。浓烟首先侵入你的口腔，让你的舌头感到刺痛，接着它们会涌入你的喉咙，进入你的肺部。有那么一瞬间，你会本能地想要咳嗽、咳出痰来，但很快这种感觉就会消失，因为你的肌肉会放松下来，这时似乎一切都不再那么重要了。当然，你会感到平静而无忧无虑，但这种状态并不会伴随着使用冬茎后那种感官变得迟钝的现象；相反，一切似乎都变得更加明亮、更加清晰了；在那一瞬间，你甚至能够清晰地看到自己的思绪在脑海中飞速流动——然后，你从那个发声器中移开嘴，呼出一口气。 ……哇。而这些还只是普通的材料呢——真想知道当贾西兰·马拉克信徒想要让自己的心灵更加敞开、更好地感受马拉克的力量时，他们会使用哪种浓度更高、效果更强的麻醉性香料呢…… “感觉不错吧？”萨尔瓦在你身旁轻声说道。当她向你露出微笑时，一股带有香料的烟雾从她的鼻孔中散发出来，随后她喝了一口这种加入了香料的葡萄酒。“能够以更加细致的方式看到、思考、听到和感受到一切。这真是啊……那一定是一个将所有满足与愉悦都浓缩在一声叹息中的表达。萨尔瓦半闭着眼睛，整个人仿佛融化了般瘫在躺椅上，那双深绿色的眼睛紧紧盯着眼前的酒杯。看来这些香料真的让她的大脑“短路”了[party.has cait | 不过凯特也好不到哪里去——当你看着她的时候，那只粉红色的小猫会一口喝光所有加了香料的酒，然后仰面躺下来，眼睛盯着寺庙高高的天花板，不断地从水烟筒的吸口处吸气。 ] 那么，下一轮吧。你喝了一口这种加了香料的酒，让它的苦甜味道在舌头上弥漫，与烟雾混合在一起，然后再次将烟嘴含在口中吸了一口。这一次，尽管烟雾很浓重，但它却显得十分顺滑、细腻。你放松的身体几乎没有产生任何抵抗，就让烟雾滑入喉咙，沉沉地落在肺部。哦，天啊，一切都开始变得如此太好了而你已经懒得再去关心任何事情了……你的杯子里还剩半杯撒了香料的葡萄酒，但你却对此毫不在意那个他大口喝下这杯酒，然后靠在床脚，尽情享受着那些香料的芬芳。浓郁的味道在舌头上爆发，刺激着你的味蕾，当这美妙的液体顺着喉咙流下去时，你的整个身体仿佛都被点燃了——当然，这是种非常美妙的感受，因为你的肚子开始热了起来。[party.has cait | 你耳边传来轻轻的呻吟声和喵喵叫声，吸引了你的注意——凯特和萨尔瓦正在互相调情，那些寺庙里的妓女们也在你的腿上拉扯着对方的衣服；或许你应该加入她们的“亲密游戏”中，但那样就会让你的“代言人”无人看管了，而且，你的身体也感觉变得沉重而柔软，就像融化的奶酪一样…… ] ……这种比较究竟是从哪里来的呢？为什么这个世界会如此明亮，色彩如此生动逼真，线条和阴影仿佛从自身的暗影中跃了出来，如此清晰地呈现在我们眼前？哇，这种看待世界的方式真是完全不同了；当你感觉到这些新的想法在你的脑海中翻腾不已时，你肯定会觉得自己的思维充满了灵感和新的创意吧！现在，要是你能想起它们到底是什么该多好啊…… 你到底吸入了多少这种香料啊？它的效果确实比直接饮用要强烈得多，也起效得更快。也许，将其燃烧后使用，才会让它的效果更加显著吧…… — 你还没来得及把那个想法说完，就直接在躺椅上昏过去了。[party.has cait |两只饥饿的小猫互相用爪子乱抓、口水弄得到处都是，那些声音会让你渐渐进入沉睡状态 ]。
rows.raw: " Salwah grins lazily at the suggestion, smacking her ample butt with her tail. "Well... I was about to light up another round for myself. You need enough to get a good density of smoke, but that usually means it's too much for a single person, so I can't justify it to myself while alone. But with [party.has cait |Caitriss[silly |-senpai ] and you |you ] here, I guess I have an excuse, don't I?" How generous of her. "Nonsense. [party.has cait |Caitriss[silly |-Senpai's |' ] here, you're here, and three is a party. The little bit of extra spice is worth it just to have the pleasure of your company." Cait laughs and pats her junior on the head, right between the ears. "You're laying it on thickly today, Sally. I'm not a supplicant that you need to turn on the soothing platitudes towards me... or am I?" |Don't put yourself down like that, [pc.name] — it's just a few grains more for the pleasure of your company. Surely you consider your presence worth more than that, right?" When she puts it that way... ] [pc.isPregnant |Question, though, it's fine for you to do this while pregnant, right? "Only asking now? But yes, don't worry about it. [salwah.isPregnant |Look at me with a kitten inside of me, and I'm smoking the stuff all day. Spice is harmless to a growing kitten; it's used all over Jassira |We even give spice bread to kittens in Jassira, so there's nothing to worry about at all ]. ] "Now, if you'll give me a moment, I'll get this all together." It's an experience watching Salwah refill her hookah — after setting her mouthpiece on the recliner, she opens a small hatch in the hookah's upper bowl and draws out a thin metal plate. It might have once been copper or bronze, but now is stained with various shades of red and brown; the comfy cat sets this on a side table and gets out a padded case from a drawer, from which she draws out [party.has cait |three |two ] flexible tubes with metal mouthpieces. "Don't worry about them being clean, the mouthpieces have to be boiled in water before I put them away," she quips. "Now to tend to the spice plate. Could you fill the water bowl while I get that done? There's a jug on the plinth over by the temple entrance; fill up the bottom bulb to the mark on the glass." As you hurry to comply, Salwah gets out a glass shaker of spice from the drawer and unscrews the cap. She gives the lid a deep sniff, sighing huskily and longingly at the scent of the heavy reddish-brown powder; a woozy smile still on her face, she thumps the shaker and sends an even dusting of spice powder atop the metal plate. "Ah, smells good," the chocokitty says with a chuckle as she slides the spice plate back into the hookah and slams the hatch shut. "The spice must flow, and it sure flows well — nothing worse in the world than caked spice powder. How's the water looking?" You're just about done — the floral pattern on the stained glass makes things a little hard to see, but you're done. After making sure everything's in order, Salwah dumps a few crumbs of charcoal into the upper bowl beneath the spice plate and [party.has cait |gives Cait a smile. "Caitriss[silly |-Senpai ], would you do the honors?" Grinning from ear to ear, Cait slinks down from the bed to take up position on the rug, selecting a mouthpiece for herself. "Gladly. It's been a while since I did this, and even longer since we did this together, Sally." "I'll leave a space open for Calla." Cait pauses, then hangs her head as her smile turns rueful. "Ah, right. Well, let's get this started." Your pink kitten mumbles a chant under her breath, and the fine charcoal suddenly bursts into gentle flame |sets them alight with a snap of her fingers ]. Before long, the surrounding air fills with a heavy, calming scent, sweet and spicy at the same time. You can't help but take great big mouthfuls of the stuff, and a pleasant albeit faint buzz starts up in the back of your head, helping your muscles relax. "Come on, [pc.name]. Take up your mouthpiece." The soft bubbling of red spice smoke through cooling water is something to behold. Even as you stare at it through the glass, mesmerised, Salwah opens a decanter of white wine and pours a small glass each for [party.has cait |all |the both ] of you, dusting the surface with a sprinkling of spice. She hands one to you[party.has cait |, one to Cait, and keeps the last for herself | and keeps the other for herself ], the three of you settling side by side on the recliner. Just three cats getting high, in full, glorious view of anyone entering the temple. "I've tried several local wines Garth has, and this one's best with the smoke. Inhale first, then take a sip." [party.has cait |You chance a glance at Cait, who's already huffing away at the mouthpiece. Drawing away, your pink kitten exhales, sweet spicy scents pouring from her lips, and a dreamy smile spreads across her face. Her ears fold forward and to the sides, and her tail swishes lazily atop the recliner's heave cushion. "Mallach's balls," she says with a sigh. "I needed this." Salwah grins and gives her senior a kiss on the cheek. "The stuff I brought from home's long since run out. Good thing that the locals don't really know what manticore nip is, so I can get it cheaply." "No meeting without parting." "No joy that doesn't fade." Closing her eyes, Cait throws her head back and raises the mouthpiece to her lips for another deep draw of the spice smoke. Salwah's smile turns a little sad, and she gives her senior's brow a gentle brush with her fingertips before parting. ] Well, nothing for it. You raise your own metal mouthpiece, steady yourself, and inhale. The heavy smoke first invades your mouth, leaving your tongue tingling, then rushes down your throat and into your lungs. For a moment, there's the instinct to cough and sputter, but that soon passes as your muscles relax and nothing seems to matter very much anymore. Sure, you feel calm and carefree, but it doesn't come with the dulled senses characteristic of winterstem use; instead, everything seems so much more bright and clear; you can practically envision your thoughts speeding through your mind in that one moment — and then you pull away from the mouthpiece and exhale. ...Wow. And this is the normal stuff — wonder what the concentrated, narcotic spice Jassiran Mallachites use when they want to open their minds to Mallach feels like... "Feels good, doesn't it?" Salwah purrs from beside you. Spice-scented smoke rises from her nostrils as she flashes you a grin, then takes a sip of the spiked wine. "Being able to see, think, hear and feel in so much more detail. It — aaaah." That has to be the most contentment and pleasure you've ever heard condensed into a single sigh. Eyes half-lidded, Salwah melts into a tanned puddle atop the recliner, dark emerald eyes fixed on the wineglass before her. Looks like the spice's just shorted out her brain.[party.has cait | Not that Cait's much better — as you watch, your pink kitten downs all her spiced wine in a single gulp and flops over onto her back, eyes staring up at the temple's high ceiling as she huffs steadily from the hookah's mouthpiece. ] Next round, then. You take a sip of the spiced wine, letting its bittersweet taste wash over your tongue and mix with the smoke, then raise the mouthpiece and take another drag. This time the smoke is smooth and subtle despite its heaviness, your relaxed body barely putting up any kind of fight as it slips down your throat and settles heavily in your lungs. Oh shit, oh shit, everything's starting to feel really gooood and you can't be bothered to care about much anymore... there's still a half-glass of spice-sprinkled wine left in your glass, and you give that a hefty gulp before settling back against the foot of the bed to enjoy the scent of spice. The explosion of intense flavor on your tongue sears your mouth as the divine liquid runs down your throat, and your insides tie themselves in knots — in a good way — as your belly heats up in earnest.[party.has cait | Soft moaning and mewling from either side of you draws your attention — Cait and Salwah are getting at each other, the temple sluts pawing at each others' clothes over your lap; perhaps you should join them in their amorous fun, but that'd mean leaving your mouthpiece unattended and besides, your body feels all heavy and runny, like molten cheese... ] ...Where did that comparison come from, anyway? And why is the world so bright, hued in such vivid detail, with lines and shadows leaping out at you from their own darkness? Wow, what a whole new perspective on the world; you're sure your mind is sloshing over with inspiration and fresh ideas, given how you can feel them roiling about in your skull! Now, if only you could just remember what they were... How much spice have you inhaled, anyway? It certainly is a lot stronger and fast-acting than if you drank it. Maybe there's something about burning it that makes it all the more — — You never get to finish that thought before passing straight out on the recliner[party.has cait |, the sounds of two hungry kittens messily pawing at and slobbering all over each other lulling you into unconsciousness ]. "

rows.original: Ah... this probably seems strange, but would she allow you to pet her? Salwah purrs throatily, half-lidding her eyes and giving you a cheeky, lip-biting smile. Swishing her tail back and forth, the comfy cat flexes her tanned form in a full-body stretch; the movement serves to show off her gymnast's body and the faint outline of muscles in her limbs and belly, how they shift and make the deep tattoos on her skin dance. "Ah, my friend... back in the temple, they charge people for the luxury of doing just that..." How much is she charging? "...But since my senior owes you her life and more, I'll do it pro bono," she finishes with a laugh. "No other freebies, though, okay? Body's a temple and all, and it needs tithes to keep up appearances." All right, you understand. "Very well." Turning her gaze up to you, Salwah fixes her wide, deep emerald eyes on you adoringly; the priestess lays out on her side atop the bed, idly flicking her tail as she reaches up for her shawl. In one fluid motion, she pulls it up and over her ears, shaking out her butt-length hair in a glorious toss and allowing the deep purple strands to fall all over her shoulders and side. "Please, begin as you wish." Well then, it's customary to begin from the top-down. Salwah's ears are long and thin for a feline, and a soft, sighing purr escapes her lips as you scratch their backs, starting from tip to base and back to tip again, one at a time. When you've made a few passes, you start tending to both at once, feeling them twitch and fold forward at your touch; her smile widens as she nestles further in the sheets and makes herself comfortable, tilting her head gently to follow your touch. Your thumbs find their way to the cartilaginous edges, teasing them while you scratch the soft, fine fuzz on the backs, then elicit a deeper sigh from Salwah as they invade their insides. "Be careful now... don't get overeager." Fine hairs tickle and prick at your thumbs, delicate fuzz suited to the sensing of sounds. The insides of Salwah's ears are delightfully warm as you stroke them in a circular motion, picking up sudden speed as they move beneath your touch. Abruptly, she shudders a little and sucks in a sharp breath — although given how much control over her body she boasts of having, one can only wonder if this is real or not... ...But does it matter? It's doing a very good job of egging you on — nothing's more of a turn-off than a limp, unresponsive partner, after all, and as a professional harlot she should know that. You give Salwah's ears several more scritches for good measure, then turn your attention to her hair. Ah, such luxuriant hair — no doubt carefully tended to for maximum effect, the deep purple strands scented with sweet, floral musk. Your breath catches in your throat as you run your fingers through this wondrous, luxuriant richness, pushing it against her bare shoulders, rolling it against her side. Salwah laughs at your eagerness and taps you on the side with her tail, tutting at you. "Careful now," she purrs. "You're straying close into paying territory." Really now? "Maybe. But I will tell you when you do cross the line, so you can decide whether you'd like to draw back or pay up." You note that she didn't say if, but when you crossed the line. Such confidence in her abilities... Still with her hair in your hand, you slide your touch over to Salwah's tattooed side; the curve of her body and sensuality of her skin spike over her lithe midriff, especially where it joins with her soft, generous hips. The sudden transition from lightly outlined abs to springy, breedable butt and hips is a masterpiece of the carnal arts, and even just being able to touch it, to sample a tiny fraction of that nubile warmth beneath your fingers is turning you on. Back and forth, back and forth, from shoulder to side and atop her hips and back upwards again — Salwah's purring is constant now, a deep, throaty sound that reverberates about the interior of the inn room. "Ah." Through all the warmth, her pulse is strong and steady, nubile energy to complement her alternately slender yet sumptuous form. You can't get enough of it, especially when your hand continues moving downward away from her shoulder and up the mound of one firm, tattooed asscheek, cupping its curve so that your palms and fingers are in contact with as much of that firm plushness and its dark swirls as they possibly can be — "Here, why don't you stroke this instead?" As she speaks, the chocokitty worms her tail over to you, its tip pushing against your grasp demandingly. It's impossible to say no to such a pleasant demand, and soon enough you're running your fingertips through the fine fuzz that coats Salwah's long, sinuous tail. Tip to mid-length and back again, even as more and more of it wraps about your wrist and crawls down your arm in a coil — only for the entire thing to start running back and forth about your forearm as if... as if... well, the things she could do to any rod-shaped object, come to think of it... rows.original: "That's correct. No matter whether it's the grand temple in the capital or a one-priestess affair in a backwater village, almost anyone can come in and get a free bath. There are a few exceptions — outlaws and others who would pose a danger to temple staff, for example — but be it perfumed oils and scented pools or simple soap and water by the temple well, that's how things are done. I suppose, then, that's what your desire is?" It would be nice to have her hands on your skin... hers, and no one else's. Salwah's smile fades a little. "Just to be sure, a bath is just that — a bath, and not a euphemism for other, more intimate services. Those do require donations of varying amounts. If that's all right with you, then I'll lead you to the temple baths." Yeah, you get it. No getting up to any hanky-panky while in the water. "While temple supplicants may have varying sensibilities and proneness to embarrassment, I mean what I say and say what I mean. Please, follow me." With that, she's up on her feet and sashaying down the hallway ahead of you. Once you reach the baths, you do indeed take your time in getting most of your things off, giving Salwah the time she needs to get everything ready. "Come on in, then!" Salwah's voice rings out from the smaller private bath adjoining the public pools. Much appreciated. You push apart the curtains and are greeted with the sight of a large marble basin set into the floor, filled with chilly water; Salwah's waiting there with some leached-ash soap, a brush, and little else. It's a bit of a letdown given — well, this being a Mallachite service and all, but it's fair to say that this is what passes for luxury in the Marches. Throwing off the last of your clothes, you lower yourself into the water and let the chococat impart plenty of soothing comfort into your muscles and bones in juxtaposition against the nippy chill. While it isn't any kind of perfumed glamour, the bath's nonetheless not bad. Salwah has technique if not resources, and her hands are quick at getting the dirt off you and applying plenty of soap, clearly experienced at this matter. "It's usually the younger kittens just out of childhood who are sent out to help with the bathing — under the watchful eye of a priestess, of course. Being able to meet many people and aid them in such a close manner introduces them to being with strangers, and many basic interpersonal skills. Do this for a month or two, and any shyness you may have had will be gone, and you'll at least be able to make passable conversation to pass the time." No doubt Cait and Calla had their time as bath assistants to temple supplicants? "That's right. Even those who don't intend to stay on with the temple after their majority help with bathing others." Salwah works up a lather on her hands, and gets to work with the brush. [pc.skinTypeMulti skin fur scales |Your skin tingles a bit as she scrubs thoroughly, feeling the stiff bristles push away the dirt and dust of travel, but you ultimately feel better and cleaner for the experience |It takes a bit of effort to get the brush in deep through your wet fur, Salwah's muscles standing out on her arms, but the deep cleansing is definitely worth it in the end. The stiff bristles feel so good against your skin under all that fur, and you can practically feel the dirt and dust of travel washing away |The stiff bristles glide smoothly over your scales, Salwah working counter to their overlap in order to get the dirt and dust of travel out from under them. A few small pieces of old scale break away and drift off in the water, and you feel very much invigorated for the effort Salwah's putting in ]. Sally's fingers are strong and nimble, and just as she said, there's absolutely nothing in the way of lewdity, although you really do feel very comfortable after she's done with you. She pays a little extra attention to your [pc.hair], doing what she can with the soap, but the thin-lipped grimace on her face betrays her concern at having to make do. At last, though, she's done. Instructing you to step out of the bath, Salwah gives you a final rinse-off, and dries you off from head to toe with a fluffy towel from one of the side racks. "Feel better?" Better and cleaner, thank her very much. "It's been a while. Most people are more interested in the other services I offer, as opposed to a bath... it's good to know I've still got it." Salwah graces you with a smile. "Only way this could be better would be if Cait were to be with us." You laugh, get dressed, and head back to the adjoining chamber to collect the rest of your things. Time to get on the road again, then...
rows.translation: 没错。无论是首都里那座宏伟的寺庙，还是偏远村庄里仅有那位女祭司主持的仪式，几乎任何人都可以免费进去沐浴。当然也有一些例外——比如那些会对寺庙工作人员构成威胁的逃犯之类的——但无论是使用芳香的精油和香薰浴池，还是仅仅使用寺庙井边的肥皂和水，情况都是这样的。那么，我想你的愿望就是这个吧？” 能够感受到她的双手触碰自己的肌肤该有多美好……只有她的手，而不是其他任何人的。 萨尔瓦的笑容稍微黯淡了一些：“只是为了确认一下，洗澡就是洗澡而已，并不是其他更亲密行为的委婉说法。那些确实需要不同数额的捐赠。如果你没有意见的话，那我就会带你去寺庙的浴场。 对了，记住在水中时千万不要做出任何不当的行为。 “虽然来寺庙祈祷的人们的敏感程度和容易感到尴尬的程度各不相同，但我所说的话都是认真的，请跟我来吧。 说完，她就站了起来，沿着走廊走在你的前面。当你来到浴室时，你确实花了些时间脱掉身上的衣服，这样萨尔瓦就有足够的时间把一切都准备妥当。 “那进来吧！”萨尔瓦的声音从公共泳池旁边那间较小的私人浴室里传来。 非常感谢。当你拉开帘子时，眼前出现的是一个镶嵌在地面上的大型大理石盆，里面盛满了冰冷的水；萨尔瓦就在那里等着你，她准备了一些浸过灰烬的肥皂和一把刷子，除此之外没有别的东西了。虽然这确实算是马拉克信徒提供的服务，但说实话，这大概就是边境地区所所谓的“奢华”了吧。脱掉身上的衣服，跳进水中，让巧克力带来的温暖缓解寒冷带来的刺痛，这种感觉还挺不错的。虽然这种沐浴方式并不带有任何奢华与芳香的气息，但效果还算不错。萨尔瓦虽然没有太多的资源，但她的手法确实娴熟——她动作迅速，能有效地将你身上的污垢清除干净，并使用足够的肥皂进行清洗，显然她在这一方面经验丰富。 通常都是那些刚脱离幼年期的小猫会被派去帮忙洗澡——当然，这一切都是在女祭司的监督下进行的。通过与很多人接触，并以这样的方式帮助他们，小猫们会逐渐学会如何与陌生人相处，也会掌握许多基本的人际交往技巧。坚持这样做一两个月，它们原本可能存在的害羞心理就会消失，至少也能学会一些简单的对话技巧，用来打发时间了。 毫无疑问，凯特和卡拉也曾担任过寺庙朝圣者们的洗澡助手吧？ “没错。即使那些在成年后并不打算继续留在寺庙里的人，也会帮忙为别人洗澡。” 萨尔瓦在手上挤出一些泡沫，然后开始用刷子清洗起来。 [pc.skinTypeMulti skin fur scales |当她仔细地擦拭你的皮肤时，你会感到一阵刺痒感，那些坚硬的刷毛正在将旅途中的污垢和灰尘清除干净。不过，经过这样的清洁过程，你确实会感到更加清爽、更加干净。 |要让刷子深入你湿润的毛发中，确实需要一些力气——萨尔瓦手臂上的肌肉因此在用力时显得格外明显，但这种彻底的清洁过程确实是非常值得的。那些坚硬的刷毛在厚厚的毛发下面触碰到皮肤时，感觉非常舒适，你几乎能感觉到旅行途中积累的污垢和灰尘正在被一点点清除掉。 |那些坚硬的刷毛在你的鳞片上顺畅地滑动，萨尔瓦巧妙地利用刷毛之间的交错结构，将旅途中所积的污垢和灰尘清除干净。有几片旧的鳞片因此脱落，漂浮在水中，而你也能感受到萨尔瓦为为你做这些努力所付出的心血，这让你感到无比振奋。 ]莎莉的手指结实而灵活，正如她所说，她的动作完全没有任何不适当的地方，不过你确实能感受到那种非常在她与你相处结束后，她会感到轻松自在。她会对你多付出一些关心和关注。[pc.hair]她用肥皂尽力清洁身体，但脸上那紧绷的苦涩表情却暴露了她对这种简陋清洁方式的无奈与担忧。 终于，她完成了工作。萨尔瓦让你走出浴缸，最后再冲洗一遍，然后用旁边架子上的一块柔软毛巾把你从头到脚擦干。 “感觉好些了吗？” 好多了。以及太感谢你了，清洁工。” “好久不见。大多数人更感兴趣的是我提供的其他服务，而不是洗澡……不过很高兴知道我这项服务依然有人需要。”萨尔瓦微笑着对你说，“要是凯特也能和我们在一起，那就再完美了。” 你笑了笑，穿好衣服，然后回到隔壁的房间去拿剩下的东西。是时候再次上路了……
