Tell me about yourself!" ] Solveig looks unsure of where to begin, leaning back and stretching herself out slowly. "Okaaay... well, my name is Solveig. One of those fancy spellings, so even though it sounds like 'Sohlveye' it's spelt S-o-l-v-e-i-g." She proudly holds up a wooden plank with strips of paper bound to it, showing off what appears to be a row of alphabets and words carefully written out... including your name, too, now that you're looking at it. The pup's tail wags. "Heh, yeah. I wanted to be a teacher one day. Not a shaman or anything mind you, but like, an actual teacher! Get all the kids lettered, instead of just leaders and mystics and stuff." The pink-furred orc-bork smiles and places the bundle down, swapping it for a tankard of drink. "Anyway, where was I? I'm Solveig Karisdóttir, my mom's name is Karis, I'm her daughter. Go figure. She's a thane back home, and had a whole bunch of kids... but most of them were a lot larger than me even when they were teens! And, uh... I was gonna say orc-ier but that's not fair of me. I think literally all of my brothers and sisters are half-orcs like me. They all just turned out bigger; borkers, snow-cats, snakeys, 'manders... mom sure [silly |raped a terrible toll |laid a lot of different cute boys ]. I just turned out smaller for some reason." "I should've had pictures of them done before I left; mom keeps a huuuuuge like, stitched-in-painted-cloth portrait of the whole family. It's amazing. I do miss that, although most of home is boring, rainy, and double-cold... even with my fluff-scruff." Solveig pointedly wags her great bushy tail, bapping you gently on the nose and grinning. "Gosh there just isn't much to me, I just always want to talk about my family instead. Maybe some time they'll come to these shores and I can introduce you, they're all so handsome and pretty and strong." Instead she turns her questions on you and Cait, not to mention any of your other companions when they pass by with drink or food. [party.randComp arona atugia azzy berwyn brienne brint einin etheryn kiyoko quin |"Damn Arona, I heard you'd gotten even huge-er and big-shottier when you moved out here. Is there really something in the water?" |"So, like, ever done any fun pranks with your head Atugia?" |"Mmm, hey, did anyone ever tell you, you smell really nice? Because you sure do, miss Azzy." |"What's it like being a tripod, shortie? And when can I play with your ears?" |"...Just, sorry, Brienne. I keep losing myself in your eyes. And your incredible boobs. We should smash." |"...Just, sorry, Brint. I keep losing myself in your eyes. And the way your pecs shift when you breathe. We should smash some time." |"Hey, miss mouse. What's it got to take to put you in my lap and give you a boob-hat? You look made for hugs." |"Oh my gosh you're such a cutie, I love princesses! Although, admittedly, all the tales of princesses back home are about deflowering them..." |"So... how does fucking to eat actually work miss Kiyoko? Because it sounds like a pretty sweet deal." |"Y'know Quin, you're a very, very handsome man. If you ever want to give up on adventuring and move to the Sailgraves, I can get us both rich having you pinned down under huge women." ] '

rows.translation: 索尔维格

rows.original: [flags.SOLVEIG_TALK_DAD |[var0 |Solveig smiles and bounces at you. "Things are going well, although it turns out neither of us have much to talk about once you get through all the initial stuff. It's really nice knowing I have family here, not to mention Gar—papa has been supporting the next step. "The next step?" The half-pup grins and pats a stack of learning materials. Right, she wants to be a teacher. "Gwyn's been helping out too, I think she's excited about the idea of me coming to help at the nursery." |Solveig's smile looks a little bit strained for a moment before melting naturally, and her tail begins to wag in defiance of any weak moods. "Heard anything new yet?" [var1 |Well, you went to your friends Anna and Morwen. Morwen's father was apparently part of a pretty successful mercenary group, and gave you a knife. Solveig blinks when you place it down on the table, holding it up a moment later while her tail wags. "Holy shit! My mom definitely has one of these in her jewellery box! Was he my papa?" Unfortunately... Morwen's father is deceased, and also it's unlikely since there's no reason he would have multiples of the same knife. You do your best to curb her disappointment, but she still lets out a small whine. "Fair enough... any other clues?" ] [var2 |"Berwyn's a dead end," you confess. Solveig huffs and pouts, slowly spreading her hands. "A shame, but it makes sense I guess; I don't look nearly girly enough to be related to him. Anything else?" ] [var3 |You ponder for a moment; Garret wasn't very helpful either, although perhaps it's for the best that he doesn't know any older men being pounded flat by a pink-haired, mythically-stacked super-milf. ] [var4 |"Sanders gave me the possible location of an old raider camp, he was active in the area back then and there were more than a few counter-raids on their camp." Solveig listens intently, tail on end. "Uh... I did find one clue," you admit, before pulling out a humongous metal bra. Solveig's eyes go wide and she takes it from your hands, letting out a wolf-whistle. "Damn, nearly as big as mom's!" Nearly? ] [var5 |Grettel definitely mentioned a black-and-white wolf boy that the thane kept all to herself, the smart roguish one who sprung the trap on them in the first place. Solveig follows your eyes towards Garth, before shrugging. "That was my very first guess, but he seemed pretty sure..." ] ] |Solveig's ears droop, before perking up again. "Ah! Well, that's the thing right? I... don't know who my papa is. Most of mom's partners have met us before, either because they came to visit themselves, or she brought them overland... and the pride, or joy on their faces... I want that." The fuzzy pink borclet gestures to the rest of the tavern, pouting slightly. "I've asked around here a bit, but nobody's leapt out knowing they've banged the hell out of a pink-haired orc with huge titties." Her hands extend outwards, a couple of extra cup sizes beyond her own incredibly plush rack. "You wouldn't happen to know, would you?" You shake your head slowly, "I could ask though. I'm sure it's not impossible to find out... but what if he's no longer with us?" Her ears droop again, falling nearly flat for a moment. "I mean... of course I've prepared myself for that possibility, but at least I'd know right? I'd like to be able to visit a grave, or the place he fell, and at least show him that he had a daughter who grew up right. Seems like the thing to be done, you know?" She soon brightens up again, as though a poor mood were something she could immediately discard with the wave of a hand. "But hey, anyone mom picked would be tough or smart or something. She liked them brainy as often as she liked them strong, doesn't sound like the kind of lupine who'd just die on me without leaving a good impression." [pc.dcb |"If you say so," you shrug. |"If you say so," you frown, rubbing your chin. |"Mmmmm, if y'say so!" ] "I do say so," Solveig huffs. "But seriously. I'm gonna be here for... well, ever, I guess. But I want to meet my father before I worry about the next step, if you find him, I'll do what I can to repay the favor."
rows.translation: [flags.SOLVEIG_TALK_DAD |[var0 |索尔薇格微笑着朝你蹦跳过来。“事情进展得不错，不过聊过最初的那些话题后，我们俩好像也没什么可说的了。能知道这里还有家人，真的让我很开心，更不用说加——爸爸也支持我下一步的计划了。 “下一步？” 小家伙咧嘴一笑，拍了拍一堆学习资料。没错，她想当一名老师。“格温也在帮忙，我觉得她很兴奋我能去托儿所帮忙。” |索尔薇格的笑容瞬间略显勉强，随即又自然地融化开来，尾巴也开始摇摆，仿佛在对抗任何低落的情绪。“最近有什么新消息吗？” [var1 |嗯，你去找了朋友安娜和莫文。据说莫文的父亲曾是某个相当成功的雇佣兵团体成员，还送了你一把刀。 你把刀放在桌上时，索尔薇格眨了眨眼，随后拿起刀举起来，尾巴欢快地摇着。“天啊！我妈妈的首饰盒里肯定有一把一模一样的！他是我的爸爸吗？” 可惜……莫文的父亲已经去世了，而且也不太可能，因为他没有理由拥有多把相同的刀。你尽力安慰她，但她仍忍不住发出一声小小的抱怨。“好吧……还有别的线索吗？” ] [var2 |“贝尔温这条路走不通了，”你坦白道。 索尔薇叹了口气，撅着嘴，慢慢摊开双手。“真遗憾，不过也说得通吧；我看起来可不像会和他有血缘关系的女生。还有别的线索吗？” ] [var3 |你沉默片刻；加雷特也没帮上什么忙，不过也许他不知道有年长的男人被一位粉发、传说中身材火辣的超级熟女压得喘不过气来，这反而是件好事。 ] [var4 |“桑德斯给了我一个旧掠夺者营地的可能位置，他当年在那一带活动过，而他们营地曾多次遭到反击。” 索尔薇专注地听着，尾巴高高竖起。 “呃……我确实找到了一个线索，”你承认道，随即掏出一只巨大的金属文胸。索尔薇的眼睛顿时睁大，她接过那东西，吹起口哨来。 “天啊，几乎和妈妈的一样大了！” 几乎？ ] [var5 |格蕾特尔确实提到过一个黑白相间的狼男孩，是领主独自养在身边的聪明又狡猾的家伙，正是他最初设下陷阱抓住了他们。索尔薇顺着你的目光看向加斯，随后耸耸肩：“那是我第一个猜测，但他看起来挺确定的……” ] ] |索尔薇的耳朵先耷拉下来，随即又竖了起来。“啊！对了，这不就是关键所在吗？我……不知道我的爸爸是谁。妈妈的大多数伴侣都见过我们，要么是他们自己来拜访过，要么是她带他们过来……他们脸上那种自豪或喜悦的神情……我也想要那样的感觉。”那个毛茸茸的粉发兽人朝酒馆其他地方比划着，微微撅着嘴。“我在这儿问了问，可没人跳出来承认自己和一个有着大胸脯的粉发兽人狠狠上过床。”她的手向外伸展，仿佛比自己那对异常丰满的胸部还要多出几个罩杯。“你不会刚好知道吧？” 你缓缓地摇了摇头：“我可以问问看。我相信要找到他并不是不可能……但万一他已经不在人世了呢？” 她的耳朵又耷拉下来，几乎瞬间垂得平贴在头上。“我是说……当然，我已经做好了心理准备，但至少能知道真相，对吧？我想能去他的墓地，或者他倒下的地方，至少告诉他，他有一个女儿，而且她长大得很不错。这似乎是最该做的事，你知道吗？”她很快又恢复了笑容，仿佛坏心情不过是挥手就能轻易甩掉的东西。“不过话说回来，妈妈选的人肯定要么很厉害，要么很聪明之类的。她喜欢脑子灵光的，也一样喜欢身体强壮的，听起来不像那种会毫无印象地就死在我面前的狼族。” [pc.dcb |“你说得是吧，”你耸耸肩。 |“你说得是吧，”你皱着眉头，摸了摸下巴。 |“嗯嗯，你说得是！” ] “我确实这么说，”索尔维格叹道，“但说真的，我会一直待在这里……嗯，大概就是永远吧。不过在考虑下一步之前，我想先见见我的父亲。如果你找到了他，我会尽我所能报答你的恩情。”

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original:
Solveig leans back in her seat, brow furrowed in consternation. "I... think that's everything, [pc.name]."

    She turns her attention to the other end of the tavern, tail tucking as she stares at Garth. "I just... I need to ask him, one more time. Put all the clues out there, and see what he has to say; if he doesn't know, I don't know who would... think you could come with me though?"
rows.translation:
索尔维格靠回椅背，忧虑地皱起眉头。“我……想来应该就这些了，[pc.name]。”

    她把目光投向酒馆另一端，盯着加斯时尾巴也收了起来。“我只是……还得再问他一次。把所有线索都摆出来，看看他怎么说；如果连他都不知道，我也不知道还有谁会知道了……不过，你能陪我一起去吗？”

rows.translation: 下一步
加斯与索薇格

rows.original:
Garth raises a brow as the two of you approach, eyeing Solveig. "Something the matter?"
        
        The pink-haired half-pup looks between the two of you for a moment before going through the clues you've brought back. "Well... I was wondering if you'd be able to do anything with all of these clues."
        
        She places down the knife from Morwen's father, and the massive metal bra. Garth's already-raised brow practically disappears into his hairline in surprise, and he picks it up to get a closer look. "I, uh..."
        
        "See, [pc.name] went and spoke with Grettel — she and my mom were on the raid where I got conceived — according to her, this used to belong to my mom. Although... it's a few sizes smaller than I think it should be, so I'm not sure." When her hand pats the knife, Garth turns his attention to it, placing the bra down.
        
        "And this? Yeah I recognize this blade..." Garth mutters, starting to look a little... haunted? Reluctant?
        
        "Yeah," Solveig nods. "Mom has one of these in her jewelry box, she must've gotten it from my father!"
        
        Garth clicks his tongue, plucking up the blade and checking the handle for an inscription. "Solveig..." 
        
        The old wolf trails off, sliding the blade and bra over. "Did your mother always have pink hair? Not a red-head perhaps?"
        
        "She's always had pink hair to me, s'why I'm pink, I think... although my oldest brother's ginger— wait! You think?" The half-orc's tail begins to wag up a storm, whipping your side and forcing you to pin it flat.
        
        [pc.dcb
            |"You were the father the whole time, Garth?" Your shoulders slump and you wave the two off, returning to your table so that the two can hug it out or whatever.
            |"You really were the father? You could've saved me a lot of running around," you sigh.
            
            "Hey, if... I mean, if I'd known." In fairness, the old wolf looks more than a little stunned, and Solveig's staring at him with great big eyes and a quivering bottom lip.
            
            "Give her a hug or something?" 
            
            "Right, uh... right."
            |"Eee! You really are the papa! Congratulations Garth!" Your shout is loud enough to stun both him, Solveig, and the nearest bar patrons... good thing you can't see an old lupine blush.
        ]
        
        Garth limps his way out from behind the bar and grumbles at you before pulling Solveig into a rough hug, letting the pink-and-green borclet bury her face into his chest and wail.

rows.original: Alright, you'll bite; you want to know why he's wearing that sleeveless blouse. It's a piece of garb that looks to be in better condition than what most people wear! Yet he wears it alongside such a short and plain garment like his caparison? "Well yeah, it's comfortable. And it's a pretty easy to maintain piece of clothing, I'll have you know! You'd be surprised how hard it is to find one that fits me this well! When I go out, I have to be very careful to not let people grab at it!" [flags.SUGO_TALK_CLOTHES |He's talking about his caparison again? |You get that finding a nice shirt might be difficult in a world with cultists and hazards in wait around every corner these days, but it's ridiculous to imagine that fitting clothes would truly be hard or rare to find. "Huh? What are you talking about? Fitted caparisons are very hard to come by!" Oh. Wait... he's talking about that cover-like cloth on his horse-end's back? ] "Of course I am! Normally horses are used as beasts of burden, so things like caparisons are more of a noble or rich fashion accessory! That's enough so that even centaurs like to wear them to stand out! But they do have one problem that particularly exists more so for a centaur. Normally they're worn beneath a saddle to hold them in place or fitted with a hood that goes over the horse's head or a harness for the neck. They normally never fit or sit right without one, so for centaurs we try to bind it around our waists like a belt or wear a harness. But... well... I like my blouse, so I asked for a somewhat matching one to be made in my size without that belt. I got the harness, but..." Despite how much information that is, you can't believe the tailor is entirely at fault for the caparison. The question of why he wears a frilled blouse still isn't answered but there's a much more alarming condition being that his caparison doesn't even fit right. Maybe a new one could make a good gift for the centaur; finding a nice enough one that properly fit and actually covered that horsey dong would probably be difficult regardless of where you went however. You can't help but wonder though; how did Sugo get this one to sit on his back without a hood or saddle so well? What about that harness he mentioned makes him unable to wear it? Once you ask, all the awkwardness of that mix-up evaporates and turns to his heart-warming smile once more. "Unfortunately for me this one is both too short and the harness can't fit the specific design they sent. So I had no belt nor a hooded mantle either; so it's... well... sometimes I spend about an hour or two setting it properly. From there I have to move slow to not disrupt it, particularly when I come in and out of my stall. Some days it can take longer or even forces me to not wear it but others? Considering I live here now, there are just some days I can't go out and have to hide inside my stall to not scar any children or get in trouble." "Sometimes you just have to make do with what you have." The horse looks over his shoulder with a sigh before glimpsing at you from the corner of his eyes. "It's either that or wear a saddle or an improperly fitted harness... and that'd be far worse and uncomfortable. Could you imagine all the people who'd be trying to ride me and not in the fun way? rows.translation: 没错！”那只金发的小家伙用后腿轻轻一跳，脸上洋溢着笑容，双手紧紧握成庆祝的拳头。“我就知道我可以信赖你！” 苏戈凑得更近了一些，几乎无法抑制自己的兴奋之情，他探过柜台，突然灵机一动，抬起了一只手指。 我敢打赌，镇上肯定有两个人，他们与马打交道，甚至可能接触过半人马，因此他们应该能提供一些线索。在这个镇子上，最接近旅馆老板或猎人身份的人……应该是莱奥拉吧？我觉得她应该是个不错的突破口；我以前确实听说过她几次。 他望向北方，手指指向市场广场的出口，再向下指向古林的大门。他的蓝眼睛从你身上移开，瞄准了那一片几乎看不见的绿色区域。 “另一个地方可能是奥格里斯；我听说他专门制作马蹄铁，所以那里肯定是个寻找配件的好地方！当然了……也有可能是一些普通的当地人能提供帮助！ 当你看到半人马重新回到他的摊位里，还轻轻整理着自己的衬衫，兴奋地盯着你看时，你不禁眨了眨眼。他……难道不会付你钱之类的吗？毕竟你可不是免费工作的。 “哦……嗯……如果你为我做这件事，我们可以接吻！ 亲吻？他不是早就随便让任何人和他发生性关系了吗？ “哼。”那个金发女孩翻了个白眼，不屑地对你摆了摆手。“我是说，没错……我确实这么做过……但那并不代表我愿意亲吻有人啊，说真的，你真的在帮我一个大忙呢！我帮你把东西退回去吧。[pc.name]，那一定会非常有趣。而且我向你保证，亲吻一个像我这样和很多人有过亲密关系的人……相信我，这绝对值得！” 你还是不太确定，但毕竟你已经答应会帮忙了。忽略他也是个选择，但或许讨好他、帮这个忙，以后还能带来更多的好处。如果苏戈是个更值得尊敬的人，那么仅仅因为与他有所关联，以后就不会有任何麻烦找上你。不过目前，你只是向他挥了挥手道别，然后转身离开了他的摊位。而看到那个英俊的狼族转眼间就冲到了柜台前，你敢肯定，他还会继续忙上好一阵子的。
rows.raw: " "Yes!" The blonde gives a clop of one of his rear legs, beaming at you as he clamps both hands into tight celebratory fists. "I knew I could count on you!" Clambering a bit closer, Sugo leans over the counter — poorly containing his excitement — and lifts one of his digits as an idea strikes. "I'd bet there's two people in town who work with horses or even centaurs to probably have a hunch. The closest thing to the town's lodgemaster or a hunter... that'd be Leorah, right? I bet she'd be a good place to start; I remember hearing about her once or twice before." Looking out and pointing the finger north, toward the exit of the market plaza and down toward the Old Forest gate, his blue eyes part from you and aim toward a familiar blob of green just barely visible. "The other would probably be Ogrish; I hear he makes horseshoes, so clearly he'd be a good place to start looking for accessories! Apart from that... maybe some random local could be a good place to start!" You blink as the centaur slips back properly within his stall, gently smoothing his blouse as he stares at you excitedly. Isn't he... going to pay you or anything? You don't work for free, after all. "Oh... um... if you do it for me, we can kiss!" Kiss? Doesn't he already let anyone and everyone have sex with him? "Pft." The blonde rolls his eyes, waving dismissively at you. "I mean, yeah... I do... but I don't kiss someone. I mean, you'd really be doing me a favor! Returning it for you, [pc.name], would be loads of fun. And I assure you; kissing someone who's been around as many others as I have? Trust me; it'll be worth it!" You're still not quite sure about that but you did say you'd help. Ignoring him is always an option but maybe flattering him and just doing this favor could lead to more later on. A more respectable Sugo means there'd be no chance of any of this coming back to bite you in the butt later for simply associating with him. For now though, you wave in farewell and turn back to leave Sugo to his stall. And considering a hunky lupine comes rushing past you and to the counter in a blink, you're sure he's going to keep being nice and busy for a while longer."

    Sugo's ears sag slightly on either side of his head, averting his gaze whilst awkwardly rubbing his shoulder.
    
    "Forget I said anything, [pc.name]. Is there something else you... er... want to talk about then?"

rows.original:
Is Ogrish any good at outfitting centaurs?
    
    "Centaurs? I mean, no different than I am with horses and people I'd wager. Why?"

    Well, you've got a friend; a local pony, specifically. You were hoping he could help out and supply a new caparison?
    
    "A caparison- oh." Initially a question, Ogrish' eyes show he knows exactly who it's for before putting on a frown. "You must mean for Sugo, the centaur lad from the valley who moved in, right? I'd seen his caparison and thought of suggesting he get a new one... but I don't sell pieces of clothing like that. I make armors and weapons; smithies don't sew."
    
    So he can't help you. Great.
    
    "Now hold on, I do know someone who can. Leorah certainly works enough around the area and probably has some leads on someone who could get one made. It'd probably not fit the best but all you need is a longer one right? I'm sure she could help you out."
rows.translation:
奥格里什在为半人马配备装备方面有什么经验吗？
    
    “半人马？嗯，我觉得我和为马匹或人类配备装备没什么两样吧。为什么这么问？”

    嗯，你有个朋友；具体来说，是当地的一匹小马。你希望他能帮上忙，提供一件新的马衣吧？
    
    “一件马衣——哦。”起初是一个疑问，但奥格里什的眼神表明，他其实很清楚这件马衣是给谁用的，随后他皱起了眉头。“你一定是说苏戈吧，那个从山谷搬来的半人马小子，对吧？我见过他的马衣，还想过建议他换件新的……可我不卖那种衣物。我打造盔甲和武器；铁匠可不缝纫。”
    
    所以他帮不了你。太好了。
    
    “等等，我确实认识一个能帮你的人。莱奥拉在这一带干的活够多，多半认识能做出这种东西的人。虽然可能不会太合身，但你需要的就是件更长的，对吧？我相信她能帮到你。”

rows.original: [flags.LEORAH_TALK_CAPARISON |"Oh, let me guess; you wanna talk about the deal?" Leorah's smirk is telling; it seems she predicted you'd be back. "Or are you going to hit the road again? |Waiting for Leorah to not seem like she's about to start skinning some pelt or sorting through some foraged goods, you finally halt the Hawkethorne huntress and tailor. "Ah, yes? What is it? Need a new bow? Or maybe a nice warm rug to lay some special guy or girl down by a cozy fire?" Not today but maybe the offers can be redeemed on a rainy day; for now you need a new caparison for the local horse boy and had been told to ask her. Surely she has something, right? It takes a few moments whilst Leorah's ears twitch and her tail flicks side-to-side, the left corner of her mouth folding in as she gently bites at it. "Mmm..." Leorah's right hand raises to cradle her chin in thought. "Well... I think I know a guy; someone who can get a good order. I'm generally pretty good at sizing folks up from afar, so I'd bet I could get one. It's because his is short, right?" Your nod only brings a playful smirk to the predatory catfolk woman. "I figured as much. Sure; since he's more or less a part of the town thanks to you, I don't mind. But I think you should pay us all back. So how about we make a deal?" Well, surely it can't be anything too awful; Leorah couldn't possibly be that mean. Hopefully. Either way, you can either choose to hear her out or turn her down; no point making her waste her breath otherwise. ]

rows.original: Okay, so what does the local huntress need to make this trade happen?
rows.translation: 那么，这位当地的猎女需要做些什么才能完成这笔交易呢？
rows.raw: "Okay, so what does the local huntress need to make this trade happen?"

rows.translation: 不用了，谢谢

rows.original: While you're fine with helping Sugo, doing errands for Leorah doesn't sound too fun.
rows.translation: 虽然你乐于帮助苏戈，但为莱奥拉跑腿似乎并不是什么有趣的事情。
rows.raw: "While you're fine with helping Sugo, doing errands for Leorah doesn't sound too fun."

rows.original:
Leorah's smirk tapers back into a proper smile; seems you've made her quite happy with agreeing to help out.

    "Good to see the hero in you step up; it's really cute." Her feigned disinterest slips briefly for her compliment, carefully reaching down and hefting an older ledger from beneath the counter and plopping it onto the surface for the pair of you. "Just stand there a moment..."
    
    Crossing your arms patiently, you watch as Leorah takes her time shuffling and sorting through the pages of the heavy thing. It's a strange sight when you really think about it; the shop-owner looks like she'd be more at home hunting in deserts than reading through a book in the Frost Marches. Thankfully for the pair of you, her reading anguish and your waiting isn't destined to be a long encounter. A final flick of the pages inspires the green-eared woman to smile, ears twitching with recognition as her sapphired gaze sets in on you.
    
    "I need you to bring me good lumber, some metals and sturdy stone; so it looks like you're heading to the Old Forest and Foothills at the very least. I'd bet that you could probably get some nice metal from beating up some of the clowns running around outside of Hawkethorne; anyone wearing nice armor or a fine sword."
    
    So basically find wood in the Forest, stone from the nearby Foothills and then beat up local riffraff? The first two were simple but the last one seems like a quest in its own right; she wasn't just trying to get you to do something that adventurers like you could get paid for was she?
    
    "Pft, of course not." Leorah clasped the book closed, turning it over and pointing at the door. "Now instead of harassing me you should get out there and harass some bad guys for some weapons."
    
    Getting thrown out wasn't on the agenda but maybe the mere mention she'd deceive you had insulted her. Or maybe it was just Leorah playing hard-to-get and feigning distance to intentionally light a fire under your [pc.butt]. At least now you have a goal.
rows.translation:
莱奥拉的坏笑渐渐变成了真正的笑容；看来你答应帮忙让她非常开心呢。

    “真高兴看到你这个‘英雄’挺身而出，真是太可爱了。”她故作不在意地夸了一句，然后小心翼翼地从柜台下面拿出一本旧账本，放在你们面前。“稍等一下……
    
    你耐心地双臂交叉着，看着莱奥拉慢慢地翻动那本厚厚的书，一页一页地仔细查看。仔细想想，这一幕确实有些奇怪——这位店主看起来，比起在霜冻之地阅读书籍，她更适合在沙漠中探险吧。对你们俩来说，幸运的是，她的阅读痛苦与你们的等待并不会持续太久。最后一页翻动的时候，那位绿耳女子露出了微笑，当她的蓝宝石般的眼睛注视着你的时候，她的耳朵微微一动，仿佛认出了你。
    
    我需要你帮我弄来优质的木材、一些金属以及坚固的石头；所以看来你至少得去古林和山脚地带一趟。我敢打赌，从鹰棘镇外面那些四处游荡的家伙那里，你肯定能弄到一些不错的金属——只要找到那些穿着精美盔甲或拿着锋利剑的人就行了。
    
    所以基本上就是去森林里找木材，从附近的山脚下采集石头，然后去对付那些当地的恶棍吧？前两项任务还算简单，但最后一项任务似乎本身就可以算是一个独立的任务了；她并不是只是想让你去做一些像你这样的冒险者本来就可以通过这些任务来赚钱的事情吧？
    
    哼，当然不会。”莱奥拉把书合上，翻过来指了指门，“现在你不该再来烦我了，应该去外面找那些坏蛋，让他们交出武器来。”
    
    虽然被赶出去本来不在她的计划之中，但也许她这么一说，反而让你误以为她是在生气。又或者，莱奥拉只是在装作高冷、保持距离，其实是想激怒你罢了。[pc.butt]至少现在你有了一个目标。

rows.original:
"Huh? Really? I thought adventurers never turned away a fun quest? But maybe you don't like the idea of gathering things to help us out... urgh, whatever. Get lost."

    Waving you out like you'd done something wrong, Leorah crosses her arms and leans back in her chair rather disappointed; maybe she was really hoping you'd do this for her... but maybe there's another way to help Sugo than working with the huntress?

rows.original: Reaching to your pack and pulling free the batch of promised goods, you toss them out over the counter. Leorah is quite pleased; the corner of her lip curling up as the last of your delivery clunks between the pair of you. Sweeping it off and behind into a bin, she unenthusiastically tosses you a thumbs up and returns to her casually uninterested facade.
rows.translation: 你伸手从背包里取出那批承诺好的商品，将它们扔到柜台上。莱奥拉显得非常满意，她的嘴角微微上扬，当你最后一批货物落在你们两人中间时，她随意地将那些商品扫到一边扔进了垃圾桶，然后漫不经心地朝你竖起了大拇指，又恢复了那副若无其事的样子。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Oh! You gathered everything, huh?" Like the cat who caught the mouse, the shop owner heartily clasps her hands together. "Good! I'm sure this will come in handy for any construction we might need in the future! With a place like Hawkethorne, you can't ever quite be certain there's not going to be someone new popping in, after all!" Remembering that she's supposed to be uninterested, she rolls her eyes and unlinks her dexterous fingers to summon a new object from beneath the shop's large surface; a book with a few colors painted onto it. "Well, pick a color and a design; I'll bet I can get it for your horse-pal... and at just the right length. No more having to worry about upsetting anyone, right?" The decision you make here is permanent.
rows.translation: 哦！你把所有需要的东西都准备齐全了，是吧？” 店主就像捉到老鼠的猫一样，高兴地双手合十。 “太好了！这些东西以后肯定会在我们进行任何施工时派上用场的！像鹰棘镇这样的地方，你永远都无法确定会不会有新来的人出现啊！ 她提醒自己应该表现得无动于衷，于是翻了个白眼，灵活地活动手指，从商店的大柜台下面取出了一个新物品——那是一本上面画着几种颜色的书。 嗯，选一个颜色和一款设计吧，我肯定能为你的马朋友制作出来……而且长度也会恰到好处。这样就再也不用担心会惹恼任何人了，对吧？ 你在这里做出的决定是不可更改的。

rows.original: Walking up, you can't help but feel like you've seen this lupine before; his silvery fur and black-ended muzzle is really the only fur visible; he's wearing boots and a simplistic plaid shirt with their paws bound tightly in worker's linen. Both of his ears are even pulled tight beneath a bandana as he watches out at the boy for a few moments longer with hungry red eyes. Wait... isn't he one of the customers you see regularly visiting Sugo? You can't help but ask him now; why is he effectively stalking the town's newest centaur prostitute and watching from afar? If he's interested in Sugo, all he needs to do is wander over and present a fat cock for the horse boy. "Oh... um... yes, b-but I don't want to impede on his business." Sugo works for free, though; what business can he interrupt? The lupine certainly seems sketchy, the big oaf's ears visibly shrinking beneath the bandana as the press along the top of his scalp. "I-I... uh... look, I'm one of the locals who... er... supports Sugo. A-And I just feel that apart from our lovemaking that I should keep an eye on him, okay? If you really need to keep intruding then you should give me a reason to stick around! I've got other spots, too, you know..." No, that'll be quite alright; you actually do have a favor to ask. Since he seems so interested in supporting Sugo, maybe he could help out with securing a new caparison for the centaur? "Huh?" His right hand rises and clasps at his furry cheek, flushing red even through that thick fur. "H-Help Sugo? I... guess I can. All I'd need is some electrum... about two-hundred, I think." Two-hundred electrum? That's it? "Well yeah! I got to make sure it's good, don't I? I'd bet someone else would make you help Hawkethorne out but... s-services like the one Sugo provides is the difference between a small village and a real town! All we need to do is support him and Hawkethorne would be way better off!" This definitely sounds short-sighted; the benefits of a prostitute to relieve Hawkethorne's... tension is great but helping the town out would likely be the more economical pick. Either way, it's not much to do with you... you can either take the deal or turn it down.
rows.translation: 走上前去，你不禁会觉得自己之前见过这只狼犬；它银色的毛皮和黑色尖端的嘴部确实是唯一能看到的部位；它穿着靴子，穿着一件简单的格子衬衫，它的爪子被工人的亚麻布紧紧地包扎着。他的两只耳朵都被头巾紧紧地包住，他用那双充满渴望的红眼睛，又注视了那个男孩好一会儿。 等等……他不是你们经常看到来苏戈的那些顾客之一吗？你现在忍不住要问他了：为什么他会偷偷跟踪这个镇上最新的半人马妓女，远远地观察她呢？如果他对苏戈感兴趣，他只需要走过去，向那个马男孩展示自己的“诚意”就行了。 “哦……嗯……是的，但是我不想打扰他正在做的事情。” 不过苏戈是免费工作的，他还能打扰什么事情呢？那头狼族看起来确实有点可疑，那个大块头的耳朵在头巾的压迫下明显缩了下去，头巾紧紧地缠在他的头顶上。 “我、我……呃……听着，我是这里的本地人之一，也……支持苏戈。我只是觉得，除了和他做爱之外，我还是应该多留意他的动向，好吗？如果你真的如果你们非要坚持打扰我，那就得给我一个继续留下的理由才行！你知道的，我还有很多其他地方可以去……” “不，其实这样也挺好的；你们确实有件事需要我帮忙。既然他这么热衷于支持苏戈，或许他可以帮忙为那个半人马准备一套新的装备吧？ 哈？”他的右手抬起来，摸了摸自己那毛茸茸的脸颊，尽管有厚厚的毛发覆盖，他的脸还是变红了。“帮帮苏戈？我……应该可以吧。我只需要一些电金……大概两百枚吧。” 两百枚电金？就这样吗？ “嗯，没错！我总得确保这个服务是优质的，对吧？我敢打赌，换作别人也会让你帮忙解决鹰棘镇的问题，但是……像苏戈提供的这种服务，才是决定一个小村庄能否真正发展成一座真正城镇的关键啊！我们只需要支持他，鹰棘镇的状况就会得到显著改善！” 这种观点显然过于短视了——虽然让妓女来缓解鹰棘镇的……压力确实能带来一些好处，但帮助整个城镇发展才是更为明智的选择。无论如何，这都与你无关……你可以接受这个提议，也可以拒绝它。

rows.original:
"Hah!" The male turns, clasping his fist into a tight ball while meeting your gaze. "That settles it then; you bring me the goods, I'll get ready to make the order!"

    As you nod and turn away, you can't help but notice Leorah standing at the door of her shop and looking down the road at you. Either she has the best hearing or figured it out already; Leorah shakes her head and heads inside before you can get a word off to discover which it is. Hopefully this can't bite you in the butt later.

    你点了点头，转身离开时，不由得注意到莱奥拉站在她店铺的门口，正望着你远去。要么她的听力非常好，要么她早就猜到了什么；在你来得及问出个所以然之前，莱奥拉摇了摇头，走回了店里。希望这件事以后不会给你带来麻烦。

rows.original:
Forcing a bag of your hard-earned wealth into the lupine's hand, it takes a moment for the whispy-colored mutt to realize that you just brought him everything he needs to order his favorite pony a new caparison.

    "This all of it? Hell... I bet it is! Alright, let me just... uh..."
    
    The lupine seems caught off-guard while you cross your arms patiently; fumbling around in his pocket for a few minutes is <b>obviously</b something you wanted to do. Thankfully it doesn't take long for him to pull free a slip of paper, though; then extend it out for you to see. It had quite a few colors and patterns on it!
    
    "Well? Pick one! It's only fair since you're paying... n-not that I'm not wishing I could pick. I-I'd love to get him a gift like this more often..."
rows.translation:
你把一袋自己辛苦赚来的钱塞到这只狼族手里，过了一会儿，他才意识到你刚刚给了他足够的钱，让他能够为自己最喜欢的小马订购一套新的马衣。

    “全部这些钱？天啊……肯定是的！好吧，让我先……呃……”
    
    这只狼族似乎有些措手不及，而你则耐心地双臂交叉站在那里，<b>显然，他觉得在口袋里翻找了好几分钟是你想要做的事情。幸运的是，他很快就拿出一张纸来，然后把它摊开给你看。那张纸上有很多颜色和图案！
    
    “那么？选一个吧！既然是你付的钱，这样才公平……虽然说，我其实也很希望自己能来选。我真的很希望能更经常给他买这样的礼物……”

rows.original: Rambling your way through the Old Forest is uneventful as always; until you hear a crack above you. [var0| But you're ready; you dodge out of the way as one of the sturdy branches slams to the ground. In a place both old and with such large trees, it's no surprise that branches occasionally break and fall. | You're too slow; the branch whacks into you and the pair of you go down. rows.original: Traveling through the Foothills sure can be boring; except when it isn't. This never seemed more apparent than now; specifically because of the large stone formation in front of you. Compared to the rather simple and barren hills, this formation seems like it'd fit better in the nearby mountains! But above all; you can see that the stones surrounding the formation are easily worth some value. They look like the ones that get used in building. You take one with you. You have obtained a sturdy stone.
rows.translation: 在山麓间穿行确实可能会让人感到无聊；不过，有时候也会遇到一些意想不到的有趣之处。此刻，这种感觉尤为明显——尤其是眼前这座巨大的石堆。与那些结构简单、荒芜贫瘠的丘陵相比，这座石堆看起来更像是来自附近的山脉！更重要的是，那些围绕着石堆的石头显然具有很高的价值，它们看起来就是用来建造房屋的材料。于是，你便捡起其中一块带在了身上。 你获得了一块坚固的石头。

rows.raw: "\n\nThe gray-furred old wolf pulls a bottle off the shelf and pours a drink into the glass he was polishing, sliding it over to you. \"I know the storm's pretty much trapped you here, kid, but you've been a good guest regardless. If there's something troubling you, feel free to share. That's what we bartenders are for, I hear,\" he chuckles."

rows.original: You raise your glass to him, trying to put words to your troubled thoughts. Why you left your home, and your life as [a] [pc.background], behind. Even now, after a year of traveling through the wild and rugged reaches of the frontier, the words don't come easily.
rows.translation: 你举杯向他，试图用言语表达自己心中那些纷乱的思绪——为什么你要离开自己的家，离开自己原本的生活[pc.background]在背后。即使到现在，在经历了整整一年的边境荒野之旅之后，这些话仍然难以轻易说出口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise your glass to him, trying to put words to your troubled thoughts. Why you left your home, and your life as [a] [pc.background], behind. Even now, after a year of traveling through the wild and rugged reaches of the frontier, the words don't come easily."

rows.original: A crash and the howling of bitter cold wind saves you from having to answer the lupine's questioning. Every head in the bar turns to the door, hanging open on its hinges to expose the black of the stormy night tinged with rushing flurries of gray snow. The silhouette of a woman is outlined against the gale, a heavy cloak drawn around her shoulders and a hood covering most of her face.
rows.translation: 一声巨响，伴随着刺骨寒风的呼啸，让你不必再去回答那位狼族的追问。酒吧里所有人的目光都转向那扇门——它挂在铰链上大敞着，露出外面暴风雨之夜的漆黑，其中夹杂着纷飞的灰雪。狂风勾勒出一个女人的身影，她肩上披着厚重的斗篷，兜帽遮住了大半张脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nA crash and the howling of bitter cold wind saves you from having to answer the lupine's questioning. Every head in the bar turns to the door, hanging open on its hinges to expose the black of the stormy night tinged with rushing flurries of gray snow. The silhouette of a woman is outlined against the gale, a heavy cloak drawn around her shoulders and a hood covering most of her face."

rows.original: "Help," she croaks weakly, voice barely audible over the roar of the snowstorm outside. "Please... anyone... help!"
rows.translation: “救命，”她虚弱地嘶哑着嗓子说，声音在门外暴风雪的呼啸声中几乎听不见。“求求你们……谁也好……救救我！”
rows.raw: '\n\n"Help," she croaks weakly, voice barely audible over the roar of the snowstorm outside. "Please... anyone... help!"'

rows.original: Nobody moves for a long moment, until old Garth growls something and grabs a cane from behind the bar, starting to hobble towards her. The rest of the folk gathered in the tavern quickly turn their heads back towards their drinks, turning away from the cold.
rows.translation: 好一会儿，没有人动弹。直到老加斯低声说了些什么，然后从吧台后面拿了一根手杖，一瘸一拐地朝她走去。酒馆里的其他顾客也迅速把头转回到自己的酒杯前，避开了那股寒意。
rows.raw: "\n\nNobody moves for a long moment, until old Garth growls something and grabs a cane from behind the bar, starting to hobble towards her. The rest of the folk gathered in the tavern quickly turn their heads back towards their drinks, turning away from the cold."

rows.translation: 你呢？
调查

rows.original: If nobody else is going to help, you sure will. Go with the bartender and see what's wrong.
rows.translation: 如果没有人愿意帮忙，那你肯定得站出来。去跟酒保一起看看到底发生了什么。
rows.raw: "If nobody else is going to help, you sure will. Go with the bartender and see what's wrong."

rows.translation: 惩罚
太厉害了，真正的英雄。这样的冠军，哇！

rows.original: What the hell — all these people here, and the limping bartender's the only one to stand up? What kind of people are they!?
rows.translation: 搞什么鬼——这里这么多人，却只有那个瘸腿的酒保站了起来？这些人到底是什么样的人啊！？
rows.raw: "What the hell — all these people here, and the limping bartender's the only one to stand up? What kind of people are they!?"

rows.translation: 什么都不做

rows.original: The townsfolk have the right idea: this isn't your problem. Mind your own business and enjoy your drink.
rows.translation: 镇上的居民想法很对：这不是你该操心的事。管好你自己的事，好好喝你的酒吧。
rows.raw: "The townsfolk have the right idea: this isn't your problem. Mind your own business and enjoy your drink."

rows.translation: 跳过教程

rows.original: Skip the tutorial adventure, advancing time to the start of the main quest. Only recommended for experienced players.
rows.translation: 跳过教程冒险，直接进入主线任务的开始阶段。仅推荐给有经验的玩家。
rows.raw: "Skip the tutorial adventure, advancing time to the start of the main quest. Only recommended for experienced players."

rows.original: Everyone else seems keen to ignore the girl, and it's not like you'd be much help anyway. Garth can handle... whatever's wrong with her.
rows.translation: 其他人似乎都打算忽略那个女孩，而且你也没什么办法能帮上忙。加斯能够处理……她遇到的任何问题。
rows.raw: "Everyone else seems keen to ignore the girl, and it's not like you'd be much help anyway. Garth can handle... whatever's wrong with her. "

rows.original: You swing back on your barstool and go back to your drink, content to let the evening pass you by...
rows.translation: 你重新坐回吧台凳上，继续喝着酒，心满意足地让这个夜晚就这样慢慢过去……
rows.raw: "\n\nYou swing back on your barstool and go back to your drink, content to let the evening pass you by..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Whatever happened with that girl, you'll never know. She and Garth disappeared, hobbling off in the cold night. When you woke up the next day, neither were anywhere to be found at the Frost Hound. Luckily, the storm had abated by the morning after, clearing up enough for you to continue your travels. A few townsfolk ask you if you've seen Garth as you're leaving, but you have to shake your head and wish them luck on their search. You've got places to be... maybe a little further south, if the weather's going to be this foul.
rows.translation: 那个女孩后来发生了什么，你永远也不会知道。她和加思在寒冷的夜晚消失了。第二天你醒来时，在霜犬酒馆号上根本找不到他们的踪迹。幸运的是，第二天早上暴风雨已经减弱，天气终于放晴，你得以继续你的旅程。在离开时，有几位镇民询问你是否见过加斯，但你只能摇摇头，祝他们能在寻找中好运。你还有其他事情要去做……如果天气继续这么糟糕的话，也许应该往南边再走走。
rows.raw: "Whatever happened with that girl, you'll never know. She and Garth disappeared, hobbling off in the cold night. When you woke up the next day, neither were anywhere to be found at the Frost Hound. Luckily, the storm had abated by the morning after, clearing up enough for you to continue your travels. A few townsfolk ask you if you've seen Garth as you're leaving, but you have to shake your head and wish them luck on their search. You've got places to be... maybe a little further south, if the weather's going to be this foul."

rows.translation: 游戏……？结束了！
下一步

rows.original: Import this character into a more heroic playthrough.
rows.translation: 将这个角色引入到更加英勇的剧情发展中去吧。
rows.raw: "Import this character into a more heroic playthrough."

rows.original: "What the hell is wrong with you!?" you shout into the collected villagers huddled into the tavern, all pointedly ignoring the waif in the doorway. Garth looks over his shoulder at you, big golden eyes catching the light of the fire as you speak. "Don't just sit there: this girl needs help!"
rows.translation: 你到底怎么了！？你朝着聚集在酒馆里的村民们大声呼喊，而那些村民们却故意无视站在门口的那个流浪者。加斯回头看了你一眼，当你说话时，他那双金色的大眼睛在火光中闪烁着光芒。别只是坐在那里发呆：这个女孩需要帮助！
rows.raw: '"What the hell is wrong with you!?" you shout into the collected villagers huddled into the tavern, all pointedly ignoring the waif in the doorway. Garth looks over his shoulder at you, big golden eyes catching the light of the fire as you speak. "Don\'t just sit there: this girl needs help!"'

rows.original: Not waiting for the cravens to respond, you jog after Garth — just in time to see the waifish girl collapse into the old wolf's arms. He grunts as the sudden weight nearly drags him to the ground, but he manages to let her down easy, keeping her from hitting her head. You shut the door to the cold and take a knee beside them, pulling the half-conscious girl's hood down to reveal a head of blonde hair dyed pink, parting around a pair of perky cat ears. Her face is caked with mud and dirt, sullying an otherwise beautiful complexion with the shadow of hardship.
rows.translation: 你没有等待那些胆小鬼做出反应，就急忙追上了加斯——正好看到那个瘦弱的女孩倒在了那只老狼的怀里。老狼发出低沉的哼声，因为这个突如其来的重量几乎把他拖到了地上，但他还是设法轻轻地把她放了下来，避免她的头部受到伤害。你关上门，挡住了寒风，然后跪在他们身边，拉下那个半昏迷的女孩的兜帽，露出一头染成粉色的金发，那些头发在两只挺立的猫耳两侧分开。她的脸上沾满了泥巴和灰尘，给原本姣好的面容蒙上了苦难的阴影。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot waiting for the cravens to respond, you jog after Garth — just in time to see the waifish girl collapse into the old wolf's arms. He grunts as the sudden weight nearly drags him to the ground, but he manages to let her down easy, keeping her from hitting her head. You shut the door to the cold and take a knee beside them, pulling the half-conscious girl's hood down to reveal a head of blonde hair dyed pink, parting around a pair of perky cat ears. Her face is caked with mud and dirt, sullying an otherwise beautiful complexion with the shadow of hardship."

rows.original: "F-father?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. You're nowhere near old enough to be her father, but she's clearly delirious, barely aware of what's around here.
rows.translation: “父……父亲？”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，还伸出脏兮兮的手来轻触你的脸颊。你显然还远不够当她的父亲，但她显然已经神志不清了，几乎意识不到周围发生了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n\"F-father?\" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. You're nowhere near old enough to be her father, but she's clearly delirious, barely aware of what's around here."

rows.original: "C-Calla?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. She must think you're somebody else — someone she cares a great deal about.
rows.translation: “卡……卡拉？”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，然后伸出脏兮兮的手来轻触你的脸颊。她一定以为你是另一个人——一个她非常在意的人。
rows.raw: '\n\n"C-Calla?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. She must think you\'re somebody else — someone she cares a great deal about.'

rows.original: "W-who..." she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching out a hand. "[A] [pc.race]?"
rows.translation: “谁……”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，同时伸出了手。“[A] [pc.race]？”
rows.raw: '\n\n"W-who..." she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching out a hand. "[A] [pc.race]?"'

rows.original: Garth grunts, drawing your attention to his hand that was cradling the girl's head a moment before. His white fur is caked with flecks of dried blood. She clearly took a nasty blow to the head before wandering here... whoever this is.
rows.translation: 加斯低声哼了一声，将你的注意力引向他刚才托着那个女孩头部的手。他的白色毛发上沾满了干涸的血迹。显然，在她来到这里之前，头部一定受到了严重的撞击……不管她到底是谁。
rows.raw: "\n\nGarth grunts, drawing your attention to his hand that was cradling the girl's head a moment before. His white fur is caked with flecks of dried blood. She clearly took a nasty blow to the head before wandering here... whoever this is."

rows.original: "What's your name?" you say, taking the cat-girl's hand.
rows.translation: “你叫什么名字？”你说着，牵起了那个猫娘的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n\"What's your name?\" you say, taking the cat-girl's hand."

rows.original: She moans, blinking hard to clear away the fog of her injury. "Caitriss," she finally answers. "My name is Cait. I... we were..."
rows.translation: 她呻吟着，用力眨眼，试图驱散因受伤而产生的视线模糊。“凯特丽丝，”她终于回答了。“我叫凯特。我……我们曾经……”
rows.raw: '\n\nShe moans, blinking hard to clear away the fog of her injury. "Caitriss," she finally answers. "My name is Cait. I... we were..."'

rows.original: "Easy," Garth tells her. You find yourself smiling up at a middle-aged woman behind you in the growing crowd as she rips a strip off her long skirt, handing it off to Garth as a bandage. He ties it off around her brow, though you know she'll need healing magic or a lot of time to recover.
rows.translation: 很简单。加斯对她说。在逐渐拥挤的人群中，你发现自己不由自主地朝身后的一位中年妇女笑了笑——她从自己长长的裙子上撕下一条布条，递给了加斯，让他用来包扎她的额头。加斯将布条系在她额头上，不过你知道，她真正需要的是治愈魔法，或者至少需要很长时间才能恢复健康。
rows.raw: '\n\n"Easy," Garth tells her. You find yourself smiling up at a middle-aged woman behind you in the growing crowd as she rips a strip off her long skirt, handing it off to Garth as a bandage. He ties it off around her brow, though you know she\'ll need healing magic or a lot of time to recover.'

rows.original: Most of the people in the tavern have gathered around her by now, shamed into action by your words. Between the lot of you, it's easy to lift the girl up and onto her feet and walk her over to one of the nearby chairs. She staggers a bit, but seems to get her footing by the time you get her seated, and ask her what happened.
rows.translation: 此时，酒馆里的大多数人都聚集在她周围，你们的话让他们感到羞愧，从而采取了行动。你们几个人一起帮忙，很容易就把那个女孩扶起来，让她站稳脚跟，然后把她带到附近的椅子上。她踉跄了几步，但在你们让她坐下并询问她发生了什么之后，似乎已经稳住了身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nMost of the people in the tavern have gathered around her by now, shamed into action by your words. Between the lot of you, it's easy to lift the girl up and onto her feet and walk her over to one of the nearby chairs. She staggers a bit, but seems to get her footing by the time you get her seated, and ask her what happened."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You hop off your barstool and follow Garth over to the silhouette of a woman standing in the doorway... just in time for her to pitch forward into the tavern. Instinct kicks in, and you find yourself lunging forward and sliding across the wood floor, reaching out just in time to catch the girl before she cracks her head.
rows.translation: 你从吧台上跳下来，跟着加斯走向站在门口的那个女人身影所在的地方……正好在那一刻，她向前扑了进来，跌进了酒馆里。本能立刻驱使你冲了上去，在木制地板上滑行着，及时伸出手去接住了那个女孩，才避免她头部受伤。
rows.raw: "You hop off your barstool and follow Garth over to the silhouette of a woman standing in the doorway... just in time for her to pitch forward into the tavern. Instinct kicks in, and you find yourself lunging forward and sliding across the wood floor, reaching out just in time to catch the girl before she cracks her head. "

rows.original: Not that it helps much. You stagger under the sudden weight, trying to gently lower the half-unconscious waif to the floor; something hot and wet coats your hand as her hood falls away, revealing a head of blonde hair dyed pink and perky cat ears over a face caked with mud and dirt. Worse, the back of her head is flecked with dried blood that rubs off on your hand. She must have taken a nasty blow before stumbling in.
rows.translation: 不过这也没什么帮助。突然加重的重量让你摇摇晃晃，你试图小心翼翼地将那个半昏迷的女孩放到地上；当她的兜帽脱落时，某种温热黏湿的东西糊在了你的手上，同时露出一头被染成粉色的金发和两只挺立的猫耳，下面是一张沾满泥巴和灰尘的脸。更糟糕的是，她后脑勺上还有干掉的血迹，那些血迹也沾在了你的手上。她肯定是受到了重创，才会跌跌撞撞地走进来的。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot that it helps much. You stagger under the sudden weight, trying to gently lower the half-unconscious waif to the floor; something hot and wet coats your hand as her hood falls away, revealing a head of blonde hair dyed pink and perky cat ears over a face caked with mud and dirt. Worse, the back of her head is flecked with dried blood that rubs off on your hand. She must have taken a nasty blow before stumbling in."

rows.original: "F-father?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. You're nowhere near old enough to be her father, but she's clearly delirious, barely aware of what's around here.
rows.translation: “父……父亲？”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，还伸出脏兮兮的手来轻触你的脸颊。你显然还远不够当她的父亲，但她显然已经神志不清了，几乎意识不到周围发生了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n\"F-father?\" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. You're nowhere near old enough to be her father, but she's clearly delirious, barely aware of what's around here."

rows.original: "C-Calla?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. She must think you're somebody else — someone she cares a great deal about.
rows.translation: “卡……卡拉？”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，然后伸出脏兮兮的手来轻触你的脸颊。她一定以为你是另一个人——一个她非常在意的人。
rows.raw: '\n\n"C-Calla?" she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching up with a dirty hand to brush your cheek. She must think you\'re somebody else — someone she cares a great deal about.'

rows.original: "W-who..." she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching out a hand. "[A] [pc.race]?"
rows.translation: “谁……”她呜咽着，用那双大大的蓝眼睛望着你，同时伸出了手。“[A] [pc.race]？”
rows.raw: '\n\n"W-who..." she whimpers, blinking her big blue eyes at you and reaching out a hand. "[A] [pc.race]?"'

rows.original: Grunting, Garth rips a strip of his apron off, pushing it against her head wound. "It's not bad, but she'll need healing," he whispers to you. "Keep her talking; I'll try and clean this up."
rows.translation: 加斯哼了一声，扯下自己围裙上的一块布，将其敷在她的头部伤口上。还不错，但她需要治疗。他轻声对你说道。让她继续说话，我试着把这件事解决掉。
rows.raw: '\n\nGrunting, Garth rips a strip of his apron off, pushing it against her head wound. "It\'s not bad, but she\'ll need healing," he whispers to you. "Keep her talking; I\'ll try and clean this up."'

rows.original: Grateful for the old wolf's assistance, you take the cat-girl's hand and ask, "What's your name, then?"
rows.translation: 感激老狼的帮助，你握住猫女的手问道：“那你叫什么名字呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nGrateful for the old wolf's assistance, you take the cat-girl's hand and ask, \"What's your name, then?\""

rows.original: She moans, blinking hard to clear away the fog of her injury. "Caitriss," she finally answers. "My name is Cait. I... we were..."
rows.translation: 她呻吟着，用力眨眼，试图驱散因受伤而产生的视线模糊。“凯特丽丝，”她终于回答了。“我叫凯特。我……我们曾经……”
rows.raw: '\n\nShe moans, blinking hard to clear away the fog of her injury. "Caitriss," she finally answers. "My name is Cait. I... we were..."'

rows.original: "Easy," Garth tells her, tying a bandage off around her brow. "You took a bad hit, lass. Let's get you sat down, eh?"
rows.translation: 很简单。加斯一边为她包扎额头，一边说道。姑娘，你受到的撞击相当严重。我们先让你坐下来休息吧，好吗？
rows.raw: '\n\n"Easy," Garth tells her, tying a bandage off around her brow. "You took a bad hit, lass. Let\'s get you sat down, eh?"'

rows.original: Cait nods weakly, and you and Garth manage to get her standing. She stumbles at first, but regains some semblance of her bearing by the time you find an unoccupied seat and sit her down to ask what happened.
rows.translation: 凯特虚弱地点了点头，你和加斯费了些劲才让她站了起来。起初她步履蹒跚，但当你们找到一个空座位让她坐下后，她终于重新恢复了些许平衡，你们便开始询问她发生了什么事。
rows.raw: "\n\nCait nods weakly, and you and Garth manage to get her standing. She stumbles at first, but regains some semblance of her bearing by the time you find an unoccupied seat and sit her down to ask what happened."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: A few minutes later, you and
rows.translation: 几分钟后，你和
几位忧心忡忡的村民
加斯

rows.original: are standing around the cat-girl, Cait, as she holds a snow-dampened cloth to the bloodied back of her head.
rows.translation: 站在猫女凯特身边，而她正用一块被雪水浸湿的布按在流血的后脑勺上。
rows.raw: " are standing around the cat-girl, Cait, as she holds a snow-dampened cloth to the bloodied back of her head. "

rows.original: You tell her to relax, running your hand along the pink-dyed hair around her injury, channeling a little of your magic with whispered words of power. A moment later and the wound is gone, leaving only matted hair and a faint scar in its wake.
rows.translation: 你安慰她放松下来，用手轻轻抚摸她受伤处周围那染成粉色的头发，同时用低声念出的咒语释放出一点点魔力。片刻之后，伤口便消失了，只留下一些缠结的头发和一道淡淡的疤痕。
rows.raw: "You tell her to relax, running your hand along the pink-dyed hair around her injury, channeling a little of your magic with whispered words of power. A moment later and the wound is gone, leaving only matted hair and a faint scar in its wake. "

rows.original: She still seems half-dazed, but after a few repeated questions, she finally recovers enough to speak:
rows.translation: 她看起来仍然有些恍惚，但在被反复询问了几次之后，她终于恢复了足够的意识，能够开口说话了：
rows.raw: "She still seems half-dazed, but after a few repeated questions, she finally recovers enough to speak:"

rows.original: "They came out of nowhere. A bunch of men in hoods jumped our wagon, just outside the gates. I didn't even have time to grab my staff before they were on us, grabbing and hitting."
rows.translation: “他们突然出现了。一群戴着兜帽的男子在城门外跳上了我们的马车。我甚至还没来得及拿起手杖，他们就已经扑了上来，开始抢夺和殴打我们。”
rows.raw: '\n\n"They came out of nowhere. A bunch of men in hoods jumped our wagon, just outside the gates. I didn\'t even have time to grab my staff before they were on us, grabbing and hitting."'

rows.original: "Us? Who else was with you?" Garth asks, putting a reassuring paw on the girl's shoulder.
rows.translation: 我们？还有谁和你在一起？加斯将一只安抚的手放在女孩的肩上，问道。
rows.raw: '\n\n"Us? Who else was with you?" Garth asks, putting a reassuring paw on the girl\'s shoulder. '

rows.original: The cat-girl hugs her arms around herself and casts a glance out the tavern's door, towards the howling blizzard raging outside. "My sister. We were coming up north to meet our dad, and got caught in the blizzard. We thought we were finally safe when we saw the village on the horizon..." She shivers violently, tears streaking her dirty cheeks. "One of them hit me with his club. When I woke up, Calla — my sister — was gone. They took her."
rows.translation: 猫女双臂环抱自己，透过酒馆的门望向外面肆虐的暴风雪。“我的妹妹。我们本来是要往北走去见我们的父亲的，结果却遇到了暴风雪。当我们在地平线上看到那个村庄时，我们以为自己终于安全了……”她剧烈地颤抖着，泪水顺着她脏兮兮的脸颊流了下来。“他们中有一个人用木棒打了我。当我醒来时，卡拉——我的妹妹——已经不见了。他们把她带走了。”
rows.raw: '\n\nThe cat-girl hugs her arms around herself and casts a glance out the tavern\'s door, towards the howling blizzard raging outside. "My sister. We were coming up north to meet our dad, and got caught in the blizzard. We thought we were finally safe when we saw the village on the horizon..." She shivers violently, tears streaking her dirty cheeks. "One of them hit me with his club. When I woke up, Calla — my sister — was gone. They took her." '

rows.original: A ragged sob escapes her lips, and you
rows.translation: 一阵断断续续的抽泣从她的嘴唇中迸发出来，而你
rows.raw: "\n\nA ragged sob escapes her lips, and you "

rows.original: watch as several townsfolk place their hats to their chests, offering murmurs of concern and pity.
rows.translation: 只见几位镇民将帽子放在胸前，低声表达着担忧与同情。
rows.raw: "watch as several townsfolk place their hats to their chests, offering murmurs of concern and pity. "

rows.original: and Garth exchange a concerned look.
rows.translation: 加斯和加斯交换了一个担忧的眼神。

rows.original: Orcs and wolf-folk having it out in the hills you could understand; monster attacks, too. But this is the first you've heard of brigands attacking people on the road around here, especially in this weather.
rows.translation: 兽人族和狼人族在山里互相争斗，这种情况还是可以理解的；怪物发动攻击也是意料之中的事。但你从来没听说过有强盗会在这一带的路上袭击行人，尤其是在这种天气条件下。
rows.raw: "Orcs and wolf-folk having it out in the hills you could understand; monster attacks, too. But this is the first you've heard of brigands attacking people on the road around here, especially in this weather. "

rows.original: "I have to go find her," Cait sniffles, looking up at you with wide eyes. "I have to... Calla's still out there. I've got to help her."
rows.translation: “我得去找她了，”凯特抽着鼻子，睁大眼睛望着你。“我必须……卡拉还在外面，我必须去帮助她。”
rows.raw: '\n\n"I have to go find her," Cait sniffles, looking up at you with wide eyes. "I have to... Calla\'s still out there. I\'ve got to help her."'

rows.original: Garth sighs wearily, hand tightening on the head of his cane. "You can't go back out there all by yourself, lass. You're hurt enough already. I'd go with you, but my leg..."
rows.translation: 加斯疲惫地叹了口气，手中的手杖握得更紧了。姑娘，你不能一个人再回到那边去。你的伤已经够严重的了。我本来想陪你去，但我的腿……
rows.raw: "\n\nGarth sighs wearily, hand tightening on the head of his cane. \"You can't go back out there all by yourself, lass. You're hurt enough already. I'd go with you, but my leg...\""

rows.original: "I have to," Cait echoes, forcing herself onto her feet and rubbing at her cheeks. "I can't leave her... but I need help. Please."
rows.translation: “我必须这么做，”凯特重复道，强迫自己站起身来，然后揉了揉自己的脸颊。“我不能离开她……但我需要帮助。求你了。”
rows.raw: '\n\n"I have to," Cait echoes, forcing herself onto her feet and rubbing at her cheeks. "I can\'t leave her... but I need help. Please." '

rows.original: She's looking at you, desperate, yet determined despite her injuries.
rows.translation: 她正注视着你，虽然身负伤痛，却依然充满决心，也显得十分绝望。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe's looking at you, desperate, yet determined despite her injuries."

rows.translation: 帮助她吧

rows.original: You know how to handle yourself, and Garth's right: Cait won't last a minute all by herself.
rows.translation: 你很懂得如何照顾自己，加斯说得对：凯特独自一人的话，一分钟都撑不下来。
rows.raw: "You know how to handle yourself, and Garth's right: Cait won't last a minute all by herself."

rows.original: "I'll go with you," you say, extending a helping hand to the battered cat-girl.
rows.translation: “我和你一起去，”你说着，向那个伤痕累累的猫女伸出了援手。
rows.raw: '"I\'ll go with you," you say, extending a helping hand to the battered cat-girl.'

rows.original: Her eyes widen with surprise, and you're rewarded with a sudden, ecstatic smile. "Thank you! Oh, thank you so much!" she all but cries, taking your hand and hauling herself up and onto you in a fierce hug. "But we've got to hurry. Those men... they attacked us just outside the eastern gate. They can't have gotten far."
rows.translation: 她的眼睛因惊讶而瞪得大大的，随后你看到她露出了一个突如其来、充满欣喜的笑容。“谢谢！哦，真的太感谢你了！”她几乎要哭出来了，握住你的手，猛地抱住你。“但我们必须赶快。那些人……他们在东门外面袭击了我们，他们应该没有走远。”
rows.raw: '\n\nHer eyes widen with surprise, and you\'re rewarded with a sudden, ecstatic smile. "Thank you! Oh, thank you so much!" she all but cries, taking your hand and hauling herself up and onto you in a fierce hug. "But we\'ve got to hurry. Those men... they attacked us just outside the eastern gate. They can\'t have gotten far."'

rows.original: Giving her a firm nod, you turn towards the tavern door and pull your cloak around yourself, bracing for the fierce cold to come. Cait does the same, following you to the entrance with slowly returning confidence in her step. "I'm not much of a fighter," she admits, "but I can do a little magic — healing, actually. Or I could, if I had my staff. I must have dropped it on the road."
rows.translation: 你坚定地点了点头，然后转向酒馆的大门，将斗篷裹紧身体，准备迎接即将袭来的严寒。凯特也做了同样的动作，跟在你身后走向门口，她的步伐中逐渐恢复了自信。“我其实不太擅长打架，”她承认了。“但我可以施展一些魔法——其实是治愈魔法。要是我的法杖还在的话，就能用了。肯定是在路上弄丢了。”
rows.raw: '\n\nGiving her a firm nod, you turn towards the tavern door and pull your cloak around yourself, bracing for the fierce cold to come. Cait does the same, following you to the entrance with slowly returning confidence in her step. "I\'m not much of a fighter," she admits, "but I can do a little magic — healing, actually. Or I could, if I had my staff. I must have dropped it on the road."'

rows.original: "Speaking of which," Garth says, hobbling up behind you and offering you a cloth-wrapped bundle. "Won't do to have you going out there unarmed. Take this."
rows.translation: 说到这个，加斯一瘸一拐地走到你身后，递给你一个用布包好的包裹。让你空手去那里可不行，拿着这个吧。
rows.raw: '\n\n"Speaking of which," Garth says, hobbling up behind you and offering you a cloth-wrapped bundle. "Won\'t do to have you going out there unarmed. Take this."'

rows.original: You accept the old wolf's offering and unfold the cloth to reveal
rows.translation: 你接受了老狼的馈赠，展开布料，露出了其中的内容。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou accept the old wolf's offering and unfold the cloth to reveal "

rows.original: a wide-bladed military knife, expertly weighted and honed to a razor point. "This was mine, back in the old days. Put it to good use, huh?"
rows.translation: 一把刀刃宽大的军用刀具，经过精心设计，重量恰到好处，刀刃也被磨得极其锋利。“这东西以前是我的。好好利用它吧，嗯？”
rows.raw: 'a wide-bladed military knife, expertly weighted and honed to a razor point. "This was mine, back in the old days. Put it to good use, huh?"'

rows.original: a short sword, not much longer than your forearm, but polished to a shine and razor sharp. "My wife's. Kept it around, just in case... maybe you'll get some use out of it."
rows.translation: 一把短剑，长度不超过你的前臂，但经过精心打磨，变得光亮无比且锋利无比。“我妻子的。我留着它，以防万一……也许你会用到它。”
rows.raw: "a short sword, not much longer than your forearm, but polished to a shine and razor sharp. \"My wife's. Kept it around, just in case... maybe you'll get some use out of it.\""

rows.original: a long, slender quarterstaff. It lacks the adornment of most mage's staves, but a quick inspection reveals a good bit of heft behind it. "My wife's. Kept it around, just in case... maybe you'll get some use out of it."
rows.translation: 一根细长的长棍。它没有大多数法师法杖上的装饰，但仔细观察就会发现，这根长棍其实相当沉重。“我妻子的。我留着它，以防万一……也许你会用到它。”
rows.raw: "a long, slender quarterstaff. It lacks the adornment of most mage's staves, but a quick inspection reveals a good bit of heft behind it. \"My wife's. Kept it around, just in case... maybe you'll get some use out of it.\""

rows.original: "Thank you, Garth," you say, wrapping your hand around the [pc.weapon]. Turning to Cait, you add, "Come on. We don't have any time to lose."
rows.translation: “谢谢你，加斯，”你说道，同时用手握住[pc.weapon]。转向凯特，你补充道：“快走吧。我们没时间可以浪费了。”
rows.raw: '\n\n"Thank you, Garth," you say, wrapping your hand around the [pc.weapon]. Turning to Cait, you add, "Come on. We don\'t have any time to lose."'

rows.original: She nods, and the two of you press out of the Frost Hound and into the howling blizzard.
rows.translation: 她点了点头，于是你们俩一起从霜犬酒馆中冲了出来，进入了那呼啸的暴风雪之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods, and the two of you press out of the Frost Hound and into the howling blizzard."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The moment you step through the gates, you're assailed by a battering hammer of whipping winds, threatening to blast you down to the ground. You end up covering your eyes with your arm, struggling to see anything through the snow flurries and stormy darkness.
rows.translation: 你一穿过大门，就会被猛烈的狂风袭击，这些狂风仿佛巨锤般猛烈地冲击着你，仿佛要把你吹倒在地。你不得不用手臂遮住眼睛，在纷飞的雪花和漆黑的暴风雨中努力试图看清前方的路。
rows.raw: "The moment you step through the gates, you're assailed by a battering hammer of whipping winds, threatening to blast you down to the ground. You end up covering your eyes with your arm, struggling to see anything through the snow flurries and stormy darkness."

rows.original: "Our wagon's not far," Cait says, having to shout over the howling winds. She pulls her cloak tight around herself, struggling forward against the gale. The snow's up well past your boots now, making every step a staggering, unsure affair; there's only the barest outline of the road left.
rows.translation: “我们的马车离这里不远，”凯特在呼啸的风声中大声说道。她紧紧地裹住自己的斗篷，努力在狂风中向前行走。积雪已经没过了你的靴子，每走一步都显得艰难而不稳定；道路上只剩下依稀可辨的轮廓线。
rows.raw: "\n\n\"Our wagon's not far,\" Cait says, having to shout over the howling winds. She pulls her cloak tight around herself, struggling forward against the gale. The snow's up well past your boots now, making every step a staggering, unsure affair; there's only the barest outline of the road left."

rows.original: You follow Cait, forging your way forward as fast as you can. Minutes pass in wordless grunts and gasps as the pair of you fight against the blizzard, following the winding path. Around you, trees bend and creak in the wind, showering you with snow and snapping branches. In the distance, outside the protective shield of the high banks and hills, you're sure you can see trees being ripped up and battered down. What the hell kind of storm is this!?
rows.translation: 你紧跟着凯特，以最快的速度向前冲去。几分钟的时间里，你们只是无声地喘息着、艰难地前行，一路与暴风雪作斗争，沿着蜿蜒的小路前进。周围，树木在风中弯曲、嘎吱作响，雪花纷纷扬扬地落在你们身上，还有树枝不断折断掉落。在远处，那些高高的堤岸和山丘形成的防护屏障之外，你们清楚地看到树木被连根拔起、被狂风摧残。这到底是一场什么样的风暴啊！？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow Cait, forging your way forward as fast as you can. Minutes pass in wordless grunts and gasps as the pair of you fight against the blizzard, following the winding path. Around you, trees bend and creak in the wind, showering you with snow and snapping branches. In the distance, outside the protective shield of the high banks and hills, you're sure you can see trees being ripped up and battered down. What the hell kind of storm is this!?"

rows.original: "Over there!" Cait shouts, stumbling off the edge of the road to an overturned wagon. A canopy is blowing from its ruined frame, flickering like a flag in the wind and threatening to tear off at any moment. Horse reins hang from the driver's seat, ripped away when the beasts fled after the attack. Boxes and bags have spilled out all over the road, scattering clothing and frozen food to the wind.
rows.translation: “在那边！”凯特大喊着，跌跌撞撞地跑到了路边，那里有一辆翻倒的马车。马车的车篷从残破的框架上飘荡下来，在风中像旗帜一样飘动，随时都有可能被吹掉。驾驶座上的马缰绳垂落着——那是马匹在袭击后逃走时被扯断的。箱子和袋子散落在道路上，衣物和冷冻食品被风吹得到处都是。
rows.raw: '\n\n"Over there!" Cait shouts, stumbling off the edge of the road to an overturned wagon. A canopy is blowing from its ruined frame, flickering like a flag in the wind and threatening to tear off at any moment. Horse reins hang from the driver\'s seat, ripped away when the beasts fled after the attack. Boxes and bags have spilled out all over the road, scattering clothing and frozen food to the wind.'

rows.original: She screams "CALLA!?" at the top of her lungs, crying to the hills and forest. No response comes. Cait curses, looking around the site of the ambush for any sign of her missing sister. Eventually, she rubs her eyes and leans over into the toppled mess of her family's cart, retrieving a long, curved-tipped staff set with a brilliant crimson gemstone almost as big as your fist.
rows.translation: 她扯着嗓子尖叫：“卡拉！？”她的呼喊传向山丘与森林，却没有任何回应。凯特咒骂着，环视伏击现场，寻找失踪妹妹的任何踪迹。最终，她擦了擦眼睛，弯腰探进倾倒的家族马车残骸中，捡起一根长长的、顶端弯曲的法杖——上面镶着一颗鲜红的宝石，几乎有你拳头那么大。
rows.raw: '\n\nShe screams "CALLA!?" at the top of her lungs, crying to the hills and forest. No response comes. Cait curses, looking around the site of the ambush for any sign of her missing sister. Eventually, she rubs her eyes and leans over into the toppled mess of her family\'s cart, retrieving a long, curved-tipped staff set with a brilliant crimson gemstone almost as big as your fist.'

rows.original: Whoever attacked her weren't mere bandits, that's for sure. That staff would have fetched a handsome price, but they just left it. Strange...
rows.translation: 袭击她的人绝对不是普通的强盗。那根法杖肯定能卖个好价钱，但他们却把它留下了。真是奇怪……
rows.raw: "\n\nWhoever attacked her weren't mere bandits, that's for sure. That staff would have fetched a handsome price, but they just left it. Strange..."

rows.original: Your companion mutters something under her breath, and the crystal tip of the staff glows with power. She runs a hand along the back of her head, and you watch as the wound on the back of her head slowly vanishes in a pale glow of magic. At least she wasn't kidding about her magic — something tells you a healer's going to be pretty useful if you wind up going toe to toe with those hooded men.
rows.translation: 你的同伴低声说了些什么，法杖的水晶尖端顿时散发出了强大的光芒。她用手抚了抚后脑勺，你看到她后脑勺上的伤口在淡淡的魔法光芒中逐渐消失了。看来她所说的魔法能力确实不是在开玩笑——如果你真的与那些戴兜帽的男人对峙起来，拥有一个治疗者未尝不是件好事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour companion mutters something under her breath, and the crystal tip of the staff glows with power. She runs a hand along the back of her head, and you watch as the wound on the back of her head slowly vanishes in a pale glow of magic. At least she wasn't kidding about her magic — something tells you a healer's going to be pretty useful if you wind up going toe to toe with those hooded men."

rows.original: Cait clenches her fists around her staff, turning her gaze toward the rough hills overlooking the road to the north. In the distance, high above, you can see what looks to be an old castle looming over the cliffs, its tall towers jutting up in ragged ruins to pierce the dark sky. "We have to go. I've got to save her.... Those men came from there, I think," Cait says, pointing her staffhead towards the hills. "There are still footprints in the snow. They — and Calla — can't have left that long ago. Come on!"
rows.translation: 凯特紧紧握住手中的法杖，将目光投向那些俯瞰着通往北方道路的崎岖山丘。在远处，高高的山巅上，可以看到一座古老的城堡矗立在悬崖之上，它那高耸的塔楼在残破的废墟中突兀地耸立着，仿佛要刺破暗影的天空。我们得走了。我必须救她……我觉得那些人就是从那里来的。凯特说着，将她的法杖指向那些山丘。雪地上还有脚印。他们——还有卡拉——不可能离开这么久。快走吧！
rows.raw: '\n\nCait clenches her fists around her staff, turning her gaze toward the rough hills overlooking the road to the north. In the distance, high above, you can see what looks to be an old castle looming over the cliffs, its tall towers jutting up in ragged ruins to pierce the dark sky. "We have to go. I\'ve got to save her.... Those men came from there, I think," Cait says, pointing her staffhead towards the hills. "There are still footprints in the snow. They — and Calla — can\'t have left that long ago. Come on!"'

rows.original: She takes off running towards the hills without a moment's hesitation, rushing headlong into the darkness. You can only hope you'll find Calla before it's too late...
rows.translation: 她毫不犹豫地冲向山丘，一头扎进了黑暗之中。你只能祈祷能在为时已晚之前找到卡拉……
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes off running towards the hills without a moment's hesitation, rushing headlong into the darkness. You can only hope you'll find Calla before it's too late..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: As you make your way through the foothills pass, you start to sense movement from above — shadows flowing across the rocks; eyes looking down, watching you. Finally, you look up, casting your gaze towards the jagged edges of rock overhanging the narrow path. Two figures in dark cloaks stand at the top, hoods drawn over their heads to conceal their faces in shrouds of shadow. The moment you see them, they leap down onto the path before you, drawing daggers from their rope belts.
rows.translation: 当你穿过山麓的隘口时，开始感觉到上方有动静——阴影在岩石上移动，仿佛有双眼睛正在注视着你。终于，你抬头望去，发现狭窄小路上方，那些陡峭的岩石边缘处，站着两个身披黑袍的身影。他们将兜帽拉下来，面容被阴影掩盖。就在你看到他们的瞬间，他们便从上面跳到了你的面前，从腰间的绳带中抽出了匕首。
rows.raw: "As you make your way through the foothills pass, you start to sense movement from above — shadows flowing across the rocks; eyes looking down, watching you. Finally, you look up, casting your gaze towards the jagged edges of rock overhanging the narrow path. Two figures in dark cloaks stand at the top, hoods drawn over their heads to conceal their faces in shrouds of shadow. The moment you see them, they leap down onto the path before you, drawing daggers from their rope belts."

rows.original: "Intruders!" one of them says, angling his knife's point at your chest. "The night of the Ritual is upon us! Bow low and give praise to our dark lady — you tread on sacred ground!"
rows.translation: 入侵者！其中一个人说着，将刀尖指向你的胸口。仪式之夜已经降临！请低下头，向我们的暗影女神表达敬意——你们此刻正踏在神圣的土地上！
rows.raw: '\n\n"Intruders!" one of them says, angling his knife\'s point at your chest. "The night of the Ritual is upon us! Bow low and give praise to our dark lady — you tread on sacred ground!"'

rows.original: "Ritual?" Cait whispers, glancing at you. "Oh, no..."
rows.translation: “仪式？”凯特轻声说道，同时瞥了你一眼。“哦，不……”
rows.raw: '\n\n"Ritual?" Cait whispers, glancing at you. "Oh, no..."'

rows.original: Your companion twirls her staff around and levels it at the first of the robed figures, determination in her eyes. "Give me my sister back, you bastards!"
rows.translation: 你的同伴旋转着手中的法杖，将其对准了那些身穿长袍的身影中的第一个，她的眼中充满了决心。“把我的妹妹还给我，你们这些混蛋！”
rows.raw: '\n\nYour companion twirls her staff around and levels it at the first of the robed figures, determination in her eyes. "Give me my sister back, you bastards!"'

rows.original: Something tells you you'll have to beat them down to get to her!
rows.translation: 你有种预感，必须先打败他们才能见到她！
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething tells you you'll have to beat them down to get to her!"

rows.original: Tutorial: Control your character in combat by selecting actions from the button menu. You have three special abilities already: an at-will power, a power that recharges after a few turns, and one power that can only be used once per encounter. Use them strategically to overcome enemies! A character's Health is represented by the red bar around their portrait. If that reaches zero, that character is defeated and can no longer act. If [pc.name] is defeated, combat ends... but that's rarely the end of things. After each combat, you regenerate half of any Health lost in that fight.

rows.original: Tutorial: In addition to Health your character has a green Experience bar next to his or her icon, and a Threat Gem in the upper right corner of the character card. The Threat Gem determines how likely a character is to be attacked by the A.I.: the redder it gets, the more likely attacks are to target the character. More powerful attacks and healing abilities generate more Threat! You can supercede your companions' A.I. by taking manual control — either in individual fights, or globally from the options menu. Left to their own devices, companions will use the same Threat system as the enemies do. In addition to the two meters and Threat Gem, there's also room in the character card for Status Effects. Green effects are beneficial; red effects are negative. You can hover over the icons (or tap them on mobile) to see tooltips about what they do! Most enemies are also vulnerable to various forms of mental damage, tease amongst them. From this fight onwards, teasing is a tool that is at your disposal!

rows.translation: 那位身着长袍的女子无力地指向上方，让你的视线越过山坡，望向山顶那座耸立着的废墟。在它的上方，即便在冬季风暴的呼啸声中，你也能清晰地看到——一轮血红色的满月高悬在天空中。这是一轮血月，而这场冬季风暴却来得格外反常。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robed woman points weakly upwards, drawing your eyes across the hillside, to the looming ruin at its peak. Above it, even through the howling gale of the winter storm blasting overhead, you can see as clear as day the moon shining in a perfect, radiant red circle high overhead. A blood moon, and a winter storm far out of season. "

rows.original: Something very wrong is going on here.
rows.translation: 这里肯定发生了什么不对劲的事情。
rows.raw: " Something very wrong is going on here."

rows.original: You're no mage, but even you can tell that's not good.
rows.translation: 你虽然不是法师，但就连你也能看出，那情况不太妙。
rows.raw: "You're no mage, but even you can tell that's not good."

rows.original: "We have to save her," Cait breathes, looking to the sky as you do. "They're going to..."
rows.translation: “我们必须救她，”凯特也抬头望向天空，就像你一样。“他们打算……”
rows.raw: '\n\n"We have to save her," Cait breathes, looking to the sky as you do. "They\'re going to..." '

rows.original: You nod. "We'll get her back. Come on."
rows.translation: 你点了点头。“我们会把她找回来的。快走吧。”
rows.raw: '\n\nYou nod. "We\'ll get her back. Come on." '

rows.original: One good kick leaves the hooded cultist unconscious on the ground. You and Cait turn to the path ahead, running forward as fast as you can. You can only hope you're not too late.
rows.translation: 一记有力的踢击使得那个戴着兜帽的邪教徒昏倒在地。你和凯特立刻转向前方的道路，以最快的速度奔跑起来。你们只能希望自己还不算太晚。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne good kick leaves the hooded cultist unconscious on the ground. You and Cait turn to the path ahead, running forward as fast as you can. You can only hope you're not too late."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You and Cait draw near to the doors of the towering stone structure. This must be the temple the cultist told you of, though it looks like it hasn't seen service in decades. The wind is howling up here, battering you and your feline partner with snow and shards of frigid wind that bites down to your bones. A pair of stone gargoyles loom overhead, weathered and worn by centuries of neglect, barely visible as shadows high above on the crumbling archways. From inside, past the ruined doors barely clinging to their titanic hinges, you can hear chanting... and a woman's cries. "That's Calla!" Cait breathes, turning to you and grabbing your hand. "We're in time! Come on!" She charges headlong through the doors. All you manage to say is "Wait-" before you're dragged along behind her. Cait's got no patience left. You follow her at a run through the temple's entranceway, and into a vast chamber that might once have been a magnificent place of worship. Now it's a stone-walled square filled with rubble from a caved-in ceiling, flush with crumbling rock and marble. A dozen black-robed figures stand in a circle with arms upraised, facing the center of the chamber, and a broad marble altar. On the altar is a naked, insensate cat-girl with her wrists tied by leather straps. Her chest heaves with heavy breath, shaking a pair of succulent pale mounds atop it. Blonde hair laced with purple dye spills down in wild curls around her jaw and over her colorful ears, mussed and flecked with dirt. Calla, no doubt about it — the resemblance is uncanny. Above her is a single man out of the circle, clutching a bladed staff in one hand, and a vial in the other. Pink residue clings to its lips, and at a glance, to Calla's as well — they've drugged her! The man turns from her and raises his hands aloft, shouting to the heavens, "My dark lady, we give this offering with lust and passion unbound! Her purity, her heart and soul, are yours! Come, take them, and show us your blessing!" You look up, following his exultant gaze. A swirling purple-pink portal flares with eldritch light above the altar, a plane of energy as flat against the air as a sheet of parchment, and wide enough for a man to step through. It's a tear in the very fabric of your world, pulsating with arcane power beyond even your wildest imaginings. The whole chamber is illuminated by the throbs and contractions of the gaping gash in the air, flashing brilliant shades of pink and luscious purples that catch on the musky clouds of incense boiling out of burners swinging from the walls. Despite the frigid winds blasting outside, the temple sanctum feels unnaturally warm and damp — and your body feels the same way in turn, an unbidden heat spreading through your flesh. Cait seems to feel the same way, and a glance shows her cheeks flushed red, and a pair of small points poking out from the chest of her skin-tight robes. Even the imminent danger and the nearness to the kidnapping madmen can't suppress the portal's lustful effects on you. What in the world have you stumbled into?
rows.translation: 你和凯特缓缓靠近那座高耸的石砌建筑的大门。这应该就是那个邪教徒跟你提到的寺庙吧，不过看样子它已经几十年没有被人使用过了。这里的风呼啸着，将雪花和刺骨的寒风裹挟在一起，不断地袭击着你和你的猫科伙伴，那些寒风仿佛能直接刺入你的骨头。一对石制滴水嘴高悬在头顶上方，经过几个世纪的忽视，它们已经风化磨损，几乎变成了高高的拱门上那些难以辨认的阴影。从内部望去，那些几乎无法固定在巨大铰链上的破碎门扉之后，你能听到诵经声。还有女人的哭声。 那是卡拉！凯特轻声说道，转身握住了你的手。我们来得正是时候！快走吧！ 她冲着大门猛地冲了进去。你所能说的只有等等——你被她拖着走。凯特已经没有耐心了。你跟着她跑过寺庙的入口，进入了一个巨大的大厅——这里曾经可能是一个宏伟的礼拜场所，但现在却变成了一个四周被石墙围起来的空地，地上堆满了因天花板坍塌而落下来的碎石和大理石碎片。十几名身着黑袍的身影围成一圈，双臂高举，面朝大厅中央以及那座宽大的大理石祭坛。 祭坛上躺着一名赤裸不堪、失去意识的猫女，她的手腕被皮革带子紧紧绑住。她的胸膛剧烈地起伏着，那一对饱满而苍白的乳房也随之晃动。金色的头发中掺杂着紫色的染料，卷曲着垂落在她的下颌旁，也覆盖着她那双色彩斑斓的耳朵，显得有些凌乱，还带着些灰尘。毫无疑问，她就是卡拉——这种相似之处实在令人难以置信。在她上方，有一个人独自站在圈子之外，一只手握着一把带刃的法杖，另一只手则拿着一小瓶药水。粉红色的残留物粘在她的嘴唇上，一眼看去，卡拉的嘴唇上也有一样——他们给她下了药！ 那个男人转过身去，双手高举，向着天空大声呼喊。我的暗影女神，我们怀着无拘无束的欲望与热情献上这份祭品！她的纯洁、她的心灵，都属于您！来吧，接纳它们，让我们感受到您的恩赐吧！ 你抬头望去，顺着他那充满兴奋的目光看去。 在祭坛上方，一个旋转着的紫粉色光门绽放出诡异的光芒，那道能量平面平整地悬浮在空气中，就像一张羊皮纸一样，宽度足以让一个人穿过。这是你所在世界的结构中出现的一道裂痕，其中涌动的神秘力量超出了你最疯狂的想象。整个房间都被这道裂痕散发出的光芒照亮，那些闪烁的粉色与紫色光芒，与从墙壁上悬挂的燃烧器中散发出来的芬芳烟雾交织在一起，构成了一幅令人叹为观止的景象。 尽管外面刮着刺骨的寒风，寺庙的内殿却显得异常温暖而潮湿——你的身体也感受到了同样的变化，一股不由自主的热量在你的体内蔓延开来。凯特似乎也有同样的感觉，瞥了她一眼，你会发现她的脸颊已经涨得通红，而她那紧身长袍的领口处，还有两颗小尖点微微凸了出来。即便是迫在眉睫的危险，以及那些绑架狂人的逼近，也无法抑制这个传送门对你产生的诱惑作用。 你究竟闯入了什么地方？

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Leave her alone!" you shout, stepping forward and brandishing your weapon. Cait steps up beside you, giving a slight nod and swinging her staff to bear, letting its jeweled crown surge with radiant light. The cultists turn in surprise, gasping and cursing, but nobody draws a weapon. Instead, they part, making way for the hooded ritualist to come and stand before you. His staff is clasped in both hands now, the blade driven through the tip glistening in the eldritch light from above. "Welcome, welcome indeed," he says with a smile, pulling down his black hood to reveal a bald pate covered in intricate runic tattoos: arcane symbols of some kind, twisting and writhing across his flesh with every twitch of his muscles. "I was told we might be expecting... unexpected guests this evening. I am Master Tollus, humble high priest of this sacrifice. Please, take a seat,
rows.translation: 别打扰她！你大声呼喊着，向前冲去，同时挥舞着武器。凯特走到你身边，微微点头，然后挥动她的法杖，使得法杖上镶嵌的宝石散发出耀眼的光芒。 那些邪教徒们惊讶地转过身来，发出惊呼声和咒骂声，但没有人拔出武器。相反，他们让开了道路，让那个戴着兜帽的仪式主持人走到你面前。他现在双手紧握着法杖，法杖的尖端插着一把刀刃，在上方投下的诡异光芒中闪闪发光。 欢迎，真是太欢迎了。他微笑着说道，同时拉下了黑色的兜帽，露出了光秃秃的头顶——上面布满了复杂的符文纹身：那些神秘的符号随着他肌肉的每一阵收缩而在皮肤上扭曲、蠕动。有人告诉我，今晚我们可能会遇到一些……意想不到的客人。我是托勒斯大师，这场仪式的首席祭司。请坐，
