rows.translation: 话音刚落，尤斯拉的嘴角就展开了笑容，而那个调皮捣蛋的猫人男孩的眼睛也亮了起来。毫无疑问，他之前已经被问过很多次这个问题了，而且非常乐意讲述这个故事。不过，形式总归是要走的，而显然，他对此感到非常开心。 “怎么，一个马拉克信徒戴着这种东西很奇怪吗？这是一种癖好，有些人确实有，你知道的，甚至有人专门来寺庙要求这个。” 嗯，这些笼子以前确实被用来作为……非传统的惩罚手段。你本人认识某个这样的人。 [etheryn.isCaged |拥有 |拥有过 ]陷入这样的困境，被一个刻薄的姐姐逼迫进入这样的牢笼，真是太不幸了。 这绝对不是尤斯拉所期望的——他的笑容消失了，取而代之的是一脸严肃的忧虑，他把尾巴卷起来，开始摆弄它。“真是不幸，我对你的朋友深表同情。话虽如此，我的处境远没有那么令人不快。” 你示意他继续说下去。 “我是自愿选择这样做的——这更类似于娜瑞瓦人会立下的那种沉默誓言，他们在誓言生效的整个期间都不会说一句话。这里也是一样——我只不过发下了一个类似的誓言，承诺在今年的年底之前，或者更长时间内，不通过自己的阴茎获得快感，之后我再决定是继续坚持这个誓言，还是让人把它取下来。” 不过，为什么要这样做呢？ “你听说过‘距离产生感情’这句话吗？” “听过……” “就是这么回事；如果你真的感兴趣，可以另外问我关于其中蕴含的神学问题。我想，这也正是我能够被选中执行这次侦察任务的原因之一吧，因为某个人大概觉得，如果把那话儿遮起来，恶魔就碰不到我的蛋了之类的。我觉得，那些人读的特洛纳里浪漫故事实在太多了——在农村地区，有些女性真的会戴上贞操带，以免被四处劫掠的兽人或半人马强奸。说实话，我觉得那没什么用；不过，关于恶魔孽种的故事实在太多了，所以他们大概觉得有备无患吧。” 总之，他那根猫咪鸡巴是派不上用场了，对吧？ “既是也不是。我发下的誓言是要克制我自己，而不是要求别人，所以如果需要的话，笼子上挂着一盏幽灵灯。”尤斯拉翻了个白眼，笑了笑，然后摇了摇头。“这就是寺庙的逻辑，某种程度上也确实有道理。仅仅因为我想克制自己的冲动，并不意味着其他人也必须这样做。给这东西施了魔法的牧师们知道自己在做什么——据我所知，它应对起动作来就跟我什么都没穿一样，所以不用担心这个。” 那么，如果他愿意的话，他能自己取下那个“贞洁笼子”吗，还是必须去某个特定的地方才能把它取下来？ “后者更符合这件事的精神，而我最初也是这么选的。不过，和从事安慰男孩那一行的人不同，我的工作中可能会出现一些意想不到的情况，所以那个方案被驳回了；必要时我确实知道该怎么把它取下来。关键在于‘必要时’这个说法——毕竟神圣的誓言就是要遵守的，如果我这么做了，那我最好能有一个真正充分的理由。” 不然呢？ 他点了点头，然后吐了吐舌头对着你说：“不然的话……我就不多说了。毕竟神圣的誓言这个话题有点敏感，如果你不介意的话。” 好吧，既然他非要这样，那也许你可以聊点别的。 [party.has cait |“嘿，放轻松点，你们两个，”凯特说着，轮流调皮地用肘子轻推了推你们俩。“没必要互相闹脾气——[pc.name]，没必要逼问尤斯拉；而尤斯拉，[pc.name]显然只是在逗你，所以没必要为此耍性子、闹脾气。” “你怎么对尤斯拉的笼子这么感兴趣？你也想给自己弄一个吗？ [pc.cockSNVH |等贾西拉人的队伍到了，我们或许能给你弄一个；我可以非常客气地求他们 |别以为有什么笼子能装得下你，那种尺寸的笼子根本不存在。大多数笼子都是为那些阴茎尺寸很小的猫人男孩设计的 |我可绝不会想着把那漂亮东西遮起来——反正他们也不会有适合你的尺寸，嘻嘻 |别以为有什么笼子能装得下你，那种尺寸的笼子根本不存在。大多数笼子都是为那些阴茎尺寸很小的猫人男孩设计的 ]。” ]
rows.raw: " No sooner have the words left your mouth that Yusra's smile widens, and the bratty catboy's eyes glint. No doubt he's been asked this question many times before, and is more than willing to tell the tale. Still, one has to go through the motions, and it's something that he obviously takes great delight in. "Why, is it strange to see a Mallachite with one of these? It is a kink some have, you know, enough that some come to the temple to ask for it specifically." Well, these cages have been used as... unorthodox punishments before. You personally know someone who [etheryn.isCaged |has |had ] the misfortune to be stuck in such a situation, caught in such a cage imposed by an abusive sister. That certainly isn't what Yusra was expecting — his smile vanishes, replaced by a look of serious consternation as he curls his tail around and fiddles with it. "Unfortunate, and my commiserations for your friend. That being said, my situation is nowhere near as distasteful." You motion for him to go on. "I put this on voluntarily — it's more akin to one of those vows of silence that Narevans take, where they don't say a word for as long as the vow lasts. So's the same thing here — I simply undertook a vow of sorts to not receive pleasure through my prick until the end of this year or more, then I can choose whether to continue or have it removed." Why, though? "Have you heard the saying, 'absence makes the heart grow fonder'?" Yes... "That's the long and short of it; you can ask me about the theology separately if you're that interested. I guess it also helped me wind up picked for this scouting assignment, since someone probably figured that the demons wouldn't be getting to my balls or something if I had them covered up. Too many Tronariian romances for those folks, I think — their women sometimes actually put on chastity belts in the rural areas to avoid getting raped by marauding orcs and centaurs. I don't really think it helps, to be honest; nevertheless, there're enough stores about demonic spawn that I guess they decided better safe than sorry." So long story short, no usage of his kitty-prick for him. Is that right? "Yes and no. I'm supposed to be depriving myself with my vow, not others, so there's a ghostlight attached to the cage should I need it." Yusra rolls his eyes, grins, and shakes his head. "That's temple logic for you, and in a way it makes sense. Just because I want to restrain my own passions doesn't mean others have to join me. The clerics who enchanted this thing knew what they were doing — as far as I can tell, it handles the motions just as if I weren't wearing anything, so don't worry about it." So, can he take off his chastity cage if he wanted to, or does he have to go somewhere special to have it removed? "The latter would be more in the spirit of the thing, and that's what I originally opted for. Then again, unforeseen circumstances can crop up in my line of work as opposed to that of a comfort boy, so I got denied for that; I do know how to remove it if necessary. If necessary is the key phrase here — holy vows are made to be kept, and if I do so I'd better have a really good reason." Or else? He nods and sticks his tongue out at you. "Or else. Not saying any more, holy vows are kind of a touchy subject, if you don't mind." Well, fine, if he's going to be that way. Maybe you can talk about something else. "There's no need to get grumpy with each other — [pc.name], there's no need to push Yusra, and Yusra, [pc.name] was clearly ribbing you, so there's no need to get all bratty and pouty about it. rows.original: "That's an old question that goes back more than two hundred years, really. They were asking it back in the day, too — if the gods are that powerful, why did they need us to fight and die in the Godswar? Why couldn't they, after having manifested themselves, clean up everything on their own? "The common knowledge from our tales of the time is that when they do personally intervene, there tends to be a lot of collateral damage, which is why they're loathe to extend themselves personally — it would be like trying to use a metal strut to darn a sock. We're able to act in smaller, finer ways." But you know that, say, Mallach's aware of the situation. If it got bad enough, he'd intervene himself, presumably? "Presumably. But it'd have to get a lot worse before the scales tipped enough for such action to be warranted. That, and I believe there's value in fighting our own fights where possible — it's only when the threat truly overcomes our ability to fight back that they should step in, I feel. "The gods can't do everything for us, [pc.name]. Well, not so much can't as shouldn't — we need to do things for ourselves, sort out our differences, and clean up our own messes. I suppose they could order everyone to stop all strife and war... but that wouldn't change anything deep down, would it? And let's be honest... would you want to live under such an edict? To live under peace, or else? Or would you prefer that they alter all of our minds so that strife and war are impossible? Would you want to have that part of you cut out altogether? Which do you think is more powerful, to be dependent on someone, or to willingly be with that person despite having the ability to walk away? Why do the gods allow evils to befall us? "Sure, they're here to catch us if we fall... but they're not going to stop us from falling in the first place. Suffering is a kind of passion in its own right, and it has its uses in teaching us valuable lessons. We'd grow too reliant on the gods if they solved all our problems on the surface, and yet nothing would really change. Since you asked, those are my thoughts on the matter." All right, then. But that leads into the next question: if the gods are there to ensure victory over this new threat at the end of the day, then it would be reasonable to ask if there would be any point in anyone doing anything, or making more than a token show of force? "Well, I believe that's the wrong way to look at it. Think about it another way: you and I, our efforts against the demons — do they actually mean anything when the hosts of Lumia, Mallach, and the other gods will eventually arrive to save the day? If they're coming eventually and clean up everything, then one might be tempted to say that nothing one does right now matters since the day is going to be saved anyway, and sit on one's hands, right?" But that isn't the case. You have other stakes in this as well. Yusra nods. "That's part of it, yes. There's the old rhyme 'for want of a nail' — our actions, though they may seem small and insignificant, may have important consequences down the line that we may not even know of. The knowledge that I'm to gather as part of my mission here, it'll be important to the host when it finally arrives, to engage the enemy in an intelligent manner. That's the point of a scout, after all. "And let's not forget that you and I, we're in the here and now while it'll take the hosts months to march up here to the roof of the world. We're able to act on the situation now... that's important. By the time our backup arrives, it'll be too late for too many people. Are the people saved due to the actions of one person insignificant compared to the entire populace of the region? Those you save certainly don't think so." For want of a nail... even if you assume that the hosts will be able to bring down the threat of Kas on her own, it can be more or less painful depending on what you do and don't do in this time. A cheeky smile. "Now you're beginning to get it, aren't you? Not that you need to agree, but it looks like you understand where I'm coming from. I don't know about you, but I do think we can make a difference — it doesn't need to be a big or earth-shattering one by comparison, but it's no less important to the lives of the people who we touch. I may be but one paladin, but the people I've escorted to and from temples and holy sites were thankful enough for it. "So yes. There are other forces at work here that dwarf you and I on our lonesome, I don't doubt. Still, that doesn't make us irrelevant or unneeded — it's all a matter of scale, you see. We're able to act fast, and get to the small details which might be missed in the scuffle. "Yes, it's true that we may feel smaller in comparison to gods or great armies. Still, that doesn't make our struggle here meaningless, or that we can just fold our hands and snooze on the job even if we think it'll get done nonetheless. The Tronariians have a saying that fate might be inevitable, but how we get there isn't — there can be a lot of needless suffering along the way, not the constructive kind — and we can do a lot about that. Does that answer your question? Well, if it doesn't, I don't have anything more."
rows.translation: 这其实是一个由来已久的古老问题，它的历史可以追溯到两百多年前。在那个时候，人们也在追问：如果神明真的那么强大，为什么还需要我们参加神战，为它们而战、为它们而死呢？既然它们已经显现出来，为什么不能自己解决所有问题呢？ “根据我们当时流传的故事，人们普遍认为，当神明确实亲自出面干预时，往往会带来大量附带伤害，因此他们很不愿意亲自介入——这就好比试图用一根金属支柱来修补一只袜子一样。我们能够以更细致、更巧妙的方式来进行处理。但是你知道，比如说，马拉克应该已经意识到了这种情况。如果情况变得足够糟糕，他很可能会亲自介入，对吧？” “大概吧。但情况必须变得糟糕到一定程度，才会使得他觉得有必要采取行动。除此之外，我认为在可能的情况下，我们应该自己努力解决问题——只有当威胁真正超出了我们的应对能力时，他们才应该介入。 “神明不可能为我们包办一切。[pc.name]嗯，与其说不能，不如说是不应该——我们自己必须采取行动，解决彼此之间的分歧，清理自己造成的混乱。我想他们或许可以命令所有人停止所有的争斗和战争……但那样并不能从根本上改变任何问题，对吧？说实话……你愿意生活在这样的法令之下吗？是选择和平生活，还是其他方式？又或者，你希望他们改变我们的思想，让冲突与战争变得不可能发生？你愿意彻底舍弃自己内心中的那一部分吗？你认为，哪种方式更强大：依赖他人，还是即使有能力离开，也依然选择留在那个人身边？为什么神明要允许邪恶降临到我们身上呢？ 当然，它们会在我们跌落时抓住我们……但它们根本无法阻止我们坠落。痛苦本身也是一种激情，它在教会我们宝贵经验方面发挥着作用。如果神明能轻易解决我们所有表面上的问题，我们就会过于依赖它们，而实际上什么也不会真正改变。既然你问了，这些就是我对此事的看法。 好吧，那么这就引出了下一个问题：如果神明的存在本来就是为了确保我们在面对这一新威胁时能够取得胜利，那么我们就有理由去思考：人们究竟还有必要付出实际行动，或者不仅仅是做做样子来展示自己的力量吗？ 嗯，我认为这种看法是错误的。换个角度想吧：你和我，我们为对抗那些恶魔所付出的努力，当卢米娅的主人、马拉克以及其他神明最终降临来拯救这个世界时，这些努力真的还有意义吗？如果他们最终会来并解决所有问题，那么人们可能会觉得，现在自己所做的任何努力其实都无关紧要，因为反正结局都会被改变，于是就选择什么都不做，对吧？ 但事实并非如此。你在这件事中也有着其他的利益关联。 尤斯拉点了点头：“没错，这也是其中的一部分。有句老话叫‘失之毫厘，差之千里’——我们的行为虽然看起来微不足道，但日后可能会产生一些我们甚至无法预知的重大影响。而我在此次任务中所要收集的信息，对于最终成功吸引敌人、以明智的方式与之对抗来说，将会起到至关重要的作用。毕竟，侦察员的职责就是这样的。 而且我们千万不要忘记，现在你我身处当下，而那些救援人员却需要花费数月的时间才能赶到这个世界之巅。我们现在就有能力采取行动……这一点非常重要。等到我们的后备力量赶到时，对太多人来说已经为时太晚了。对于整个地区而言，一个人所采取的行动所带来的拯救效果，难道真的微不足道吗？那些被你拯救下来的人，肯定不这么认为。 正所谓“失之东隅，收之桑榆”……即使你认为那些主持人能够独自消除卡希带来的威胁，但在这段时间里，你采取的行动与否，都会对最终结果产生或多或少的影响。 她露出一个俏皮的微笑：“现在你开始明白我的意思了吧？虽然你不一定同意我的观点，但看起来你至少理解我的立场了。我不知道你是怎么想的，但我确实认为我们能够带来一些改变——这种改变不一定非得是巨大而震撼性的，但对于那些因此而受到帮助的人们来说，它的意义同样重要。我或许只是个微不足道的小人物，但那些我陪同他们前往寺庙和圣地的人们，他们对我的帮助确实心存感激。 “所以，没错。就是这样。我毫不怀疑，这里还有其他一些力量在起作用，它们的影响力远远超过了你我这样的个体。不过，这并不意味着我们毫无作用或被忽视——关键在于规模的不同罢了。我们能够迅速采取行动，去关注那些在混乱中可能会被忽略的细节。 是的，与神明或强大的军队相比，我们确实可能会感到自己微不足道。但即便如此，这也并不意味着我们在这里的努力是毫无意义的，更不意味着我们可以坐视不理、无所作为，就认为事情最终还是会有人去完成。特罗纳里安人有一句谚语：命运或许难以避免，但通往命运的道路并非如此——在这段旅程中，往往会伴随着许多不必要的痛苦，而这些痛苦并非具有建设性的意义——而我们完全可以在这些方面采取行动。这样回答你的问题，可以吗？嗯，如果不行的话，我就没有什么别的办法了。
rows.raw: " "That's an old question that goes back more than two hundred years, really. They were asking it back in the day, too — if the gods are that powerful, why did they need us to fight and die in the Godswar? Why couldn't they, after having manifested themselves, clean up everything on their own? "The common knowledge from our tales of the time is that when they do personally intervene, there tends to be a lot of collateral damage, which is why they're loathe to extend themselves personally — it would be like trying to use a metal strut to darn a sock. We're able to act in smaller, finer ways." But you know that, say, Mallach's aware of the situation. If it got bad enough, he'd intervene himself, presumably? "Presumably. But it'd have to get a lot worse before the scales tipped enough for such action to be warranted. That, and I believe there's value in fighting our own fights where possible — it's only when the threat truly overcomes our ability to fight back that they should step in, I feel. "The gods can't do everything for us, [pc.name]. Well, not so much can't as shouldn't — we need to do things for ourselves, sort out our differences, and clean up our own messes. I suppose they could order everyone to stop all strife and war... but that wouldn't change anything deep down, would it? And let's be honest... would you want to live under such an edict? To live under peace, or else? Or would you prefer that they alter all of our minds so that strife and war are impossible? Would you want to have that part of you cut out altogether? Which do you think is more powerful, to be dependent on someone, or to willingly be with that person despite having the ability to walk away? Why do the gods allow evils to befall us? "Sure, they're here to catch us if we fall... but they're not going to stop us from falling in the first place. Suffering is a kind of passion in its own right, and it has its uses in teaching us valuable lessons. We'd grow too reliant on the gods if they solved all our problems on the surface, and yet nothing would really change. Since you asked, those are my thoughts on the matter." All right, then. But that leads into the next question: if the gods are there to ensure victory over this new threat at the end of the day, then it would be reasonable to ask if there would be any point in anyone doing anything, or making more than a token show of force? "Well, I believe that's the wrong way to look at it. Think about it another way: you and I, our efforts against the demons — do they actually mean anything when the hosts of Lumia, Mallach, and the other gods will eventually arrive to save the day? If they're coming eventually and clean up everything, then one might be tempted to say that nothing one does right now matters since the day is going to be saved anyway, and sit on one's hands, right?" But that isn't the case. You have other stakes in this as well. Yusra nods. "That's part of it, yes. There's the old rhyme 'for want of a nail' — our actions, though they may seem small and insignificant, may have important consequences down the line that we may not even know of. The knowledge that I'm to gather as part of my mission here, it'll be important to the host when it finally arrives, to engage the enemy in an intelligent manner. That's the point of a scout, after all. "And let's not forget that you and I, we're in the here and now while it'll take the hosts months to march up here to the roof of the world. We're able to act on the situation now... that's important. By the time our backup arrives, it'll be too late for too many people. Are the people saved due to the actions of one person insignificant compared to the entire populace of the region? Those you save certainly don't think so." For want of a nail... even if you assume that the hosts will be able to bring down the threat of Kas on her own, it can be more or less painful depending on what you do and don't do in this time. A cheeky smile. "Now you're beginning to get it, aren't you? Not that you need to agree, but it looks like you understand where I'm coming from. I don't know about you, but I do think we can make a difference — it doesn't need to be a big or earth-shattering one by comparison, but it's no less important to the lives of the people who we touch. I may be but one paladin, but the people I've escorted to and from temples and holy sites were thankful enough for it. "So yes. There are other forces at work here that dwarf you and I on our lonesome, I don't doubt. Still, that doesn't make us irrelevant or unneeded — it's all a matter of scale, you see. We're able to act fast, and get to the small details which might be missed in the scuffle. "Yes, it's true that we may feel smaller in comparison to gods or great armies. Still, that doesn't make our struggle here meaningless, or that we can just fold our hands and snooze on the job even if we think it'll get done nonetheless. The Tronariians have a saying that fate might be inevitable, but how we get there isn't — there can be a lot of needless suffering along the way, not the constructive kind — and we can do a lot about that. Does that answer your question? Well, if it doesn't, I don't have anything more." "

rows.translation: 动作

rows.original: It's just a little odd, that's all. The stories about Jassirite Mallachites which filter out into the wider world tell of dusky-skinned cat-women with wide eyes and faces hidden behind veils, after which everything goes off for the moonlit orgies by the waterside. That makes sense as a demonstration of passion, not the opposite. To have Mallach teaching to rein in one's desires — " — When appropriate," Yusra says, cutting into your sentence. "That's the important thing, when appropriate. No doubt the temple matron has already given you the official temple stance on consent and not going around raping people, but there's more to it than that." Such as? The catboy licks his lips and considers his answer before giving it to you. "Well, let's begin with a purely practical answer. [pc.name]... one of the less well-known services the Temple offers in the richer parts of Jassira is treatment for overindulgence. Did you know that?" Cait's never mentioned it before, no. "I'm not surprised, it's even more embarrassing than some diseases people can catch from each other, and just in need of a cure. Anyways, sex, drink, drugs, and kind of pleasure — it happens most amongst people who've just come into new money, but don't have the traditions of restraint the old money have. For example, people who've suddenly succeeded in business and have money to spend on pleasures they've never had before. "Without moderation, the novelty of indulgence soon wears off, and those poor fools just don't recapture that first rush by doing the same old thing over and over again. Their ability to feel passion soon burns out, and they need more, more, more to even get but a pale image of that first high. Eventually, it ends up killing them, whether it's more direct like a drug overdose, or less obvious circumstances — and this is why Mallach teaches temperance even if he is the Prince of Passion." Can't be passionate if you're dead. "Dead... that's arguably being better than a burnt-out husk. But yes, it's the long and short of it — even if you're not particularly pious, even if you don't think it'll hurt anyone else, you want to restrain yourself in your passions so that you can continue to appreciate the indulgences you do partake of. Over enough time, you experience more passion in a healthier manner than otherwise, which pleases our prince." So that's what led him to put a chastity cage on himself? "One of the reasons, my friend. Have you ever held it in for a week? A month? Two?" Yusra flashes you a mischievous smile. "I'm expecting that it will be quite impressive when it's finally time to remove this cage and I do get off from my prick again. Hunger is the best spice, and people fast to remind themselves of the importance of food, amongst other things. Being pent-up is an excellent driver of passion... and I'm sure you can guess the rest. "It's not so strange an idea, really. Ordinary people fast to remind themselves of the importance of food, and to be able to understand in some small way how those who don't have any feel. Some sects of Narevans eschew magic for long periods of time to understand how important it is to our lives; the same goes for some extreme Sorran cults who willingly sell themselves into indentured servitude for months at a time. Periods of willing abstinence in the right frame of mind can teach us much and help us empathise with others, even if we think sympathy isn't warranted at the end of it all." Yes, yes, you think he's made his point well enough. "Either way, I hope I've shed some light on why the Jassirite traditions do teach temperance after a form. You come to the temple to sate your passions, and then return home to reflect on the wonders you've tasted. Like bars that won't serve a drunk, temples are obligated to not offer their services to those who overindulge. That's one of the main differences between us and the whorehouses foreigners like to compare us to."
rows.translation: 只是有点奇怪而已。那些流传到外界的关于贾西拉人特·马拉克信徒的故事，描述的是那些皮肤黝黑、眼睛大而美丽的女性，她们的面容总是被面纱遮住，之后她们就会在月光下来到水边参加狂欢聚会。将这视为一种表达激情的方式，确实很有道理，而不是相反。让马拉克来教导人们如何控制自己的欲望—— “——在适当的时候，”尤斯拉插话道，“这才是关键，要在适当的时候这么做。毫无疑问，寺庙的女管理者已经向你们说明了寺庙对于同意事项的官方立场，也就是不会随意强奸他人，但事情其实还有更复杂的一面。 比如什么呢？ 猫人男孩舔了舔嘴唇，仔细考虑了一下才回答你。那么，我们就从一个非常实际的答案开始吧。[pc.name]在贾西拉较富裕的地区，神庙提供的那些不太为人所知的服务中，就有治疗过度放纵的行为。你知道这个吗？” “凯特以前从未提过这件事，是啊。” “我并不感到意外，这种问题甚至比某些会通过人际传播的疾病还要尴尬，确实需要有人来提供解决办法。总之，性、酒、毒品以及各种享乐行为，大多发生在那些刚刚赚到一大笔钱，却还没有老一辈人那种节制传统的人身上。比如那些在商业上突然取得成功、有钱去享受那些以前从未体验过的享乐的人。 如果不加以节制，放纵带来的新鲜感很快就会消失。那些可怜的人之所以无法重新体验最初的那种兴奋感，只是因为他们一直在重复同样的事情。他们感受激情的能力很快就会耗尽，于是他们需要越来越多的东西，才能勉强获得那种最初兴奋感的微弱残影。最终，这种行为会害了他们——无论是像药物过量那样直接致命，还是通过一些不那么明显的方式……正因如此，即使马拉克是‘激情王子’，他仍然倡导节制。 如果已经死了，就无法拥有激情了。 “死了……或许反而比变成一个空壳要好。但事实就是如此——即使你并不特别虔诚，即使你认为自己的行为不会伤害到别人，你也应该控制自己的激情，这样才能继续享受那些你所追求的东西。长此以往，你会以一种更健康的方式体验激情，而这也正是我们王子所希望看到的。 所以，这就是他为什么要给自己戴上这种“贞操笼”的原因吗？一原因之一就是这个，我的朋友。你有没有试过忍一个星期？一个月？甚至两个月？”尤斯拉坏笑着看着你。“我敢打赌，当终于可以摘下这个‘笼子’，重新自由行动的时候，效果一定会非常显著。饥饿才是最好的催化剂，人们通过禁食来提醒自己食物的重要性，以及其他许多事情。被束缚住反而会激发人们强烈的欲望……剩下的你应该也能猜到吧。 其实，这个想法并不奇怪。普通人通过斋戒来提醒自己食物的重要性，从而能够在某种程度上理解那些没有食物的人的处境。纳雷万的一些教派会长时间放弃使用魔法，以此来体会魔法对我们生活的重要性；同样，一些极端的索拉教派也会自愿让自己沦为奴隶，忍受数月的奴役生活，以此来领悟某些道理。在正确的心态下，有意识地选择节制某些行为，其实能让我们学到很多东西，也能帮助我们更好地理解他人。即使到最后我们觉得并没有必要表现出同情心，这样的经历依然很有意义。 没错，你认为他已经把观点表达得足够清楚了。” “无论如何，我希望我能够解释清楚为什么贾西拉人特的传统会强调节制。人们来到寺庙是为了宣泄自己的情感，然后回家后反思那些自己所体验到的美好事物。就像那些不会为醉汉提供服务的酒吧一样，寺庙也有责任不向那些沉溺于过度享乐的人提供服务。这就是我们与那些外国人喜欢将我们与妓院相提并论的地方之间的主要区别之一。

rows.original: Yusra's most familiar with the Jassirite way of doing things, but he's traveled a bit in the course of pilgrim escort, hasn't he? He must've visited temples from all over — can he tell you something of their practices? Sure, Jassirans are well known as the most ardent worshippers of the Prince of Passion, but even if he doesn't have outright dominance in other places he's still worshipped well enough. You'd like to hear something of how his patron deity is revered in different cultures. "Well... so long as you understand what I'm about to tell you probably isn't the big picture. I've only traveled to places on this continent, and never really stayed between pilgrim escorts that long to get a grip on the local temple practices. That being said, if you're still interested, I can tell you something of what I've seen." If he wouldn't mind. Knowing something is better than knowing nothing, after all. Yusra flashes you a grin and tips his head, folding his ears forward. "Mm-hm. I think the one that stuck with me the most is the week-long music festival that the Baranians were having while I just happened to be there, courtesy of the local temple. Music in the streets, free admission to the theatres — the temple outright runs them over there — and plenty of merriment to go around. There wasn't just the local sheepfolk music, it was enough of a deal that musicians from the neighboring city-states made the trip to play as well. "Music, a bit of sculpture, plenty of street food and drink, and of course, fucking in the temples' back rooms. Excellent people the sheepfolk are — they really go out of their way to please you, and their politeness is genuine. Can't recommend it enough. There's no fixed date, but it happens in mid-autumn, so if you ever want to go there then that's when you should be aiming for. Even without the festival, they're very big on music in Barania as an art form, which I do enjoy. It's nice to be reminded that despite the dangers of the wilderness and the fact that much of old Belhar is still plagued by its past, there're places peaceful and prosperous enough to put on a large-scale festival of the arts like that. Do you know that the Baranian temple actually sends its acolytes out to sweep the streets and keep them clean? They make a whole ritual of it and are especially proud to do a lot of it during the festival." Well. Any other places he's been to? "I've never actually been to Kitsuhon myself, but I've spoken to a couple of paladins who have. Their way of doing things is much more decentralised than, say, the Jassirite tradition — each shrine has a lot of autonomy in how the Prince of Passion is revered, even depicted in some places. He's portrayed mostly as a 'nuki there, but the two-tailed catfolk insist on keeping to the more orthodox interpretation of him being a cat, out of sheer contrariness. Of course, since no one can say they're wrong or would even care to begin with, it's not a big deal. What happened? Yusra scratches his chin. "Well... it's a bit of a long story, but since you asked and we have time, there's no harm in telling you. It kind of happened when the local shrine maiden who ran things by her lonesome realized there just weren't enough visitors to the shrine given its poor location, and hence not enough donations for upkeep. Instead of asking for help, the 'nuki went to quite extreme measures." Oh, this should be good. "It was, if it wasn't against our teachings of temperance. Nothing wrong with that in and of itself, but the newfound wealth led to one thing after another and she wound up hanging her ass out for the supplicants to use while she servicing the gloryholes with her hands. "As opposed to Jassira, where the Temple extends itself into the lives of the common people, yes."
rows.translation: 尤斯拉对贾西尔人的行事方式最为熟悉，不过在护送朝圣者的过程中，他也去过一些其他地方，对吧？他肯定参观过全国各地的寺庙——他能告诉你一些关于这些地方祭祀习俗的事情吗？当然可以。贾西尔人以他们是“激情之君”最狂热的崇拜者而闻名，不过即使在其他地方，这位神明也依然受到人们的虔诚敬仰。你肯定想了解一下，这位守护神在不同文化中是如何被人们尊崇的吧。 嗯……只要你能理解我接下来要讲的内容，就应该知道这其实并不是全部真相。我只在这一片大陆上旅行过，也从未在朝圣者的护送队中停留太久，因此无法深入了解当地寺庙的习俗。不过，如果你仍然感兴趣的话，我可以告诉你一些我所见到的事情。 如果他不介意的话。毕竟，知道一些总比一无所知要好。 尤斯拉对你笑了笑，歪了歪头，把耳朵向前凑了凑：“嗯，我觉得最让我印象深刻的是有一次为期一周的音乐节。当时我正好在那个地方，而这次音乐节是由当地的寺庙主办的。街头洋溢着音乐的气息，剧院也免费向公众开放——实际上，是那座神庙在负责运营这些剧院——到处都充满了欢乐的气氛。那里不仅有当地牧羊人的音乐，甚至还有来自邻近城邦的音乐家专程前来表演。 音乐、一些雕塑作品、丰富的街头美食和饮品，当然还有在寺庙的后屋里尽情享受……这些羊群般的人们真是太好了——他们真的会不遗余力地取悦你，他们的礼貌也是发自内心的。我强烈推荐你去。虽然没有固定的日期，但这个活动通常在仲秋时节举行，所以如果你想去的話，最好选择那个时间。即使没有这个节日，巴拉尼亚地区也非常重视音乐这种艺术形式，而我个人也非常喜欢音乐。很高兴有人提醒我们：尽管荒野中充满了危险，而且古老的贝尔哈尔的大部分地区至今仍深受过去遗留问题的困扰，但仍然有一些地方足够宁静繁荣，能够举办如此规模盛大的艺术节。你知道吗，巴拉尼亚的神庙实际上会派他们的信徒们去清扫街道，保持街道的整洁。他们甚至会将这一活动仪式化，而且在节日期间，他们尤其以能够完成大量的清扫工作而感到自豪。 “本来也会很有趣，要不是这违背了我们关于节制的教义。那个女孩把捐款箱所在的区域改成了一个带人体孔的小隔间，然后开始为人们提供这种服务。本身来说这并没有什么不妥，但突如其来的财富让她变得越来越放纵，最终她在为人们提供这种服务时，甚至允许求饶者们利用她自己的身体。甚至还挂了一张标语牌，上面乱涂乱画地写着“请捐款用于精神净化，拯救我们的神社吧！ 从那以后，事情开始逐渐恶化。这座寺庙逐渐荒废了，因为那位女祭司完全沉浸在她所认为的公共服务中，无暇顾及寺庙的维护。我认为，最终导致事情彻底失控的是，当年新年那天，那位女祭司竟然提供了“助孕服务”，结果吸引了方圆数英里内所有有性需求的男人。当那些狐族贵族们的儿子们开始纷纷走向她，被她吸引时，这些贵族们终于受够了。他们于是召集了大家族的长老们，来想办法解决这个问题——因为这位女祭司正在乡间到处勾引男人和双性人，简直太放肆了。当那些圣骑士们赶到时，他们发现她已经处于极度兴奋的状态，完全失去了意识，而现场还有大约三十名来自各个阶层和职位的男子。圣骑士们决定关闭这座寺庙，然后将这位女祭司带回去，让她重新学会节制——显然，她早已忘记了这一点。" 与贾西拉不同吗？ “与贾西拉不同，在那里，神庙真正融入了普通人的生活，是的。

rows.original: "Not that much, to be honest. I understand that he's always had a presence in this part of the world, as do every member of the pantheon — wherever the catfolk were sold off to over the generations, they brought a bit of Jassira with them, even if they didn't know it. How many catfolk dye their hair these days without really knowing why?" Just about all of them, you'd wager. [pc.ora catfolk |You certainly didn't fully understand it, at least — it was simply the way the other catfolk about you did things and it kinda looked nice, what with people expressing themselves that way. Whether you dyed your hair and fur or not's your business, but it was certainly done because it was done |Maybe it's just the way things have always been done, and people thought it looked nice and continued doing so? References to Jassira or Mallach with regards to the practice have been just about non-existent from every catfolk you've met ]. "Mm. Maybe this temple is just that, give people a nice place to do what they need do with others instead of in their own homes, that's all. The Prince of Passions is content with his power base for now — it is arguably amongst the most organized, if not outright strongest in the world these days — and sees no need to cause tensions, especially in the midst of a crisis. This is what I'm here to liaison with representatives of the other gods for, an assurance that the army on its way isn't going to get up to any mischief on their turf, so to speak. "As for the temple's own direction... you're on closer terms with the temple matron than I am, [pc.name]. I certainly don't have any authority over her, doubly so in her own temple!" Yusra laughs. "Truth be told, [pc.name], there's a lot of politics that goes on without the gods getting in on it themselves. The Seven are content to leave us largely to our own devices, which I'm grateful for; it's the only way that we'll ever truly learn as people. That means letting us make our own mistakes." Interesting. That being said, you have a related question for him. "Yes?" The army that's crossing the water and marching all the way up here — or more correctly, armies, since the other gods are doing the same — what does he think would happen if you dealt with the threat before they arrived? Yusra's expression turns serious as the catboy thins his lips. "Coming from anyone else, I might be skeptical, but the temple matron's told me enough of your adventures that I can believe you just might have a chance. As embellished as they probably are, tales from the time of the Godswar are full of singular people who managed to turn the tide, after all. "Hypothetically, if you did deal with this demon threat... well, what do you mean by that, exactly? Killing their leader, or 'neutralization' through other means? Stopping their incursions? Ending their activities? What happens to the leftovers, so to speak?" Broadly speaking, at the very least you'd hope to have Kas stop what she's doing; [kas.romantic |it may feel like a long shot to convince her to stop aggravating everyone, to put it lightly, but you think that you have a special relationship with her. If you could give her what she wants, and convince her to stand down... Yusra nods. "The temple matron has told me something of the demoness since my arrival. You're more merciful than most, [pc.name]; I encountered several nasty pieces of work on her way here. I can't say for sure how the gods would react in such a situation, but it's important to remember that they are both merciful and just." |ending her life may be a necessity at that if she won't submit to being captured and dealt with. Certainly if you were in her shoes, that's the fate you'd expect. Yusra purses his lips and nods slowly. "The temple matron has told me something of the demoness since my arrival; the threat she is and that she represents should not be underestimated. I cannot speak for even my patron in this manner, let alone the other gods... but it's important to remember that they are both merciful and just. Whatever happens, none should take delight in it." ] You guess that's about as good an answer as you can get out of him, if he's going to be honest about it. But what about the armies marching north? "Oh, there'll be something for them to do, all right. I've been in the Belharan Heartlands a couple times to know as much — even the mildest wraithspawn incursion from yet another diastrophism leaves broken homes and dead people in its wake. "Again, I don't have any authority to decide how a situation like what you proposed would play out, but given what's happened before I'd expect pretty much the same — hunting down stragglers, cleaning up the dirt, helping the survivors get back on their feet and providing some measure of order and security. We're holy warriors, [pc.name] — despite the name, we're capable of more than just fighting, and I doubt that even if you deal with their leader all the demons are simply going roll over afterwards. Even if the leader of an army is decisively dealt with, the fighting can still go on for many reasons — sheer inertia, if nothing else. There's that old legend about a Belharan legion who still believed the Godswar was still being fought forty years after it'd ended, simply because they were forgotten about in the aftermath and the island they were stationed on was still assaulted intermittently by sea monsters. "That's how it works — despite what children's tales may say, cutting the head off a snake doesn't prevent the body thrashing about afterwards and causing many problems. If you and your companions, the temple matron included, do manage to resolve the crisis at the top on your own, there'll still be a need for the armies that're converging on the roof of the world." After all, it's not every day that a holy war on this scale happens, right? [pc.isDK |No doubt it's an opportunity to some. Yusra sighs. "No doubt there're mundane concerns — there're always mundane concerns. Like the anubians say, war is profitable for the right people, which is why there're always border skirmishes with Tronarii." Profiteers abound in any and every situation, no matter how grim. |It's certainly going to be inspiring for some. Unity against an external threat and all. Yusra smiles thinly. "[pc.bgMulti soldier noblescion |You look to be a veteran in the way you carry yourself, so that's a little surprising to hear coming from you." You're just acknowledging the reality of the situation: there's going to be no shortage of young men and women who've never swung a weapon at anything more than a training dummy marching up north. No doubt, they'll have filled their own heads with dreams of sticking a monster or two and returning home to laugh about it. Who knows, some of the more fortunate ones might even get to live the dream and escape unscathed. The paladin's smile widens. "Now that's more like it, oh jaded one. But it's not untrue that many seek a higher cause, even if appraised of the dangers. It's work that must be done." No argument there. |You seem rather intimate with the issue, unsurprisingly so." It's one of the fates which might've befallen you had you not opted to leave home, given that you weren't even the spare, let alone the heir. Bring glory to the house and all that, maybe even work up a little holding of your own while in service, that kind of thing. With the way things are in the heartlands, there's always land being lost and reclaimed from the things coming out from beneath the earth. The paladin's smile widens. "I see. It's a little poetic that you wound up doing the very same thing that you might've been doing had you not left, but at least it's not on your terms and for your own purposes. That does make all the difference, doesn't it?" And you get to pick your own allies, and set your own terms. That's important. |Quite so. Pilgrim escorts, small skirmishes, suppression of wraithspawn... those are all engagements in which we've the overwhelming advantage, and the younger paladins think it'll be like that, only on a larger scale. [silly |My [pc.mf |boy |girl ], |They don't quite realize that ] this peace is what all true warriors strive for." But they'll learn in the end, won't they? Those that survive, that is. ] ] "Indeed. But what you're insinuating is right — now that the ball's started rolling, there's no stopping it. I can only hope that you pull it off and they aren't needed as desperately as they could be."

    “穿孔饰品，嗯？”奥格里什说着，考虑了一下。“当然，看不出有什么不行的。大概可以用电银敲打出一副来。给我十枚做饰品的钱，再加四十枚的工钱，我甚至能在今天之内就给你做好。”
rows.raw:
'
    "Would you be able to make me a set of piercings, Ogrish?" you ask. "I have a friend interested in them."
    
    "Piercings, eh?" Ogrish says, mulling it over. "Sure, don't see any reason why not. Can probably hammer some out from electrum. Toss me ten for the piercings and forty for the labor and I can get it to you before the day's out, even."
    '

rows.original:
"Here," you say, handing him the coins. "So you're going to make the piercings from the electrum?"
    
    "Sure am," he says with a nod, inspecting the coins closely. "Trick is to get the ones with high gold content... with a polish, comes out lookin' real nice. Look great in anyone's ears."
    
    "Ears. Yes, definitely," you mutter, [party.has brienne|ignoring Brienne's quiet snickering from behind|turning and coughing]. "Thanks, Ogrish. I'll be back in a couple of hours for them then?"
    
    "Yep, should be fine," he says, separating the coins into two piles. "I'll be here."
    
    [party.has brienne|"Nice, [pc.name]. You sounded totally convincing," Brienne comments as you walk away. "Not at all like you were going to immediately poke them through your minotaur girlfriend's nipples."
    
    "Thanks," you say dryly, rolling your eyes[party.has cait| as Cait joins in with the giggling|].
    
    "I think you'd look cool with piercings," Brienne says seriously, coming up behind you and touching your [pc.ears]. "Then again, I already like the way you look. Maybe plain is better."
    
    "Well, we already know you're sexy with or without them," you reply, reaching back and groping her [brienne.ass]. "So no problems there."
    
    "Mm hm," she murmurs, nestling against you. "I'm thinking of a few ways we can pass the time before we go pick them up..."
    
    You grin.|You while away the time around Hawkethorne [party.solo|doing nothing in particular|with [comp.names]] until it's about time.]

    “我觉得你戴穿刺饰品一定很酷，”布蕾妮认真地说道，从后面靠近，触碰你的[pc.ears]。“不过话说回来，我本来就喜欢你的模样。或许不加装饰更好。”
    
    “嗯，我们早就知道，无论戴不戴穿刺饰品，你都很性感，”你回答道，伸手向后揉捏她的[brienne.ass]。“所以完全不用担心。”
    
    “嗯哼，”她依偎在你身旁，低声说道。“我正在想，在我们回来取货之前，可以用哪些方式打发时间……”

rows.original:
Ivris's shop is surprisingly bright and cheery, with bright red walls covered with flickering magic crystals that bathe the shop in a radiant crimson glow. Shelves and shelves of alchemical equipment, herbs, and half-finished potions line the walls, surrounding tables covered in vials, burners, scales, and other equipment you can't name. 

    Ivris herself is prancing around the shop, tending to various experiments. Her bright pink skirts billow and flow around her, showing off an enticing bit of leg with every bouncing step. The wyld elf's antler-like horns only just avoid colliding with hanging bits of equipment and deftly avoid knocking things off the shelves as their owner moves gracefully about. The way she moves, you'd never know she was blind!
rows.translation:
艾薇莉丝的店铺出奇地明亮而欢乐，鲜红色的墙壁上布满了闪烁的魔法水晶，这些水晶将整个店铺笼罩在一片绚丽的深红色光芒之中。货架上摆满了各种炼金设备、草药以及半成品的药剂，墙壁两侧还排列着许多架子；那些摆满小瓶子、燃烧器、天平以及其他名称你甚至都叫不出来的设备的桌子，也遍布在整个店铺中。 

    艾薇莉丝本人正在商店里蹦来跳去，忙于进行各种实验。她那亮粉色的裙子随着她的动作飘动开来，每走一步都会露出诱人的腿部曲线。这位荒野精灵那鹿角般的角刚好没有碰到悬挂在上面的设备，而且在她优雅地移动时，也巧妙地避开了把架子上的东西碰掉。她的行动方式让人完全看不出她其实是盲人！

rows.original: . Ivris comes to a sudden halt, her metal-tipped shoes clattering on the polished floor as she angles herself towards you. "I heard you come in, silly!" she chides, bouncing deftly around one of the tables to get closer to you. "I was just waiting for you to say you needed me! So what can I do for you? A little love potion for that special someone, or maybe something to spice up your life with some transformations?" She giggles at the suggestion, running a hand along her elk-like antlers in anticipation of your desires.
rows.translation: 。 艾薇莉丝猛地停下脚步，她那装有金属鞋尖的鞋子在光洁的地板上咔嗒作响，随后她转向你。“我听见你进来了，傻瓜！”她嗔怪道，灵巧地绕过一张桌子朝你靠近。“我一直在等你说你需要我呢！那么，我能为你做些什么呢？给你心中那个人来一小瓶爱情魔药，或者用些变身效果给你的生活添点情趣？” 听到这个提议，她咯咯笑了起来，一只手顺着自己那鹿角般的角抚摸，仿佛在期待你的愿望。

rows.original: Pushing open the door to the alchemist's shop, you're immediately greeted by a bright red light and the oppressive smell of smoke and cooking herbs. You blink hard, adjusting your eyes to a large shop adorned with flaming red wall paint and glaring crystals ringing the many, many shelves, shining magical light across the shop. Several tables are aligned in neat rows, all covered with scales and vials and simmering burners — this place looks like more of a lab than a store, especially considering you[party.solo|'re the only one| and your companion[party.som|||s] are the only ones] here. Aside from a single elf woman, anyway. The woman, the shop's owner you presume, is positively prancing through the place, going from burner to burner stirring pots and tipping carefully-measured ingredients into cauldrons. A bright pink skirt flutters around her knees, and metal-toed boots clatter noisily on the polished wood floor as she bounds from work to work, humming a jaunty tune as she goes. Your eyes are instantly drawn to her %"mark of the wyld," the mutation all wyld elves bear: in her case, a pair of huge elk-like antlers grow from the sides of her head, seemingly made of twisting brown tree-bark. Small leaves grow from the tips of the branches, adding a touch of green to her otherwise flaming red outfit. It's only a moment later that you finally notice the thick, pink cloth wrapped around the elf's eyes. "
rows.translation: 推开门走进炼金师的店铺，顿时被一道鲜红色的光芒以及浓重的烟雾与烹饪香草的气味所包围。你使劲眨了眨眼睛，试图适应这个装饰着火红色墙漆、无数水晶在架子上闪烁着魔幻光芒的宽敞空间。几张桌子整齐地排列着，上面摆满了天平、小瓶子以及正在加热的炉子——这个地方看起来更像是一个实验室，而不是商店。尤其是考虑到[party.solo|你是唯一的一个。| 以及你的同伴[party.som|||]是唯一的那些]就在这里。 当然，除了一个精灵女性之外。 你应该认为，这个女性就是这家商店的老板，她真的蹦跳着她穿梭在各个角落，从一个炉子跑到另一个炉子，不停地搅拌锅中的食材，然后小心翼翼地将量好的配料倒入大锅里。一条亮粉色的裙子在她膝盖处飘动，而她穿着金属鞋底的靴子，在经过抛轻型的木地板上发出嘈杂的声响，一边忙碌着，一边哼着欢快的曲调。你的目光立刻被她头上的那对“野性标志”所吸引——这是所有野性精灵都拥有的变异特征：在她的身上，一对巨大的、类似麋鹿的鹿角从头部两侧生长出来，看起来仿佛是由扭曲的棕色树皮构成的。那些鹿角的枝梢上还长着小叶子，为她那火焰般红色的装扮增添了一抹绿色。 过了片刻，你才终于注意到，那个精灵的眼睛被厚厚的粉色布布住了。 "

rows.raw: "Raizel is sick, but, fortunately, the symptoms are mild. Still, if Ivris can give anything to help speed her recovery along, you're sure she'd appreciate it."

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: Glancing around the wide array of expensive equipment and the heavy sacks of herbs hanging from the ceiling, you ask if Ivris can shed a little light on her trade. How does one go about becoming an alchemist, exactly? "It's actually really easy!" she beams, prancing from you over to one of the bubbling cauldrons nearby. "Stodgy old wizards will always tell you it's this big deal, but really the only complicated part is finding what things work with what, and what they do when you mix them together. Otherwise it's not that different from cooking. A potion's just like a bowl of stew, and needs just as much love and creativity poured into it. Except potions can make you explode, or turn your skin into scales." You grimace at the mention of exploding. As if sensing your expression, Ivris giggles and scoops out a spoonful of whatever she's brewing: it smells like spicy pepper, but a little muskier and richer. "I'm kidding about exploding. Mostly. That almost never happens if you're careful." She sips at the concoction, scrunches her nose, and puts the remainder of the spoonful back into the cauldron. Not quite done, you guess. "Anyway, like I said, alchemy's actually pretty simple. Here, I'll show you!" she offers, skipping over to another empty cauldron and striking a match under it, setting it to boil. "You've got to start off with some boiling water, and it has to be in a metal cauldron. Nothing else will do — alchemy and metal are really reactive with each other! So you need an Alchemist's Kit to do it on the fly, or you can use a lab like mine." As she's talking, Ivris reaches up on her tip-toes and hooks one of her antlers' points through a bag on the ceiling, craning it down into her grasp. "The next thing you need is a reagent: that's the core ingredient, and determines what you're going to have the potion do in the end. Most of the reactive ingredients like puppy pepper or minotaur's blood... you could eat them raw and they might still make you mutate in weird ways. Well, you could, anyway — most people would just get a stomach ache. But a reagent focuses the ingredients, targets them to a specific part of your body." "Wait," you say,
rows.translation: 环顾周围那些价格高昂的设备，以及悬挂在天花板上的那些装满草药的重型袋子，你忍不住问道：艾薇莉丝能否稍微解释一下她的职业究竟是做什么的？究竟要怎样才能成为一名炼金术士呢？ 其实真的非常简单！她欢快地笑着，从你身边蹦跳到附近那些冒着热气的大锅旁。那些古板的老巫师总是会把这说得特别复杂，但实际上，唯一棘手的部分就是弄清楚哪些材料可以搭配使用，以及将它们混合在一起后会产生什么效果。否则，这其实和烹饪并没有什么区别。药剂就就像一碗炖菜，同样需要投入大量的心思和创意来制作。只不过，药剂有时候会让你爆炸，或者让你的皮肤变成鳞片…… 一提到“爆炸”这个词，你就露出了痛苦的表情。似乎察觉到了你的反应，艾薇莉丝轻声笑了起来，然后舀了一勺她正在准备的那种东西出来：闻起来有辛辣的胡椒味，但同时也带着一丝麝香的气息，味道更加浓郁。我说要爆炸只是开个玩笑啦。其实大多数情况下，只要小心点，这种事根本不会发生。 她尝了尝那混合物，皱了皱鼻子，然后把剩下的那一勺又倒回了锅里。看来她还没喝够呢。 总之，就像我说的，炼金术其实相当简单。来，我给你们演示一下！她走到另一个空锅旁，划了一根火柴，将锅烧开了。首先，你必须使用沸水，而且必须使用金属锅来煮水。其他任何材料都不行——炼金术过程中，金属与水会发生强烈的化学反应！因此，你必须要使用金属锅。炼金术士的工具包要即兴完成这件事，或者你可以使用实验室。就像我的一样。 她一边说话，一边踮起脚尖，将其中一根鹿角的尖端钩住天花板上的一个袋子，然后将其拉下来抓在手中。接下来你需要的就是炼金材料这就是核心成分，它决定了这种药水最终会产生什么效果。像小狗胡椒或米诺陶尔的血液这类具有反应性的成分……即使生吃，也可能会让你发生一些奇怪的变异。嗯，你反正，大多数人只会觉得肚子疼而已。但是这种炼金材料能将相关成分集中起来，并引导它们作用于你身体的特定部位。。" 等等。你说呢？

rows.original: grabbing her wrist. "What do you mean about me?" Ivris cocks her head to the side and scratches at her blindfold. "Uhhh, well, people who've been exposed to a lot of magic tend to be more reactive than other people when it comes to alchemy. Or anything, really. Once you get blasted with enough raw magical energy, your body and mind become a little... softer, I guess? Easier to reshape. And I can totally smell the magic on you, [pc.name]! Like you got dunked in a well of it!" The portal eruption. The lingering energies from that must be what she's %"smelling" on you. Right?
rows.translation: 抓住她的手腕。“你说我是什么意思？” 艾薇莉丝把头偏向一边，抓了抓自己的眼罩。“呃，嗯，那些接触过大量魔法的人，在炼金术方面往往比其他人更容易产生反应。其实，任何事情都是这样。一旦你被足够多的原始魔法能量冲击过，你的身体和心灵就会变得……更柔软一些，我想？也就更容易被重塑。而且我完全能闻到你身上的魔力，[pc.name]！简直就像你被扔进了一口满是魔力的井里一样！” 传送门爆炸了。那些残留的能量，肯定就是她现在能“闻到”你身上的东西。对吧？

rows.original: The elf shrugs noncommittally and wriggles her hand free. "If that's news for you, uh, maybe try not to put everything you find in your mouth. You might grow new body-parts, or mutate in weird ways. But alchemy can make sure you only ever change in the way you want, if you've got the time and money for it. Speaking of which," she adds, picking a small vial of milk out of the bag she's been holding and upending it into the cauldron. "That's the reagent I'll use here. Sweet cream. Guess what that'll change about you? Now we need a reactive ingredient, which will decide what appearance your transformation will take. If you want to become more like a minotaur, get some minotaur blood wine. More like a lupine? Get wolfsboon. Something closely associated on a symbolic or physical level with what you want to become. In this case," she smiles, taking out a bottle of what looks like sherry and pouring it into the cauldron. "I'm using bovum sherry, a popular lady's drink from the minotaur kingdom of Khor'minos." She flashes your general direction a smile and starts stirring the pot, not needing to look its way. "To bring the reagent and reactive ingredient together, you need two things: an alchemist kit and electrum. Your average alchemist's kit includes bonding agents and chemicals that make the two bind together into a proper potion, plus the actual set up to work with — at least a cauldron and mortar and pestle. I sell portable kits you can just set up in your camp if you need some quick field work, though if you're working in a permanent shop like mine, you might get to use actual glassware! But the chemicals that come with the kit are the real showstoppers. Here," she adds, searching around on the counter until she finds a blue bag. Ivris upends it into the cauldron, and a puff of milky-white smoke billows up into her face. She coughs and splutters, waving the steamy white away. "The last thing you need is electrum," the elf says, fishing through a small pouch on her belt and retrieving a few coins. She flips them into the cauldron like they were vegetables in a stew. "Like I said, metals are really reactive with alchemy, and electrum's symbolic of mixing. It's a mix of gold and silver, usually about one-fifth or more silver, but Belharan coins like we use today are about evenly split 'cuz that seems to be the perfect trigger for alchemy. An even mix of gold and silver, and all the elements start to react together instead of just bubbling in a pot, thanks to the bonding powder!" Ivris gives the cauldron a few more stirs, and inside you can see the concoction of milk, cream, powder, and metals starting to swirl together, boiling much hotter than they should be. A little blue smoke rises from the pot, wafting across Ivris's face. She breathes in deep, coughs, and pronounces the potion done. "Just flavor to taste after that. Personally, I like strawberries!" she laughs, reaching up and retrieving a pair of the red berries from her ceiling sacks and tossing them in. "Every alchemist has their own recipes and ways to do it, but that's really all alchemy is!" she says, grabbing an empty vial from the table and slotting it into a pair of metal tongs. With a little searching around, Ivris is able to dunk the vial into the cauldron, fill it with a frothy white mixture, and cork it. Smiling from ear to ear, she presents it to you with outstretched tongs. "On the house, for a good listener. I don't know if you've got boobs or not, but if you do, drink that and it'll make you start lactating. Or lactate nice, rich milk like a cow's if you normally make something else for whatever reason." Taking the potion from her, you can't help but ask, "Do a lot of people come asking for milk potions?" Ivris giggles, filling a few more vials with the leftover brew. "Nah. I only put this recipe together the other day, after old man Garth's daughter had her pups. She had sooooo many, so she wanted to make sure she made enough milk for all of them. Since I buy my ingredients in bulk I have lots left over now, so I might as well make a few extras! Potions last basically forever 'cuz magic, unlike milk and cream. Which is probably going to go bad in a couple days, actually. I should make a lot more potions!" You thank the bubbly elf for the tutorial and pocket the potion.
rows.translation: 精灵漫不经心地耸了耸肩，然后把手抽了回来。如果这对你来说还是个新鲜事的话，呃，或许最好别把遇到的所有东西都往嘴里塞。否则你可能会长出新的身体部位，或者发生一些奇怪的变异。不过，如果你有足够的时间和金钱，炼金术确实能确保你的变化只发生在你希望的方向上。说到这里……她接着说，从自己一直拿在手中的袋子里取出一小瓶牛奶，然后将其倒入大锅里。 这就是我在这里要使用的炼金材料——甜奶油。猜猜这会让你发生什么变化？现在我们需要这种反应性成分将决定你的变身会呈现出什么样的形态。如果你想变得更像弥诺陶洛斯，那就喝一些弥诺陶洛斯的血酒吧。如果你想变得更像狼族，那就饮用狼族饮料。选择那些在象征意义或实际形态上与你想要成为的形象密切相关的东西。在这个例子中，……她微笑着拿出一瓶看起来像雪利酒的液体，将其倒入大锅里。“我使用的是博文雪利酒，这是来自科尔米诺斯弥诺陶洛斯王国的流行女性饮品。” 她朝你的方向微微一笑，然后开始搅拌锅里的液体，甚至都不用看那个方向。要将炼金材料和反应物质结合在一起，你需要两样东西：一套炼金术工具包还有电银。一个普通的炼金术士工具包里会包含一些粘合剂和化学炼金材料，这些成分能让电银和另一种材料结合在一起，从而制成真正的药剂；当然，进行实验时至少还需要一个大锅以及研钵和杵。我也有便携式工具包出售，如果你需要在野外快速进行实验，就可以把这些工具包带到营地使用。不过，如果你是在像我这样的固定实验室里工作，或许还能使用真正的玻璃器皿哦！不过，这套工具包里配备的化学炼金材料才是真正的亮点所在。来，看看这些……她一边说着，一边在柜台上翻找，最终找到了一个蓝色的袋子。艾薇莉丝将袋子倒进大锅里，顿时有一股乳白色的烟雾腾了起来，弥漫到了她的脸上。她咳嗽着，挥动手臂试图驱散这些雾气。 “你最不需要的就是电银。，”精灵说着，从腰间的小袋子里掏出几枚硬币，然后将它们扔进大锅里，就像把蔬菜扔进炖菜里一样。正如我所说，金属在炼金术中确实会发生强烈的化学反应，而电银正是这种混合过程的象征。它是由黄金和白银混合而成的，通常白银的比例会占到五分之一甚至更多。但我们今天使用的贝尔哈兰硬币，其中黄金和白银的比例几乎是相等的——因为这种比例似乎才是引发炼金反应的完美条件。当黄金和白银以完美的比例结合在一起时，所有的元素就会开始发生反应，而而不仅仅是在锅里沸腾而已，这都要归功于那种特殊的粘合剂！ 艾薇莉丝又搅拌了几下大锅，只见里面的牛奶、奶油、粉末以及各种金属成分开始剧烈混合，温度也高得异常。锅里冒出一缕缕蓝色的烟雾，飘到了艾薇莉丝的脸上。她深吸一口气，随后轻咳了一声，宣布这种药剂已经制成了。之后可以根据个人口味添加调味料。我个人喜欢加草莓！她笑了，伸手从天花板上的袋子里拿出一串红色的浆果，然后把它们扔了进去。 每一位炼金术士都有自己独特的配方和方法，而炼金术的本质其实就是如此！她说着，从桌上拿起一个空药瓶，将其放入一把金属钳中。经过一番寻找，艾薇莉丝终于把药瓶浸入大锅里，然后往里面倒入那种泡沫状的白色混合物，最后盖上瓶盖。她笑得合不拢嘴，用伸出的金属钳将药瓶递给了你。 免费赠送，送给善于倾听的人。我不知道你有没有胸部，但如果你有的话，喝下这个吧，它会让你开始分泌乳汁。或者，如果你平时因为某些原因喝的是别的东西，喝这个也能让你分泌出像奶牛一样香浓的乳汁来。 从她手中接过那瓶药水，你不禁问道：有很多人来询问关于牛奶药水的事情吗？ 艾薇莉丝轻声笑了起来，然后用剩下的药液又装满了几支小瓶子。不行。这个配方其实是前几天老加斯的女儿生下小狗后我才拼凑出来的。她生的小狗太多了，所以她想确保有足够的奶水喂它们。因为我都是批量购买食材的，现在家里还剩下很多，所以干脆多做一些吧！药剂因为是魔法制成的，所以基本上可以永远保存，跟牛奶或奶油不一样——那些其实几天后就会变质了。我真应该多做一些药剂才行！ 你感谢那位热情洋溢的精灵提供了教程，然后把那瓶药水收进了口袋。

rows.original: "Hey, you're a mage, right?" you ask, glancing at the staves hanging on the wall. Ivris giggles and bounces over to you. As she does, the tips of her fingers start to glow an incandescent blue, crackling with power. "What gave it away?" She dismisses the building power in her hands with a brilliant flash, grinning like a kid all the while. Blinking the flash away, you ask her if she'd be able to teach you a few things. "Oh, sure! I've always wanted an apprentice," she laughs. "If you've got the time, and a little something to make it worth my while to close the shop for a while, I'd be happy to show you a little magic. I know plenty of spells I wouldn't mind sharing, or if you've got more time, I could get you in shape to be a full-blown magician like me. Your choice!"
rows.translation: 嘿，你是个法师，对吧？你问道，同时瞥了一眼挂在墙上的法杖。 艾薇莉丝咯咯笑着，蹦跳着走到你身边。当她靠近你的时候，她的指尖开始发出炽热的蓝光，那光芒中蕴含着强大的能量。是什么暴露了它的存在？ 她用一道耀眼的光芒驱散了手中凝聚的力量，整个过程中一直笑得像个孩子一样。当你眨眼让光芒消失后，便问她是否可以教你一些东西。 哦，当然！我一直都想收一个学徒。她笑了。如果你有时间，而且能给我一些报酬，让我愿意暂时关店陪你，我很乐意向你展示一些神奇的魔法。我知道很多咒语，很乐意与你分享；如果你有更多的时间，我还可以帮你成为一名像我一样的真正的魔法师。随你的选择！
rows.raw: ' "Hey, you're a mage, right?" you ask, glancing at the staves hanging on the wall. Ivris giggles and bounces over to you. As she does, the tips of her fingers start to glow an incandescent blue, crackling with power. "What gave it away?" She dismisses the building power in her hands with a brilliant flash, grinning like a kid all the while. Blinking the flash away, you ask her if she'd be able to teach you a few things. "Oh, sure! I've always wanted an apprentice," she laughs. "If you've got the time, and a little something to make it worth my while to close the shop for a while, I'd be happy to show you a little magic. I know plenty of spells I wouldn't mind sharing, or if you've got more time, I could get you in shape to be a full-blown magician like me. Your choice!"'

rows.original: Change your class to Black Mage, a magic-focused offense class. Switching classes does not transfer or unlock new Talents, though it will give you the perks of your new class up to your current level. You would be well-advised to have the coin to buy additional talents afterwards. Switching classes costs 3,000 Electrum Coins, and will take one full week of time.

Also so you don't blow my shop up." Considering she doesn't punctuate that thought with a smile for once, maybe that actually happened once... You gulp and accept one of her practice staves, following Ivris out back. The next
rows.translation: 听起来不错！盲人精灵微笑着，从你手中拿走了你的硬币。过来，跟我到后面去，我们就可以开始了。需要一些空间让你活动活动你的‘法师腿’，这样你也不会把我的店铺炸毁。 考虑到她这一次竟然没有用微笑来表达那个想法，也许那件事确实发生过一次……你咽了口唾沫，接过她准备好的练习用木棒，然后跟着艾薇莉丝走到了后面。 接下来

rows.original: passes in surprisingly grueling magical training. For all her bubbly mirth, Ivris is a strict but patient teacher who works you to the absolute bone with repetitions of your newfound spells until you've absolutely mastered them. Finally, when she deigns you ready, Ivris congratulates you on your new mastery with a kiss on the cheek and a congratulatory home-cooked meal. You stagger back to the Frost Hound later that night, sore and mentally fatigued... but feeling like you've got a much firmer grasp on the secrets of the arcane now.
rows.translation: 艾薇莉丝在魔法训练中表现得异常严格，但同时也非常有耐心。尽管她性格开朗、总是充满笑声，但她会让你反复练习那些新学的法术，直到你真正掌握它们为止——这个训练过程确实非常艰苦。终于，当她认为你已经准备好了的时候，艾薇莉丝会亲吻你的脸颊，祝贺你掌握了这项新技能，还会为你准备一顿美味的家常菜。那天晚上，你筋疲力尽地回到了霜犬酒馆那里……但现在你感觉自己已经更加深入地掌握了那些神秘的知识了。

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Say," you start, leaning against one of the glassware-laden tables. The blind shopkeeper quirks her head in your direction, brushing her antlers against the myriad sacks and ropes hanging from the rafters. "What would it take to bring this setup with me?" "You mean a setup, right? You can't have mine!" Ivris giggles, tapping her chin. "Well, really all you need is a source of heat, a cauldron, and maybe a mortar and pestle. Most of the equipment here is just for convenience, or to help me make a bunch of different things all at once. For homebrew, you really don't have to have all that much." "So can you put something together?" Ivris thinks a moment before smirking. "Sure I can! You'll only be able to use it at a campsite, though, since you need to, you know, brew the potions up. Oh, and if you end up using this to cook up something weird like psychedelics or whatever... make sure you come back to share!" As she's talking, Ivris is already gathering up a few items from the highest shelves, leveraging her wyld growths to nudge a heavy black pot into reach. With a grunt of effort, she's able to bring it down in her arms, all by herself. Grinning at her accomplishment, Ivris throws a few other bits and bobs in: the aforementioned mortar and pestle, a folding metal rack to hold the cauldron over your campfire, and a wooden box full of empty potion vials. When it's all said and done, Ivris hefts the whole thing up and deposits it on her store counter with a thunderous rattle. "Whew! Okay, all set. Wow, that's heavy. Umm, let's call it two hundred hawks, 'kay? Good cauldrons are hard to come by this far north, you know!" Sounds good. You [silly|hook a full coin pouch onto one of Ivris's antlers and|hand over a pouch laden with coin before you] heft up the full kit and awkwardly shove it into your pack. With how bulky this is, she isn't kidding about only working with it in a camp...
rows.translation: “我说，”你开口道，靠在一张摆满玻璃器皿的桌子旁。盲眼店主将头偏向你的方向，鹿角擦过从椽木上垂下的无数袋子与绳索。“要怎样才能把这样一套设备带在身边？” “你是说另一套设备，对吧？我的可不能给你！”艾薇莉丝咯咯笑着，轻点下巴。“其实，你真正需要的只有热源、一口大锅，或许再加一套研钵和研杵。这里的大多数设备只是为了方便，或者帮我同时制作许多不同的东西。要自己酿制药水，真的用不着这么多东西。” “那么，你能帮我凑出一套吗？” 艾薇莉丝想了片刻，露出得意的笑容。“当然可以！不过，你只能在露营地使用它，毕竟你得在那里，呃，把药水煮出来。哦，还有，要是你最后用它做出了迷幻药之类的奇怪东西……一定记得回来跟我分享！” 说话间，艾薇莉丝已经开始收拢最高几层架子上的物品，借助身上的野性枝角，将一口沉重的黑锅拨到自己够得着的地方。她使劲闷哼一声，独自伸手将锅抱了下来。艾薇莉丝为自己的成果咧嘴一笑，又往里面扔进几样零碎：先前提到的研钵和研杵、一只用来把大锅架在营火上方的折叠金属架，还有一只装满空药水瓶的木箱。一切收拾妥当后，艾薇莉丝举起整套设备，轰隆一声放到店铺柜台上。 “呼！好啦，全都备齐了。哇，真够沉的。嗯——就算两百鹰币，好吗？你也知道，在这么靠北的地方，可很难找到一口好锅！” 听起来不错。你[silly|把装满硬币的钱袋挂到艾薇莉丝的一根鹿角上，随后|先将沉甸甸的钱袋递给她，随后]抱起整套设备，笨拙地将其塞进背包。考虑到这东西有多么笨重，她说只能在营地里使用还真不是开玩笑……

rows.original:
[flags.LEORAH_MET
        |The inside of the huntress's shop is surprisingly cozy, with a blazing hearthfire against the eastern wall that shines a comfortable light and a radiant heat across the room. A huge bearskin rug lies on the floor, surrounded by mounted heads from all manner of creatures on the walls. The most prominent display piece, however, is a beautiful whitewood bow hanging over the counter, complete with a quiver of blue-feathered elvish arrows.
rows.translation:
[flags.LEORAH_MET
        |这位女猎手的店铺内部出奇地舒适，东墙边熊熊燃烧的炉火洒下舒适的光线，把暖意送到整个房间。地板上铺着一块巨大的熊皮地毯，四周的墙上挂满了各种生物的头颅标本。然而，最引人注目的陈列品，是那把挂在柜台上方的精美白木弓，还配着一壶蓝色羽毛的精灵箭。

rows.original: is sitting underneath the bow, leaning heavily on the counter with her eyes drooping half-closed out of boredom. |You step into the shop, and are instantly greeted by a refreshing warmth radiating from a crackling fire in a stone hearth in the far wall, bathing the interior of the little shop in a soft amber glow. A sprawling bearskin rug covers most of the rough wooden floor, and the walls are covered in various hunting trophies: stuffed heads of mountain lions and tusky boars, among many others. [pc.bg hunter|You feel almost unnaturally at home here — clearly this place was meant for people like you!] Your eyes are drawn to the shop's counter, and the beautiful whitewood bow hanging over it. Elvish make, by the looks of things, with sprawling scrollwork and gold bands around sinfully smooth ivory curves. A gorgeous weapon, hanging over a gorgeous girl sitting behind the counter: a catfolk with skin darkened to a sultry brown by the desert suns of her homeland, her almond eyes half-closed with fatigue. A pair of black tattoos trace long, claw-shaped marks from under her eyes to near her chin, and branching out to cover her cheeks in vein-like strands. She's got a short-cropped mess of untamed and green-dyed hair, parting around a pair of particularly tall feline ears of the same color. A pair of small but perky breasts peek up from a low-cut padded vest and white undershirt, showing off a fair bit of cleavage as their owner leans over the counter. "Up here, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]," the cat-girl yawns, arching an inquisitive eyebrow at you. You [pc.isChamp|cough and apologize|keep staring], approaching the counter. [pc.ra catfolk|"Well, well. Don't see many other cats around here.[party.has cait| Especially two at once.] Nice to meet you. I'm Leorah, the owner.|She idly blows a stray lock of hair out of her eyes as you close this distance, looking at you with mild disinterest. "Name's Leorah. This is my shop.]" "[pc.name]," you say by way of introduction before asking her what she sells here, exactly. The sign outside wasn't entirely explicit. The dusky cat-girl sits up a little straighter as you bring up business. "I make and sell supplies for the other hunters in the village. I used to be one myself, until a wyvern just about took my leg off. Now I make arrows, leather armor, bows... light weapons and armor, basically. If that's something you need, you're in the right place. Otherwise... enjoy the fire, I guess?" ]
rows.translation: 正坐在弓下，重重倚靠着柜台，因无聊而半闭着双眼。 |你踏入店铺，立刻被远处墙壁上石砌壁炉中噼啪作响的火焰所包围，温暖的光晕将小店铺的内部笼罩在柔和的琥珀色光芒中。一张铺展开的熊皮地毯覆盖了大部分粗糙的木地板，墙上挂满了各种狩猎战利品：山狮和长牙野猪的标本头颅，还有许多其他猎物。 [pc.bg hunter|你竟然出奇地感到自在——这里显然是为你们这样的人准备的！] 目光被吸引到店铺的柜台前，以及悬挂其上的精美白木弓。从外观来看，这显然是精灵工艺，繁复的卷轴花纹与金带环绕着丝滑的象牙曲线。 一件绝美的武器，悬挂于柜台后那位绝美的少女之上：一位猫族少女，肌肤被故乡的沙漠阳光晒成迷人的棕褐色，杏眼半眯，显露出些许倦意。一对黑色纹身从她眼下方延伸至下巴附近，再向脸颊蔓延，如同血管般的纹路。她拥有一头短发凌乱而蓬松，染成绿色，发丝在一对同色的高耸猫耳两侧分开。一对小巧而饱满的胸部从低领填充胸衣和白色衬衣中探出，随着主人俯身柜台，展露出丰腴的胸线。 在这上面， [pc.mf|伙伴|亲爱的]，”猫女打了个哈欠，好奇地扬起眉毛看着你。你[pc.isChamp|咳了几声并道歉着|继续盯着]走近柜台。 [pc.ra catfolk|嗯，嗯。这儿的猫倒是不多。[party.has cait| 尤其一次两个。]很高兴见到你。我是莱拉，主人。|她随手将一缕散落的发丝从眼前吹开，当你靠近时，她淡淡地瞥了你一眼，目光中带着些许冷淡。我叫莉娅。这是我的店铺。]” "[pc.name]，”你先打个招呼，然后才问她到底在这里卖什么。外面的招牌倒是没写得太清楚。 听到你提起生意，她微微挺直了身子。我给村里其他猎人制作和出售物资。我曾经也是猎人，直到一只翼龙差点把我的腿给撕了。现在我做箭、皮革盔甲、弓……基本上就是轻型武器和盔甲。要是你需要这些，来对地方了。否则的话……就享受篝火吧，我想。 ]

rows.translation: 商店
交出毒液

rows.original: Hand over the wyvern venom you have on you.
rows.translation: 交出你身上带的翼龙毒液。
rows.raw: "Hand over the wyvern venom you have on you."

rows.original: You don't have any wyvern venom on you at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前身上没有任何双足飞龙毒液。
rows.raw: "You don't have any wyvern venom on you at the moment."

rows.translation: 训练

rows.original: Ask Leorah if she'd be willing to teach you a thing or two.
rows.translation: 问问莱奥拉，她是否愿意教你一些东西。
rows.raw: "Ask Leorah if she'd be willing to teach you a thing or two."

rows.translation: 聊天

rows.original: Chat with the lethargic shopkeeper... or chat her up.
rows.translation: 和那个懒惰的店主聊聊天吧……或者试着和她套近乎。
rows.raw: "Chat with the lethargic shopkeeper... or chat her up."

rows.translation: 性行为

rows.original: Proposition Leorah for a romp in the hay... or more correctly, on her rug.
rows.translation: 莱奥拉的提议：在干草堆上尽情嬉戏……或者更准确地说，是在她的地毯上。
rows.raw: "Proposition Leorah for a romp in the hay... or more correctly, on her rug."

rows.translation: 性行为

rows.original: Proposition the taciturn shopkeeper for some fun time.
rows.translation: 想办法让这个沉默寡言的店主开心一下吧。
rows.raw: "Proposition the taciturn shopkeeper for some fun time."

rows.original: Banger? You barely even know her!
rows.translation: 邦格？你其实几乎不了解她吧！
马衣

rows.original: Maybe Leorah can help you out; that's the first bet Sugo had after all, right?
rows.translation: 也许莱奥拉能帮你解决这个问题；毕竟，这是苏戈最初提出的建议，对吧？
rows.raw: "Maybe Leorah can help you out; that's the first bet Sugo had after all, right?"

rows.translation: 交付

rows.original: Deliver the materials to Leorah so you can get the caparison.
rows.translation: 把这些材料交给莱奥拉，这样你就能拿到那件马衣了。
rows.raw: "Deliver the materials to Leorah so you can get the caparison."

rows.original: You don't have all the materials Leorah requested.
rows.translation: 你并没有准备好莱奥拉要求的全部材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have all the materials Leorah requested."

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: The door creaks open and you step in, a gust of warm air rushing to greet you as you cross the shop's threshold. Barely anything's changed since the last time you were here, but Leorah herself looks up at you sharply across the counter as you make your presence known. "Shut the door, if you will. You're letting the cold in." You close the door with a thump, and move to browse the wares, but Leorah beckons you over with an outstretched finger, a clear "come hither" motion if you ever saw one. Chin cupped in her hands, eyes half-lidded, the catgirl rolls her gaze upward lazily to meet yours as you draw close. [pc.cunningRange 80|She's not fooling anyone, though. That's a decent facade of disinterest, but you can tell from the occasional twitch of her tail that she's clearly holding something back.] You ask her what's up. "Right. I have a business proposition for you, [pc.name]. One of those you-scratch-my-back-and-I'll-scratch-yours things. You interested?" Well, that's rather forward. That, and you'd have to hear what she's got in mind first. Leorah shrugs and flicks her tail at you. "Up here, there's no time for waffling about, especially when you're not being rude by being direct. Life's too short for that. As for what I want, I'd like you to get me some wyvern venom. I use it for... ah, several purposes about the shop, and supplies are running a little low. Best to take care of it before it becomes a problem." How did she get any before you came along? "You're asking because...?" Well, you have to know where to get some, don't you? A sigh. "Up in the foothills. People coming down from there would bring me some, but ever since the blizzard came along and the orcs moved in, no one's about to go traipsing up there anymore. It's been some weeks now, and — look, just go into the hills and beat up a wyvern or two for some, okay? Shouldn't be too hard. I'd go myself, if it weren't for my knee; Garth tells me you're going out of town looking for trouble, so..." And what do you stand to get out of it? "I'll teach you something of what I know about archery. Deal?" Hmm... "If you're going out there and getting into scraps, you'll want to have as many tools as you can at your disposal. I've learned a thing or two in my time that I can impart to you in exchange for some venom to tide me over until I can work out a new arrangement with the other folks in town. Deal?" Sounds like it couldn't hurt, if you ever manage to get your hands on some. What does she want it for, anyway? Leorah rolls her eyes and waves a hand noncommittally. "Oh, you know. A bit of this, a bit of that. Always good on arrowheads, that kind of stuff; it's also good for subduing a beast you don't want to kill just yet. Hundred and a half small uses for this kind of nonlethal stuff, unlike blood iris." [party.has cait|"Calla once said that venoms are used in concocting all sorts of antidotes and cures," Cait supplies helpfully. "I've never actually tried milking a viper, but I've seen it done." Leorah quirks a corner of her mouth upwards. "Smart girl."] You'll need to think about it. "Think about it all you need, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]; I'm not going anywhere. So long as you show up on my doorstep with the goods, I'll consider the deal done. Now, can I help you with something?"
rows.translation: 门吱呀一声打开了，你走了进去，一股温暖的空气迎面扑来。自从你上次来到这里之后，几乎没有什么变化，但当你走进店铺时，莱奥拉却立刻从柜台后面抬起头，紧紧地注视着你。 如果你愿意的话，把门关上吧。这样会让冷空气进来的。 你砰地一声关上了门，然后走过去浏览那些商品，但莱奥拉却伸出手指向你招来，那动作简直就是在明确地告诉你“过来”。她双手托着下巴，半闭着眼睛，这个猫娘懒洋洋地抬起头，与你对视起来。 [pc.cunningRange 80|不过，她并没有骗任何人。她装作毫不在意的样子，确实挺像样的，但你可以从她偶尔出现的反应中看出，她显然在隐瞒些什么。] 你问她发生了什么事。 好的。我有一个商业建议要向您提出来。[pc.name]就是那种你帮我忙，我也会帮你忙的关系。你感兴趣吗？ 嗯，这样未免太直接了。而且，你得先听听她到底有什么打算。 莱奥拉耸了耸肩，然后甩了甩尾巴向你示意。在这里，根本没有时间浪费在拐弯抹角上，尤其是当你直截了当地表达自己的意思并不会显得无礼的时候。人生苦短，根本经不起这样的浪费。至于我想要什么，我希望你能帮我弄来一些翼龙毒液。我在店里用它来……嗯，有很多用途，而且现在的库存已经有点不足了。最好在问题真正出现之前就把这件事解决掉。 在你出现之前，她是怎么得到那些东西的？ 你这么问，是因为……？ 嗯，你总得知道去哪里才能弄到这些东西吧？ 一声叹息。在山脚下吧。以前从那里下来的人会给我带一些来，但自从暴风雪来袭，兽人入侵之后，就再没人愿意去那里了。现在已经过去好几周了……听着，你去山里抓几只飞龙不就得了吗？应该不会太难吧。要不是我的膝盖有问题，我也会去的；加斯说你要出门去惹麻烦，所以…… 那么，接下来会是什么呢？你有办法摆脱这个困境吗？ 我会把我所知道的关于射箭的知识教给你。怎么样？ 嗯…… 如果你打算去外面冒险，那么你肯定需要尽可能多的工具来帮助自己。这些年来，我学到了一些东西，可以分享给你。作为交换，你只需要给我一些毒液，让我能够暂时应付一下，等我和镇上的其他人商量出新的解决办法。怎么样？ 听起来试试也没坏处，如果你真能搞到一些的话。她到底想用这些来做什么呢？ 莱奥拉翻了个白眼，漫不经心地挥了挥手。哦，你知道的。这种东西嘛，用处多多。用在箭头上效果很好，也能用来制服那些你还不想杀掉的野兽。这种非致命武器有一百五十种不同的使用方法，这可和‘血之鸢尾’完全不一样。 [party.has cait|卡拉曾经说过，毒液被用来制作各种各样的解毒剂和治疗方法。凯特热心地提供了帮助。我其实从未试过给毒蛇挤奶，但我见过有人这么做过。 莱奥拉微微上扬嘴角。聪明的女孩。] 你需要仔细考虑一下。 仔细想一想吧，你需要考虑所有这些因素。 [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]我哪儿也不会去。只要你把东西送到我家门口，我就认为这笔交易完成了。现在，还需要我帮忙什么吗？

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Oh. You got it." [pc.cunningRange 80|Leorah's voice might be perfectly flat, but she's fooling no one: you spy her knuckles whitening as she presses her fingers against the wooden counter, suppressing the impulse to snatch the bottle of venom out of your hands.] So you did. Will this be enough? "It'll tide me over, although I wish you could've brought more." The dusky-skinned catgirl chuckles. "Come on, [pc.name]. Some things you can never really have enough of, and wyvern venom's one of them. When the weather gets warm, that stuff goes out the door as quickly as it comes in. Cheers." You press the bottle of venom down on the counter, and watch as Leorah picks it up, studying it like a housewife watching the scales at market. She turns it over in the light a few times, making note of its color, then places her nose to the still-stoppered bottle and gives it a good sniff. Looking more and more like a cat by the moment, Leorah continues to inspect your offering with all five senses, her ears twitching all the while. [party.has cait|[pc.ora catfolk||Cait looks a little embarrassed at the display and leans over to whisper to you. "That's, um, something special, all right. Most catfolk don't get so playful with their toys..." Toys? That bubblegum-pink tail of hers twitches in agitation. "A turn of phrase."]] "Aaah, not bad. It's still relatively fresh, just the way I like it; not bad at all, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. Give yourself a pat on the back." If it's all the same to her, you'd like more than a pat on the back. There's something that she promised you... "Yeah, right. Since you were kind enough to get me some of this stuff, why don't I teach you how to handle it properly? That way you can use any you find to your advantage without accidentally poisoning yourself. Kids think poisoned blades and arrowheads are cool, they go and buy a flask or two from Ivris — then end up sick because they didn't know the first thing about working with the stuff. Come on, let's go out back and I'll show you how some of this is done." Leorah is good to her word. While it might seem simple at first glance, getting an even coat of the venom on a sharp edge or point without coming into contact with any of the wyvern venom turns out to be trickier than expected. "Venom from animals and the like tends to be safer," she explains as she demonstrates how to properly treat arrowheads with the wyvern venom you brought her. "Give them a couple days to a week in the sun and air, and they'll degrade into uselessness; on the other hand, mineral poisons like arsenic can linger on a surface for months if you don't clean them off carefully. That way if you accidentally scratch yourself with your own weapon later on, it's less likely that any of the stuff'll get into your system. "Not that there aren't any exceptions, though. Blood iris — that one's a bitch. But wyvern venom should be relatively safe; it starts to go once it leaves the beastie in question. That's why you have to stopper it tightly for it to keep." [party.has cait|Cait looks on from the sidelines, clearly intending to rush in and provide aid at the drop of a pin, but Leorah knows her job well enough to steer you away from any mishaps. ]It takes an hour or two, but after a few tries you feel far more comfortable about this stuff than you did when it was coming out of the wyvern. After you've a good couple dozen treated arrows, she takes you out with one of her cheap bows and has you practice loosing a multitude of envenomed missiles at a pair of archery butts.
rows.translation: 哦，你明白了。 [pc.cunningRange 80|莱奥拉的声音听起来可能毫无情绪波动，但没人会被她骗到：你可以看到她的指关节因为用力按在木制柜台上而变得发白，她正在强压住从你手中夺走那瓶毒药的冲动。] 所以你这么做了。这样够吗？ 这已经足够让我应付了，不过我真希望你能带多一些来。那个皮肤黝黑的猫女轻声笑了起来。来吧，[pc.name]有些东西，你永远都不会觉得拥有得够多，而翼龙的毒液就是其中之一。每当天气变暖，这种毒液就会像被迅速吸走一样，立刻从家里被“带出去”。干杯！ 你将那瓶毒液放在柜台上，看着莱奥拉把它拿起来，像一位主妇在市场上仔细观察秤一样仔细地端详着它。她在光线下把瓶子翻来覆去地看了几遍，注意观察它的颜色，然后把鼻子凑到仍然盖着塞子的瓶口上，深深地闻了闻。莱奥拉的样子越来越像一只猫了，她用所有的感官继续检查你送来的这个“礼物”，她的耳朵还不停地动着。 [party.has cait|[pc.ora catfolk||凯特看到这样的场面，显得有些尴尬，她凑过来低声对你说了些什么。那个，嗯，确实是一件特别的事情。大多数猫族并不会对自己的玩具如此爱玩闹…… 玩具？ 她那根粉红色的尾巴正不安地扭动着。一句妙语。]] 啊，还不错。味道还挺新鲜的，正是我喜欢的那种；真的不错啊。 [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]好好表扬自己一下吧。 如果对她来说这一切都无所谓，那你想要的可不仅仅是几句表扬而已。她曾经向你承诺过一些事情…… 是啊，当然。既然你这么好心地给我弄来了这些东西，那我为什么不教你如何正确使用它们呢？这样你以后遇到什么就能好好利用，而不会不小心把自己毒伤了。孩子们总觉得被毒过的刀刃或箭头很酷，于是会从艾薇莉丝那里买上一两瓶这种东西——结果却因为根本不懂如何使用而生病了。来吧，我们到后面去，我教你怎么操作这些东西。 莱奥拉确实言出必行。乍看之下，这个任务似乎很简单，但实际上要在不接触到任何翼龙的毒液的情况下，让毒液均匀地覆盖在那些锋利的边缘或尖端上，却比预想的要困难得多。 动物等生物体内的毒素通常来说更为安全。她一边演示如何正确处理你带给她的那些含有翼龙毒液的箭头，一边进行解释。把它们放在阳光下、空气中几天到一周的时间，它们就会变得毫无用处；而像砷这样的矿物毒素，如果不好好清理，就会在物体表面残留数月。这样一来，以后如果你不小心用自己的武器划伤了自己，这些毒素就不太可能进入你的身体。 不过，也并非没有例外。血虹草汁确实是个麻烦……但翼龙毒液应该还算安全；只要它离开那种生物的身体，就会开始失效。因此，必须把容器密封好，才能让它保持效力。 [party.has cait|凯特在一旁观望着，显然随时准备冲上来提供帮助，但莱奥拉非常清楚自己的职责，因此总能及时阻止你遇到任何麻烦。 ]这可能需要一两个小时，但经过几次尝试后，你会发现自己对这些操作越来越熟练了，远比当初那些箭从翼龙身上射出来时熟练得多。当你制作了二三十支经过处理的箭之后，她就会用她那把便宜的弓带你出去练习，让你向那些靶子连续发射许多含有毒药的箭矢。

Will this be enough? "It'll tide me over, although I wish you could've brought more." The dusky-skinned catgirl chuckles. "Come on, [pc.name]. Some things you can never really have enough of, and wyvern venom's one of them. When the weather gets warm, that stuff goes out the door as quickly as it comes in. Cheers." You press the bottle of venom down on the counter, and watch as Leorah picks it up, studying it like a housewife watching the scales at market. She turns it over in the light a few times, making note of its color, then places her nose to the still-stoppered bottle and gives it a good sniff. Looking more and more like a cat by the moment, Leorah continues to inspect your offering with all five senses, her ears twitching all the while. [party.has cait|[pc.ora catfolk||Cait looks a little embarrassed at the display and leans over to whisper to you. "That's, um, something special, all right. Most catfolk don't get so playful with their toys..." Toys? That bubblegum-pink tail of hers twitches in agitation. "A turn of phrase."]] "Aaah, not bad. It's still relatively fresh, just the way I like it; not bad at all, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. Give yourself a pat on the back." If it's all the same to her, you'd like more than a pat on the back. There's something that she promised you... "Yeah, right. Since you were kind enough to get me some of this stuff, why don't I teach you how to handle it properly? That way you can use any you find to your advantage without accidentally poisoning yourself. Kids think poisoned blades and arrowheads are cool, they go and buy a flask or two from Ivris — then end up sick because they didn't know the first thing about working with the stuff. Come on, let's go out back and I'll show you how some of this is done." Leorah is good to her word. While it might seem simple at first glance, getting an even coat of the venom on a sharp edge or point without coming into contact with any of the wyvern venom turns out to be trickier than expected. "Venom from animals and the like tends to be safer," she explains as she demonstrates how to properly treat arrowheads with the wyvern venom you brought her. "Give them a couple days to a week in the sun and air, and they'll degrade into uselessness; on the other hand, mineral poisons like arsenic can linger on a surface for months if you don't clean them off carefully. That way if you accidentally scratch yourself with your own weapon later on, it's less likely that any of the stuff'll get into your system. "Not that there aren't any exceptions, though. Blood iris — that one's a bitch. But wyvern venom should be relatively safe; it starts to go once it leaves the beastie in question. That's why you have to stopper it tightly for it to keep." [party.has cait|Cait looks on from the sidelines, clearly intending to rush in and provide aid at the drop of a pin, but Leorah knows her job well enough to steer you away from any mishaps. ]It takes an hour or two, but after a few tries you feel far more comfortable about this stuff than you did when it was coming out of the wyvern. After you've a good couple dozen treated arrows, she takes you out with one of her cheap bows and has you practice loosing a multitude of envenomed missiles at a pair of archery butts. "

rows.original: You have learned the Wyvern Sting power. You have learned the Crowd Control power. When she's finally done, Leorah picks up the wares she was using for the demonstration and ushers you back into the store, plopping her butt back on her usual spot behind the counter. "Hope you learned something today. There's more I could teach you, but I've got a date with the rest of the venom you've brought me." You did. Wait, there's more she's willing to teach? "Yeah. That's all you're getting for now, though; no more freebies. If you want to know more about handling a bow or sling, come back another time with payment." Looking smug, Leorah settles back in her chair and curls her tail about the legs of her chair. "Now, if you'll excuse me, I think I'm going to close up the shop." Isn't it a little early for that? She taps the side of the bottle. "I'm going to be putting this stuff to good use. Could be dangerous, you know; while wyvern venom isn't the most lethal of toxins, someone could nevertheless have a very bad day if they mucked about with it. Reasons that I'd rather not have a customer walking in on me there and then, yeah? I mean, you should know, considering the little lesson we just had." It does make sense. Who're you to say anything if she doesn't mind the lost business? Leorah grins slyly. "Trust me, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. This baby'll bring in more customers than I'd lose by shutting my doors for a few hours. Now, if you wouldn't mind giving [a] [pc.mf||fellow ]woman some privacy..." So it comes to pass that the dusky-skinned catgirl hustles you out of her shop, and you hear the bolt click in place behind you. The windows blinds follow suit in short order, followed by the sounds of Leorah rummaging about within. Guess she's readying to get to work, then — you're just about to leave when on the edge of your hearing, a soft, most uncharacteristic moan sounds from within the hunting shop. ...Now that's interesting. Wonder what's really going on inside there — think you'd like to try and sneak a peek?
