Oh, of course. Now that you're properly alone, there's nothing in your way now. |Since you're all alone, there's no problem here. ] The door to Leorah's little hunting shop is sturdily built, but it looks like she didn't draw the blinds on her windows properly in her haste. There's still more than enough space for you to peep through, and you can even hear her quite clearly... "Seven suns and sands, this is going to be great," the dusky-skinned catgirl croons as she cradles the wyvern venom in her hands like a particularly rare vintage. She's sitting on the huge bearskin rug with her legs outstretched, warming her bare feet by the fire. "Come to momma, you sweet little thing. Nothing like some of this stuff in front of a warm fire on a cold day; I thought I'd never get any in time." With one swift motion, Leorah pulls the stopper out from the bottle of wyvern venom, sticks her face right into the bottle's neck, and takes a deep huff of the fumes. Once, twice, thrice — with each inhalation, a distinct change comes over the usually laconic shopkeeper. Her ears droop forward, her shoulders slump, and a happy, stupefied expression creeps over her face. Her tail starts writhing about on the rug, and a soft moan escapes her lips as she starts pawing at the collar of her undershirt, trying to get it off without dealing with her vest first. "Fuck this. I've waited long enough!" Her movements might be less coordinated than they ought to be, but sheer determination sees them through. Already, a faint flush is spreading under the sultry brown of the catgirl's skin, turning it the color of old blood; her nipples press against her clothes, cleanly outlined against the fabric of her undershirt. Pausing occasionally to paw at herself, Leorah finally unbuckles her vest and pulls off her undershirt, tossing both in a lazy arc over in the general direction of the counter. With nothing to support them — she's evidently not in the habit of wearing a bra — her small, perky tits roll out into view, bouncy handfuls that she wastes no time pressing to the warmth of the roaring fire. "Mallach's balls. Either this stuff is really fresh, or it's really potent." Leorah heaves a few deep breaths, giggles to herself, then reaches for the open bottle once more. Grinning like a drunkard faced with a particularly fine vintage, she tips the bottle and splashes a small amount of wyvern venom into an open palm. You watch in amazement and horror alike as Leorah coats her hands with the potent toxin as if she were lathering them with soap, then starts groping her tits like a two-coin slut. She's always so indifferent towards everyone and anything — seeing her like this, it's like meeting an entirely new person. Her head thrown back as she sits cross-legged on the bearskin rug, the dusky catgirl cups each of her tits in a palm, applying pressure to the small orbs of firm flesh as she rotates her hands in wide circles, kneading and squeezing all the while. Where her fingers pass, a thin sheen of venom's left in their wake, glistening in the firelight; she pauses for a moment to lavish attention on her rock-hard nipples, thumbs capping them and pushing down on her black areolae while she digs the heels of her palms deep into what breastflesh she has. Pushing, rubbing and squeezing away, Leorah shamelessly molests herself with wanton abandon, her face and collar burning as the flush of arousal becomes more and more prominent. The blush in her cheeks has spread all the way into her neck, and it's threatening to spill over into her collarbone any moment now. "A-ah!" A soft, involuntary mewl escapes Leorah's lips as she pauses to give her hands a fresh coating of venom. The dusky-skinned catgirl's ears are flat against her head, her green hair soaked with sweat — the same sweat that's beading on the curves of her boobs and mixing in with the venom slathered on her skin. Despite her panting heavily, she doesn't seem to be feeling the heat any; if anything, she's drawn towards the roaring fire, basking on the rug like a lizard on a sun-warmed rock. "Fuck. rows.translation: 你考虑了一会儿，但最终决定不去做那个偷窥者。无论莱奥拉在里面做什么，那都是她自己的事情，而且你肯定也不希望有人在霜犬酒馆的房间里偷看你吧？因此，你理应也给予她同样的尊重。 [party.hasCompanions|“有什么心事吗？” 当你正要离开莱奥拉那里时，[comp1.name]说道。 什么？ “你刚才看起来好像有点烦恼。” “哦，没什么大不了的。”] 嗯，你还有事情要做，而这些事情是不会自己完成的。最好让莱奥拉继续享受她的乐趣，你自己也赶紧去忙吧；天知道，她一整天都这么无精打采，确实需要一些刺激才行。
rows.raw: " You entertain the thought for a moment, but eventually decide against playing peeping tom. Whatever Leorah's doing in there, it's her own business, and you wouldn't want someone spying on you in your room at the Frost Hound, right? It only stands to reason you should extend that courtesy to her. [party.hasCompanions|"Something on your mind?" [comp1.name] says as you start away from Leorah's. What? "You looked troubled for a bit there." Oh, it's nothing.] Well, you've still got things to do, and they're not going to get themselves done. Best leave Leorah to her fun and hop to it; gods knows she needs a bit of excitement with how lethargic she is all day."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Nah, this has nothing to do with you.
rows.translation: 不，这跟你没有任何关系。
rows.raw: "Nah, this has nothing to do with you."

rows.original: Leorah tilts her chin upwards to meet your gaze. "If you want to learn more, I'll need paying. Time is money, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]; I can't be watching the shop while I'm out with you." That's fair, you guess. You'd have to make up for her lost business. Does she take wyvern venom as payment? A grin — or more correctly, Leorah shows you her teeth. "Tempting, but no. Coin only; venom might be nice, but I need something the merchants will take. So, what'll it be?"
rows.translation: 莱奥拉微微仰起下巴，与你对视。如果你想了解更多内容，就需要付费。时间就是金钱， [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]我和你在一起的时候，总不可能同时照看店铺吧。 这也算公平吧。你总得弥补她因此失去的生意损失。她是用翼龙的毒液来作为付款方式吗？ 莱奥拉露出了一丝笑容——或者更准确地说，她露出了她的牙齿。很诱人，但还是算了吧。只能用硬币来购买；毒液或许也不错，但我需要的是商人们会接受的东西。那么，最终会选择什么呢？

rows.original: Leorah eyes your coins as they slide across the counter, a soft scraping ringing out as you count out the amount and set them before her. At last, she straightens her back, rolls her shoulders, and sweeps your offering into a drawer with a single swift movement. "All right then, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], let's get down and dirty. Hope you're not afraid of working up a sweat." [party.hasCompanions|You tell [party.compNames] to take the rest of the day off at the Frost Hound, then fall in step behind Leorah. ]The rest of the day is spent out back behind the shop, amongst stretched-out hides and freshly scraped pelts. Leorah has you perform a few exercises to limber your muscles, then goes straight to the meat of the matter. She's her usual taciturn self, preferring to demonstrate and then walk you through the steps of the technique instead of more verbal instruction; mistakes and mishaps are punished with light, almost playful slaps to the offending body part. Once you've enough of a grasp on the subject that you're not liable to hurt yourself, she has you practice on a number of targets to further cement your feel for what you've just learned. Enough time passes that it starts to get dark outside, but Leorah puts out a couple of lanterns and has you continue. "Eh, that'll do, [pc.name]," she says at long last. "That'll do. Don't go forgetting everything I've tried to drill into your head today." Given what you've gone just gone through, you'd hope not. A nod. "Go and get some sleep. Tomorrow's going to be another day." Yeah, that sounds like a fine idea, especially since the sun's set a little while ago now. [party.hasCompanions|By the time you get back to the Frost Hound, [party.compNames] [party.som||has|have] long since headed to bed, a thought weighing on your mind as you climb into your own...|The common room is practically deserted by the time you reach the Frost Hound, and you wave at Garth as you climb upstairs and get some much needed rest...]
rows.translation: 当你的硬币在柜台上滑动时，莱奥拉注视着它们。你数好钱数，将硬币放在她面前，这时传来一阵轻微的刮擦声。最后，她挺直身子，活动了一下肩膀，然后迅速将你给的钱收进了抽屉里。 “[pc.mf|那好吧，伙计|那好吧，宝贝]，那我们就开始实干吧。希望你不怕出汗哦。” [party.hasCompanions|你让[party.compNames]今天剩下的时间在霜犬酒馆休息，然后跟在莱奥拉后面。]这天剩下的时间都花在店铺后面的场地里，周围是摊开的皮革和刚刮好的毛皮。莱奥拉让你做几组动作活动筋骨，然后直接进入正题。她依旧是那副沉默寡言的样子，更喜欢先做示范、再带着你一步步走完动作，而不是多费口舌讲解；一旦你犯错或搞砸，就用轻轻一拍——几乎像在开玩笑——打在出错的部位上。等你对这门手艺掌握到不至于伤到自己的程度，她就让你在好几个靶子上练习，进一步巩固刚学到的手感。时间过得很快，外面开始黑下来，莱奥拉还是点起几盏灯笼，让你接着练。 “嗯，这样就可以了，[pc.name]，”她终于说道。“这样就可以了。可别把我今天试图灌输给你的东西全忘了。” 考虑到你刚刚经历的一切，你希望不会吧。 她点了点头。“去睡一会儿吧。明天又是新的一天。” 嗯，这听起来是个不错的主意，尤其是现在太阳已经落山一会儿了。[party.hasCompanions|等你回到霜犬酒馆时，[party.compNames] [party.som||早就|早就]上床睡觉了，某个念头在你钻进自己被窝时仍萦绕在脑海中……|等你回到霜犬酒馆时，公共休息室里几乎空无一人，你向加斯挥了挥手，然后上楼好好休息了一番……]

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: "Suit yourself." Slouching back onto the counter, Leorah resumes tapping the leg of her chair with her tail. "Though I'd warn against getting a girl all worked up and then choosing not to follow through. "Now, is there anything else you need?"
rows.translation: “随你便吧。”莱奥拉懒洋洋地靠回柜台上，继续用尾巴轻敲椅子的腿。“不过我还是要劝你一句，别把姑娘撩得兴起，最后却不负责到底。” “现在，还有其他什么你需要吗？”
rows.raw: ' "Suit yourself." Slouching back onto the counter, Leorah resumes tapping the leg of her chair with her tail. "Though I'd warn against getting a girl all worked up and then choosing not to follow through. "Now, is there anything else you need?"'

学习技能

rows.original: Train non-class ranged power that you are high enough level to use. Costs 100 Electrum Coins per level of the power, and will take up the rest of your day.
rows.translation: 当你达到足够高的等级时，就可以学习这种非职业范围的远程技能。学习每级这种技能需要消耗100枚琥珀金币，而且学习过程会占用你一整天的时间。
rows.raw: "Train non-class ranged power that you are high enough level to use. Costs 100 Electrum Coins per level of the power, and will take up the rest of your day."

rows.original: There are no powers Leorah can teach you right now.
rows.translation: 目前，莱奥拉并没有任何能力可以教给你。

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: "Hmph." Still leaning on the counter, Leorah doesn't move, but twitches an ear up at you. "Do I look like the chatty kind?" No, but it can't hurt to be friendly with one's customers. You're pretty sure that's part of good business acumen or something. Leorah makes a show of stifling a yawn that's almost certainly fake. "Well, I guess you did me a favor, plus there aren't any other customers in the store at the moment. Fine, I won't say no if you want to make small talk. What'll it be?"
rows.translation: “哼。”莱奥拉仍然倚在柜台上，没有动，但她的耳朵微微朝你这边动了动。“我看起来像那种爱闲聊的人吗？” 不，不过与顾客保持友好关系总没有坏处。你应该也明白，这属于良好的商业素养的一部分吧。 莱奥拉故作努力地忍住了哈欠，而那哈欠几乎肯定是假装的。“嗯，我想你确实帮了我一个忙，而且现在店里也没有其他顾客。好吧，如果你想闲聊几句，我也不会拒绝。你想聊些什么呢？”

You're pretty sure that's part of good business acumen or something. Leorah makes a show of stifling a yawn that's almost certainly fake. "Well, I guess you did me a favor, plus there aren't any other customers in the store at the moment. Fine, I won't say no if you want to make small talk. What'll it be?""

rows.translation: 她自己

rows.original: Leorah eyes you. "Eh? Me? Never mind me, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], I'm just your usual everyday girl... and I mean it. Sure, I had an exciting childhood, but most people round these parts had one whether they wanted it or not. You don't come out to the border without a very compelling reason; it's just not safe." You look at her. She looks at you. "Seriously, I don't have a sob story to tell, or some long history you could write a book about. Everyone's got ups and downs in their lives, but it doesn't make you special in the least. I just try to get by, you know? Most of the stuff I have on sale here has more interesting tales to tell than I do; if you're into that kind of thing then maybe you should pick something out for yourself." Yeah, but you weren't asking her about her past or to spill the beans on her life up till now. All you wanted to know was if she has her head on right, and she's giving you this long roundabout story — it really sounds too vigorous a denial for an innocuous question like this. It'd really do her well to be more social. "Feh, I'm as talkative as my job needs me to be, and that's good enough. All right, I'll play this game." There we go. [rand |"I'm gonna let you in on a secret, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. When someone brings in a carcass to me, I make sure every bit gets used. It's not just the pelts and hides that've value; that's what city slickers think. There's plenty of value to be wrung out the average beastie." Oh? "Well, once you've got the pelt off, there's the meat and fat; I don't see why people should balk at something perfectly edible. Some of the fat goes off to Ivris next door to be rendered into tallow and soap. No reason why you can't eat a good number of the organs either, so long as you cook them well to kill parasites; Garth has first dibs on the hearts, livers and intestines for making his special sausages. Guts and offal, you can mash that up into pet food and bait for beasties or fish. Bones, you can make stuff out of them, you can boil them to make soup stock, and what's left over can be sold off to Mistress Ivris; she dissolves them in oil of vitriol to make stuff the local farmers put on their crops. Anything else that I really can't use goes onto the compost heap. "Nothing's ever truly useless, as my mom would say. You just gotta use your imagination a little, and a world of possibilities opens up for you to lay your grubby little hands on." |"I made the trip to Tychris some years ago; wanted to open an account with the bank they have there. Thought it'd help with my finances — you can't fritter away money you don't have on hand — but they soundly rejected my business." Why? "Apparently I was too small, and my business could go any moment. I was what, in their terms, was called a —" she takes great care to pronounce every syllable — "small-medium enterprise. I don't know why that has anything to do with it, I wasn't looking to take out a loan or anything, and Garth has his name on their rolls just fine. "To be honest, I think they just didn't want anything to do with a scruffy cat and made up an excuse to get rid of me. I work with my hands, you see. Nobs and city folk like those you find in Tychris, they look down on us dirt-folk living on the border. Just a bunch of dirty, uncultured, uneducated rubes, not worth their time in the slightest. And now that I'm making enough that I could probably apply to open an account and get away with it, I don't feel like doing it one bit." Huh. "I know enough of the world that I'm not fooled by relative sizes. Folks around these parts may think of Tychris as the big city, but as big cities go it's pretty shit from what it used to be, let alone what you can find in other places like, say, Jassira. The ruling family never quite recovered from losing their heirs under mysterious circumstances literally weeks before the Godswar broke out, and they've been kinda down on their luck since then. That they have a bank within those walls isn't saying much when their vaults are empty and no one outside of the Marches takes their credit." |From the looks of her, she's from Jassira, right? "Hmph. What gave it away? The skin tone?[ party.has cait | Your kitten friend over there's from over the ocean, and she's almost as pale as milk. Never spent a day out in the sun, I reckon." Cait frowns and plants a hand on her hips. "Now, wait a minute —" "It's all right, you temple whores never see the light of day, anyway. Skin might peel in the sun, or you might get a rash, or — well, anything for that matter. All about the moonlight orgies and whatnot." "Now, I won't have the Temple maligned —" Ladies, ladies, this isn't getting anywhere. Back to the topic at hand, please? Leorah faces Cait's death glare head-on and yawns. "Right. So, as I was saying, what gave it away? ]" Weeelll... something like that, but not exactly. You can tell her skin's darker than it used to be, which suggests a lot of strong sunlight out of doors, and it's hard to get much of that out here between the natural climate and the cold. There're some other tells, too, but this was the big one. "Fancy you can tell, considering that was years and years ago. But yes, I'm a first-generation emigrant from Jassira. Little River down by the Frost Hound — he's three generations in, and he's already starting to look more and more like the locals when it comes to fitting in. Can't say I've much love for where I came from, if I'm going to be completely honest." With how laconic and lethargic she is all day, it's hard to imagine Leorah having much love for anything, to be honest. "Oh, that's what you think, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. That's what you think. I'm a cat with hidden depths, I tell you that. For example, this place; I've enough love for Hawkethorne that I don't imagine wanting to pull up my roots any time soon now." What was it about Jassira that led her to leaving, if you might ask? [party.has cait|"Yeah." Cait sniffs and folds her arms under her prodigious boobs. "Surely a practical woman like you couldn't be wanting to see the world like Calla and I did."] Leorah rolls her eyes. "Lemme think... nah, there wasn't any one event that led to me deciding to cross the sea. Getting sick of having to clean sand out of my fur every morning. The Sultana's slew of crazy edicts that were practically changing every two months, so no one knew which was in effect at any time. Having no one left whom I gave a damn about, that really helped me with making the leap. "When I heard that some would-be aristocrat was making the trip over the water, instead of saying 'why', I said 'why not'? And years later, here I am, feeling more at home than I ever did back in the land of sun and sand. It's odd how these things work out sometimes." |So, what's the story behind that bow she's got up on the wall? [ pc.ora catfolk |Despite its quality, it's definitely not of catfolk make, that much is obvious. |[pc.ora wyldelf |You're not sure how she got her hands on a whitewood bow — most wyld or pale elves don't even get to see one — but you're sure there's a good tale behind it. There has to be. |Looks like a neat piece, too neat to be hanging up in a place like this. How she got her hands on it — that's got to be a good tale. ] ] "What?" The bow! "Oh. Uh. It's just spoils of war. Sorry to disappoint, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], but there isn't any high and mighty story to tell." She can pull the other one, it's got bells on. Leorah arches an eyebrow. "No, seriously. Handful of years ago, I'm in a deeper part of the woods when some chubby elf ponce makes her entrance with a couple of what look like retainers, and declares that I'm a something-or-the-other for 'raping the forest.' That's right, little old me, 'raping the forest' and 'engaging in cruel slaughter of the fluffy ones'. "I was going to be nice, too. You see this kind of shit wherever you go, be it Jassira, Tychris or wherever — a young fop gets bored and goes off to harass the little locals on the flimsiest of pretexts, rationalisations so they don't have to feel like they're doing anything wrong." [pc.bg noblescion |Hmm, you don't think you ever engaged in such activity in your time, did you? Sure, you might have had some wild times in the past as a noble scion, but you don't think you ever went out of your way to trouble the little people, as Leorah would put it... "Eh. You gotta look at it from their perspective. What might be a harmless spot of fun to a highborn brat could very well mean the difference between eating or not to someone like me. Although I'll say that you're not a completely bad person yourself, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], so you're probably in the clear. Probably." That's an amazing vote of confidence, coming from her. "Why thank you. I don't know what kind of big shot you used to be, but you've been doing decently since you came to Hawkethorne. Anyways, back to the story..." |[pc.bg courtesan |You've heard of such things happening in your time as a courtesan; careless whispers get around. Guess the little bastards are the same wherever you go, whoever they are... Leorah shrugs. "There's a saying in Jassira: 'wherever you go, the sun is sure to follow.' Some things never change. Anyway, back to the story..." |You don't know about this; you've never had the misfortune to run into one of those lordlings out to have some fun. "Hopefully you don't. It's never a good sign when those types take an interest in you. Anyways, moving on..." ] ] Right. "I knew I couldn't take on the pale elf lordling and her retainers all at once, but I didn't feel like grovelling in front of her either. Only thing left to do was lead them on a merry chase. "That shit about all elves being naturally gifted in the woods? Don't believe it for a moment. Too much good food and not enough exercise'll do them in like anyone else. There isn't an instinct that'll stop you from wheezing and panting all over the place like a blob." [pc.ora wyldelf|Oh, you know full well the truth of that statement.|Makes sense.] "I got the overeager bitch thinking she was on a merry wild hunt after a poor piece of terrified game, separated her from her retainers, then led her over a couple of the snares I'd set up for small game that morning. By the time I was done, I'd taken the little bitch's toys and she was crying that she was going to get her mommy to come after me. "So yes. Spoils of war, and I don't regret it one bit. Little lordling's mommy must've either not been that big a deal, or she agreed with me, 'cause I haven't had any problems since." |This is a nice shop. It's got a lot of personality; it really feels like a place someone like Leorah would be at home in. Leorah throws you a lazy grin. "Yeah, it's kinda sluggish, except when it has to move fast. Bit like me, if you know what I mean — no point in wasting energy on unnecessary stuff. When it's necessary, though, you'll see the goods practically fly off the shelves!" They don't seem to be moving at all... "Then why don't you buy something, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]? Shift some of my inventory? The deals are the best in town, because they're the only ones in town!" A chuckle, and Leorah's tail flicks upwards to thump heavily on the counter. "Seriously, though — this place is nice enough that I'm really feeling it. Don't want to have to move again if it can be helped... I'm kind of attached to the smell that's gathered in the boards and rafters." Looks like it's solidly built, too. "Isn't it? Stout timbers all the way from Westbank, and Garth knows some of the best lads and lasses in the Marches. I did most of the thatching, running up and down the roof, and we threw it together in just two weeks. Looking at how lazy it is now, you'd never imagine all the work that went into building this little establishment of mine." ]
rows.translation: 莱奥拉注视着你。呃？我吗？算了，别管我吧[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]我只不过是个平凡的女孩……我是认真的。当然，我的童年很精彩，但这个地区的大多数人，不管他们愿不愿意，也都经历过这样的童年。如果没有非常充分的理由，人们是不会来到边境地区的；那里实在太不安全了。 你看着她，她也在看着你。 说真的，我并没有什么凄惨的故事可以讲，也没有什么漫长的人生经历可以写成一本书。每个人的生活中都会有起起落落，但这丝毫不能让你变得特别。我只是尽力过好每一天而已。这里出售的大多数商品，它们所蕴含的故事都比我自己的故事更有趣；如果你喜欢这类东西，或许应该为自己挑选一些吧。 是啊，但直到现在你都没有问过她关于她的过去，也没有要求她透露自己生活中的细节。你只是想知道她是否头脑清醒而已，而她却讲了这么一个长篇大论的故事——对于这样一个简单的问题来说，这样的反应未免有些过激了。如果她能多一些社交活动，对她自己肯定会有好处。 哼，我话多多少少也是根据工作需要来决定的，这样就已经够好了。好吧，那我玩这个游戏吧。 好了，就这样。 [rand |我要告诉你一个秘密[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]每当有人把猎物带到我面前时，我都会确保把每一部分都利用起来。其实有价值的并不只是那些皮毛；至少是城里人这么认为的。其实，任何一只普通的野兽，都能被我们挖掘出很多有用的价值。 哦？ rows.raw: " Leorah eyes you. "Eh? Me? Never mind me, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], I'm just your usual everyday girl... and I mean it. Sure, I had an exciting childhood, but most people round these parts had one whether they wanted it or not. You don't come out to the border without a very compelling reason; it's just not safe." You look at her. She looks at you. "Seriously, I don't have a sob story to tell, or some long history you could write a book about. Everyone's got ups and downs in their lives, but it doesn't make you special in the least. I just try to get by, you know? Most of the stuff I have on sale here has more interesting tales to tell than I do; if you're into that kind of thing then maybe you should pick something out for yourself." Yeah, but you weren't asking her about her past or to spill the beans on her life up till now. All you wanted to know was if she has her head on right, and she's giving you this long roundabout story — it really sounds too vigorous a denial for an innocuous question like this. It'd really do her well to be more social. "Feh, I'm as talkative as my job needs me to be, and that's good enough. All right, I'll play this game." There we go. [rand |"I'm gonna let you in on a secret, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. When someone brings in a carcass to me, I make sure every bit gets used. It's not just the pelts and hides that've value; that's what city slickers think. There's plenty of value to be wrung out the average beastie." Oh? "Well, once you've got the pelt off, there's the meat and fat; I don't see why people should balk at something perfectly edible. Some of the fat goes off to Ivris next door to be rendered into tallow and soap. No reason why you can't eat a good number of the organs either, so long as you cook them well to kill parasites; Garth has first dibs on the hearts, livers and intestines for making his special sausages. Guts and offal, you can mash that up into pet food and bait for beasties or fish. Bones, you can make stuff out of them, you can boil them to make soup stock, and what's left over can be sold off to Mistress Ivris; she dissolves them in oil of vitriol to make stuff the local farmers put on their crops. Anything else that I really can't use goes onto the compost heap. "Nothing's ever truly useless, as my mom would say. You just gotta use your imagination a little, and a world of possibilities opens up for you to lay your grubby little hands on." |"I made the trip to Tychris some years ago; wanted to open an account with the bank they have there. By the time I was done, I'd taken the little bitch's toys and she was crying that she was going to get her mommy to come after me. "So yes. Spoils of war, and I don't regret it one bit. Little lordling's mommy must've either not been that big a deal, or she agreed with me, 'cause I haven't had any problems since." |This is a nice shop. It's got a lot of personality; it really feels like a place someone like Leorah would be at home in. Leorah throws you a lazy grin. "Yeah, it's kinda sluggish, except when it has to move fast. Bit like me, if you know what I mean — no point in wasting energy on unnecessary stuff. When it's necessary, though, you'll see the goods practically fly off the shelves!" They don't seem to be moving at all... "Then why don't you buy something, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]? Shift some of my inventory? The deals are the best in town, because they're the only ones in town!" A chuckle, and Leorah's tail flicks upwards to thump heavily on the counter. "Seriously, though — this place is nice enough that I'm really feeling it. Don't want to have to move again if it can be helped... I'm kind of attached to the smell that's gathered in the boards and rafters." Looks like it's solidly built, too. "Isn't it? Stout timbers all the way from Westbank, and Garth knows some of the best lads and lasses in the Marches. I did most of the thatching, running up and down the roof, and we threw it together in just two weeks. Looking at how lazy it is now, you'd never imagine all the work that went into building this little establishment of mine." ]"

rows.original: [rand |"Couldn't be better. Ever since that blizzard came down upon us, there's been no shortage of glory-hunters coming up to the Marches to seek trouble, and they have to stop by Hawkethorne on their way out. The frontier's always been a magnet for those kinds, especially people intending to dig around in the ruins of Old Belhar, but things have practically been abuzz these days. Sure, there're fewer hunters daring to risk larger hauls out in the forest, even if things have settled down a bit, but the volume of would-be adventurers more than makes up for it. I'm even getting coinage minted in the heartlands these days." Has she considered expanding the shop? "Naaaaah." Leorah brings up her tail-tip to the counter and gives it a good thwack. "When people come here, they expect rustic, they expect provincial. This shop, it's got a personality; every building in Hawkethorne does. I have been considering taking on an apprentice to keep up with the workload, but... eh. Finding a suitable lad or lass in town these days interested in this kind of work is hard." |Does she make everything she sells here? "Some. There're things you don't want to leave to the merchants, so they've got to be fashioned by hand by someone you trust instead of someone who'll be gone with the sun. Then, there're custom jobs, pieces that people would like fitted just right. "Then there's the matter of using your imagination — the only way to turn things others wouldn't give a second glance into top-notch wares is to put them together with your own two hands. It's part of why my prices are so low, because I use... aha, clever ways to keep my costs down. More than one way to skin a cat and all." |"Decently. It'd be better if you'd buy something, though. I mean, why else would you come all the way here?" To talk to her? "Ha! Ha! Now there's a good one, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. Life's too short to waste time on just talking — I always forget you're not really from around these parts, eh? Although..." Yes? "It's kinda flattering that you'd want to come all the way here to chat me up, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. Real nice of you. You know what would be nicer? If you'd purchase something off the shelves, that'd be real great." Hey, she doesn't have to steer the conversation back to that all the time... "You asked about business, I answered. It's important to not ask questions that have answers you may not like." |"Pretty good. I'm sure I've said this before, but with more people coming in this way, there've been plenty of opportunities for good business. People keep on finding all kinds of weird stuff out in the wilds, stuff that people from the big cities like Tychris are interested in getting their hands on. Most of the merchants who make their way out there tend to be wholesalers, and I act as a liaison between them and the little guys who end up using their stuff. That's in addition to the things I make on my own, of course." A liaison? Leorah taps her nose, then draws a circle on the wooden counter with her finger. "Imagine you're a trader who's here from Tychris; you want to spend as little time in this dangerous backwater as possible. You've also got a hundred different glory-seekers fresh in from the wilds, each and every one convinced they've found ancient treasures from times beyond imagining. Individually appraising everything they've to offer and negotiating a deal simply takes too long, so you pay someone to do that job for you and pass along the most interesting finds. Am I making sense?" In a way, yes. Is the situation that bad to warrant such, though? "[pc.mf|Buddy|Babe], you would not believe the trash people have tried to pawn off on me. At least the idiots selling ruined offal and chipped teeth vaguely remember what kind of store this is; what in the name of all Seven Gods am I supposed to do with mushrooms and a handful of pine sap? It defies all belief." |"I've finally found someone — many someones, to be precise — to keep me in supply with wyvern venom, so you don't have to worry about that anymore. I won't say no to taking any you might have off your hands, though. Like I said, there any many, many uses for a nonlethal yet effective incapacitating toxin; I'm moving the stuff almost as quickly as I can get my hands on more. Then there's the stuff I keep around for personal use." Personal use, she says. Leorah arches an eyebrow at you. "Not that kind of personal use, if that's what you're thinking. But yeah, like I said — if you get your hands on any extra, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], don't hesitate to come right on up to me. I'll give you a good price." |"Would never think I'd say this, but things are almost too good for my liking. I'm making a good turnover in volume these days, and to be frank I'm not sure what I could spend all the coin that's accumulating in my stash on. I considered having the place redone, but that'd make it lose much of its charm; I'm thinking about just giving away the surplus to Garth or Sanders and having them decide what to do with it. If there's anything those two can be counted upon to do, it's having the good of the village in mind." Ah, yes. The old problem: everyone has money, but there's nothing to buy with it? "No, it's not that, I could pick plenty of things I wanted off caravans traveling the East Tychris route. It's more that... well, my mom used to say that too much success can be a bad thing, and I'm beginning to understand what she meant. On the other hand, if I don't give my job my all, I feel like a dirty slob. So yeah, I think that giving the excess to those two will solve my problems. They'll know what to do with it, because I sure don't, and leaving all that coin stashed away isn't doing much for anyone." That's very noble of her. "Haha, no. Noble is giving when you can't afford it, and I damn well can afford it and more. Gods, they're actually doing me a favor by taking my money out of my hands. Can't claim myself to be some kinda philanthropist when that's the case, can I?" ]
rows.translation: [rand |再好不过了。自从那场暴风雪降临之后，就不断有那些追逐荣耀的人来到边境地区寻衅滋事，而他们在离开的时候都必须要经过鹰棘镇。边境地区向来就是这类人的聚集地，尤其是那些打算在老贝尔哈的废墟里翻找东西的人。而这些天，这里的局势简直热闹非凡。确实，现在越来越少有猎人愿意冒险进入森林去寻找那些价值更高的猎物了，尽管局势已经有所缓和，但那些渴望成为冒险者的年轻人数量却足以弥补这一不足。这些天，我在内陆地区甚至看到了有人开始铸造货币了。" 她有没有考虑过扩大店铺规模呢？ 不……莱奥拉将尾巴尖端抵在柜台上，用力敲了一下。当人们来到这里时，他们期待看到的是乡村风格、具有地方特色的东西。而这家店有自己的个性；鹰棘镇的每栋建筑都是如此。我确实考虑过招个学徒来分担工作量，但是……嗯，现在在城里找到一个对这类工作感兴趣的合适人选确实挺难的。 |她在这里销售的这些商品都是她自己制作的吗？ 有些东西，是你不愿意交给商人们去制作的，因此这些物品必须由你信任的人亲手打造，而不是那些明天就会离开的人。另外，还有一些定制订单，人们希望这些物品能够被精确地制作出来，以满足他们的特殊需求。 "然后关键就在于发挥你的想象力——只有亲手将那些别人根本不会多看一眼的东西组合起来，才能把它们变成一流的成品。这也是我的价格之所以如此低廉的原因之一，因为我采用了……啊哈，一些巧妙的方法来降低成本。毕竟，对付同一件事，总会有多种解决办法的。 |还行吧。不过如果你能买点东西的话会更好。我的意思是，不然你大老远跑过来到底是干什么呢？ 去和她谈谈吗？ 哈！哈！这个可真有趣， [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]人生苦短，不该把时间浪费在闲聊上——我总是忘记你其实并不是这个地方的人，对吧？不过…… 嗯？ 你能专程来到这里来找我聊天，这真的让我感到挺荣幸的。 [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]你真是太好了。你知道什么会更好吗？如果你能从货架上买些东西的话，那就再好不过了。 嘿，她没必要总是把话题重新引回到那个话题上…… 你问到了关于业务的事情，我也给出了回答。重要的是，不要去问那些你可能不会喜欢答案的问题。 |相当不错。我之前应该也说过，随着越来越多的人通过这种方式来到这里，很多不错的商业机会也随之出现了。人们总是在那些荒野地区发现各种奇怪的东西，而像提克里斯这样的大城市里的人，就很想得到这些东西。大多数前往那里的商家都是批发商，而我则充当他们与最终使用这些商品的小商家之间的联络人。当然，这还不包括我自己生产的产品。" 联络人？ 莱奥拉轻敲了一下自己的鼻子，然后用手指在木制柜台上画了一个圆圈。想象一下，你是一名来自提克里斯的商人，你当然希望尽快离开这个危险的偏远之地。同时，还有上百名刚从野外赶来的寻宝者，他们每个人都坚信自己找到了那些超乎想象的古董珍宝。如果逐一评估他们带来的所有物品并协商交易细节，将会耗费太多时间，因此你便雇了别人来替你完成这项工作，然后只把其中最有趣的发现转交给自己。我讲得清楚吗？ 从某种意义上来说，是的。不过，情况真的有那么糟糕吗，以至于需要采取这样的措施吗？ "[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]你绝对想不到人们都试过拿什么垃圾来卖给我。至少那些卖变质内脏和有缺口牙齿的蠢货还隐约记得这是一家什么店；可我到底该怎么处理这些蘑菇和一把松树汁呢？真是让人无法相信。 |我终于找到了一些人——准确来说，是很多人——他们能够持续为我提供翼龙毒液，所以你们再也不用为此担心了。不过，如果你们手头有多余的毒液，我也会欣然接受。正如我所说，这种既不会致命又具有有效致昏效果的物质有着很多用途；我正在尽快获取更多的毒液，同时也会留一些供自己使用。 只是个人使用而已，”她说。 莱奥拉挑了挑眉毛，看着你。不是那种个人用途，如果你是在想这个的话。不过，就像我之前说的——如果你能弄到一些多余的的话[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]如果你有需要，随时都可以来找我。我会给你一个不错的价格。 |真没想到我会说出这种话，但生意好得几乎过头了。这些天我的交易量很大，说实话，我还不确定应该把积攒下来的那些金币用来买什么。我本来考虑过重新装修这个地方，但那样会让它失去很多原有的魅力；所以我在考虑把多余的金币送给加斯或桑德斯，让他们来决定该怎么处理这些钱。如果说有谁一定会为村庄的利益着想的话，那就是这两个人了。 啊，没错。这个老问题：每个人都有钱，但却没有什么东西可以买。 不，不是这样的。其实我可以从沿东提克里斯路线行进的商队那里买到很多我想要的东西。问题在于……嗯，我妈妈以前也说过，过于成功反而可能是一件坏事，现在我开始明白她的意思了。另一方面，如果我不全身心地投入到工作中，我会觉得自己像个懒惰的人。所以，把那些多余的东西送给那两个人，我觉得就能解决我的问题。他们知道该怎么处理这些东西，因为我确实不知道该怎么做，而把那些钱都囤起来，对任何人来说都没有什么好处。 她真是太高尚了。 哈哈，才不是呢。Noble是在你买不起的时候才给你东西，而我呢？我完全买得起，而且还能有余呢。天啊，我把钱交给他们，他们实际上是在帮我的忙。在这种情况下，我怎么能自称是什么慈善家呢，对吧？ ]

rows.original: At the mere mention of wyvern venom, Leorah's ears perk up, and you hear the swishing of the shopkeeper's tail pick up pace, loud enough to be heard over the crackling of the hearth. It's a second or two before she catches herself, but a sheepish grin crosses her face as she realizes you've caught wind of her excitement. "Eh. Congratulations, guess you caught me. Not that I try to make some big secret of it, though — it's not anything bigger than either a drink or a pinch or two of winterstem in the pipe. Girl's got to have her vices, right? At this point, I'd wager most, if not all of Hawkethorne knows already, they just don't say it out loud. Not much point in passing along the whispers when everyone already knows, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]." Did you ever mention it's cute how she keeps on trying to feign disinterest so transparently? Yawning, Leorah pushes herself off the counter, stretches, and slouches back in her chair. "Gotta keep up appearances, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. You look too eager to sell, folks'll catch the scent of desperation and start trying to twist you, regardless of whether you're really harp up or not. I'm a sleepy cat in a sleepy shop in a sleepy town; what more could you ask for?" So, back to the venom... you gather she's been using it for a while now? All the samples she buys from people coming on down from the foothills... "Fuck no. What was the saying again? 'Never get high on your own supply'? When I want some venom for personal use, I go out and wrestle down a wyvern on my own; I can't rough it for weeks like I used to thanks to my knee, but nipping out for a few hours is still more than doable. "No siree, trade goods are just that; I don't use anything earmarked for the store. Besides, the rush you get from wyvern venom more than a day or two old is pretty damn awful; Ivris says it's because the stuff that makes it tick denatu — denatur — goes off really quickly once it's exposed to air. It's still useful for poisoning and the like, but the high just won't be there any more. Having to go through all this trouble to get stuff I can use... it stops a girl from overindulging, and I'm thankful for that." Huuuh. "Although — and let's be frank here — I wouldn't shirk at entertaining gifts, if someone was so kind to pass along some for free." Is she hinting at something? "Maybe. I really don't care either way." After that display of hers when you first brought up the topic, you'll take those words with a grain of salt. "Heh heh. I use it on and off to have a bit of fun, but I don't let it rule my life, you know? Take too much too often and you'll start building up a resistance to it, and then you've got to have more to get the same rush... before you know it, you're up to your eyeballs in debt and nothing else. So no, I'm a big girl now and I can take my vices in moderation." Was that how she busted her knee? Going after wyvern venom? Leorah scratches her chin, and her ears fold forward and to the sides. "Yeah... happened about some years back, when I first arrived in Hawkethorne. It didn't even have a wall in those days, that's how long ago it was — I was wondering what to do other than hunt now that I'd gotten settled in a little. Word came in that there were wyverns in the foothills nearby, so I thought to get some of their spew straight from the tap. "Well, you can see where that got me. I was holding the beastie down when one of her hind claws caught me directly to the side of the kneecap, cut the tendons clean through; I tumbled, and she took the chance to throw me off and wing it. My leg was dangling like some strung-up puppet by the time the other hunters got to me, throw together a stretcher with sticks and canvas, and rushed me to Sanders." Ouch, that sounds painful. "Heh heh. You know, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], there's a really thin line between pleasure and pain — and wyvern venom messes that right up. I don't remember much of what happened save the pink haze, but Sanders says he had to tie my hands together and make me wear scratchy, rough mittens so I wouldn't try and jill myself off until the venom ran its course. I mean, I'd used wyvern venom from time to time, but there and then I fucking developed a taste for it like some people do for gods-damned wine. "Either way, between Ivris and Sanders, they were able to reattach my leg. It never set right at the knee joint, though, so I can't walk long distances without it hurting real bad, let alone climb. I was sitting around for half a year, teaching my leg to obey me like it used to, and I began doing shit for other people. Bowyering, fletching, scraping flesh off pelts, anything I could do to earn my keep. Then one day, Garth's boy Garret — he was just a pup then — comes up and says, 'hey, Miss Leorah, I think you're really good at this, you should open up a shop. Let's face it, you're not going to ever go back to what you used to do. "And that was that, and here I am. Sad story, eh?" A very sad story indeed. It's surprising, though, that someone who's usually as tight-lipped as her would spill out so much of her life story to you. "You did me a good turn, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. That means we're friends now, you know?" A wink. "Not that I'm going to turn into a chatterbox overnight, but I think you deserve as much, eh?"
rows.translation: 一提到翼龙毒液，莱奥拉的耳朵立刻竖了起来，而店主摆动尾巴的声音也变得更快了，那声音大得足以盖过壁炉里燃烧木头的噼啪声。过了一两秒钟，她才回过神来，但当她意识到你注意到了她的兴奋之情时，她脸上浮现出了一丝尴尬的微笑。 嗯，恭喜你，看来你发现我了。不过我并不是想把这件事保密起来——这不过是一杯酒，或者是在烟斗里加那么一点点冬茎而已。女孩子总得有些爱好吧？我想，现在恐怕鹰棘镇镇上大多数人都已经知道了，只是他们没有公开说出来而已。当大家都已经知道这件事的时候，再继续传闲话也没什么意义了。 [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]。" 你有没有注意到，她总是那么明显地试图装作不感兴趣的样子，其实挺可爱的吧？ 莱奥拉打着哈欠，从柜台上站起来，伸了个懒腰，然后又懒洋洋地坐回了椅子里。总得维持表面的体面才行， [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]你们看起来太急于卖东西了，人们会察觉到这种急切，然后就会开始想办法占你们的便宜，不管你们是不是真的在极力推销。我就像是一个生活在偏远小镇上、一家生意冷清的小店里的懒猫——还能有什么更好的处境呢？ 那么，回到这种毒液的问题上……你应该是发现她已经使用这种毒液有一段时间了吧？她从山脚下来的人们那里购买的所有样本…… 绝对不行。有句什么话来着？‘永远不要依赖自己手头的资源来获得满足感’吧？当我需要一些毒液自用时，我会亲自出去把一条翼龙抓来；虽然因为膝盖的问题，我已经不能像以前那样连续几周进行这样的冒险了，但出去待上几个小时还是完全没问题的。 不，女士，交易商品本来就是这样的；我从来不会使用那些专门为商店准备的商品。再说，那些存放了一两天以上的翼龙毒液，带来的效果实在糟糕透了。艾薇莉丝说，这是因为那种让毒液发挥作用的成分一旦接触空气，就会迅速失效。虽然这些毒液仍然可以用来下毒之类的，但效果已经大打折扣了。为了得到自己能用的东西而费尽这些周折……其实这也让一个女孩不会过于放纵自己，对此我感到很庆幸。 呼 虽然说——坦白讲——如果有人好心免费送我一些礼物，我当然会欣然接受。 她是在暗示些什么吗？ 也许吧。其实我两种情况都无所谓。 自从你第一次提起这个话题时，她当时的反应让你觉得，那些话实在不可全信。 呵呵，我偶尔会用它来玩玩而已，但并不会让它控制我的生活，你懂的吧？如果使用得太频繁、用量太大，就会产生抗药性，到时候就麻烦了。更多为了获得同样的快感……不知不觉间，你就会陷入债务的深渊，再无其他东西了。所以，不，我现在已经是个成熟的人了，能够有节制地享受自己的爱好。 她就是这么摔伤膝盖的吗？是因为去采集翼龙的毒液吗？ 莱奥拉抓了抓下巴，她的耳朵向前然后向两侧耷了下来。是的……那是几年前我刚来到鹰棘镇的时候发生的。那时候那里甚至还没有围墙，时间确实已经过去这么久了。当时我刚安顿下来，不知道该做些什么，除了打猎之外也没别的办法。后来有人告诉我，附近的山脚下有翼龙，于是我就想着直接去抓些它们的唾液来用。 嗯，你们可以想象那让我陷入了多大的麻烦。当时我正在按住那只野兽，结果它的后爪直接抓中了我的膝盖侧面，把肌腱完全割断了；我摔倒了，而它趁机逃脱了。等到其他猎人赶到我的身边，用树枝和帆布搭了一个担架，把我赶紧送到了桑德斯那里，我的腿当时就像一个被吊起来的木偶一样悬在那里。 哎哟，那听起来真疼啊。 呵呵，你知道的[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]快乐与痛苦之间的界限其实非常模糊——而翼龙的毒液恰恰把这种界限彻底打破了。我几乎不记得发生了什么，只记得眼前有一片粉红色的雾气。不过桑德斯说，他不得不把我的手绑起来，还给我戴上那些粗糙、刺痒的手套，这样我就不会在毒液发挥作用之前试图自残了。说真的，我之前也偶尔使用过翼龙的毒液，但那次之后，我竟然真的对它产生了某种癖好，就像有些人对该死的葡萄酒一样。 不管怎样，多亏了艾薇莉丝和桑德斯，他们终于帮我重新接上了腿。不过，膝盖关节处始终没能恢复正常，所以如果走太久，就会感到非常疼痛，更别提爬山了。我有半年时间都在努力让我的腿重新适应我的控制，后来就开始帮别人做一些小事了。博耶林、制作箭羽、从兽皮上刮下肉来……只要是我能做的任何事情，我都会去做，只为谋生。直到有一天，加斯的儿子加雷特——那时他还只是个幼犬——走过来对我说：“嘿，莱奥拉小姐，我觉得你真的很擅长这些活计，你应该开一家店吧。说实话，你再也不会回到过去的生活方式了。 就这样，然后我就来到了这里。真是个悲伤的故事，嗯？ 确实是一个非常悲伤的故事。不过，令人惊讶的是，像她这样通常守口如瓶的人，竟然会向你倾诉这么多关于她自己的人生经历。 你真是帮了我大忙， [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]这意味着我们现在已经是朋友了，你知道吗？眨一下眼。并不是说我会一夜之间变得话多起来，但我觉得你确实应该得到这些，对吧？
rows.raw: " At the mere mention of wyvern venom, Leorah's ears perk up, and you hear the swishing of the shopkeeper's tail pick up pace, loud enough to be heard over the crackling of the hearth. It's a second or two before she catches herself, but a sheepish grin crosses her face as she realizes you've caught wind of her excitement. "Eh. Congratulations, guess you caught me. Not that I try to make some big secret of it, though — it's not anything bigger than either a drink or a pinch or two of winterstem in the pipe. Girl's got to have her vices, right? At this point, I'd wager most, if not all of Hawkethorne knows already, they just don't say it out loud. Not much point in passing along the whispers when everyone already knows, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]." Did you ever mention it's cute how she keeps on trying to feign disinterest so transparently? Yawning, Leorah pushes herself off the counter, stretches, and slouches back in her chair. "Gotta keep up appearances, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. You look too eager to sell, folks'll catch the scent of desperation and start trying to twist you, regardless of whether you're really harp up or not. I'm a sleepy cat in a sleepy shop in a sleepy town; what more could you ask for?" So, back to the venom... you gather she's been using it for a while now? All the samples she buys from people coming on down from the foothills... "Fuck no. What was the saying again? 'Never get high on your own supply'? When I want some venom for personal use, I go out and wrestle down a wyvern on my own; I can't rough it for weeks like I used to thanks to my knee, but nipping out for a few hours is still more than doable. "No siree, trade goods are just that; I don't use anything earmarked for the store. Besides, the rush you get from wyvern venom more than a day or two old is pretty damn awful; Ivris says it's because the stuff that makes it tick denatu — denatur — goes off really quickly once it's exposed to air. It's still useful for poisoning and the like, but the high just won't be there any more. Having to go through all this trouble to get stuff I can use... it stops a girl from overindulging, and I'm thankful for that." Huuuh. "Although — and let's be frank here — I wouldn't shirk at entertaining gifts, if someone was so kind to pass along some for free." Is she hinting at something? "Maybe. I really don't care either way." After that display of hers when you first brought up the topic, you'll take those words with a grain of salt. "Heh heh. I use it on and off to have a bit of fun, but I don't let it rule my life, you know? Take too much too often and you'll start building up a resistance to it, and then you've got to have more to get the same rush... before you know it, you're up to your eyeballs in debt and nothing else. So no, I'm a big girl now and I can take my vices in moderation." Was that how she busted her knee? Going after wyvern venom? Leorah scratches her chin, and her ears fold forward and to the sides. "Yeah... happened about some years back, when I first arrived in Hawkethorne. It didn't even have a wall in those days, that's how long ago it was — I was wondering what to do other than hunt now that I'd gotten settled in a little. Word came in that there were wyverns in the foothills nearby, so I thought to get some of their spew straight from the tap. "Well, you can see where that got me. I was holding the beastie down when one of her hind claws caught me directly to the side of the kneecap, cut the tendons clean through; I tumbled, and she took the chance to throw me off and wing it. My leg was dangling like some strung-up puppet by the time the other hunters got to me, throw together a stretcher with sticks and canvas, and rushed me to Sanders." Ouch, that sounds painful. "Heh heh. You know, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], there's a really thin line between pleasure and pain — and wyvern venom messes that right up. I don't remember much of what happened save the pink haze, but Sanders says he had to tie my hands together and make me wear scratchy, rough mittens so I wouldn't try and jill myself off until the venom ran its course. I mean, I'd used wyvern venom from time to time, but there and then I fucking developed a taste for it like some people do for gods-damned wine. "Either way, between Ivris and Sanders, they were able to reattach my leg. It never set right at the knee joint, though, so I can't walk long distances without it hurting real bad, let alone climb. I was sitting around for half a year, teaching my leg to obey me like it used to, and I began doing shit for other people. Bowyering, fletching, scraping flesh off pelts, anything I could do to earn my keep. Then one day, Garth's boy Garret — he was just a pup then — comes up and says, 'hey, Miss Leorah, I think you're really good at this, you should open up a shop. Let's face it, you're not going to ever go back to what you used to do. "And that was that, and here I am. Sad story, eh?" A very sad story indeed. It's surprising, though, that someone who's usually as tight-lipped as her would spill out so much of her life story to you. "You did me a good turn, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. That means we're friends now, you know?" A wink. "Not that I'm going to turn into a chatterbox overnight, but I think you deserve as much, eh?""

rows.original: To your surprise, Leorah blushes, the usually dispassionate shopkeeper straightening up as color rises into her dusky skin and her aloof demeanour melts away. Her ears fold forward as she leans over the counter towards you, a grin on her face that you can't quite decide is sheepish or impish. "Ex-cuse me, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]? Did I hear you right? Did you just say you wanted a roll in the furs with me, or should I be cleaning out my ears?" The steady thump-thump-thump of Leorah's tail on the floorboards leaves little doubt that she knows full well what you said; she just wants you to repeat it for — why, exactly? To watch you squirm? To just be able to hear you say it again? Leorah's elbows are planted firmly on the countertop while she cradles her chin in her hands, waiting expectantly. Fine, fine. You're indeed asking if she wouldn't mind a roll in the furs, as she puts it. Is she happy now? "Ah-ha-ha-ha. Ahahahaha! It's been a while since anyone propositioned me, let alone was so direct about it!" Choking on her own laughter, Leorah swivels her head to survey her shop. "Thank the Seven there's no one in here but you and me... [party.som|smart move, coming alone to say it|and your friend can stay silent|and your friends know how to keep a secret], eh? Girl like me might have died of embarrassment, and then where would we be, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]?" Embarrassment? Her? Come on, she's usually so calm, it's usually impossible to get a rise out of her! "Heh. Like I said, it's just been a while since someone actually dared to ask. A long, long while." Or thought she'd be interested in the first place. That aloofness, it doesn't swell the confidence of any would-be suitor... "But you asked anyway." Purring, Leorah extends her index finger and scratches your chin. "You're an interesting one, [pc.mf|buddy|babe], to overcome all that and ask someone who by all appearances is a jaded old broad for a romp — and without even so much as buying me a meal first. Not to mention, at such a convenient time... "Because I was slated to go into heat a day or two ago, and it's been long overdue." At that, the dusky catgirl practically leaps up onto the counter, kicking off her sandals in one swift motion. Before you know it, she's grabbed you by the collar and is staring you in the eye, her bosom heaving under her vest as she looses the trembling breath she'd been holding. [pc.ra lupine catfolk|She's not lying. You can smell the heat pouring off Leorah, waves of deep, musky scent that seep from every pore in waves. The heavy scent of tanning goods and the shop itself had masked it quite well, but now that she's all up and in your face you can't escape it. Tempestuous and tempting, that's what it is — coiling about your throat like a noose and singing to something in the back of your mind.] [party.hasCompanions |"Now, I don't suppose we could get some privacy, could we? I've got a few things I'd like to work off." |"Timely and fortuitous indeed. No one's bothered to ask me in years." Maybe they'd be less intimidated if she smiled a little more often. "Haha! Ha!" ] [party.has cait brint |[party.has cait|You look around for Cait, but she's already halfway to the door, giving you a cheery wave and a swish of her sinfully short skirts as she turns the handle. "Oh my, look at what the ice queen's been hiding all along. Back at the temple, there were girls who'd put on that kind of show for the laity who preferred the chilly type... but it looks like you've got the real deal here. Have fun, the two of you! If there's any itch that she can't scratch, [pc.name], let me know once you're done and we're alone, okay?" With that, she's out, the door shutting behind her bubblegum-pink tail with a note of finality.] [party.has brint|"You know, back home it's usually the men who do the asking," Brint says with a grin on his face. "But every now and again one of the womenfolk get in this sort of mood, and it's usually not done to get in her way. Not that any red-blooded minotaur would do so, of course! I'd enjoy myself if I were you; it's not every day that they're so eager." Throwing you a mock salute, Brint heaves open the door to the little shop and is gone in the blink of an eye.] |[party.som ||[comp1.name] looks around at the scene and quickly decides that [comp1.heShe] shouldn't linger where [comp1.heShe]'s not wanted. "Uh, have fun. I'll wait for you back at the Frost Hound, okay?" |[comp1.name] and [comp2.name] look at each other for all of a moment, then grin and start backing towards the door. "Hey, have fun. We'll wait for you back at the Frost Hound, okay?" ] ] "Now then, I don't see any reason to drag this out. Girl's got needs, you [pc.isFemale|should know well enough|know]." Rolling her shoulders, Leorah drops her hands from your collar to the buckles on her vest and starts undoing them. "Didn't fancy you as the one who'd actually work up the guts to ask, but life's full of surprises like that." M-maybe she should slow down a bit; the door's not bolted. Couldn't someone just walk in on — "That's kind of the point, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]. Anyone could step into the store and catch us doing the nasty on the rug? Only makes it all the more exciting. It's what a tough and aloof girl like me would do, isn't it?" The vest's off now, with the undershirt already unbuttoned and soon to follow. Tossing her clothing onto the counter, Leorah eyes you, still fully clothed. "What's the matter? Shy all of a sudden? It's okay, I'll take care of you nice and good." Wait, that's not — you don't even have time to finish the thought before the dusky catgirl pounces onto you, the suddenness of her movements knocking you backwards into the soft bearskin rug. Leorah's struggling to keep a straight face, but the steadily spreading rust-brown patch on her face and the way her palmable breasts are heaving in her makeshift bra betray what's going on in her head. [pc.strengthRange 50|While you're pretty sure you could throw her off any time you liked, there's something so earnest about her movements that it's hard to find the heart to do it.] "You asked. Don't ask questions you're not ready to receive the answers to, [pc.mf|buddy|babe]." Without further ado, Leorah commences pulling off your [pc.armor], then proceeds to the rest of you and herself. Before long, the two of you are in your birthday suits on the bearskin rug, the heat from the roaring hearth licking at your [pc.skinFurScales]. The dusky catgirl shoves you onto your back, purring deep in her throat, and the thick, rich fur of the rug is more than inviting as she clambers atop your legs.
rows.translation: 令你惊讶的是，莱奥拉竟然脸红了——这个平时冷若冰霜的店主，此刻的肌肤因羞涩而泛起红晕，她那疏离的态度也仿佛随之消失了。她把耳朵凑到柜台前，朝你微笑，那笑容让你一时分不清她是害羞还是在顽皮。 打扰一下， [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]我听清楚了吗？你刚才说的是想和我一起享受那些美好的时光，还是说我该去检查一下耳朵是不是有问题？ 利奥拉的尾巴在地板上不断有规律地敲打着，这一声声声响得再清楚不过了——她其实完全明白你说了什么；她只是想让你再重复一遍而已……究竟是为了什么呢？是为了看你尴尬地扭动身体吗？还是仅仅是为了再听你把那些话说出来而已？利奥拉的双肘牢牢地撑在台面上，双手托着下巴，正满怀期待地等待着。 好吧，好吧。你其实是在问，用她自己的话来说，她是否不介意在那些毛皮上打滚一番。现在，她开心了吗？ 啊哈哈哈，哈哈哈！已经有好久没有人向我提出这样的要求了，更不用说还这么直截了当了！被自己的笑声呛到，莱奥拉转过头来环顾着自己的店铺。谢天谢地，这里除了你和我之外没有其他人…… [party.som|真是个明智的决定，你居然独自过来承认这一点。|而你的朋友也可以选择保持沉默。|你的朋友们也懂得如何保守秘密。]呃？像我这样的女孩恐怕早就尴尬得死了，那样的话，我们现在还会在哪里呢？ [pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]？" 尴尬？她？得了吧，她平时可冷静了，通常根本不可能让她生气或感到尴尬的！ 呵呵，就像我说的，已经有很长时间没有人敢这么问了……真的很久很久了。 或者以为她本来就会对此感兴趣。那种冷漠的态度，绝对不会让任何追求者感到有信心…… 但你还是问了。莱奥拉发出呼噜声，伸出食指轻轻挠了挠你的下巴。你真是个有趣的人[pc.mf|伙计|宝贝]要克服这一切，还要去向一个看上去如此老练、对感情已经厌倦的女人提出约会请求——而且她甚至都没有先请我吃顿饭。更不用说，选择的时间还这么凑巧…… 因为一两天前我就该进入发情期了，而这个过程早就该发生了。 说着，那个皮肤黝黑的猫女几乎是跳上了柜台，动作敏捷地脱掉了自己的凉鞋。转眼间，她就抓住了你的衣领，直视着你的眼睛，她胸前的背心随着她急促的呼吸而微微起伏。 [pc.ra lupine catfolk|她没有撒谎。你能闻到从莱奥拉身上散发出来的浓烈气味，那种深沉、带有麝香味的香气从她的每一个毛孔中渗出来。之前，晒黑用品的浓重气味以及商店本身的环境让这种气味被很好地掩盖住了，但现在她就这样站在你面前，你再也无法逃避它了。这种气味狂暴而诱人，就像一条套在你脖子上的绞索，同时在你脑海中引发某种复杂的反应。] [party.hasCompanions |现在，我想我们应该可以有点私人空间了吧？我有些事情需要认真思考一下。 |真是恰逢其时，又充满巧合。竟然没人费心来问我一下多年。" 如果她能多笑一些，或许他们就不会那么害怕了。 哈哈！哈！ ] [party.has cait brint |[party.has rows.original: "So, what do you want to talk about?"
rows.translation: “那么，你想聊些什么呢？”
rows.raw: '\n    "So, what do you want to talk about?"'

rows.original:
"Aww, how sweet. You want to hear about me?"

    [pc.dcb|Obviously. Why else would you have asked?|Yeah, you do. Does she not get that question very often?|Like, of course you want to hear about her! Why wouldn't you?]
    
    "Well, if you're really curious, I'm a simple goblin widow whose kids have all since moved out to live their lives. My husband was a fellow goblin, so all my kids are the classic green and short goblins people expect."
    
    
    What about her parents? She doesn't look any different from how you'd picture a goblin either.
    
    "That's a bit of an odd story. My mom was a goblin, but I actually never knew my dad. Apparently, he didn't like the idea of raising a kid, so he bolted as soon as he found out he'd knocked up my mom. The only thing I know about him is that he wasn't a goblin. Any time I'd ask mom about 'im, she'd just yell that he was a good-for-nothing and not give me a straight answer." She gives a slight shrug and a half smile before continuing, "If I had to guess, he was probably an orc and I got his drinking ability."
    
    What was she like before she got married? Was she always a seamstress?
    
    "Pfft, no. In my youth, I was, as many young goblins are, an adventurer. I was fascinated by the world around me, and I loved seeing new places. During my travels, I saw everything from ancient ruins to staggeringly large cities to caves lined with crystals that glittered when the sun came up. Each new sight was something fun and interesting."
    
    How did she meet her husband, then?
    
    "Well, he was a traveling merchant at the time, and with me being an adventurer, we crossed paths a few times. Each time we did, we'd flirt a little and, after one such time, well, he took me back to his room in the local tavern, and the next thing you know, he's asking me to stay with him. We were both romantic—and young, for that matter—so I said yes. He'd also gotten me pregnant, though we didn't know it yet. So, he agreed to come back here with me, and we started raising our family. He kept up his merchant traveling, but I gave up adventuring to raise our kids."
    
    What happened to him?
    
    "He was traveling and his caravan was waylaid by bandits. That's about all I know, besides the fact that the next time I saw him, he was no longer breathing." At this point, a few tears have begun to well up in her eyes. She quickly brushes them aside with her finger, then resumes. "So, I took up being a seamstress. Had to find some way to afford to feed my children, after all."
    
    "Anything else you want to hear about?"
rows.translation:
“哎呀，真贴心。你想听听我的故事？”

    [pc.dcb|显然如此，不然你为什么要问？|当然想。难道她不常听到别人问这个问题吗？|那当然啦，你肯定想听她讲自己的故事！怎么可能不想呢？]
    
    “好吧，既然你真的好奇，我不过是个普通的哥布林寡妇，孩子们如今都已搬出去过自己的生活。我的丈夫也是哥布林，因此我的孩子全都是人们印象里那种经典的绿色矮个哥布林。”
    
    
    那她的父母呢？她的外表看起来同样与想象中的哥布林没有区别。
    
    “这件事说来有些古怪。我妈妈是哥布林，可我其实从没见过自己的父亲。听说他不愿意养孩子，一发现自己让妈妈怀孕，就立刻逃之夭夭了。我只知道他不是哥布林。每次我问妈妈关于他的事，她总会大骂那家伙一无是处，却从不给我一个明确答案。”她微微耸肩，露出淡淡的笑容，接着说道：“要我猜的话，他很可能是个兽人，而我继承了他的酒量。”
    
    她结婚以前是什么样子？一直都是裁缝吗？
    
    “噗，当然不是。年轻时，我就像许多年轻哥布林一样，是一名冒险者。我对周遭的世界充满好奇，也喜欢见识新的地方。旅途中，我见过一切：从古老遗迹和大得令人咋舌的城市，到日出时会闪闪发亮、四壁铺满水晶的洞窟。每一处新景象都新鲜有趣。”
    
    那么，她后来是怎么认识丈夫的？
    
    “嗯，当时他是个旅行商人，而我是个冒险者，所以我们偶遇过几次。每次见面，我们都会调几句情。有一次调情后，那个……他把我带回了当地酒馆的房间，等我回过神来，他已经在请求我留在身边了。我们都很浪漫——而且说到底也都很年轻——所以我答应了。当时他也已经让我怀上孩子，不过我们还不知道。因此，他同意跟我一起回到这里，我们开始共同养育家庭。他继续四处经商，我则放弃冒险，留在家里抚养孩子。”
    
    他后来怎么了？
    
    “他在旅行途中，商队遭到了强盗伏击。除此之外，我只知道再见到他时，他已经停止了呼吸。”说到这里，她的眼中开始涌出几滴泪水。她迅速用手指将其抹去，继续说道：“所以，我就当起了裁缝。毕竟总得想办法赚钱养活孩子们。”
    
    “你还想听些什么？”

rows.translation: 关于她

rows.original: "So, I mentioned how I started off as an adventurer, right? Well, in my travels, you pick up a few skills in order to keep your quality of life up. Given the battering my clothes took, it was only natural I got good at sewing. Then, to keep costs down, I used those same skills when my kids were born. Most of their clothes were handmade, I'm proud to say!" She pauses for a moment, her face suddenly moving from intense pride to one of sorrow. "When my husband... my husband passed, I had to find some way to provide for my family. I wasn't going to leave them behind to go try to adventure, and they were far too young for me to take with me. So, I started off by just patching up clothes for enough money to get myself some resources accumulated." "Once I had some electrum, I was able to afford the materials to start making clothes to sell, and I found myself enjoying such things. I picked up a little skill called haberdashery from some of the old tomes I'd scavenged back in my youth to further offset costs, and began making my living. Eventually, one of the locals came to me asking for a gift for his wife. Some fancy underclothes of some kind. Next thing I knew, there was a decent demand for the stuff." With a shrug and a half-smirk, she continues, "Within a few months, I had a stall. These days, most of the town has some of my products, so I make most of my income from patching up clothes and the like, but I don't need nearly as much money anymore, given that I live alone these days." "Anything else on your mind?"
rows.translation: “所以，我之前提到过自己最初是如何成为一名冒险者的，对吧？在旅途中，为了保证自己的生活质量，人们会学会一些技能。由于我的衣服经常被损坏，所以我自然而然地掌握了缝纫技术。后来，为了降低成本，我的孩子们出生后，我也运用了那些同样的技巧。他们的衣服大多是手工制作的，我可以为此感到自豪！” 她停顿了一下，脸上的表情突然从强烈的自豪转为悲伤。“当我丈夫……我丈夫去世后，我必须想办法养活我的家人。我不可能丢下他们，自己跑去冒险，而他们实在太小了，我没法带在身边。所以，我最初只是靠修补衣物赚些钱，好为自己攒下一些资源。” “等到我攒到了一些琥珀金币，我就有足够的资金来购买制作衣物的材料了，于是我开始自己制作衣物并出售它们，而且我发现，自己真的很喜欢这个过程。我在年轻时翻阅的一些古老典籍中学会了一门叫做“布料裁剪”的手艺，以此来进一步降低成本，从而维持生计。后来，有位当地人找到我，请求我为他的妻子制作一份礼物。是一些花哨的内衣之类的东西。后来我发现，这些商品其实很有市场需求。” 她耸了耸肩，露出一丝微笑，继续说道：“几个月后，我就有了自己的摊位。现在，镇上差不多到处都有我的商品了。我的主要收入来源是修补衣服之类的活计，不过由于我现在独自生活，所以需要的钱也少多了。” “你还有其他想说的吗？”

rows.translation: 她的商店

rows.original: "Curious about my family, eh? Well, as I've said before, I have kids. Three of them, in fact. You know, in case you couldn't tell from my... matronly figure," Nelia says with a wink. "My eldest, Keala, has always had a craving for action; he's a traveling gladiator. He spends most of his time off in the Heartland, but he likes to come home every couple months. When I'm really lucky, he brings with him some interesting textiles or other materials that he either found or won during his free time in the city just for me. I think he was on his way to Khor'minos to participate in some grand event or something there." "My middle child is another son, named Arden. He traveled as a merchant—following in his father's footsteps, that one—for a while, but, during a trip to Tychris, he met himself a nice Salamander girl. Any time he went to Tychris, he would go on dates with her. Then, one day, he brought her a ring during his travels, and the next thing I knew, they were married. It was a lovely wedding, and she has a wonderful family. He... he lives over in Tychris with her now, and I do go visit occasionally.... Gotta see my adorable grandkids, after all." A huge smile crosses Nelia's face as she then begins to tell you about them, "The little blue scales on the oldest and the tail flame of their daughter and their middle son's blue eyes and the blue skin of the youngest and oh they're just so adorable." Realizing what she was doing, Nelia pauses for a moment, a blush spreading into her cheeks. "Sorry... I get excited when I talk about my grandkids. I guess that means I'm getting old and grandmotherly," she says with a weary chuckle. [pc.dcb|"At least you've still got your figure. You may be getting old but you're not ugly yet," you say. "Pfft, yeah, I guess that's consolation," she responds, sneering slightly.|"Hey, you're not old just yet. Still got plenty of years left in you, and you certainly don't look particularly old," you console. "That's awfully kind of you to say. rows.original: "Oh, goblins? We're an odd bunch, to say the least. See, goblins can mate with any other race, but every child from a goblin is born a goblin. You know, like harpies, right? 'Cept we have both genders—and then some, on occasion, but we'll get there in a moment—and harpies have only got females. Now here's where things get strange: if one of the parents isn't a goblin, the child gets one or two of the traits of that parent's race." She pauses for a moment, checking to see if you understand. In response, you give a short nod for her to continue. "So, for example, if one parent is a goblin and the other is a lupine, the kid might come out covered in fur, with a tail, with fangs, or any other number of things. Sometimes, like with me, you can't even tell at first glance what one of the parents was. They get just one or two traits from that parent, but the rest stays goblin. Their children are goblins, and those children can take on new traits. There are all sorts of theories about what happens if a group of goblins mates with the same race for too many generations, but so far no one has really been able to get a solid answer on what happens." "There's a bit more about us to talk about, but really, that's the big thing that makes us different from most other races. A scholar could probably tell you more about our history, but that's way out of my realm of knowledge." "Got anything else you want to talk about?"
rows.translation: “哦，哥布林？至少可以说，我们是一群很特别的家伙。你看，哥布林可以与任何其他种族交配，但哥布林生下的孩子无一例外都是哥布林。你知道的，就像鹰身女妖一样，对吧？只不过我们既有雄性也有雌性——偶尔还会有其他性别，不过这个稍后再说——而鹰身女妖只有雌性。事情奇怪的地方在于：如果父母中有一方不是哥布林，孩子就会继承那个种族的一两个特征。” 她停顿片刻，确认你是否听懂。你简短地点点头，示意她继续。 “举个例子，如果父母一方是哥布林，另一方是狼族，那么孩子可能浑身长毛、长出尾巴或獠牙，也可能出现其他各种特征。有时候，就像我这样，第一眼甚至根本看不出父母中另一方是什么种族。他们只从那一方继承一两个特征，其余部分仍然是哥布林。他们生下的孩子也是哥布林，而这些孩子又可能获得新的特征。关于一群哥布林连续太多代都与同一种族交配会发生什么，人们提出过各种理论，但至今仍没人能给出确切答案。” “关于我们还有一些可说的，不过这才是我们与大多数其他种族最主要的区别。学者或许能告诉你更多关于我们历史的事情，但那就远远超出我的知识范围了。” “还有什么想聊的吗？”

rows.original: "Well, if you wanna hear my thoughts on some of my fellow townsfolk, we might as well go through the list, I guess. "Garth is one of the nicest men in the town, though he has every right to not be, what with all he's been through. He's done his damnedest to raise his kids right, which is hard as hell for any single parent. I speak from experience on that. I can't imagine how much of a pain in the ass Garret was. Garth has also managed to run one fine establishment, here. Serves some damn good ale at that." She gives her empty tankard a wiggle and goes to take a swig, only to realize part way that it is, in fact, empty. She puts it back down and pouts, before returning to the conversation. That's probably a fair analysis[var1|, especially knowing Garret]. She's also spot on about the quality of the ale. "Sanders is another nice guy. Lotta history there. I hear he used to be part of some kind of order back in the day, but don't know too much about it. To be entirely honest, while I think he's nice, religion was never really my thing. Been in too many old, ruined temples and the like to put much thought to it." [flags.NELIA_ABOUT_HER_TALK|It makes sense, given her adventuring past. Maybe at some point you could hear some of her stories about what all she saw during her youth.|You pause for a moment wondering why she would have seen ruined temples. Maybe there's more to this goblin woman than you thought.] "Ogrish is fairly decent to be around. On occasion, I'll visit his shop for any metallic items I need for my work, such as belt buckles or what have you. Any time I visit him, I always enjoy our conversations." She hesitates for a moment before adding, "Even if our conversations are rather one-sided in my favor." [pc.dcb|You snort at the truth of the statement|You let out a knowing chuckle but say no more|You tilt your head to the side, not quite catching her meaning]. "Leorah is a grump, but I'm pretty sure all that apathy she has is fake. She's definitely cute though, and I can't imagine she'll stay single for long. Shame about her leg, though. That wyvern did a number on her." [flags.LEORAH_CHAT_VENOM|[flags.LEORAH_FUCKED|While her leg injury is certainly unfortunate, you've gotten some nice rewards for assuaging her pain to say the least.|Her reason for wrestling the wyvern girl is certainly also unfortunate. Not to mention her added cravings for it since.]|You wonder for a moment why Leorah was out and able to be injured by a wyvern in the first place. Maybe you should try and ask her about it later.] "I'm going to be honest, I've never really known what to think of Ivris. She certainly seems polite, but her ability to see and all the alchemy stuff really throws me off." [flags.IVRIS_ALCHEMY|Whatever your opinion of her, Ivris taught you the basics of alchemy. That counts for something.|You wonder if Ivris could teach you some of that %"alchemy stuff." It might come in handy at some point.] "Gwyn is such a sweet girl. I can't believe her baby daddy ran off! What an asshole. I love what she's doing with the nursery though. I wish it had been around when I was raising my kids, sure would have made my life a helluva lot easier." [var0|She's certainly been a help to you.|You're sure the nursery will come in handy if you end up with any offspring.] "[var1|I'm glad to see Garret back. He's a rambunctious boy, and he causes his father no end of grief, but he's got a good heart. [garret.fucked|I will say, I'm glad that boy finally got laid; he's needed it|You know, if he wasn't such a dunce sometimes, he could probably be swimming in pussy. He's quite the hunk, after all]." You flash a grin, in no small part because of your hand in getting him back.|I'm really worried about Garth's son Garret. "Hey Neila, I have a... horse... that needs some riding gear," you say, giving her a look. "Namely, I need some reins and maybe a riding crop. I know you work with leather. Any chance you could look into making some for me?"

    "Making? Oh, I have some you can just buy," the goblin says with a chuckle. "A set of adjustable reins and a riding crop. I even have a pair of cuffs if your... horse... is a little ornery, if you'd like them."
    
    "You know what? I think I'll take those too," you decide, giving her a nod. "How much all up?"
    
    "I could let the set go for around 300 electrum," Neila says. "It's a few years aged, but hasn't been used. I'll replace the bit — that's the part that goes in the mouth, if you're not an experienced jockey — for free."
rows.translation:
“嘿，内莉娅，我有匹……马……需要一些骑乘装备。”你意味深长地看着她说道，“具体来说，我需要缰绳，也许还要一根马鞭。我知道你会制作皮具，能替我做一套吗？”

    “做？哦，我这里就有现成的可以买。”哥布林轻笑道，“一套可调节的缰绳和一根马鞭。要是你的……马……脾气不太好，我还有一副束具；你喜欢的话也可以买走。”
    
    “你知道吗？我看束具也一起要了。”你点头决定道，“总共多少钱？”
    
    “整套大概卖三百琥珀金。”内莉娅说道，“放了几年，不过没用过。我会免费更换嚼子——如果你不是经验丰富的骑手，那就是塞进嘴里的部分。”

rows.original: "Sounds great. Do you think the bit will fit in a minotaur's snout?" you ask casually. "Oh, yes," Neila says, smiling. "Don't worry about that. Let me just dig them up for you, I'll be back in a moment." She goes rifling through a bunch of miscellaneous equipment — some of which certainly draws your attention — and emerges victorious with a set of reins, along with a riding crop and a pair of cuffs you think might just fit around Brint's wrists. "You've got quite the collection there," you say with a smile. "Thanks, Neila." "Not a problem," she says, giving you a wave. "Say hello to your horse for me."
rows.translation: 听起来不错。你觉得那个东西能放进弥诺陶洛斯的鼻子里吗？”你随意地问道。 “哦，当然可以，”妮拉微笑着回答，“别担心这个。让我去把它们找出来，马上就回来。” 她开始在一堆杂七杂八的装备中翻找——其中有些装备确实引起了你的注意——最终她拿出一套缰绳、一根马鞭以及一副手铐，你心想可能正好适合布林特的手腕。 “你的收藏还真不少啊，”你微笑着说，“谢谢你，妮拉。” “不客气，”她挥了挥手，“代我向你的马问好吧。

rows.original:
"Hey Nelia, do you think you could make me a fishnet outfit? I'd like one with really wide nets," you ask, roughly approximating the net size with your fingers. 
    
    "Sure! I take it you're looking for a full body number then, since you said outfit? Do you want it separate between the top and bottoms? I could do it either way," she asks, already ruffling through her things to find materials.
    
    You hadn't really thought about it that in depth, but you guess a full body outfit would make the most sense.
    
    "Hmm. I might need you to get me some drider silk. Do you think you can get some for me? I'll also need two thousand electrum for the enchanted dyes I'll need to make sure the silk doesn't tear and can stretch to fit you." she asks.
     
    "Sure! I think I can manage that," you reply. You'll need to find some silk to get your order completed.
rows.translation:
嘿，内莉娅，你能不能为我做一套网眼装啊？我想要那种网眼非常宽的款式，”你一边说，一边用手指大致比划着网眼的大小。
    
    “当然可以！那么你应该想要一套能覆盖全身的款式吧，因为你说的确实是‘一套装’啊。你是想把上半身和下半身的衣服分开来吗？两种方式我都可以做到，”她边说边开始翻找自己的东西，寻找所需的材料。
    
    其实你之前并没有仔细考虑过这个问题，但想来，一套完整的服装会是最合理的选择吧。
    
    嗯，我可能需要你帮我弄一些飞龙丝。你觉得你能帮我搞到吗？另外，我还需要两千枚电银来购买那些特殊的染料，这样才能确保飞龙丝不会破裂，而且能够充分伸展，适合你的身材。她问道。
     
    “当然可以！我想我能完成这个任务，”你回答道。你需要找到一些丝绸才能完成这个订单。

"Hey Nelia, did you finish my order?" you ask.
    
    "Oh! The fishnets! Yes. I have them just over here," she says. She shuffles around, stretching up to grab a simple wooden box off a table in the back end of her stand. She bounces back and around to hand the box[pc.heightRange 50| up] to you.
    
    "There you go! I hope you enjoy them, and please come back soon," she says with a wink. You thank her before heading back to your business with the new outfit in tow.
rows.translation:
“嘿，内莉娅，我订的东西做好了吗？”你问道。
    
    “哦！渔网装！做好了，就在这里。”她说着翻找起来，踮脚从摊位后方的桌上取下一只朴素的木盒。她蹦跳着回来，把盒子[pc.heightRange 50|向上]递给你。
    
    “给你！希望你会喜欢，也请早点再来。”她眨了眨眼。你向她道谢，随后带着新服装继续去忙自己的事。

rows.original: Sooooo, is she in the market for a new dye? "I could be, sweetie," Nelia says warmly. She leans forward to rest on the stall, her current sewing project temporarily forgotten. "Is there something specific you had in mind?" You heft your tin container onto the top of her stand and grin. Does she recognize it? The goblin shopkeep wrinkles her nose. "Ooof, that smells. And that decoration on the tin... is that a snail?" Raising an eyebrow, she brings a finger up to her cheek and frowns. "Huh. You know, this could be murex pigment. Very expensive Minoan stuff." [pc.isBimbo |Oh good, she knows what it is. You kinda forgot, hee hee. |Yeah, that's what you figured. ] Does she know what to do with it? Nelia confesses, "Never tried to do anything with it before — never even seen it, to be honest. But I'd love to experiment and try to figure it out. That's worth... hmm, you know, that's worth quite a lot to me. This dye goes for a pretty penny on the street, after all, and getting to play around with it is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for anyone who doesn't live under the mountains!" [pc.dcb |Cut to the chase: how much? |What kind of price is she offering? |Ooooh, muns! How many muns? ] "Hmm." She strokes her chin as if possessing a beard, then says, "500 hawks for the container. How does that sound to you?"
rows.translation: 所以——她有兴趣收购一种新染料吗？ “当然可能有，亲爱的。”内莉娅热情地说道。她俯身靠在摊位上，暂时将手头的缝纫活抛到脑后。“你具体想到了什么？” 你把锡制容器搬到她的摊位上，咧嘴一笑。她认得这东西吗？ 哥布林店主皱起鼻子。“呃，好臭。罐子上的装饰……那是一只蜗牛吗？”她挑起眉毛，用一根手指抵着脸颊，皱眉思索。“唔，你知道吗，这可能是骨螺紫染料。米诺斯的昂贵货色。” [pc.isBimbo |太好了，她知道这是什么。你自己倒有点忘了，嘿嘿。 |对，这正是你猜的东西。 ]那她知道该怎么使用吗？ 内莉娅坦言：“我以前从没用过——老实说，我甚至从没亲眼见过。但我很想拿它做做实验，弄清楚该怎么用。这东西对我来说值……嗯，值不少钱。毕竟这种染料在市面上价格不菲，而对于不住在群山之下的人来说，能亲手摆弄它可是一生难遇的机会！” [pc.dcb |直说吧：多少钱？ |她愿意出什么价？ |哦哦哦，有钱钱！多少份钱钱？ ] “嗯……”她摸着下巴，仿佛那里真长着胡子，随后说道：“这一罐我出500鹰币。你觉得怎么样？”

rows.original:
[flags.NELIA_AMALGAM
        |"Hey Nelia! Are you still up to work on those clothing designs for the unique friends we discussed before? I've got the money now!" you say, pulling out a small stack of electrum coins.
        
        "Sure I am! It'll still take about three days, though. Come back then and I'll have everything you asked for!" Nelia replies, taking the offered money. You head back to adventuring, anticipating the completion of your clothing commission.
        
        [var0]
        |"Hey, Nelia. I have some very uniquely shaped friends who need some clothing designed. I was wondering if you'd be available to help?" you ask.
        
        "I'm sure I could, but I'm going to need a little more information than 'uniquely shaped.' What exactly do you mean by that?" she laughs, waiting for you to explain before she starts digging for materials.
        
        You give a brief explanation of their shape, and then give a more in depth explanation of how Emrisse needs a pair of panties that can be put on without needing to go up her legs.
        
        "That's easy enough, there are styles of panties that tie at the hips!" she says, fishing for some brightly colored silk.
        
        While she looks, you explain Anisette's circumstances, and how she'll need similar, but for a full body dress. A normal outfit will mostly work for Leanore, but she'll need a skirt that ties at the waist.
        
        "You weren't kidding about them being uniquely shaped. Is this a curse of some kind? No matter, I can definitely help! It'll cost about a hundred electrum per outfit, half that for the first one, and about three days time. That sound ok?"
    ]

        “当然还在忙呢！不过大概还需要三天的时间。到时候你再来，我就会把你要求的所有东西都准备好！”内莉娅接过你递来的钱，回答道。你继续踏上了新的冒险旅程，期待着这些服装设计能够顺利完成。

rows.original: "You need your hair styled? Not a problem." Aurera smiles faintly, snipping her scissors idly at the air. "Anything you have in mind?"
