rows.raw: '\n    "You need your hair styled? Not a problem." Aurera smiles faintly, snipping her scissors idly at the air. "Anything you have in mind?" '

rows.original: [var1 |Aurera tuts, trailing her fingers gently through your [pc.hair]. "Aaah, such a waste of my grand talents. But I'd be a poor fucking sight if I coul—" "Language!" Claire interrupts from the other side of the room. "A poor sight," the anubian sighs, "if I couldn't help you achieve perfect smoothness." Aurera claps her hands together a moment later, gesturing towards the selection of chairs. "Pick a chair, the right height please. Don't want me clipping where I shouldn't clip." Claire approaches as you pick out a chair, wrapping some cloth around your neck to catch any loose fuzz. "It takes a little longer than just a haircut, by the way. She'll have to trim you down, then shave you. Or it'll hurt." The anubian interrupts your chat with a menacing snip-snip, gently shoo-ing her wife away. "Let's get you smooth, [pc.mascFem|handsome|cute-stuff]." Her touch is a soft one as she finds her way through little tangles or matted points, but there's no need for soaps or oils or any tool fancier than her scissors — at least to start with. ...Then Aurera gets out a wicked set of keen-looking silver blades, turning them over end-to-end to catch the light. When she catches you looking there's just a smug grin as she plucks up a loose hair and lets go, winking at you when nothing but its gentle fall serves to split it down the middle on the blade. "You'll sit still, yes?" You bet your fucking ass you'll sit still. Her half-lupine milkslut of a wife is irritatingly bubbly about your sudden discomfort, but it's hard to stay mad when she blows you a kiss and brings over a tray of foamy-looking liquid. She rubs it into your head, smiling when your hackles rise at the odd tickling sensation it leaves on you. "You'll be fine, seriously." It's hard to believe it when the borker seems to think it's necessary to comfort you, but it's not like you can get away at all. The blade comes down... with expert precision, drawing gently down the back of your head and to the base of your neck before returning the journey against the grain. Each motion is met by a slow wipe-off on the cloth wrapped around your neck, followed by another smooth swipe across your increasingly-chilly scalp. By the time she's done you can actually feel the anubian's breath on your sensitive scalp, accompanied by the soft jingle-jangle of her bangles as she steps away to clean her tools. "All done, not a nick on you... so incandescently smooth, and ready for the boy or girl of your dreams to give it a smooch." Her short tail fwips from side-to-side when Claire tiptoes to kiss the anubian's own head, pressing into the perfectly straight locks. "I prefer having something to bury my face into," she insists with a wicked grin. "Mmmmmine." While they're busy fondling each other, you extricate yourself from the chair and run a hand over your bald head. Smooth, shiny, easy to maintain. |Aurera looks you over, twirling her scissors before gesturing to a set of chairs of differing heights and widths. "Slide your [pc.mascFem|charming ass|cutie rear] into one of these seats — the correct height please." The moment you're seated, she settles a little cape around your neck to catch any falling hair, twirling her scissors with dextrous digits. She sinks her fingers into your hair and draws it out, rubbing and scratching gently with her fingernails until you're shivering in delight. "You've got incredibly good, healthy hair. Many a man or woman would be envious of this; it's perfect for cutting, growing, dyeing..." Aurera lets a soft sigh slip from her lips. "You wouldn't believe how much work I have to do on my own." You can hear a soft bark of laughter, although Claire's out of your peripheral vision. "That's a lie, you toootally just love my hands all up inside, giving you a nice soapy headrub and using the oils." "I'm spanking her later," the anubian insists. "So much." Thankfully your amused snort doesn't result in getting jabbed by scissors, but it does bring the elegant stylist back to reality. There's a soft jangle of bangles and a chiming of gentle beads clicking together when she gets to work in earnest. rows.translation: 短波波头。
扎一些漂亮的辫子吧。
适用于所有发长的卷发造型。

rows.original: Neaten all those edges up so you look good in a ponytail.
rows.translation: 把那些边缘都整理整齐，这样扎马尾辫的时候看起来才会更漂亮。
rows.raw: "Neaten all those edges up so you look good in a ponytail."

rows.original: A classic look for the adventurer everyone wants to stroke.
rows.translation: 一款适合人人都想抚摸的冒险者的经典造型。
rows.raw: "A classic look for the adventurer everyone wants to stroke."

rows.original: Loose shaggy locks, like everyone's favorite demon.
rows.translation: 松散而蓬乱的头发，就像大家心中最喜欢的恶魔一样。
rows.raw: "Loose shaggy locks, like everyone's favorite demon."

rows.original: Short and close to the head.
rows.translation: 短小且紧贴头部。

rows.original: Get your hair gelled and twisted into dreadlocks.
rows.translation: 把头发弄成凝胶状，然后编成脏辫。
rows.raw: "Get your hair gelled and twisted into dreadlocks."

rows.original: Get dreadlocks and have them tied back. Your edges get gelled and shaped up as well.
rows.translation: 留上脏辫，然后把它们扎在后面。这样，你的发边也能被定型并梳理整齐。
rows.raw: "Get dreadlocks and have them tied back. Your edges get gelled and shaped up as well."

rows.translation: 朋克风的侧削发，再配上脏辫！

rows.original: An afro of tightly curled hair.
rows.translation: 一头紧卷的爆炸头。

rows.original: The afro is long enough to be tied back into a pony tail.Your edges are gelled and shaped as well.
rows.translation: 这个爆炸头长到可以扎成马尾辫。你的发边也经过了定型处理，形状非常整齐。
rows.raw: "The afro is long enough to be tied back into a pony tail.Your edges are gelled and shaped as well."

rows.original: Get your tightly curled afro braided back and split into two large afro puffs.
rows.translation: 把你那紧卷的爆炸头编成辫子拢到脑后，再分成两个大大的爆炸头蓬蓬发。
rows.raw: "Get your tightly curled afro braided back and split into two large afro puffs."

rows.translation: 整齐、干净、笔直。

rows.original: A punky sidecut, shaven on one side and left long on the other.
rows.translation: 朋克风的侧削发，一侧剃光，另一侧留长。
rows.raw: "A punky sidecut, shaven on one side and left long on the other."

rows.translation: 只剪掉几英寸。
将头发剃得干净光滑。

rows.original: Not so much a style, more so the lack of it. For those who want a more natural look.
rows.translation: 与其说这是一种风格，不如说是一种风格的缺失。对于那些希望获得更加自然外观的人来说，这种设计正是他们所需要的。
rows.raw: "Not so much a style, more so the lack of it. For those who want a more natural look."

rows.original: Dual ponytails placed on opposite sides of your head.
rows.translation: 将两条马尾辫分别扎在头部的两侧。
rows.raw: "Dual ponytails placed on opposite sides of your head."

rows.original: Pulls and twirls a large part of your hair into a swirling bun.
rows.translation: 将你大部分的头发挽成一个旋转式的发髻。
rows.raw: "Pulls and twirls a large part of your hair into a swirling bun."

rows.original: Common among soldiers, most of your hair is shaved off the sides while the hair on top is flattened out.
rows.translation: 在士兵中很常见：你的头发两侧大部分被剃光，而头顶的头发则被压平。
rows.raw: "Common among soldiers, most of your hair is shaved off the sides while the hair on top is flattened out."

rows.original: Mostly bald, with a straight strip of hair left on top going from front to back.
rows.translation: 大部分头发都已经脱落，只有头顶从前到后留着一条直长的头发。
rows.raw: "Mostly bald, with a straight strip of hair left on top going from front to back."

rows.original: An %"experimental" style where your hair is shaped into unnatural spikes using some kind of alchemic conditioner to help it maintain its shape.
rows.translation: 这种“实验性”发型是通过使用某种特殊的护发产品将头发塑造成不自然的尖刺状，以此来保持其形状。
rows.raw: 'An %"experimental" style where your hair is shaped into unnatural spikes using some kind of alchemic conditioner to help it maintain its shape.'

rows.original: The sides of your head cut into fade, but the top is tied dreadlocks. Somehow the faded part never grows, only the dreadlocks.
rows.translation: 你头部两侧的头发剪成了渐层短发，但头顶部分却扎成了脏辫。奇怪的是，渐层的那部分从来不会生长，只有脏辫会继续长。
rows.raw: "The sides of your head cut into fade, but the top is tied dreadlocks. Somehow the faded part never grows, only the dreadlocks."

rows.original: An afro that obscures one or both eyes.
rows.translation: 一种会遮住一只或两只眼睛的爆炸头。
rows.raw: "An afro that obscures one or both eyes."

rows.original: The hair on the sides and back of your head are cut to be shorter than the top. Increasingly short as the hair goes down your skull to a create %"fade" effect. Somehow the faded bit never grows, only the top.
rows.translation: 你头部两侧和后部的头发被剪得比顶部的头发短。这些头发越往下延伸，长度就越短，从而形成一种“渐层”效果。奇怪的是，那些被剪短的头发永远不会重新生长，只有顶部的头发会继续生长。
rows.raw: 'The hair on the sides and back of your head are cut to be shorter than the top. Increasingly short as the hair goes down your skull to a create %"fade" effect. Somehow the faded bit never grows, only the top.'

rows.original: The hair is sectioned out into boxes or triangles. Each section is braided diligently resulting in a cascade of shiny wonderful braids hanging from your head. Your hairline is gelled, leaving wave like wisps of hair lining your forehead and cheeks.
rows.translation: 头发被分成方块或三角形的区块，每一块都被用心地编成辫子，最终形成一串串闪闪发亮、漂亮的辫子，垂在你的头上。你的发际线用发胶固定住，留下波浪般的发丝贴在额头和脸颊两侧。
rows.raw: "The hair is sectioned out into boxes or triangles. Each section is braided diligently resulting in a cascade of shiny wonderful braids hanging from your head. Your hairline is gelled, leaving wave like wisps of hair lining your forehead and cheeks."

rows.original: Your hair is braided on both sides of your head upward. They meet at the top of your head creating a large braid in the style of a pompadour. If your hair is particularly long the braid in the middle also turns into a ponytail.
rows.translation: 你的头发在头部的两侧都被向上编成辫子，这两条辫子在头顶处交汇，形成了一个类似蓬巴杜发型的大型辫子。如果你的头发特别长，中间的那条辫子也会被扎成马尾辫。
rows.raw: "Your hair is braided on both sides of your head upward. They meet at the top of your head creating a large braid in the style of a pompadour. If your hair is particularly long the braid in the middle also turns into a ponytail."

rows.original: Get your hair slicked and gelled into a Pompadour.
rows.translation: 把头发梳得服帖并抹上发胶，做成蓬巴杜发型。
rows.raw: "Get your hair slicked and gelled into a Pompadour."

rows.original: Your hair flows back into fluffy spikes behind your head. Two large bangs hang down and outline your face.
rows.translation: 你的头发向后飘散，在脑后形成蓬松的尖刺状。两束长长的刘海垂下来，勾勒出你的脸型。
rows.raw: "Your hair flows back into fluffy spikes behind your head. Two large bangs hang down and outline your face."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: Claire slips in alongside Aurera, smiling softly. "I can help you pick out some makeup. Anything you're interested in? I can do your nails or claws, eyeshadow, lipstick. All in a number of matching styles!"
rows.translation: 克莱尔微笑着凑到奥蕾拉身边：“我可以帮你挑选一些化妆品。你有什么感兴趣的吗？我还可以帮你美甲或修剪爪子，画眼影、涂口红哦！所有这些都可以搭配成统一的风格呢！”
rows.raw: '\n    Claire slips in alongside Aurera, smiling softly. "I can help you pick out some makeup. Anything you\'re interested in? I can do your nails or claws, eyeshadow, lipstick. All in a number of matching styles!"'

rows.original: Claire smiles and gestures you towards a chair, fetching her goodies. A fine set of tools consisting of brushes and soft balls of fluff, and some thin wooden boxes full of powders and paints. "Okay [pc.name]. Set your butt down, and I'll do the first application for you! After this it's easy, I'll give you a little touch-up kit for after and you can keep this sweet look going from day-to-day. You won't even have to think about it." The buxom pupper sets to her task with well-practiced hands, gently drawing lines about your eyes, dusting them with shadow, and touching up the edges. Her hands are delicate and soft, slowly brushing across you while she explains each step so that you can repeat it for yourself every day. "See? It's not so hard. It's good that you don't blink and flinch a lot, too." You're used to scarier things than eye-liners, to be honest. Claire leans in and gives you a little 'puff!', taking away a loose eyelash. "Done! Not bad, huh?" She hands you a tiny wooden box with touch-up brushes and a makeup pencil, smiling and tail-wagging.
rows.translation: 克莱尔微笑着示意你坐到椅子上，转身取来她的宝贝工具：一套精巧的刷具、柔软的绒球，以及几个装满粉末和颜料的薄木盒。“好了，[pc.name]。把屁股坐稳，我来替你完成第一次上妆！之后就很简单了，我会送你一套补妆用的小工具，让你每天都能维持这副漂亮模样，根本不用费心。” 这位胸部丰满的犬娘以娴熟的手法开始工作，轻轻勾勒你的眼部线条，扫上眼影，再仔细修饰边缘。她的双手柔软而灵巧，缓缓拂过你的肌肤，同时逐步讲解，让你以后每天都能自己照着做。“看吧？并不难。你不会老是眨眼或躲闪，这一点也很方便。” 说实话，你早已习惯面对比眼线笔可怕得多的东西。 克莱尔凑近，对着你轻轻“呼！”了一下，吹走一根松脱的睫毛。“完成！还不错吧？”她笑着摇动尾巴，将一个装有补妆刷和化妆笔的小木盒递给你。

        “嗯……就这样。还有，请把嘴唇抿紧哦！”她做出亲吻的动作，那双可爱的小耳朵也在不停地摇动。

rows.translation: 亲吻她

rows.original: Sure, you'll purse your lips... and snatch a kiss! Her ears go on end, her eyebrows rise, and a muted yelp buries itself in her throat. She huffs when you finish, a little blush burning on her freckled face. "Hey, you want to play with me, Aurera has to be involved." Claire continues to mutter a 'bad [pc.mf|boy|girl]', but you purse your lips for her properly so that she can paint them. There's still a little blush in her cheeks by the time she's finished painting your lips, but she looks satisfied with her work. "Perfect. Here's your own kit!" She hands you a little wooden box full of goodies to keep your lipstick maintained, nodding firmly. "You'll get so used to it you won't even notice; but you'd better believe everyone else will with a look like that."
rows.translation: 当然，你会撅起嘴唇……然后抢一个吻！她的耳朵立刻竖了起来，眉毛也扬了起来，一声压低的惊呼几乎要从她的喉咙里冲出来。当你吻完后，她气呼呼地哼了一声，她那长满雀斑的脸上泛起了红晕。“喂，你想和我一起玩的话，奥蕾拉肯定也要参与才行。”克莱尔继续小声嘟囔着‘[pc.mf|坏小子|坏丫头]’，但你还是认真地抿紧嘴唇，好让她能够画上唇线。 当她画完你的嘴唇后，她的脸颊上还带着一丝红晕，但她看起来对自己的作品非常满意。“太完美了！这是你的专属工具包！”她递给你一个装满各种保养用品的小木盒，坚定地点了点头：“你会习惯这些的，甚至都不会注意到它们的存在；但可以肯定的是，别人看到你这样的嘴唇，肯定能立刻注意到。”

照做即可

rows.original: With a grin that belies your momentary train of thought, you purse your lips and wait for her. Claire smiles and nods back at you, carefully painting your lips. By the time she withdraws her little brush and dips it in some water she looks satisfied, judging her work with a careful stare. "Perfect. Here's your own kit!" She hands you a little wooden box full of goodies to keep your lipstick maintained, nodding firmly. "You'll get so used to it you won't even notice; but you'd better believe everyone else will with a look like that."
rows.translation: 你露出一个掩饰了自己此刻思绪的微笑，抿紧嘴唇等待着她。克莱尔也微笑着向你点头，然后仔细地描绘着你的嘴唇。当她收回小画笔，将其浸入水中时，她看起来非常满意，用审视的目光仔细检查着自己的作品。“太好了。这是你自己的工具包！”她递给你一个装满各种保养用品的小木盒，一边坚定地点头说：“你会习惯这些用品的，甚至都不会注意到它们的存在；但可以肯定的是，其他人看到你这样的打扮，肯定会注意到的。”

rows.original: Hey, be cool. Her wife is right over there.
rows.translation: 嘿，冷静点。她的妻子就在那边。
rows.raw: "Hey, be cool. Her wife is right over there."

rows.original:
[var0
            |Claire nods sagely and waves you towards her little workspace chair, scooping up a jar full of colorless liquid. "Okidoki; make sure to not breathe too deeply, and be sure to wash your hands gently for a day or so after!" 

            You're settled down in your seat, and the curvy half-lupine soaks the polish in liquid before applying a tough-bristled brush. A few slow, careful scrubs is all it takes to have the polish peeling away... although maybe you should be concerned that she sees fit to hold her breath every time she gets close to them. When the sting creeps into you she blows gently on your fingers and daubs them with water, tail gently wagging when it seems your discomfort is only temporary. "Damn, I'm jealous of you tough adventurer-types sometimes. My fingers get itchy for days when I remove polish."
            
            Once finished, she blows your fingers dry and hurriedly reseals the jar she'd been using. "Bleh. Okay! All done, anything troubling you?" You shake your head a no, and Claire pats you gently on the head. "Awesome, thanks again for your service."
            |Claire grins and claps her hands. "Excellent, I love doing nails and claws. Sit in the chair, feet on the stool, hands on the little bench." The cheerful half-lupine guides you towards a seat of wood and cushions, adjusting it for your height and settling you in place. Once properly propped up she grabs a wooden box and two brushes, revealing the box to be full of thick, acrid-smelling paint. "Heh, I know. Smell takes a bit to get used to, but it goes away once it's dried, and then it goes hard so it won't chip super easy."

            [pc.hasFeet|She giggles when you fidget at her painting of your toes,|She sighs when you turn out to have hooves — although she makes sure to file some rough edges away and make sure they're nicely polished —] before moving onto your fingers. The curvaceous redhead hums a happy tune, making sure your nails are shiny and glistening before blowing gently on them. "Awesome, you have some good ol' scratchers for this."
            
            Claire waits until your nails are completely dry before she allows you to move again, and once you do there's a wooden box placed in your grasp. "Here, you can use this to patch up any time you chip, or outgrow it. It's super simple to keep maintained, honest."
        ]
rows.translation:
[var0
            |克莱尔煞有介事地点了点头，挥手示意你坐上小工作区的椅子，接着拿起一罐无色液体。“好嘞；记得别吸得太深，之后一天左右也一定要轻轻洗手！” 

            你在座位上坐稳，这位身材丰腴的半狼族姑娘用液体浸透指甲油，随后拿来一把硬毛刷。只消缓慢而仔细地刷上几下，指甲油便开始剥落……不过，她每次靠近你的指甲时都特意屏住呼吸，或许你确实该担心一下。刺痛感渐渐袭来时，她轻轻吹拂你的手指，又用水点洗；见你的不适只是暂时的，她的尾巴便轻轻摇了起来。“该死，有时候我真羡慕你们这些皮糙肉厚的冒险者。我卸掉指甲油后，手指总要痒上好几天。”
            
            完工后，她吹干你的手指，连忙重新封好刚才使用的罐子。“呸。好啦！全部完成，还有哪里不舒服吗？”你摇头否认，克莱尔轻轻拍了拍你的脑袋。“太好了，再次感谢你的服务。”
            |克莱尔咧嘴一笑，拍起双手。“太棒了，我最喜欢给指甲和爪子上色。坐到椅子上，双脚放上凳子，双手放到小台子上。”这位开朗的半狼族姑娘将你领向一张木制软垫椅，按照你的身高调整好，让你安稳坐下。等你妥善倚好后，她取来一只木箱和两把刷子；打开一看，箱中装满了浓稠刺鼻的颜料。“嘿，我知道。这个味道得花点时间适应，不过干透后就会消失，而且颜料会变得很硬，不容易出现缺口。”

            [pc.hasFeet|她给你的脚趾上色时，你不安分地动来动去，惹得她咯咯直笑；|她发现你长着蹄子，不禁叹了口气——不过她还是锉平了几处粗糙的边缘，确保蹄子被打磨得光洁漂亮——]随后才开始处理你的手指。这位身材丰腴的红发姑娘哼着欢快的小调，仔细将你的指甲涂得光洁闪亮，然后轻轻吹拂。“真棒，你这副老练的利爪很适合上色。”
            
            克莱尔等到你的指甲完全干透才允许你再次活动；你刚一动弹，一只木盒便被放进了手中。“拿着，要是哪里磕掉了，或者指甲长长了，你随时可以用它补色。维护起来真的超级简单。”
        ]

rows.original:
Claire blinks and smiles, tail wagging. "Looking to feel freshened up? We can get all the makeup off. I know, just a normal wash tends to leave it mostly intact huh? Don't worry about it." The half-lupine grabs a small bronze pot, dipping her fingers into it and gathering up a cream. "This one's less abrasive than our scrubs, but Aurera figured out a really nice mixture to help get rid of the oils that make up the makeup." She giggles at her vague wordplay, leaning over you and dabbing cream onto the makeup-covered portions of your face.

    "You'll feel a tiny tingle, don't lick your lips please! It smells of wild fruits, but I promise it won't taste of it."
    
    "Mhm." 
    
    She snickers softly at your grunt, gently dabbing away and rubbing on more cream with a cloth, repeating the process until the cloth comes away clean still. By the time she's done you're still tingling — and a tiny bit itchy — but a small splash of cold water seems to resolve that straight away. "Aaand done. Spotless!" Claire baps your nose gently and steps away, drying her hands on a fresh cloth and tossing it over to you. "Anything else?"
rows.translation:
克莱尔眨了眨眼，露出了微笑，尾巴也欢快地摇动着。“想要让肌肤焕然一新吗？我们可以把所有的妆容都卸掉哦。我知道，普通的洗脸通常只能让妆容保持大部分原状，对吧？别担心。”这个半狼族女孩拿起了一个小青铜罐，将手指浸入其中，取出一团乳霜。这种清洁产品比我们之前用的那些清洁剂要温和一些，但奥蕾拉调配出了一种非常有效的配方，能够帮助去除化妆品中含有的油脂。”她一边说着，一边因为自己这种含糊的表述而轻笑起来，然后凑近你，在你脸上那些被化妆品覆盖的地方轻轻涂抹这款面霜。

    你会感觉到有一丝刺痛的感觉，请不要舔嘴唇哦！它闻起来像野果，但我保证它的味道并不像野果。”
    
    “嗯。”
    
    听到你这样的回答，她轻声笑了起来，然后轻轻地将你嘴唇上的东西擦掉，再用布再涂一些乳霜，重复这个过程，直到布擦过来时已经完全干净了。等她弄完的时候，你的皮肤依然会感到一阵刺痛，还有点发痒，但用一点冷水冲洗一下，这些症状立刻就消失了。“好了，干干净净的！”克莱尔轻轻拍拍你的鼻子，然后走开，用一块干净的布擦了擦手，再把布扔给你。还有其他事情吗？

You crane your head up and wait while she wipes your neck down carefully, making sure there are no abrasions or scratches already pleasant. "Try to keep swallowing gentle, and don't squirm." She nods and gives your chin a little tap, before pulling out a selection of wooden sticks covered in thin needles, and what would appear to be a tiny hammer. She opens her jars of dye, and swabs the inside of the empty wooden box with the contents of the clear-liquid jar; "keep your tools clean," is all she gives you by way of explanation. What follows is an unpleasant period of having tiny, dye-covered needles punched into your throat. You're not able to do anything besides look directly up at the roof, or stare down at the ground depending on what side of your neck she's working on. The anubian similarly is not much of a conversationalist when she's trying not to stab you too deeply in the throat or jugular. A low groan slowly builds up in the base of your throat, itching heat building up on sensitive skin unused to constant stress... Eventually that comes to an end though, and Aurera slowly wraps her hands around your neck. Damn, ow. You're sore. Thankfully a soothing glow seeps from Claire's digits a moment later, trailing tendrils of white magic that settle into you with a coolness to wash away the burning sting. "Done. Don't scratch for a few days though! Definitely keep the pet-play to a minimum, don't want to tug a collar on this." It's slightly awkward having both Claire and Aurera holding up mirrors so you can see it all, but wow... you've got a pretty cool [pc.neckTattoo] tattoo.
rows.translation: 当你舒适地坐下来后，奥雷拉拿出了一个木箱、一个装着透明液体的玻璃罐，以及几小瓶装有彩色染料的玻璃瓶。“先提醒你一下，这个过程会让你觉得有点难受。不过最终的效果一定会很棒，而且我有足够的治愈魔法来缓解过程中的疼痛。只是这个过程本身确实不太舒服罢了。 你必须始终保持坐姿端正，脱掉上衣，同时努力忽略奥雷拉那充满欲望的目光。你仰起头，静静地等待着她仔细地擦拭你的脖子，确保没有留下任何擦伤或划痕。尽量慢慢吞咽，不要扭动身体。”她点了点头，轻轻敲了敲你的下巴，然后拿出一堆覆盖着细小针刺的木棍，还有看起来像是一把小锤子的东西。她打开那些装着染料的罐子，用其中一个透明液体罐里的染料擦拭那个空木盒的内壁；“要保持工具的清洁”，她只是这样简单地向你解释道。 接下来，你会经历一段相当不舒服的时光——有人会用那些被染色的小针刺入你的喉咙。在这段时间里，你什么也做不了，只能要么直直地盯着天花板看，要么低头看着地面，具体取决于医生正在处理你脖子的哪一侧。当这位阿努比亚人试图不至于将刀刺得太深、伤及你的喉咙或颈动脉时，她同样不太喜欢与人交谈。一种低沉的呻吟声会慢慢在你喉咙深处响起，那种灼热的感觉会逐渐在那些不习惯持续承受压力的敏感皮肤上蔓延开来。然而，这一切最终还是结束了，奥蕾拉缓缓地将双手环绕在你的脖子上。 该死，好疼……你真会疼痛的幸运的是，片刻之后，克莱尔的指尖散发出柔和的光芒，那些白色的魔法丝带缓缓笼罩在你身上，带来的清凉感缓解了那种灼热的刺痛。“好了。不过接下来几天千万不要抓挠哦！一定要尽量减少与它的‘亲密接触’，可不想弄伤它啊。” 让克莱尔和奥蕾拉同时举着镜子让你能清楚地看到整个过程，确实有点尴尬……不过，哇……真是太神奇了！你这个[pc.neckTattoo]纹身的想法相当不错啊。

rows.original: Aurera laughs when you have to get yourself naked. "Come on, there's no need to be bashful. Pants off and up on the table." Once you're sat comfortably she pulls out a wooden box, a glass jar of clear liquid, and a number of small glass bottles filled with colorful dye. "Fair warning; this will suck for you. "There! No problems at all! Be careful with it though, y'hear?" Although you've been watching the whole process from start to finish, it's still amazing to get a real look at your brand new [pc.legTattoo] tats.

rows.translation: 当你舒适地坐好后，奥蕾拉拿出了一个木箱、一个装着透明液体的玻璃罐，以及几小瓶里面装着五颜六色染料的玻璃瓶。“事先提醒你，这个过程会让你觉得有点难受。不过最终的效果一定会很棒，而且我的治愈魔法也足以在之后消除你的疼痛。只是这个过程本身确实不太舒服而已。” 在整个过程中，你都必须保持直立的姿势，而且还得脱掉上衣。同时，你还得努力忽略奥蕾拉那充满诱惑的眼神。总之，这个过程确实有点不容易彻底的对你的检查[pc.chest]她接着检查了你的手臂，然后拿出一堆覆盖着细小针刺的木棍，以及一个看起来像小锤子的工具。她打开了那些装着染料的罐子，用其中一个透明液体罐里的内容物擦拭那个空木盒的内部；“要保持工具的清洁”，她只是这样简单地向你解释道。 接下来，你会经历一段令人不适的时光——那些被染色的细针会被扎进你的手臂。在过程中会有那么一刻，你会误以为一切都结束了……直到你意识到，她还有另一只手臂等着被刺。当你能够直视她的脸时，你会看到她是多么的镇定；你可以称之为一种自然的专注状态，但当你触碰到她那些特别敏感的部位时，她的耳朵偶尔会微微抽动。不过，这种状态最终也会结束，而奥蕾拉会将那些略带血迹的双手放在你疼痛的四肢上。 等她处理完这些，那种灼热的刺痛感已经消失了。幸运的是，克莱尔就在旁边，能够照顾你的需求。白色的魔法能量像冷却的触须一样渗透进你的皮肤，将那种不适感转化成了令人舒缓的平静。“处理完毕了。不过这几天千万不要抓挠，否则如果你再回来需要重新处理，奥蕾拉肯定会生气的。小狗因为用力而额头上冒出了细小的汗珠，但除此之外，它的表情依然像往常一样开心。 你站在镜子前打量着自己，欣赏着自己那漂亮的新墨水；你手臂上的[pc.armTattoo]纹身相当不错！

"Fair warning; this will suck for you. End result should be lovely, and I know enough healing magic to whisk away the pain afterwards. The process is just unpleasant." You have to stay upright the entire time, getting topless and trying to ignore the lusty look Aurera's giving you. After a thorough inspection of your [pc.chest] she moves onto checking your arms before pulling out a selection of wooden sticks covered in thin needles, and what would appear to be a tiny hammer. She opens her jars of dye, and swabs the inside of the empty wooden box with the contents of the clear-liquid jar; "keep your tools clean," is all she gives you by way of explanation. What follows is an unpleasant period of having tiny, dye-covered needles punched into your arms. There's an awkward pause partway through where you think it's all over... before realizing she has the whole other arm left to go. When you're able to look her in the face you can see how calm she is; casual concentration you'd call it, but for the way her ears occasionally twitch when you hiss at an extra-sensitive spot. Eventually that comes to an end though, and Aurera rests slightly-bloody hands on your aching limbs. rows.original: Aurera grins and settles you into a chair. "I may love nice thick hair on top, but I will always be a sucker for a nice smooth face." She runs her hands along your jawline, tutting at the roughness and the sound of abrasion against her perfect fingernails. "We'll soon fix this." She fetches a thick cream that reminds you more of cooking fat than anything, but it foams up a little on contact with your [pc.beard]. After a few minutes of waiting she quickly snips away thickest portions of your facial hair, finding it comes away easy with a razor-sharp 'snikt-snikt'. There's no humming, or cheerful hip-swaying — although to be fair Claire's doing more than enough of that for both of them — but it still proves to be a relaxing feeling... at least until she finishes with the scissors and pulls out a wickedly-sharp silver razor. You watch as she drops a hair onto the blade and it splits cleanly down the length, unable to keep yourself from gulping. "Don't tense up please," she sighs. "I wouldn't want to split you open because you get a cramp in your shoulder or something." Your fingers are still digging into the chair, but at least you stay still for the anubian to finish sliding a literally-razor-sharp-blade along your skin. In all fairness, her hand is steady and swift, running once down your face, and then a second time against the grain to ensure that you're perfectly smooth. She drops her razor into a jar of clear liquid afterwards, while Claire walks up and dabs your face down with a cool, wet cloth. "Mmmm, smooth. Looking good [pc.mascFem|handsome|cutie]." You've now got a perfectly-smooth face!
rows.translation: 奥雷拉微笑着把你扶到椅子上。“虽然我喜欢浓密的头发，但我还是更迷恋光滑细腻的肌肤。”她用手轻轻抚摸你的下颌线，对于那些粗糙的地方以及那些与她那完美的指甲相摩擦时发出的声音，她显得有些不满。“我们很快就会解决这个问题的。” 然后她拿出一管质地浓稠的乳霜——这种乳霜看起来更像烹饪用油，但一旦接触到你的皮肤，就会立刻起泡[pc.beard]等了几分钟后，她迅速剪掉了你脸上那些较粗的胡须，那些胡须似乎很容易就被她那锋利如剃刀的工具剪掉了。嘶嘶声没有哼唱，也没有欢快的摇摆动作——不过公平地说，克莱尔已经为她们俩做了足够多的这类事情了——但这种氛围依然让人感到放松……至少在她用完剪刀、拿出那把锋利无比的银色剃须刀之前是这样。 你看着她把一根头发扔到刀刃上，刀刃立刻沿着头发的长度整齐地切了下去，你忍不住倒吸了一口凉气。“请不要紧张，”她轻声说道，“我可不想因为你的肩膀抽筋之类的原因而把你切伤啊。你的手指仍然紧紧抓着椅子，但至少你没有动弹，让那个使用锋利如剃刀的刀刃的人能够顺利完成操作。公平地说，她的动作非常稳准且迅速——她的刀刃先从你的脸上划过一次，然后又逆着方向划过一次，以确保你的皮肤被处理得十分光滑。 之后，她把剃须刀放进了装满透明液体的罐子里，而克莱尔则走过来，用一块凉爽湿润的布轻轻擦拭你的脸。“嗯，真舒服，看起来不错呢。 [pc.mascFem|英俊的|可爱的人或物]。" 现在，你的脸庞已经变得无比光滑了！

rows.original: You're escorted to one of Aurera's various chairs, and the anubian trails her fingers along your jawline before she slips away again. When she returns it's with a thick cream that smells more like food than anything, and she smears it into your beard and waits for a minute before digging into her business with gusto. Her bangles jangle pleasantly while Claire busies herself around in the background, and you let your eyes drift closed as her scissors begin to snip while a fine-toothed comb performs its work. It's soothing as a process; it's almost a shame just how quickly she's finished with those slender fingers, but when she steps away and fetches a mirror you can see it... You've got [a] [pc.beard]! Nice.

rows.original:
[pc.dcb|"Let's fuck, fuck like dumb, horny animals."|"Aurera... would you be interested in a little fun?"|"Hey, you know, you're like. Super hot and stuff. Wanna fuck?"]

    Aurera smirks, pinching Claire's ear before the ginger half-wolf can speak up. "We would hear no end of it from the rest of Hawkethorne if we just pounded it out with any [pc.mascFem|handsome bastard|adorable little bitch] who came our way. How about you do us a favor first?"
    
    "What kind of favor?"
    
    "I don't like sending Claire out to fetch ingredients for dyes and scrubs, and I really don't like buying directly from the ladies here— nothing personal, of course, it's just that it would get expensive rather quickly. If you were to bring us, say... three winterstem, we could use it to fertilize our own tiny crop."
    
    "Isn't winterstem just used for getting high?"
    
    The anubian snorts in amusement, idly rubbing her wife's scalp. "It certainly has that use... primarily, in fact, but it's great in compost. Just not in large batches, or it'll taint the crop. Or so I've heard."
    
    "Or so you've heard?"
    
    Claire is the one to pipe up this time, smirking and wagging her tail. "Fuck, I remember that. We sold every drop of hair-dye we had that week, you'd get stoned to the gills on headrubs."
    
    Sounds neat.
    
    "Anyway—" Aurera pauses and grumbles when her fingers end up getting nibbled. "Three winterstem and I can use it for all sorts."
rows.translation:
[pc.dcb|我们来做爱吧，像那些愚蠢又充满欲望的动物一样。|奥蕾拉……有兴趣来点有趣的事情吗？|嘿，你知道吗，你简直太性感了，想不想来点什么？]

    奥雷拉 smirk着，在那个红发半狼来得及开口之前，捏了捏克莱尔的耳朵：“如果我们随便解决这件事，鹰棘镇的其他人肯定会没完没了地抱怨个不停。 [pc.mascFem|帅气的混蛋|可爱的小贱人]那些来找我们的人。你能不能先帮我们一个忙？”
    
    “什么忙？”
    
    “我不太愿意让克莱尔去外面采购制作染料和清洁剂所需的材料，也不太愿意直接从这里的女士们那里购买这些东西——当然，这并没有什么个人恩怨，只是这样的话费用会很快累积起来，变得相当高。如果你能给我们带来比如说……三株冬茎，我们就可以用它们来为我们的小作物施肥。”
    
    “冬茎不就是用来让人产生兴奋感的吗？”
